Vilniaus maratonas 2023. Bėgikai gatvėje, renginio vieta.

name: 45 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Polska
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining to pieszy rajd na orientację, w którym drużyny 2-5 osobowe planują własną trasę, aby w wyznaczonym czasie odwiedzić jak najwięcej punktów kontrolnych rozmieszczonych w terenie i oznaczonych na mapie. Zawody są otwarte dla uczestników w różnym wieku i o różnym stopniu zaawansowania, zarówno dla pasjonatów, jak i osób startujących rekreacyjnie, w tym rodzin. Rogaining ma charakter turystyczno-sportowy i pozwala na dowolne modyfikowanie trasy podczas rywalizacji, co czyni go atrakcyjną formą aktywności na łonie natury. Impreza organizowana jest przez Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej, które od lat prowadzi zawody na orientację w regionie.
course_highlights: Drużyny poruszają się wyłącznie pieszo, używając mapy i kompasu do orientacji w terenie
Punkty kontrolne mają różną wartość punktową zależną od trudności ich odnalezienia
Możliwość samodzielnego wyboru i zmiany trasy o dowolnej długości, od 5 do 70 km
additional: Zawody są otwarte dla wszystkich grup wiekowych i płci. Drużyny składają się z 2-5 osób. Rogaining ma charakter turystyczno-sportowy, odpowiedni zarówno dla zaawansowanych zawodników, jak i rodzin. Można zmieniać trasę w trakcie zawodów. W 2026 roku planowane są cztery edycje rogainingu w okolicach Strzelina, w tym 45. edycja w listopadzie. Zawody obejmują różne dystanse od 5 km do 70 km, z mapami i kompasami, przeznaczone dla różnych poziomów zaawansowania, z możliwością rywalizacji rekreacyjnej i sportowej.

name: Szybka Piątka
description: Szybka Piątka to bieg na dystansie 5 km organizowany w Lublinie, który odbywa się 29 listopada 2026 roku. Impreza jest częścią cyklu biegów organizowanych przez Fundację Rozwoju Sportu w Lublinie, promującej aktywność fizyczną i integrację społeczności lokalnej. Bieg jest doskonałą okazją dla biegaczy na różnych poziomach zaawansowania, aby sprawdzić swoją formę i cieszyć się sportową atmosferą miasta.
course_highlights: Dystans 5 km w terenie miejskim
Wsparcie treningowe od 8 do 20 tygodni
Organizacja przez lokalną fundację sportową
additional: Bieg jest częścią lokalnych wydarzeń sportowych, obejmuje różne dystanse i kategorie wiekowe, a także klasyfikacje Grand Prix Lublina.

name: 9 Żorski Półmaraton Leśny
description: 9 Żorski Półmaraton Leśny to bieg leśny organizowany w malowniczym Miasteczku Westernowym Twinpigs w Żorach. Zawody odbywają się 29 listopada 2026 roku i obejmują trzy dystanse: półmaraton (21 km), bieg na 11 km oraz bieg na 5 km. Impreza skierowana jest do dorosłych biegaczy, oferując wyjątkową trasę w otoczeniu natury. Start zaplanowano na godzinę 12:00, a organizator zapewnia profesjonalną obsługę i kontakt mailowy dla uczestników.
course_highlights: Trasa leśna w Miasteczku Westernowym Twinpigs
Dostępne trzy dystanse: 21 km, 11 km i 5 km
Malownicze otoczenie i naturalne warunki biegowe
additional: Zawody przeznaczone są dla dorosłych. Dostępne pakiety startowe dla każdego dystansu. Organizator zapewnia listę startową oraz kontakt telefoniczny i mailowy. Start 29 listopada 2026 r. o godz. 12:00. Zapisy na wszystkie dystanse są zakończone. Limit wynosi 400 uczestników oraz 10 dodatkowych miejsc dla organizatora. Możliwy jest start z psem na smyczy; osoby biegnące z psami startują jako ostatnie.

name: VI Biegowe Grand Prix Krainy Dobrej Energii
Christmas Run To Tree
description: The Christmas Run To Tree is an atmospheric forest run in Klövensteen Forest near Hamburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km or 12 km. The run combines sporting activity with the special experience of buying a Christmas tree. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Forest run through scenic Klövensteen Forest
Choice of 6 km or 12 km distance
Race bib in the shape of a Christmas tree
additional: Race packet pickup on event day from 09:00 to 11:15. The race bib is in the shape of a Christmas tree and must be worn visibly on the chest. Bag drop-off is available with the coupon on the race bib. Late entries are not possible. Participant transfers are possible for a fee until November 25. Awards ceremony for the 6 km at 11:15 and for the 12 km at 13:00. The event includes race bib pickup, certificates, Christmas activities, and a festive atmosphere.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Schiffenberger Wald, Gießen, is a flat race held annually in November. It offers 5 km and 10 km races for adults, as well as events for children and teenagers. The event is ideal for runners looking for a fast, flat course in a natural setting. The start and finish are at the same location; exact details are available via RUNME Premium. The race takes place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, and starts at 10:15 a.m.
course_highlights: Flat course in Schiffenberger Wald
5 km and 10 km distances for adults
Events for children and teenagers
additional: The start and finish are the same for all events. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium. There are also 5 km walking and Nordic walking events. Results are usually published shortly after runners finish on the RUNME results page. The race is for adults, children, and teenagers, with start times in the morning.

name: Friedeholz Cross
description: The Friedeholz Cross is a traditional forest cross-country race in Syke, Lower Saxony, and part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series. On November 29, 2026, races will be held over various distances, from a 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race to the 10.3 km main race, for children, young people, and adults. The course runs mostly on forest trails, with a short asphalt section before the finish at Waldstadion Syke. The event offers a varied cross-country running experience in an autumn setting and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Mostly forest trails with only approx. 100 m of asphalt
Start and finish at Waldstadion Syke
Part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series, with several distances
additional: Four distances on race day: 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 3.6 km middle distance for U16 and older, and 10.3 km main race for U20 and older. The event is part of a series of three races, with series scoring for those who register before the first race. Switching between the middle and long distances is possible, but does not count as a series switch. Forest trails, cross-country running, series scoring, registration required for series scoring, limited shower and changing facilities at Waldstadion Syke

name: Ratzeburger Adventslauf
description: The Ratzeburg Advent Run is a traditional race around Lake Ratzeburg, taking place on 29 November 2026. The main course is 26 km long and runs mostly along hiking trails, with scenic sections and historic points of interest. There is also a 7.5 km run around Küchensee and a 1.5 km children’s run, offering an accessible introduction to running. The event combines a sporting challenge with a nature experience and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 26 km around Lake Ratzeburg, with approximately 80% hiking trails and 20% asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the course at km 5, 10, 15, 20 and 22.5
A scenic, hilly 7.5 km route around Küchensee, plus a 1.5 km children’s run with crowd support
additional: New since 2022, intermediate timing on the 26 km course allows spectators and athletes to follow split times. The races start simultaneously, with runners arranged at the start on the right-hand side of Königsdamm. The children’s run is supported by Dein-Holzpferd.de.

name: Schlößlelauf - 4. Lauf der Jedermannlaufserie
description: The Schlößlelauf in Donauwörth is the fourth race in the Jedermannlauf series and offers runners of all ages and ability levels an attractive opportunity to compete. The event is organised by LG Donau-Ries and traditionally takes place in late autumn. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Donauwörth and is part of a popular running series in the region. The event promotes recreational sport and is aimed at children, young people and active runners.
course_highlights: Part of the Jedermannlauf series
Various categories for all age groups
Race in the historic town of Donauwörth
additional: Registration is by email. The event includes running and cycling events, as well as filters for terrain and sport type.

name: Uplengener Adventslauf
description: The Uplengen Advent Run is a traditional cross-country race taking place for the 54th time. The races run through the Hollsand Nature Reserve and offer challenging courses depending on the weather. The event is one of the oldest running events in the region and is often used to prepare for cross-country championships. Various course distances give young people and adults the opportunity to achieve personal bests or improve their endurance. The Remels Primary School Friends’ Association will provide coffee and cake.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Hollsand Nature Reserve
Challenging courses depending on the weather
Various course distances for different age groups
additional: U14 runners can choose between 1450 m and 3100 m; U16 runners can take part in the 4450 m middle-distance race. The red loop is approximately 3000 m plus a 100 m start chute. The course uses a checkpoint system for route guidance. Cross-country race in the Hollsand Nature Reserve; course distances vary; registration and results online; coffee and cake from the Remels Primary School Friends’ Association.

name: Herbstwaldlauf – Berlins ältester Crosslauf
description: The Herbstwaldlauf is Berlin’s oldest cross-country race and traditionally takes place in Tegeler Forst. The event offers distances of 1.5 km, 3 km, 5.5 km, and 10.5 km and welcomes runners of all ages. The course follows varied hiking and forest trails, with flat and hilly sections. Every finisher receives a medal, which can also be engraved on-site. The event is part of the Berliner Läufercup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments in the start/finish area.
course_highlights: Varied course on hiking and forest trails
Flat to hilly sections in Tegeler Forst
A medal for every finisher
additional: Open from 08:00 on race day. Start times: 10:00 for the 1.9 km family run and children’s races, and 10:40 for the 5.5 km fun run and walking event. Unsupervised changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. Finish-line refreshments include snacks, drinks, and Christmas treats. Medals can be engraved on-site for €6. Course marshals at key junctions help runners find their way. Christstollen and tea are traditionally offered.

name: Bathory Cross (Čachtický krvák)
description: Bathory Cross is a mountain race in the Little Carpathians, starting and finishing in Čachtice, Slovakia. It has been held since 2016. The 11th-anniversary edition in 2026 offers two courses: the longer 23 km route, with +900 m of elevation gain, called “Čachtický krvák,” and a shorter 12 km route with +450 m of elevation gain. Runners pass through the beautiful natural surroundings of Čachtice Castle and Veľký Plešivec. The event is suitable for experienced runners, recreational athletes, and families with children, with organizers emphasizing the sporting experience and the promotion of nature.
course_highlights: The course passes through the area of Čachtice Castle Hill and Veľký Plešivec (484 m above sea level).
The longer route is 23 km with +900 m of elevation gain; the shorter route is 12 km with +450 m of elevation gain.
The course surface is 75% forest trails and 25% asphalt.
additional: Race registration takes place on Saturday from 15:30 to 18:00 and on Sunday from 8:00 to 9:30 at the LEGENDARIA Exhibition building in Čachtice. Electronic timing is provided by SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk. Each runner receives a race number with a chip, which they keep as a memento. The participant limit is 1,000 runners. Parking is available in the designated car park of KK Group Cooling Slovakia and in adjacent areas. The start is at 10:00.

name: Poľančanska päťka
location: Sečovská Polianka, Vranov nad Topľou District, Prešov Region, Slovakia

name: Trail Start: Nemokama Bėgimo Treniruotė
location: Vingio parko lauko treniruoklių sporto aikštelė
description: Trail START. A free running workout with Monika Mile will take place on December 2 (Tuesday) at 18:30 at the outdoor fitness equipment area in Vingis Park. The workout will last about 1 hour and cover approximately 5 km at an easy pace. It is aimed at beginners who want to learn to run confidently in the forest. The focus will be on technique, feel, and safety in the forest. You must bring running shoes with good tread, weather-appropriate clothing, a headlamp, and a good mood.

name: Advento bėgimo iššūkis 2026
description: The Advent Running Challenge 2026 is a virtual event taking place from December 1 to 24. Participants receive a new task each day, involving running, physical, accuracy, and creative challenges. The challenge encourages not only speed, but also perseverance, creativity, and engagement throughout all 24 days. Participants compete for the title of Advent Champion and receive a participant kit, with the chance to win prizes from the prize fund.
course_highlights: 24 days with 24 different tasks
Physical, accuracy, and creative challenges
A virtual running challenge with the opportunity to earn points and compete
additional: A participant kit for every participant. Prize fund: €175 (may increase depending on the number of participants). A 24-day challenge with tasks, prizes, and registration via a Google Form.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk to wyjątkowy bieg trailowy odbywający się 5 grudnia 2026 roku w malowniczym Trójmiejskim Parku Krajobrazowym. Trasa łączy nadmorski klimat z urozmaiconym, górskim terenem, oferując biegaczom wymagające podbiegi, doliny, jary i wąwozy. To doskonała okazja, by zakończyć sezon w atmosferze sportowej rywalizacji i kontaktu z naturą. Impreza jest częścią ogólnopolskiego cyklu biegów górskich, który promuje aktywność fizyczną i szacunek do środowiska.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi przez Trójmiejski Park Krajobrazowy z bliskością morza
Zróżnicowany teren z gęstymi lasami, dolinami, jarami i wąwozami
Wymagające przewyższenia i naturalne podbiegi charakterystyczne dla trailu
additional: Wydawanie pakietów startowych odbywa się w dniach 4-5 grudnia 2026 w biurze zawodów. Starty odbywają się falami: nocny bieg 6 km o 19:00 4 grudnia, a 5 grudnia starty na dystansach 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30), 12 km (13:30) oraz biegi Garmin Junior dla dzieci. Limit czasu na ukończenie dystansów wynosi od 2 do 15 godzin w zależności od długości trasy. Dostępne są zniżki przy zapisie na więcej niż jedną imprezę cyklu. Karta zawodnika dostępna jest 5 dni przed zawodami po zalogowaniu na startlist.pl. Dystanse od 12 km do 86 km, limity czasowe, punkty kwalifikacyjne do Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, biegi towarzyszące dla dzieci i młodzieży.

name: Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf
description: The Wiedenbrück Christkindl Run is a popular race around the Christkindlmarkt in Wiedenbrück’s old town, illuminated for Christmas. The course is a five-lap circuit covering approximately 10.2 km and is not officially measured. Traditionally held in December, the race offers a festive atmosphere in the town centre. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück and attracts many runners from the region.
course_highlights: Five-lap circuit around the Christkindlmarkt
Wiedenbrück’s old town illuminated for Christmas
Course length approximately 10.2 km; run clockwise
additional: Start and finish on Lange Straße in Wiedenbrück. No race-day registrations. Time limit: 75 minutes. Wearing headsets or earphones is prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants are asked to keep as far to the right as possible and not to run in groups, as runners may be lapped. Participant limit: 1,100. Online registration only. Medals can be reordered. Start on 04.12.2026.

name: 46. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
price_range: Keine Startgebühr; eine Spende von 5 € für Umwelt- oder soziale Projekte wird erbeten.
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon takes place in Rheda-Wiedenbrück at the Stadthalle car park and is held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.10 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is marked depending on the weather. Times are recorded using a handheld stopwatch; a photo of the stopwatch taken on race day must be submitted by email as proof. This is a private running event with a limit of 15 participants and a minimum age of 18. There is no entry fee; instead, a donation of €5 is requested for environmental or social projects.
course_highlights: Seven laps of 6.10 km each, total distance 42.7 km
Course measured with a measuring wheel and GPS watch
Self-catering is possible; refreshments are available at your car after each lap
additional: Showers and changing facilities are not available; toilets with warm water are 150 m away. The race will take place only if there are at least three participants. Participation is at your own risk, and the German Road Traffic Regulations apply. Certificates of results will be sent by email. Self-catering and manual timekeeping; the certificate will be sent by email. Participant limit: 15; minimum age for the marathon: 18. Registration by email; at least three participants are required.

name: Pražská stovka
location: Milín, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Pražská stovka is a traditional winter long-distance hike and ultratrail race with a history dating back to 1994. The event takes place on a challenging route with significant elevation gain and distinctive winter conditions, bringing together runners, long-distance hikers, and enthusiasts of extreme trekking each year. The main Route A starts in Český Brod at midnight on Friday and finishes in Prague. The race is known for its friendly, supportive atmosphere, where helping one another matters more than rivalry, and it brings elite ultrarunners together with enthusiastic long-distance hikers.
course_highlights: Main Route A: 130 km with +4400 m elevation gain
Starts in Český Brod at midnight on Friday and finishes in Prague
Challenging terrain and winter conditions with significant elevation gain
additional: Luggage transport between the start in Český Brod and the finish in Prague is provided; only closed and labelled luggage is accepted. At the finish, warm showers, a gym for sleeping in your own sleeping bag and on your own sleeping mat, and light refreshments are available. It is recommended that participants have completed at least one off-road event of over 50 km as a qualifying recommendation. The start is accessible by PID suburban trains from Prague. Pražská stovka is the final stage of the EKUT 2026 series.

name: Vánoční večerní běh Líbeznice
location: Areál ZŠ a ZUŠ Líbeznice, Líbeznice, Czech Republic
description: The Christmas Evening Run in Líbeznice is a traditional sporting event held at the ZŠ and ZUŠ Líbeznice grounds. The run is paired with a competition for the best Christmas strudel, adding a festive atmosphere and a sense of community. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an enjoyable experience in the lead-up to Christmas. It is organised by Monika Šponerová and takes place on Friday, 4 December 2026.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km long
Gently undulating terrain with both paved and off-road surfaces
Part of the route is unlit; a headlamp was mandatory in previous editions
additional: The event takes place at the ZŠ and ZUŠ Líbeznice grounds. It is paired with a competition for the best Christmas strudel. The event takes place at the ZŠ and ZUŠ Líbeznice grounds. The event also includes a competition for the BEST strudel.

name: Mikulášske kilometre nádeje pre Klárku - Družstevná pri Hornáde
location: Družstevná pri Hornáde, Košice-okolie District, Košice Region, Slovakia
distance_verbose: 22 km, 15 km, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1 km

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic to cykl biegów organizowany przez Stowarzyszenie Truchtacz Mysłowice, promujący zdrowy i aktywny styl życia oraz integrację biegaczy na różnych poziomach zaawansowania. Impreza odbywa się w Mysłowicach i jest otwarta dla wszystkich grup wiekowych i poziomów biegowych. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na przyjazną atmosferę i możliwość rywalizacji w ramach całego cyklu Grand Prix. Zapisy odbywają się wyłącznie w Biurze Zawodów w dniu biegu, a udział w zawodach jest bezpłatny.
course_highlights: Bieg na 10 km w malowniczej okolicy Mysłowic
Seria sezonowych wydarzeń promujących zdrowy styl życia
Społeczność biegaczy i integracja lokalnej społeczności
additional: Zapisy do cyklu Grand Prix możliwe są tylko w Biurze Zawodów w dniu biegu. Udział w zawodach z cyklu Grand Prix jest bezpłatny. Impreza jest otwarta dla wszystkich, niezależnie od poziomu zaawansowania i wieku. Wydarzenie skupia się na promocji aktywności fizycznej, zdrowia i społeczności biegaczy, z różnorodnymi trasami i sezonowymi edycjami.

name: Bunt Mikołajów
description: Bunt Mikołajów to bieg na dystansie 5 km organizowany w Niepołomicach, który promuje aktywność fizyczną na świeżym powietrzu oraz walory miasta i regionu Małopolski. Trasa biegu prowadzi ulicami miasta, z nawierzchnią asfaltową, betonową i brukowaną, a start i meta znajdują się przy ul. Zamkowej. Zawody odbywają się w grudniu i mają na celu również promocję naturalnych metod wzmacniania odporności oraz zdrowia. Biuro zawodów mieści się w Zamku Królewskim w Niepołomicach i jest czynne w dniu imprezy przed startem.
course_highlights: Trasa miejska o nawierzchni asfalt, beton, bruk
Start i meta na ul. Zamkowej w Niepołomicach
Limit czasu na pokonanie trasy: 50 minut
additional: Biuro zawodów czynne w dniu imprezy od 14:00 do 16:15 w Zamku Królewskim, ul. Zamkowa 2. Trasa oznakowana białymi strzałkami na niebieskim tle. Ruch pojazdów na trasie będzie wstrzymywany przez służby porządkowe. Zawodnicy muszą stosować się do poleceń służb i nie schodzić z wyznaczonej trasy. Start zaplanowano na 16:30. Limit czasu wynosi 50 minut. Biuro zawodów będzie mieścić się w Zamku Królewskim w Niepołomicach przy ul. Zamkowej 2.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL — Wrocław
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury, Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego oraz Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL to ogólnopolski cykl biegów przełajowych na dystansie 5 km, odbywający się w pięknej, leśnej scenerii Lasu Osobowickiego we Wrocławiu. Zawody są otwarte dla biegaczy na różnym poziomie zaawansowania, od początkujących po zaawansowanych, którzy mogą sprawdzać swoje wyniki na stałej trasie. Impreza promuje aktywność fizyczną na świeżym powietrzu i zdrowy styl życia, a uczestnicy mogą rywalizować w klasyfikacji lokalnej oraz całego cyklu. Start i meta znajdują się w pobliżu boiska w Lesie Osobowickim, a biegi odbywają się w godzinach przedpołudniowych.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 5 km w leśnej scenerii Lasu Osobowickiego
Start i meta zlokalizowane przy boisku w Lesie Osobowickim
Trasa przełajowa, odpowiednia dla początkujących i zaawansowanych biegaczy
additional: Biuro zawodów otwierane jest o 8:30, a numery startowe i chipy do pomiaru czasu odbiera się w dniu biegu. Nie ma limitu uczestników. Możliwość wykupienia pakietu charytatywnego wspierającego Fundację Siepomaga. Parkowanie możliwe wzdłuż ul. Osobowickiej według wskazań obsługi ruchu. Uczestnicy muszą przestrzegać przepisów ruchu drogowego. W ramach karnetu można skorzystać z jednego bezpłatnego startu w innym mieście cyklu po wcześniejszym zgłoszeniu mailowym. Zapisy elektroniczne odbywają się przez stronę CITY TRAIL; możliwa jest też rejestracja w biurze zawodów w dniu biegu. Uczestnicy biegu głównego muszą mieć ukończone 16 lat lub ukończyć 16 lat w 2026 roku.

name: VI Nocny Mikołajkowy Bieg Nyski
description: VI Nocny Mikołajkowy Bieg Nyski to coroczny bieg uliczny na dystansie 5 km, który odbędzie się 5 grudnia 2026 roku w Nysie. Organizatorem wydarzenia jest Fundacja „W DZIAŁANIU”. Bieg ma charakter nocny, co dodaje mu wyjątkowej atmosfery i atrakcyjności dla uczestników. Impreza jest doskonałą okazją do aktywnego spędzenia czasu oraz integracji biegaczy w okresie przedświątecznym.
course_highlights: Dystans 5 km ulicami miasta Nysa
Bieg odbywa się w godzinach wieczornych, w nocy
Organizowany przez Fundację „W DZIAŁANIU”

name: XII Półmaraton Mikołajkowy w Mikołajkach
description: XII Półmaraton Mikołajkowy w Mikołajkach to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się 5 grudnia 2026 roku. Zawodnicy mogą rywalizować na dystansach 21 km oraz 10 km, a także w biegach dziecięcych i młodzieżowych. Start i odbiór pakietów startowych odbywa się rano, a po biegach następuje uroczyste wręczenie pucharów, nagród i dyplomów. Limit uczestników wynosi 450 osób, co zapewnia kameralną atmosferę wydarzenia.
course_highlights: Dystanse 21 km i 10 km ulicami Mikołajek
Biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe z osobnym harmonogramem
Limit uczestników do 450 osób
additional: Zapisy i odbiór pakietów startowych odbywają się w godzinach 8:00-11:00. Biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe startują o 10:30, a wyniki i wręczenie nagród następuje bezpośrednio po ich zakończeniu. Wyniki i dekoracja dla dystansów 10 km i półmaratonu odbywają się o 14:15. Wydarzenie przewiduje bezpłatny udział dla osób powyżej 70 roku życia, osób niepełnosprawnych oraz mieszkańców Gminy Mikołajki na obu dystansach. Start imprezy zaplanowano na 11:45. Zapisy internetowe trwają od 16 września do 1 grudnia 2026 r.; przewidziano także możliwość opłaty na miejscu. Limit wynosi 450 zawodników.

name: Trail!ON Stawiguda 2026/2027 #1
location: Ruś, Gmina Stawiguda, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Polska

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn forest parking, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, Polska
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE to zimowy turniej biegowy składający się z czterech imprez rozgrywanych na dystansach półmaratońskich i maratońskich oraz marszach Nordic Walking. Biegi odbywają się na leśnych duktach i ścieżkach lasów nadwarciańskich w okolicach Biedruska, oferując kameralną atmosferę zarówno dla amatorów, jak i profesjonalistów. Trasa prowadzi przez malownicze tereny nad rzeką Wartą, zróżnicowane pod względem nawierzchni i ukształtowania terenu. Start i biuro zawodów mieszczą się przy parkingu leśnym Łysy Młyn nad jeziorem Łyse, a start ostry zaplanowano na godzinę 10:00.
course_highlights: Trasa półmaratonu to jedna pętla o długości 21,3 km, maraton to dwie pętle
Trasa prowadzi głównie niebieskim szlakiem rowerowym wzdłuż rzeki Warty oraz leśnymi duktami i ścieżkami
Nawierzchnia trasy jest śliska i nierówna, z liśćmi, kałużami i błotem, co wymaga uwagi i przygotowania
additional: Odbiór pakietów startowych w dniu biegu od 7:45 do 9:30 w biurze zawodów. W sezonie zimowym 2026/2027 odbywają się także biegi i marsze Nordic Walking na dystansach 5 i 10 km. Każdy bieg w cyklu ma temat przewodni i zachęca do stosowania strojów tematycznych. Trasa nie posiada atestu, jest mierzona licznikami rowerowymi i Garminem. Centrum zawodów znajduje się przy parkingu leśnym Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, nad jeziorem Łyse. Dojazd możliwy samochodem lub autobusami miejskimi i podmiejskimi; dostępne są bezpłatne parkingi. Start zaplanowano na 10:00. Nordic Walking odbywa się na dystansie półmaratonu.

name: Augsburger AOK-Winterlaufserie Südring
description: The Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series organized by TG Viktoria Augsburg consists of four races through the beautiful Western Forests Nature Park. The courses run through hilly terrain in the western forests of Augsburg and require good fitness and health. The event offers age-group rankings and an overall ranking with attractive prizes and trophies. The races take place on Saturdays and one Sunday in November and December and are a popular series for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Western Forests Nature Park
Hilly terrain with challenging sections
Course distances of approximately 2.8 to 3.2 km per race
additional: Race numbers are distributed in the start/finish area each time. Portable toilets are available at the Kathreinerstraße car park (races 1–3), and there is space to leave a change of clothes or luggage in a tent or pavilion (at your own risk). Finish refreshments include tea, water and a cake buffet at races 1–3; the fourth race also offers mulled wine and children’s punch. The overall awards ceremony takes place at the forest hut after the fourth race. Parking is available in Bergheim, on Kathreinerstraße and on surrounding streets, but not at the Bergheim sports clubhouse. Races take place in November, with distances ranging from approximately 2.8 km to 9.9 km. The meeting point is usually by the forest car park near Kathreinerstrasse and Brennhölzerweg in Augsburg-Bergheim. November weather can be cool and rainy.

name: Hamelner Cross-Winterlaufserie
price_range: Kein Startgeld; Spenden für Materialkosten willkommen
description: The Hameln Cross Winter Running Series 2026/2027 is organized by the athletics section of ESV Eintracht Hameln and takes place in the Klüt Forest around the Finkenborn Youth Hostel. The series consists of six events, with the three best results counting toward the standings. The course uses paved and unpaved paths and offers a varied cross-country running experience. There is no entry fee, though small donations toward material costs are welcome. After the final race, an awards ceremony and informal get-together will be held.
course_highlights: Races in the Klüt Forest on paved and unpaved paths
Start and finish at the sports grounds/parking lot of the Finkenborn Youth Hostel
Varied cross-country course with a natural character
additional: Entries are accepted only on the day of each race, up to 15 minutes before the start. Timing is manual. The standings are based on each participant’s three best races in the series. After the final race, an awards ceremony will be held at the Finkenborn Youth Hostel. There is no compulsory entry fee; small donations toward material costs are welcome. Donations of cakes for the closing event are welcome. Participation is at your own risk; the organizer accepts no liability. The meeting point is the sports grounds or parking lot at the Finkenborn Youth Hostel. Registration is available on race day up to 15 minutes before the start. The three fastest races per person count toward the series standings.

name: Berliner Nikolauslauf 2026
price_range: 5,00 Euro bis 30,00 Euro (je nach Kategorie und Anmeldungstermin)
description: The 2026 Berlin St. Nicholas Run is a traditional race around the picturesque Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke lakes in Berlin’s Grunewald forest. The course follows a measured 5.3-kilometre lakeside path that is popular with both recreational visitors and competitive athletes. The event offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. It takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organised by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.
course_highlights: A loop around Schlachtensee, 5.3 km per lap
A nature-rich route through Berlin’s Grunewald forest
A popular training route with top athletes and recreational visitors
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:00 a.m. at Fischerhüttenstraße 137, 14163 Berlin, near the turning circle between Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. Race-day late entries are available online, subject to an additional fee. The event offers a range of distances for runners and Nordic walkers, as well as relay races. Distances range from 330 m to 26.8 km. Registration is available online or in writing; race-day late entries are online only and subject to a fee. Race bibs can be collected in Berlin.

name: Forchheimer Nikolauslauf
description: The Forchheim Nikolauslauf is a long-standing running event hosted by LG Forchheim on the Sportinsel in Forchheim. The 46th edition takes place on December 5, 2026, and features races for children and young people, a 5.3 km fun run, and a 10 km main race. The course follows a new route heading south, with the 10 km race making four circuits around the Sportinsel. The event regularly attracts more than 600 participants and offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children’s and youth races in the morning, starting at 11:20 a.m.
5.3 km fun run on a new route heading south (4 laps)
10 km main race with four laps around the Sportinsel
additional: Start times: children’s and youth races from 11:20 a.m., 5.3 km fun run at 1:00 p.m., 10 km main race at 2:00 p.m. The 5.3 km course is run four times heading south; the 10 km course is run four times around the Sportinsel. Various race categories, festive atmosphere, traditional December event, children’s and youth races, 5.3 km fun run, 10 km main race.

name: Glücksburger Nikolaus-Crosslauf
location: Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2, 24960 Glücksburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Glücksburg St Nicholas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country event held in December in Glücksburg on the Baltic Sea, organised by TSV Glücksburg 09. The races start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2. Adults and older teenagers can choose between a medium 4.1 km cross-country run and a long 8.2 km run, while younger children take part in shorter, fun runs. The event has a St Nicholas theme, with a piggyback run for parents carrying babies and various races for toddlers and young people. Every participant receives a chocolate Santa Claus as a gift.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on varied terrain by the Baltic Sea
Start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2
A range of distances from 100 m to 8.2 km for all age groups
additional: The youngest participants’ races are not timed, to preserve their fun, playful character. The event takes place in typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. It also includes volunteer duties at the start, finish and along the course, as well as refreshments including coffee, tea and cake. Registration is online, and the event takes place at Schwennau Arena in Glücksburg.

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Schnaitheim is a traditional running event held annually at Moldenberg. The event offers various distances for students, fitness runners, and trail runners, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 12 km trail run. Runners can look forward to a varied course in a sporty, family-friendly atmosphere. TSG Schnaitheim Athletics looks forward to welcoming all participants on December 5.
course_highlights: Children’s races with age-appropriate courses
5 km fitness run and walking on varied terrain
12 km trail run with sections close to nature
additional: The Nikolauslauf takes place at Moldenberg. The event is organized by TSG Schnaitheim 1874 e.V. Various race distances are available for different age and ability groups. Results and rankings from previous races are available to download. The event takes place on December 5, 2026, with course analyses, elevation details, and downloadable results. It is a popular event for runners and walkers in the region.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim (2)
description: The Rodgau Winter Race Series is a long-standing running event that has taken place in Rodgau-Jügesheim since 1980 and attracts both recreational runners and top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series consists of four race dates, each featuring 5 km and 10 km distances, starting at the Maingau-Energie Stadium. Alongside the sporting competition, community spirit is also a focus, supported by team scoring for men’s, women’s, and mixed teams. The event is easy to reach by public transport and offers professional timing with a chip attached to the race bib.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Maingau-Energie Stadium in Rodgau-Jügesheim
5 km and 10 km distances
Easy to reach by S-Bahn (S1), with just a 1 km walk from the station
additional: Team scoring is available for teams of three (men, women, mixed). Chip timing with gun-time recording by MA:XX-. The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. The series includes several races, with team scoring also available. The routes are on paved surfaces and asphalt forest paths, which often have snow or frost in winter conditions. Training plans for various target times are offered to help runners prepare for the races.

name: MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus-Trail Pommelsbrunn
description: The MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus Trail in Pommelsbrunn offers trail running and hiking in the picturesque Hersbrucker Schweiz in the Nürnberger Land. On December 5, 2026, runners can choose from four challenging routes ranging from 10 km to a marathon, and families can take part in the Wichtel Trail. The trails are well marked and cross varied terrain with some challenging climbs, making them ideal for both ambitious runners and beginners. A free shuttle service makes getting there easier, and there are special options for trail runners with dogs.
course_highlights: Four routes from 10 km to a marathon, with challenging climbs
Well-marked trails in the Hersbrucker Schweiz
Wichtel Trail for families and special trails for runners with dogs
additional: On Saturday, December 5, 2026, the XL and L trails and the Wichtel Trail take place; on Sunday, December 6, 2026, the S and M trails take place, including options for runners with dogs. A free shuttle service runs from parking areas in Happurg to the start and finish area. The routes are fully marked, and participants receive a voucher code 14 days before the event for a free Komoot route download. Parking in Pommelsbrunn is limited, so travel by public transport is recommended. Trails with up to 1,582 meters of elevation gain, aid stations, well-marked routes, GPS downloads available.

name: CROSSLAUF am Rodelberg
location: Kampfbahn B, An der Raa, Pinneberg, Germany
description: The cross-country race at Rodelberg is organized by LG Wedel-Pinneberg and takes place on December 5, 2026, in Pinneberg. There are various events for children, teenagers, and adults, with distances from approximately 1,200 m to 8,500 m. The races start in staggered order from 11:00 a.m., separated by gender and age group, with each group scored separately. All participants receive a certificate. The event offers a sporting challenge in the natural surroundings of Rodelberg.
course_highlights: Various distances from approximately 1,200 m to 8,500 m
Separate scoring by age group and gender
A nature-rich course at Rodelberg in Pinneberg
additional: Registration is online via LADV or directly by clicking on the respective race on the website. Online registration via LADV; the VfL Pinneberg organizes the race.

name: Göttinger Cross-Serie (2. Lauf)
description: The Göttingen Cross-Country Series 2026/27 comprises three traditional cross-country races, including the second race on December 5, 2026, at Hainholzhof/Kehr in Göttingen. The event offers races over various distances, including the middle distance (approx. 5,000 m), long distance (approx. 10,000 m), and children’s races over approx. 900 m and 1,800 m. The races take place in all weather conditions and multiple starts are permitted. The series is open to runners of all ages and ability levels and is an established event in the region.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country races at various locations in Göttingen
A range of distances from approx. 900 m to 10,000 m
Terrain with typical cross-country challenges at Hainholzhof/Kehr
additional: Multiple starts are permitted. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Registration is online and requires details of the race distance and personal information, as well as confirmation of the liability waiver and data protection provisions. Children’s, middle-distance, and long-distance races have scheduled start times. Multiple starts are permitted; the event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Maraton Praha – Dobříš
location: A Park, Braník, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Prague–Dobříš Marathon is a traditional trail race held on 5 December 2026. The event offers three distances: 42 km with an individual start, and 21 km and 10 km with mass starts. The route runs from Prague 4, Braník, through Dobříš to Kytín, with elevation ranging from 125 to 593 metres. Runners can use baggage transport from the start to the finish. Overall winners and age- and gender-based category winners are announced. The event is suited to trail-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with a choice of distances.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 593 m of elevation gain
Start in Prague 4, Braník; finish in Kytín
Baggage transport for runners from the start to the finish
additional: The 42 km race has an individual start; the 21 km and 10 km races have mass starts. The 42 km course has aid stations at kilometres 10, 16, 27 and 33, and at the finish. Parking is available near the start and finish area. Runners take part at their own risk and must take extra care when crossing roads. The course is suitable for runners of all levels. Online registration is available, along with course maps and information about race categories.

name: Mikulášský běh Čimelice
description: The Mikulášský běh Čimelice is a traditional annual race held in Čimelice, a popular event with a long history that usually takes place in early December. It attracts local runners and visitors, who can look forward to a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. Exact details about the course and race distance are not currently available, but the race is part of the local sporting calendar and has a long tradition.
course_highlights: A traditional race with a long history in Čimelice
Held annually in December
Friendly atmosphere and local community
additional: The race is part of the local sporting calendar. Results from 2025 are available online.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - prosinec
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children aged 12 and under (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is a precisely measured asphalt loop; the children's course is 800 m long. The race is open to all age groups, with categories for men, women, boys, and girls. You can start by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11.

name: Mikulášský běh Olomouc
description: The Mikuláš Run in Olomouc is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. The club specializes in promoting endurance running and organizes a number of races in the region. The race is part of a rich running tradition and is suitable for the general public as well as ambitious competitors.
course_highlights: 8.8 km course for men and 5.9 km course for women
Part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Traditional race in a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere
additional: The race takes place on December 5, 2026. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and on-site registration is also available.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race has a friendly atmosphere and encourages everyone to enjoy running, whether you want to improve your personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. After the finish, everyone gets a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children one.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children up to 12 years old run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful setting in the Royal Game Reserve – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate (below the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Pre-registration online is available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age, with an age-adjustment coefficient used for the year-round Lívancový Cup. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage facility, and toilet cabins are available. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. 3.2 km course, road surface, registration is voluntary, and running without a bib is permitted.

name: LEKI WINTER SkyRace®
description: LEKI WINTER SkyRace® is a winter skyrunning race held on Ještěd at the ski jump venue. The race offers a challenging 22 km royal course with 1,180 metres of elevation gain, bringing the 2025 skyrunning season to a close. Shorter courses and children’s races are also available, making the event accessible to a wide range of runners. The atmosphere is rounded out by the winners’ presentation and an accompanying programme.
course_highlights: Winter SkyRace® royal course: 22 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
Other courses: Winter Trail 12 km / 520 m+, Winter Easy 6 km / 220 m+
Children’s races: 200 m, 500 m and 1,200 m
additional: The winners’ presentation starts at 15:30. Canicross races are also available over the same distances as the main courses. The race is part of the LEKI JEŠTĚD SERIES. winter mountain race, multiple courses, children’s races, canicross, registration, race equipment and refreshments

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace®
description: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace® is a trail-running race held on the Ještěd Ridge in the Liberec Region. It offers challenging courses with beautiful views and natural scenery, appealing to both experienced runners and fans of mountain running. The race is part of the JEŠTĚD SKYRACE series and is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and extensive accompanying program, including healthy refreshments and a partner zone. Participants can also purchase original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary.
course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd Ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with courses of varying distances (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Extensive accompanying program, including healthy and varied refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially stocked race bag. Healthy and varied refreshments are available, including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary is available. Races on different courses, a series of summer and winter races, registration, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť over a distance of 5.7 km. It offers not only a sporting experience, but also a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Runners are welcome to wear devil costumes, adding a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories by age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol hall and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Traditional 5.7 km winter run
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Sokol Cup results announced after the race
additional: The race takes place on 6 December 2025 from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, at the Sokol hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in different age groups). After the race, there is a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course. Registration via naZávody.cz. The event is suitable for all age groups and fans of dressing up.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
description: The Ráztoka–Pustevny Uphill Run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoky and around Pustevny. It offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners’ endurance and strength in the beautiful setting of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular with athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes everyone who enjoys mountain running and wants to experience the race’s unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Climb to Pustevny with 400 m of elevation gain
Course length of approximately 5.7 km
Mountain setting in the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is also suitable for children. Weather may affect conditions. Registration details are not provided. The event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: Jested Series
description: Ještěd Skyrace is a technical trail-running race on the Ještěd Ridge, featuring challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and professionals and includes several route options, including races for children. The event is part of a race series with a friendly atmosphere and a generous participant race pack.
course_highlights: Technical trail sections on the Ještěd Ridge
Challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 m of elevation gain
Route options from 6 km to 22 km, including children’s races
additional: Mandatory equipment is required. Race bibs and timing chips are provided. On-site registration is available, along with bag storage, changing rooms and toilets. Refreshments and an awards ceremony are provided after the finish. The race is livestreamed, and results are available online. The race also offers canicross options and children’s races on shorter routes. The series also includes children’s races. The listed Winter SkyRace distances are 22, 12 and 6 km; the date 5 December 2026 is not confirmed in the available information.

name: Last Man Standing Run VYSOČINA
description: Last Man Standing Run Vysočina is a unique endurance race held on December 5, 2026, at Želiv Monastery. Competitors repeatedly complete a 6.7 km loop, starting every hour, with the aim of lasting as long as possible and lining up for another start on the hour. The inaugural edition is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops, with the winner being the person who completes all 24 loops. The race is not about speed, but about endurance and the ability to overcome physical and mental challenges in the winter conditions of Vysočina.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the hilly terrain of Vysočina
A new start every hour, up to a maximum of 24 loops / 24 hours
The official time is set by the tolling of the church bell at Želiv Monastery
additional: The race is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops. Every competitor must wear their race bib throughout the event and keep a timing chip on their ankle. Headphones are prohibited on the course for safety reasons. Registration is processed manually; payment details are sent by email after the application has been processed. A T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on for 490 Kč. The official race time is set by the tolling of the church bell, which also symbolically closes the finish gate on the hour. The entry fee includes participation, light refreshments and facilities. Mandatory equipment includes a red rear light, a reflective item, neck protection and a personal drinking container. Part of the route may run along roads open to regular traffic.

name: Veleslavín běží
location: Přerost a Švorc, Veleslavín, Prague 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Veleslavín běží is a 7.2 km run through the Veleslavínka Valley, past Libocký Pond in Prague 6. It takes place on December 5, 2026, at the Přerost a Švorc grounds. The race is part of the Běhej s námi 2026 series and offers events for children and adults. Children’s races of 100 m to 1,500 m, depending on age, take place in the morning, followed by the main adults’ race in the afternoon. The field is limited to 200 runners, and the race bib is also valid for other races in the series. The route runs mainly along park and field paths, with one more pronounced climb beyond the pond.
course_highlights: The 7.2 km route runs through the Veleslavínka Valley, past Libocký Pond
Mostly park and field paths with gravel and dirt, plus short sections of asphalt
One more pronounced climb of about 25 m of elevation gain beyond the pond
additional: The race bib with timing chip is also valid for other races in the Běhej s námi 2026 series. The field is limited to 200 runners. Check-in and bib pickup close 30 minutes before the start. Parking is included in the entry fee. Running with a dog is not permitted. There is no time limit. The adults’ race starts at 13:00, and the children’s races begin at 11:00. Online entry costs 200 Kč for adults; children can enter free of charge. Entry on the day costs 300 Kč for adults and 100 Kč for children. Check-in closes no later than 30 minutes before the start. Adults must be at least 15 years old to compete; running with a dog is not permitted.

name: Christmas Run Olomouc
location: Výstaviště Flora, pavilion E, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Christmas Run Olomouc is an atmospheric night run taking place on 5 December 2026 in Olomouc at Výstaviště Flora. It offers three race courses: the 5 km INTERSPORT CHRISTMAS RUN, the 2 km Fénix Run charity race, and the 1 km non-competitive NN KIDS CHRISTMAS RUN for children. The event is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants may start only with written consent from a legal guardian. The programme also includes warm-ups with Santa and an awards ceremony. The event is organized by EVENT media s.r.o.
course_highlights: The 5 km INTERSPORT CHRISTMAS RUN course in the nighttime setting of Olomouc
The 2 km Fénix Run charity race
The 1 km non-competitive NN KIDS CHRISTMAS RUN for children
additional: Registration is valid only once the entry fee has been credited to the organizer’s account. Once race capacity is reached, no further registration is possible, either online or on site. Children under 15 must have written consent from a legal guardian. The race pack includes a bag with gifts from the event’s partners. The main race is intended for runners aged 12 and over; participants under 15 need written consent from a legal guardian. The children’s run is non-competitive, and children may run with their parents. The main race has a capacity of 1,000 runners.

name: Běh na 2 míle – Praha, Stromovka
location: Bruselská brána, Královská obora-Stromovka, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for the general public. The course follows paved paths through the beautiful Královská obora – Stromovka Park. Adults run two laps, while children up to 12 years old run one. The race is usually held on the first Saturday of every month, with an exact start time of 9:07. Every participant’s time is recorded, and results are published online. The race is part of the year-round Lívancový pohár, which recognizes performances adjusted using an age coefficient.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles); children up to 12 years old run 1 lap (1 mile + 70 m)
Beautiful setting in Královská obora – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area beneath the Marold Panorama building from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage service, and toilet cubicles are available. Arriving by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is recommended by the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate beneath the Marold Panorama building; online registration is also available.

name: Mikulášský vodácký půlmaraton
location: Eliščino nábřeží, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sokol Hradec Králové, oddíl rychlostní kanoistiky a Vodní Sporty Hradec Králové, z. s.
price_range: 300–400 Kč; štafeta 500 Kč; dětské tratě a registrovaní vodáci zdarma

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 5 km a 10 km: 300 Kč, půlmaraton: 300 Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné smíšené štafety 4x5 km 500 Kč, pouze předem

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dětské kategorie zdarma, bez omezení počtu

description: The Mikuláš Water Sports Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Hradec Králové on Eliščino Embankment by the Elbe River. The race offers 5, 10 and 21 km distances, including a 4 x 5 km relay and children’s races over 400 and 800 metres. The course runs mainly along the Elbe Trail on mostly paved surfaces and is suitable for men, women and water sports enthusiasts. The start is always at 10:00 on the first Saturday in December, and participants can expect refreshments along the course and at the finish. The 50th anniversary edition will also include a small commemorative gift for participants.
course_highlights: Out-and-back course along the Elbe Trail, mostly on paved surfaces (asphalt, concrete, approximately 1 km of dirt)
Refreshment stations every 5 km on the 10 km and half-marathon courses
Start and finish on Eliščino Embankment by the Elbe River in central Hradec Králové
additional: The adult races are limited to 200 participants; on-site registration is available only for the children’s races. Race numbers bearing participants’ names are sent to those who pay in advance by 2 December 2026. On-course and finish refreshments include water, electrolyte drinks, tea and bananas. Water sports participants registered with the canoeing association can enter for free by listing their club as “water sports participant(s).” The half marathon has a time limit of 3.5 hours. Race facilities are at the Sokol Hradec Králové building; registration is through Sport-Base.cz.

name: Běh na 2 míle, Zlín – Příluky
location: Madal Bal, Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and covers just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake. Categories are divided by age and gender, with times recorded and prizes awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are Men (ages 13–127), Women (ages 13–127), Boys (up to 12 years) and Girls (up to 12 years); age categories remain the same throughout the calendar year. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The top three finishers in the men’s, women’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. The men’s course record is 9:31.8. Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building from 8:15 to 8:55, and the main race starts at 9:00. Times are recorded for all participants, and the top three in the women’s, men’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. Runners can look forward to a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish.

name: Adventní běh Žatec
location: Náměstí Svobody, Žatec, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Advent Run in Žatec is a traditional pre-Christmas race held through the city’s historic centre, starting at Svobody Square. The race offers various categories for men, women, youth and children, with distances ranging from 330 metres to 6.6 km. Every participant receives a medal and a cup of mulled wine at the finish, adding to the festive Advent atmosphere. Registration begins at 14:00, and the main races start from 15:55. The event is organised by the Hopman Triathlon team, which puts on events for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: A 2,200 m loop through Žatec’s historic centre
Men run 3 loops (6,600 m); women and male youth runners run 2 loops (4,400 m)
Children’s and school-age races cover 330 m and 1,000 m
additional: Registration from 14:00; the first children’s races start from 15:15, and the main adult categories start from 15:55.

name: Adventní běh pro zdraví
location: Městský úřad Hodonín, Hodonín, Czech Republic
description: The Advent Run for Health is a traditional running event organized by Běžecký klub Hodonín, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the community. The race takes place in the center of Hodonín, by the Municipal Office, and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages and ability levels. The club has a long history of organizing running competitions and supports the development of distance running in the region. The event is part of a wider running calendar and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the Municipal Office in Hodonín
The route runs through an urban setting on a pleasant surface
Friendly atmosphere and support for a healthy lifestyle
additional: The organizer is Běžecký klub Hodonín, which has a long-standing tradition. The club also organizes other running events in the region. Contact details for the club's chairman, Pavel Bíl, are listed on the website. Results from previous editions and information about other races in the Grand Prix of Distance Runners of Hodonín District are available on the website. In the 2025 edition, the first category started at 10:30; results are published on the Běžecký klub Hodonín website.

ČSOB zimná séria - Bratislava

name: EUROVAISTINĖS Kalėdinis bėgimas
description: EUROVAISTINĖS Christmas Run 2024—the most beautiful winter run, welcoming Christmas and spending time filled with unforgettable emotions and the captivating energy of running! WE RUN on December 7, 2024, in Vilnius. The event stands out for its festive atmosphere and participants dressed in Christmas costumes with glowing accents. This year, participants can run after dark, when the capital’s streets reveal a truly sparkling and magical Christmas spirit.

images.alt_text: Kalėdinis bėgimas su kostiumais, Vilniuje.
Senelis Kalėda su maišu prie eglutės.
Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas 2024. Šventinis bėgimas Vilniuje.
Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas 2023 metų logotipas su kalėdiniais elementais.

name: Edgaro atminimui Bėgimas
description: On October 18, we invite everyone to the 11th annual “In Memoriam” run, held to honor the memory of soldiers who died this year. All funds donated during the run will support the families of deceased Lithuanian soldiers. Two championship distances are dedicated to the memory of Lithuanian sports legends: the Felicija Karoblienė Cup (2,000 m for girls) and the Jonas Pipynė Cup (5,000 m for boys).

name: 22. Bieg Barbórkowy - Rybnik
description: 22. Bieg Barbórkowy w Rybniku to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez MOSiR Rybnik, która odbywa się 6 grudnia. Bieg ma charakter tradycyjny i jest ważnym wydarzeniem sportowym w regionie, przyciągającym biegaczy z różnych grup wiekowych. Impreza jest częścią Biegowego Grand Prix Rybnika, promując aktywność fizyczną i integrację lokalnej społeczności.
course_highlights: Organizacja przez MOSiR Rybnik, zapewniająca profesjonalne warunki i pomiar czasu
Różnorodne trasy miejskie dostosowane do różnych dystansów
Część serii Biegowe Grand Prix Rybnika, promująca aktywność i zdrowie w regionie
additional: Bieg odbędzie się 6 grudnia 2026 roku, start o godzinie 12:00, zapisy do 29 listopada 2026, dostępne różne dystanse i trasy miejskie.

name: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów – XXIV Półmaraton Świętych Mikołajów
description: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów w Toruniu to największy w Polsce bieg mikołajkowy, który co roku przyciąga ponad 2000 uczestników. Wydarzenie odbywa się w świątecznej atmosferze na urokliwych ulicach Torunia, oferując różnorodne dystanse od półmaratonu po marsz Nordic Walking. Start i meta biegów głównych zlokalizowane są odpowiednio na Rynku Staromiejskim i Stadionie Miejskim. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na bogaty pakiet startowy oraz liczne atrakcje towarzyszące.
course_highlights: Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi ulicami Torunia z startem przy Rynku Staromiejskim i metą na Stadionie Miejskim
Dostępne dystanse: półmaraton, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km oraz 5 km Nordic Walking
Świąteczna atmosfera i udział ponad 2000 biegaczy przebranych za Świętych Mikołajów
additional: Biuro Zawodów działa w Kortach Tenisowych MOSiR w Toruniu w dniach 5 grudnia (15:00 - 20:30) i 6 grudnia (8:00 - 11:00). Pakiet startowy zawiera koszulkę techniczną z długim rękawem, czapkę Świętego Mikołaja, worek sportowy, numer startowy z chipem, batony energetyczne, prezenty od sponsorów, medal pamiątkowy oraz ciepły posiłek regeneracyjny. Przed biegiem uczestnicy otrzymują SMS z numerem startowym. Organizowany jest także Drużynowy Mistrzostwa Polski w Półmaratonie Św. Mikołajów z wymogiem co najmniej jednej kobiety w drużynie. W pakiecie startowym przewidziano m.in. techniczną koszulkę z długim rękawem, worek i czapkę Mikołaja; na mecie medal, zupę i napoje. Wydarzeniu towarzyszy akcja charytatywna „Mikołaje Dzieciom”.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL to ogólnopolski cykl biegów przełajowych na dystansie 5 km, odbywający się w pięknych, leśnych sceneriach. W Katowicach trasa prowadzi przez tereny Lasów Państwowych Nadleśnictwa Katowice, startując około 700 metrów od mety przy ośrodku "Rybaczówka" nad stawem Janina. Zawody są dostępne dla biegaczy na różnym poziomie zaawansowania, od początkujących po zaawansowanych, którzy mogą regularnie sprawdzać swoje wyniki na tej samej trasie. Biegi odbywają się cyklicznie w sezonie 2026/2027, a uczestnicy mają możliwość rywalizacji w klasyfikacji lokalnej i ogólnopolskiej.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km w leśnej scenerii Lasów Państwowych Nadleśnictwa Katowice
Start około 700 m od mety przy ośrodku "Rybaczówka" nad stawem Janina
Trasa przeznaczona dla biegaczy na różnych poziomach zaawansowania
additional: Biuro zawodów otwierane jest o 8:30, zamykane o 10:30. Start biegu głównego na 5 km o godzinie 11:00. Nie ma możliwości dojazdu bezpośrednio do startu, parking znajduje się przy ul. Karolinki, około 1 km od biura zawodów. W ramach zawodów odbywają się także biegi CITY TRAIL Junior na krótszych dystansach. W Katowicach meta zlokalizowana jest przy ośrodku "Rybaczówka". Bieg jest częścią sezonu Grand Prix CITY TRAIL 2026/2027.

name: II Bieg Mikołajkowy
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Srebrna Dziesiątka i OSP Gorenice
price_range: 70 zł (bieg 5 km lub Nordic Walking); 40 zł (biegi dziecięce); 90 zł w dniu wydarzenia
description: II Bieg Mikołajkowy w Gorenicach to coroczne wydarzenie biegowe organizowane przez Stowarzyszenie Srebrna Dziesiątka wraz z OSP Gorenice. Impreza odbędzie się 6 grudnia 2026 roku na stadionie Leśnik Gorenice i obejmuje bieg główny na 5 km oraz biegi dla dzieci na stadionie. Limit uczestników to 200 osób w biegu głównym oraz 50 dzieci. Wydarzenie ma świąteczny charakter, pełen atrakcji i niespodzianek, a patronat nad nim objął Starosta Olkuski Bogumił Sobczyk.
course_highlights: Bieg główny na 5 km z malutkim haczykiem
Biegi dla dzieci odbywające się na stadionie Leśnik Gorenice
Trasa dobrze znana uczestnikom z poprzednich edycji
additional: Limit uczestników biegu głównego to 200 osób, a dla dzieci 50. Wydarzenie ma charakter świąteczny z licznymi atrakcjami i niespodziankami. Wymagane są zgody rodziców dla dzieci. Impreza odbywa się na stadionie Leśnik Gorenice. Zapisy zaplanowano od 14 września do 27 listopada 2026 r.

name: W pogoni za św. Mikołajem
description: W pogoni za św. Mikołajem to rodzinny bieg mikołajkowy organizowany przez Radio Wrocław w Parku Tysiąclecia we Wrocławiu. Impreza ma charakter rekreacyjny, nastawiony na dobrą zabawę i świąteczny klimat, z udziałem św. Mikołaja, który prowadzi rozgrzewkę i wręcza medale na mecie. Trasa biegu głównego ma długość 3500 metrów i przebiega po wyznaczonej ścieżce Trasy Biegowej Radia Wrocław. Dla dzieci organizowany jest osobny Bieg Krasnala, również z paczkami od św. Mikołaja. Całość odbywa się przy muzyce Radia Wrocław, tworząc wyjątkową atmosferę świątecznej zabawy i sportowej rywalizacji.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 3500 m po wyznaczonej i oznakowanej ścieżce Trasy Biegowej Radia Wrocław
Start i meta w Parku Tysiąclecia przy mini siłowni na otwartym powietrzu
Obecność św. Mikołaja na trasie i na mecie, który prowadzi rozgrzewkę i wręcza medale
additional: Limit uczestników: 200 osób w biegu głównym, 50 osób w Biegu Krasnala. Limit czasowy na trasie wynosi 60 minut. Odbiór pakietów startowych w dniu zawodów w biurze organizatora od godz. 9:00 do 10:30. Zapisy na Bieg Krasnala możliwe w dniu zawodów od godz. 9:00. Każdy uczestnik otrzymuje pakiet startowy z paczką i czapką św. Mikołaja oraz imienny numer startowy.

name: XIV Bieg Mikołajkowy
location: Stadion OSiR, ul. Piaskowa 97, Police, Polska
price_range: 85–110 zł (do 1 października; wpisowe będzie później stopniowo rosło)
description: XIV Bieg Mikołajkowy w Policach to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się 6 grudnia na stadionie OSiR przy ul. Piaskowej 97. Zawodnicy mogą wybrać między dwoma dystansami - 5 i 10 kilometrów - które prowadzą drogami asfaltowymi miasta. Bieg ma świąteczny charakter, a uczestnicy tradycyjnie startują w czapkach Mikołaja, z możliwością udziału w specjalnej kategorii dla przebierańców. W programie są także biegi dla dzieci, Nordic Walking oraz widowiskowa Sztafeta Marzeń z choinkami. Start głównego biegu zaplanowano na godzinę 12:00, a dekoracje zwycięzców odbędą się o 13:30.
course_highlights: Trasa asfaltowa o długości 5 lub 10 km ulicami Polic
Świąteczny klimat z czapkami Mikołaja na głowach uczestników
Widowiskowa Sztafeta Marzeń - bieg z choinkami
additional: Biuro zawodów otwarte od godz. 8:00. Biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży od godz. 10:00. Nordic Walking startuje o 12:10. Dekoracje zwycięzców o 13:30. Start biegu głównego zaplanowano na 12:00, a Nordic Walking na 12:10. Limit biegu głównego wynosi 800 osób. Zapisy internetowe trwają do 30 listopada lub do wyczerpania limitu miejsc.

name: XV Grand Prix Krakowa w biegach górskich – Bieg Mikołajkowy
organizer: Grand Prix Krakowa w Biegach Górskich
description: XV Grand Prix Krakowa w Biegach Górskich to cykl biegów górskich odbywających się w Krakowie, w tym Bieg Mikołajkowy 6 grudnia 2026 roku. Zawody oferują różnorodne dystanse od 3,7 km do 23,2 km oraz bieg Vertical, a także biegi dla dzieci. Trasy są zróżnicowane i zachęcają do testowania ich w okresie letnim. To jubileuszowa edycja, która przyciąga zarówno amatorów, jak i doświadczonych biegaczy górskich.
course_highlights: Trasy o długościach: 3,7 km, 5,7 km, 11,6 km, 23,2 km oraz Vertical 1,5 km
Zróżnicowany teren górski w okolicach Krakowa
Możliwość udziału w biegach dla dzieci i rywalizacji drużynowej
additional: Limit zgłoszeń na pojedynczy bieg wynosi 100 osób na dystans. Cena zniżkowa dotyczy dzieci i młodzieży do 18 lat oraz seniorów 65+. Możliwość opłaty przelewem na konto Wojsko Klub Sportowy Wawel. Trasy można testować w okresie letnim. W ramach XV edycji dostępne są klasyfikacje generalne, drużynowe, sztafety oraz dodatkowe rywalizacje. Bieg odbędzie się w niedzielę 6 grudnia 2026 r.

name: Mikołajkowy Charytatywny Bieg i Marsz NW
47. Mühlenberger Nikolauslauf
location: Bezirkssportanlage am Ossietzkyring, Ossietzkyring, Hannover, Germany
description: The 47th Mühlenberger Nikolaus Run is a family-friendly running event in Hanover on December 6, 2026. It offers races over 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km on a flat, fast course, ideal for runners of all ages and experience levels. The event takes place at the district sports facility on Ossietzkyring and is known for its pleasant, community atmosphere. There are special races for children and teenagers, with every student receiving a St. Nicholas surprise. The best runners in each age group are rewarded with certificates and honorary prizes. The race is part of the Lauf(s)pass series in the Hanover region and invites all running enthusiasts to celebrate the festive season in an active way.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course at the district sports facility
Family- and child-friendly event with special races for teenagers
Part of the Lauf(s)pass series in the Hanover region
additional: Online registration available; race in Mühlenberg, Hanover; open to all age groups; awards for winners and age-group winners

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Lage is a traditional running event organized by the running division of TG Lage. The course runs through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park and features well-maintained forest trails, partly along the famous Hermann Trail. The run is suitable for runners of all ability levels and takes place annually in December. The event is part of TG Lage’s varied running and walking program, which also offers beginner courses and training opportunities.
course_highlights: Course through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park
Well-maintained, easy-to-run forest trails
Sections along the famous Hermann Trail
additional: TG Lage’s running division also offers a Nordic walking beginner course that covers the basics in 4 sessions of 60 minutes each. Walking poles are available to borrow. There is also a 10-session pass for time-limited training participation, valid for 6 months and 10 training sessions. The office is open on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Run on forest and field paths in the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park, on the 2nd Sunday of Advent; easy to reach, with a festive atmosphere in the gym.

name: Fischteiche Cross
description: The Fischteiche Cross is a traditional cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst near Leck, organised by SV Enge-Sande. It marks the end of the Cross-Cup series and offers races for different age groups and distances, from 0.8 km for the youngest children to 9.6 km for adults and seniors. The event features a varied woodland course and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments on site.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Langenberger Forst
Distances from 0.8 km to 9.6 km, depending on age group
Varied woodland course with typical December weather
additional: Starts are organised by age group and suitable distance; registration and results via myraceresult; coffee, cake and other refreshments available on site; awards ceremony after the race. Cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst, with distances for all age groups and registration via myraceresult. Weather-dependent, with possible winter conditions, and refreshments including coffee and cake.

name: FT Jahn Nikolauslauf
location: Jahn Vereinsheim, Landsberg am Lech, Bavaria, Germany
description: The FT Jahn Nikolauslauf in Landsberg am Lech is a traditional running event held annually in December. It offers various distances for all age groups and fitness levels, from 1 km for children to 10 km for endurance runners. Nordic walking is also included. The event combines sporting ambition with a friendly community atmosphere in one of Germany’s most beautiful towns, inviting everyone to kick off the Advent season in an active way.
course_highlights: Distances from 1 km to 10 km for different age groups
Winter atmosphere in the historic town of Landsberg am Lech
Combination of running and Nordic walking events
additional: Start times are staggered by distance: the 1 km and 2 km races start at 11:00, the 5 km run and Nordic walking event at 11:30, and the 10 km run at 11:45. Minimum ages vary by distance (6 years for 1 km, 12 years for 2 km, and 16 years for 5 km and 10 km). The event takes place at the Jahn clubhouse in Landsberg am Lech. Running and Nordic walking distances from 1 km to 10 km; various age groups; winter atmosphere; registration required.

name: Heeslinger Nikolauscross
description: The Heeslingen Nikolaus Cross-Country Run is a popular cross-country race held annually in Heeslingen, Lower Saxony. The event attracts athletes and families from the region and is known for its high-level sporting challenges. The races also determine the district champions of Rotenburg/W. The organizer, Heeslinger SC, is an established point of contact for sports enthusiasts and volunteers from the surrounding communities.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through varied terrain
Determination of the district champions of Rotenburg/W.
Event in the Heeslingen region with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Courses and participation conditions are available in the relevant event announcement; no entry fee is required. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children, young people, adults and masters.

name: Klausdorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Klausdorf St. Nicholas Run is a longstanding running event on the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord, taking place on December 6, 2026, in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district. This will be the 41st edition of the event, attracting runners from the region. The event offers a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere and is a sporting highlight for all age groups. Official registration is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays.
course_highlights: Run along the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord
Traditional running event with a festive atmosphere
Event in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district
additional: The official registration page is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays. Course maps are available as images on the website. Registration is expected to be available on the official website after the 2026 summer holidays; the event is known for its good value for money and family-friendly atmosphere.

name: landesoffener Nikolaus-Waldlauf
