description: The 46th open Nikolaus Forest Run will take place on December 6, 2026, at the Arnstorf School Centre. The event offers various races for adults, young people and children on hilly forest trails, with distances ranging from 2.7 km to 7.2 km. The start and finish are at the Arnstorf School Centre, which can be reached by a free shuttle bus. The award ceremonies and shower facilities are also at the school centre. The event is part of the Grenzland Running Cup and includes age-group rankings for schoolchildren.
course_highlights: Hilly route through woodland
Start and finish at the Arnstorf School Centre, with shower facilities
Free shuttle bus to the start/finish
additional: Distances range from 300 m to 8.7 km, with age-group rankings for schoolchildren. Races are offered for children, young people and adults, as well as Nordic walking. The route to the school centre is signposted. Various distances; start at the Arnstorf School Centre; free shuttle buses; shower facilities; winter running event in woodland.

name: Melsunger Adventslauf Rund um die Koppe
description: The Melsungen Advent Run is a traditional running event held every year on the second Sunday of Advent in Melsungen. Various distances are offered: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km. The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course. The event attracts runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with special appreciation for children and recreational runners. It is organised by the running group of Melsunger Turngemeinde 1861 e.V. and is a fixture in the North Hesse popular running calendar.
course_highlights: Various distances: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
Family-friendly event with special care for children
additional: Results and certificates are provided via My Race Result. The event takes place every year on the second Sunday of Advent. Children receive a small treat (e.g. chocolate wafers) and a medal at the finish, as well as a certificate at the awards ceremony. The event is organised by the MT Melsungen organising team / recreational sports department / running group. Course distances: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km; registration and results via My Race Result; winter weather is possible.

name: Nikolaus-Lauf in Ochsenfurt
description: The Nikolauslauf in Ochsenfurt is a traditional running event organized annually by Turnverein Ochsenfurt 1862 e. V. The event offers various races for Bambinis, schoolchildren, young people, recreational runners, and a main race. The courses are suitable for all age groups and foster a sense of sporting community in the region. The run traditionally takes place in early December and attracts numerous participants from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: Various race categories for all age groups
Festive December atmosphere in Ochsenfurt
Annual event with a tradition and community spirit
additional: Alongside the races, the Nikolauslauf also offers a sociable atmosphere, ideal for families and running enthusiasts. Results from previous years are available on the website.

name: Oelder Nikolauslauf
location: Oelder Jahnstadion, Oelde, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 52nd Oelde St. Nicholas Run takes place on December 6, 2026, at Oelde’s Jahnstadion, welcoming children, young people, and adults to a varied running experience. With four different running distances and a Nordic walking and walking distance recognized as a performance distance for the German Sports Badge, the event offers a suitable challenge for every age and ability level. The routes pass through the stadium and the surrounding countryside, including challenging climbs in Limberger Forest. The event is a popular St. Nicholas Day tradition and promotes recreational sport in the region.
course_highlights: 0.6 km lap in the stadium for children up to age 7
3 km fitness run along paved farm roads through the Bergeler farming community
11.5 km countryside run with climbs in Limberger Forest
additional: The 7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route is barrier-free and also suitable for wheelchairs. Age-group awards are offered for walking. Various running and walking routes, including Nordic walking; barrier-free; performance distances for the German Sports Badge; children's and youth races

name: Saalfelder Winterlauf
description: The Winter Run Around the Katze in Saalfeld an der Saale is a traditional 15 km road race held in winter since 1982. The course starts at the Langenschader Straße sports field, loops around the local landmark “Katze,” passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm, and returns to the start. The race is officially measured and scored in DLV age groups, making it especially appealing to club runners of all ages. The event is small, usually attracting fewer than 100 participants, and offers straightforward organization with online registration, changing rooms, and showers on site.
course_highlights: Officially measured 15 km road-race course
Loop around the “Katze” landmark in Saalfeld
Course passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the Langenschader Straße sports field. The event usually has fewer than 100 runners. Results are scored in DLV age groups. December weather is typically cold, averaging 3 °C, with frequent snowfall. The race offers online registration, changing rooms, and showers at the venue, and results are scored by age group.

name: Crosslauf Weißenseer Sportverein
description: The cross-country race of Weißenseer Sportverein Rot-Weiss traditionally takes place at Stadion Buschallee in Berlin. The event is part of the club’s diverse athletics program and invites runners of all ages to take part in a well-organized competition. The course offers a varied cross-country experience in a sporting, family-friendly atmosphere. Spectators and participants benefit from the dedicated support of the club and numerous volunteers.
course_highlights: Cross-country race at Stadion Buschallee, Berlin
Traditional race with regional and national participation
Event included in WSV Rot-Weiss’s diverse athletics program
additional: The cross-country race is part of the club’s athletics events and has a long tradition. The event is supported by numerous officials and volunteers. There is no information about different start waves or special participant restrictions. Online registration is possible; the registration deadline is December 1, 2026, at 23:59.

name: ELM-Advents-HALBMARATHON
description: The ELM Advent Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon race in Königslutter, held annually in December. The course starts and finishes at Lutterspring 1 and offers runners an attractive opportunity to race during the Advent season. The race is open to participants aged 14 and over and is organized by TSV Lelm. A partnership with TSG Königslutter also allows participants to use the sauna and showers for a small fee.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lutterspring 1, 38154 Königslutter
Half-marathon course through the Königslutter region
Partnership with TSG Königslutter for access to fitness facilities and the sauna
additional: Late entries are accepted only for the main half-marathon race, by WhatsApp or email. The minimum age to participate is 14. The partnership with TSG Königslutter allows participants to use the fitness equipment, sauna and showers for a section fee of 17.50 euros, without paying TSG’s main membership fee. Results and certificates are available online via RUNTIMING.

name: Nikolauslauf des Ahrensburger TSV
description: The Ahrensburger TSV Saint Nicholas Run is a traditional running event held annually in Ahrensburg in Forst Hagen. The race is open to various age groups, from children to masters, and offers a sporting opportunity in the run-up to Christmas. Organized by Ahrensburger TSV, the event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the sporting challenge of running outside the stadium.
course_highlights: Route through Forst Hagen, Ahrensburg
Various categories, from children to masters
Traditional Saint Nicholas Run held in December
additional: The entry fee is paid when collecting race materials on the day of the event.

name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
description: The Malá cena Velké Verandy is a traditional forest cross-country race held in Choceň. The race is 4,300 metres long and follows forest roads and trails, with approximately 200 metres of elevation gain. The course is marked with ribbons and includes a short stretch of asphalt. The race is also the Jirka Švadlena Memorial and is popular with runners looking for challenging terrain with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: 4,300 m along forest roads and trails
Hilly profile with approximately 200 m of elevation gain
Course marked with ribbons, approximately 400 m of asphalt
additional: The race includes approximately 400 m of asphalt and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting. It is part of the local sporting calendar.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and runners earning points throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00, and the start is by the fountain in the park.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) route through Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
A race suitable for all ages and running abilities
Picturesque park setting, with the fountain as the starting point
additional: The race venue is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens, except for two races in June and August, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is run on an asphalt course, registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and the event is part of a series of runs in Olomouc with multiple dates throughout the year.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - září
location: Smetanovy sady fountain, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. Everyone competes primarily against themselves and runs for the enjoyment of it. The race takes place in the scenic Smetana Gardens, by the fountain in Olomouc. It also includes a cup competition, in which results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens, by the fountain
Suitable for all ages and running abilities
Cup competition with points calculated using an age coefficient
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 on race day. The top three finishers are announced in each category.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://cs.srichinmoyraces.org/beh-2-mile-olomouc): 2026-12-06 — "Další závod: 6. prosinec 2026 Olomouc" (was estimated 2027-09-05)

name: Čertovský běh Damníkov
location: ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov, Damníkov, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 100 Kč, přihlásit se lze jen v den závodu při prezentaci.

description: Čertovský běh Damníkov is a traditional road race uphill from Damníkov to Anenská Studánka in the Lanškroun region, held since 1984. The 4 km course follows an asphalt road with about 150 metres of elevation gain and a challenging uphill profile, especially in the second half. The race is part of the ISCAREX POHÁR 2026 series and is suitable for the general public, including junior categories. The start is at ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov and the finish is at the cultural centre in Anenská Studánka, where refreshments and the awards ceremony are provided.
course_highlights: 4 km asphalt course with approximately 150 m of elevation gain
The climb becomes steeper after the railway crossing
The route runs from Damníkov to Anenská Studánka; in December, there may be snow or icy conditions
additional: Race-day check-in takes place from 9:00 to 10:10 in the ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov building. Changing rooms are available at both the start and finish. Refreshments and the awards ceremony are provided at the finish. Anenská Studánka railway stop is on the route about 1.2 km before the finish, making it easier to return after the race. According to the available information, registration takes place on race day during check-in at the ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov building; winter weather may affect the course surface.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 12. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race organized by Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the race starts at 10:00. The event is part of a series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Challenge Cup, with finishing times adjusted using age coefficients based on year of birth.
course_highlights: Course length: 2 miles (3.218 km); children: approx. 200 m
Venue: Kuchajda swimming pool grounds, Bratislava
Check-in beside the volleyball court
additional: Registration takes place on site beside the volleyball court from 9:30. Categories are children (13 and under), juniors, women, men, female veterans, and male veterans. Competitors are awarded points based on the number of participants in their categories; junior men and junior women are scored separately. In the event of a tie, year of birth and the best time that year determine the result. An amnesty is granted for two participations, in which the two months with the lowest point totals are discarded. Races take place in several rounds throughout the year, including the 12th round in December. On-site registration is available; pricing details are not specified, and the course is mostly asphalt in an urban setting.

name: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke
location: Základná škola Hviezdoslavova, Lipany, Prešov, Slovakia
description: The Mikuláš Night Run to the Balážka lookout tower is an adrenaline-fueled night race for participants over 15 years old. The event starts at 19:00 from Hviezdoslavova Primary School in Lipany. Runners can look forward to a unique nighttime experience with views from the lookout tower. The entry fee is a minimum of €7, and participants must register.
course_highlights: A night run with an adrenaline-fueled atmosphere
The route leads to the Balážka lookout tower
The event is for participants over 15 years old
additional: This is a unique nighttime event with a minimum entry fee of €7. Participants must be over 15 years old.

name: Nitrianska bežecká liga – 12. kolo
location: Entrance to the summer swimming pool, Mestský park na Sihoti, Nitra, Slovakia
price_range: 5 € za hlavný beh; detské behy zdarma
description: The Nitra Running League – Round 12 is a running event held in Nitra, in Sihoť City Park by the entrance to the summer swimming pool. The race takes place on a 5 km asphalt course and is suitable for a wide range of age groups, from juniors to seniors. The event also includes children’s races over distances of 50 to 1,000 metres, with no entry fee and small prizes. After the races, a raffle is held, and the league’s best runners are honoured at an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 5 km asphalt course
Children’s races divided by age groups from 0 to 15 years
The race takes place in Sihoť City Park by the entrance to the summer swimming pool
additional: After the races, a raffle is held for all participants in the main race; the league’s best runners are honoured at an awards ceremony. Age categories range from juniors (16–18 years) to men over 70. Children’s races are divided by age, with different course distances ranging from 50 m for toddlers to 1,000 m for schoolchildren. Children’s categories are divided by age from 0 to 15 years. The first three finishers in each category are announced, and a raffle is held after the main race.

name: Beh 2 míle
location: Park Ostredky or Kuchajda swimming pool grounds, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: The 2 Miles Run Bratislava is a running series organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, held in Bratislava at Park Ostredky and the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds. The race is run on a paved road course measuring 2 miles (3.22 km), and also includes children’s races. The series features a points competition for a perpetual trophy, with points awarded in each round based on participation and placing. Entry is free, allowing the general public to take part without financial burden. Check-in and registration take place on site before the races.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.22 km) course on paved roads
The races take place in the pleasant surroundings of Park Ostredky and the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds
Children’s races are also held: 200 m for children under 13
additional: Check-in and registration take place on site behind Komunitné námestie from 9:30. Parking is available in the large car park on Sputniková Street or near OC Budúcnosť. The nearest public transport stops are Súmračná, Clementisova and Maximiliána Hella. There are no public toilets in the park.

name: Mikuláš behá v Jame
location: Park Jama, Nové Mesto, Bratislava, Slovakia

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Nižbor
price_range: 390 Kč za závod, 1 900 Kč za 6 závodů, 2 900 Kč za celou sérii

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voucher na celou sérii 12 běhů = 2 900 Kč (240 Kč/závod)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River, from Radotín to Nižbor, running from January to December 2026. The routes follow trails with stunning views and varied terrain, often near nature reserves and historical sites. The series is suitable for experienced runners and beginners alike, and aims to encourage regular running. Most starts are at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs. At the end of the series, winners are announced and prizes are awarded in 12 categories.
course_highlights: Trails with views of the Berounka River and the Český kras Protected Landscape Area
Challenging climbs and nature reserves, such as Klapice and Radotínské skály
Starts at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs
additional: Refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms with showers, and race bibs are available at the race venues. Bringing a headlamp is recommended. Rankings are based on the 10 highest-scoring races in the series. Most starts are near train stations and at local pubs that provide facilities. Trail races in the Berounka area; starts mostly accessible by train; winners announced in December; 12 categories; scoring based on the 10 best races

name: Prosincový běh Smetanovými sady Olomouc
location: Hudební pavilon, Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The December Run through Smetana Gardens in Olomouc is a 6.55 km race on a 1.3 km asphalt loop in the beautiful surroundings of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Running League and offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a run in a pleasant urban park. The route is suitable for fast running on asphalt and is ideal for winter running outdoors near the city center.
course_highlights: 6.55 km race on a 1.3 km asphalt loop
The loop runs through the picturesque Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
Part of the Olomouc Running League

name: 9 Bieg Śladami Żubra
description: Bieg Śladami Żubra to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie Sportowe "Aktywna Pszczyna" w Studzienicach, odbywająca się w grudniu. Trasa biegu prowadzi po jednej lub dwóch pętlach studzienickiego lasu, będącego częścią Puszczy Pszczyńskiej, oferując malownicze leśne krajobrazy. W ramach wydarzenia odbywają się różne dystanse, w tym Bieg Przebierańców, biegi dla dzieci oraz biegi i Nordic Walking na 6 km i 12 km, a także półmaraton i maraton. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na medale, wyróżnienia za przebrania oraz tradycyjną grochówkę na mecie.
course_highlights: Trasa po studzienickim lesie, części Puszczy Pszczyńskiej
Rywalizacja na jednej lub dwóch pętlach leśnych
Malownicze leśne krajobrazy i naturalne błoto
additional: Starty rozłożone są na różne godziny: 08:00 maraton, 08:30 Bieg Przebierańców (1,8 km), 10:10 półmaraton. Dla dzieci przygotowano biegi na dystansach 200m, 400m, 800m oraz 250m, 400m, 850m w zależności od wieku. Na mecie czekają medale i wyróżnienia za najciekawsze przebrania. Organizowana jest klasyfikacja drużynowa (4 najlepsze czasy po 1 pętli). Trasa jest wykorzystywana także do Nordic Walking. Na mecie serwowana jest tradycyjna grochówka. Dostępne są pliki GPX tras półmaratonu, maratonu oraz biegów 6 km i 12 km. Nowy dystans maraton, zmieniona lokalizacja startu i mety, atrakcje kulinarne i regeneracyjne, patronaty honorowe, zawody dodatkowe w crossie i klasyfikacja drużynowa

name: 6 Wigilijny Bieg Charytatywny
price_range: 45–90 zł, zależnie od konkurencji i terminu zapisów
description: 6. Wigilijny Bieg Charytatywny to bieg przełajowy na leśnej trasie w Lasku Majońskim w Luboniu, odbywający się 12 grudnia 2026 roku. Uczestnicy mogą wybrać między biegiem na 5 km a marszem Nordic Walking na tej samej trasie. Impreza ma charakter charytatywny i wspiera Fundację Dobro się niesie, pomagającą osobom w kryzysie bezdomności. Dla dzieci przygotowano krótsze dystanse z osobnymi kategoriami dla dziewcząt i chłopców. Organizatorzy zapewniają pakiet startowy, pamiątkowy drewniany medal, posiłek oraz upominki od sponsorów.
course_highlights: 5 km bieg i Nordic Walking po 100% leśnej trasie trailowej
Tereny Nadleśnictwa Babki - Lasek Majoński w Luboniu
Bieg przełajowy z limitem czasu 50 minut
additional: Biuro zawodów od 9:45 przy Cmentarzu w Luboniu, ul. Armii Poznań 51B. Pakiet startowy zawiera numer startowy, drewniany medal, posiłek (drożdżówka i herbata) oraz upominki od sponsorów. Pomiar czasu realizowany jest za pomocą chipów zwrotnych mocowanych w bucie. Kategorie wiekowe i klasyfikacje OPEN, mieszkańców Lubonia, ZSM Poznań oraz drużyn 4-osobowych. Limit dzieci na biegi 100 osób. Dodatkowy odbiór pakietów 10 grudnia 2026 w godzinach popołudniowych (lokalizacja podana przez organizatora). Start biegu na 5 km i Nordic Walking zaplanowano na 12:30. Limit czasu wynosi 50 minut, a łączny limit uczestników tych konkurencji to 200 osób. Wpisowe obejmuje cegiełkę charytatywną w wysokości 10 lub 20 zł.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Sątopy, Nowy Tomyśl County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Polska
description: Dwumaraton Olęderski to cykl biegów organizowany przez Nowotomyski Klub Biegacza Chyży, odbywający się w warunkach terenowych jesienią i zimą. Zawody mają charakter towarzysko-sportowy i są przeznaczone zarówno dla doświadczonych biegaczy, jak i początkujących. Minimalny dystans do pokonania to 10,5 km, a pełny dystans maratonu to 42,2 km, który można pokonać jako wielokrotność pętli 10,5 km. Impreza odbywa się w Sątopy, a jej celem jest aktywne przepracowanie trudnego okresu jesienno-zimowego w terenie.
course_highlights: Trasa terenowa z pętlą 10,5 km
Możliwość pokonania pełnego maratonu lub wielokrotności pętli
Zawody odbywają się w warunkach jesienno-zimowych
additional: Dwumaraton Olęderski to cykl zawodów odbywający się jeden weekend w miesiącu od października do marca, każdy w innej miejscowości. Biuro zawodów otwierane jest o 09:00, a start pierwszego biegu o 10:00. Limit czasu na pierwszy bieg to 16:00, a na drugi bieg kolejnego dnia start o 09:00 z limitem do 15:00. Zawody są współfinansowane przez Powiat Nowotomyski i odbywają się zgodnie z obowiązującymi obostrzeniami. Informacje dla edycji 2026/2027 wskazują termin 12 grudnia 2026 r.; podane przez użytkownika 13 grudnia może odnosić się do innego dnia wydarzenia lub weekendu.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Polska
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL z Fundacją Lotto to ogólnopolski cykl biegów przełajowych na dystansie 5 km, odbywający się w 7 lokalizacjach, w tym w Bydgoszczy. Bieg ma charakter rekreacyjno-sportowy, skierowany do osób od 16 roku życia, promując aktywność fizyczną na łonie natury. Trasa biegu prowadzi przez leśne tereny Myślęcinka i Nadleśnictwa Żołędowo, oferując piękne, naturalne otoczenie. Zawody odbywają się cyklicznie, a uczestnicy mogą sprawdzić swoje możliwości na stałej trasie przez cały sezon.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km w leśnej scenerii Myślęcinka i Nadleśnictwa Żołędowo
Start i meta na Polanie Różopole
Trasa przełajowa po lasach i parkach miejskich
additional: Biuro zawodów otwierane jest o 8:30, zamykane o 10:30. Przed biegiem o 10:45 odbywa się wspólna rozgrzewka z Ambasadorkami CITY TRAIL. Nie ma możliwości parkowania przy Polanie Różopole, zalecane jest korzystanie z parkingów około 1-1,5 km od startu. Zawody mają stały harmonogram i lokalizację biura przez cały sezon. Start zaplanowano na godz. 11:00. Zapisy przez panel zawodnika na citytrail.pl/zapisy lub w biurze zawodów w dniu biegu.

name: WINTER TRAIL MAŁOPOLSKA
location: Kasinka Mała, Mszana Dolna, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Polska
description: Winter Trail Małopolska 2026 to dziesiąta edycja zimowego festiwalu biegów górskich, będąca jednocześnie 19. zawodami serii ULTRA-TRAIL® MAŁOPOLSKA. Trasy prowadzą przez malownicze tereny Beskidu Wyspowego i Gorców, w najpiękniejszych lasach Małopolski, na obszarach nadleśnictw myślenickiego i limanowskiego. Zawody są wyjątkowo wymagające, dedykowane prawdziwym ultrasom, którzy nie boją się trudnych zimowych warunków. Na mecie czeka gorący posiłek wegetariański oraz serdeczna atmosfera.
course_highlights: Trasy przez Beskid Wyspowy i Gorce
Przebieg przez lasy nadleśnictw myślenickiego i limanowskiego
Trudne zimowe warunki i wymagające przewyższenia
additional: Start i meta na Stadionie Miejskim w Mszanie Dolnej przy ul. Spadochroniarzy. Biuro zawodów i depozyt w Miejskim Ośrodku Kultury w Mszanie Dolnej, otwarte na godzinę przed startem. Brak pakietów startowych, na mecie pakiet finiszera. Obowiązkowe wyposażenie kontrolowane przy rejestracji i na trasie. Na trasie i mecie dostępne punkty wegetariańskie oraz gorący posiłek VEGE. Możliwość zostawienia depozytu (przepak) na trasie dla dystansów WTM 140 i WTM 105. GPS Tracker obowiązkowy dla WTM 140 i WTM 105. Edycja 2026 odbędzie się 12 - 13 grudnia. Dostępne są zapisy, informacje dla uczestników, FAQ i śledzenie online.

name: Adventscrosslauf
description: The Wilscher Advent Cross-Country Run Gifhorn is a traditional cross-country race held during Advent in Gifhorn, Lower Saxony. The main distance is 7.5 km and runs through the winter landscape of the Wilsche district. The race starts at 14:00 at the meeting point at An der Masch 4. The event is organised by VfR Wilsche/Neubokel, and the entry fee is 7 euros.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the winter landscape of Gifhorn-Wilsche
Main distance: 7.5 km
Start and meeting point at An der Masch 4
additional: The meeting point and start are at An der Masch 4 in the Wilsche district of Gifhorn. Typical December weather includes temperatures around 3 °C and snow cover on most days. The race starts at 14:00, with the meeting point at An der Masch 4 in Gifhorn. Registration is via the club website. The event is a lovely opportunity to enjoy the Advent season in an active and sociable way.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 2. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a traditional running event organised by TSG Alten-Buseck. It includes several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The races take place during the colder months and offer a great opportunity to enjoy the winter landscape around Alten-Buseck together with other runners. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, with special races for children and young people. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy refreshments, followed by an awards ceremony for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km
Start and finish at Harbig Halle in Alten-Buseck
Winter running routes; the course may be changed because of construction work
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, with awards for the three fastest participants of the day (men/women) and age-group winners. Certificates, results and photos are available online. After crossing the finish line, participants receive a free refreshing drink; coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Harbig Halle. Parking at Harbig Halle is limited. The Bambini run starts at approximately 14:15 (December only). Distance options: 700 m and 15 km; the event is expected to take place in winter conditions; start location: Alten-Buseck, Buseck.

name: Bühlerzeller Winterlauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 4.5 km, 3000 Meter, 0.9 km
description: The Bühlerzell Winter Run is an established winter running event in Bühlerzell, Germany, organized by Sportfreunde Bühlerzell. With at least 21 editions, the event offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, including 3 km, 5 km, and 6.5 km. The program is aimed at younger runners, beginners, and experienced road runners, and takes place in typical December weather, with courses usually covered in snow.
course_highlights: Various distances from 900 m to 10 km
Winter running conditions with snow
Start and finish in Bühlerzell
additional: The event offers very short races alongside the 10 km race to include a range of runner groups. Typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall, shapes the event. Races over various distances, including walking, take place in winter in Bühlerzell; typical temperatures are around 3°C. Check details with the organizer before registering.

name: Jahresendlauf
location: Bad Berka, Weimarer Land, Thuringia, Germany
price_range: bis 16 Jahren: 4,00 EUR, ab 17 Jahren: 8,00 EUR, zusätzliche Servicegebühr bei Anmeldung am Tag vor Ort

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: bis 16 Jahren: 4,00 Euro bei Vor-Anmeldung im Portal

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: ab 17 Jahren: 8,00 EUR bei Vor-Anmeldung im Portal

description: The year-end run in Bad Berka is a traditional running event held every December. The routes pass through the scenic Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas on paved, gravel and forest roads. The event offers various distances, including a free 400 m mini-run for children and longer distances for young people and adults. It is open to all running enthusiasts and is organized by the sports club Spielvereinigung Bad Berka e.V.
course_highlights: Routes through the Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas
Paved, gravel and forest roads
Start and finish at Ilmtalstadion Bad Berka
additional: The 400 m mini-run is free. On-site registration is available on race day, with an additional service fee (€1.00 up to age 16, €2.00 from age 17) and cash payment only. Changing rooms and showers are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße (approx. 500 m walk). The race office opens at 9:00 a.m. The routes have a rolling profile. Online registration is available. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße.

name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada, between the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in Chabařovice and offers 12.5 km and 5.3 km routes, as well as Olympia children’s races. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the lake’s magical snowy and icy landscape. All races have a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere and are suitable for children, families and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes run through the natural surroundings of a former brown-coal mine transformed into Lake Milada
A winter run through the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: a 12.5 km long route and a 5.3 km short route, plus children’s races
additional: A race pack and medal for every competitor. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. The first 100 children to register receive a children’s T-shirt free of charge. The race is limited to 500 competitors. The accompanying programme includes St. Nicholas, a devil and an angel, and the Olympia children’s corner. Terrain in the former mine area, winter/icy conditions, family and children’s categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club. The race takes place in the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The race bib is valid for the entire series of races organized by the event organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the square in Úpice, by the A. Jirásek Theatre
Categories for children and adults, with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the option to take part in the race series
additional: The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. Registration closes at 13:30 for the children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The race bib is valid for the entire race series and must be brought to each subsequent race. Results are not announced after each individual race but are published on the organizer’s website. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in the square in Úpice. The scheduled start times are 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration takes place one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026. It is both a charity event and a race. The aim is to encourage more people to take up sport, help those in need, and give participants a chance to unwind from pre-Christmas stress by running through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas. The route passes through the beautiful chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere. You can preview it in a video or download the GPX file for your smartwatch. After the race, warm soup and mulled wine will be served to round off the event.
course_highlights: Run through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas
The route passes through the chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere
Downloadable GPX route file for smartwatches
additional: The race is a charity event, and warm soup and mulled wine will be served to participants after the run. The overall male and female winners hold the course record with a time of 19:10. The route is illuminated for Christmas, and festive decorations add to the atmosphere. The event offers two distances, 900 m and 5,500 m, and is open to children and adults. It features a Christmas atmosphere and a downloadable GPX route file.

name: Mikulášský běh Petřkovice
location: Stadion MK Seitl, Petřkovice u Starého Jičína, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Mikulášský běh Petřkovice is a traditional race held in the village of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The event is part of the District Running League and welcomes runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the run-up to Christmas. Exact race distances and registration details have not yet been announced, but the race is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar. It is a great opportunity to combine sport with a community experience and celebrate the approaching Christmas season in an active way.
course_highlights: Part of the District Running League
Traditional pre-Christmas atmosphere
Suitable for runners of all levels
additional: The race takes place on December 12, 2026, near the MK Seitl stadium in Petřkovice, and is part of the regional running calendar.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: The Pre-Christmas Run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for both young people and adults. Young runners take on asphalt loops in the stadium grounds ranging from 180 m to 1.7 km. Adults run kilometre loops: men run 8 km and women 3 km, with various distances available in the stadium grounds. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt loops in the stadium grounds for young runners, from 180 m to 1.7 km
Kilometre loops in Staré Město for adults — 8 km for men and 3 km for women
Race with a long-standing tradition dating back to 1984
additional: A run in the stadium grounds, with on-site registration, refreshments in the stadium clubhouse, and various distances from 200 m to 8 km

name: Vranovský noční Trail
location: Samovýčep, Vranov u Brna, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Night Trail is a winter race run in the dark around Vranov u Brna, offering a challenging yet beautiful course. The race symbolizes the balance between day and night and is the first real running test of the new season. The start and finish are at the Samovýčep venue, which has facilities including a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. After the race, warm Italian food, mulled wine and a relaxed after-party await. The organizers emphasize quality refreshments and a friendly atmosphere that runners can enjoy after finishing.
course_highlights: A 21.3 km course in the Podkomorské forests and around the reservoir
The course is marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter race run in the dark over challenging terrain
additional: Race facilities at the Samovýčep venue include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. There is plenty of water and sports drinks on the course. After the race, there is warm Italian food, mulled wine and an after-party with the opportunity to share feedback and socialize. A headlamp is essential. Facilities include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea, a warm post-race meal and an after-party.

name: CHRISTMAS RUN Praha
location: Rudolfinum, náměstí Jana Palacha, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Christmas Run Prague is an experiential 5 km night run held in the center of Prague in front of the Rudolfinum. The event is part of the INTERSPORT Christmas Run series and also features a children’s race and the charitable Fénix Run. The run is accompanied by a festive Christmas atmosphere, a warm-up with Santa, and the option to purchase a red “SANTA” hat. The race is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants may start with written consent from a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The course runs through the center of Prague in front of the Rudolfinum
A night run with a Christmas atmosphere and a warm-up with Santa
Option to purchase a red “SANTA” hat as part of the event
additional: People aged 12 and over may register; those under 15 may participate only with written consent from a legal guardian. Registration is valid only once the entry fee has been credited to the organizer’s account. No further registration is possible once race capacity is reached. The race package includes a bag with gifts from event partners. The children’s run is 1 km long, and children may run with their parents. The Fénix Run is 2 km long, and its proceeds support nonprofit organizations. Participants in the main race receive a medal at the finish.

name: Běh okolo náměšťského zámku
location: Náměšť na Hané, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Náměšť Castle is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering runners the chance to experience the beauty of the area around Náměšť na Hané. The club specializes in recreational and competitive running and organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of Central Moravia’s running events and welcomes runners of all levels who want to test themselves in a picturesque setting. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and support for the running community.
course_highlights: The area around Náměšť na Hané, with views of the castle
A traditional endurance race in the Olomouc Region
Picturesque natural and historic surroundings
additional: In the previous edition, the start was at the KVS Náměšť na Hané grounds; the date and location for the 2026 edition have not been confirmed in the available information.

name: Mikulášsky beh na Tancovú
organizer: Občianske združenie Behači Bytča a okolie
description: Mikulášsky beh na Tancovú is an annual charity run organized by the Behači Bytča a okolie civic association. It will take place on December 12, 2026, in Kaplnka, Bytča. This 6th edition offers runners and outdoor enthusiasts the chance to take part in a 12 km run or a 5 km walk (Nordic walking) in the pleasant surroundings of an old asphalt road through forest and meadow. All proceeds from the event will go toward rehabilitation following a serious accident. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, with refreshments along the course and at the finish, and the opportunity to enter a raffle.
course_highlights: 12 km run along an old asphalt road through forest and meadow
5 km walk (Nordic walking) along the embankment, suitable for families and seniors
Charity event supporting rehabilitation following a serious accident
additional: Registration is open from 09:00 to 10:30. New participants can also register on race day. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and refreshments along the course and at the finish. The event includes a raffle, with tickets available for purchase at the race base. Parking is available at several locations, including Námestie SR, where it is free on weekends. The organizers provide a heated tent for warming up. The event is charitable; proceeds will go to Rudo Šamánek for rehabilitation following a serious accident. The three-person relay is 12 km.

name: Vianočný beh mesta Zlaté Moravce
location: Mestský štadión Calex, Zlaté Moravce, Slovakia

name: Tony Treadmill Run
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km

name: Kauno SK Nemunas 1000 m
description: The Kaunas SK „Nemunas” 1000 m Race Cup will take place on December 14, 2024, in Kaunas. On Saturday, 127 runners competed in the 1000 m event. The top places went to the Youth category: Simas Gedeikis (Kaunas) with a time of 2:38.62 and Viltė Bubinaitė (Vilnius) with 3:04.08. Juniors, younger juniors, and children also took part and achieved excellent results.

images.alt_text: Bėgikas lenktynėse su numeriu 49, SK Nemunas apranga.
1000 m bėgimo varžybų nugalėtojai ant pakylos.
Jauni bėgikai su medaliais ir dovanomis ant podiumo.
Dvi mergaitės po bėgimo su medaliais.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė is a Backyard Ultra race designed to help runners cover the 100-mile distance as easily as possible. If you’ve never received a DNF in your life, here’s your chance to earn one with honor. There will be only one winner, so get ready for a challenge in Alytus.

name: Perly Malopolski Rabka Zdroj Gorce
description: Wydarzenie jest częścią serii biegów Perły Małopolski, obejmującej różne lokalizacje w Małopolsce, i przyciąga miłośników biegania z różnych regionów. Trasa prowadzi przez malownicze tereny Gorców, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe wrażenia i możliwość podziwiania piękna okolicznej przyrody.
course_highlights: Malownicza trasa w górach Gorce
Część prestiżowej serii Perły Małopolski
Różne dystanse dostosowane do różnych poziomów biegaczy
additional: Wydarzenie obejmuje różne dystanse, a rejestracja rozpoczyna się w styczniu 2025 roku. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na piękne widoki i sportową atmosferę.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (12)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach
price_range: 20-110 zł, pakiety od 220 zł do 800 zł, opłaty dla pracowników i studentów 30 zł

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w wysokości 20 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w dniu biegu 30 zł

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: pozostałe osoby – w wysokości 45 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: pozostałe osoby – w dniu biegu 60 zł

tiers.label: tier_5
tiers.description: małżeństwa – w wysokości 80 zł przelewem na konto (każda osoba z małżeństwa zapisuje się osobno)

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika to rekreacyjna impreza biegowa i Nordic Walking odbywająca się w malowniczych lasach panewnickich w Katowicach. Zawody rozgrywane są na pętli o długości około 4882 metrów, którą można pokonać do czterech razy. Impreza promuje aktywny styl życia oraz edukację na temat prawidłowych zachowań w terenach leśnych. Uczestnicy mogą startować indywidualnie lub w parach, a wydarzenie jest otwarte zarówno dla amatorów, jak i zawodników zrzeszonych w klubach sportowych.
course_highlights: Trasa w lasach panewnickich o długości około 4882 m
Pętla oznaczona co 1 km
Możliwość pokonania trasy do 4 razy
additional: Limit czasu na pokonanie trasy w biegach i Nordic Walking wynosi 3 godziny. Uczestnicy powyżej 18 roku życia muszą podpisać oświadczenie o udziale na własną odpowiedzialność lub przedstawić zaświadczenie lekarskie. Osoby niepełnoletnie muszą mieć obecność rodzica lub opiekuna podczas weryfikacji. Możliwość zakupu pakietu startów na cały rok. Opłaty startowe nie podlegają zwrotowi, ale mogą być przeksięgowane na kolejny start pod warunkiem zgłoszenia do czwartku poprzedzającego start do godz. 15:00. Zawody mają charakter rekreacyjny, z limitem czasu 3 godziny, zapisy elektroniczne, opłaty nie podlegają zwrotowi. Impreza ma również edukacyjny wymiar, promując prawidłowe zachowania na terenach leśnych.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: ul. Spokojna, Mały Kack, Gdynia, Polska
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL z Fundacją Lotto to ogólnopolski cykl biegów przełajowych na dystansie 5 km, odbywający się w siedmiu lokalizacjach, w tym w Trójmieście na terenie Nadleśnictwa Gdańsk i okolic Małego Kacka w Gdyni. Biegi prowadzone są w naturalnym otoczeniu lasów i parków miejskich, promując aktywność fizyczną na świeżym powietrzu. Cykl składa się z czterech biegów w każdej lokalizacji, a uczestnicy mogą rywalizować w klasyfikacji lokalnej oraz łącznej. Zawody są otwarte dla osób od 16 roku życia, a młodsi uczestnicy mogą startować za zgodą opiekunów. Start biegu głównego odbywa się o godzinie 11:00.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km prowadzi przez lasy i parki miejskie
Lokalizacja Trójmiasto obejmuje Nadleśnictwo Gdańsk i okolice Małego Kacka w Gdyni
Bieg odbywa się w naturalnym otoczeniu, promując aktywność na świeżym powietrzu
additional: Biuro zawodów otwierane jest o 8:30, a numery startowe i chipy do pomiaru czasu odbiera się w dniu biegu. Harmonogram jest stały dla wszystkich lokalizacji. Uczestnicy mogą wykupić karnet na cały cykl lub startować pojedynczo. W dniu biegu opłata jest wyższa. Nie ma limitu uczestników. Uczestnicy młodsi niż 16 lat mogą startować za zgodą opiekunów. Możliwość bezpłatnego startu w innym mieście dla posiadaczy karnetu po wcześniejszym zgłoszeniu. Zapisy elektroniczne przez Panel Zawodnika na citytrail.pl/zapisy lub w dniu biegu w biurze zawodów. Dostępny jest karnet na cztery biegi w lokalizacji.

name: III Bieg Crossowy Śladami Bobra
description: III Bieg Crossowy Śladami Bobra to bieg terenowy odbywający się w Szarlejce, na trasie o długości 5 km. Impreza organizowana jest przez Fundację Sportu Pozytywnego i skierowana jest do miłośników biegania oraz nordic walking. Zawody odbywają się w grudniu, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalny pomiar czasu oraz przyjazną atmosferę. Biuro zawodów działa od godziny 9:00 do 10:30, a start biegu odbywa się w tym samym dniu na ul. Borowej 2.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 5 km
Bieg terenowy w naturalnym otoczeniu
Możliwość udziału w biegu oraz nordic walking
additional: Biuro zawodów czynne od 9:00 do 10:30. Organizator: Fundacja Sportu Pozytywnego. Elektroniczny pomiar czasu. Kategorie: bieg na 5 km oraz nordic walking 5 km. Biuro zawodów czynne w godz. 9:00 - 10:30.

name: VII Bieg Mikołajów
organizer: Stowarzyszenie WKR FAN, Superczas.pl i Miejski Ośrodek Kultury w Olsztynie
price_range: od 30 zł; opłata w dniu imprezy od 60 zł

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Podstawowa opłata startowa jest równa 30 zł ale to Ty zdecydujesz jaką kwotą wesprzesz potrzebujące dzieciaki.

description: VII Bieg Mikołajów to coroczny bieg charytatywny odbywający się w Olsztynie w ramach Warmińskiego Jarmarku Świątecznego. Trasa o długości 5 km prowadzi przez malownicze Stare Miasto, Park Centralny oraz Łynostradę. Impreza skierowana jest do osób pełnoletnich oraz młodzieży od 12 roku życia, a jej celem jest dobra zabawa oraz wsparcie Oddziału psychiatrycznego dla dzieci i młodzieży w Olsztynie. Uczestnicy otrzymują okolicznościowe czapki Mikołajów, a limit uczestników wynosi 420 osób.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km przez Stare Miasto w Olsztynie
Malownicze alejki Parku Centralnego
Bieg wzdłuż Łynostrady
additional: Biuro zawodów działa od 9:00 do 11:00 w Amfiteatrze im. Czesława Niemena przy ul. Zamkowej 1. Uczestnicy otrzymują okolicznościowe czapki Mikołajów. Pomiar czasu realizowany jest za pomocą chipów zwracanych na mecie. Wszelkie środki z opłat startowych przeznaczone są na wsparcie Oddziału psychiatrycznego dla dzieci i młodzieży w Olsztynie. Udział od 12. roku życia (rocznik 2014 i starsi). Zapisy elektroniczne do 9 grudnia 2026 r. lub do wyczerpania limitu. Biuro zawodów mieści się w Amfiteatrze im. Czesława Niemena przy ul. Zamkowej 1. Opłaty wspierają oddział psychiatryczny dla dzieci i młodzieży w Olsztynie.

name: Adventslauf
price_range: 10,00 € bis 16,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Advent Run in Hamm is a traditional winter race on officially measured out-and-back courses through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the Kurpark in Bad Hamm. The start and finish are on the tartan track at Jahnstadion, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with chip-based net and gun timekeeping. Alongside the sporting challenge, charity is also a key focus, with a donation collected for the support association of the hospice in Hamm.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back courses
Lippeaue nature conservation area
Kurpark in Bad Hamm
additional: Young people and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). An additional €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib (refunded when returned), along with a €1.00 donation for the support association of the hospice in Hamm. Timing is provided using Race Result systems via a chip in the race bib. The timing is eligible for best-list results and is forwarded to the DLV federation. Headphones, dogs and jogging strollers are prohibited during the race. The awards ceremony takes place approximately 45 minutes after the first runner finishes. Discounted admission is available at the neighboring Maximare adventure swimming pool. Courses are timed using Race Result; race bibs contain a chip; the awards ceremony is approximately 45 minutes after the finish; admission to Maximare is available.

name: Flensburger Adventslauf
description: The Flensburg Advent Run is a long-standing running event held every December in Flensburg. It is organized by 1. Flensburger Lauftreff, a club recognized with distinction by the German Athletics Association. The event promotes community and enthusiasm for running in the region, offering runners of all abilities an appealing opportunity to take part in sport. The route winds through the winter city, creating a festive atmosphere shortly before Christmas.
course_highlights: Various race distances (1.8 km to 14 km)
Hilly course profile
Suitable for all age groups and Nordic walking
additional: Running event in December with winter weather, course route and age categories, chip timing, safety rules, no refunds for non-participation

name: Ismaninger Winterlaufserie
description: The Ismaning Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in several stages from December to February. It offers races for different age groups and distances, including 13 km, 17 km and a half marathon, as well as races for schoolchildren and speed races. The races take place in the beautiful surroundings of Ismaning and are ideal for runners who want to stay active in winter. A free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station makes getting there easier, and refreshments at the finish invite participants to linger.
course_highlights: 13 km, 17 km and half marathon courses
Separate races for schoolchildren and speed races for different age groups
Free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station
additional: Finish refreshments; participants may bring their own cup. Free shuttle buses from Ismaning S-Bahn station. Races for schoolchildren and speed races for U16 and older. GPX course files are available. The event also includes youth and speed races, with shuttle bus transport from Ismaning S-Bahn station. Results and historical data are available on the website.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen. The event is organized by the local running community, which also organizes the Wellen Marathon, and offers a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere away from large city events. The course includes several distances and runs through the rural surroundings, supported by local volunteers, sponsors, and the fire brigade. The series preserves its traditional character and offers runners a challenging, authentic winter running experience.
course_highlights: Rural course with a traditional character
Event with a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere
Support from local volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather conditions: around 7 °C, mostly rainy; start location: Beverstedt-Wellen; the event is part of a series with several distances (3 km and 11 km). Distances: 3 km, 11 km; traditional, community-oriented; December weather is usually cool and rainy.

name: Sparkassen Advents-Cross der LG Nordheide
location: Jahnplatz, Schützengehölz, Winsen (Luhe), Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: U10-U16 2,50 Euro, U18-U20 3,00 Euro, Erwachsene 5,00 Euro
description: The Sparkassen Advent Cross-Country Run hosted by LG Nordheide takes place on December 13, 2026, in Winsen (Luhe), at Schützengehölz by Jahnplatz. The event is open to participants from across the state and offers races for all age groups from U10 to seniors, including age groups up to M/W 95. The races cover various distances of approximately 1,400 meters to 9 kilometers. Team rankings are held separately for male and female participants. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available, as well as signposted parking nearby.
course_highlights: Various distances from approx. 1,400 m to 9 km
Races from U10 through senior age groups, including M/W 95
Venue in Schützengehölz, with a signposted walking route
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a 50% surcharge. Entries submitted by email incur a surcharge of EUR 1.00 per start. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available. Parking is available behind the Stadthalle and at the Stadthalle car park; the venue is about a 300-meter walk through Schützengehölz along a signposted route. Registration constitutes consent to the publication of the participant’s name, year of birth, club, and photo and video material in results lists and the media. Distances range from approximately 1,400 m to longer distances; registration is open until December 6, 2026. Late entries are possible for an additional fee. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available; parking is behind the Stadthalle.

name: Int. Weihnachts-Crosslauf
description: The Int. Christmas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country race held shortly before Christmas at Ravensberger Stadium in Borgholzhausen. The event is organized by LCS Olbä and offers several distances, including 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 7.5 km walking/Nordic walking course. The 16 km course consists of two laps over partly hilly terrain around Borgholzhausen and a loop around Barenberg, which is run twice. It is a true cross-country challenge with climbs and descents. The start and finish sections are on paved paths, where spikes are not allowed. The race attracts a diverse field, from top runners to recreational and older runners, as well as walkers.

name: Christmas Run Most
location: 1. náměstí, Most, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: Hlavní závod 650–900 Kč; dětský běh 200–400 Kč; Fénix Run 250–300 Kč
description: Christmas Run Most is an atmospheric night run taking place on 13 December 2026 in the centre of Most. It offers three race options: the 5 km main race, the 2 km Fénix Run charity race, and a 1 km non-competitive children’s run. The event also features a warm-up with Santa and a festive awards ceremony. The race is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants may take part only with written consent from a legal guardian. The event is organised by EVENT media s.r.o.
course_highlights: Night run in the centre of Most
Main course: 5 km (2 × 2.5 km laps)
2 km Fénix Run charity race and 1 km children’s run
additional: Registration is valid only once the entry fee has been credited to the organiser’s account. No further registrations are possible once the race capacity has been reached. Children under 15 must have written consent from a legal guardian. The race pack includes a bag with gifts from the event’s partners. The main race has a capacity of 1,000 runners. The children’s run is non-competitive, and children may run with their parents. Participants in the main race receive a medal; proceeds from the Fénix Run and voluntary contributions support non-profit organisations.

name: Trailová Závist
location: TJ Sokol Zvole clubhouse, Hlavní 197, 252 45 Zvole, Czech Republic
description: Trailová Závist is a running race across three valleys in an area of rugged slopes and steep-sided ravines above the Vltava River. The approximately 17.3 km course runs through deep forests and combines challenging climbs, technical descents, and running sections with beautiful views. The race is open to runners of all abilities and is included among the UTMB Index Races, allowing participants to earn a 20 km Index. The start and registration take place at the TJ Sokol Zvole clubhouse, which also provides baggage storage and refreshments after the finish. After the race, participants receive soup, a medal, and a pin, all included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: The course crosses rugged slopes and steep-sided ravines above the Vltava River
Challenging climbs and technical descents, with a mix of asphalt, gravel, mud, and leaves
Beautiful views and running through deep forests with a Celtic historical backdrop
additional: The race is limited to 250 starters. Race numbers can also be purchased on site until 9:30. The entry fee includes a timing chip on loan, refreshments at the finish (soup), a medal, and a pin. After the race, outdoor seating and the clubhouse are available as shelter from bad weather. There are no showers or heated changing rooms. Entries can be transferred to another person until 11.12.2026 12:00 via sportovniservis.cz. T-shirts, hoodies, and caps featuring the race design are also available for purchase. The entry fee includes a timing chip on loan, refreshments at the finish, soup, a finisher’s medal, and a pin. The race is limited to 250 runners.

name: Běh cyklistů
location: Novoveská ulice, Jinonice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh cyklistů is a challenging cross-country race in Prague’s Jinonice district, taking runners over hilly terrain on forest and meadow paths. The race offers 6 km and 3 km courses; in previous editions, the longer course was for men and the shorter one for women, juniors, and veterans. Expect a fast-paced off-road race with repeated climbs and steep descents.
course_highlights: A hilly cross-country course on forest and meadow paths.
A loop course with sharp climbs and steep descents.
Two course distances: 6 km and 3 km.
additional: Race facilities are on Novoveská Street in Prague-Jinonice.

name: Adventní charitativní běh Kuňka
location: Ráby, Pardubice District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic

name: Santa Fun Run Šiauliai
description: The Santa Fun Run is a lovely tradition for Šiauliai residents and visitors, with nearly 500 participants dressed as Santa Claus running through the city streets. The run has a noble purpose: all funds raised go to charity. There are no age restrictions, and everyone can easily complete the symbolic 1.3 km distance. At the finish, participants will be in for a surprise: one of Lithuania’s best-known performers, Jovani, will greet the running Santas.

name: Bieg po moczkę i makówki
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Stanowicach, Stanowice, Opole, Polska
description: Bieg po Moczkę i Makówki to coroczna, przyjacielska impreza biegowa odbywająca się w Stanowicach, która od 2012 roku wpisała się na stałe do kalendarza biegów świątecznych. Trasa liczy 10 km, podzielona na cztery pętle po 2,5 km, z możliwością wcześniejszego ukończenia po dowolnej liczbie pętli. Po biegu uczestnicy otrzymują ręcznie robione medale z piernika oraz tradycyjną moczkę i makówki, a także mogą liczyć na gorącą kawę i herbatę. Wydarzenie charakteryzuje się luźną, przyjacielską atmosferą, a także konkursem na najciekawsze przebranie i konkurs kibiców z nagrodami.
course_highlights: Trasa 10 km podzielona na cztery pętle po 2,5 km
Start i meta przy Szkole Podstawowej w Stanowicach, ul. Szkolna 17A
Możliwość ukończenia biegu po dowolnej liczbie pętli
additional: Po biegu uczestnicy otrzymują ręcznie robione medale z piernika oraz porcję tradycyjnych świątecznych potraw: moczki i makówek. Na trasie odbywa się konkurs kibiców z nagrodami, a także konkurs na najciekawsze przebranie świąteczno-karnawałowe zarówno indywidualne, jak i grupowe. Wydarzenie ma luźną, przyjacielską atmosferę i zachęca do aktywnego kibicowania. Impreza obejmuje konkursy na przebrania, wydarzenia rekreacyjne, bazę w Szkole Podstawowej w Stanowicach, oraz możliwość udziału w biegu na dystansie 10 km. Bieg odbywa się zwykle w grudniu, w okresie świątecznym.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Gór...

price_tiers.distance: Bieg dorosłych 5 km i 10 km oraz Nordic Walking

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 74 zł – w przypadku rejestracji do ostatniego poniedziałku poprzedzającego zawody.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 84zł – w przypadku rejestracji w ostatni wtorek, środę i czwartek przed zawodami.

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich to cykl biegów odbywających się na terenie Parku Krajobrazowego Puszcza Zielonka, promujący aktywność fizyczną i zdrowy tryb życia. Zawody odbywają się na leśnych trasach z pętlą o długości 5,15 km, z dwukrotnym wbiegnięciem na szczyt Dziewiczej Góry, najwyższego wzniesienia parku. W ramach imprezy organizowane są biegi na 5 km i 10 km, marsz Nordic Walking oraz biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe na krótszych dystansach. To wydarzenie integruje biegaczy i miłośników sportu w różnym wieku, tworząc przyjazną atmosferę i sportową rywalizację.
course_highlights: Pętla o długości 5,15 km w całości na terenie leśnym
Dwukrotne wbiegnięcie na szczyt Dziewiczej Góry
Trasa przebiega przez centrum zawodów, umożliwiając doping kibiców
additional: Biegi dziecięce odbywają się na dystansach 200m, 500m, 1000m oraz 1500m z osobnym harmonogramem startów od 9:00 do 9:45. Biuro zawodów czynne od 8:15 do 10:30, zapisy na bieg dorosłych i marsz Nordic Walking możliwe także w dniu zawodów do godziny 10:00 (opłata wyższa). Zawodnicy na 10 km pokonują dwie pętle trasy. Po wyjściu z lasu organizacja mety rozdziela zawodników kończących bieg i tych kontynuujących drugą pętlę. Sezon obejmuje sześć biegów; trasy są oznaczane pomarańczowymi szarfami, a czas mierzony elektronicznie.

name: Zimna Połówka
description: Zimna Połówka to bieg organizowany w miejscowości Niegowonice, Gmina Łazy, który odbędzie się 19 grudnia 2026 roku. Start zawodów zaplanowano na godzinę 10:30. Impreza jest organizowana przez Grupę ExtremeJura, a pomiar czasu zapewnia Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu, wykorzystując nowoczesne systemy elektroniczne oparte na chipach RFID. Zawody są doskonałą okazją do sportowej rywalizacji w zimowej scenerii Jury Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej.
course_highlights: 21-kilometrowa trasa półmaratonu
Jurajskie podbiegi i leśne ścieżki
Wymagający, techniczny charakter trasy
additional: Zamknięcie zapisów online następuje 15 grudnia 2026 o godzinie 23:59. Organizator zapewnia pomiar czasu na najwyższym poziomie z wykorzystaniem systemów testowanych na największych maratonach świata. Kontakt telefoniczny dostępny jest w godzinach 8:00-16:00 oraz w dniu zawodów pod numerem alarmowym. Start Zimnej Połówki zaplanowano na 10:30. W ramach wydarzenia odbędzie się również Chłodna Ćwiartka na 11 km oraz marsz nordic walking na tym samym dystansie. Zapisy online trwają do 15 grudnia 2026 r. do godz. 23:59.

name: XIX Nocny Bieg Wigilijny Od zmierzchu do...
XXXVII Strzelecki Bieg Uliczny im. Euzeb...
Seligenstädter Winterlaufserie, Lauf 2
description: Seligenstadt Winter Running Series Race 2 is a popular winter running event in the picturesque town of Seligenstadt. The series gives runners the opportunity to compete over 1 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances, and regularly attracts many running enthusiasts from the region. The event is organized by the Triathlon Team Seligenstadt and takes place in a friendly and motivating atmosphere. It is an ideal opportunity to maintain your running motivation during the cold season and experience the sporting community.
course_highlights: Races over 1 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Traditional winter running series in Seligenstadt
Event in a picturesque town with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The event takes place on December 19, 2026, and is part of the winter running series held from December to February. Online registration is recommended.
