description: The Christmas Half Marathon in Hradec Králové is a traditional winter running race held in the city’s forests near the U Vlka refreshment stand. The race offers an individual half marathon and three-person mixed relays, with each runner covering a 7 km leg. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish, and prizes are awarded to the top runners. The event has a friendly atmosphere and promotes a healthy lifestyle and the local sporting community.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city’s forests in Hradec Králové
Three-person mixed relay with 7.0325 km legs
Refreshments on the course and at the finish
additional: Registration and race number pickup take place from 9:15 to 10:15. Entry is valid only after the entry fee has been paid. Categories are divided by age and weight, including the special Santa Claus category (over 100 kg) and Three Kings category (over 200 kg). Bistro U Vlka will be open throughout the event; refreshments will also be available at the finish.

name: Varėnos Kalėdinis pusmaratonis
description: On December 20, 2025, Varėna Sports Center is organizing the Christmas running event “Varėna Christmas Half Marathon.” The event is free, but organizers invite participants, if possible, to contribute a donation to improve the quality of the event. Your support helps us create a festive, smooth, and memorable running event for all participants.

name: Kauno „Kalėdinis bėgimas - 2026“
description: The Kaunas Christmas Run is a traditional running event held in Kaunas in December. The event is open to runners of all ages and aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and the popularity of running. The race takes place in Panemunė Forest, and the courses are paved and suitable for both recreational and professional runners. After the run, participants are treated to kūčiukai and tea, and can also use the swimming pool.
course_highlights: Course in Panemunė Forest, Kaunas
Paved surface; snow and ice are possible depending on weather conditions
Choose to run 1.7 km, 5 km (one lap) or 10 km (two laps)
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on race day from 10:00 to 11:40. The entry fee must be paid to the account of the Kaunas Running Club. After the run, participants will be treated to kūčiukai and tea. From 14:30 to 15:30, participants can swim at Žalgiris Swimming Pool (Karaliaus Mindaugo Ave. 50, Kaunas). Registration is permitted only in your own name; bib transfers are prohibited. Registration is open until October 31. Participants will receive personalized bibs. Event date: 2026-12-19

name: Druskininkų Kalėdinis bėgimas
location: Turistų gatvė prie Vijūnėlės tvenkinio, Druskininkai, Lithuania
organizer: Asociacija „Sporto renginiai“ ir Druskininkų sporto centras

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 0 Eur – dalyvis bėga su šventiniu kalėdiniu kostiumu

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 20 Eur – paprasta bėgiko ar kita apranga (bėgimas be kalėdinio kostiumo)

description: Druskininkai Christmas Run 2026 is a festive running event taking place on December 19 on Turistų Street by Vijūnėlė Pond in Druskininkai. The event is organized by the “Sporto renginiai” Association together with the Druskininkai Sports Centre to promote running as a healthy lifestyle and encourage local residents to be more active. Anyone can take part, and participants will receive special event medals. The event offers 500 m, 4 km, and 8 km distances, with no timing, making it suitable for both professionals and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Turistų Street by Vijūnėlė Pond
500 m, 4 km, and 8 km distances without timing
Festive atmosphere, with the option to run in a Christmas costume
additional: The maximum number of participants is 100. Registration and race-number collection take place on December 19 near the start area. Participants must register under their own names. All participants receive special event medals. The number of participants is limited to 100; each participant will receive an event medal. Registration and race-number collection on event day will take place near the start area.

name: Žieminis backyard 2026, Mariaus Zakarausko taurei laimėti
description: The Winter Backyard in memory of Marius Zakarauskas is a unique ultrarunning event in the Backyard Ultra format, held at Bėgimo namai in Kūjagalviai village, Kaunas District. Participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour until only one runner remains, who becomes the winner. The event aims to promote long-distance running in Lithuania, strengthen the running community, and encourage endurance and a healthy lifestyle. The most important factors are not speed, but mental toughness, tactics, and the ability to manage one’s energy. Participants are invited to enjoy a friendly atmosphere that encourages them to push their personal limits and share their experiences.
course_highlights: Run a 6.7 km (4.167-mile) loop every hour
The race continues until only one runner remains who can complete a loop
Completing 24 loops in 24 hours means running approximately 170 km (100 miles)
additional: The event is free. The start is at Bėgimo namai in Kūjagalviai village, Kaunas District. Participants have one hour to complete each loop, with the remaining time to rest and prepare for the next one. The event aims to promote the Backyard Ultra format in Lithuania and encourage community spirit and endurance. The start is at 11:00. Twenty-four loops total approximately 170 km. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments, a sauna, and a hot tub.

name: Augsburger AOK Winterlaufserie Weihnachtslauf
description: The Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series organized by TG Viktoria Augsburg consists of four races through the beautiful Western Forests Nature Park. The routes cross hilly terrain in the forests west of Augsburg and require good fitness. The series offers age-group rankings and an overall ranking with attractive prizes. The races take place in November and December, with the Christmas Run bringing the series to a close.
course_highlights: Routes through the Western Forests Nature Park
Hilly terrain with challenging sections
Routes approximately 2.8 to 3.2 km long per race
additional: Bib pickup is in the start/finish area for each race. Portable toilets are available at the Kathreinerstraße parking lot (races 1–3). Change of clothes and bags can be left in the tent or pavilion, but are not covered by liability. Finish refreshments include tea, water and a cake buffet at races 1–3; the Christmas Run also offers mulled wine and children's punch. The awards ceremony takes place after the 4th race from 11:45 a.m. at the forest hut, with wooden trophies and cash prizes. Online registration closes at 10 p.m. on the Thursday before each race. Part of the AOK Winter Running Series; typical December winter weather; online registration available; routes on hilly terrain; start and finish locations in Augsburg.

name: Weihnachtslauf Lipperreihe
description: The Weihnachtslauf Lipperreihe is a traditional running event held annually on the fourth Sunday of Advent in Lipperreihe, a district of Oerlinghausen. The loop course starts and finishes at Lipperreihe Primary School and is precisely measured, with a hilly, moderately challenging profile. The scenic route is timed using the professional race|result timing system. The event is for adults and young people and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Precisely measured course with a hilly profile
Moderately challenging route through scenic surroundings
Start and finish at Lipperreihe Primary School
additional: Online registration is available until 7 a.m. on the day of the event. Late entries are possible until 30 minutes before the start, with a late-entry fee of 5 EUR payable in cash only. Animals are not permitted. An event shirt in French navy can be ordered as an option. Timing uses the race|result system, with a dual transponder in the race number since 2019. Residents are provided with information about traffic restrictions and road closures. Precisely measured; race|result timing; online registration until 7 a.m. on the day of the event; cash payment only; no animals permitted.

name: 406. Malá cena Monaka – Vánoční
description: Malá cena Monaka - Christmas is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This Christmas race is part of the Malá cena Monaka series and gives runners the opportunity to compete in a pleasant pre-Christmas atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and is known for its friendly organization and sporting spirit. It is organized by KRB Chrudim, which has been organizing running events in the region for many years.
course_highlights: A traditional Christmas run in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany
A friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization
Part of the long-running Malá cena Monaka series
additional: The race takes place on 20 December 2026 in Slatiňany, Pardubice Region, and is part of the Malá cena Monaka series. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Vánoční běh Opava
description: The Opava Christmas Run is a traditional running race organized by the BěhOpava association team. The race covers a 4.7 km course starting on Englišova Street and heading toward Gappay (Latarna) along a farm track with an asphalt surface, with several turns before returning to the finish. Kilometer markers are placed along the course to help runners track their performance. The race is open to various age categories, from pupils to men across several age groups. The organizers provide small prizes for the top runners and hold a prize draw for additional prizes.
course_highlights: A 4.7 km course along a farm track with an asphalt surface
Kilometer markers along the course for orientation
Start and finish by Englišova Street – the gate of the School Farm
additional: The course record is held by Petr Gebel, set in 1994 with a time of 13:39. Participants race at their own risk and are advised to take care when crossing roads and follow the organizers’ instructions. The finish judges are members and supporters of the BěhOpava association. The race takes place on an asphalt course with a slight uphill section, starts at the School Farm, and includes small prizes and a commemorative run.

name: Vánoční kros v Bělském lese
location: Areál zdraví, Bělský les, Ostrava-Zábřeh, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: The Christmas Cross-Country Race in Bělský les invites runners to enjoy the natural surroundings of Ostrava’s forest park. Participants can choose between 3 km and 6 km courses, combining a sawdust track with forest paths. The start and race facilities are at Areál zdraví in Ostrava-Zábřeh. The race is part of the Drahomír Gromotovič and Bohumil Prauzek Memorial.
course_highlights: The routes follow both the sawdust track and the forest paths of Bělský les.
Choose between 3 km and 6 km courses.
The start and finish facilities are located at Areál zdraví.

name: Zimný beh v Púchove
location: Čerpacia stanica Orlen pri Váhu, oproti firme Continental, Púchov, Slovakia
organizer: OZ Klub bežcov a priateľov športu v Púchove
description: The Winter Run in Púchov is a running event taking place on December 20, 2026, in Púchov. The race is run on a 6 km course, mostly on asphalt (70%) and partly on trails (30%). The start is at 11:00 by the Orlen gas station opposite the Continental company. The event is organized by OZ Klub bežcov a priateľov športu v Púchove. Online registration is available until December 16, or in person on race day.
course_highlights: 6 km course with 70% asphalt and 30% trail surface
Start by the Orlen gas station opposite the Continental company in Púchov
Age categories for men and women, from juniors to veterans
additional: Race check-in begins at 9:30. The entry fee is paid at check-in on race day. On-site registration is available for €15.

name: Panevėžio Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: On the first Saturday of winter, the annual Eurovaistinė Christmas Run will take place, celebrating its 50th anniversary this year. This running festival will welcome thousands of participants, standing out for its festive atmosphere and distinctive participants dressed in Christmas costumes. The event schedule has been shifted so participants can run after dark, when the magical Christmas spirit comes alive on the streets of Panevėžys. This year, we invite you not only to prepare Christmas costumes but also to add illuminated details that will turn the crowd of runners into a glowing Christmas spectacle.

name: Vánoční běh v Ďáblickém háji
location: Ďáblický háj, Praha 8, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Christmas Run in Ďáblický háj is a non-competitive running event held at the health area in Ďáblický háj in Prague 8. The course consists of two loops through Ďáblický Forest. It is mostly flat, with one gentle hill, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The event traditionally takes place on 24 December, with the first category starting at 10:00. It is organised by AVC Praha and is free of charge, fostering a friendly, community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two loops through Ďáblický Forest
Flat terrain with one gentle hill
Woodland setting in the health area
additional: This is a non-competitive event. The start is at the health area in Ďáblický háj, and the run is free of charge. It is organised by AVC Praha. Contact: Zdeněk Weig, tel. 733 690 323. The course is suitable for all age groups. The event takes place on Christmas Eve, 24 December 2026, at the health area in Ďáblický háj.

name: Štědrodenní běh Jilešovicemi
location: Penzion Kamenec, Jilešovice, Háj ve Slezsku, Czech Republic
organizer: Maraton klub Seitl Ostrava a Sbor dobrovolných hasičů Jilešovice
description: The Štědrý Day Run through Jilešovice is a traditional Christmas running race organized by Maraton klub Seitl Ostrava and the Jilešovice Volunteer Fire Brigade. The race takes place on December 24 in the village of Jilešovice, near Háj ve Slezsku, and features a course approximately 4 km long, running from Jilešovice to Kozmice and back across the footbridge over the Opavice River. The start is in front of Penzion Kamenec, which also hosts registration and the finish. Shorter courses are prepared for children according to their age and the number of participants. Refreshments are provided after the race, including beer, non-alcoholic drinks, soup, and Christmas punch. The results are announced, and a raffle is held with valuable prizes.
course_highlights: The course runs from Jilešovice to Kozmice and back along the cycle path
Crossing the footbridge over the Opavice River
Approximate course length: 4 km
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:50 at Penzion Kamenec. Children start at 10:30. The maximum number of starters is 120. The first 100 runners to finish receive a commemorative medal. A raffle will be held among participants, with a trekking bicycle as the main prize. The entry fee is paid on site. Runners participate at their own risk. Race facilities are at Penzion Kamenec in Jilešovice.

name: Vianočný beh, Spoznaj Trebičov behom, Séria 5
location: Trebišov, Okres Trebišov, Košický kraj, Slovakia

name: 21. Wolfshäger Gänsebraten Fettverbrennungslauf
location: Wolfshagen im Harz, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wolfshäger Gänsebraten Fettverbrennungslauf is a traditional race held annually on December 26 in Wolfshagen im Harz. The event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels and offers a sporting way to round off the Christmas season. It is organized by Laufteam Wolfshagen im Harz e.V., a nonprofit club that promotes running in the region. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the strong sense of community among its runners.
course_highlights: A run through the picturesque Harz countryside
A family-friendly course for all ages
A traditional end-of-year race on December 26
additional: The race is organized by Laufteam Wolfshagen im Harz e.V., a club that also holds charity runs. The event is open to recreational and competitive runners, as well as children and teenagers. No prices or start times are published on the website. The organizer can be contacted by email with questions. Information about distances and registration is available on the website; the event promotes health and community spirit.

name: Schokocross
description: Schokocross is a cross-country running event organized by ATS Buntentor Bremen at the Sportanlage Kuhhirten in Stadtwerder, Bremen. The event features short off-road races for adults over distances of approximately 2.2 km, 4.2 km and 8.2 km, as well as 400 m races for children under 10 and 800 m races for children under 14. This local club race offers competitions for children, young people, women and men, and is particularly family-friendly, with appealing race options for both young and adult runners. It traditionally takes place on December 26 and is known for its winter conditions.
course_highlights: Cross-country course at the Sportanlage Kuhhirten in Stadtwerder
Distances ranging from 400 m to 8.2 km
Competitions for children, young people and adults
additional: Typical December weather: approx. 3 °C, with nighttime temperatures down to -2 °C, an average of 40 mm of precipitation, and usually snow-covered conditions. This local club race has competitions for various age groups, including U8 and U10. Cross-country running in winter weather, with categories for children, young people and adults. Registration deadline: December 22, 2026.

name: Štěpánský běh Prachatice
description: The St. Stephen’s Run in Prachatice is a traditional sporting event being held for the 44th time, open to everyone from children to veterans. The morning program begins with children’s and youth categories. The 10 km main race and 5 km hobby race start at 11:00. The route follows paved roads, with an elevation gain of 176 metres on the main course and 68 metres on the hobby course. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice and is part of the 2025 South Bohemian Running Cup.
course_highlights: 10 km main course with an elevation gain of 176 metres
5 km hobby race with an elevation gain of 68 metres
Start and finish in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available to runners in the stadium stand, and refreshments (tea and pastries) are provided at the finish. Race numbers and timing chips are issued during check-in and must be returned to the organizers after the race. Trophies, prizes in kind, and cash bonuses for breaking the course record are awarded to the top finishers. The first 100 participants in the main races to register and pay will receive gifts from sponsors. The event includes 5 km and 10 km courses. Registration is available via maraton.cz, and showers, refreshments, and facilities for runners are provided.

name: Štěpánský kros pro děti všech kategorií a Lidový běh
location: Svitavy, Svitavy District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: The Štěpánský Cross-Country Race for children of all age groups and the People’s Run is an open running event held in Svitavy, with courses for children and adults on a mixed asphalt and grass surface. The race is suitable for all age groups, from the youngest children running 100 metres to adults taking part in the 4,200-metre People’s Run. The event takes place in all weather and offers a sporting atmosphere and support for all participants. Registration is available online, by email or on site on race day.
course_highlights: Mixed course surface: asphalt and grass
Categories for children aged 4 and up, as well as adults
Adults’ 4,200 m People’s Run (2 × the large loop)
additional: On-site check-in runs from 8:45 to 9:45; children’s categories must check in by 9:30. Changing rooms are available in the stadium stand, but they are public and the organizers are not responsible for items left there. Entries can be submitted electronically by 23. 12. 2025, by email, using a QR code or in person on race day. The course has a mixed surface—both asphalt and grass; registration is available online or on site; there are different course lengths for different age groups; changing rooms are available; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Štěpánský běh Zlín
location: Příluk u Zlína, Zlín, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma (dětské běhy), ceny za dospělé od 300 Kč výše
description: The St. Stephen’s Run in Zlín is a traditional running race organized by the Běhy Zlín association in Příluky. The 10 km main race consists of three laps and starts at the football field at 10 a.m. The event also includes free children’s races, held after the main race. The race offers rewards for adult runners and original medals for category winners. It attracts runners from the wider area and is part of the Běhy Zlín series.
course_highlights: 10 km main course consisting of three laps
Around the football grounds in Příluky
Children’s races after the main race
additional: The awards ceremony takes place at 11:45 at the race registration area. Category winners receive original medals and, where applicable, non-cash prizes. Children’s races are free, with a small reward for every child and no winners’ awards ceremony. The race is part of the Christmas season celebrations, with the awards ceremony at 11:45, and offers various categories and prizes for winners. The event takes place around the football grounds in Příluky and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Vánoční běh Třtice
description: The Třtice Christmas Run is a traditional running race held annually on December 26 in the village of Třtice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 4.8 km long, with categories based on age and gender. This popular sporting event continues a long-standing tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area. It is part of the village’s sporting activities and offers a pleasant atmosphere for athletes and spectators alike.
course_highlights: 4.8 km course
Categories by age and gender: A (up to 39 years), B (40–49 years), C (50–59 years), D (over 60 years), E (women)
Traditional Christmas run held since 1976
additional: The race uses the same categories as the summer Třtická Punčocha run. Results from previous editions are regularly published on the village website. Třtice offers sports facilities, including a children’s playground and a multi-purpose sports court. The race takes place on December 26, 2026, and is attended by approximately 200 runners. The course is around 4.8 km long, with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for the general public and fosters a festive Christmas sporting atmosphere.

name: Vánoční maraton, půlmaraton a desítka okolo Boleváku
description: The Christmas Marathon, Half Marathon and 10K around Bolevák is a winter trail run taking place on December 26, 2026, in the picturesque northern outskirts of Plzeň. This race is not about breaking personal records, but about enjoying a beautiful experience, a festive atmosphere and the pleasure of exercising together in a winter landscape. Participants can choose from three distances and enjoy the crisp winter air and the peaceful energy of nature. Race bibs are available from 8:40 a.m., and parking is provided near the start and finish.
course_highlights: A winter trail run in the picturesque northern outskirts of Plzeň
A loop with kilometre markers from 1 to 10 km
Parking near the start and finish at the intersection of Gerská and Ke Krkavci streets
additional: Check-in and race-bib collection start at 8:40 a.m. Slower marathon runners may start at 9:00 a.m. Parking is available at the intersection of Gerská and Ke Krkavci streets, with space for at least 50 cars.

name: Štěpánský běh Kyjov
location: Kyjov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

name: Vánoční maraton, půlmaraton a 10,55 km – Plzeň, Severní předměstí
location: Severní předměstí, Plzeň, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic

name: Vánoční běh Hlučínem
location: Mírové náměstí, Hlučín, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 4. zimné kolo
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany
description: The Lemešany Running League – 4th Winter Round is a running competition held in Lemešany at the Záhrada pohybu grounds. The event is open to all ages and ability levels and offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of different levels. The league promotes an active lifestyle and community sports activities outdoors.
course_highlights: Short 4.5 km asphalt course
Long 9 km asphalt course
Children’s 100 m mini-runs
additional: Refreshments are available at the finish; changing rooms, toilets and a baggage storage area are available in the start area. Parking is available by the Záhrada pohybu grounds. The children’s mini-runs are free. Runners who complete all four rounds of LBL 2026 will receive a participant T-shirt.

name: Zimný beh zdravia – Trnava
location: Športový areál AŠK Slávia Trnava, Trnava, Slovakia

name: XII Sylwestrowy Bieg i Nordic Walking
(Před)Silvestrovský běh Lysá nad Labem
location: Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Lysá nad Labem is a traditional race organized by the Sokol Lysá nad Labem sports association. Held at the end of December, it attracts runners who want to enjoy a sporting activity during the winter. After a two-year hiatus, the race is once again looking forward to welcoming participants, who can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and a sporting challenge in Lysá nad Labem. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and promotes physical fitness and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: The course runs along the city streets of Lysá nad Labem, including the town center
Routes of 6.2 km and 3.1 km are available
The race is part of a traditional year-end celebration with a Christmas-season atmosphere
additional: The race starts and finishes in Lysá nad Labem. It is a traditional annual event that promotes sporting activity in the community.

name: Hraběnčino běhání – memoriál Jaroslava Parmy
location: Petrovice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hraběnčino běhání - Jaroslav Parma Memorial is a traditional running race held in Petrovice in the South Moravian Region. The race is part of the Blansko District Running League, which has a long-standing tradition dating back to 1976. The course is demanding, with a challenging profile that tests the fitness of all participants. The race is ideal for runners looking for a challenge in the picturesque surroundings of the Moravian Karst.
course_highlights: The course profile is very demanding and tests physical fitness
The route runs through the Moravian Karst, with beautiful natural scenery
The climb below Karolín is a key and challenging section of the course
additional: The race is part of the Blansko District Running League, which also offers other running events in the region. The course is known for its difficulty and long-standing tradition. The start and finish are in Petrovice at Penzion u Hraběnky. Timing is done with chips embedded in the OBL race bibs.

name: Kalėdinis bėgimas „AKTYVŪS TRAKAI 365“
location: Užutrakis Manor Estate Park, Trakai District Municipality, Lithuania
description: On December 27, the “Aktyvūs Trakai 365” Christmas run will take place in the park of Užutrakis Manor, welcoming both experienced runners and anyone looking to spend time actively and enjoy the festive atmosphere. Distances from 1 to 13.5 km allow participants to choose the one best suited to their age and ability. All participants will receive original finisher medals, while prize-winners will receive trophies and prizes. The event is free, so gather a team and join us in Trakai for an active and fun day.
course_highlights: The run takes place in the park of the Užutrakis Manor estate, one of Lithuania’s most beautiful locations
Distances from 1 to 13.5 km, suited to participants of different ages and abilities
A festive atmosphere and the chance to spend time actively with like-minded people
additional: The event will take place from 11:00 to 17:00. The run is free. Original medals are planned for all participants, and trophies and prizes for prize-winners.

name: Aschauer Vorsilvesterlauf
organizer: Lauffeuer Chiemgau e.V. und Gewerbeverein Aschau e.V.
description: The Aschau Pre-New Year’s Eve Run is a popular running event in Aschau im Chiemgau, organized since 2009 by Lauffeuer Chiemgau e.V. and Gewerbeverein Aschau e.V. With a flat, fast 5 km course through the town center and a 1.7 km children’s run, the event offers an appealing race for both recreational and competitive runners. It is known as Southern Bavaria’s biggest running party between the years and attracts numerous participants and spectators every year. Alongside sporting ambition, community and fun are also central, supported by a varied program of activities and an after-run party.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 5 km course through Aschau town center
Children’s run over one 1.7 km lap
Three laps in the recreational and night runs, for a total of 5 km
additional: Rental timing chips are provided and must be returned by 9 p.m.; otherwise, a €30 fee applies. Mulled wine (including a non-alcoholic version), gingerbread and stollen are available in the finish area. Every finisher receives an edible medal. After the night run, an awards ceremony and after-run party are held at the Chalet. Parking is available at the Festhalle, tourist information office, sports hall and railway station. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the Red Cross building and railway station. 5 km run, children’s run, community event, held annually on December 28, festive atmosphere, medals and refreshments included

name: Bėgimas į Naujus
description: Run Into the New Year is an annual race held on the last day of the year. The event brings together runners and enthusiasts who want to celebrate the arrival of the New Year actively. Participants can choose from different distances, allowing everyone to find a challenge that suits them. The route offers beautiful city sights and a unique atmosphere created by participants and spectators.

images.alt_text: Didelis fejerverkas virš miesto, švenčiant Naujuosius metus.
Bėgikai starte, renginys lauke.
Kalėdų eglutė su šventinėmis lemputėmis ir dekoracijomis, puikiai tinkanti Naujųjų metų šventei.
Bėgimas į Naujus 2026 su fejerverkais.

name: Silvestrovský běh ulicemi města Soběslavi
description: The New Year’s Eve run through the streets of Soběslav is a traditional race for all age groups, including children and seniors. The main race starts at midnight, and its distance increases by one metre each year; this year it is 2026 metres. A rich cultural programme is held in the square during the race, and refreshments are provided for all participants. Winners in each category receive prizes.
course_highlights: The route is 2026 metres long and increases by one metre each year
The race runs through the streets of Soběslav
The run is accompanied by a rich cultural programme in the square
additional: The youth categories start at 21:00, and the main race starts at midnight. Winners in each category receive prizes. The youth categories start at 21:00 and the main race at midnight. Winners in the categories receive prizes.

name: Silvestrovský beh na tartane – „Memoriál Pavla Rajca“
location: Mestský štadión Dubnica nad Váhom, Dubnica nad Váhom, Slovakia
organizer: Jogging klub Dubnica nad Váhom, Únia behov do vrchu Dubnica nad Váhom a Mesto Dubnica nad Váhom
description: The Silvester Run on the Track – Pavol Rajec Memorial is a traditional 5 km race held on the tartan track at the Municipal Stadium in Dubnica nad Váhom. Runners compete in categories by age and gender and can look forward to refreshments at the finish. The event is organized by Jogging Club Dubnica nad Váhom together with the Mountain Running Union and the City of Dubnica nad Váhom. Registration is available online or at the starting area, with cash prizes for the top three in each category.
course_highlights: 5 km course on the tartan track at the Municipal Stadium
Finish-line refreshments: bread with lard and onion, and drinks
Categories by age and gender, with cash prizes for the winners
additional: Runner check-in takes place in the main stand of the Municipal Stadium. On-site registration is available until 10:45. Changing rooms are available in the main stand. Check-in and changing rooms are in the stadium’s main stand. Refreshments are served at the finish, and the top three in each category receive cash prizes.

name: Silvestrovský beh Piešťany
description: The Piešťany New Year’s Eve Run is one of the oldest races in Slovakia and has been held annually since 1965. It takes place on Spa Island in Piešťany, where participants run around the entire island in a beautiful New Year’s Eve atmosphere. The event offers various categories for children, schoolchildren and adults, and every runner receives a participant’s medal. Registration takes place at the Esplanade Ensana Health Spa Hotel, and showers, changing rooms and an outdoor thermal pool are available. The event features a live broadcast and is hosted by Peter Mano Tomič.
course_highlights: A 2,580 m loop for the main categories, completed 2 or 4 times
An approximately 500 m loop for the schoolchildren’s categories, completed 1 or 2 times
A 100 m course for the youngest runners in the HappyMove Run category
additional: Runner registration takes place at the Esplanade Ensana Health Spa Hotel, ALAMEDA wing. Changing rooms, showers and the outdoor thermal pool at Eva swimming pool are available. The children’s races are organized in cooperation with HappyMove. Participation limit: 500 runners for the 5 km and 10 km races, and 20 relay teams in the relay category. Registration and collection of race numbers take place at the Esplanade Ensana Hotel, Alameda wing. Changing rooms, showers and the outdoor thermal pool at Eva swimming pool are available to runners; the event is broadcast live.

name: XVII Koszaliński Bieg Sylwestrowy
location: Hala Widowiskowo-Sportowa, ul. Śniadeckich 4, Koszalin, Polska
description: XVII Koszaliński Bieg Sylwestrowy to sportowe pożegnanie roku w Koszalinie, zaplanowane na 31 grudnia 2026 r. W programie są bieg na 5 km, rajd Nordic Walking na 3,4 km oraz biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży. Start i biuro zawodów znajdują się przy Hali Widowiskowo-Sportowej przy ul. Śniadeckich 4. To propozycja dla biegaczy i miłośników aktywnego spędzania końcówki roku.
course_highlights: Bieg główny na dystansie 5 km
Rajd Nordic Walking na dystansie 3,4 km
Biegi dziecięce na dystansach 200 m, 400 m i 800 m
additional: Zapisy online. Biuro zawodów działa w godz. 9:00 - 11:00 w Hali Widowiskowo-Sportowej przy ul. Śniadeckich 4. Rajd Nordic Walking startuje o 11:30.

name: 27 Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny
location: Teatr Letni im. Heleny Majdaniec, Szczecin, Polska
description: Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny 2027 to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się 1 stycznia przy Teatrze Letnim im. Heleny Majdaniec w Szczecinie. W programie znajdują się Bieg Główny na 5 km, Nordic Walking oraz biegi dziecięce dla różnych roczników. Trasa biegu głównego prowadzi alejkami Parku im. Jana Kasprowicza, obok Psiej Polany i wokół Jasnych Błoni, start i meta znajdują się w tym samym miejscu. Impreza jest doskonałą okazją do aktywnego rozpoczęcia nowego roku w sportowej atmosferze, z medalami dla każdego uczestnika.
course_highlights: Trasa biegu głównego to dwie pętle po 2,5 km każda
Trasa prowadzi alejkami Parku im. Jana Kasprowicza, obok Psiej Polany i wokół Jasnych Błoni
Start i meta przy Teatrze Letnim im. Heleny Majdaniec
additional: Numery startowe wydawane są 29 i 30 grudnia 2026 w godzinach 17:00 - 19:30. Depozyt na rzeczy działa przy biurze zawodów przez cały czas trwania imprezy. Przebieralnie dostępne są w strefie startu przy Teatrze Letnim od otwarcia biura zawodów. Limit miejsc: 470 dla Biegu Głównego i Nordic Walking łącznie oraz 115 dla biegów dziecięcych. Dzieci startują w trzech seriach według roczników na dystansach około 100, 200 i 400 m. Każdy uczestnik biegu dzieci otrzymuje medal pamiątkowy. W programie Nordic Walking oraz biegi dziecięce na dystansach około 100, 200 i 400 m. Liczba miejsc jest ograniczona.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz na Orientację to cykl biegów na orientację organizowanych przez Fundację Bydgoszcz na Orientację, które odbywają się w różnych lasach i terenach wokół Bydgoszczy. To aktywność dla każdego, niezależnie od wieku i doświadczenia, łącząca sport z przygodą i odkrywaniem natury z mapą i kompasem. Fundacja promuje dostępność, tworząc trasy także dla osób niewidomych i słabowidzących. Cykl obejmuje różnorodne trasy o różnym stopniu trudności, a uczestnicy mogą zdobywać odznaki za ukończenie poszczególnych rund.
course_highlights: Różnorodne tereny leśne wokół Bydgoszczy, zmieniające się co rundę
Trasy dla początkujących i zaawansowanych, w tym trasy dla osób niewidomych i słabowidzących
Możliwość zdobywania cyfrowych odznak i kolekcjonerskich naklejek za ukończenie rund
additional: Cykl składa się z sześciu rund odbywających się od listopada do stycznia w różnych lasach i terenach wokół Bydgoszczy. Za każdą ukończoną rundę uczestnicy otrzymują cyfrową odznakę oraz naklejkę do kolekcjonerskiego kuponu. Po ukończeniu całego cyklu dostępna jest specjalna odznaka finałowa. Trasy są dostosowane do różnych poziomów zaawansowania, a finałowa runda odbywa się ze startem masowym na półotwartych terenach po dawnym folwarku.

name: Kresowe Trail #1
description: Kresowe Trail to kameralne biegi terenowe organizowane przez Fundację Maratony Kresowe, które promują zdrowy tryb życia i aktywność fizyczną w otoczeniu natury. Cykl biegów odbywa się na malowniczych trasach wschodniej Polski, z poszanowaniem przyrody i lokalnych społeczności. Zawody są przeznaczone zarówno dla początkujących, jak i doświadczonych biegaczy, a ich celem jest budowanie wspólnoty biegaczy opartej na pasji, rywalizacji i przyjaźni. Każdy bieg oferuje starannie oznakowane trasy, elektroniczny pomiar czasu oraz bogaty pakiet startowy.
course_highlights: Trasy terenowe o długości od około 5 km do ponad 18 km
Starannie oznakowane szlaki z kolorowymi strzałkami (zielone, czerwone, fioletowe)
Bufety na trasie i na mecie, limit czasu około 2 godzin
additional: Rejestracja możliwa w dniu zawodów do godziny 08:40 oraz na miejscu od 8:00. Nowe numery startowe obowiązują od sezonu 2026, pierwszy numer startowy jest bezpłatny. Pakiet startowy zawiera ciepły posiłek regeneracyjny (również opcja wegetariańska), elektroniczny pomiar czasu, zabezpieczenie medyczne, bufety na trasie i mecie, pamiątkowy medal (przy wcześniejszej rejestracji), serwis fotograficzny oraz punkty do klasyfikacji generalnej cyklu. Obowiązuje bezwzględny zakaz śmiecenia na trasie. Dostępna jest rejestracja internetowa oraz zapisy na miejscu w dniu zawodów.

name: Lekkoatletyczne Halowe Mistrzostwa Europ... Bieg Uliczny 5 km
description: 15. Mistrzostwa Europy Masters w Lekkoatletyce Halowej odbędą się w Toruniu. W ramach imprezy organizowany jest bieg uliczny na dystansie 5 km, który stanowi doskonałą okazję dla biegaczy masters do rywalizacji na malowniczych trasach miasta. Zawody łączą sportową rywalizację z atmosferą integracji środowiska lekkoatletycznego w kategorii masters.
course_highlights: Bieg uliczny na dystansie 5 km w centrum Torunia
Malownicze trasy miejskie z historycznymi widokami
Impreza towarzysząca halowym mistrzostwom lekkoatletycznym
additional: Bieg uliczny 5 km jest częścią programu 15. European Masters Athletics Championships Indoor w Toruniu. Szczegóły programu dostępne w PDF na stronie głównej. Brak informacji o opłatach startowych i rejestracji online. Bieg uliczny na 5 km był również jedną z konkurencji mistrzostw w 2026 roku.

name: XVII Noworoczny Bieg z Ochotą
description: Bieg Noworoczny to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w Warszawie, która pozwala uczestnikom wbiec z energią w Nowy Rok. Trasa biegu prowadzi przez malownicze miejsca stolicy, oferując zarówno amatorom, jak i bardziej doświadczonym biegaczom wyjątkowe sportowe przeżycie. Organizatorzy zapewniają profesjonalną obsługę i przyjazną atmosferę, zachęcając do wspólnego świętowania i aktywnego rozpoczęcia nowego roku.

name: XX Jubileuszowy Śląski Maraton Noworoczn...
description: XX Jubileuszowy Śląski Maraton Noworoczny Cyborg odbył się w Parku Śląskim w Chorzowie. Uczestnicy mogli wybrać od jednej do sześciu pętli po 7 km, pokonując dystans od 7 km do maratonu, a miłośnicy Nordic Walking mogli wystartować w półmaratonie. Start i meta znajdowały się przy budynku dyrekcji Parku Śląskiego. To propozycja dla osób, które chcą rozpocząć nowy rok aktywnie, we własnym tempie i na wybranym dystansie.
course_highlights: Pętle po 7 km, z możliwością wyboru od jednej do sześciu
Dystanse biegowe od 7 km do maratonu
Półmaraton Nordic Walking na trzech pętlach
additional: Start zaplanowano na godz. 12:00. Limit czasu na maraton wynosił 360 minut; liczbę pętli można było zmienić w trakcie biegu. Na mecie uczestnicy otrzymywali medal, gorącą herbatę i ciepły posiłek.

name: Wbiegnij z Nami w Nowy Rok
price_range: Od 20 zł do puszki na cel charytatywny
description: w"BIEG"nij z nami w NOWY ROK to coroczne spotkanie biegowe organizowane w Szczecinie nad Jeziorem Głębokim. Uczestnicy wspólnie pokonują około 5 km, a wydarzenie ma charakter integracyjny i charytatywny, łącząc sport z możliwością wsparcia potrzebujących. Po biegu jest opcja morsowania, a całość odbywa się w przyjaznej atmosferze, sprzyjającej składaniu noworocznych życzeń. To nieformalna impreza biegowa, która zachęca do aktywnego rozpoczęcia nowego roku.
course_highlights: Trasa około 5 km nad Jeziorem Głębokim
Opcja morsowania na zakończenie biegu
Spotkanie integracyjne z noworocznymi życzeniami
additional: Wydarzenie odbywa się 1 stycznia o godzinie 12:00 nad Jeziorem Głębokim w Szczecinie. Po biegu możliwość morsowania. Wydarzenie ma charakter charytatywny, minimalna kwota do puszki to 20 zł. Nie jest to tradycyjna impreza biegowa, lecz spotkanie biegowe i integracyjne. Start o godz. 12:00 z leśnej polany lub parkingu, około 400 m od ronda przy Głębokim w stronę Wołczkowa. Udział nie ma charakteru rywalizacji i odbywa się na własną odpowiedzialność. Osoby planujące morsowanie powinny zabrać odpowiedni sprzęt.

name: Silvesterlauf Bremen
description: The Silvesterlauf Bremen is a popular running event on December 31 that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers various distances, from 400 m for Bambinis to 10 km for experienced runners, through the beautiful surroundings of Werdersee. Alongside a sporting end to the year, festive music and a New Year’s Eve atmosphere make for a special experience. Participants in costumes are warmly invited to add their own creative touch to the event and run together into the New Year.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Werdersee
More accessible 2.5 km route for beginners and people with special needs
Festive New Year’s Eve atmosphere with music and medals for all finishers
additional: Start times vary by distance: 5 km run at 12:00, 2.5 km walk at 12:30, 5 km and 10 km walks at 12:50, 400 m Bambini run at 12:55, 1,000 m kids’ run at 13:00, 10 km run at 13:15. Race materials can be shipped for a fee. More accessible 2.5 km route suitable for everyone. Costumes are expressly encouraged for a special New Year’s Eve feeling. Various distances, including children’s and walking options, festive atmosphere, medals for everyone, creative costumes welcome.

name: Silvesterlauf Hannover
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a traditional year-end race held on December 31. The event features a 7.7 km loop, mostly on paved paths through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and along the Stichkanal to the Ihme. The race starts at 13:00 at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer. After the race, participants can refuel with mulled wine and bratwurst and receive a finisher wheat beer glass as a keepsake. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and mass start.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course goes through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Start and finish at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer
additional: Mass start; mulled wine and bratwurst at low prices after the race; every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass in the event design. On-the-day registration is possible on site from 12:00 (cash or PayPal). The race takes place on December 31, with online registration open until 31.12.25 at 10:00. There is a mass start and festivities that make the race a sociable way to end the year.

name: Silvesterlauf Wernigerode
description: The 49th Wernigerode New Year's Eve Run is the perfect end to the year in the Harz district for running enthusiasts. The race takes place on December 31, 2026, at Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode and offers a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V., this popular event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode
Run through Wernigerode's picturesque old town
Festive end-of-year atmosphere in the Harz district
additional: The course goes around Wernigerode Castle; start and finish at Marstall; no shower facilities; several events, including youth races and training sessions.

name: Silvesterlauf Burgwedel
description: The Burgwedel New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Burgwedel. The races cover several distances, including 10.6 km, 5.3 km and 2 km for children, and follow a scenic course with the start and finish at the modernised stadium on Ramhorst. The event attracts numerous runners and spectators and is organised by Schwimmverein Burgwedel. It is a popular sporting way to round off the year, with a family-friendly atmosphere and a diverse range of participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the recently modernised stadium on Ramhorst
Distances: 10.6 km, 5.3 km and a 2 km children’s race
Beautiful blue running track in the stadium
additional: The starting signal is given promptly at 12:00 by the local mayor. The event traditionally takes place on Ramhorst, where the series began in 1984. There is an award for the largest group, and the event is supported by numerous volunteers, sponsors and spectators. Distances: 2 km, 5.3 km, 10 km; December weather is usually cold and snowy; the event involves local clubs, fire brigades and families; course records have been set.

name: Silvesterlauf Salzgitter
organizer: Move SZ - Wir fördern Sport e.V.
description: The New Year’s Eve Run at Salzgittersee is a long-standing running event held on the last day of the year. The event offers various running and walking distances for different age groups and ability levels. The run is a sporting highlight and a meeting place for runners and spectators who want to end the year on an active note together. Alongside the sporting competition, there is a team classification and an awards ceremony that gives special recognition to the children’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes at Salzgittersee of 5.7 km and 11.4 km
1.2 km children’s race for participants born from 2013 to 2019
Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners
additional: Race number collection and late registration (plus transfers and late registrations) are available on 30.12. (15:00–17:00) and 31.12. (11:00–13:00) in the Stadtbad foyer. Online registration is open until 31.12.25 at 10:00 with no extra fee, unless the event is fully booked. Team classification is based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners. Race materials do not need to be collected in person. Register online by 31.12.25; race number collection at Stadtbad Salzgitter; refreshments in the finish area; parking available at Salzgittersee; dogs and running buggies allowed.

name: Silvesterlauf Magdeburg
description: The Magdeburg New Year's Eve Run is a traditional popular sporting event that has been held on the last day of the year for over 50 years. It brings together runners of all ages and ability levels in the city of Magdeburg. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and its sporting end to the year, with over 900 participants crossing the finish line. The run is part of the Magdeburg City Rankings and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: 5 km loop, run twice
10 km main race
1.5 km children's run for the youngest participants
additional: The New Year's Eve Run is the eighth and final event in the Magdeburg City Rankings. More than 950 runners of all ages take part. The event is organized by the Magdeburger LaufKultur 08 e.V. club. Courses, registration, results, photos, press reports; the weather in December is usually cold and snowy.

name: Silvesterlauf Berlin
description: The Berlin New Year’s Eve Run on December 31 gives runners the chance to end the year on an active note. The event offers three different distances (4 km, 6 km and 10 km) through the scenic Grunewald, with challenging sections such as Drachenberg and Teufelsberg rewarded with great views over Berlin. Alongside the sporting experience, fun takes centre stage, particularly with the option to run in costume and prizes for the best costumes. At the finish, all finishers receive a delicious Pfannkuchen as a sweet keepsake to hang around their neck.
course_highlights: Route through the Grunewald, including Drachenberg and Teufelsberg
Fantastic views across Berlin before the turn of the year
A choice of distances: 4 km, 6 km and 10 km
additional: The start and finish are near Mommsenstadion (Waldschulallee 34, 14055 Berlin). The race pass and race number will be sent by email in advance. Race materials can be collected on site from 10:00 a.m. on the event day. Timing is provided by a disposable transponder attached to the race number. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes. Water, tea and Pfannkuchen are available at the finish. Only reusable cups are used. Changing facilities are available at Mommsenstadion, but there is no bag drop. Results and certificates are available online that evening. Distances vary between 2, 4, 6 and 10 km; a run for all age groups; start and finish at Mommsenstadion; refreshments include Pfannkuchen, with awards for the top finishers and the most original costumes.

name: Silvesterlauf München
description: The MRRC Munich New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event in Munich’s Olympic Park, held every year on December 31. With over 4,300 participants from 54 nations, it is one of Germany’s largest New Year’s Eve runs. The races follow loop courses through the Olympic Park, starting and finishing by the lakeside near the Olympic Tower. The event offers distances for all age groups and ability levels, making for a sporty and atmospheric end to the year.
course_highlights: Loop courses through Munich’s Olympic Park
Start and finish by the lakeside near the Olympic Tower
10 km race measured by the DLV and eligible for official rankings
additional: Race bib pickup on December 30 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on event day from 9:30. The race bib with QR code must be worn clearly visible on the chest. Safety pins are provided. Pacemakers are available for the 5 km and 10 km races. No late registration is possible. Public transport and cycling are recommended for getting to the event. Annual participant numbers range from 1,600 to over 2,900. Results, photos, and videos are available; online registration is possible.

name: Silvesterlauf Gütersloh
description: The Gütersloh New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event, taking place for the 42nd time on December 31, 2026. The route follows the Dalke and passes through the beautiful Rhedaer Forst, making it a scenic run. It is a popular gathering for friends, families, and running enthusiasts who want to end the year on an active note. Whether you are a competitive runner or a recreational athlete, everyone is welcome to say goodbye to the old year and welcome the new one together.
course_highlights: Route along the Dalke
Run through the Rhedaer Forst
Scenic and varied route
additional: Short-notice route changes may be possible in the Hermann-Simon-Str./Dalke-Promenade area. Online registration via RaceResult is recommended.

name: Silvesterlauf Nürnberg
description: The Nuremberg New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional running event held annually on December 31 around Lake Wöhrder. Various races are offered for all age groups, from the Bambini run to the school and fun runs and the 10 km main race. The course is mostly flat and entirely paved, allowing for fast times. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and offers a festive atmosphere to close out the year.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Wöhrder, entirely paved
Flat course, ideal for fast times
Out-and-back courses for the Bambini and school runs along the north shore
additional: The start and finish are in front of Café Tante Noris im Wastl on Johann-Soergel-Weg. Race packets are distributed at Sebastianspital. Nordic walking poles and jogging strollers are allowed in the fun run, but not in the main race for safety reasons. Participant limits apply: 150 for the Bambini and school runs, and 1,300 for the fun and main races.

name: Silvesterlauf Zossen-Ludwigsfelde
description: The 46th Zossen-Ludwigsfelde New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional race covering approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde. The race starts at Zossen Town Hall Square, with an honorary start at 9:00 a.m. and the official start at 9:15 a.m. at the outskirts of Zossen. The route follows firmly frozen paths that are good to run on in favorable weather. At the finish in Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, participants receive a commemorative medal and Prosecco as a reward.
course_highlights: Approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde
Start at the outskirts of Zossen, beyond the railway crossing on the old B246
Finish at Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, with a medal and Prosecco
additional: In freezing conditions, the route is firmly frozen and good to run on.

name: Silvesterlauf Gießen
description: The traditional Sparkasse Gießen New Year’s Eve Run takes place on December 31, 2026, in Gießen-Ost and offers runners a varied event with four race distances: a student run, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The event is sold out, with 1,800 places, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization. The start and finish are at Karl-Reuter-Weg, and every finisher receives a medal sponsored by Autohaus Erben. In addition to the races, there are awards and presentations for walkers and Nordic walkers, as well as a team competition with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Karl-Reuter-Weg in Gießen-Ost
Four distances: student run, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Separate classification and awards ceremony for walkers and Nordic walkers
additional: Race bibs can be collected before Christmas at Sparkasse Gießen and on the day before the race at Sporthalle Ost. Changing and shower facilities are available at Sporthalle Ost. Every finisher receives a medal; for the first time, fruit will be available in the finish area. Start times are staggered to ease congestion on the course. The number of participants is limited to 2,200, and medals will be awarded to the first 2,000 finishers. Finisher shirts can be ordered separately. Parking is available at Philosophikum I and Studierendenwerk on Otto-Behaghel-Straße. Course routes are available as GPX files and can be used with navigation apps.

name: Silvesterlauf Bad Staffelstein
description: The Silvesterlauf Bad Staffelstein is a traditional running competition held annually on December 31. The event attracts both recreational and competitive runners and offers an appealing course in the Bad Staffelstein region. The race is known for its team rankings and the personal bests achieved by participants. The event is organized by Böhnlein Sports Bamberg e.V., which also provides professional training programs.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer race course
Team rankings with strong participation
Appealing course in Bad Staffelstein
additional: Böhnlein Sports Bamberg e.V. offers professional training with experienced coaches. The event is part of the club calendar and is organized by a dedicated team. It features strong team rankings, and participants often achieve personal bests. The event takes place at the Adam-Riese-Halle in Bad Staffelstein and offers both individual and team competitions. It is a popular opportunity to end the year on an athletic note.

name: Silvesterlauf Schwalmstadt
description: The New Year's Eve Run in Schwalmstadt-Ziegenhain is a traditional race that has taken place every year on December 31 since 1970. The event offers a short 2.7 km race for children and young people, as well as a long 8.1 km race for adults. The race marks the end of the Schwalm-Eder Cup series and is known for its musical program, with samba rhythms by Sola Quente accompanying runners along the course. The event is organized by a dedicated team from TuSpo Ziegenhain and is a popular way for many track and field athletes to end the year.
course_highlights: Short race: 1 lap = 2,740 m; long race: 3 laps = 8,100 m
Samba rhythms by Sola Quente provide musical accompaniment
The course runs through Schützenwald, with parking nearby
additional: Parking is available in the woods between the hospital and the start. Access to the parking lot at the start is possible until 12:45 p.m. After 12:45 p.m., free parking is available at the Asklepios Hospital parking lot. The awards ceremony takes place at the venue in Schützenwald after the races. The race takes place in Schützenwald; online registration is available. The start and finish area is by the pond at Ziegelhütte. Parking is available nearby. There are no shower facilities. Food and drinks are available, along with a program of music and community activities.

name: Silvesterlauf Winsen (Aller)
description: The MTV "Fichte" Winsen (Aller) New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional year-end running event that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 1,600 m for children to 10,300 m for adults, as well as a 6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure. The run starts and finishes at the Allertalsporthalle, where changing rooms and showers are also available. The event is officially sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and features a celebratory awards ceremony for the fastest participants in each distance.
course_highlights: Distances from 1,600 m to 10,300 m for all age groups
6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure
Start and finish at the Allertalsporthalle, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Race bib distribution from 2 December 2024 at the business office (Mon–Fri, 8:00–12:30). Late registration is possible on the event day from 12:00 to 13:45 for an additional fee. Plenty of parking is available at the Allertalsporthalle. Awards ceremony at approximately 15:30. Distances: 3 km, 5 km, 10.3 km, children’s race 1.6 km; walkers welcome. Start at 14:30. Register online or on site.

name: 12. Silvesterlauf an der Leine
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hannover is a popular year-end race that traditionally starts on December 31 at 13:00. The event features a 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths along the Leine, through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and back along the Ihme. It is organized by Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC), Bladerunner and Trimindous UG, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, with mulled wine and bratwurst after the race. Every finisher receives a wheat beer glass featuring the event design as a keepsake. There is also a walking category, making the event appealing to a range of participants.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course goes through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the canal
Return route along the Ihme
additional: Mass start at 13:00; on-the-day registration is available on site from 12:00 for payment by cash or PayPal. Every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass featuring the event design. The event venue is the clubhouse of Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC) at Weddigenufer 23, near Unisport. The race offers a relaxed atmosphere with mulled wine, bratwurst and a wheat beer glass for finishers. There is also a walking category, and the course is ideal for anyone who wants to wrap up the running year in good company.

name: 25. VR-Bank Mitte Silvesterlauf
location: Seeburger See, Bernshausen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The VR-Bank Mitte New Year's Eve Run is a sporting way to round off the year, held around Lake Seeburg in Bernshausen. The flat circuit on paved paths offers runners an attractive course with one or two laps around the lake, depending on the distance. The event traditionally takes place on 31 December and welcomes runners of all ability levels for an atmospheric end to the year. The start and finish areas are on Kreisstraße 106 near the Bernshausen multipurpose hall.
course_highlights: Flat circuit around Lake Seeburg
Paved paths
5 km loop (1 lap around the lake) and 10 km loop (2 laps around the lake)
additional: Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 10:30 at the Bernshausen multipurpose hall, until 30 minutes before each start. Race bibs are not available for collection at Laufline Göttingen. No refund of the entry fee is available if a participant does not take part or if the event is cancelled.

name: 38. Silvesterlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The SC Altenrheine New Year’s Eve Run is the region’s sporting end to the year. With up to 800 participants, from young to old, it is one of the largest running events in the area. The event offers various distances through Altenrheine, each finishing with a lap of the stadium. The varied routes include out-and-back sections and circuits through the town. The run is a popular opportunity to end the year on a sporty note and enjoy a sense of community.
course_highlights: 600-metre out-and-back route along Schürweg towards the car park, plus 1 lap of the stadium
2,000-metre out-and-back route along Schürweg towards Außenhook, plus 1 lap of the stadium
10,000 metres: 3 laps through Altenrheine, plus 1 lap of the stadium
additional: The event is designed for up to 800 athletes, from young to old. Distances range from 600 m to 10,000 m. Registration is online; registration details and prices are not explicitly listed on the website. The run offers a festive end-of-year atmosphere, with routes in the region and a broad range of participants.

name: 44. Bad Harzburger Silvesterlauf
location: Sportpark an der Rennbahn, Bad Harzburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Bad Harzburg New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event organized by MTK Bad Harzburg since 1981. The race takes place every year on December 31 in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn and is the oldest New Year’s Eve run in the region. The event offers several distances, including 2,500, 5,000 and 10,000 meters, run on a 2,500-meter loop. Participants can record and follow their lap times electronically, making the race especially appealing.
course_highlights: 2,500-meter loop in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn
Electronic chip timing with split times after each lap
Traditional New Year’s Eve run since 1981, with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The race office opens at 11 a.m. on race day. Live results are available online for the first time at https://oresults.eu/events/2639. Timing is provided by a SportIdent chip, which is scanned after each lap on the 5,000- and 10,000-meter courses. Certificates and trophies are presented at 3:30 p.m. Distances: 2,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m; registration by post or on race day; electronic timing; awards ceremonies for top finishers; start at 1:30 p.m.

name: 47. Silvesterlauf rund um die Thülsfelder Talsperre
description: The 47th International New Year’s Eve Run around the Thülsfelder Talsperre is a traditional race held on New Year’s Eve in Molbergen, Lower Saxony. The course runs around the Thülsfelder Talsperre and offers two distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km. Organized by SV Molbergen since 1975, the race is the final competition of the year for many runners and officially counts toward rankings. After the finish, traditional pea soup provides a sociable end to the event.
course_highlights: Loop course around the Thülsfelder Talsperre
Scenic route in Lower Saxony
Traditional start with a cannon shot
additional: The race starts with a cannon shot fired by a local fireworks club; traditional pea soup is served after the race; the event attracts many local runners and club runners; December weather is typically cold, with possible snowfall. Distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km; held on December 31, 2026; traditional communal meal after the race; large fields of participants can cause bottlenecks at the start.

name: Active Laufshop Silvesterlauf
description: The ACTIVE LAUFSHOP New Year’s Eve Run in Münster is a popular running event traditionally held on December 31. Organized by Laufsportfreunde Münster e.V., one of Germany’s largest running clubs, the event offers several race distances for runners of all abilities. The routes pass through the city of Münster, creating a varied and lively atmosphere to round off the year. The event is open to recreational runners and competitive athletes and supports community and running in the region.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 5 km and 10 km
Routes pass through the city of Münster
A varied and lively running atmosphere at the end of the year
additional: Course maps for the 3 km, 5 km and 10 km races are available as PDFs on the website. The run takes place annually on December 31 and is a popular way to end the year on an active note. Registration is already open.

name: Dübener Silvesterlauf
description: The 47th Dübener New Year's Eve Run takes place in Bad Düben and is organized by SV Bad Düben, Athletics Department. The event offers runners of all ages the opportunity to end the year on an active note. The route runs through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben and promises a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Registration is online through SV Bad Düben.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben
Traditional New Year's Eve run to close out the year
Event for children, teenagers, and adult runners
additional: The event is aimed at children, teenagers, and adult runners. The venue is the Obermühle sports facility, Parkstraße 1, Bad Düben. Cross-country run through heathland and woodland, children's and walkers' races, compact club event

name: Emmerthaler Silvesterlauf
description: The Emmerthal New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal, celebrating its 51st edition in 2026. Organized by TSG Emmerthal, the event gives runners the opportunity to track their performance with detailed lap times. It is supported by local sponsors and volunteer helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and the club. The race is known for its friendly, community spirit and warmly welcomes all participants.
course_highlights: Distances: 300 m and 7 km
Results published with lap times
Race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal
additional: Supported by local sponsors and helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and TSG Emmerthal. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with frequent snowfall. The venue is in Emmerthal, with directions provided. December weather is typically cold and snowy; results are published with lap times; the event is very popular with runners and families.

name: Finale Furioso 2.0 - Silvesterlauf der DJK Göggelsbuch
location: Sportgelände des Vereins, Allersberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: Finale Furioso 2.0 is a New Year’s Eve run organized by DJK Göggelsbuch at the club’s sports grounds in Allersberg. The race is open to everyone, from ambitious runners to families with children, and offers several distances, including a Bambini run, a children’s race, a 5.5 km run and the 10 km main race. The flat routes follow paved farm and forest paths with short asphalt sections and are easy to run. After the race, the sports hall provides a cozy atmosphere with refreshments, music and an awards ceremony, under the motto “Welcome among friends.”
course_highlights: Flat routes over paved farm and forest paths
Short asphalt sections
Start and finish directly at the DJK clubhouse
additional: Refreshments in the sports hall include Weißwurst, Vienna sausages and pretzels; music and awards ceremony; a compact race day centered around the club. Distances: 700 m, 5.5 km, 10 km; family-friendly, flat routes, refreshments, music, awards ceremony, and food such as Weißwurst and pretzels.

name: Geraer Silvesterlauf
description: The Gera New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held annually on December 31 in Gera. The event offers various distances from 3 km to 20 km, with varied routes featuring elevation changes. The run is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners and ends in a festive atmosphere to mark the close of the year.
course_highlights: A range of distances: 3 km, 4 km, 11 km, and 20 km
Varied routes featuring elevation changes
Start and finish in front of the Panndorfhalle in Gera
additional: Online registration includes direct payment by credit card, Klarna, or PayPal. Participant certificates can be printed after the race until March 31 of the following year. The event offers extensive online media galleries and result records. The run takes place on December 31; details about the terrain and registration are available on the website.

name: Haseder Silvesterlauf
location: Dorfgemeinschaftshaus Giesen, Giesen, Hildesheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Hasede New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Giesen. With courses for children and adults, the run offers a sporting and sociable way to see out the year with friends and family. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, professional timing and dedicated team of volunteers. The courses run through the residential area around the sports hall and offer both short and longer distances for different ability levels.
course_highlights: The 600 m course loops once around the sports hall, through the residential area and back
5 km and 10 km courses for ambitious runners
Family-friendly atmosphere with children’s races over 0.6 km and 1.2 km
additional: Professional timing is provided by Eichels-Event from Hanover. The event is supported by a large team of volunteers. Bambini races are offered for children over 0.6 km and 1.2 km. The awards ceremony takes place in the sports hall, which also serves as a meeting point. Courses for children and adults, results, photo gallery, timing by Eichels-Event, refreshments on site

name: Hohenloher Silvesterlauf 1. Lauf zum 4 Jahreszeiten Laufcup 2027
description: The Hohenloher Silvesterlauf is a traditional race in Germany’s Hohenlohe region, starting and finishing in Hengstfeld on December 31, 2026. The event offers two distance options: a 5 km fun run and a 10 km main race. As the first race in the 4-Seasons Running Cup, it combines a year-end run with a larger series spanning all four seasons. The race is aimed at club runners, recreational joggers, and beginners who want to end the year on an active note.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the clubhouse of SpVgg Hengstfeld-Wallhausen e.V.
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Run through the scenic Hohenlohe region
additional: Typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. The race is the first of four events in the 2027 Seasons Running Cup. Start at 13:00; weather-dependent winter conditions with snow cover. Suitable for different ability levels and part of the Four Seasons Running Cup.

name: Hueber-Silvesterlauf in Pleinfeld
description: The Hueber New Year’s Eve Run in Pleinfeld is a long-standing race held at the Brombachhalle Sports Park. With over 600 participants, it marks the finale of the Raiffeisen Läufer-Cup Roth/Weißenburg series. The event offers races for Bambini, schoolchildren, walkers, and adult runners. After the competitions, the Brombachhalle provides refreshments and an awards ceremony for a pleasant end to the day.
course_highlights: Race at the Brombachhalle Sports Park in Pleinfeld
Distances: 0.5 km and 9 km
Finale of the Raiffeisen Läufer-Cup Roth/Weißenburg series
additional: After the races, the awards ceremony and refreshments take place in the Brombachhalle. The event is open to all age groups, from Bambini to adults. Distances: 0.5 km and 9 km; December weather: approx. 3°C, with snow cover on some days; includes an awards ceremony and refreshments after the race.

name: Int. LEW Silvesterlauf Gersthofen
description: The International LEW Gersthofen New Year's Eve Run is a traditional year-end race in Gersthofen, Bavaria. It offers various events, including the main race of approx. 9.7 km, a schoolchildren's race, the Flitzi Run for the youngest participants, and hiking and Nordic walking routes. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, professional organization, and varied program with musical accompaniment. The start and finish areas are located on the grounds of the TSV sports hall in Gersthofen.
course_highlights: Main race of approx. 9.7 km through Gersthofen
Schoolchildren's race of approx. 2.2 km
Hiking and Nordic walking routes of approx. 9 km
additional: Late registration is possible until 31.12.2026 for a fee. Race packs will be available on December 30 and 31 at the TSV Gersthofen sports hall. Group warm-up before Nordic walking and hikes. Musical accompaniment by the Gersthofer Blasharmoniker on the day of the event. Race routes, online registration, start at the sports hall, limited to 1,500 participants

name: Kieler Silvesterlauf
description: The Kiel New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held on December 31 in Kiel-Ellerbek at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz. The event is organized by LTV Kiel-Ost e.V. and is limited to 250 runners. In addition to the sporting competition, there is a costume contest for individuals and teams, as well as a draw for prizes. The awards ceremony takes place in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School, and every participant receives a memento and has the option to order a certificate.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz
Limited to 250 runners
Costume contest for individuals and teams, with prizes
additional: Race materials can be collected at the sports hall on 30.12.2026 from 15:00 to 16:30 and on 31.12.2026 from 11:00 to 12:30. Late entrants must pay a fee and may receive a place if any are still available. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 14:30 in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School. There are no age-group rankings, but men and women are ranked separately. Participants who hand in their race number after the run are entered into a draw for prizes; attendance is required. Participant limit: 250; start times on 30.12.2026 and 31.12.2026; late registration possible; awards ceremony at approximately 14:30; certificates and prizes

name: Lüchower Silvesterlauf

name: Nellschützer Silvesterlauf
description: The Nellschütz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional 10 km road race in Lützen, Saxony-Anhalt, held on the morning of December 31. Since 2000, it has been a regular fixture in the local running calendar and offers runners in the Burgenlandkreis a chance to end the year together. The race starts near the church in Nellschütz and is officially organized within the German athletics framework, including insurance and coordination of the event date. Its characteristic relaxed style means runners usually run and chat in small groups rather than aiming for a personal best. After the race, participants are traditionally treated to hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family.
course_highlights: 10 km road race through Lützen and the surrounding area

Finish area with hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family

The race is designed as a communal year-end event, with runners taking part in small groups. The start is near the church in Nellschütz. The race starts in Nellschütz near the church, with a dedicated aid station on the course. The event is known as a year-end race with a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Oberlichtenauer Silvesterlauf
description: The Oberlichtenau New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional end-of-year race in Pulsnitz, Saxony. With a 1.2 km children’s run, a 4.8 km fun run, and a 9.2 km long-distance run, it offers a sporting menu for all ages and ability levels. The race is a popular event for runners and spectators and always takes place on New Year’s Eve, giving participants a sporting way to see out the year. The event is distinguished by its family-friendly atmosphere and dedicated organizers.

name: OTB Silvesterlauf
description: The OTB New Year’s Eve Run in Osnabrück is a traditional year-end race that welcomes recreational runners, walkers and competitive athletes alike. On the last day of the year, participants can choose from several distances, including a 10 km main race, walking routes, a 5.6 km short race, an accessible fun run and a Bambini run. The event offers a lively atmosphere and modern timing with a disposable chip. The route passes through scenic areas such as Rubbenbruchsee and Natruper Holz, and the race has been a fixture on Osnabrück’s running calendar since 1980.

Several race options are available, including an accessible run, a children’s race and walking; spikes are not allowed; online registration is available; field limited to 3,000 runners.

After the race, participants receive a hot drink, a Berliner doughnut and a commemorative medal, as well as a personalized certificate on request.
