The 7 km course features 85% off-road paths and 15% asphalt, with 180 metres of elevation gain, making for an interesting and challenging route. The race starts at 17:00 by the small bridge near the sports field and is organized by SK Žďárák. It is suitable for trail running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in nature.

name: Pohár města Třemošnice
description: The O pohár starosty města Třemošnice firefighting sports competition is a traditional sporting event held in Třemošnice and is part of the Chrudim District League. Men’s and women’s teams compete, showcasing top-level performances in firefighting sports. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and ample refreshments for participants and fans. It is organized by the Třemošnice Volunteer Fire Brigade in cooperation with the town of Třemošnice. Everyone is welcome to attend the next edition, which will take place.

name: „Vilnius 5 in 5“ (1 diena)
organizer: VšĮ „Maratomanija“ ir VšĮ “100 marathon club Lithuania”
description: “Vilnius 5 in 5” is a unique five-day running challenge in Vilnius, where participants can complete five marathons, half marathons, 12.6 km or 4.2 km distances on consecutive days. The event encourages endurance, determination and returning to the course each day, offering the chance to experience a true stage-running adventure. It is the first event of its kind in Lithuania, inspired by a global tradition, and takes place at the Vingis Park bandstand. Participants can choose their distance and start time. The event is organized by VšĮ “Maratomanija” and VšĮ “100 marathon club Lithuania”.
course_highlights: Vingis Park bandstand in Vilnius
Option to choose a 9:00 or 15:00 start time on the first three days for the 4.2 km and 12.6 km distances
Five starts over five days, with different distances: marathon, half marathon, 12.6 km and 4.2 km
additional: Time limits: 8 hours for the marathon, 4 hours for the half marathon, 3 hours for 12.6 km and 1 hour for 4.2 km. The course GPX file is available online. Participants must bring an identity document to collect their race number. Parents, guardians or coaches are responsible for minors. There will be a refreshment station on the course during the event. Participants agree that their photos and video footage may be used for marketing purposes. A multi-day run on courses in Vilnius’s Vingis Park, with various distances; registration and a health check are required.

name: Wydminy Night Run 5K
description: Wydminy Night Run to coroczny bieg na dystansie 5 km odbywający się w malowniczej miejscowości Wydminy. Impreza organizowana jest przez HERON ULTRA TRAIL i lokalnych partnerów, przyciągając biegaczy ceniących sobie atmosferę nocnego biegu w otoczeniu mazurskiej przyrody. Trasa prowadzi przez tereny leśne i nad jeziorami, oferując wyjątkowe widoki i wyzwania dla uczestników. To doskonała okazja do aktywnego spędzenia czasu i integracji w sportowym duchu.
course_highlights: Trasa przebiega przez lasy i tereny mazurskie
Bieg odbywa się nocą, co dodaje wyjątkowego klimatu
Widoki na jeziora i pagórkowaty teren
additional: Organizatorem jest HERON ULTRA TRAIL. Wydarzenie ma charakter nocnego biegu na dystansie 5 km. Brak informacji o opłatach startowych i godzinie startu. Wydarzenie promowane jest na Facebooku, gdzie można znaleźć aktualności i kontakt z organizatorami.

name: III Ryszewkowy Bieg o Puchar Strażaka
Berliner Wasserbetriebe 5x5 km TEAM-Staffel
description: The Berliner Wasserbetriebe 5 x 5 km TEAM-Staffel is a unique relay race in the heart of Berlin’s Tiergarten, putting team spirit and shared experiences at the center. Five team members each run a 5 km lap on a scenic course between the Victory Column and the Federal Chancellery. The event stands out for its lively relay zone, festive atmosphere, and special medal symbolizing solidarity. Beyond the competition, the focus is on sharing the experience and enjoying the run.
course_highlights: A 5 km lap through the northern Tiergarten, with shade even on hot days
Start with a view of the Reichstag and finish-line cheers in the tent lane
Relay zone in the start/finish area, serving as a lively central meeting point
additional: The race starts in waves to avoid congestion. Timing is recorded via a relay baton with an integrated timing chip. Each team receives an eco-friendly snack bag instead of a picnic basket, and participants are asked to bring their own water bottles or reusable cups. The medal is a special symbol of team spirit and solidarity; after five participations, the medals can be joined together to form one large medal.

name: Sonnefelder Wald-Cross-Lauf
description: The 5th Sonnefeld Forest Cross-Country Run takes place in Sonnefeld and offers runners of all abilities an appealing event in scenic surroundings, on field and forest trails. There is an 8.3 km main race with 110 metres of elevation gain, a Nordic walking event on the same course, and a 1.7 km schoolchildren’s race. The event is open to competitive runners, Nordic walkers and young athletes, and is held in accordance with official athletics regulations. Refreshments, showers and changing facilities are provided, and all finishers receive a medal.

name: Volkslauf Wacker Frohnhausen
description: The Wacker Frohnhausen Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Gladenbach-Frohnhausen, organized annually by SV Wacker Frohnhausen. The races run around Donnerberg and offer routes for different ability levels. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and involvement of the local community. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with varied routes.

name: 3. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro zdraví is a charitable running series organized by the TJ Jäkl Karviná athletics club in the beautiful setting of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run is 3 km long and is suitable for anyone who wants to do something for their health while supporting people in need, as the proceeds from entry fees are donated to help those in need. The event is friendly and open to the general public, with participants free to run at any pace. Registration begins at 17:00 and the start is at 17:45. Everyone is warmly invited to take part in this regular sporting event.
course_highlights: A 3 km route in the beautiful setting of Božena Němcová Park
The route follows a cycle path suitable for running
A charity run with proceeds going to help people in need
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, with the start at 17:45 at Lodičky in Božena Němcová Park. A series of seven runs for health, where everyone can run the route at any pace. Charity run; proceeds from entry fees go to help people in need.

name: Běh na Vysoký vrch
description: The Run to Vysoký vrch is a mountain race to the highest hill in the Kladno region. It offers a challenging but short run, with 200 metres of elevation gain over a route approximately 2.8 km long. The race is divided into age and gender categories, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place in Malé Kyšice and is organised by TJ Sokol Unhošť. The race is scheduled to start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for both runners and spectators.

name: Rozkvetlá Kaštanka
description: Rozkvetlá Kaštanka is a popular running race held in Lhota, Central Bohemian Region, traditionally in June. The race features a 7.5 km route along paved roads and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and the atmosphere of spring, when the surrounding area bursts into bloom with gorgeous chestnut blossoms. The race is suitable for runners of all abilities and is a welcome opportunity to meet the local running community.

name: II Biegniem bez las
organizer: LUKS Huragan Lipniki oraz grupa „Razem możemy więcej”
description: „Biegniem bez las” to wydarzenie biegowe organizowane w Lipnikach, w gminie Łyse. Uczestnicy mogą wybrać bieg na 5 lub 10 km albo marsz Nordic Walking na 5 km. Trasy prowadzą leśnymi drogami Kurpiowszczyzny, a wydarzenie łączy aktywność sportową ze spotkaniem lokalnej społeczności.
course_highlights: Bieg na dystansie 5 km
Bieg na dystansie 10 km
Marsz Nordic Walking na 5 km
additional: Wydarzenie odbywa się w Lipnikach, w gminie Łyse.

name: Heider Abend-Stadtlauf
description: The Heider Evening City Run is a long-standing race in Heide, organized by MTV von 1860 e.V. Heide. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to compete on an attractive route through the city. The race is known for its welcoming atmosphere and the support of the local sports club. The course is well marked and offers a varied running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Heide.

name: Saalfelder Bambini-Schloßparklauf
distance_verbose: 13.5 km, 10 km, 9.9 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km
description: The Saalfeld Bambini Schlosspark Run is a traditional running event specifically for preschool and primary school children. The event takes place in Saalfeld’s Schlosspark and offers age-appropriate distances that vary by age group. The races encourage children to enjoy sport and movement in a family-friendly atmosphere. The awards ceremony takes place shortly after the final race, making it a special experience for the children.
course_highlights: Races in the idyllic Schlosspark in Saalfeld
Age-appropriate course lengths of 1 to 2 laps
Family-friendly atmosphere, with the awards ceremony immediately afterward
additional: The races are grouped by year of birth, starting with 3-year-old children running one lap and ending with 9-year-old children completing two laps. Registration is possible online, at the start, or by phone. The awards ceremony takes place about 10 minutes after the final race.

name: Spargellauf
description: The WERNER Asparagus Run in Deinste is a 5.5 km relay race held annually, celebrating its 20th anniversary in 2026. Teams of five run together through the asparagus fields, using an asparagus spear as the baton. The race is suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to professionals, and the focus is on fun, as the winning team is selected by drawing lots. In addition to the race, there is a food mile featuring regional specialties and a family program with a bouncy castle and other attractions. A special race shirt will be offered for the anniversary, and a big after-show party will take place.

name: Stapelmoorer Run-Fun-Loop
description: The Stapelmoorer Run Fun Loop is a 10 km DLV-measured race that starts and finishes at the Teutonia Stapelmoor sports field. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Stapelmoor, with sections along farm tracks, school routes, and village streets. The event is part of the Teutonia Stapelmoor running community and offers runners a well-organized, varied course in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Warnemünder Stapellauf
description: The Warnemünder Stapellauf is a small running event held in June in Rostock, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Germany. It offers short distances of 555 meters and 9.3 kilometers, ideal for runners looking for a straightforward race experience. The courses have local nautical names that reflect Warnemünde’s coastal identity, including the 5 Seemeilen-Lauf (9 km) and the 3 Seemeilen-Lauf (6 km). Results are managed via my.race|result, and the event is listed in the laufen.de calendar.

name: Kolem Trpaslíka v Hybrálci
description: The Kolem Trpaslíka race in Hybrálec is a 10 km running race that runs mostly along unpaved forest paths in the Hybrálec area near Jihlava. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and offers runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural terrain of the Vysočina region. The course is suitable for fans of forest running and a pleasant sporting experience in nature.

name: Valašské kilo
description: Valašské Kilo is a challenging 100 km ultramarathon through the beautiful, hilly landscape of Valašsko, with at least 3,500 metres of elevation gain. The race challenges not only experienced athletes but also those who want to push their limits and experience an off-road adventure. After the mass start at 22:00, runners plan their own routes between checkpoints within the 30-hour time limit. Race headquarters are at Žerotínova Elementary School in Valašské Meziříčí, where a gym, showers and a dining hall are available. Valašské Kilo offers the freedom to navigate the terrain and is one of the best ultramarathons in Czechia.

name: Ultramaraton Babia Góra
description: Ultramaraton Babia Góra to prestiżowy bieg górski odbywający się w Lipnicy Wielkiej. Zawody obejmują różne dystanse, w tym ultramaratony wielokrotnego okrążenia Babiej Góry oraz biegi krótsze, takie jak SkyRace®. Trasa prowadzi przez malownicze tereny Babiogórskiego Parku Narodowego, oferując wymagające podbiegi i spektakularne widoki. Zawody promują aktywny tryb życia i wspierają działania charytatywne Fundacji Rak’n’Roll. Organizator zapewnia punkty odżywcze, zabezpieczenie medyczne oraz możliwość dostarczenia przepaków na trasę najdłuższych dystansów.

name: 12. Tarczyński Nocny Wrocław Półmaraton
description: 12. Tarczyński Nocny Wrocław Półmaraton to jedna z najważniejszych sportowych imprez we Wrocławiu, która odbędzie się 5 czerwca 2027 roku. Zawodnicy pobiegną nową, szeroką i bezpieczną trasą ze startem i metą na Tarczyński Arenie Wrocław. Półmaraton ma symboliczne znaczenie dla miasta jako wydarzenie promujące aktywność fizyczną i zdrowie mieszkańców, przyciągając co roku tysiące biegaczy z Polski i zagranicy. Organizatorzy stawiają sobie ambitny cel, by znaleźć się wśród największych półmaratonów europejskich, oferując rekordową liczbę pakietów startowych. To wyjątkowe sportowe święto z silnym wsparciem lokalnej społeczności i kibiców.
course_highlights: Nowa, szeroka i bezpieczna trasa półmaratonu
Start i meta na Tarczyński Arenie Wrocław
Trasa o długości 21,0975 km nawiązująca do liczby pakietów startowych
additional: Rekordowa liczba 21 975 pakietów startowych nawiązuje do długości półmaratonu. Start zaplanowano przy bramie A Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. W ubiegłych latach pierwsza pula pakietów rozeszła się w zaledwie 30 godzin. Impreza ma na celu przekroczenie liczby 20 tysięcy uczestników i wejście do pierwszej dziesiątki największych półmaratonów w Europie.

name: II Półmaraton Miasteczkowskich Lasów
description: II Półmaraton Miasteczkowskich Lasów to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie Góra Jerzego w Miasteczku Śląskim, promująca zdrowy styl życia i integrację lokalnej społeczności. Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi przez malownicze tereny leśne wokół miasta, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe doświadczenie biegowe w otoczeniu natury. Wydarzenie przyciąga zarówno zawodników z regionu, jak i gości, tworząc atmosferę sportowej rywalizacji i rodzinnej zabawy. Organizatorzy dbają o bezpieczeństwo i komfort uczestników, zapewniając m.in. parkingi, biuro zawodów oraz atrakcyjne nagrody.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi przez malownicze lasy wokół Miasteczka Śląskiego
Bieg integruje lokalną społeczność i promuje zdrowy styl życia
Organizacja zapewnia bezpieczne warunki i udogodnienia dla biegaczy
additional: Biuro zawodów otwarte od 8:30 do 10:30 na terenie boiska CSIR. W dniu biegu od godziny 11:00 planowane są chwilowe utrudnienia w ruchu drogowym z powodu zamknięcia kilku skrzyżowań. Dostępne dwa parkingi publiczne w pobliżu biura zawodów. Dla uczestników przewidziane nagrody, m.in. dwa zegarki Garmin Forerunner 55 ufundowane przez Gminę Miasteczko Śląskie. Mieszkańcy Miasteczka Śląskiego mogą skorzystać z 50% rabatu na opłatę startową.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
location: Fort Poznań Event Place, Poznań, Polska
description: Poznańska Piwna Mila to cykl biegów na dystansie mili, które łączą rywalizację sportową z pasją biegania oraz propagowaniem aktywnego stylu życia. Impreza odbywa się w Fort Poznań Event Place w Poznaniu i przyciąga biegaczy chcących zmierzyć się na krótkim, dynamicznym dystansie. Atmosfera wydarzenia sprzyja zarówno sportowej rywalizacji, jak i integracji uczestników.
course_highlights: Bieg na dystansie jednej mili
Organizacja w Fort Poznań Event Place
Cykl biegów łączący sport i pasję biegania

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk to bieg szlakiem schronów bojowych SGO "Narew" odbywający się w Nowogrodzie. Trasa półmaratonu ma około 21,1 km i prowadzi głównie drogami polnymi, leśnymi i gruntowymi, z krótkimi odcinkami utwardzonymi. Na trasie znajdują się trzy punkty odżywcze z wodą, colą, izotonikiem, domowymi ciastami, owocami i przekąskami. Uczestnicy otrzymują pamiątkowy medal po ukończeniu biegu w limicie czasu 3 godzin i 30 minut. Wydarzenie towarzyszy bieg na 7 km bez limitu czasu, a po biegu organizowana jest dekoracja i biesiada przy ognisku.
course_highlights: Trasa półmaratonu o długości około 21,1 km prowadzi drogami polnymi, leśnymi i gruntowymi
Na trasie półmaratonu trzy punkty odżywcze z bogatym zaopatrzeniem
Trasa obejmuje krótkie odcinki utwardzone, w tym osiedlowe uliczki Nowogrodu
additional: Biuro zawodów i start/meta przy scenie koło skansenu w Nowogrodzie. Limit czasu półmaratonu to 3 godziny 30 minut, brak limitu dla biegu 7 km. Zabezpieczenie medyczne na trasie. Po biegu dekoracja zwycięzców i konkurs z nagrodami oraz biesiada przy ognisku. Dodatkowo w dniu imprezy zwiedzanie Skansenu z przewodnikiem i inscenizacja walk o Nowogród z 1939 roku. W poprzednich edycjach program towarzyszący obejmował bieg na 5 lub 7 km, Nordic Walking oraz biegi dziecięce.

name: Kwietny Bieg
description: Kwietny Bieg w Lisowicach to wyjątkowa 24-godzinna sztafeta biegowa, która upamiętnia ducha wolności rozbudzonego przez Ojca Świętego Jana Pawła II podczas jego pierwszej pielgrzymki do Polski. Bieg odbywa się na atestowanej pętli o długości 1352 metrów, która jest doskonale oznakowana i oświetlona po zmroku. Wydarzenie jest otwarte dla wszystkich chętnych i ma charakter rekreacyjno-sportowy, przyciągając zarówno amatorów, jak i doświadczonych biegaczy. Uczestnicy, którzy pokonają dystans 10 Kwietnych Mil (35,3 km), otrzymują certyfikat i pamiątkowy medal. Kwietny Bieg to także okazja do wspólnego świętowania i ustanawiania rekordów na trasie.
course_highlights: 24-godzinna sztafeta na pętli o długości 1352 metrów z atestem PZLA
Trasa doskonale oznakowana i oświetlona pochodniami oraz lampkami
Bieg odbywa się na symbolicznym dystansie Kwietnej Mili - 3530 metrów
additional: Bieg odbywa się na pętli o długości 1352 m z atestem PZLA. Trasa jest oświetlana pochodniami i lampkami po zmroku. Sztafeta chorążych dba o ciągłość biegu, biegnąc z biało-czerwoną szarfą. Wydarzenie jest otwarte i bezpłatne, a w poprzednich edycjach ustanowiono rekordy liczby uczestników i pokonanych okrążeń.

name: MnO Jaszczur i Czerwony Most
description: Maraton na Orientację "Jaszczur i Czerwony Most" to impreza organizowana przez Zgromadzenie Wędrownicze w Koszalinie. Jest to wydarzenie dla miłośników biegania na orientację, łączące sportową rywalizację z eksploracją terenów. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na wymagające trasy i atmosferę przygody. Impreza ma charakter kameralny i odbywa się w malowniczych okolicach.
course_highlights: Trasy biegnące przez zróżnicowany teren
Elementy biegu na orientację wymagające nawigacji
Malownicze okolice Koszalina

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika to wyjątkowy bieg uliczny odbywający się w magicznej scenerii Torunia, miasta Mikołaja Kopernika. Uczestnicy mają do wyboru dystanse 10 km oraz 5 km, a także możliwość udziału w Nordic Walking. Bieg startuje wieczorem, co pozwala przeżyć niezapomnianą nocną atmosferę miasta. Meta znajduje się na Stadionie Miejskim, a organizatorzy zapewniają depozyt rzeczy oraz wsparcie wolontariuszy.
course_highlights: Trasa 10 km rozpoczyna się przy Galerii Copernicus, ul. Żółkiewskiego 15
Trasa 5 km i Nordic Walking startują z Mostu im. Józefa Piłsudskiego, Camping Tramp przy ul. Dybowskiej
Meta na Stadionie Miejskim, ul. Bema 23/29
additional: Limit czasu na 10 km wynosi 1 godz. 20 min. Limit czasu na 5 km to 50 min, a dla Nordic Walking 60 min. Biuro zawodów znajduje się w Galerii Copernicus przy sklepie Decathlon i jest czynne 6 czerwca od 15:00 do 21:00. Organizator zapewnia depozyt na starcie z transportem rzeczy na metę. Wolontariusze wydają worki na depozyt z numerem startowym, które należy samodzielnie zawiązać i oddać przed biegiem.

name: Sudecki Festiwal Biegów Gorskich
description: Sudecki Festiwal Biegów Górskich to kontynuacja Biegów Szlakiem Riese w nowej formule, odbywająca się w malowniczej Głuszycy. Festiwal oferuje różnorodne trasy górskie o zróżnicowanym stopniu trudności, w tym ultramaraton, półmaraton oraz krótsze biegi. Uczestnicy mogą korzystać z profesjonalnie przygotowanych profili tras dostępnych w formacie GPX. To wydarzenie dla miłośników biegania w terenie, którzy chcą zmierzyć się z wymagającymi górskimi szlakami Sudetów.
course_highlights: Trasa WRC - Waligóra Run Cross Droga Tytanów 82 km
Trasa ULTRA WRC - 53 km
Trasa HALF WRC - 28 km
additional: Dostępne profile tras wraz z linkami do plików GPX dla wszystkich dystansów. Wydarzenie obejmuje kilka biegów górskich o różnych długościach, w tym WRC - Waligóra Run Cross Droga Tytanów 82 km, ULTRA WRC 53 km oraz HALF WRC 28 km.

name: XII Festiwal Biegu Rzeźnika
description: Festiwal Biegu Rzeźnika to prestiżowe wydarzenie biegowe odbywające się w malowniczych Bieszczadach, w okolicach Cisnej. Oferuje różnorodne dystanse od krótkich biegów dla dzieci po ultramaratony i rajdy piesze, które przyciągają zarówno amatorów, jak i doświadczonych biegaczy. Trasy prowadzą przez górskie szlaki, oferując wyjątkowe widoki i wymagające technicznie odcinki. To nie tylko rywalizacja, ale także święto sportu i aktywności na świeżym powietrzu, z bogatym programem towarzyszącym.
course_highlights: Trasy górskie w Bieszczadach z wymagającymi podbiegami i zbiegami
Malownicze widoki na dziką przyrodę i beskidzkie krajobrazy
Różnorodność dystansów od 5 km do 175 km oraz rajd pieszy etapowy
additional: W ramach Festiwalu odbywają się liczne biegi na różnych dystansach, w tym biegi dla dzieci. Dostępne są także rajdy piesze etapowe oraz specjalne wyzwania takie jak Rzeźnicki Szlem. Impreza ma charakter wielodniowy z bogatym harmonogramem biegów i wydarzeń towarzyszących.

name: 19. Lauf zwischen den Meeren
description: The Lauf zwischen den Meeren is a unique relay race that takes participants as a team along a 92.2-kilometre route from Husum on the North Sea to Damp on the Baltic Sea. The route crosses Schleswig-Holstein and connects the coasts of the two seas, with up to ten athletes per team running together. The race promotes both individual performance and camaraderie, attracting up to 800 teams from recreational and elite running. The fastest relays take about 5 hours and 10 minutes and reach the finish at around 14:15.
course_highlights: 92.2-kilometre route from Husum to Damp
10 varied stages ranging from 6.9 to 11.5 kilometres
The route passes through flat North Frisia, historic towns, along the Schlei and through the terminal moraine landscape of Schwansen
additional: The entry fee is per team (5–10 runners). Teams registering for the corporate category pay an additional 19% VAT. The race starts at the harbour point in Husum and is organised by LAV Husum. The route has 10 changeover points and is temporarily closed at railway crossings.

name: 3. Abend-Kanallauf Rethmar
location: Sportgelände des MTV Rethmar, Sehnde, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: MTV Rethmar von 1900 e.V. - Sparte Laufen
description: The 3rd Evening Canal Run Rethmar 2026 is a versatile running event at the MTV Rethmar sports grounds in Sehnde. Distances range from 400 m for the Bambini to the Kalimandscharo Half Marathon over 21.1 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings, with a light cross-country character. The event takes place in all weather and is open to runners of all age groups, whether or not they belong to a club.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km courses with a light cross-country character
Kalimandscharo Half Marathon course over 21.1 km
A range of distances from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon
additional: The late entry fee of EUR 3.00 is waived for the 400 m and 1,500 m races for all U18 age groups. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings. Age-group classification is in accordance with the DLO. Measured courses, cross-country character, online registration, results published after the race, event held in all weather, various age groups

name: Lingelbacher Windmühlenlauf
description: The Lingelbach Windmill Run is a long-standing running event in Lingelbach near Alsfeld, taking place for the 21st time in 2026. The run is organized by TSV Lingelbach 1925 e.V. and offers various race distances for children, school students, and adults. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and scenic course around Lingelbach. Entry fees are paid in cash at the race-number collection.
course_highlights: Various distances (700 m, 5.3 km, 10 km)
Hilly routes offering a sporting challenge
Suitable for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
additional: The entry fee must be paid in cash at race-number collection. The event takes place in June, with typical temperatures of around 23°C; there are various categories, including children’s races and walking. Cash payment is available on site.

name: Silberberglauf
price_range: regulärer Preis bis 01.06.2026, Last Minute bis 05.06.2026, vor Ort ab 08:30 Uhr
description: The 41st Silberberglauf offers runners and walkers varied courses around the Silberberg near Ilmenau. With distances of 21.1 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as children’s races over 2.5 km and 0.6 km, there is something for all age groups and ability levels. The event is part of the Sparkassencup Saalfeld-Rudolstadt and the TLV-Cup, and promises a sporting atmosphere with refreshments, medals and awards ceremonies. The children’s sports festival in the afternoon rounds off the event in a family-friendly way.
course_highlights: Half marathon with approx. 600 m of elevation gain
11 km course with approx. 250 m of elevation gain and a Nordic walking category
Children’s races and a children’s sports festival in the afternoon
additional: Race number collection on race day from 07:30 to 08:45 for the main races; children’s races start at 14:00. Last-minute registration on site until 08:30 for the main races and until 14:40 for the children’s races. Refreshments along the courses and at the sports ground, changing facilities, toilets, finisher medals and certificates. Poles are mandatory for the 11 km course; running is prohibited. Baby joggers, dogs and bicycle escorts are not permitted for safety reasons. The finish closes for all courses at 13:00. Trail terrain, online registration via Race Result, equipment-related safety rules, participation in multiple cups

name: Wolfhager Volkslauf Rund um den Graner Berg
2. Jenaer Backyard Ultra
description: The Jena Backyard Ultra is a unique “Last Human Standing” race in Jena-Cospeda, Thuringia. All participants start together every hour on a 6.7 km loop, which they must complete within one hour. Anyone who fails to finish the loop or drops out is eliminated. The race continues until only one runner remains. In addition to the individual competition, there is a team competition for teams of up to three participants, with the team that completes the most laps over the course of the event winning.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with some steep climbs
Beautiful scenery and rewarding views
Start and finish at the Cospeda sports field in Jena
additional: Arrival is possible from 04.06.2027 at 16:00. Tent pitches are available on the event grounds, but there are no spaces for caravans, campers or cars. Parking at the event grounds is permitted for unloading; afterwards, use the designated parking areas on Mühlenweg. The route to the grounds follows an uneven dirt and gravel track.

name: 41. Internationaler Sollinglauf
organizer: Laufgruppe des Dasseler Sport-Clubs von 1920 e.V.
description: The 41st International Solling Run takes place in the Solling area near Dassel. The event offers various race distances, from 400 m to the Leaders Akademie Solling Marathon over 42.5 km. The routes pass through the diverse landscape of the Solling and offer suitable options for ambitious runners, recreational runners, and walkers. The event is organized by Dasseler Sport-Club von 1920 e.V. and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive prize money.

name: Below- Gedenk- und Heidelauf
description: The Below Memorial and Heath Run is a traditional race through the Wittstock Heath and forest, held annually by LC Dosse Wittstock e.V. The 8.5 km course is open to women, men and young people and offers varied natural scenery. In addition to the main race, there are classifications for young people and schoolchildren, as well as a school cup classification. The event is part of the Brandenburg Cup and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with trophies for the overall winners and certificates for all participants.

name: Finkenwerder Insellauf (mit HH-Meisterschaften 5 km)
description: The Finkenwerder Island Run takes place in Finkenwerder, Hamburg, and offers a varied range of races for all age groups. The main races follow an accurately measured, flat 5 km loop through green spaces and along the Elbe, ideal for fast times and the Hamburg 5 km Championships. In addition to the main distances, there are age-appropriate races for children and young people, as well as relay and walking events. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish right at Finkenwerder Market Square, and its sustainable approach, including reusable cups and recycled medals.

name: Oranienburger Stundenlauf
description: The Oranienburg Hour Run is a varied track running competition behind Oranienburg Palace. The event offers various races with time limits of 15, 30 and 60 minutes, as well as a 400-metre children’s race and Nordic walking. Races are divided by age group and gender, and all laps completed within the time limit count. Every finisher receives a medal, and certificates and awards ceremonies are provided for the top runners.

name: Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow LC/NLC
description: The Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow is a traditional running event held in Güstrow, Germany. The event is organized by Tri Fun Güstrow e. V. and offers various distances for different age groups. The main event is a 10 km race for runners aged U20 and above, complemented by shorter races for young people and children. The 48th edition of this local event takes place at the InselseeHeidberg beach and promises a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany’s first beach marathon and takes place on the island of Usedom. The races run exclusively over sand along the Baltic Sea beach, with no asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique natural running experience right by the sea. Participants can choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10 km short-distance race, or marathon relay. The event combines a sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional program in the finish area in Ahlbeck.

name: Volkslauf des MTV Soltau powered by Stadtwerke Soltau
description: The MTV Soltau Volkslauf powered by Stadtwerke Soltau is a traditional race in Soltau that welcomes runners of all ages. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. The race promotes community and grassroots sport in the region and is supported by dedicated local partners.

name: Wremer Deichlauf
description: The Wremer Deichlauf is the traditional highlight of TuS Wremen 09’s sports season and warmly welcomes all running enthusiasts. Two distances are offered: a short 5,300-meter loop and a long 15,900-meter course through the green marshland. The routes run mostly along paved cycle paths and farm roads, and also pass outside the dike directly alongside the water and tidal flats. The short loop also features a separate walking competition.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly along paved cycle paths and farm roads
Run directly alongside the water and tidal flats on the Treibselräumweg
Two distances: 5.3 km and 15.9 km through the green marshland
additional: Walking competition on the 5,300-meter loop

name: Čertovskej Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné stejné pro obě trasy: 1 222 Kč

description: Čertovskej Ultratrail is a challenging trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of the mysterious Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj regions. It offers a main 66.6 km route that is also suitable for beginner ultrarunners thanks to well-stocked aid stations and a friendly atmosphere. A shorter 33.3 km course, called Letní půlčert, is also available. The race is part of the prestigious Ultracup series and offers ITRA points to runners. Capacity is limited, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: A trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj
Well-stocked aid stations along the course
Scenic countryside and a family-friendly race atmosphere
additional: A personal drinking cup is mandatory equipment. You can order one during registration, along with a Čertovskej cup, T-shirt or socks. Race capacity is limited. Categories are available for individuals and relay teams, including a family relay with a child under 15. The route is marked with ribbons and arrows. The time limit for the Čertovskej Wintertrail is 7 hours. Post-race refreshments are provided at the finish, including soup, a main course and drinks. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races and ITRA National League. A personal cup is mandatory at the aid stations. A running cup, T-shirt or socks can be ordered during registration.

name: Jesenická šedesátka
description: Jesenická šedesátka is a hiking and running event along the ridges of the Hrubý Jeseník Mountains, offering beautiful natural surroundings and the chance to test yourself against the clock. The 60 km route is intended for more experienced participants aged 16 and over and includes refreshment stations. The event is a long-standing favourite, with chip timing and results announced at the finish. The organizers emphasize safety and a relaxed atmosphere, and the event is suitable for both runners and hikers.

name: Čertovskej ultratrail
description: Čertovskej Ultraltrail is a trail race across mountains, mines, castles and waters through the mysterious countryside of Kokořínsko and the Máchův kraj region. It offers a main 66.6 km route through beautiful scenery, with well-stocked aid stations, and is suitable for beginner ultrarunners too. The race is part of the Ultracup series and is also the final stage of the 8-day Čertovská výzva 666 km. The atmosphere is family-friendly, and runners will enjoy unforgettable experiences on the picturesque course.

name: Běh Zelenským údolím
location: Přírodní park Zelenov, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic

name: Skřipovská lítačka
description: Skřipovská lítačka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque countryside of fields, meadows, and woods around the village of Skřipov near Opava. The seventh edition of the race will be based at the TJ Sokol Skřipov football pitch. It offers courses for all ages, from the youngest children to adults, along with a varied program of activities including an inflatable maze, face painting, and refreshments. All courses are clearly marked, and volunteers at intersections point runners in the right direction. The event is organized by Běžecký klub Skřipov, z. s.

name: Happy run
description: Happy Run is a charity run held in Studenec near Třebíč in the Vysočina Region. It is open to everyone—athletes and non-athletes, families with children and individuals—who can choose from several routes to suit their abilities. The event supports Viktorka, a boy with serious health complications, and the proceeds from the run go toward his rehabilitation stay. In addition to the run itself, a varied program of activities and an evening party are planned.

name: Běh napříč republikou
location: Česko (867 km po celé republice), Vysočina
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event, now taking place for the fifth year. Participants run together from different parts of the Czech Republic to its geographical center in Čihošť, at a pace suited to recreational runners and comfortable for conversation. The routes are divided into individual sections, with pacers who help maintain the right pace and follow the route. This is not a race, but a shared experience that offers a chance to discover new places and meet other runners.

name: Z Hejnic do Pekla
description: Z Hejnic do Pekla 2026 is the second edition of a running race held in the Liberec Region, starting at the Hejnice Skatepark. The race offers a welcoming atmosphere, refreshments, medical support, and a race packet for every participant. It is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and seniors, who receive special entry fee conditions. The organizers prioritize runners’ comfort, providing changing rooms, showers, and luggage storage.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S01 – Machnín-Výpřež
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique event that is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace. In 2026, it will take place for the fifth time, with four parallel routes heading from different parts of the Czech Republic (including a route from Liberec-Machnín) to the country’s geographical center in Čihošť. The run follows a precise schedule, with pacers on every section to set the pace and guide the route. Participants can choose how many sections they want to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S02 – Výpřež-Rašovka
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event taking place for the fifth time. It brings together four starts from different corners of the Czech Republic, all heading to the country’s geographical center in Čihošť. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each section responsible for the pace and route guidance. Participants can choose any number of sections to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape. The event is suitable for recreational runners and offers a chance to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

The event offers a chance to discover new places, meet like-minded runners and enjoy an unusual sporting experience. The start is at 7:00 and the finish is at 17:00 in Čihošť.

description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in the geographical centre of the country, in Čihošť. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each section. Runners can choose any number of sections and experience the beauty of the Czech countryside, whether in the hills, on flat terrain, along forest trails or on city streets. The run starts at 7:00 from four locations and finishes at 17:00 in Čihošť.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S08 – Podkost-Dolní Bousov
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the geographical center of the country. Runners can choose any number of sections and join the running “trains” from Liberec, Pohoří na Šumavě, Prostějov, and Rokycany. The route crosses varied terrain—hills, flat stretches, forests, and towns—and offers the chance to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

The routes are divided into sections, which participants can choose freely and run as many of as they like. The event offers a chance to discover new places, meet new friends, and enjoy the beauty of the Czech countryside across varied terrain.
