name: Běh napříč republikou, S11 – Ledce-Loučeň
description: Running Across the Republic, S11 - Ledce-Loučeň is a planned running race that will take place in the Ledce and Loučeň area of the Central Bohemian Region. Exact details about the course, distance, or registration are not available in the sources, but the race is part of a broader concept of running or hiking events in the Czech Republic. The race offers runners and hikers an opportunity to discover the region’s beauty and enjoy an active break in nature.

name: Běh na Kohout a zpět
description: Běh na Kohout is a traditional hill race held since 2006 in Besednice, by the swimming pool. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running, and most editions are run on the same course, allowing times to be compared. The start and finish are at the swimming pool in Besednice, which offers excellent facilities. Every year, an accompanying program and a raffle with attractive prizes are prepared. The race will take place, and runners of all categories are welcome.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Ústí nad Labem
description: Barvám Neutečeš in Ústí nad Labem is a colorful run full of joy, friendship, and fun, held in the Severní Terasa district. Participants can choose between a 5 km route with five color zones or a shorter 1.5 km route with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about sharing the experience, enjoying bursts of color, and soaking up a great atmosphere for all ages. Race packages include a T-shirt, colors, a medal, and other accessories that highlight the event’s unique character. Come with family or friends, or on your own, and enjoy a day full of color and fun.

name: Běh na Čerchov
description: The Run to Čerchov is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series, which offers runners a range of routes around the Chodsko region. It is suitable for all running enthusiasts looking to experience a challenging yet beautiful run in nature, with views of Čerchov. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Běh okolo Hostěnic
description: The Run Around Hostěnice is a running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Hostěnice. The 5.83 km course is flat and combines paved and forest paths. The race starts at 17:00 and is suitable for the general public, including children, who have a shorter, age-appropriate course. Organizers David Šálek and Jan Řebíček warmly invite all runners to take part in this traditional event.

name: 5, 10, 21 km trail okolo hory pro každého
description: The Trail Running Cup is a traditional series of trail races with a history dating back to 2011, offering courses of various distances from 5 to 50 kilometers amid the beautiful scenery of the Czech Republic. The races are suitable for all runners, including children, and provide great entertainment for the whole family. The series features a variety of terrain and difficulty levels, so everyone can find a course to suit them. The overall standings are based on points awarded for results in individual races held throughout the season.

name: Běh dobroučským krajem
description: The Běh dobroučským krajem is a traditional running race organized by the ISCAREX Athletics Club in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč in the Pardubice Region. The race offers technically interesting courses with gentle undulations and a number of turns, running along paved paths. The event is open to the general public and welcomes experienced runners, recreational athletes, and families with children. It is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and offers a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for runners and spectators alike.

name: Běháme pro radost - Help4Africa
description: Běháme pro radost is a traditional charity run held in the village of Smidary, celebrating its 10th edition in 2026. The event supports children’s projects in Africa through the organization Help4Africa, founded by Marcel Doubrava. The run combines physical activity with helping children in need, and participants can see the direct impact of their support through photographs from the projects. It is not only a sporting event, but also an opportunity to find joy in helping others.

name: Kounovský kros
description: Kounovský kros is a running race organized by TriClub Dobruška, held in the picturesque surroundings of Kounov near Dobruška in the Hradec Králové Region. The race is part of the Dobruška Cup and offers a sporting experience for the general public, including amateur runners. TriClub Dobruška is known for its long-standing tradition and for actively involving its members and the public in sporting events. The race is suitable for all age groups and levels of running ability.

name: Řepočetův výběh
description: Řepočetův Výběh is a unique sporting and social event in Rokytnice nad Jizerou, held at the natural amphitheatre in Horní Rokytnice. The race offers two routes: 19.1 km with 650 m of elevation gain for Řepáci, and 12 km with 400 m of elevation gain for Dumliky. The event supports the Run for the Memory of the Nation initiative and offers original race bibs, with the option to donate to the non-profit organization Post Bellum. The start is at 14:00, registration opens at 12:00, refreshments are provided after the race, and the venue can only be reached on foot, with parking available within walking distance.

name: Heroes Race
location: Hradec nad Moravicí, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: Banskobystrický maratón
location: Banská Bystrica, Okres Banská Bystrica, Banskobystrický kraj
description: The Banská Bystrica Marathon is the largest recurring sporting event in central Slovakia, offering a magical evening atmosphere and a fast, certified course that delivers a memorable experience. Runners can choose from several events, including the marathon, half marathon, 10K, STEFE 5K and relay. The course is well supported, with refreshment stations and sound systems, ensuring a great experience for all participants. The event is suitable for both active runners and families looking to enjoy exercise and a sporting atmosphere.

name: Poludnica Run
description: Poludnica Run is a mountain race in the Low Tatras, with a 23 km course and 1,600 metres of elevation gain. The route runs mostly along marked hiking trails, through beautiful south-facing forest singletracks, a rock city and the summit of Poludnica, with panoramic views of the Liptov region and the Tatras. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League and the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia, and also serves as a qualifying race for the Skyrunning World Championships. The atmosphere is friendly, and the course is among the toughest in Slovakia in its category. The 2026 event will be the final edition.

name: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou
location: Vyšná Myšľa okr. Košice okolie, Vyšná Myšľa okr. Košice okolie, futbalové ihrisko
description: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou is a running event organized by the Vyšná Myšľa Running Club and the municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The races take place at the football field in Vyšná Myšľa and offer categories for men, women, and children across different age groups. The event also includes a two-person relay of 2 x 3 km. The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including club members and residents of the municipality, who receive discounts on the entry fee.

name: Trail Run
location: Družstevná pri Hornáde, Družstevná pri Hornáde, Okružná ulica pri multifunkčnom ihrisku
description: Trail Run in Družstevná pri Hornáde is a running event featuring a route with a natural character and varied terrain. Participants can choose between 8 km and 15 km loops that follow asphalt, concrete, forest, and field roads, with elevation gain of up to 309 metres. The event also includes children’s categories with various route distances, making it suitable for runners of a wide range of ages. The start and finish are located by the multifunctional sports court on Okružná Street in Družstevná pri Hornáde.

name: Starostovská desiatka
location: Hôrka okr. Poprad, Hôrka okr. Poprad, futbalové ihrisko Kišovce
description: Starostovská desiatka is a running race held in the village of Hôrka, Poprad District, at the Kišovce football pitch. The race offers a 10 km course with age- and gender-based categories, as well as a 5 km hobby category and races for children and pupils. The main categories start at 16:30, and the children’s categories begin at 13:00. The organizers are the Hôrka Municipal Office and TJ Baník Hôrka, who welcome runners of all ages and abilities.

name: Beh pre dobrú vec
description: Run for a Good Cause is a running event in the village of Pača, offering a 4.4 km course. The race is open to a broad age range, from younger to older runners, with categories for men and women. This community run combines sport with a good cause, and participants can compete in various age groups. The event is part of the pretekaj.sk platform and offers simple online registration.

name: Beh na vrchol Minčola
location: Lipany okr. Sabinov, Lipany okr. Sabinov, Lúčka-nad obecným úradom
organizer: Turisti a priaznivci behu na Minčol v spolupráci s Mestom Lipany
description: The Run to the Summit of Minčol is a traditional running race in Lipany, offering a challenging 7,300-meter course with 649 meters of elevation gain. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from the youngest children to seniors, and also includes a competition in the 2025 Eastern Slovak Hill Running League. It is organized by Tourists and Running Enthusiasts of Minčol in cooperation with the City of Lipany. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys hill running and wants to test their strength in a beautiful natural setting.

name: Single-Trail run 30
location: Ruská Nová Ves, Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom (/budova obecného úradu)
description: Single-Trail Run 30 is a running race in Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom, offering three distances: 25 km, 15 km, and 7 km. The race is open to men and women with no age restrictions and is organized by O.z. Single-Trail Run 30. Registration is available online and on site, and the event offers the chance to experience a challenging trail run in nature. The organizers provide contact information for anyone seeking further details.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with about 70 meters of elevation gain
Course runs through the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single- and double-track trails and gravel; the same loop is run day and night
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. A minimum of 7 loops (46.9 km) is required to earn a medal. Runners receive warnings 3, 2, and 1 minute before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. There are no showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents, but are not the organizer's responsibility. The event has a tent base and aid stations, but there are restrictions on support along the course.

name: Vilnius 5000 2027
location: Vilnius Vingio parko stadionas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Vilnius 5000 is a unique 5,000-metre race held at Vilnius Vingis Park Stadium. Participants have the opportunity to compete alongside the fastest runners from Lithuania and abroad, enjoy live DJ music and a festive atmosphere. The event offers various races, including individual 5,000 m runs, a 5x1000 m relay and a 2x400 m father-and-child relay. It is a great opportunity to improve your personal best and experience unforgettable support and community spirit.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Vilnius Vingis Park Athletics Stadium
5,000 m run, 5x1000 m mixed relay and 2x400 m father-and-child relay
Live DJ music and a festive atmosphere, with a food truck after the finish
additional: Participants are grouped according to their personal bests or predicted finish times. Elite-group participants must wear World Athletics-approved track running shoes and have a certificate of completion for an anti-doping course. The 5x1000 m relay teams are mixed, and there are no age restrictions for the 2x400 m father-and-child relay. A food truck will be available during the event, and participants agree that their results and photo/video material may be published publicly. The event takes place at Vilnius Vingis Stadium, participant registration takes place on the day of the event, and both professional and amateur runners may take part.

name: Olimpinės dienos bėgimo renginiai
description: The Olympic Day running events in Kaunas invite city residents and visitors to take part in a range of free sports activities. The event offers several running distances: a 500-metre children’s run, a 1,988-metre Lithuanian Olympic Mile, and 5- and 10-kilometre races. In addition to running, participants can try an extreme obstacle run, orienteering, and a 3×3 basketball tournament. The event aims to bring communities together and promote an active lifestyle, while also offering the chance to meet professional athletes and Olympians.
course_highlights: 500-metre children’s run
1,988-metre Lithuanian Olympic Mile
5- and 10-kilometre races
additional: More than 15,000 prizes will be handed out to participants. Visitors can also take part in educational and Olympic education events and games, and meet Olympians. The event is free and focused on mass participation and bringing communities together. More than 100 activities, runs, tournaments, educational events, a concert, and a film screening.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
location: Aleja Tysiącletnich Dębów, Rezerwat Pustelnik, Kazimierz Biskupi, Polska
description: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami to wyjątkowe wydarzenie sportowe odbywające się w malowniczym Kazimierzu Biskupim, w sercu Puszczy Bieniszewskiej. Bieg łączy sport, historię i piękno lokalnej przyrody, prowadząc uczestników przez aleję tysiącletnich dębów w Rezerwacie Pustelnik. Impreza jest otwarta zarówno dla doświadczonych biegaczy, jak i amatorów oraz rodzin, oferując biegi na różnych dystansach oraz marsz Nordic Walking. Organizatorami są Stowarzyszenie Aktywny Kazimierz Biskupi oraz Gmina Kazimierz Biskupi, a tradycja biegu sięga początku XXI wieku.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi przez malowniczą aleję tysiącletnich dębów w Rezerwacie Pustelnik
Bieg odbywa się w sercu Puszczy Bieniszewskiej, oferując kontakt z naturą
Dostępne są trasy biegowe na 10 km i 5 km oraz marsz Nordic Walking na 5 km
additional: Start biegu głównego na 10 km o godzinie 13:00, start biegu towarzyszącego na 5 km oraz marszu Nordic Walking na 5 km o 13:10. Limit czasu na ukończenie biegu to 14:40. Po biegu ceremonia dekoracji zwycięzców i zakończenie imprezy o 14:45.

name: Bieg Śladem Konia
description: Bieg Śladem Konia to coroczny bieg organizowany przez WKB Piast Wrocław, odbywający się w malowniczych terenach Wrocławia. Trasa biegu prowadzi przez różnorodne ścieżki i tereny zielone, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe doświadczenie biegowe. Impreza ma charakter amatorski i jest częścią kalendarza biegów klubowych, promując aktywność fizyczną i integrację biegaczy. Bieg jest dobrze znany lokalnej społeczności i ma długą tradycję.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi przez tereny zielone Wrocławia
Różnorodne nawierzchnie - ścieżki leśne i miejskie
Malownicze widoki i naturalne otoczenie
additional: Organizatorem jest WKB Piast Wrocław. Wyniki z poprzednich lat dostępne są na stronie. Brak szczegółowych informacji o opłatach startowych i godzinie startu na stronie głównej i regulaminach archiwalnych.

name: I Bieg po Jagodę Kamczacką
location: PLANTIN Haskap Berry Plantation, Muniakowice, Polska
description: I Bieg po Jagodę Kamczacką to wyjątkowe wydarzenie sportowe, które łączy pasję do biegania z ideą zdrowego stylu życia i bliskości z naturą. Zawody odbywają się na plantacji jagody kamczackiej firmy PLANTIN w Muniakowicach koło Krakowa, gdzie start, meta i baza zawodów znajdują się w sercu plantacji. Bieg jest częścią Sztafety Jagodowej i promuje świadome wybory żywieniowe oraz lokalne produkty. To nie tylko rywalizacja, ale także spotkanie ludzi ceniących ruch na świeżym powietrzu i autentyczne doświadczenia.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Warszawa
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Warsaw to prestiżowy triathlon rozgrywany w sercu polskiej stolicy, łączący pływanie, jazdę na rowerze i bieg na dystansie połówki Ironmana. Zawody startują nad Zalewem Zegrzyńskim, a trasa rowerowa prowadzi przez malownicze gminy i ulice Warszawy, kończąc się biegiem w Multimedialnym Parku Fontann. To wyjątkowe wydarzenie sportowe przyciąga zawodników z całego świata, oferując nie tylko sportowe wyzwanie, ale także możliwość poznania kulturalnego i historycznego bogactwa Warszawy.
course_highlights: Pływanie 1,9 km w Jeziorze Zegrzyńskim z limitem 1 godziny 10 minut
Trasa rowerowa 90 km przez gminy Nieporęt, Marki, Radzymin oraz ulice Warszawy
Bieg 21,1 km w trzech pętlach ulicami historycznego centrum Warszawy z metą w Multimedialnym Parku Fontann
additional: Zawody oferują usługi takie jak wypożyczalnia rowerów, bike transfer, bike build & pack, grawerowanie medalu, finisher foto oraz camper park. Trasa jest w pełni zabezpieczona i wygrodzona, z zamknięciem ulic i kontrolą ruchu. W trakcie zawodów działa infolinia dla kierowców pod numerem 500 261 000. Start odbywa się nad Zalewem Zegrzyńskim, meta w Multimedialnym Parku Fontann. Limit czasu ukończenia całego wyścigu to 8 godzin 30 minut.

name: Pogórzański Festiwal Biegowy - Lato
description: Pogórzański Festiwal Biegowy - Lato to coroczne wydarzenie sportowe odbywające się w Burzynie koło Tuchowa, promujące bieganie i zdrowy styl życia wśród mieszkańców Małopolski. Impreza obejmuje biegi na różnych dystansach, w tym bieg górski na 22 km z przewyższeniem 800 m, bieg na 10 km, bieg na 5,5 km oraz Nordic Walking na 5,5 km. Start i meta znajdują się na stadionie LKS Burzyn przy Szkole Podstawowej w Burzynie, a uczestnicy otrzymują pakiet startowy z upominkiem i przekąskami. Wydarzenie odbywa się pod honorowym patronatem Burmistrza Gminy Tuchów i jest organizowane przez LKS Burzyn oraz Kępa Sport.
course_highlights: Bieg górski na 22 km z sumą przewyższeń 800 m
4 punkty żywnościowe na trasie biegu 22 km
Start i meta na stadionie LKS Burzyn przy Szkole Podstawowej w Burzynie
additional: W dniu zawodów dostępnych jest 30 dodatkowych pakietów startowych. Biegi dzieci rozpoczynają się od 9:30 na stadionie co 5 minut. Rozdanie nagród planowane jest około godziny 13:30 - 14:00. Biuro zawodów, depozyt, szatnie i prysznice znajdują się w hali Szkoły Podstawowej w Burzynie obok stadionu.

name: VI EKO Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie
description: VI Eko Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana w Jerzmanowicach-Przeginiach, która promuje zdrowy styl życia i aktywność fizyczną. Zawody odbywają się w malowniczej okolicy, a uczestnicy mogą rywalizować na trasach dostosowanych do różnych poziomów zaawansowania. Organizatorzy zapewniają bezpieczne i oficjalne zapisy oraz możliwość odkupienia pakietów startowych. Impreza ma charakter ekologiczny i integracyjny, zachęcając do regularnych treningów od momentu rejestracji do dnia zawodów.
course_highlights: Trasa przebiega przez teren gminy Jerzmanowice-Przeginia
Malownicze krajobrazy i naturalne otoczenie
Treningi liczą się od momentu rejestracji do dnia zawodów
additional: Pakiety startowe można odkupować lub wystawiać na giełdzie pakietów oficjalnie i bezpiecznie. Biuro zawodów mieści się w Chochołowym Dworze, ul. Jana III Sobieskiego 172, czynne w godzinach 8:00-9:15.

name: X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
location: Boisko przy ul. Leśnej, Wdzydze Kiszewskie, Polska
description: Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Aktywności Fizycznej we Wdzydzach to jubileuszowa, dziesiąta edycja wydarzenia promującego bieganie i aktywność fizyczną w malowniczych terenach Kaszub. Impreza odbywa się w dniach 5-7 czerwca i obejmuje pięć głównych biegów tworzących cykl Hard Runner, w tym dystanse od 1,6 km do półmaratonu. Uczestnicy rywalizują o klasyfikację generalną na podstawie sumy punktów zdobytych we wszystkich biegach. Festiwal integruje środowisko biegowe Polski Północnej, promując jednocześnie lokalną kulturę i przyrodę.
course_highlights: Trasy o długościach 1,6 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km oraz półmaraton (21 km)
Malownicze tereny Kaszub i lasy Nadleśnictwa Kościerzyna
Trasy dostępne do obejrzenia na platformie Traseo
additional: Numer startowy z chipem do pomiaru czasu (zwrotny). Biuro zawodów czynne w dniach trwania festiwalu. Klasyfikacja generalna oparta na sumie punktów z pięciu biegów. Wyróżnienie dla najlepszych zawodników z Gminy Kościerzyna.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
location: Opalenie, Gmina Gniew, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Polska
description: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZRADE im. Barbary Karaczyńskiej to kameralne wydarzenie biegowe organizowane w Opaleniu, które odbywa się przy okazji rocznicy powstania Centrum Leczenia Uzależnień "Zapowiednik". Trasa maratonu jest w całości asfaltowa, prowadzi przez malownicze pola i lasy Kociewia, posiada atest Polskiego Związku Lekkiej Atletyki i charakteryzuje się licznymi, dość stromymi podbiegami oraz łączną sumą przewyższeń 646 m. Bieg jest wymagający ze względu na ukształtowanie terenu i warunki termiczne, ale oferuje piękne widoki i niezapomnianą atmosferę. Po biegu uczestnicy mogą liczyć na posiłek regeneracyjny, a wszyscy otrzymują pamiątkowy medal, dyplom oraz koszulkę.
course_highlights: Trasa w całości asfaltowa przez pola i lasy Kociewia
Łączna suma przewyższeń 646 m z licznymi stromymi podbiegami
Trasa oznaczona co 1 km i punkty odżywiania co 5 km oraz lotne punkty odżywiania
additional: Po biegu serwowany jest posiłek regeneracyjny. Trasa "Olka" 10 km jest utwardzona i częściowo pokrywa się z trasą półmaratonu. Wpisowe przekazywane jest w całości na Fundację DASZRADE wspierającą osoby wychodzące z uzależnienia.

name: XV Bieg Pszczyński
description: XV Carbo Asecura Bieg Pszczyński to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana od 2012 roku w Pszczynie. Główny bieg odbywa się na znanej i lubianej trasie o długości 10 km, a w ramach wydarzenia organizowane są także biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży. Trasa biegu głównego nie posiada atestu PZLA, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na sprawdzony i atrakcyjny przebieg. Impreza przyciąga biegaczy z różnych grup wiekowych, oferując sportową rywalizację i dobrą atmosferę.
course_highlights: Trasa głównego biegu o długości 10 km
Dwa punkty nawadniania na trasie (około 4 km i 7,8 km)
Biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży w ramach wydarzenia
additional: Biuro zawodów znajduje się w hali MORiS w Pszczynie przy ul. Basztowej 4. Odbiór pakietów startowych odbywa się w sobotę i niedzielę, z wykorzystaniem kodu QR. Na trasie biegu głównego znajdują się dwa punkty nawadniania serwujące wodę w plastikowych kubeczkach. Start biegu głównego z Rynku o godzinie 09:30. Parkingi płatne i bezpłatne dostępne w pobliżu miejsca startu. Po biegu pomiar czasu brutto realizowany jest za pomocą czipu w numerze startowym.

name: 10 Bieg po Gminie Świerczów
location: Dąbrowa, Świerczów Municipality, Opole Voivodeship, Polska

name: III Bieg Charytatywny Dookoła Jeziora Cz...
IV Bieg Charytatywny Nagronik
location: Stryszawa, Sucha County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Polska

name: XXX Bieg Łagowskiego Lata
location: Łagów, Świebodzin County, Lubusz Voivodeship, Polska

name: 17. Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon
description: The 17th Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon offers a unique running weekend with an exhilarating atmosphere in the heart of Salzkotten. The routes pass through the town and the district of Verne, are officially measured, and offer a top-level sporting experience. In the shade of the Salzkotten saltworks, runners can enjoy a first-class refreshment area and a relaxed chill-out area. All event proceeds go directly to youth programs run by local clubs, supporting sport in the region.
course_highlights: Attractive loop course of approximately 10.55 km through Salzkotten and Verne
Marathon and half-marathon courses officially measured and compliant with IWR/DLO rules
Loop course with around 25 metres of elevation gain; flat 10 km course ideal for personal bests
additional: Start times vary by distance: the marathon and half marathon start at 08:30, the 10 km race at 10:30, the 5 km race at 11:30, and the Bambini races from 15:30, with different start times for each age group. The courses are officially measured and comply with international competition rules. On event day, roads through the town and side streets will be closed from approximately 06:30 to 16:00. A supervised bicycle parking area is available at the Sälzerhalle car park in exchange for a voluntary donation. The NUNAV app is recommended for a stress-free journey and parking search. The marathon places particular emphasis on community and team spirit, with company teams able to take part in the team competition. The event also offers parking, pacemaker teams, and a family program.

name: Harzgeröder Klippenlauf
description: The Harzgeröder Klippenlauf is a varied popular and cross-country race in the Lower Harz, suitable for runners of all ability levels. Distances range from 1 km for children to a challenging half marathon of 21.1 km with 450 metres of elevation gain. The routes run through the Selke Valley along the Selketalstieg, past the districts of Mägdesprung and Alexisbad, with rocky sections, narrow trail paths and a rock tunnel. Alongside the sporting challenge, the Klippenlauf offers fun for the whole family, including a raffle and other events. The start and finish are at the dog training ground in Harzgerode.
course_highlights: Rocky sections and challenging climbs
Narrow trail paths along the Selketalstieg
Rock tunnel on the 15 km and half-marathon courses
additional: The start and finish are at the dog training ground in Harzgerode, where the race office and race-number distribution are located. Safety pins may not be used to attach race numbers; race belts are available for 5 EUR. Separate starts are held for the taster run (1 km), schoolchildren’s race (2.5 km), everyone’s race (5 km), main race (15 km) and half marathon (21.1 km). A raffle offers great prizes for participants. The event is one of the region’s major running and sporting events. Participants can pre-order a running shirt, registration is available online, and running with dogs is prohibited. The event is limited to 600 participants.

name: Deichlauf
organizer: TSV Winsen (Luhe) von 1850 e.V. und SV Greven
description: The Deichlauf in Hohnstorf/Elbe offers a varied running program, with races for children and teenagers, an Olympic school relay, and 5 km and 10 km races. The event is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The scenic route follows the dike and offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, family atmosphere. Special and team categories add to the excitement of the competition.
course_highlights: Running routes along the Elbe dike
A variety of distances from 1000 m to 10 km
An Olympic school relay as a special highlight
additional: Showers are not available. Medical staff are on hand at the finish and along the route. Photos and videos will be taken by an appointed service provider and may be published. The event is a community gathering with a particular focus on families and nature lovers.

name: Europamarathon 2026
description: The Europamarathon Görlitz-Zgorzelec is a cross-border race through the European twin city of Görlitz and Zgorzelec, held annually since 2004. The event offers a range of distances, from the marathon, half marathon and relay to 10 km and 5.6 km races, as well as children’s and youth races. The course passes through historic neighborhoods and crosses the Neisse, connecting two countries. It welcomes runners of all abilities, as well as families and corporate teams. The atmosphere is shaped by numerous spectators and lively support along the course.
course_highlights: Cross-border loop through Görlitz and Zgorzelec with a hilly profile
Crossing the Neisse on the historic Old Town Bridge, the loudest section of the course
The route passes historic façades and winds through the European twin city
additional: The marathon consists of 4 laps and the half marathon of 2 laps. Relay races and walking distances are also available. The children’s and youth course is 1.5 km (2 laps). The start and finish are in Görlitz city center. The event is organized by a club with the help of many volunteers. In addition to the marathon and half marathon, there are 5 km and 10 km races, a children’s and youth race, and a 400 m Landskron soda dash.

name: Lingener Citylauf
description: The Lingener City Run is a long-standing event held each year on and around Lingener Market Square. For the 35th time, the city centre will become a sporting stage full of energy and community spirit. The event offers various distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 10-kilometre relay with up to 100 teams. The course runs through the city centre and is part of the EL Cup. The event is a highlight for runners and spectators from the region and beyond.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Lingener Market Square
Route through the city centre of Lingen
Part of the EL Cup, with 5 km and 10 km runs
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the start for a fee of €3.00. Bib number distribution begins at 10:00 on race day. Changing facilities and restrooms are available in the Bäumerstraße gym, about 500 m from the market square. Timing is recorded using transponders attached to the bib numbers, which must be handed in after the race. Parking is available, among other places, in the Marktplatz underground car park and at the Alter Pferdemarkt car park. Due to road closures, access to parking in the city centre will be restricted on the event day. Start and finish on Lingener Market Square, parking in the city centre, changing facilities at the Bäumerstraße gym, no timing for the children's race

name: Mainauenlauf 2026
description: The scenic, challenging undulating course runs through green parks with wonderful panoramas over the city. Various distances are offered, including 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races. A special highlight is the atmospheric finish in the Finisher Park, with excellent refreshments and a unique finisher medal. City championships will also be held for the first time across all distances.
course_highlights: Challenging, undulating 5 km loop with 85 metres of elevation gain per lap
Highest point on the course: Col Bellota
Finish in the Mainauenlauf Finisher Park, with refreshments and a medal
additional: Showers are available at the Ost School Centre until 15:00. There is a photo booth in the start/finish area. Bags can be dropped off in the Finisher Park and collected by 15:00. Group warm-up run on Saturday at 18:30 in the Finisher Park. Refreshment stations at km 2, 3, 6 and 7 with water, isotonic drinks, pastries and fruit. Toilets are available near the finish area and at the Ost Sports Centre. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, relays, Nordic walking, children’s and youth races; start on the grounds of the State Garden Show; refreshments at several points; finish in the Finisher Park

name: Neustädter Stadtlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: 14. Stadtlauf des TSV Neustadt
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 14th TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge City Run is an accessible fun run that fosters community and social connection. The event promotes inclusion and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. Held in the city of Neustadt am Rübenberge, it offers a sporting opportunity for young and old to be active together.
course_highlights: Accessible run promoting inclusive participation
Community spirit and social connection
Event in Neustadt am Rübenberge

name: 21. ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf
description: The ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf in Potsdam is a unique running event that combines tradition, culture, and sporting challenge. The course passes through the historic palaces, gardens, and landmarks of the state capital of Brandenburg, offering runners an unforgettable experience in a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With more than 4,500 participants, the race is a popular event for runners of all abilities. Experience the special atmosphere and the diverse sights along the route through the city’s history.

name: 45. Wehlheider Volkslauf
description: The Wehlheider Volkslauf is a traditional recreational running event in Schönfeld Park in Kassel-Wehlheiden and is part of the Nordhessencup. The course runs mainly along paved paths and through wooded areas, with various distances for all age groups. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. Changing and shower facilities are available, and runners are provided with refreshments along the course.

name: Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf
organizer: Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. und Freunde des Vogelberglaufes
description: The Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf is a traditional race held in Bleicherode. The event offers four distances (2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 20 km) on road and trail courses, starting at the former Schneckenhengst youth hostel building. The race is organized by Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. and Freunde des Vogelberglaufes. Results are scored according to the age-group system of the German Athletics Association, with specific age restrictions for younger participants. Trophies and certificates are awarded to the top runners in various categories.

name: Norderstedter Stadtlauf
description: The Norderstedt City Run is a popular running event held annually by Norderstedter Sportverein e.V. Runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in various races, including the 5-kilometer race, 10-kilometer race, fun run and children’s run. The event offers a sporting atmosphere on closed, traffic-free routes and is supported by the police, the THW and volunteers. The run promotes community, fun and health and is a highlight of the regional sports calendar.

name: Altöttinger Intersp. Siebzehnrübl Dultlauf mit Staffeln
description: The Altöttinger Siebzehnrübl Dultlauf is a traditional running event in Altötting, offering various distances for all age groups. The races take place on a road circuit and include both individual and relay events. The event is family-friendly and has a warm atmosphere, with every participant receiving a Dult pretzel. The awards ceremony takes place at the Dult after the races.
course_highlights: Road circuit
4 x 2.5 km relay
Family-friendly distances from 500 m to 10 km
additional: Race bibs can be picked up from 7:45 a.m. at the stadium and must be collected no later than 60 minutes before the start. Late entries are accepted at the event venue up to 1 hour before the start for an additional fee of €5. Results will be published online.

name: Everstener Brunnenlauf 2026
description: The Everstener Brunnenlauf is a long-standing running event in Oldenburg. Various races are offered, including races for schoolchildren, a 6.3 km corporate and taster run, and a 10 km fun run. The route passes through the Eversten district, starting on Wienstraße and finishing in Eversten Holz. The event is known for its large number of participants and family-friendly atmosphere, appealing to both recreational and competitive runners.

name: FLVW Halbmarathonmeisterschaften
description: The FLVW Half Marathon Championships will take place on June 6, 2027, in Salzkotten and are organized by the Westphalian Football and Athletics Association (FLVW). The event is for runners who wish to qualify for the Westphalian Half Marathon Championships. The championships offer a sporting challenge on a half marathon course and promote regional running. Interested participants are encouraged to register promptly to take part in this long-standing competition.

name: Haster Volkslauf
description: The Haster Volkslauf 2026 takes place on June 7 in Osnabrück-Haste and offers races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini races, an inclusive fun run, and short- and long-distance races. The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Haste and is recognized as an officially sanctioned race by the German Athletics Association. Participants receive medals and trophies, with the awards ceremony held immediately afterward at the sports field. The entry fee also supports a fundraising campaign for “Jede Oma zählt.”

name: Hopfengarten-Pokallauf - Landescup 9
description: The Hopfengarten Cup Race is part of the Novo Nordisk State Cup Saxony-Anhalt and takes place in Magdeburg. The event is organized by the Saxony-Anhalt Athletics Association (Leichtathletik-Verband Sachsen-Anhalt e.V.) and is open to runners of all age groups. The State Cup provides a sporting platform for ambitious runners and promotes running in the region. Runners must register through the LADV registration portal, and the association’s age-group and course recommendations apply.

name: Lauf um die Himmelsschaukel Bründersen 2026
description: The Run around the Sky Swing in Bründersen is a traditional scoring race in the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup. Various distances are offered, from 400 meters to 20 kilometers, suitable for all age groups, from Bambini to seniors. The event takes place at the Bründersen sports field and offers a varied course through the beautiful surrounding area. The race is part of TSV Bründersen 1967 e.V. and combines sporting competition with community and regional ties.

name: Pfreimdtaltrail 2026
description: The Pfreimdtal Trail is a trail half marathon around Trausnitz. The course covers approximately 21 kilometers with about 450 meters of elevation gain and offers varied landscapes along the Pfreimd, including steep climbs, downhill sections, and scenic stretches on the Goldsteig. The event is registered as a UTMB Index Race and is open to runners aged 16 and over. Alongside the athletic challenge, the race offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, an awards ceremony, and food and drink provided by TSV Trausnitz.

name: ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau
description: The ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau is being held for the 36th time and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 400 m Bambini run. The courses are officially measured and suitable for record attempts, with the start and finish at the TSV Ratekau sports field. There are suitable races for all ability levels, including a schoolchildren’s cup that runs throughout the calendar year. The event places great emphasis on safety, with road closures, and provides refreshments along the course and in the finish area.

name: Mnichovohradištská patnáctka, memoriál ing. Josefa Hrona
description: The Mnichovohradištská Fifteen is a road race with a gently undulating out-and-back course measuring 15 km. It takes place in Mnichovo Hradiště, on T. G. Masaryk Square. The course is well paved and has marked kilometres, helping runners pace themselves. The race is held in memory of Ing. Josef Hron and offers a pleasant atmosphere for all runners. The start is at 10:00, and the organiser is Vladimír Koudelka. The race is suitable for runners looking for a quality road run with a long tradition.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all age groups. Each participant competes primarily against themselves, creating a friendly and motivating atmosphere. The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, adding to the enjoyment of the run. It is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to test their speed over a short distance.

name: Běh přes Červený vrch
description: The Run over Červený vrch is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub ISCAREX in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Čermná in the Pardubice Region. The race features a technically interesting course with gentle undulations and numerous turns, suitable for a wide range of runners, from recreational athletes to experienced competitors. The event is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and provides high-quality facilities for both competitors and spectators. You can register online or on the day of the race.

name: Babický trail 1/4 maraton 2026
location: Sportovní areál Babice, Topolová 500, Babice, Czech Republic

description: The Babice Trail 1/4 Marathon is a traditional running race held in the scenic Babice forest. It offers two main routes of 10.55 km and 5.95 km, with elevation gains of 160 m and 60 m. The event is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who have shorter races. The route runs mainly along forest roads and trails, offering an enjoyable experience in nature. The main race is limited to 200 participants, creating an intimate atmosphere. The organizers emphasize fairness and safety, including adapted routes for children’s categories.
course_highlights: Main race route: 10.55 km with 160 m of elevation gain
Predominantly forest roads and trails (94% of the surface)
Specially adapted routes for children’s races (300 m, 1,000 m, 1,500 m)
additional: Registration and race-number pickup take place from 08:30 to 09:45. Children’s races start from 09:45 to 10:01, and the main race starts at 11:00, with the 1/4 and 1/8 marathons starting together. Parking is available at the sports complex and in the surrounding streets; participants are asked to be considerate of local residents. Online registration is also available on the morning of race day, but a 100% surcharge applies once race check-in has begun. The routes have been adjusted because of logging in the forest; this year, a route similar to the 2024 course returns. The race route consists of 38–51% forest roads, 43–56% forest trails, and 6% paved road. Start and event facilities: Sportovní areál Babice, Topolová 500. Entry fees are 400 Kč for the main races and 50–150 Kč for children’s races; a package for one parent and one child costs 490 Kč.

name: Skalecký kros
description: Skalecký Cross-Country Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Baroque grounds of Skalka in Mníšek pod Brdy. It offers 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races, running along forest paths and paved roads. The main race starts at 11:30 and is suitable for the general public, including children and teenagers. The event is organized by SK Mníšecko, z.s., which ensures high-quality organization and a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Červenkovská desítka
description: Červenkovská Desítka is a 10 km road race held in Červenka near Olomouc. The race is part of the 2026 Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. The course is an out-and-back route from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renoty and back, mostly on roads. Runners are divided into age categories, with prizes awarded to the winners in each category. The results ceremony will take place at the race venue, Hostinec u Nádraží, and the results will be published on hanackybeh.cz.

name: Milada Run
description: Milada Run is a popular sporting event held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Milada. The event offers various routes, including a half marathon, 10 km race, and children’s races, which follow undulating and flat paths with views of the lake. The atmosphere is family-friendly and welcoming, making it suitable for all ages and running abilities. All races are part of the Milada Tour series, which runners themselves praise for its high standards and popularity.

name: Konopišťská desítka
description: The Konopiště 10K is a traditional 10 km running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Konopiště natural amphitheatre and park near Benešov. The race is part of the Benešov Running Festival and offers the chance to compete in the main race, relays, and children’s categories. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a run in picturesque natural surroundings with high-quality organization. The 30th anniversary edition will take place.

name: Bolfánek třikrát jinak
description: Bolfánek Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities in Chudenice, in the Plzeň Region. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and offers an unusual format in which runners tackle the course in three different ways. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own age categories. The organizers emphasize a sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Mnichovická běhna
description: The Mnichovická běhna is an amateur running race through the beautiful Central Bohemian countryside, featuring a challenging course approximately 7–8 km long with around 200 meters of elevation gain. The varied terrain includes steep climbs and descents, running on paved paths, through forest, meadow, and pasture, accompanied by domestic and forest animals. The start and finish have been newly located at the Podhorky playing field by the Šibeniční vrch sports complex. All runners receive a commemorative medal and certificate; category winners receive trophies and a small surprise. The Mnichovická běhna is part of the Ladův kraj Cup running race series, and everyone who finishes the race healthy and alive is a winner.

name: Bathory Run
location: Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), futbalové ihrisko
organizer: Obec Sedliska a MV Running team Sedliska
description: Bathory Run is a running event in the village of Sedliska near Vranov nad Topľou, offering courses for children, juniors and adults. Runners follow a varied route through an orchard, giving the race a pleasant natural character. The children’s categories start at 10:30, while the men’s and women’s races start at 13:00. The event is organized by the Municipality of Sedliska and MV Running team Sedliska, who ensure a high-quality race experience for all age groups.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Charity Run
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, námestie pod OD Billa
organizer: Mesto Trebišov, Stredná odborná škola služieb a priemyslu sv. Jozafáta
description: The Charity Run in Trebišov is a traditional event that brings together running, walking, Nordic walking and cycling. This charity run offers an opportunity to discover the city of Trebišov while supporting a good cause. The event is organised by Majcher-Production s.r.o. and is suitable for the general public who want to spend time actively and contribute to charity.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 4. kolo
description: The Šamorín Running League (ŠBL) is a series of races organized by 3klub Šamorín, open to the general public with no age or performance limits. Runners compete in the men’s, women’s, boys’ and girls’ categories, with shorter distances for children’s races. The league runs throughout the year and includes the traditional Pomlé Run. The entry fee covers race bibs, timekeeping, refreshments and league scoring. The overall league standings are officially announced and the top runners are awarded in the final round.

name: Šebešská pätnástka
location: Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, futbalové ihrisko Vyšná Šebastová
description: Šebešská Pätnástka is a running race organized by the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club in cooperation with the Vyšná Šebastová municipal office and sports associations. The main course is 15.5 km long and includes a climb to Nevická chata, complemented by a recreational 3 km course and children’s events for various age groups. The race takes place every year on the Sunday of the first weekend in June, with a morning start and a rich cultural and social program that attracts hundreds of visitors. The event is part of several running competitions and a league, and the organizers emphasize promoting sport and building the village’s reputation. Šebešská Pätnástka received the Running Diamond award in 2011 and 2012.

name: Bėgimas Tėvo dienos proga 2026
description: The Father’s Day run in Tauragė is a festive event inviting all running enthusiasts to take part with family and friends. It is a great opportunity to celebrate Father’s Day actively and have fun as part of the city festival. The event takes place during Tauragė City Festival, offering a chance to experience community spirit and sporting enthusiasm.
course_highlights: A festive run during Tauragė City Festival
A friendly atmosphere for families and friends
A chance to celebrate Father’s Day actively
additional: The event is part of Tauragė City Festival, takes place outdoors, and encourages active leisure and family participation.

name: 5000 m bėgimo varžybos „Vilnius 5000“.
description: Vilnius 5000 is a unique 5,000-meter running event held at the athletics stadium in Vilnius’s Vingis Park. The event offers not only individual 5,000 m races, but also relay races—a mixed 5x1000 m relay and a 2x400 m parent-and-child relay. Participants can enjoy live DJ music, a festive atmosphere, and support to help them achieve their best results. The competition is open to both professionals and recreational runners, and the organizers aim to promote athletics in Lithuania and encourage a sporting community.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at the athletics stadium in Vilnius’s Vingis Park
5,000 m race, 5x1000 m mixed relay, and 2x400 m parent-and-child relay
Live DJ music and a festive atmosphere, with a food truck after the finish
additional: Participants are divided into groups according to their personal bests or predicted finish times. Elite-group participants must wear running shoes approved by World Athletics for track use and have a certificate of completion for an anti-doping course. The 5x1000 m relay teams are mixed, and there are no age restrictions for the 2x400 m parent-and-child relay. A food truck awaits participants after the finish. The winners and runners-up are awarded sponsor prizes and cash prizes for outstanding results. The competition will take place on June 13, 2027, with various categories on offer, including elite and recreational runners, and detailed schedule information. The event promotes sport and family participation.

name: 37. Campuslauf Technische Universität Clausthal
description: The 37th Campus Run at Clausthal University of Technology is taking place, offering runners a sporting challenge on campus. The event includes several race distances, including one lap, three laps, and a children’s run. The run is a popular university sports event that welcomes students, staff, and guests alike. There is also a Campus Open Air, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Mladé BĚKODO
location: Doubravka, Teplice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Mladé Běkodo is a series of running races for children and young people aged 2 to 15, held around Doubravka in Teplice. The races offer distances from 200 to 1,650 metres and are divided into age categories. Each race is followed by an awards ceremony for individual and team results. BK Běkodo is part of TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and has a long tradition dating back to 2001.

name: Běh Advenťáka BRNO
description: Běh Advenťáka Brno 2026 is a charity race held on June 9 by the Medlánky Pond in Brno. The race offers a 6.45 km course on paved paths, suitable for runners of all levels, with trail shoes recommended. The event also includes children’s categories with shorter courses. Participants’ entry fees support people who face challenges in life, and runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere, sports prizes, and other benefits.

name: Pivní míle Heřmanův Městec
description: The Beer Mile in Heřmanův Městec is an original race on the Bažantnice athletics track, where runners complete four laps of 400 metres with beer breaks. This unconventional sporting experience combines running and fun in a friendly atmosphere. This year marks the 10th edition of this popular event, which is part of the Heřmanův Městec running club.

name: Otevřený přebor SABZO v přespolním běhu
description: The SABZO Open Cross-Country Championship is a traditional running race organized by the SABZO Running Club in Prague. The race gives amateur runners the chance to test their strength in cross-country running in a pleasant sporting atmosphere. The SABZO Club is known for its long history and for regularly organizing running events in Prague and the surrounding area. The race is part of the club’s broader calendar of running events, which promotes an active lifestyle and a community of runners.

name: Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The 19th MittSommerNachtsLauf is an open race for everyone, with a steady pace of approx. 6 min/km, or 6 km/h for walking. The race starts at 7 p.m. in the village center of Marklohe and finishes at the heated outdoor pool in Wietzen, where the swimming pool will remain open until 10 p.m. and the support association will provide refreshments. The running route is up to 18 km, with additional starting points at 13, 10 and 5 km. The walking route is up to 10 km or 5 km. The event promises a sporting evening in beautiful surroundings and is open to everyone who enjoys running or walking.

name: Běh Advenťáka OSTRAVA
description: The Advenťák Ostrava Run 2026 is a charity running race held on June 10 in Komenského sady. The race offers two main categories: adults running 6.45 km and children, called little elves, on courses from 0.2 to 1 km. The route follows paved and firm-surface paths, and road-running shoes are recommended. A large portion of the entry fee supports heroes who face challenges in life, and participants receive a race number, certificate, gingerbread cookie, and other benefits. The event is friendly, charitable, and suitable for all age groups.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The VAŠÍ LIGA Trail of Zlíchov Viewpoints is an amateur trail race held in Prague, offering runners the experience of running in nature across varied terrain and enjoying interesting views. The races are part of VAŠÍ LIGA, the largest amateur league in the Czech Republic, which promotes the joy of sport and a community atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a friendly environment and the chance to test themselves against runners of all ages. Winners are regularly announced and awarded medals in the under-40 and 40+ categories.

name: 189 Pobino i 73 popekspres
location: Brynek, Tarnowskie Góry County, Silesian Voivodeship, Polska

name: Ekstremalny Półmaraton Górski
location: Lipowa, Żywiec County, Silesian Voivodeship, Polska

name: 42. Bugasee-Marathon
description: The 42nd Bugasee Marathon takes place in Kassel and is organized by Laufwerk Kassel under the direction of Sylke Kuhn. The course is 42.3 km long and runs on flat, paved park paths around Bugasee in the Fuldaaue. The marathon consists of a 1.7 km opening section followed by 10 laps of 4.06 km each. The event is designed as a birthday marathon and offers a personal atmosphere without an entry fee, as this is covered by the birthday celebrant.

name: Červnová Krásná Morava
description: The June Krásná Morava is a running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Hejčín. It is part of the rich tradition of running events in the Olomouc Region, which are open to runners of all ages and abilities. The race offers a chance to experience the picturesque Haná countryside and join a community of sports enthusiasts. STMSVS is known for its long-standing organization of endurance sports and its support for running, cycling, and triathlon disciplines in the region.

name: Lysolajský běh
location: Tělocvična ZŠ, Kovárenská ulice, Lysolaje, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Lysolaje Run is a traditional running event held in the Prague-Lysolaje district. The start and finish are by the elementary school gym on Kovárenská Street. The run offers athletes and recreational runners the chance to enjoy running in the pleasant surroundings of Lysolaje and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the community.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the elementary school gym on Kovárenská Street
Run through the natural surroundings of Lysolaje and the surrounding area
Traditional sporting event in the Prague-Lysolaje district
additional: Registration is preferably available online at the address provided, or directly at the starting area until 18:00.

name: Nocny Półmaraton Piotrkowski
location: Amfiteatr Miejski, ul. Gabriela Narutowicza, Piotrków Trybunalski, Polska
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piotrkowie Trybunalskim
description: Nocny Półmaraton Piotrkowski to coroczne wydarzenie biegowe odbywające się ulicami Piotrkowa Trybunalskiego. Trasa półmaratonu ma długość 21,0975 km i prowadzi przez ulice miasta, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe nocne doświadczenie biegowe. W ramach imprezy organizowany jest także Ćwierćpółmaraton na dystansie 5,2 km. Start biegu następuje o godzinie 21:00, a biuro zawodów mieści się w Amfiteatrze Miejskim przy ul. Gabriela Narutowicza. Organizatorem jest Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piotrkowie Trybunalskim.
course_highlights: Trasa półmaratonu ulicami miasta Piotrkowa Trybunalskiego
Dystans półmaratonu 21,0975 km
Nocny start biegu o godzinie 21:00
additional: Biuro zawodów czynne 12.06.2027 od godziny 12:00 do 20:00 w Amfiteatrze Miejskim. Centrum zawodów znajduje się przy Amfiteatrze Miejskim przy ul. Gabriela Narutowicza.

name: 41. AZ-Abendvolkslauf
description: The 41st AZ Evening Fun Run takes place in Uelzen and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. From short introductory runs for children to the 5 km and 10 km main races, as well as walking, Nordic walking and recreational hiking, there is something for everyone. The course passes through Uelzen’s historic city center and along the Ilmenau meadows, among other places. The race is an established event supported by dedicated volunteers and numerous sponsors from the region.
course_highlights: The course passes through Uelzen’s historic city center
The 10 km loop is run twice
Sections along the Ilmenau meadows and over the Katzenbuckel Bridge
additional: Late registration is possible on race day until approximately 1 hour before each event; the late registration fee is €3.00 (except for the introductory run and hiking). All children’s and school-age races up to 2.0 km award medals at the finish. Certificates can be printed online after the event. The start for all events is on Albertstraße, in front of the turning area.

name: Holstenköstenlauf
organizer: SVT Neumünster in Kooperation mit BMS Die Laufgesellschaft mbH
price_range: 10 km Lauf: 23,00 Euro bis 26,00 Euro, 5 km Lauf: 13,00 Euro bis 16,00 Euro, Holstenkösten-Becher: 12,00 Euro
description: The Holstenköstenlauf in Neumünster is a traditional city race held as part of Schleswig-Holstein’s largest city festival, the Holstenköste. The event offers races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, and takes runners through various parts of Neumünster. The 10 km course is officially measured according to DLV rules and offers an attractive route through the city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld. All finishers receive a coveted festival medal as a memento of the event.
course_highlights: Attractive course through the city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld
10 km course officially measured according to DLV rules
Start and finish at Kleinflecken, with the same start and finish line
additional: Participation available for various age groups; registration online or on site; bib number collection in the foyer of the Stadthalle; refreshments on the course and at the finish; award ceremonies in the evening

name: Oesterweger Feuerwehrlauf
description: The Oesterweg Fun Run and Fire Brigade Run in Versmold offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels. From short Bambini and school runs with no entry fee to an officially measured 10 km road race and a 6 km team and fire brigade run, there is something for everyone. The flat, asphalted routes pass through the town center, with spectators providing plenty of encouragement. Walkers can also enjoy a scenic 6 km tour through the rural countryside alongside the event.
course_highlights: Flat, asphalted routes through the center of Oesterweg
10 km loop course with four identical laps plus an introductory lap
6 km loops for the team and fire brigade runs, as well as walking
additional: The Bambini run (450 m) and school run (1.2 km) have no entry fee. Participants up to age 11 are eligible for the school run standings; the taster run is for participants up to age 15. The team and fire brigade run consists of teams of four participants each. Walkers start alongside the fire brigade run from the rear rows so they do not interfere with the runners. Various distances, online registration, downloadable race brochures, special categories for fire brigades and teams, results on TimeTeamJung.

name: Voxtruper Volkslauf
description: The 13th Voxtrup Fun Run in Osnabrück offers a varied selection of races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes distances from 0.4 km for Bambinis to the 9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain. The races take runners through very scenic countryside, with several refreshment stations to support participants. Late entries are possible on the day of the event, and the event prioritises a safe and smooth race experience. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed.
course_highlights: Very scenic countryside run with a range of distances
9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain
Several refreshment stations depending on the distance (up to four for 9.8 km)
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event, up to 45 minutes before the respective race. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. Certificates can be printed online, and results are available at www.laufen-os.de. Refreshment stations: 1 at 3.9 km, 2 at 5.5 km, and 4 at 9.8 km. Participants can register on site; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. The courses are designed to take runners through scenic countryside.

name: Internationaler Brüder-Grimm-Lauf
organizer: Verein zur Förderung des Brüder-Grimm-Laufes e.V.
price_range: Startgebühr, ermäßigt für Mitglieder: 5 Euro Rabatt, sonst unklar
description: The International Brothers Grimm Run is a traditional 3-day event that covers approximately 82 km from Hanau, the birthplace of the Brothers Grimm, to Steinau, where the collectors of fairy tales spent their childhood. The route is divided into 5 stages and offers a challenge for recreational runners as well as competitive athletes. It follows historic trade routes, passing historic buildings, scenic attractions, and spa and resort towns in the Spessart and picturesque villages in the Kinzig Valley.
course_highlights: Approximately 82 km from Hanau to Steinau over 5 stages
Follows centuries-old trade routes and passes historic buildings
Scenic attractions and spa towns in the Spessart and Kinzig Valley
additional: The route is mostly paved, with some sections through open countryside and forest. The elevation profile is flat, with minimal inclines (maximum elevation approx. 130 m). The stages include, among other things, cycle paths, forest trails, and paved paths. The start and finish of each stage are in different towns along the route, such as Niederrodenbach and Neuenhaßlau. The event is intended for recreational runners and competitive athletes alike.

name: 14. Garbsener Citylauf
description: The 14th Garbsen City Run is Garbsen’s largest sporting event and offers races for all age groups and ability levels. There are six different races, from a 500-meter parent-child run to the 10,000-meter Agon Tax Run. The courses pass through Rathausplatz, the IGS grounds, along Meyenfelder Straße, and by Berenbosteler See. The event is family-friendly and emphasizes fun and community, supported by a dedicated organizing team and numerous volunteers.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2026 Lauf 1: 36. Donoper Volkslauf
description: The first race, the 36th Donoper Volkslauf, is organized by SC Donop 1948 e.V. and offers a varied 7,777-meter route around the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop. The series combines a sporting challenge with nature and community, and is open to runners, walkers, and hikers.

name: Aschauer Bankerl-Lauf
description: The Aschauer Bankerl-Lauf is a sociable evening run in the idyllic Chiemgau countryside, open to everyone who enjoys running. For the fifth time, organizer Lauffeuer Chiemgau e.V. invites runners to an untimed event where the joy of running takes center stage. Various distances are offered, from approximately 1 km (children’s run) to 7 km. Part of the proceeds will be donated to charity, making the event a socially minded one as well.

name: Derentaler Löwenlauf
description: The Derental Lion Run is a traditional race in the Weser Uplands, designed as a family-friendly sporting event for all ages. The event offers various distances through the beautiful Derental countryside and the Steinbach Valley. It places particular emphasis on diversity, tolerance, and working together, supported by a donation to the “augen auf!” Foundation for every participant. The race is organized with great care by the Weserbergland Runners Derental and promises an unforgettable day for children, young people, adults, and seniors.

name: Kleinbahn-Lauf
description: The Kleinbahn Run in Rhauderfehn is a fun run without timekeeping, welcoming runners and walkers on 5- and 10-kilometer routes. There are also children’s races for kindergarten and primary school children, enthusiastically cheered on by parents and grandparents. The 10 km loop starts at the marketplace and runs along the Hauptfehn Canal, through the villages of Holtermoor and Rhaude, and back to the finish via the Ostfriesland hiking trail. The 5 km route also starts at the marketplace and follows the Ostfriesland hiking trail back to the finish. The race offers a lovely opportunity to experience the region along varied routes.

name: Krackenlauf 2026
description: The Krackenlauf Großlangheim takes place on Friday and offers races for various age groups and ability levels. Events include an 800-meter Bambini run, a 2,000-meter schoolchildren’s run, a 7,500-meter main race, and a 6,000-meter walking event. This popular local running event has unchanged start times and distances and is open to all running enthusiasts. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.

name: Mittsommerlauf
distance_verbose: 10.2 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5.2 km, 3000 Meter, 1 km

name: Sparkassenlauf Geislingen
location: 73312 Geislingen an der Steige, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

name: Meine Nacht – Kirche laufend erleben
description: Meine Nacht - Kirche laufend erleben is a running event in Meine, taking place on June 11, 2027. The event offers a 10 km race and a relay competition with teams of five, each running a 2 km leg. The course is flat overall. The race starts at 20:00, making it a special evening event. Separate races are also offered for children and teenagers.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km course
Relay competition with teams of five and 2 km legs
Evening race starting at 20:00
additional: The start and finish are the same for all races. The exact location is shown only to RUNME Premium members. Races are offered for children and teenagers. The course is flat and therefore suitable for many runners.

name: Přes tři hráze Opatov
description: Přes tři hráze Opatov is a traditional running race held in Opatov in the Vysočina Region and is part of the Vysočina Runner’s Cup series. The race offers various distances, including the 8.8 km main course for men and veterans up to 69 years old, as well as shorter courses for women, veterans over 70, juniors, youth, and children. The course runs mainly along field and forest paths, including a route over the dams of three local ponds, giving the race its unique character. The event is open to a broad range of age groups and emphasizes sporting experiences and support for the local running community.

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok is a 5-kilometre night race held at the Rozálka Sports and Recreation Area in Pezinok. Runners can enjoy a fast, dynamic run along a route through the Malé Karpaty region, illuminated by artificial lights to create a unique atmosphere. The event is open to everyone aged 15 and over, with starting corrals divided according to ability. The organizers prioritize safety, so headphones are prohibited, and reflective gear or headlamps are recommended. Registration is available online and is tied to the runner’s name; preregistration is also possible.

name: Runway Run
location: Kamenica nad Cirochou Airport, Kamenica nad Cirochou, Slovakia
description: Runway Run is a unique running race held at the airport in Kamenica nad Cirochou, giving runners the chance to experience an unusual course directly on the airport runway. The race is suitable for the general public and creates a welcoming atmosphere with race instructions and accompanying activities. The event is known for its security check and opening of the runway entrance to runners, ensuring the race runs professionally.
course_highlights: The course runs directly along the airport runway
Security check before entering the runway
An atmosphere featuring partner presentations and accompanying competitions
additional: The program includes the opening and partner presentations at 18:00, a competition for runners with Rádio Košice at 18:30, opening of the runway entrance and a security check at 18:30, and the announcement of results at 20:45. Registration is available by bank transfer or in person during late registration at the venue.

name: The Run Slovakia
location: naprieč Slovenskom, naprieč Slovenskom, Košice, ul. Hlavná, resp. Teplička nad Váhom
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 is a national relay race across Slovakia, held over three days. Runners cover more than 530 km together from Košice to Bratislava, passing through beautiful natural scenery, historic landmarks and picturesque towns. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, teamwork and many unforgettable experiences. The route passes notable sites such as Spiš Castle, the High Tatras, Orava Castle and the Little Carpathians, and runners can also enjoy a varied programme of accompanying activities.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: 4 Skolwińska Mila to coroczny bieg uliczny organizowany w Szczecinie, który przyciąga zarówno dorosłych, jak i dzieci. Impreza odbywa się i kontynuuje tradycję poprzednich edycji, oferując uczestnikom możliwość rywalizacji na krótkim dystansie. Bieg jest doskonałą okazją do aktywnego spędzenia czasu i integracji lokalnej społeczności. Organizatorzy zapewniają łatwy kontakt poprzez formularz zgłoszeniowy oraz wsparcie administracyjne.
course_highlights: Dystans 1 mili (1609 metrów) na malowniczym terenie rekreacyjnym
Rejestracja online i pomiar czasu przez Sport-Time
Nagrody dla najlepszych i medale dla wszystkich finiszujących
additional: W ramach imprezy odbywają się także biegi dziecięce na dystansie około 200 metrów. Uczestnicy mogą korzystać z formularza zgłoszeniowego dostępnego na stronie, który umożliwia szybki kontakt z organizatorem i administratorem systemu. Uczestnicy mogą korzystać z treningowych planów od 8 do 20 tygodni, wydarzenie wspiera lokalny sklep budowlany, a limit uczestników wynosi 60 osób.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha
description: IV Bilczańska Dycha to bieg uliczny organizowany w Morawicy, który przyciąga miłośników biegania na trasę o długości 10 km. Impreza odbywa się na terenach rekreacyjnych Bilcza Park i jest częścią Bilczańskich Biegów Ulicznych, które obejmują także biegi dla dzieci. Wydarzeniu towarzyszy festyn rodzinny, co tworzy przyjazną i integracyjną atmosferę dla uczestników i ich bliskich.
course_highlights: Trasa biegu prowadzi przez tereny rekreacyjne Bilcza Park
Bieg uliczny na dystansie 10 km
Impreza towarzysząca z festynem rodzinnym
additional: W dniu biegu organizowany jest festyn rodzinny, który uatrakcyjnia wydarzenie dla uczestników i ich rodzin.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka to coroczny, oficjalnie atestowany bieg na 5 km, który odbywa się w Szamotułach. Trasa prowadzi przez ulice miasta, zapewniając uczestnikom możliwość rywalizacji na profesjonalnym poziomie z uznawanymi wynikami. Impreza jest otwarta dla wszystkich, w tym dla dzieci i rodzin, które mogą wziąć udział w biegach towarzyszących na krótszych dystansach. Start głównego biegu odbywa się wieczorem, co nadaje wydarzeniu wyjątkowy, nocny charakter. Organizatorzy dbają o komfort uczestników, oferując poczęstunek po biegu oraz dekoracje zwycięzców.
course_highlights: Trasa atestowana przez Polski Związek Lekkiej Atletyki
Bieg nocny z startem o godzinie 21:55
Trasa miejska prowadząca ulicami Szamotuł
additional: W dniu biegu obowiązuje czasowa zmiana organizacji ruchu z utrudnieniami w parkowaniu i wytyczonymi objazdami. Wydawanie pakietów startowych odbywa się od 17:00 do 21:30. Po biegu przewidziany jest poczęstunek dla uczestników oraz dekoracje zwycięzców. Dla osób niepełnosprawnych dostępnych jest 26 darmowych pakietów startowych w biegu rodzinnym z opiekunem po zgłoszeniu mailowym.

name: 8 Bieg Chwalisza
description: 8. edycja Biegu Chwalisza to coroczny bieg charytatywny odbywający się w Ścierniach, który łączy sport z pomocą potrzebującym dzieciom. Trasa biegu jest dobrze oznaczona i zróżnicowana, idealna zarówno dla amatorów, jak i doświadczonych biegaczy. Wydarzenie towarzyszy festyn rodzinny, tworząc radosną i przyjazną atmosferę dla całych rodzin. Organizatorzy zapraszają również na wspólne treningi, które odbywają się co czwartek o godzinie 19:00. Każdy uczestnik biegu wspiera szczytny cel, a atmosfera wydarzenia sprzyja integracji lokalnej społeczności.
course_highlights: Zróżnicowana trasa crossowa, dobrze oznaczona
Trasa odpowiednia dla amatorów i doświadczonych biegaczy
Rodzinna atmosfera z festynem towarzyszącym biegowi
additional: Wspólne treningi w każdy czwartek o godz. 19:00 spod przedszkola w Ścierniach ul. Kamienna 17. Wydarzenie ma charakter charytatywny, wspierając dzieci w potrzebie. Festyn rodzinny towarzyszy biegowi, zapewniając dodatkowe atrakcje i integrację uczestników.

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
description: Ósmy ogólnopolski bieg „Recepta na Zdrowie” odbędzie się w łódzkim Arturówku. To zdrowa impreza biegowa promująca aktywność fizyczną, integrację środowiska biegowego i farmaceutycznego oraz zdrowy styl życia. Trasy biegów prowadzą po pętli 5 km w Lesie Łagiewnickim, z dystansami 5 i 10 km oraz Nordic Walking na 5 km. Dla dzieci i młodzieży przewidziano krótsze biegi na tej samej trasie. W okolicy startu i mety odbędzie się rodzinny piknik z bezpłatnymi badaniami i konsultacjami.

name: II Leśny Bieg Gminy Brzeźnio - Tumidaj
Leśna ZaDyszka
description: Leśna ZaDyszka to bieg organizowany w malowniczym Leśnictwie Szulmierz w Gminie Regimin, promujący zdrowy styl życia i aktywność na terenach leśnych. Trasa składa się z pętli o długości 5 km, prowadzącej przez dukty leśne oraz fragment asfaltowy, ukazując piękno mazowieckiej przyrody. Uczestnicy mogą wybrać spośród trzech biegów: 5 km, 10 km (2 pętle) oraz Nordic Walking na 5 km. Dla dzieci przewidziany jest bieg na 1500 m bez klasyfikacji. Start i meta znajdują się na polanie śródleśnej przy drodze Szulmierz-Regimin, a czas mierzony jest profesjonalnym systemem z chipami.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km pętla przez dukty leśne i asfalt (4 km las, 1 km asfalt)
Malownicze tereny mazowieckiej przyrody
Start i meta na polanie śródleśnej przy drodze Szulmierz-Regimin
additional: Czas mierzony chipami umieszczonymi na obuwiu. Biuro zawodów czynne od godz. 9:00. Wszyscy uczestnicy otrzymują okolicznościowy medal i posiłek regeneracyjny. Nagrody za miejsca w kategoriach wiekowych i open. Możliwość wyboru koszulki standardowej w cenie lub Premium LAS z dopłatą 20 zł. Trasa zabezpieczona przez wolontariuszy.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
description: XIII Radomszczański Bieg Uliczny Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana w Radomsku, upamiętniająca Mariana Szymańskiego. Zawody odbywają się na ulicach miasta, oferując uczestnikom możliwość rywalizacji w przyjaznej atmosferze. Organizatorem jest Miasto Radomsko oraz Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Radomsku, a pomiar czasu zapewnia profesjonalna firma Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. Start biegu zaplanowano na godzinę 17:30, a zapisy online kończą się kilka dni przed wydarzeniem.
course_highlights: Bieg uliczny w centrum Radomska
Organizacja na wysokim poziomie z profesjonalnym pomiarem czasu
Wieczorny start o godzinie 17:30

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka to bieg na dystansie 10 km odbywający się w Kwidzynie, w województwie pomorskim. Zawody zaplanowano na sobotę 12 czerwca 2027 roku. Bieg jest doskonałą okazją do sprawdzenia swojej formy na asfaltowej trasie o średnim stopniu trudności. Organizatorzy oferują plany treningowe dostosowane do różnych poziomów zaawansowania, wspierając uczestników w optymalnym przygotowaniu do startu.
course_highlights: Trasa asfaltowa o średnim stopniu trudności
Dystans 10 km
Bieg uliczny w malowniczym Kwidzynie
additional: Organizatorzy oferują plany treningowe od 8 do 20 tygodni, dostosowane do poziomu VDOT biegacza, z szczegółowymi instrukcjami i wsparciem ekspertów.

name: XII Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar ...
description: XII Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Borsuka to tradycyjny bieg przełajowy odbywający się w malowniczej miejscowości Zagwiździe. Zawody przyciągają biegaczy ceniących naturalne, leśne trasy i rywalizację na wymagającym terenie. Impreza jest doskonałą okazją do sprawdzenia swojej kondycji wśród miłośników biegów terenowych oraz do aktywnego spędzenia czasu na świeżym powietrzu. Organizatorzy dbają o profesjonalny pomiar czasu i sprawną organizację wydarzenia.
course_highlights: Trasa przełajowa w naturalnym, leśnym terenie
Wymagające podbiegi i zróżnicowana nawierzchnia
Malownicze widoki i kontakt z przyrodą

name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: Bieg Marszałka to coroczna impreza biegowa w Sulejówku, nawiązująca do przedwojennych marszów Sulejówek - Belweder na dystansie 26 km.
