W ramach wydarzenia odbywa się bieg główny na 10 km oraz biegi towarzyszące dla dzieci i młodzieży. Trasa prowadzi ulicami Sulejówka, głównie po asfalcie, z krótkim odcinkiem po kostce brukowej. Start i meta zlokalizowane są przy ul. Paderewskiego 94, obok Willi Bzów. Bieg ma charakter historyczny i sportowy, łącząc tradycję z aktywnością fizyczną.
course_highlights: Trasa biegu głównego na 10 km prowadzi ulicami Sulejówka, głównie po asfalcie
Krótki odcinek trasy po kostce brukowej
Start i meta przy ul. Paderewskiego 94, obok Willi Bzów
additional: W ramach Biegu Marszałka odbywają się także biegi towarzyszące: Memoriał im. Haliny Zielińskiej (ok. 3,6 km), Bieg Malucha (ok. 100 m) oraz Bieg Starszaka (ok. 200 m). Start Biegu Malucha o 09:30, Biegu Starszaka o 09:40. Przed startem głównego biegu i Memoriału o 09:50 odbywa się uroczystość złożenia kwiatów pod pomnikiem Marszałka Józefa Piłsudskiego. 17:00-19:00 oraz w dniu biegu od 7:00 do 9:45. Organizator zapewnia posiłek regeneracyjny i wodę. Dostępny jest parking muzealny u zbiegu al. Piłsudskiego i ul. Matejki. Strefa gastronomiczna znajduje się w budynku Muzeum oraz na dziedzińcu muzealnym.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego
200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
XIX Bieg Zajączkowski
location: Zajączki Drugie, Gmina Krzepice, Silesian Voivodeship, Polska

name: XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
location: Morzyczyn, Stargard County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Polska

name: 55. Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
description: The Bartenwetzer Volkslauf is the oldest fun run in North Hesse and takes place at Waldstadion Melsungen. The event includes children’s and schoolchildren’s races over 400 m and 1000 m, as well as 5 km, 10 km and 19 km races on paved paths through Melsungen city forest. As the 10th scoring race in the Nordhessencup, it offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, award ceremonies and a buffet. The start and finish areas are centrally located at Waldstadion, which also has changing facilities.
course_highlights: Races on paved paths through the beautiful Melsungen city forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Melsungen, on the edge of the city forest
Distances: 5 km, 10 km and 19 km, plus children’s races on the track
additional: Race-pack pickup from 14:30 at the MT clubhouse at Waldstadion. Race-day entries are not possible. Changing facilities are available at the MT clubhouse. Refreshments include water on the longer courses, hot tea at the finish, and a buffet with coffee, cake and bratwurst from 15:30. Medical support is provided by the German Red Cross. Certificates and medals for the Bambini and 1000 m races; certificates can be printed on site or accessed online. The event is subject to the applicable regulations for road and off-stadium running events. Register online via RaceResult. The event at Waldstadion Melsungen includes award ceremonies, refreshments and medical support.

name: SV Greven Deichlauf
description: The SV Greven Deichlauf offers an unforgettable running experience along the picturesque Ems dike and through the town forest. The route, surrounded by nature, is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes, and is lined by numerous spectators. Around 1,000 runners take part, seeking both an athletic challenge and an experience in nature.
course_highlights: Circuit from Stadion Emsaue along the Ems dike
The route runs through the town forest
Nature-filled running route with many spectators
additional: Running event, circuit, experience in nature, approx. 1,000 participants, official timing, medals for children and age groups

name: Ketteler-Lauf, Lauf dem Krebs davon
description: The Ketteler Run is a charity run held in Offenbach under the motto “Run away from cancer.” Proceeds from the run support care for cancer patients. The starting signal sounds at 15:00 on Obere Grenzstraße in Offenbach. Those who register in advance can collect their race numbers and finisher T-shirts at Ketteler Hospital as early as 12 June. The event is an established tradition that combines sporting commitment with a social purpose.
course_highlights: Start on Obere Grenzstraße, approximately opposite house number 119, Offenbach
Charity run supporting care for cancer patients
Race numbers and finisher T-shirts can be collected in advance at Ketteler Hospital
additional: On the event day, collection is also possible from 12:00 to 14:00 in the hospital courtyard. The run offers distances of 5 km and 7 km, with on-site registration available. The event is part of an annual series of charity runs to fight cancer and offers finisher T-shirts to participants.

name: Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf
location: Kurpark Bad Nenndorf, Bad Nenndorf, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf is a long-standing, DLV-approved public race and part of the Schaumburg Running Series. It takes place in the beautiful Kurpark in Bad Nenndorf and offers distances for different age and ability groups, including 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km walking and Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly and attracts many participants, who run on paved paths through the park. In addition to the sporting competition, there is an attractive supporting program and good facilities, including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through the Kurpark
Start and finish on Kurpromenade by the Wandelhalle
A range of distances from 1,000 m to 10 km, plus walking options
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports center, which can be reached by bus shuttle. Insurance coverage is provided through an LSB contract. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Medical support is provided. A maximum of 300 participants in the 1,000 m and 2.5 km races. The 5 km Nordic walking and walking events are timed, with no placings. First race for the Samtgemeinde Cup. Scoring race in the Schaumburg Running Series. The race takes place as part of the State Garden Show, with various distances and a family-friendly atmosphere. Early registration is possible, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Mut-Lauf
description: The MUT-LAUF Kiel is an annual running event that promotes greater openness and courage in dealing with mental illness. Its aim is to take a stand against stigma and raise awareness of mental health. The run celebrates moving together without pressure to perform and is open to everyone, regardless of age, fitness level, or physical limitations. Alongside the run, there is a varied program featuring music, interviews, food and drink, and a marketplace with information about mental health and prevention.
course_highlights: A run open to everyone, with no pressure to perform, including wheelchair users
Event held at the Moorteichwiesen in Kiel
Program featuring music, interviews, and a marketplace
additional: Registration is available online through the Davengo portal or in person at KIELER FENSTER, Ambulantes Zentrum. The event takes place every year on the Saturday before Kiel Week begins. The program includes activities for the whole family and a marketplace featuring self-help groups and social organizations. Entry fees are €10 for adults and €5 for children. Information about self-help groups and a sociable program are provided.

name: Oelder Citylauf
description: The Oelde City Run is a traditional running classic in the heart of Oelde that has delighted runners of all ages for over 45 years. The event offers a varied programme featuring Bambini, schoolchildren’s and inclusive races, as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The races take place before a large crowd in a festival-like atmosphere and are part of the Volksbank Cup race series. The course is measured to international standards and runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square.
course_highlights: An internationally measured 2.5 km lap, repeated as required for each distance
The course runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square
A variety of races for all ages, including Bambini and inclusive races
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a late-entry fee of EUR 3.00. Race packets can be collected at the event centre on the Market Square. Certificates for the schoolchildren’s and Bambini races are available on site; certificates for the other races are available online. Showers are available at the Oelde Comprehensive School sports hall, approximately 300 m from the finish. Registration is via Raceresult; the event is known for its diverse categories and friendly atmosphere.

name: Straßenlauf Gollhofen mit Mittelfränkischer Meisterschaft über 10 km
location: Gollhofen, Landkreis Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Gollhofen Road Race is being held for the 26th time and includes the Central Franconian 10 km Championship. The event is hosted by FC Gollhofen and gives runners the opportunity to take part in a long-standing competition. Further details and information are available in the announcement on the website. The event is aimed at competitive runners and running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km road race with the Central Franconian Championship
Traditional race with more than 25 years of history
Event in the municipality of Gollhofen, Würzburg district
additional: Registration for the Gollhofen Road Race is via the link provided on the website. Further details are included in the flyer and announcement. The race takes place on a road course at Gollhofen’s sports grounds. Registration is online, and the event also includes youth categories. The event offers a great opportunity to meet the running community in the region.

name: Söltjerlauf
description: The Söltjerlauf in Bad Münder is a charity run in the beautiful Süntel hills, where every lap counts. The event welcomes all age groups and fitness levels, from children to marathon runners, and features a shaded forest loop of approximately 3.8 km with a refreshment point. Participants have four hours to run as many laps as possible, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health, and invites participants to stay after the run for catering and the awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Shaded forest loop of approximately 3.8 km
Refreshment point along the course
Atmosphere at the Bergschmiede restaurant, with catering
additional: A shuttle service is available from 09:30 to help participants arrive in time for the 11:00 start. Every participant receives a certificate stating the distance covered. The top individual runners and the top 10 teams receive prizes. Parking is limited, so using the overflow parking areas and bus shuttle is recommended. Dogs must be kept on a short leash and are not allowed to participate as team members. Competition open to all age groups; sponsors donate for each lap to local projects. The event takes place on the Bergschmiede grounds, with support from local sponsors such as Sparkasse Hameln-Weserbergland and Ardagh Group.

name: Volksbank Haren Citylauf
description: The 27th Volksbank Haren City Run takes place on an attractive, fast course through Haren city centre. The 5 km and 10 km races are measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings, making them ideal for competitive athletes and recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in special races over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km. There is also a team competition in the 5 km race for teams from companies, clubs or groups.
course_highlights: Attractive, fast course through Haren city centre
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings
Special races for children and young people over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km
additional: All participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive finisher shirts. Entry fees are paid by direct debit. The 5 km race includes a team competition for teams of at least 3 people. Children from Haren daycare centres and schools can take part for free if their institution participates. Large trophies and certificates are awarded for school competitions.

name: Gellershäuser Abendlauf
location: Sportplatz in Gellershausen, Edertal, Hesse, Germany
organizer: Turn und Sportverein Hessen 1848 Frankenberg Eder e.V.
description: The Gellershausen Evening Run takes place at the sports ground in Gellershausen, Edertal, and offers races for children and school students, as well as a 10-kilometer race and a half marathon. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and attracts runners of various age groups. The course runs through scenic surroundings and offers a pleasant running atmosphere in June. Information about registration, the course, results, and photos is available.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10-kilometer courses starting at Gellershausen Sports Ground
Children’s and school students’ races included
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup
additional: Typical June weather: around 23 °C during the day and 13 °C at night, mostly sunny, with an average of 65 mm of precipitation. Children’s and youth races with distances of around 400 m and 1,000 m; the event promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.

name: 12. Heilwald Marathon
description: The 12th Heilwald Marathon takes place in Bad Lippspringe. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and runs through the unique Heilwald, whose soothing low-mountain climate and species-rich forest offer a special running experience. The event is a private, self-supported race, with times recorded by hand; a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participation is at your own risk, and a voluntary donation for tree planting is requested.

name: 13. Himmelswegelauf
description: The Himmelswegelauf is a long-standing race around the Nebra Sky Disc, held every year in June. The event offers various disciplines, including a marathon, half marathon, the 10-kilometer Sky Disc Run, walking, a bike tour, and guided hikes to the site where the Sky Disc was found. The routes pass historical and archaeological sites such as the Goseck Solar Observatory, the Dolmengöttin of Langeneichstädt, and the Arche Nebra visitor center. The start and finish are usually at Arche Nebra, near where the Sky Disc was found; the disc is considered the oldest concrete depiction of the cosmos. The race combines a sporting challenge with cultural experiences in a unique landscape.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Arche Nebra, near where the Sky Disc was found
Marathon starts at the 7,000-year-old Goseck Solar Observatory
Route through the Ziegelroda Forest and past archaeological sites
additional: In addition to the races, the event includes walking, bike tours, and guided hikes to the site where the Sky Disc was found. All routes are subject to approval by the relevant authorities. The medal is awarded in an exclusive design.

name: 15. Fullestrand-Ultramarathon
description: The Fullestrand Ultramarathon takes place in Kassel and features a challenging 46.5 km route along the Fulda, with around 350 metres of elevation gain. The route heads upstream from Kassel, follows the Fuldahöhenweg and returns along the Fuldaradweg, passing through varied landscapes and natural areas. The event is organised by Laufwerk Kassel, led by Sylke Kuhn, and combines a sporting challenge with the beauty of northern Hesse’s nature and culture.

name: 18. Edeka Ladage-Lauf
description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen is a long-standing community race with a variety of events for all age groups. The event takes place at the Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School sports facility and offers varied loop courses for everyone from kindergarten children to experienced runners. The longer races follow a slightly modified 2.5 km loop, with the start and finish close to the event area, creating a special atmosphere. Alongside the competition, the event also emphasizes a sense of community, supported by a prize draw and a dedicated team of volunteers.

name: 23. Sudenburg-Lauf - Der Lauf mit dem Lächeln
description: The Sudenburg Run is an event with the motto “By runners, for runners” and takes place at Heinrich Germer Stadium in Magdeburg. The event is distinguished by enthusiasm for running and for the Sudenburg district. There are various race routes for children, teenagers, and adults, which lead through the city and the stadium. The focus is on getting as many people as possible running and putting a smile on their faces.

name: Ottermeerlauf
description: The Ottermeer Run in Wiesmoor is a long-standing event. It offers a varied course and a motivating atmosphere, and is open to both individual runners and relay teams. A particular highlight is the 6-hour ultramarathon, which is part of the Nordcup and open to runners aged 18 and over. Every finisher receives a custom medal shaped like the outline of the Ottermeer, featuring the mascot Otti.

name: 24h Lauf Halberstadt
description: The 24-hour run at Friedensstadion Halberstadt starts at 18:00 and is organized by VfB Germania Halberstadt in collaboration with the Halberstadt Leisure and Sports Center. The goal is to keep runners on the tartan track continuously throughout the 24 hours. The event is part of VfB Germania’s club festival, where various sports departments introduce themselves and invite visitors to join in. In addition to the run, traditional activities include pulling a coach on the track. The event offers a sporting challenge and a sociable program for participants and spectators.

name: Fischland-Darss-Zingst-Ultramarathon (FDZU)
description: The Fischland-Darss-Zingst Ultramarathon (FDZU) is the longest nature-experience run in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and is being held for the 10th time. The route passes through the unique Baltic Sea coastal landscape from Rostock to Stralsund, offering runners a special experience of nature along the region’s peninsulas and islands. The race is defined by its tradition and distinctive atmosphere, created by the combination of nature, challenge and community.

name: Harsefelder Lauf- und Musikfestival
organizer: Lauftreff Harsefeld, LSC Harsefeld, Stadtmarketing Harsefeld
description: The 20th Running and Music Festival takes place in Harsefeld, combining sporting challenges with musical entertainment. Runners of all ages can take part in a range of distances, from children’s and Bambini runs to short and long-distance races and relays. In the evening, Marktstraße becomes a lively party strip with an open-air disco and live music. The festival is a regular fixture on Harsefeld’s event calendar and, alongside the sporting events, offers a varied children’s program and food stalls.

name: Kalimandscharolauf 2026
description: The event is organized by K+S Minerals and Agriculture GmbH, Zielitz plant. The race takes place away from the stadium and offers runners an attractive course in the Magdeburg/Börde region. Registration is open.

name: Kidsmarathon
description: The Pillenstein KIDSmarathon is an inclusive running event for up to 4,000 children aged 1 to 11. Children can choose their own distance, with fun and participation taking priority. There is no timekeeping, and every participant is a winner. The event offers a great atmosphere and a varied program, and is designed to be accessible so children with disabilities can take part.

name: Lauf um den Senftenberger See
description: The 49th Run Around Lake Senftenberg offers runners a choice of distances around picturesque Lake Senftenberg. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from the Bambini race to the challenging 17.7 km lake loop. Races start at 09:00 in front of the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with a friendly atmosphere, ample refreshments, and changing and washing facilities. Register online via myRacePartner; late registration is available until race day for a small fee.

name: Luckenwalder Turmfestlauf
description: The 35th Luckenwalder Turmfest takes place from 11 to 13 June 2027 around the Market Tower. The city centre will be transformed into one of the largest festival areas in the Teltow-Fläming region, with modern amusement rides, numerous market stalls and a varied stage programme. The festival is open to all visitors, regardless of their means, as there will be no standard cultural contribution in 2027. Supporters can make a voluntary donation or purchase a supporter wristband to help preserve and develop the tradition of the city festival.
additional: The Turmfest starts at 12:00 on all three days. The festival closes at 01:00 on Friday and Saturday, and at 22:00 on Sunday. There is no standard admission fee; voluntary donations are requested instead. Supporter wristbands are available for 10 euros at the Tourist Information Centre. The Tourist Information Centre is open at varying times from Monday to Friday, but is closed from 24 December 2026 to 1 January 2027.

name: OSTSEE Run
description: The OSTSEE Run by ROTEC is a sporting highlight as part of the OSTSEE Sports Games in Cottbus. The race offers an attractive course for runners and walkers and is part of a varied sports and leisure program featuring numerous other competitions and activities. The event welcomes sports enthusiasts of all ages and, in addition to the sporting competition, offers a lively program of activities and a large OSTSEE party with free admission. This combination of sporting event and celebration makes the OSTSEE Run a special experience in the region.

name: OSTSEE Sparkassen Halbmarathon
description: The SPARKASSEN Half Marathon takes place in Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee. The 21-kilometer course starts at 10:00 a.m. from the Möbel Höffner grounds. Race materials can be collected from 7:00 a.m. in the start and finish area. The race is open to participants aged 18 and over and offers an attractive route along the Baltic Sea coast. On-site registration is not available; participants must register in advance.

name: Panorama-Baumwipfel-Lauf 2026
description: The Panorama Treetop Run 2026 is an appealing running event in the Steigerwald that attracts runners from all over Germany. The varied routes pass through vineyards and the Steigerwald Nature Park, along winding trails and forest paths. The half-marathon and 12 km routes go via the tower of the Steigerwald Treetop Walk and return via Oberschwarzach Herrenberg. The start and finish are at the Panorama Terrace at the sports facility / Sebastianihaus Oberschwarzach, and the course offers beautiful new views around every bend.

name: Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg
description: The Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg is a challenging running event held in Altenburg. Participants can choose from various distances, including the marathon, two-person marathon relay, half marathon, 13.3 km run, fitness run, children’s and students’ races, and walking events. The course takes runners through the historic city of Altenburg, with varied sections that include climbs in the city forest and along the Großer Teich. In addition to the sporting challenge, the supporting program offers a wide range of entertainment, including music, a children’s festival, and a talk by running legend Uta Pippig.

name: Tollenseseelauf
description: The Neubrandenburg Tollensesee Run is a scenic race around Lake Tollensesee that attracts more than 2,000 runners each year. With distances for young and old, the event offers a varied running festival in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is challenging, with several climbs, which is why the race is also known as “The Toughest in the North.” More than 300 volunteers help create an unforgettable running experience, with certificates, technical T-shirts, and trophies for the top finishers.

name: Waaker Bystopen-Attacke
description: The Waaker Bystopen Attack is an obstacle race in Lower Saxony, held around the Waaker Büsteppe in the Göttingen Forest. The event offers distances of 2.5 km (family run), 5 km and 10 km, with more than 30 natural and artificial obstacles. You can participate individually or as part of a team; team scoring requires at least 4 runners. Alongside the main race, there is also a Bambini Attack for the youngest participants, which does not require registration. The event focuses on fun, team spirit and exercise in nature.

name: Bürgerlauf Visbek
description: The 1st Visbek Community Run takes place in Visbek Park (Pastors Wisk) and offers a varied program for runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, as well as intermediate and main races over 5 km and 10 km, complemented by a walking or hiking route. Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 15:00, and all races are professionally measured. Proceeds benefit the Visbek Community Foundation, making the run a sporting event with a charitable purpose.

name: Drebber-Marathon
description: The Drebber Run offers a wide range of competitions for all ages and ability levels. The course follows an officially measured 2.34 km loop through the Jacobidrebber district, with the start and finish at the sports field. In addition to individual and relay events ranging from a children’s run to a marathon, there is an attractive supporting program for spectators and participants. Emergency services personnel are especially invited to take part in the Blue Light Cup as a relay team and showcase their performance.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Olomouc 2026
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc 2026 is a traditional half marathon that takes you through the beauty of Olomouc’s historic center. The start and finish are on Upper Square, where you can admire the Holy Trinity Column and the town hall with its unique astronomical clock. During the race, you’ll enjoy the city’s atmosphere, historic buildings, and beautiful parks. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers an accompanying program.

name: Horem dolem Chospílem
description: Horem dolem Chospílem is a 9.2 km interval-start running race that follows meadows and farm tracks around Postřekov in the Chospíl area. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers runners pleasant terrain in a natural setting. The interval start makes for an interesting race format. This race is suitable for runners looking for a mix of nature and sporting challenge in the Plzeň Region.

name: Sokolovský  ¼ maraton
organizer: Živý kraj – Destinační agentura pro Karlovarský kraj, z.s.
description: The Sokolov Quarter Marathon is a running event taking place in Sokolov, in the Karlovy Vary Region. The course runs mainly through scenic parts of the town and the surrounding countryside, and is approximately 10.5 km long. The event is intended both for recreational runners and for those who want to experience the atmosphere of a race in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and sporting experiences for all participants.

name: Dobročinný běh po stopách Silver A
description: We invite you to the 3rd annual charity run and walk, In the Footsteps of Silver A, organized by the Zámeček Memorial in Pardubice. The event is suitable for athletes and non-athletes, children and adults, and the entry fees go to charitable causes. The run offers two routes—a shorter 5-kilometer route and a longer 10-kilometer route—as well as a children’s race of approximately 1 kilometer. There will also be a guided walk through the city to places associated with the Silver A parachute group, starting at the Zámeček Memorial.

name: Hradecký koloběh
description: Hradecký Koloběh is a mixed-pair race held in the beautiful surroundings of the city forests, starting at Biřička. The race combines running and cycling: one team member runs while the other rides a bike. Competitors can switch at any time during the race, adding strategy and excitement. The event celebrates team spirit and the joy of movement, with OPEN and FAMILY categories. It is held with the support of the City of Hradec Králové and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Jinecký kros
organizer: Městys Jince a Jinečáček, z. s.
description: Jinecký kros is a traditional running race held in Jince, offering a challenging course approximately 5.7 km long with around 178 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are at the football pitch by the Biokoupaliště, which provides facilities for runners, including parking, changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The course runs along asphalt roads, forest paths and meadows, and includes crossing a wooden footbridge, running on asphalt roads and climbing Vystrkov hill. The race is suitable for adults and children, who have their own categories. The main race starts at 11:00.

name: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton
description: The Jindřichův Hradec Half Marathon 2026 is the tenth-anniversary edition of a running race offering a unique experience that combines the town’s picturesque historic centre, sections along the water, and scenic stretches with significant elevation gain. The race is open to individuals running 21.1 km, relay teams, families, and schools taking part in shorter races. The atmosphere is enhanced by spectators and music, with race services including refreshment stations and showers. A special Rebel Run for schools is also planned, focusing on teamwork rather than time. The race start is and participants will receive original medals and may win prizes.

name: Neveklovské běhy
organizer: kulturní a sportovní komise města Neveklov
description: Neveklov Runs is a traditional running event held in the picturesque Castle Park in Neveklov. The race offers runners of all abilities the chance to enjoy a run in the park’s pleasant surroundings and friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the wider Běžec Podblanicka running race calendar, which promotes an active lifestyle and brings athletes in the region together.

name: 7 pohoří Jeseníky
description: Jeseníky 2026 is a technical trail race in the beautiful countryside beneath Králický Sněžník, offering three courses of varying distances and elevation gain. The routes have been prepared by members of the local mountain rescue service and run mostly through natural terrain. Participants can enjoy a professionally marked course, chip timing, refreshments along the route and at the finish, and a commemorative medal. The event takes place in all weather conditions and is suitable for all trail-running enthusiasts looking for epic views and an atmosphere they won’t find anywhere else.

name: Okrouhelský běh
description: The Okrouhlá Run is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, held in the picturesque village of Okrouhlá in the Liberec Region. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to enjoy a run in a natural setting with a friendly atmosphere. The Okrouhlá Run is part of a series of regional running races that promote an active lifestyle and community sports.

name: Extrem Run 5Hills
description: Extrem Run 5 Hills is an ultratrail running race in the westernmost part of the Czech Republic, offering a challenging 91-kilometre course with 2,174 metres of elevation gain. The route crosses five peaks of Egerland and combines paved roads, cycling and hiking trails, and forest terrain. The race is intended for experienced runners seeking an extreme sporting challenge and stunning panoramas. The organizers place emphasis on accurate timekeeping and participant safety. The race takes place in the scenic Vojtanov area and also offers relay and two-person duathlon options.

name: Běh na Pajrek
description: Běh na Pajrek is the second edition of a running race organized by TJ Nýrsko, held in the area below the ski slope in Nýrsko. Men run an 8.6 km course (2 laps), while women run 4.2 km (1 lap), with 152 metres of elevation gain per lap. The finish is at the same location as the start. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and the Ešus League, with refreshments available at the venue. The organizers warn that the course may change due to construction work and provide prizes in kind for the top finishers in each category.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: Ultra Nízke Tatry is the inaugural edition of a mountain running event that follows the ridge of the Low Tatras from west to east. The course is 49.7 km long with 2,650 metres of elevation gain, following marked hiking trails from Donovaly to Srdiečko. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as the Milan Styko Memorial, honouring a prominent runner and mountaineer who tragically died in 2025. The start is scheduled for 7:00 in Donovaly, by the Donovaly Brewery.

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska mašľa is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike around Strečno. The race offers two routes: a challenging 50 km route with approximately 2,985 metres of elevation gain, and a shorter 25 km route, which is also suitable for runners with dogs. The routes follow marked hiking trails through both parts of the Malá Fatra and part of the national park, with the start and finish at the Radinové football field in Strečno. The organizers provide race packs, prizes for the top finishers, and quality conditions for participants.

name: Krosak pod hradom
location: Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Obecný úrad
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
description: Krosák pod hradom is a running race in Trnava pri Laborci, offering various categories, including the 10 km Big Cross, the 5 km Small Cross, a health run, and Nordic walking. The course follows farm and forest roads with asphalt surfaces, and the Big Cross consists of two 5 km loops. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League and is suitable for a wide range of runners, from juniors to veterans. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Trnava pri Laborci, with children’s categories starting at 9:00 and the main race at 11:00.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca
description: The Kysuce Marathon is the second-oldest marathon in Slovakia and a major sporting and social event in the Kysuce region. The course follows the picturesque Kysuce Valley along the Kysuca River, with a safer and more attractive route on the cycling path for runners from 2025. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, a marathon relay, and a minimarathon for children. The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca, in front of the House of Culture. Runners compete in various age categories and have access to aid stations and facilities including changing rooms and wellness services.

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom
location: Žehra časť Hodkovce, Žehra časť Hodkovce, Kaštieľ Hodkovce 1, Žehra, areál DSS DOMOVINA no.
description: The Run Through Hodkovce Park is a running event held in the grounds of Hodkovce Manor in Žehra. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads with an asphalt surface. The event is divided into categories: an 8 km competitive run for men and women in various age groups, and non-competitive 4 km categories for Run for Health and Nordic walking, with no age limit. The organizer, DOMOVINA n.o., ensures a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization for all participants. Online entry is available at a discounted price, encouraging early registration.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: The Kalvária Run is a charity race held in the beautiful surroundings of Kalvária in Považská Bystrica. The event offers courses for both adults and children, with forest roads making up the course surface. This fourth edition is an opportunity to experience community, exercise and joy, while the proceeds from the run go to children in need. The organizers emphasize high-quality organization and support for charitable causes.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
description: The 2nd Summer Round of the Lemešany Running League is a running event held in Lemešany, on the meadow above the village. The race is divided into several categories by age and gender, including children’s categories and Nordic walking. The main categories start at 17:00, and the children’s categories start at 17:10. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for a summer race.

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranské Matliare, Tatranské Matliare, Kežmarská Biela voda, pri zastávke SAD
description: The Run to the Green Lake Hut is a mountain race for sports and nature enthusiasts, suitable for both amateur and professional athletes. The event has been held regularly since 2005 on the second weekend of June and commemorates Karel Jakeš, a prominent Czechoslovak mountaineer. The route crosses challenging mountain terrain with significant elevation gain, making the race a test for all participants. The aim is to bring together different sporting groups and offer them a unique experience in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Krakės - Laiko ratu“
organizer: Krakių bendruomenės centras, Krakių kultūros centras, Krakių seniūnija
description: The “Krakės – Laiko ratu” running race is a traditional national event held in the town of Krakės, Kėdainiai District. The race welcomes everyone, from professionals to beginners and recreational runners, with a range of distances for different age groups. The start and finish are in the town centre, at Laisvės Square. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and awards across various age categories. Participants are served traditional šiupinys stew, and can play outdoor wooden games by “LPA GAMES”.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Laisvės Square in the town of Krakės
Different distances for age groups: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 600 m “Catch the Stork” run around the Krakės honour circuit for children and families
additional: Race bibs are issued from 11:00. The opening ceremony and the 600 m “Catch the Stork” run start at 11:30. All participants are served šiupinys stew prepared by the Krakės Community Centre. Awards are presented to age-group winners, the youngest and oldest participants, and the fastest 10 km runners. Advance registration is online, and the entry fee is paid by bank transfer. There are various distances and age groups, as well as games and entertainment during the event.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego to najstarszy, nieprzerwanie organizowany nocny maraton w Polsce, odbywający się od 2007 roku. Bieg rozgrywany jest w wyjątkowej, nocnej scenerii Plant Bydgoskich oraz wzdłuż unikatowych zabytków hydrotechniki, jakimi są śluzy z XVIII wieku na Kanale Bydgoskim - najstarszym śródlądowym kanale wodnym w Polsce. Zawody przyciągają biegaczy z całego kraju oraz zagranicy, oferując bogate pakiety startowe, oryginalne medale i koszulki oraz profesjonalny pomiar czasu. Impreza ma rosnący prestiż i jest znana z żywej atmosfery, muzyki na żywo oraz licznych atrakcji towarzyszących.
course_highlights: Nocny bieg w scenerii Plant Bydgoskich
Trasa wzdłuż zabytkowych śluz XVIII-wiecznego Kanału Bydgoskiego
Unikalna atmosfera z muzyką na żywo i artystycznymi wrażeniami
additional: Klasyfikacja odbywa się na 6 dystansach. Uczestnicy otrzymują oryginalne medale, okolicznościowe koszulki oraz bogate pakiety startowe. Zapewniony jest profesjonalny elektroniczny pomiar czasu i numery startowe. Impreza odbywa się z muzyką na żywo, co podnosi atrakcyjność dla biegaczy i kibiców. Wydarzenie obejmuje 6 dystansów, elektroniczny pomiar czasu, pamiątkowe medale i koszulki, a także bogate pakiety startowe. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalne oznakowanie i oprawę artystyczną podczas biegu.

name: 15 Piknik Biegowy Biała Biega
description: 15 Piknik Biegowy Biała Biega to rodzinne wydarzenie biegowe organizowane w Białej Podlaskiej, które przyciąga biegaczy w różnym wieku i o różnym stopniu zaawansowania. Impreza ma charakter pikniku, łącząc sportową rywalizację z dobrą zabawą i integracją lokalnej społeczności. Na liście uczestników znajduje się już ponad 260 osób, co świadczy o dużym zainteresowaniu i przyjaznej atmosferze wydarzenia.
additional: Na liście zapisanych jest już ponad 260 osób, co wskazuje na dużą popularność wydarzenia. Impreza ma charakter rodzinnego pikniku biegowego, co sugeruje obecność atrakcji dla różnych grup wiekowych i integrację uczestników.

name: TATRA FEST 2026
description: Tatra Fest to wyjątkowy festiwal górski odbywający się w Zakopanem, oferujący różnorodne aktywności biegowe, wspinaczkowe i trekkingowe. Najbardziej znanym wydarzeniem jest TATRA FEST BIEG 68 km, wymagający bieg typu skyrunning po tatrzańskich szlakach, z trasą przebiegającą powyżej 2000 m n.p.m. oraz znacznymi przewyższeniami. Festiwal promuje kontakt z naturą, aktywność fizyczną i odpowiedzialność ekologiczną, zapraszając do outdoorowego świętowania życia i Tatr.
course_highlights: Trasa TATRA FEST BIEG 68 km przebiega po tatrzańskich szlakach powyżej 2000 m n.p.m.
Najdłuższy podbieg i zbieg mają około 1100 m deniwelacji.
Eksponowane górskie szlaki z linami poręczowymi na niektórych odcinkach.
additional: Biuro zawodów mieści się w Sokolni, ul. Orkana 2. Na trasie biegu 68 km znajdują się punkty limitów czasowych na Kasprowym Wierchu, Hali Ornak, Polanie Chochołowskiej i Zahradziskach. Start i meta w Parku Miejskim w Zakopanem. Weryfikacja obowiązkowego sprzętu odbywa się przed startem. W trakcie festiwalu odbywają się także warsztaty, wycieczki i inne aktywności outdoorowe.

name: Zawojski Festiwal Biegowy
description: Zawojski Festiwal Biegowy to jedna z największych imprez sportowych w regionie, odbywająca się w malowniczej scenerii Babiej Góry i Pasma Policy. Festiwal promuje biegi górskie oraz aktywny styl życia, oferując uczestnikom sportowe wyzwania i możliwość poznania bogactwa przyrodniczego i kulturowego Babiogórskiego Parku Narodowego. Wydarzenie przyciąga biegaczy z całej Polski i zagranicy, łącząc pasję do biegania z pięknem górskiej przyrody. W programie znajdują się różnorodne dystanse, od krótkich biegów dla dzieci po ultramaraton górski.
course_highlights: Trasa ultramaratonu o długości 63 km z przewyższeniem 3340 m
Malownicze widoki Babiej Góry i Pasma Policy
Różnorodne dystanse dostosowane do różnych grup wiekowych i poziomów zaawansowania
additional: Limit uczestników: 200 biegaczy na dystansach 63 km i 42,9 km, 300 na półmaratonie, 250 na dystansie 6,2 km. Starty rozłożone są na różne godziny: 5:00 (63 km), 10:00 (42,9 km), 15:00 (półmaraton i 6,2 km). Limit czasu na najdłuższy dystans to 15 godzin. W programie także biegi dziecięce na dystansach od 100 m do 800 m, podzielone na kategorie wiekowe.

name: XVII Elbląski Bieg Piekarczyka Mini Bieg Piekarczyka
description: Elbląski Bieg Piekarczyka to jedna z największych i najbardziej rozpoznawalnych imprez biegowych w Elblągu, odbywająca się corocznie w czerwcu. Wydarzenie ma charakter dwudniowy, łącząc sportową rywalizację z licznymi atrakcjami towarzyszącymi, w tym biegami na różnych dystansach oraz animacjami dla dzieci. Trasa biegu prowadzi ulicami centrum miasta, oferując płaską nawierzchnię asfaltowo-kostkową z jednym podbiegiem, co sprzyja szybkim wynikom. Bieg przyciąga zarówno zawodników amatorów, jak i bardziej doświadczonych biegaczy, a także licznych kibiców wspierających uczestników na trasie.
course_highlights: Trasa płaska z jednym podbiegiem na ul. Teatralnej
Asfalt (80%) i kostka brukowa (20%)
Trasa atestowana przez Polski Związek Lekkiej Atletyki
additional: Limit czasu ukończenia zawodów wynosi 1 godzinę i 30 minut. Mini Bieg Piekarczyka odbywa się na pętlach ulicy Teatralnej o długościach od 50 do 600 metrów, dostosowanych do wieku dzieci. Pakiety startowe wydawane są w dwóch lokalizacjach: Centrum Handlowe Ogrody (13 czerwca) oraz lodowisko „Helena” MOSiR (14 czerwca). Osoby powyżej 70 roku życia są zwolnione z opłaty startowej po rejestracji.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
location: Park przy dworcu kolejowym, Oława, Polska
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie; Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: Bieg Charytatywny CZTERY PORY ROKU - Etap IV to wydarzenie sportowe organizowane w Oławie, w parku przy dworcu kolejowym. Uczestnicy mogą wziąć udział w biegu na około 5 km lub marszu Nordic Walking na tej samej trasie. Impreza ma charakter charytatywny i jest koordynowana przez lokalne stowarzyszenie oraz Urząd Miejski w Oławie. Biuro zawodów działa w dniu biegu, a pomiar czasu jest elektroniczny, co zapewnia profesjonalną organizację.
course_highlights: Trasa biegu i marszu o długości około 5 km
Start i meta w parku przy dworcu kolejowym w Oławie
Elektroniczny pomiar czasu zapewniony przez ZmierzymyCzas.pl
additional: Biuro zawodów czynne w dniu biegu w godz. 09:30-10:30 w pobliżu startu. Kategorie: bieg ok. 5 km oraz marsz Nordic Walking ok. 5 km. Organizatorzy zapewniają regulamin, oświadczenia rodzica/opiekuna i uczestnika. Koordynacja biegu: Mariusz Jarosławski i Mateusz Bularz. Informacje o dostępnych dystansach i miejscu wydarzenia pochodzą z opisu IV etapu cyklu.

name: Dziki Trail
description: Dziki Groń to górski bieg ultra odbywający się w malowniczej okolicy Pienin, ze startem i metą w Szczawnicy na Placu Dietla. Trasa o długości około 54 km prowadzi przez wymagające, naturalne tereny z pięcioma punktami żywieniowymi, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe widoki i wyzwania. Bieg jest częścią Pieniny Ultra-Trail®, a uczestnicy otrzymują pamiątkowe medale oraz mają szansę na nagrody i statuetki dla najlepszych zawodników. Organizatorzy dbają o środowisko, eliminując plastikowe kubki na punktach odżywczych.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości około 54 km przez Pieniny z pięcioma punktami żywieniowymi
Start i meta w Szczawnicy na Placu Dietla
Naturalne, górskie tereny z wymagającym profilem wysokościowym
additional: Obowiązkowe wyposażenie: numer startowy i chip na bucie, pojemnik na wodę o pojemności co najmniej 0,5 litra, telefon komórkowy z działającą baterią. Na trasie 5 bufetów, w tym jeden z samą wodą. Organizator nie udostępnia plastikowych kubków na punktach żywieniowych. Pamiątkowe medale dla wszystkich finisherów oraz nagrody dla najlepszych zawodników. Szczegóły nagród zostaną opublikowane do 31.03.2027.

name: IV Charytatywny Bieg z Żonkilem
location: Klubokawiarnia Laba, Wyspa Bolko, Opole, Polska
description: IV Charytatywny Bieg z Żonkilem to wydarzenie sportowe organizowane w Opolu, które łączy pasję do biegania z celami charytatywnymi. Bieg ma charakter integracyjny i promuje aktywność fizyczną oraz wsparcie dla potrzebujących. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalny pomiar czasu oraz przyjazną atmosferę. Impreza odbywa się w malowniczych okolicach Opola, zachęcając do udziału biegaczy na różnych poziomach zaawansowania.

name: Rozbiegane Suwałki
description: Rozbiegane Suwałki to coroczne miejskie święto biegania, które odbywa się w czerwcu w Suwałkach. Wydarzenie trwa trzy dni i przyciąga setki uczestników w różnym wieku i o różnym poziomie zaawansowania. W programie znajdują się biegi dla dzieci, Bieg na Piątkę (5 km), Suwalska Ćwiartka (10,5 km) oraz Śniadaniowy Bieg na Wyspę (ok. 3,5 km). Trasy są płaskie i szybkie, sprzyjające biciu życiówek, a atmosfera jest pełna sportowej rywalizacji i integracji mieszkańców.
course_highlights: Płaskie, szybkie trasy miejskie
Wieczorny bieg główny na 10,5 km - Suwalska Ćwiartka
Różnorodne dystanse dla dzieci i dorosłych
additional: Wydarzenie trwa trzy dni i obejmuje biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży, bieg na 5 km, bieg główny na 10,5 km w wieczornej scenerii oraz rekreacyjny bieg na ok. 3,5 km z śniadaniem na finiszu. Organizator to Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach, który oferuje także wypożyczalnię rowerów i sprzętu wodnego oraz wynajem obiektów sportowych.

name: Suszecki dziki bieg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Zapisy i wpłaty drogą elektroniczną na stronie: https://bgtimesport.pl/ do dnia 10.06.2027 r. do godz. 21:59 - biegi dla dorosłych

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Zapisy i wpłaty drogą elektroniczną na stronie: https://bgtimesport.pl/ do dnia 11.06.2027 r. do godz. 21:59 - biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży

late_fee.price: 25 zł do 50 zł (gotówką w biurze zawodów, jeśli będą wolne pakiety)

description: Suszecki Festiwal Biegowy to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Gminny Ośrodek Sportu w Suszcu, która promuje aktywny tryb życia wśród dzieci, młodzieży i dorosłych. Wydarzenie odbywa się na terenie Ośrodka Rekreacyjnego „Gwaruś” i obejmuje różnorodne biegi terenowo-przeszkodowe dla najmłodszych, biegi młodzieżowe na 800 i 1600 metrów oraz dystanse dla dorosłych, w tym Dziki Super Dublet na 10 i 21 km. Impreza ma charakter rodzinny i integracyjny, z licznymi atrakcjami dla uczestników w różnym wieku.
course_highlights: Biegi terenowo-przeszkodowe dla dzieci do 9 lat
Młodzieżowe biegi na 800 m i 1600 m
Dziki Super Dublet: 10 km i 21 km na trasach terenowych
additional: Biuro zawodów otwarte: sobota 12:00-14:55, niedziela 8:00-10:00. Zapisy na poszczególne biegi należy dokonać najpóźniej 30 minut przed startem. Dostępny tor terenowo-przeszkodowy dla dzieci i młodzieży. Ceremonie dekoracji po biegach dziecięcych i półmaratonie. Możliwość płatności gotówką w kasie hali sportowej oraz w biurze zawodów.

name: VIII Rodzinny Festiwal Biegowy o Złotą K...
X Bieg o Złotą Monetę
description: IX Charytatywny Bieg o Złotą Monetę w Olsztynie to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Fundację Przyszłość dla Dzieci, której celem jest wsparcie chorych i niepełnosprawnych dzieci z Warmii i Mazur. Bieg główny na dystansie 5 km odbywa się nad jeziorem Ukiel i jest dostępny dla biegaczy na różnym poziomie zaawansowania, także dla debiutantów. Wydarzeniu towarzyszy piknik rodzinny oraz liczne atrakcje, a uczestnicy mają okazję pomagać poprzez aktywność fizyczną i zabawę. Bieg jest finałem akcji „DOBRO ODDAJE” i wspiera rehabilitację oraz zakup sprzętu medycznego dla dzieci.
course_highlights: Malownicza trasa nad jeziorem Ukiel w Olsztynie
Przyjazna i dostępna dla biegaczy na każdym poziomie, także do marszu
Dystans 5 km z limitem czasu jednej godziny
additional: Wydarzeniu towarzyszą biegi towarzyszące dla dzieci na dystansach od 400 m oraz biegi juniorów i młodzików na dystansach dostosowanych do wieku. Gościem specjalnym jest wielokrotna mistrzyni Polski i świata w podnoszeniu ciężarów Krystyna Abramczyk Puzio. Po biegu odbywa się piknik rodzinny z nagrodami i upominkami dla uczestników.

name: Maraton Smolecki
location: Smolec, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Polska

name: Mrowna Run Grodzisk łączy w biegu
Kefenröder Dorflauf
description: The 35th Dorflauf in Kefenrod is taking place and is organized by Turnverein 1908 Kefenrod e.V. The event gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in a traditional race in the idyllic surroundings of Kefenrod. Registration is through the Oberhessencup website, making it easy to sign up in advance. The race is a regular part of club life and promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.
course_highlights: Four laps through Kefenrod on a varied elevation profile
Distances of 1 km and 10 km for different ability levels
Festive awards ceremony with food and a communal atmosphere
additional: Registration is through the Oberhessencup website (ohc18). No start times or pricing tiers are listed directly on the website. The race is part of the club life of TV 1908 Kefenrod e.V. It is part of the local running calendar and, alongside the competition, offers a convivial atmosphere with coffee, cake, beer, and grilled food at the awards ceremony.

name: Barmstedter Stadtlauf
description: The 22nd Barmstedt City Run takes place in Barmstedt. The event offers measured 5 km and 10 km circuits that are eligible for rankings. In addition to the main races, there are Nordic walking, walking, children’s and toddlers’ races. The start and finish are at the market square in Barmstedt, and the route runs through the town centre and around Lake Rantzau, on a variety of surfaces including cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km circuits, eligible for rankings
Route through Barmstedt’s town centre and around Lake Rantzau
Varied surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths
additional: Timing is done with a loan chip worn around the ankle (except for the children’s races), which is collected at the finish. Unreturned chips will be charged at 40 euros. Jogging strollers and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. The races have different age categories and minimum ages. The route may vary slightly due to construction work; updates will be posted on the website. Routes are measured; surfaces vary; online registration is available; no late registrations; refreshments and medals are included.

name: Donatus-Lauf
location: Sportgelände SC Fortuna Liblar, Hamburg-Rissen, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Donatuslauf takes place around Lake Donatus on the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds in Hamburg-Rissen. The event offers a range of race distances, from a 400 m toddlers’ run and 1,200 m schoolchildren’s races to a half marathon and a 10 km main race. The races are designed for different age groups and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with additional walking and family races. The course is varied and clearly marked, with the start and finish area close to Erftstadt railway station. Awards ceremonies take place shortly after the races, and certificates can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400 m to a half marathon
Start and finish area near Erftstadt railway station, with easy access
Family race and Nordic walking as additional offerings
additional: Late entries are accepted only until the participant limit is reached and incur a €3 late-entry fee. Awards ceremonies take place on the sports grounds immediately after the respective races. Parking is available only at Erftstadt railway station, just 100 m from the start and finish area. Certificates can be downloaded online as PDFs and printed. Courses around Lake Donatus, online registration, parking at Erftstadt railway station, start and finish area at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds

name: Kirschlauf
description: The Kirschlauf in Kleinfahner, organized by USV Erfurt, is a traditional race with a history spanning more than 20 years. The 24th edition takes runners along scenic routes with challenging highland trails. The event offers various distances, including a 14-kilometer main race, a 4.5-kilometer fun run, and races for schoolchildren and young children. The awards ceremony is traditionally conducted by the Thuringian Cherry Queen, and the race is part of the TLV Running Cup.
course_highlights: 14-kilometer main race along a scenic highland trail with views across the northern Thuringian Basin
4.5 km fun run with challenging terrain in the Imtal valley
Finish through a cherry orchard above Kleinfahner with magnificent views
additional: Race packet pickup from 8:00 a.m. at the event tent by the mill. Late entries are possible online from June 13 at 2:00 a.m. and on race day until 30 minutes before the race, with a €5 late entry fee. Awards ceremonies take place from approximately 9:45 a.m. for the schoolchildren’s races and from approximately 11:30 a.m. for the other races.

name: Handewitter Sommerlauf
description: The Handewitt Summer Run on June 27, 2027, offers runners of all ability levels suitable routes with little elevation gain. From the Bambini race to 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, Nordic walking, half marathon, relay and wheelchair races, there is something for everyone. The event takes place around the Wikinghalle in Handewitt and stands out for its excellent organization, lively atmosphere and unforgettable finish-line experience. The DLV-measured courses invite both beginners and ambitious runners to make their race day their own.
course_highlights: Routes with little elevation gain around the Wikinghalle and through Handewitt
A variety of DLV-measured courses, from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon
Water, apples and bananas at aid stations on the longer routes
additional: Start and finish area at the Wikinghalle in Handewitt. Bib pickup on Saturday from 12:00 to 16:00 and on Sunday from 08:30. Wooden medals; no paper cups; reusable cup system. Drinks and fruit available in the finish area and along the courses. Online certificates available to download after the race. Parking within walking distance of the event venue, which is also accessible by public transport. Transfers to another race category are possible up to the registration deadline for a fee.

name: Drei-Länder-Lauf
description: The Three-Country Run takes place in Arenshausen and connects the regions of Thuringia, Lower Saxony and Hesse. The event offers various race distances, including 1.2 km, 2 km, 5 km and 13 km, some of which are loop courses and others out-and-back races. In addition to the main races, there is a fun run for preschool children with no timing, as well as Nordic walking as a non-competitive event. The run has a long tradition as a symbol of the region growing together after German reunification.

name: Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf
description: The Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf is a long-standing running event in Schackensleben, about 25 km west of Magdeburg. Distances of 400 m, 1.4 km, 6.0 km and 10.8 km are offered, running through the village and the surrounding countryside with the gently undulating profile typical of the Börde region. The races take place on roads and paved farm tracks and feature several drink stations. Participants have access to good changing and shower facilities, as well as extensive refreshments including coffee, cake, drinks and grilled food. After finishing, runners can refuel with drinks and fruit, and there is a traditional raffle with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Route through Schackensleben and the surrounding countryside, with a gently undulating profile
Running on roads and paved farm tracks
Several drink stations along the route
additional: The start and finish for all distances are at the sports field, with changing and shower facilities in the clubhouse. Refreshments include coffee, cake, lard sandwiches, drinks and grilled food. After finishing, participants are offered drinks and fruit. A raffle with attractive prizes takes place alongside the awards ceremony. The Hopfenlauf is part of the Novo Nordisk Landescup and the Elbe-Ohre-Cup.

name: REWE Women´s Run Hamburg
description: The REWE Women’s Run Hamburg is a road race for beginners and ambitious runners in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg. The event offers a measured 10 km loop course starting and finishing at Ballindamm. In addition to the main race, there is also the REWE Girl’s Run for girls aged 5 to 10 over 1 kilometer. Participants receive a finisher medal and can use showers and changing facilities after the race.

name: Heidenheimer Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The Heidenheimer Sparkasse City Run offers a variety of races for everyone from beginners to half-marathon runners through downtown Heidenheim. The half marathon follows two almost identical laps through the city, passing landmarks such as Pauluskirche, the city library, and Brenzpark. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km races, as well as races for schoolchildren and young children. All participants receive chip timing with a transponder integrated into their race number and a generous selection of refreshments at the finish.

name: Herzogstadtlauf Straubing
description: The Herzogstadtlauf in Straubing is a long-standing popular race that welcomes runners of all ages. From the children’s race and a range of distances to the BMW Half Marathon, the event offers a varied program with attractive routes through the historic city and city park. Alongside the sporting challenge, an extensive supporting program featuring stage performances and DJ music creates a lively atmosphere. The event promotes community and health and is a highlight of the Eastern Bavarian running calendar.

name: Metropolmarathon
organizer: Laufteam Fürth 2010 und Team Klinikum Nürnberg
description: The Sparkassen Metropolmarathon 2026 will take place on June 13 and 14 in the cities of Fürth and Nuremberg. The running event connects two cities with varied routes, numerous competitions and a colorful supporting program. With around 9,000 participants and 600 volunteers, the Metropolmarathon offers a weekend full of exercise, fun and community. The events range from the marathon and half marathon to 10 km races, Nordic walking, and races for children and young people.

name: Sparkassenlauf
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a long-established running event with DLV-certified courses over 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The races take runners through Wittringer Wald on a flat, fast loop course featuring paved walking paths, asphalt and a tartan track. All participants receive a personalised race number bearing their name and a finisher’s medal. The event also hosts the district road running championships and offers net times and live timing.

name: Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund
description: The Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund is a traditional race in the town of Kappeln, held annually by TSV Kappeln. The event gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to run on a varied course through the town and its surroundings. The race promotes recreational sport and a sense of community in the region. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through Kappeln city center
A varied route with urban and natural sections
Suitable for runners of all age groups and ability levels
additional: The event is organized by TSV Kappeln, a sports club offering a wide range of activities. The website provides no explicit information about start times, waves, or special amenities. Registration is online via the entry-fee page. The event is part of the club's program and is regularly announced in TSV Kappeln's news.

name: Alfelder Bernd Meyer Staffelmarathon
description: The Alfelder Bernd Meyer Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay marathon held in Alfeld (Leine). The event is open to runners from across the region and is organized jointly by several local running clubs and the town of Alfeld. The course is an approximately 3 km loop, run twice, with the start and finish on the market square. Each team consists of 7 runners, who must be registered by name. Timing is electronic, using disposable transponders. There is also a children’s race of approximately 700 m.

name: Bad Kohlgruber Schluchtlauf
description: The Bad Kohlgrub Gorge Run is a scenic race in the Alpine foothills that, despite its name, is not a mountain race. The course is gently undulating and consists of 20% asphalt and 80% forest paths. The event takes place at the Sport and Leisure Center at Erle in Bad Kohlgrub and offers free drinks along the route and at the finish. Coffee, cake, food, and drinks are available, and all participants receive certificates, with trophies for the age-group winners.

name: Barsbütteler Volkslauf
description: The Barsbüttel Fun Run is a long-standing running event held every June at the sports field in the Barsbüttel Sports Center. It offers a range of distances from 400 m to 10 km, which are mostly flat and run along paved or firm, sandy farm tracks. Most of the routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbüttel countryside and offer scenic views, particularly the longer 5 km and 10 km routes. Times are measured electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterward. Food and refreshments are also available for runners and spectators.

name: Famberglauf
description: The Famberglauf is a running event held in June in Fambach, organized by SV Schwarz-Weiß Fambach 09 e.V. The program offers four distances: a half marathon of 21.1 km, the 10.9 km Famberglauf, the 5 km Famberg Sprint, and a 1000 m children’s race. The event is aimed at runners of all ages and abilities and has more of the feel of a family-friendly club run than a major competition.

name: Kirchenkirnberger Wald- und Wiesenlauf
description: The 3rd Kirchenkirnberg Forest and Meadow Run takes place in Murrhardt. It is a short running race with two distances, taking runners through forest and meadow landscapes. The race offers a pleasant running atmosphere in typical June weather, with mild temperatures and mostly sunny days. Runners of all ages are warmly invited to take part and enjoy the nature around Murrhardt.

name: Ludwigsluster Schlossgartenlauf
description: The Ludwigslust Palace Garden Run takes place in Ludwigslust Palace Park and offers runners of all ages a varied choice of distances. The routes range from 2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, with additional walking events over 5 and 10 km. New to the program is a fun run for the youngest children, with no registration or timing, who receive an official medal at the finish. This traditional event warmly welcomes beginners and professionals alike to enjoy the beautiful park landscape.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře
location: Fotbalový stadion, Alejní ulice, Kravaře, Czech Republic
description: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře is a running race held mainly on gravel paths through the chateau park, on a flat course. The race takes place at the football stadium in Kravaře and also includes children’s races. It is organized by Prajzský BK Kravaře, which welcomes all runners to this pleasant and friendly event.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly along gravel paths through the chateau park
Flat course
Children’s races
additional: The first category starts at 9:15, and the main category starts at 10:00. The organizer is Prajzský BK Kravaře; the contact person is Jan Ferenz. The race is mixed and takes place in the Moravian-Silesian Region, at the football stadium on Alejní Street in Kravaře. In 2026, the start was at the football stadium on Alejní Street. Price information applies to the 2026 edition and has not been confirmed for 2027.

name: Půlmaraton okolo Prahy 4
description: The Half Marathon Around Prague 4 is a unique individual running event offering a meditative running experience on the varied terrain of an urban trail. The course is approximately 21 kilometres long and follows the perimeter of the Prague 4 district, giving participants the chance to get to know the area as well as assess their own running form. There is no mass start: runners set off individually or in small groups between 9:00 and 10:00, avoiding stress and congestion at the start and on the course. Following a successful debut, the half marathon is being held for the second time and is suitable for anyone who wants to combine athletic performance with an enjoyable experience in both nature and the city.

name: Chaloupecký kros
description: The Chaloupky Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Chaloupky near Komárov. The race offers two main routes, approximately 8 km and 4 km long, which run along paved roads, forest trails, and meadows. The main race starts at 10:00, giving participants the chance to enjoy a combination of natural beauty and sporting challenge. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for the general public; there are no children’s categories.

name: Běh na Hraničář
description: Běh na Hraničář is a traditional and prestigious uphill race held in the picturesque setting of the forest amphitheatre by the Úhlava River in Nýrsko. The 5 km route, with 380 metres of elevation gain, passes the ruins of Pajrek Castle and finishes at the summit of Hraničář, offering a wonderful view of Mount Ostrý. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and, after a three-year break, has been held again since 2020. After the race, participants must make their own way back to the start.

name: Dobývání Dívčích hradů
description: The Conquest of Dívčí hrady is a 2 km uphill race with an elevation gain of 135 metres, held in Hlubočepy, Prague 5. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and offers runners the challenge of a demanding climb. The course passes through picturesque terrain with beautiful views, making the race appealing to fans of mountain running and hill running. It is suitable for anyone looking to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain.

name: Račiansky kros – leto
description: Račiansky kros LETO is a running race held in Bratislava-Rača, offering three courses of varying distances and elevation gains. The route runs mostly through forest terrain, with some asphalt sections, and is well marked with colored ribbons and arrows on the ground and on trees. Runners can compete on the 16 km and 9.5 km courses, as well as children’s courses. The start and finish are in Knižkova dolina. The event is suitable for the general public and offers age- and gender-based categories, with prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: 16 km course with +503 m elevation gain and a 3-hour time limit
9.5 km course with +335 m elevation gain and a 2-hour time limit
The course surface is 80% forest and 20% asphalt
additional: The route is marked with pink ribbons, white flour arrows on the ground, and laminated arrows on trees in blue, pink, and orange. The required gear is a race bib, visibly fastened to the chest. The race results are scheduled to be announced shortly after the last runners finish.

name: Vranovská desiatka
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Dom kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou, M. R. Štefánika 875
organizer: Mesto Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský športový klub Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský dom kultúry
description: Vranovská desiatka is a traditional running race in the town of Vranov nad Topľou, offering 10 km and 5 km courses. The race is organized by the Town of Vranov nad Topľou, the Municipal Sports Club, and the Municipal Cultural Centre. Categories are divided by age and gender, and the top three runners from Vranov are also recognized. The start and finish are at the Cultural Centre in Vranov nad Topľou. The race is suitable for the general public, from recreational runners to competitors.

name: Čeľovská sedmička
location: Čeľovce, okr. Trebišov, Čeľovce, okr. Trebišov, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Čeľovská sedmička is a running event held in the village of Čeľovce, Trebišov District, in front of the Cultural Centre. The race is open to various categories, including men, women, families and children, and also offers a summer walk and a competition for the youngest runners. The event is part of the Beh.sk running community and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant setting of the village.

name: Tatranská 15
organizer: Obecný úrad Mlynčeky, Športoví nadšenci z Mlynčekov
description: Tatranská 15 is a running race organized by the Mlynčeky Municipal Office and sports enthusiasts from Mlynčeky. The race takes place at the football field in Mlynčeky and offers runners the chance to experience the atmosphere of a sporting event in beautiful surroundings. A discounted entry fee is available for early registration, and it is also possible to register on race day. The organizers welcome all runners and sports enthusiasts to this traditional event.

name: Alytaus maratonas 2026
location: Didžiosios Dailidės ežero apylinkės, Alytus, Alytaus rajonas, Lithuania
description: In Alytus, around the Great Dailidė Lake. The event aims to promote running in Lithuania and raise Alytus’s profile, inviting both amateurs and professionals to compete in distances ranging from a 500 m children’s race to a full marathon. Participants can choose from several running and Nordic walking distances, and the courses are technically prepared for competition with electronic timing. The event is organized by VšĮ „Maratomanija“ and ensures safe and fair competition for all participants.
course_highlights: Distances from a 500 m children’s race to a 42.195 km marathon
Start and finish by Great Dailidė Lake in Alytus
Electronic timing using a chip attached to the race shirt
additional: Participants are prohibited from using vehicles on the course. Timing is conducted with an electronic chip that must be attached to the front of the race shirt. Time limits: marathon, 6 hours; half marathon, 3 hours; 10.6 km, 2 hours; 5.3 km, 1 hour; 2 km, 0.5 hours; Nordic walking distances, 5 hours. Start times for the different distances: 12:00 for most races, 16:30 for the 2 km race, and 16:45 for the 500 m children’s race. Water and refreshment stations will be available at the event. The participant limit is 300, and distances include children’s and family races. Registration opens on April 1 and remains open until the day of the event.

name: 2 Yellow Ribbon Run Polska
location: Park Leśnicki, Zamek w Leśnicy, Wrocław, Polska
description: Yellow Ribbon Run Polska to międzynarodowa inicjatywa promująca ideę drugiej szansy i readaptacji społecznej osób po odbyciu kary pozbawienia wolności. Bieg odbywa się w Parku Leśnickim wokół Zamku w Leśnicy we Wrocławiu i ma na celu przełamywanie stereotypów oraz wspieranie reintegracji społecznej byłych skazanych. Wydarzenie organizowane jest przez Ministerstwo Sprawiedliwości i stanowi ważny element działań edukacyjnych i promocyjnych na rzecz inkluzywnego społeczeństwa. Uczestnicy biegu wyrażają solidarność z osobami walczącymi o nową, czystą kartę w życiu.
course_highlights: Trasa biegu prowadzi przez malowniczy Park Leśnicki wokół Zamku w Leśnicy
Bieg ma charakter symboliczny, promujący ideę drugiej szansy i przeciwdziałanie stygmatyzacji
Wydarzenie odbywa się na terenie historycznego zamku i otaczającego go parku
additional: Wydarzenie jest częścią dwudniowego programu odbywającego się na zamku i w parku Leśnickim. Projekt jest częściowo finansowany ze środków Funduszu Sprawiedliwości. Wiceminister sprawiedliwości Maria Ejchart bierze udział w biegu, podkreślając znaczenie inicjatywy. Wydarzenie łączy uczestników z różnych środowisk, w tym osoby po odbyciu kary pozbawienia wolności, funkcjonariuszy Służby Więziennej i mieszkańców.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, czyli Aktywny Czerwonak Nocą to cykliczne, bezpłatne wydarzenie sportowe organizowane przez Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej w Czerwonaku. Impreza odbywa się wieczorem i łączy aktywność fizyczną z integracją lokalnej społeczności. To już wieloletnia tradycja, która przyciąga uczestników chcących spędzić czas na świeżym powietrzu w sportowej atmosferze. Wydarzenie jest częścią Grand Prix Czerwonaka i odbywa się regularnie, promując zdrowy styl życia.
course_highlights: Bieg odbywa się w Bolechowie, w gminie Czerwonak.
Poprzednia odnotowana edycja obejmowała dystans 5 km.
Wydarzenie jest częścią cyklu Aktywny Czerwonak Nocą.
additional: Wydarzenie jest bezpłatne i odbywa się wieczorem, zwykle w godzinach 19:30-22:00. To spotkanie sportowe organizowane regularnie, będące częścią cyklu Grand Prix Czerwonaka. Brak informacji o limitach uczestników, opłatach czy wymaganym sprzęcie.

name: 95. Terrainkurweg Marathon
description: The 95th Terrainkurweg Marathon in Salzgitter is a challenging run on a hilly course with about 150 meters of elevation gain and loss. The route passes through Vöppstedter Forest, by the Liebenburg forester’s lodge, and along the Salzgitter golf course. The event is not an official DLV event and is intended for well-trained runners. Refreshments, including drinks and snacks, are available in a covered room.

name: Unicredit Pražská štafeta RunCzech
organizer: Prague International Marathon, spol. s r.o. (RunCzech)
description: The UniCredit Prague Relay is a traditional relay race organized as part of the RunCzech series and held at Prague Exhibition Grounds. The race gives teams the opportunity to compete in different relay categories and is known for its friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The organizers emphasize fair conditions and support for the running community in Prague and throughout the Czech Republic. The race is part of the wider RunCzech running events calendar, which also includes marathons and half marathons.
course_highlights: Relay race at Prague Exhibition Grounds
Various relay categories, including special categories
Professional organization with support from experienced pacers
additional: The race pack contains everything runners need. Photography is provided by witisi.photo; photos can be pre-ordered during registration or ordered after the race. Relay categories have a dedicated lane marked with RELAY and 2RUN flags. The organizers recommend using the RunCzech mobile app for better navigation and information during the race. The Prague Relay 2027 takes place from June 22 to 24; the specific date listed for this race is June 22, 2027.

name: Kros Otakara Pachmanna
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Otakar Pachmann Cross-Country Race is a 4.4 km race through the beautiful natural surroundings of Krčský les in Prague 4. It is part of the SABZO series and gives runners the chance to enjoy natural terrain and a woodland atmosphere. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and wants a sporting challenge in peaceful woodland surroundings.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 2 etapas
description: Jonava Running Cup - 2026, Stage 2 is a running event taking place in the village of Ragožiai, Jonava District. This traditional race is intended for active sports enthusiasts and offers various distances and the opportunity to test their endurance and strength. The event is open to everyone who wants to spend time actively and enjoy running in nature. It is organized by the Lithuanian Amateur Runners Association, which ensures the smooth running of the competition and participants’ comfort.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the surroundings of the village of Ragožiai
Different distances are adapted for runners of various levels
Nature and natural trails provide an enjoyable running experience
additional: The event is open to all active and sporty people in Lithuania. Among the different distances and obstacle courses, everyone can find a suitable challenge or activity. There is no specific information about the event course or the number of participants; registration takes place through the official platform.

name: 4. Stadtwald-Firmenlauf
description: The 4th Stadtwald Corporate Run in Oberhain (Königsee) is a community running event that brings together companies and teams from the region. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of exercise in a natural setting. The run takes place in the Stadtwald and offers a pleasant course for all participants. It is a great opportunity to combine sport, fun, and community.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque Stadtwald of Oberhain
Natural and varied course
Ideal for company teams and running together

name: Sommernachtslauf am Hufeisen
description: The Summer Night Run at Hufeisen is a traditional race in the municipality of Linsengericht, organized by Laufteam Gelnhausen for more than 20 years. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and high participation, attracting runners from the Main-Kinzig district and beyond.
