name: Binner Abendlauf
description: The Binner Evening Run is a long-standing running event held as part of the sports festival of Sport- und Jugendbund Binnen e.V. The run offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, family atmosphere in Binnen. The event attracts runners of all ages and is a fixture on the regional sports calendar. Alongside the run, there is a varied sports festival with other activities and offerings for the whole family.

name: FORT FUN Westernlauf
description: The FORT FUN Western Run is a popular running event at FORT FUN Abenteuerland amusement park in Bestwig-Wasserfall. On the park grounds and in the surrounding forests, families and runners of all ages can choose from a total of 12 different races. The event is especially family-friendly and offers wonderful views, as well as the chance to enjoy the amusement park’s attractions afterward. The event is held in collaboration with TuS Valmetal and is ideal for active children, young people, and families.

name: Hofmann-Flechtkulturlauf-Obermain
description: The Hofmann-Flechtkulturlauf Obermain (FKLO) is a large-scale fun run in Lichtenfels, taking place for the 14th time. The event offers a variety of running and Nordic walking routes along the flat “Path of Basketry Culture” and welcomes both recreational and ambitious runners without a strong focus on performance. The Lichtenfels Wine Festival takes place alongside the race, making the day a sporting and sociable community event. Highlights include the Blue Light Championship for emergency services and competitions for company managers and teams on the 10.4 km course.

name: Hüttlinger Muffigellauf
description: The Hüttlingen Muffigelläufe offer a varied running and movement experience for all ages and ability levels. From the Bambini run for the youngest participants to children’s, school-age and youth races, as well as more challenging routes such as the 10 km run at Kocherknie and the 7 km run at the Limes, there is something for everyone. The Walk around the Limes also invites participants to take part at a relaxed pace. The event is organized by the dedicated running group of TSV Hüttlingen and places great emphasis on fun, community and unforgettable moments.

name: km Staffellauf-100 jahre TSV Brokstedt
description: The 100 km relay race celebrating the 100th anniversary of TSV Brokstedt is a special running event in which teams of young people and adults complete 50 laps in pairs to cover the total distance of 100 km. Children aged 13 and under can take part in a shorter version of 25 laps over 50 km. The event promotes team spirit and endurance and takes place at the sports ground in Brokstedt. Participation is limited to a maximum of 100 teams, and mixed teams with at least two women are encouraged.
course_highlights: Relay race with teams running in pairs
50 laps for 100 km (adults/young people); 25 laps for 50 km (children)
Event at the sports ground in Brokstedt
additional: Registration is by email to staffellauf@tsvbrokstedt.de. Please include the team captain and the expected number of runners. Withdrawal of the entire team is not possible.

name: Referees Run
description: The Referees Run is a 10-kilometer race held annually in Borgholzhausen since 2005 as part of the “Nacht von Borgholzhausen” fun run. The Gelsenkirchen Referees’ Association traditionally forms one of the largest groups at the race. The event promotes camaraderie among referees through sport and offers an athletic challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The race takes place and is managed by Stefan Tendyck.

name: Saucony Berlin 10K
description: The Saucony BLN 10K is a spectacular new race at Berlin’s historic Tempelhofer Feld. The event combines fast-paced urban running with a unique atmosphere at one of the city’s most historic sites. The start and finish are in the heritage-listed Hangar 6, alongside a cool-down zone with DJs, drinks, and street food. The course consists of two fast 5-kilometer laps, passing historic aircraft and running through the hangar, for an unforgettable experience combining urban lifestyle and music.

name: Sommerlauf Waren(Müritz) (LC/NLC)
description: The 4th Summer Run Waren (Müritz) is a running event organized by the SV Waren 09 e.V. running team. The race takes place at Müritzstadion in Waren (Müritz) and is open to children, young people, active runners and Masters. The event offers runners of all ages a sporting opportunity in beautiful surroundings. Registration is through the tollense-timing.de platform.

name: Stuifenläufe
description: The Stuifenläufe in Wißgoldingen is a traditional running event being held for the 74th time. The event includes various races, including races for schoolchildren, a kindergarten run, the Stuifen circuit, a mountain run, and Nordic walking. The routes cross varied terrain, with forest roads and a challenging steep climb to the summit. The races are suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels, offering a lovely combination of experiencing nature and sporting challenge.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is a cross-country race for experienced runners, enthusiasts, and amateurs, held in the picturesque Podblanicko region. The race offers two routes, 10 km and 5.2 km long, running mainly along field and forest paths for an enjoyable running experience in nature. This race is ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy running in a clean environment while testing their abilities against other runners. Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional event that attracts a wide running community.

name: Prague Park Race – Divoká Šárka
description: Prague Park Race – Divoká Šárka is a running race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. The race offers a unique atmosphere and breathtaking views for runners to enjoy on routes of 8 and 14 kilometres. The routes follow paved and unpaved roads, meadows and trails, and also partly use asphalt roads with limited traffic. The race is suitable for the general public and offers refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and registration take place at the SK ARITMA grounds in Prague-Vokovice, which are easily accessible by public transport and car.

name: Krosový běh Chudenickým Žďárem
location: Chudenice, sportovní areál Jalovčí, hřiště pod Bolfánkem, Plzeňský
description: The Run through Chudenice’s Žďár is a young cross-country race founded in 2016. It takes place amid the picturesque autumn scenery of Žďár Hill above the village of Chudenice. The course is a challenging cross-country run with no asphalt sections, a gently undulating profile, and an appealing climb up the forest steps to Bolfánek. The start and finish are located at the local sports club grounds. The main race is 6.2 km long and offers runners both a challenge and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Příborský běh
organizer: město Příbor, Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice
description: The Příbor Run is a traditional running race organized by the town of Příbor in cooperation with the Scout troop and the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race is open to both competitive runners and recreational runners, who can choose a distance to suit their abilities. The options include a 4.6 km recreational race, a 9.2 km competitive race, and relays made up of four runners (2 men + 2 women), with each runner completing a 2.3 km lap. There are also children’s races over various distances. The race has a friendly atmosphere and supports the region’s broad running community.

name: Běh Jana Opletala
description: The In the Footsteps of Jan Opletal Run and Jiří Vacek Memorial is a traditional running event organised by the Jan Opletal Grammar School in Litovel. The race commemorates notable figures and the history of the school and town. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Litovel region and is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting experience with a historical dimension.

name: Běh okolo Vraní skály
description: The Run Around Vraní Skála is a traditional running race held in Černín near Zdice, featuring a challenging course approximately 9 km long. The race combines a steep uphill road section, forest trails and narrow paths leading to the summit around Vraní Skála, followed by a rolling, mostly downhill section with a steep descent to the finish. The race starts in the square in Černín near Zdice, and the main race begins at 10:30. It is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for runners who enjoy a combination of road and trail running with significant elevation gain.

name: Běh na Kozlovský kopec
description: The Run to Kozlovský Hill is a traditional road hill race in Česká Třebová. The race starts at 10:00 on Habrmanova Street, in front of the Secondary Vocational School building, and finishes at Max Švabinský’s Chalet on Kozlovský Hill. The 5.2 km course climbs 230 metres and runs on asphalt. It is one of the more challenging races in the regional ISCAREX Cup series and the Czech Hill Running Cup. Race facilities are in the school building, where registration, changing rooms and toilets are available. You can register online in advance for a reduced entry fee or on race day.

name: Běh Memoriálu Petry Hézlové - MPH 2026 Louny
description: The Petra Hézlová Memorial is a charity sporting event held in Louny, offering running races for adults and children. The main race features 5 km and 10 km courses for men, women, and students, timed using chip timing. The event is part of a family sports afternoon and offers a varied programme of activities alongside the races. All participants receive a wooden commemorative medal, and there is a prize draw for a LIFEFIT.PRO treadmill. The memorial supports health and social projects, especially oncology.

name: Krakonošova pětadvacítka - B25
description: Krakonošova pětadvacítka (B25) is a 25-kilometer trail run held in Vrchlabí and part of the Krakonošova stovka race series. The course crosses mountainous terrain with approximately 903 meters of elevation gain and offers challenging conditions suited to experienced runners. The event takes place every June and attracts participants from across the Czech Republic who want to enjoy the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains and the challenge of a mountain run.

name: FarmaRun
description: FarmaRun 2026 is a family sports event organized by the Libchavští chlupáči animal sanctuary farm in Horní Libchava. The race offers a main 5 km run along a pleasantly shaded, flat cycle path, suitable for both runners and walkers. Children can take part in a short 300 m run, and there is an exhibition race for the youngest children, aged 4 and under, right on the farm grounds. After the race, participants receive a commemorative medal, a refreshing drink, and light refreshments. There is also an accompanying program for the whole family.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional cross-country race with a long history, held in Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race is open to all age groups and offers a range of distances, from children’s races to the men’s 7,800-metre event. The Lucky Náprstková Memorial commemorates a tragic event and is part of this sporting event. The organizer is the Czech Union of Sport, which encourages the general public to stay active and participate in sport.

name: Revírní POHO běh
description: The Revírní poho běh project is a unique running race for adults and children alike, set amid the breathtaking natural surroundings of the Karviná Sea. Inspired by the region’s mining history, it makes use of the potential of the post-mining landscape and its revitalized environment. Its aim is to introduce this unique place to the public and to athletes. With the motto “Run in POHO!”, the race offers routes for everyone and the joy of movement.
additional: Also featured: a 4 × 6 km relay race, children’s races, and a health festival

images.alt_text: Logo závodu Revírní POHO běh s textem poho 50 v moderním stylu
Běžci a diváci na závodě Revírní POHO běh pod modrým bannerem poho
Děti závodí v běhu na modrém povrchu během venkovní sportovní akce

name: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou
organizer: Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, Ružomberskie Strely o.z.
description: The Run Through Ludrovská Valley is a running event held in Ludrovská Valley near the football stadium in Ludrová. The races offer starts for children’s categories on grass and adult categories on forest trails and asphalt. The event is suitable for a wide range of ages, from children to seniors, with categories divided by age. The organizers are the Municipality of Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, and Ružomberskie Strely o.z., who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization.

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: The 2nd round of the Prešov Running Series, known as Šariš Run, is a running event held on the banks of the ponds in Veľký Šariš, beneath the historic Šariš Castle. This venue is new to the series and has become very popular with runners. The event is full of sporting spirit, community, and a love of nature, and also offers a rich program of activities, including musical performances, health booths, a relaxation zone, and activities for children. The friendly, family atmosphere makes the run an unforgettable experience for all participants.

name: Beh cez Zalužické poľa
location: Zalužice, okr. Michalovce, Zalužice, okr. Michalovce,
description: Run through the Zalužice Fields is the second edition of a running event held in the Zalužice area. This race gives runners the opportunity to experience the nature and beauty of Zemplín in summer. The event is part of the Zemplín Extreme series, which offers a range of running challenges in the region.

name: toRunská vrtuľa
location: Stará Turá, Stará Turá, ATC Dubník (KEMP53 - reštaurácia)
organizer: Zuzana Jankovičová, Lívia Skurská, Monika Tomisová
description: toRunská vrtuľa is a charity running and community day in the beautiful surroundings of the Dubník Reservoir in Stará Turá. The event focuses on exercise and helping others, with all proceeds from entry fees donated to fund rehabilitation for Simonka Zigová. Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps around Dubník as possible, in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. The organizers and volunteers run the event without compensation, emphasizing its community and charitable spirit.

name: Ruskovská deviatka
location: Športový areál, Nový Ruskov, Trebišov District, Slovakia
description: Ruskovská 9ka is a running race held at the sports complex in the village of Nový Ruskov. This traditional event gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on a course approximately 9 kilometres long. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant setting of the village.
course_highlights: The course runs through the sports complex in the village of Nový Ruskov
The course is approximately 9 kilometres long
The race is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners

name: Tatry charity run
location: Tatranská Lomnica, Tatranská Lomnica, Relax Park Jazierko
organizer: Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, mesto Vysoké Tatry, TANAP
description: Tatry Charity Run is a running event held in Tatranská Lomnica at Relax Park Jazierko. The course is mainly on asphalt and hard-packed terrain, ensuring a comfortable run for all participants. The race is open to the general public and offers categories for men and women in different age groups. It is organized by the Kotrmelec Sports Foundation, the town of Vysoké Tatry, and TANAP, who ensure the event runs smoothly. Online registration is available, with a limit of 300 runners. On-site registration is also available on race day.

name: Beh k Iliašovskej kapličke
description: The Run to the Chapel of Iliašovce is a running event held in Iliašovce at the FK56 football pitch. The race offers two main routes, 5.6 km and 10.8 km long, which run mainly along farm and forest roads. The main category starts at 10:00, and the children’s race starts at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of a wide range of ages, including children, and offers a pleasant atmosphere in nature.

name: Doby vežu – extrémny prekážkový beh a trail
location: Brezno, Brezno, Lidl Brezno, Československej Armády 2612/68
description: Doby vežu is an extreme obstacle race and trail run held in Brezno, Slovakia. Racers must tackle challenging obstacles and complete a course leading to the top of Slovakia’s second-highest observation tower, which stands 40 metres tall and offers beautiful views. The course runs mainly along forest paths, meadows and a stream, with very little asphalt, and includes steep climbs and descents. In addition to the sporting experience, a fun program of activities is planned for all age groups. The organizer is M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., and the race director is Marek Janoštiak.

name: Birštono pusmaratonis. Lietuvos 10 km bėgimo plentu čempionatas.
organizer: VšĮ Birštono sportas ir Asociacija Sporto renginiai
description: The Birštonas Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Birštonas that hosts the Lithuanian 10 km Road Running Championship. The event attracts both professional athletes and recreational runners, offering excellent conditions to compete and enjoy running in beautiful surroundings. Participants can expect a well-organized course and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km paved road course
Race held as part of the Lithuanian 10 km Road Running Championship
Beautiful surroundings in the town of Birštonas
additional: You can sign up for the newsletter to receive information about registration opening and the latest news. Runners competing in the Lithuanian 10 km Road Running Championship must have a valid anti-doping education certificate.

name: Pasvalio maratonas
location: Pasvalio kultūros ir poilsio parko stadionas, Pasvalys, Pasvalio rajonas, Lietuva
organizer: Bėgimo mėgėjų ir sveikos gyvensenos klubas „Vėtra“, Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija, Pasvalio sporto mokykla
description: The Pasvalys Marathon is a traditional running event held in the city of Pasvalys. It aims to promote running among young people and adults and encourage a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place at the stadium in Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park, where participants compete in the marathon, half-marathon, and children’s race. The course length and number of laps are adjusted for the different distances, with water and refreshment stations every 5 km. Participants receive prizes and commemorative medals, and the event is part of the Pasvalys City Festival “Vys par to ãlo” programme.
course_highlights: 10 km course; 4 laps for the marathon and 2 laps for the half-marathon
Water and refreshment stations every 5 km
Start and finish at the stadium in Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 8:00 at Pasvalys Stadium. The children’s 400 m race starts at 11:00. Participants must have a doctor’s permission or an application bearing a doctor’s approval; otherwise, they are responsible for their own health during the competition. Participants who finish within the time limit receive commemorative medals. Various distances are offered, and participants can look forward to medals, certificates, prizes, and refreshments.

name: Perly Malopolski Wapienne Magura
location: Wapienne, Sękowa, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Polska
description: Perły Małopolski Wapienne - Magura to bieg górski w okolicach Wapiennego i Magury. Do wyboru są cztery dystanse: około 5, 10, 20 i 50 km, w tym trasa ultra. Wydarzenie zaprasza zarówno osoby stawiające pierwsze kroki w biegach górskich, jak i doświadczonych biegaczy szukających dłuższego wyzwania.
course_highlights: Cztery dystanse: około 5, 10, 20 i 50 km.
Trasy prowadzą w rejonie Wapiennego i Magury.
Najdłuższy dystans to bieg ultra na około 50 km.

name: Bieg Lotnej Kompanii Szturmowej
description: VIII Bieg Lotnej Kompanii Szturmowej w Haczowie to coroczna impreza biegowa upamiętniająca Lotną Kompanię Szturmową por. Stanisława Maczka oraz Haczowskich Bohaterów walk o niepodległość Polski w latach 1918-1921. Zawody odbywają się na trasach o długości około 12 km i 5 km oraz w marszu Nordic Walking na 5 km, z przewagą dróg asfaltowych i szutrowych na terenie gminy Haczów. Bieg promuje zdrowy tryb życia, aktywność fizyczną oraz integrację lokalnej społeczności. Dla dzieci organizowane są bezpłatne biegi na krótszych dystansach dostosowanych do wieku.
course_highlights: Trasy o długości około 12 km i 5 km oraz Nordic Walking 5 km
Przewaga dróg asfaltowych i szutrowych na terenie gminy Haczów
Na trasie jeden punkt odżywczy z wodą
additional: Limit zawodników wynosi 150 osób. Na trasie znajduje się jeden punkt odżywczy z wodą. Biuro zawodów i baza znajdują się w Parku Dworskim przy Gminnym Ośrodku Kultury i Wypoczynku w Haczowie oraz na stadionie LKS w Haczowie. Dla dzieci organizowane są bezpłatne biegi na dystansach od około 200 m do 1000 m, w zależności od kategorii wiekowej. Limit uczestników biegów dziecięcych to 200 osób. Opłata startowa dla dorosłych nie podlega zwrotowi. Pakiety startowe wydawane są w godzinach 13:00-14:30.

name: Gryf Arena Run
description: Gryf Arena Run to coroczny bieg uliczny odbywający się w mieście Gryfice, który przyciąga biegaczy w różnym wieku i na różnych dystansach. Trasa prowadzi ulicami miasta, oferując uczestnikom świetną atmosferę, sportowe emocje oraz pozytywną energię. Wydarzenie obejmuje także biegi dla dzieci, co czyni je imprezą rodzinną i integracyjną. To już dziewiąta edycja tego popularnego biegu, który jest ważnym wydarzeniem sportowym w regionie.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi ulicami miasta Gryfice
Atmosfera pełna sportowych emocji i pozytywnej energii
Biegi dziecięce w programie, przyjazne dla rodzin

name: Klon Biega i Chodzi Dla Zdrowia
description: Klon Biega i Chodzi Dla Zdrowia to lokalna inicjatywa organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie na Rzecz Rozwoju Wsi Klon i Okolic. Impreza promuje aktywność fizyczną i zdrowy styl życia wśród mieszkańców i sympatyków regionu. Bieg i marsz odbywają się w malowniczej okolicy Klonu, sprzyjając integracji społeczności lokalnej. Wydarzenie ma charakter rekreacyjny i jest otwarte dla wszystkich chętnych.

name: X Bieg STO-nogi
description: Bieg STO-nogi w Milanówku to tradycyjny bieg uliczny na dystansie 10 km, odbywający się w malowniczym mieście Milanówek. Trasa biegu ma kształt litery "T" i składa się z dwóch pętli po 5 km każda, prowadzących ulicami miasta. Impreza jest organizowana przez lokalną grupę pasjonatów biegania, którzy promują sport wśród mieszkańców i uczestników z całej Polski. Bieg ma kameralny charakter i jest doskonałą okazją do aktywnego spędzenia czasu oraz integracji biegaczy.
course_highlights: Trasa w kształcie litery "T"
Dwie pętle po 5 km ulicami Milanówka
Start i meta przy SLO Nr 5, ul. Herberta 41
additional: Start biegu tradycyjnie przy SLO Nr 5 (ul. Herberta 41). Trasa uliczna, dwie pętle po 5 km. Organizatorzy to lokalna grupa STO-nogi Milanówek, która organizuje także inne biegi i imprezy biegowe. Kontakt telefoniczny do organizatorów: Leszek Janasik - 666 353 600, Jerzy Stypa - 601 825 560.

name: X Ostródzki Półmaraton św. Jerzego
description: X Ostródzki Półmaraton św. Jerzego to jubileuszowa dziesiąta edycja półmaratonu organizowanego przez Grupę Ostródzkich Biegaczy „Ostróda Runners”, Klub Sportowy PLAY oraz Ostródzkie Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji. Bieg odbywa się w malowniczej Ostródzie nad Jeziorem Drwęckim, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalny pomiar czasu oraz bogate zaplecze organizacyjne. Impreza przyciąga zarówno lokalnych biegaczy, jak i gości z innych regionów, oferując nagrody pieniężne dla najlepszych zawodników. Pakiety startowe wydawane są w biurze zawodów, a organizatorzy dbają o sprawną i bezpieczną obsługę uczestników.
course_highlights: Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi malowniczym bulwarem nad Jeziorem Drwęckim w Ostródzie
Profesjonalny pomiar czasu z chipem zwrotnym
Możliwość odbioru pakietów startowych w Amfiteatrze nad jeziorem
additional: 7:00 - 9:00. Rejestracja po godzinie 9:00 w dniu biegu jest niemożliwa. Pakiety startowe wydawane są za okazaniem dokumentu tożsamości. Możliwy odbiór pakietu w imieniu innej osoby na podstawie podpisanego oświadczenia i kopii dowodu osobistego. Opłata startowa nie podlega zwrotowi ani przeniesieniu na innego uczestnika. Nagrody pieniężne dla najlepszych zawodników (kobiety i mężczyźni) w wysokości 1000, 700 i 500 PLN, wypłacane na konto w ciągu 3 dni od zawodów. Z każdej opłaty startowej 5 zł przekazywane jest na cele rehabilitacji w ramach akcji charytatywnej.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
description: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka to bieg terenowy odbywający się na leśnych terenach MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. Trasa charakteryzuje się urozmaiconą nawierzchnią, podbiegami i zbiegami o różnej długości i nachyleniu, dużymi poletkami piachu oraz wąskimi odcinkami w krzakach. Crossowy charakter trasy przyciąga biegaczy chcących uciec od asfaltu lub przygotować się do biegów górskich. Zawody odbywają się na trzech dystansach: 4, 8 i 12 km, a także przewidziane są biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży. Uczestnicy otrzymują symboliczne medale nawiązujące do maliny, a najlepsi zawodnicy na każdym dystansie otrzymują puchary.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi przez leśne tereny MOSiR Zgierz Malinka
Urozmaicona nawierzchnia z podbiegami, zbiegami, piaskiem i wąskimi odcinkami w krzakach
Crossowy charakter trasy, nietypowy dla terenów miejskich
additional: Wszyscy zawodnicy startują jednocześnie niezależnie od dystansu. Marsz nordic walking odbywa się na dystansie 4 km. Biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży na dystansach 150 m (0-6 lat) i 800 m (7-15 lat). Miasteczko biegowe z atrakcjami: plac zabaw, tor do pumptrucku, wodny plac zabaw, boiska do siatkówki plażowej, mini piłki nożnej i koszykówki, boiska do beach soccera, kąpieliska, wypożyczalnia kajaków, strzelnica golfowa oraz gry i zabawy dla dzieci.

name: Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna
location: Centrum Rekreacji i Wypoczynku Deczno, Świecie, Polska
description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w malowniczej okolicy Centrum Rekreacji i Wypoczynku Deczno. Zawody obejmują bieg główny na dystansie 10 km oraz bezpłatne biegi dla dzieci, co czyni wydarzenie atrakcyjnym dla całych rodzin i biegaczy na różnym poziomie zaawansowania. Trasa biegu głównego prowadzi wzdłuż brzegu rzeki Deczna, oferując uczestnikom piękne widoki i przyjemne warunki do rywalizacji. Organizatorzy zapewniają profesjonalny pomiar czasu oraz pakiety startowe z koszulkami dla wcześniejszych zgłoszeń. Limit uczestników biegu głównego wynosi 240 osób, co gwarantuje kameralną atmosferę.
course_highlights: Trasa biegu głównego o długości 10 km wzdłuż brzegu rzeki Deczna
Malownicze widoki i naturalne otoczenie Centrum Rekreacji i Wypoczynku Deczno
Dodatkowe biegi dla dzieci, bezpłatne i ograniczone do 115 uczestników
additional: Limit uczestników biegu głównego to 240 osób, a biegów dla dzieci 115 osób. Start biegów dla dzieci o godzinie 10:00, start biegu głównego o 11:00. 23:59.

name: XI Cienińska Szóstka
location: Cienin Zaborny, Słupca County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Polska

name: Gorch-Fock-Lauf Wilhelmshaven
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 0.6 km
description: The Gorch-Fock-Lauf in Wilhelmshaven takes place every year in June and offers distances for all age groups, including children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. The course runs mostly along the coastline and the inner harbour, starting at Jade-Allee and finishing in Pumpwerk-Park. The course is measured by the DLV, ensuring fair competition. In addition to the sporting competition, there is also a club and school race with attractive prize money to promote youth sports in the region.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course with quality seal
Course along the coastline and inner harbour
Start at Jade-Allee, finish in Pumpwerk-Park
additional: Timing is provided by a chip integrated into the race number. There are several refreshment stations along the course. The club and school race offers prize money for the five clubs/schools with the most participants. Changes of registration can be made online via a self-service link; changes cannot be made on site. The event also includes a running service, club and school competitions, medals, shirts and prize money. Registration is online, with early-bird discounts available. The start is at Jade-Allee and the finish is in Pumpwerk-Park.

name: RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf
description: The RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf will be held for the 43rd time in 2026 and is organized by Lauftreff Schafhauser Wald e.V. in Dunum, Lower Saxony. The event is supported by Raiffeisen-Volksbank eG, Aurich, and offers runners and walkers of all ability levels a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. The routes pass through the beautiful Harlinger landscape, with the start and finish in Dunum. In addition to the Volkslauf, walking and Nordic walking options are available, along with an extensive photo and results archive from previous years.
course_highlights: Start on Vorackkerweg, finish at Dunum School
10 km Volkslauf with 2 laps
Half marathon and other routes with interactive course maps
additional: The event includes various distances: 10 km Volkslauf (2 laps), half marathon, 5 km Volkslauf, 7.5 km walking, and Bambini and schoolchildren's races. The start and finish are in Dunum, and the routes are available as interactive maps. The running group's training sessions are on Mondays at 19:00 and Wednesdays at 18:00, meeting at the NIGE sports ground or, from September, at the stadium on Peldmühle. Everyone is welcome, from beginners to professionals. The event takes place in June, with officially homologated courses for official performance records. It supports the German solidarity system in sport and is aimed at runners of all ages, including children and young people.

name: Globus-Theißen-Lauf
description: The Globus-Theißen Run is a community running event in Theißen, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place for the sixth time. It offers distances for all age groups, from the Bambini race through 1.5 km, 3 km and 7 km to 14 km. The event takes place at the Bergarbeiter Stadium and is part of the Rangliste-Burgenland for adults and the Wiesen-Grundcup for children and young people. Refreshments include a cake buffet, coffee and savoury food, and children’s entertainment is provided during the awards ceremony. The event is a joint project by Globus-Theissen, local clubs and residents.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 m (Bambini) to 14 km
Start and finish at the Bergarbeiter Stadium in Theißen
Course routes available as GPS tracks and PDFs
additional: Refreshments include homemade cakes and coffee as well as savoury food; proceeds support the clubs’ youth programmes; children’s entertainment during the awards ceremony; start and finish at the Bergarbeiter Stadium; ample parking nearby; certificates for children at the finish; the event is part of the Rangliste-Burgenland and the Wiesen-Grundcup. Courses for children, young people, women, men and seniors; virtual routes available; a community event of regional significance.

name: Letter Vituslauf 2026
location: Heimathaus Letter Deele, Beelener Straße, Oelde-Lette, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Letter Vituslauf is a traditional running event in Oelde-Lette, held on flat, paved and surfaced paths. The courses are measured and offer runners of all ages a fair and attractive race environment. The event is organized by VfB Germania Lette e.V. and Leichtathletikverein Oelde e.V. and takes place at the Heimathaus Letter Deele. Alongside the races, there is a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards and vouchers for the fastest runners and for children.
course_highlights: Flat course on asphalt and surfaced paths
Measured 5 km and 10 km courses
Start and finish at the Heimathaus Letter Deele, Oelde-Lette
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 12:30 p.m. at the race office at the Heimathaus. Changing and shower facilities are available at Norbertschule and the sports hall. Late entries are accepted until 30 minutes before the respective start. Results are classified according to DLO age-group categories. Certificates are awarded to the top three in each age group, as well as vouchers for the fastest runners and children.

name: Reinhardswaldwalking
location: VfL Veckerhagen, Reinhardshagen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: VfL Veckerhagen 1897 e.V. warmly invites you to the 15th Reinhardswald Walking Day. Routes of 3 km, 6 km and 11 km are offered, passing through open countryside, along the edge of the forest and through the Reinhardswald. The start and finish are at VfL Veckerhagen’s Mittelpunkt sports facility. Refreshment stations are available along the way, and drinks, coffee, cake and bratwurst are offered at the finish. The three groups with the most participants will receive cash prizes.
course_highlights: Routes through open countryside, along the edge of the forest and through the Reinhardswald
Start and finish at VfL Veckerhagen’s Mittelpunkt sports facility
Refreshment stations along the way
additional: The three groups with the most participants will receive cash prizes. Participants are advised to bring the completed registration form to speed up registration on site. Participants can choose between 3 km, 6 km, 8 km and 11 km; the event promotes community and experiencing nature; refreshments and prizes are offered for the groups with the most participants.

name: Sachsenlauf Coswig
price_range: 2 € erste Stunde, danach 1,50 € (Parkgebühren im Parkhaus an der Moritzburger Straße)
description: The Sachsenlauf Coswig is a long-standing sporting event held annually in June since 1980. The races follow forest roads, woodland trails and field paths through the Friedewald and into the Moritzburg Hills. A special highlight on the 21.1 km route is running through the Moritzburg State Stud to the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel. In addition to running distances, walking and hiking options cater to different fitness levels and ambitions. The event is part of the Meißner Sparkassencup and the Niederlausitzcup, and also features dedicated races for children and Bambinis, with surprises at the finish.
course_highlights: Running routes on forest roads, woodland trails and field paths in the Friedewald and Moritzburg Hills
Route through the Moritzburg State Stud, past the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel (21.1 km route)
Hiking routes on the Karras circular trails, passing natural features such as Moselwiese and Seerosenteich
additional: Start and finish are at the corner of Friedewaldstraße and Sachsenlaufweg. Awards ceremonies take place in the schoolyard. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available in the neighboring Spitzgrund sports hall. The course closes for all distances at 14:00. Paid parking is available in the Moritzburger Straße car park. Travel by public transport (VVO bus routes 400, 401 and 405) is recommended. Children and Bambinis have their own out-and-back races (500 m and 800 m) with small surprises at the finish. Race bibs include a single-use timing transponder. Late registrations are possible on race day until 10:00; payment on site is cash only. Course adjustment due to the state championships, parking in the car park, travel by bus and train recommended, refreshments and awards ceremonies in the finish area, children’s and hiking routes

name: Wallernhäuser Dorflauf
description: The Wallernhausen Village Run is a traditional village race in Nidda-Wallernhausen, Germany, starting at 9:00 a.m. on Sunday morning. The event offers two distances: a short 1.6 km run and a longer 10 km run. This makes it suitable for younger runners and beginners, as well as those looking for a classic longer distance. The course runs through the village of Wallernhausen and offers a friendly atmosphere away from large urban areas. Now in its 18th edition, the race is a popular local sporting event.
course_highlights: Run through the village of Wallernhausen
Two distances: 1.6 km and 10 km
Friendly village-run atmosphere
additional: Typical June weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny days. The event takes place in June, with typical temperatures around 23°C and a low chance of precipitation. It is a local event focused on community and the enjoyment of running.

name: 10K Hamburg - Volkspark
description: The 10K Hamburg Volkspark is an exciting 10-kilometer race on fully closed and secured out-and-back routes along paved and asphalt paths. The race offers attractive sections in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg and is open to runners of all abilities. The event is part of a cup series, where the fastest participants can win great prizes. Registration is online only, and an official registration confirmation is sent after registration closes.
course_highlights: Fully closed and secured out-and-back routes
Paved and asphalt paths
Attractive spots in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg
additional: A bag-drop facility for personal belongings is available on the event day. Travel by public transport is recommended. The cup series covers all 10K Hamburg events, with points awarded to the 30 fastest men and women at each event. The course is officially measured in accordance with IWB and AIMS standards; finish times are valid for rankings.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 2
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands off the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. It takes place annually and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. Participants can run all seven stages or individual stages, each of which is about 10 kilometers long. The event places great importance on creating an enjoyable running experience and protecting the islands from overcrowding.

name: Barsinghäuser Fuchsbau Spendenlauf
description: The Barsinghausen Fuchsbau Charity Run is a running event in support of the “FUCHSBAU” association, which provides bereavement support for children and young people. Since 2010, the association has supported young people facing the death of people close to them. The charity run was launched in 2024 to fund Fuchsbau’s important work, as the association has relied entirely on donations since 2023. The event promotes community and social engagement in Barsinghausen and will take place again in 2026.

name: Bestenseer Seenlauf
organizer: Heimat&Kulturverein Bestensee e.V. und WSG 81 KWeV
description: The Bestensee Lakes Run is a traditional race held annually in Bestensee since 2002. It offers three different distances of 2 km, 7.5 km, and 16 km, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The race starts at the Landkost Arena, surrounded by the region’s idyllic lakes and woodland. The event is open to all age groups, and children and young people up to age 13 can take part for free.

name: Buchholzer Stadtlauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Buchholz City Run is a long-standing race with cult status in the Nordheide. The course runs right through downtown Buchholz and is cheered on by numerous spectators, creating a special atmosphere and providing motivation. A range of distances offers suitable challenges for all age and ability groups, from the children’s race to the popular team relay. There is also running training with certified coaches, and all participants receive special medals and certificates.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Norderney (2. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian islands on Lower Saxony’s North Sea coast. It takes place and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. The individual stages follow varied routes with a maritime atmosphere, dune landscapes, and the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site. The event offers a unique running experience, with each stage starting and finishing on the islands, as well as comprehensive facilities including race-number collection, sports bag storage, and on-site award ceremonies.

name: Lamspringer Klosterlauf
description: The Lamspringe Monastery Run is an annual running and walking event starting and finishing at Lamspringe Forest Stadium. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including children’s races, and is part of the South Lower Saxony Cup. Runners, Nordic walkers, and hiking enthusiasts are warmly invited to enjoy the varied routes through the countryside around Lamspringe. The event combines sporting ambition with fun and a sense of community in beautiful surroundings.

name: Sababurger Tierparklauf
description: The Sababurg Zoo Run is a popular charity run held in the picturesque Sababurg Zoo and the adjoining Reinhardswald forest. The carefully selected routes pass through an unrivalled natural setting and are lined with enthusiastic spectators. The run is part of the Reinhardswald Running and Walking Cup series and this year supports the planned Amphibian World at the zoo. With a large number of participants and a family-friendly atmosphere, the run offers an unforgettable experience for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Route through Sababurg Zoo and the adjoining Reinhardswald forest
Unrivalled natural setting with enthusiastic spectators along the course
Part of the Reinhardswald Running and Walking Cup series
additional: The run supports the planned Amphibian World, a new nature education project at Sababurg Zoo that lets visitors explore and learn about aquatic habitats. The zoo run regularly attracts large numbers of participants and is a fixture of the regional running series.

name: Schlossinsellauf Lübben
description: The Schlossinsellauf Lübben is a traditional running event held on the idyllic Schlossinsel in the town of Lübben in the Spreewald. It offers races for children, teenagers, and adults, including Bambini races, children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, and a Run & Bike half marathon. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and varied course, which runs both on the Schlossinsel and through the surrounding Spreewald area. The race is part of the Spreewaldcup and attracts numerous runners every year.

name: Spessarthelden - Laufen gegen Gewalt
description: The Spessarthelden Run Against Violence is a charity run in Bad Soden-Salmünster, organized by Tuğçe Albayrak e.V. and the city. The event sends a strong message against violence and is supported by former German President Christian Wulff as its patron. There are various running distances suitable for all age groups, and the event promotes community and social engagement in the region.

name: Töpfermarktlauf Bürgel
description: The Töpfermarktlauf in Bürgel is a long-standing race that has been a sporting highlight in the Saale-Holzland district since the 1990s. The event offers various distances, including the challenging 12 km main race and the 6 km introductory race, which take runners through the varied landscape around Bürgel. All participants receive a handmade, ceramic medal as a memento. The event is family-friendly, with races for children and school students, and takes place on Sunday morning to make it possible for as many running enthusiasts as possible to take part.

name: Běhej lesy Týmovka - týmový závod
description: Běhej lesy Týmovka is a unique team relay running race held in the heart of the Vysočina region, offering an adventure for teams of 4 to 8 runners. The race consists of three different loops with a total distance of approximately 27.5 km, which each runner must complete over the weekend. The race also takes place at night with headlamps, adding to its uniqueness and challenge. In addition to the race, a rich programme of sports activities, cultural events and workshops is planned, while the facilities include a comfortable campsite with sanitary facilities and refreshments.

name: Velichovská sedmička
description: Velichovská sedmička is a friendly family running race held in the village of Velichovky, offering a main 7 km course along forest trails and local roads. The race is open to all age groups, including children, and encourages active leisure time in nature. The event is part of the Primátor Cup series and is ideal for sports enthusiasts and families looking for a shared sporting activity. It takes place on the last Saturday in June, with the option to take part in other shorter routes and children’s categories.

name: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň
description: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň is a family-friendly running event with a joyful, relaxed atmosphere, suitable for both recreational and elite runners. It offers a range of distances, from children’s races to 3, 5 and 10 km runs and a half marathon. The race takes place in the centre of Plzeň and is part of a series of events held throughout the Czech Republic. Participants can enjoy not only the race but also a family-friendly entertainment programme and high-quality service from start to finish.

name: Dobratický běh
description: The Dobratice Run is a traditional running race in the picturesque village of Dobratice, attracting sports enthusiasts of all ages. The race offers beautiful routes through nature and scenic surroundings, suitable for both experienced runners and families with children. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, themed categories, and valuable prizes for winners and participants. Each year brings a new theme, giving the race a unique atmosphere and adding to the joy of running.

name: Hamelika třikrát jinak
description: Hamelika Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities at the Hamelika site near Mariánské Lázně. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and the Plzeň Region Running Cup, offering a sporting experience for the general public. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels, with an emphasis on a welcoming setting and a sporting atmosphere. Pro Sport Activities has a long tradition of organizing running races and looks forward to welcoming participants in 2026.

name: Sunrise Marathon / Halfmaraton
description: The Sunrise Marathon and Half Marathon take place at Olympia Brno in Modřice. The race starts early in the morning at 4:46 so runners can experience the magical atmosphere of sunrise during the run. The course is flat and consists of five equal-length laps, running partly through natural surroundings and partly along shaded sections. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping and support at key points along the course. The race is suitable for all runners who want to welcome summer actively and enjoy the unique experience of running at dawn.

name: Hradecký kros
description: Hradecký kros is a traditional 10 km trail race held in the forests around Biřička in Hradec Králové. The race offers a unique experience on natural terrain with fewer asphalt sections, making it suitable for the general public and recreational runners alike. The event is part of the East Bohemia Running Grand Prix and attracts runners of all levels every year. The course consists of two 5 km laps over mildly undulating terrain, highlighting the race’s beauty and challenge.

name: Ivčin kopeček
description: Ivčin kopeček is a 3.4 km uphill race with 240 metres of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců series in Prague and the surrounding area. The race offers runners a challenging yet appealing course in the beautiful natural surroundings of Beroun in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill running who want to test their endurance and strength on a short but intense route. The race is open to the public and welcomes all runners looking to enjoy a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Grobský Runfest
location: Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Areál za MŠ a ZŠ Javorová Alej
organizer: SBT Spid.com, s.r.o., Susedský Hi o.z., PavúčikSport Team o.z., obec Chorvátsky Grob
description: Grobský Runfest is a two-day sports festival in Chorvátsky Grob, bringing together professional athletes and recreational enthusiasts of all ages. It offers running courses of various distances, children’s races, cycling races, and a rich cultural and entertainment program, including a food zone and musical performances. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle in a pleasant setting, with a variety of activities for all visitors.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava is Slovakia’s largest obstacle race, held at the Divoká Voda complex in Čunovo. Competitors tackle more than 20 obstacles on a course of approximately 5 km, with different participation options, including a non-competitive fitness mode and timed racing. After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments and watch strength competitions. The race is also suitable for children aged 8 to 14 and includes a medal, photos and a race video as keepsakes.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš
location: Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš
description: The Run Through the Streets of Veľký Krtíš is a traditional running race organized by the Bežci VK civic association. It offers various categories, including children, recreational runners, and Nordic Walking. The race takes place in the town of Veľký Krtíš, with distances ranging from 3,000 m to the main 11,000 m race. The children’s race starts at 09:45, and the main category and Nordic Walking start at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers discounts for seniors over 60.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy
location: Moldava nad Bodvou, Moldava nad Bodvou, Hlavné námestie
description: The Moldava Cup of the Bodva is an international road race, cycling and inline skating event held in Moldava nad Bodvou. The event offers various categories for runners, cyclists and inline skaters, with routes passing through the surrounding countryside and villages. It is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, with the start and finish on the Main Square in Moldava nad Bodvou. It also includes a mass run for health, which is open to the general public.

name: Mano MAMA juda – Gelgaudiškio TRAIL spalvų bėgimas 2026
description: Mano MAMA juda - Gelgaudiškio TRAIL Color Run 2026 is an event for families and running enthusiasts, held in Gelgaudiškis Manor Park and the surrounding area. The event aims to promote running in the Šakiai District and encourage physical activity. The course includes forest trails and asphalt, while color stations along the route add extra fun for participants. The event takes place on June 21 and offers a 400 m children’s run and 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: The 5 km loop is mainly on forest trails
The 10 km distance consists of two 5 km loops
Course surface: forest trails and asphalt
additional: Race bibs are distributed from 9:00 to 10:00. The 400 m children’s run starts at 10:00, and the 5 km and 10 km distances start at 10:30. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 12:00. Minors must have written consent from a parent or guardian. Participants agree that organizers may use photos and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. The event includes a color run, various distances, challenges, and varied terrain. Participants’ results are recorded using a professional timing system, but the most important things are the experience and emotions.

name: 55-asis bėgimas – pusė maratono „Aplink Elektrėnų marias“
description: The 55th “Around the Elektrėnai Lagoon” run is a traditional half-marathon event in Elektrėnai, held in the scenic surroundings of the Elektrėnai Lagoon. The event invites runners to enjoy an active day out and discover the nature and history of this young Lithuanian city. The run takes place in June, giving participants the chance to enjoy the summer atmosphere and the sights of the Elektrėnai area. It is a great opportunity to exercise and discover the beauty of the Elektrėnai region.
course_highlights: A scenic route around the Elektrėnai Lagoon
Nature and opportunities for active recreation in the Elektrėnai area
Discover the history and culture of a young Lithuanian city
additional: The event takes place on June 21 from 08:30 to 16:00. The Elektrėnai Tourism Information Center provides information about routes, accommodation, dining, and other opportunities for active recreation in the region.

name: Panemunės pusmaratonis 2026
description: The Panemunė Half Marathon is a traditional 21 km race held in Panemunė Forest in Kaunas. It’s a great opportunity to enjoy nature and spend time actively running along a beautiful forest trail. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs who want to test themselves over the half-marathon distance.
course_highlights: A 21 km route along the forest trails of Panemunė Forest
Nature and a peaceful setting in Kaunas
A course suited to both experienced and beginner runners

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 2
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon that divides the classic distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The route follows loop courses through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, and also offers a kids’ stage for younger participants. Organized by regional clubs, the event will take place for the 18th time in 2026.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 3
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a long-standing stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of around 10 km each, travelling from island to island. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere, dune landscapes and the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site. Due to limited ferry capacity and infrastructure, the number of participants is limited, ensuring an exclusive and well-organised event.

name: Sommerlauf Baierbrunn
description: The Baierbrunn Summer Run is a traditional race held annually since 2015 that brings the entire Baierbrunn community together. The event is open to professional and recreational runners of all ages and offers various routes through the surrounding forests across varied terrain. After the races for different age groups and distances, a summer party is held for all participants and friends of SC Baierbrunn. The course is marked and closed to traffic, with drink stations along the way.

name: Kros Sázava
description: Kros Sázava is a running race in Pikovice, Central Bohemian Region, offering three routes of varying distances and elevation gains. The longest route is 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain, the medium route is 10 km with approximately 230 m, and the hobby route is 5 km with 120 m. All routes run exclusively through nature, offering beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of various levels who want to enjoy cross-country running in a picturesque setting.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Už vaikų rytojų“
description: The “For Children’s Tomorrow” running race is an event aimed at encouraging the public to become foster parents to older children and changing negative attitudes toward children in foster care. The race takes place in Kaunas Oak Grove, with the start and finish near the main building of the Lithuanian Sports University. The event draws attention to children over the age of 10 who are waiting for foster families and promotes the services provided by the foster care centre. Participants can choose from several distances, and every finisher receives a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: 5 km distance — 2 laps of 2.5 km each
Start and finish near the main building of the Lithuanian Sports University
The race takes place in Kaunas Oak Grove, near the monument to S. Darius and S. Girėnas
additional: There are three distances: 500 m (for those born in 2014 or later; start at 18:30), 1 km (start at 18:45), and 5 km (start at 19:05). Participants must wear their bib on the front of their shirt. Winners and runners-up are awarded in various age groups, and every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Participants and supporters are not allowed to use vehicles or personal escorts during the race. Registration is online. The event is intended for children and young people and aims to encourage an active lifestyle and social engagement.

name: Poznań Malta #67
description: Kiprun Poznań Malta #67 to cykliczny, luźny event biegowy organizowany przez biegaczy dla biegaczy nad Jeziorem Maltańskim w Poznaniu. Wydarzenie odbywa się w przyjaznej i bezpiecznej atmosferze, gdzie przed startem organizatorzy wyjaśniają zasady i przebieg trasy. Do wyboru są dwa dystanse, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na dokładny pomiar czasu. To doskonała okazja zarówno dla osób chcących aktywnie spędzić czas, jak i dla tych nastawionych na sportową rywalizację.
course_highlights: Spokojna trasa nad Jeziorem Maltańskim
Dokładny pomiar czasu
Przyjazna i bezpieczna formuła wydarzenia
additional: Wydarzenie obejmuje również nordic walking. Event jest bezpłatny.

name: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów Biegaj - Pomagaj

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Minimum 40 zł, a w przypadku chęci otrzymania prezentu dla dziecka - minimum 50 zł

description: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów to wyjątkowa inicjatywa Fundacji Dorastaj z Nami, która wspiera dzieci pracowników służb publicznych i medycznych, którzy zginęli lub zostali ranni podczas pełnienia obowiązków. Uczestnicy wybierają trasę 5 km i mogą przebiec ją w dowolnym terminie między 1 a 23 czerwca, przesyłając zrzut ekranu z aplikacji biegowej. Bieg łączy symbolicznie Dzień Dziecka i Dzień Ojca, podkreślając pamięć o bohaterach i wsparcie dla ich dzieci. To wydarzenie o charakterze charytatywnym, które łączy sport z pomocą i pamięcią.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 5 km do wyboru przez uczestnika
Bieg odbywa się w dowolnym terminie w dniach 1-23 czerwca
Możliwość udziału z dowolnego miejsca w Polsce
additional: Uczestnicy po zapisaniu się otrzymują link do wpłaty startowej oraz link do przesłania zrzutu ekranu z aplikacji rejestrującej bieg. Bieg ma formułę wirtualną, umożliwiającą udział z dowolnego miejsca i czasu w wyznaczonym okresie. Po biegu należy przesłać organizatorom zrzut ekranu z aplikacji rejestrującej aktywność.

name: VI-asis Alaušo maratonas
location: Sudeikių ežeras, Sudeikiai, Utenos rajonas, Lithuania
organizer: VšĮ Utenos verslo ir turizmo agentūra
description: The 6th Alaušas Marathon is a traditional running event held in the town of Sudeikiai, in Utena District, on the eve of Joninės night. The marathon offers sports enthusiasts the chance to experience a unique atmosphere and test their endurance in beautiful natural surroundings by Lake Sudeikiai. The event begins in the evening on June 23 at 19:30 and invites participants and spectators to enjoy an active and fun evening of sport.
course_highlights: Held in the town of Sudeikiai, by Lake Sudeikiai
The event begins on the eve of Joninės night, June 23 at 19:30
The marathon takes place in Utena District, surrounded by nature
additional: Registration is available through the official website, with the option to sign in via Facebook. The event takes place on the eve of Joninės night, so the start is scheduled for the evening. The venue is marked on Google Maps in the town of Sudeikiai. The event includes not only running but also other active activities; registration takes place online, and it is an important part of the local sports festival.

name: Szczecińska Dobranocka 27 - finał
description: Szczecińska Dobranocka to cykl biegów na orientację organizowany przez Klub Orientacji Sportowej BnO Szczecin. Zawody odbywają się w różnych terenach wokół Szczecina, oferując uczestnikom możliwość sprawdzenia swoich umiejętności nawigacyjnych i biegowych. Impreza jest otwarta dla zawodników na różnych poziomach zaawansowania, od początkujących po doświadczonych biegaczy. Tradycja i różnorodność tras sprawiają, że jest to popularne wydarzenie w środowisku biegów na orientację.
course_highlights: Różnorodne tereny leśne wokół Szczecina
Trasy dostosowane do różnych poziomów zaawansowania
Możliwość potwierdzania punktów kontrolnych za pomocą piktogramów
additional: Organizatorem jest Klub Orientacji Sportowej BnO Szczecin. Wydarzenie ma charakter cykliczny i jest częścią szerszego kalendarza biegów na orientację w regionie. Na stronie dostępne są mapy do biegów oraz instrukcje dla początkujących dotyczące potwierdzania punktów kontrolnych.

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
description: Herbatka u Tadka czyli Bieg do Herbacianego Domku to bieg na dystansie 10 km odbywający się w Warszawie. Uczestnicy mogą przygotować się do startu korzystając z planów treningowych dostosowanych do różnych poziomów zaawansowania, oferujących wsparcie ekspertów i szczegółowe instrukcje. Wydarzenie jest doskonałą okazją do sprawdzenia swojej formy na ulicach stolicy w przyjaznej atmosferze.
course_highlights: Dystans 10 km ulicami Warszawy
Treningi dostosowane do poziomu VDOT biegacza
Wsparcie ekspertów i szczegółowe plany treningowe
additional: Dostępne plany treningowe od 8 do 20 tygodni, dostosowane do indywidualnego poziomu biegacza. Możliwość korzystania z platformy do zarządzania wizytówką biegu i współpracy marketingowej.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 4
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon held in seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each around Osterode am Harz. The fourth stage runs through the beautiful Beber nature reserve in Schwiegershausen, along varied paths of gravel, concrete and grass. The start and finish are at the Schwiegershausen sports hall, and the route offers a great view of the Harz as well as a mix of gentle and steep sections. The race is open to everyone physically able to run about 7 kilometres without stopping and promotes community among the regional clubs.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 4
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of about 10 km on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and a chance to enjoy nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out quickly.

name: Erfurter Campuslauf
description: The Erfurt Campus Run is a sporting event organized by the University of Erfurt in cooperation with Universitätssportverein Erfurt e.V. Runners can take part in various events, including a 10-kilometer individual race, which also counts as the Thuringian University Championship in the 10-kilometer road race. There is also a 25 x 400-meter team relay and a Bambini run for children. The event features a varied course on the university campus and is open to all ages and ability levels.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Juist (4. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Stage 4 takes place on the island of Juist, the longest of the islands at 17 kilometers, and impresses with its dunes and Juist Water Tower. The start and finish are at Kurplatz, and the event offers runners and walkers a unique running experience surrounded by nature and the sea. The race number is valid for all stages and is issued with an integrated timing chip.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (7) – červnový
description: Come and run on a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava River in Prague’s Braník district, where personal records are often set! The race is part of the 16th edition of VAŠE LIGA’s regular 5 km and 10 km runs, held every month. The course has been measured by a certified measurer, and the 10 km race offers the chance to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, you can review your performance and refuel at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. We reward both the top runners and our loyal participants.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 5
organizer: TG LaPeKa, MTV Osterode, MTV Förste, TSV Schwiegershausen, TSC Dorste, MTV Freiheit, SFC Harz-Weser
description: The 18th Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven pleasant after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The runs follow circuits through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the foothills of the Harz Mountains. The start is on Sunday in Förste, with a new stage each day until Saturday. In addition to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers are also very welcome. There is also a 750-meter kids’ stage on June 27 in Schützenpark.

name: Bremer Firmenlauf zur Spätschicht
description: The Bremen Company Run for the Late Shift is a community running event covering approximately 5 km around the Weser weir in Bremen, with a focus on team spirit and togetherness. The event is for companies, groups of friends, and running clubs who want to run or walk together without the pressure to perform. New for 2026, official timing will be available for the first time for everyone who wants to test their athletic ambition. After the run, a lively after-run party with music, food, and drinks offers a relaxed end to the evening.

name: DAK FIRMENLAUF Nordhessen 2026
description: The DAK Nord Hesse Company Run has been organized by FTSV Heckershausen 1890 e.V. since 2011 and is held under the motto “Running together—for your health. A lifetime long.” The run promotes health and the enjoyment of exercise and is open to teams and individual runners. The course is about 5.3 km long and runs mostly along unpaved paths, with a short asphalt section. The event starts at 18:30 and offers refreshing drinks and changing facilities on site.

name: Firmenlauf Bremerhaven
description: The 9th Bremerhaven Company Run is open to employees and trainees from companies, public authorities, and other organizations. Participants run a 6 km loop from the Nordsee-Stadion through Speckenbüttler Park. With a limit of 500 participants, the event is a great opportunity for teams to compete athletically and have fun together. Groups receive a free-entry discount when at least 10 participants are registered by the end of May. The event is well established and very popular in the region.

name: Běh Vídrholcem
description: The Vídrholec Run is a popular running race held in Prague 9-Klánovice. It is part of the local running calendar and attracts runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. The event is held under the auspices of the Czech Running Association and the Czech Athletics Federation, and offers not only competition but also the joy of exercising in nature.

name: GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way to górski bieg nad morzem, który odbędzie się w Gdyni i okolicach Kaszub. Zawodnicy mogą wybrać spośród pięciu dystansów, od 14 km do 160 km, z różnorodnym przewyższeniem i malowniczymi trasami. Start i meta znajdują się w różnych punktach, a organizator zapewnia transport na start najdłuższego dystansu. To wyjątkowa okazja, by zmierzyć się z wymagającą trasą i cieszyć się pięknem nadmorskiej przyrody.
course_highlights: Dystans 160 km z przewyższeniem +/- 2502 m, start w Pucku o 10:00
Dystans 100 km z przewyższeniem +/- 2267 m, start w Gdyni o 21:00
Trasy prowadzą przez Kaszuby i nadmorskie tereny z punktami kontrolnymi i limitami czasowymi
additional: Na start najdłuższego dystansu (160 km) zawodników dowożą autokary sprzed Gdyńskiego Centrum Sportu - Narodowy Stadion Rugby (transport płatny). Limit czasu na dystans 160 km to 31 godzin. Trasa posiada punkty kontrolne z limitami czasowymi i przepakami. Wydarzenie obejmuje zarówno letnie, jak i zimowe edycje, z trasami prowadzącymi przez różne miejscowości w regionie, zapewniając niezapomniane wrażenia dla biegaczy na każdym poziomie zaawansowania.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań - edycja nocna 2026 to bieg przełajowy organizowany w malowniczym Ogrodzie Dendrologicznym Uniwersytetu Przyrodniczego w Poznaniu. Impreza jest częścią cyklu biegów organizowanych od 2014 roku przez grupę pasjonatów, którzy kładą nacisk na estetykę tras i popularyzację biegania. Po biegu uczestnicy otrzymają unikalne medale, inne niż podczas edycji wiosennej, co zachęca do kolekcjonowania ich. To wyjątkowa okazja, by biegać w pięknym otoczeniu i w nocnej atmosferze.

name: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku
description: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku to bieg na dystansie 10 km, który odbędzie się w Siemianowicach Śląskich, na terenie Parku Pszczelnik. Trasa składa się z czterech pętli, a zawodnicy startują wspólnie. Po każdej pętli z trasy odpada 20 zawodników, którzy pokonali ją w najdłuższym czasie, otrzymując na mecie tzw. „prawie medal”. Ostatnią pętlę pokonują najlepsi zawodnicy walczący o zwycięstwo. Bieg jest otwarty dla osób powyżej 16 roku życia.

name: Biegaj z Duchami
description: Biegaj z duchami to wyjątkowy nocny bieg przełajowy odbywający się w Leśniowie. Uczestnicy zmierzą się z dwoma trasami o długości 15 km i 9 km, pełnymi mrocznych zakamarków i niespodzianek, które tworzą niepowtarzalną atmosferę pełną dreszczyku emocji. Bieg zachęca do przebrania się za zjawy, duchy i inne upiorne postacie, co dodaje magii i klimatu wydarzeniu. To nie tylko rywalizacja, ale także sprawdzian wytrzymałości i odwagi w ciemności, gdzie uczestnicy stawiają czoła własnym słabościom i tajemniczym postaciom na trasie.

name: Bieg dla Słonia
description: Bieg dla Słonia to nocny bieg upamiętniający Artura Hajzera, himalaistę i zdobywcę siedmiu ośmiotysięczników. Uczestnicy pokonują symboliczny dystans około 7 kilometrów na terenie Stadionu Śląskiego i Parku Śląskiego w Chorzowie. Bieg ma charakter rekreacyjny, bez klasyfikacji i pomiaru czasu, a udział jest bezpłatny. Wydarzenie odbywa się wieczorem, tworząc wyjątkową atmosferę i jednocześnie wspierając pamięć o wybitnym himalaiście.
course_highlights: Trasa około 7 km na terenie Stadionu Śląskiego i Parku Śląskiego
Nocny bieg częściowo na oświetlonej trasie, rekomendowane latarki czołowe
Symboliczne upamiętnienie siedmiu ośmiotysięczników zdobytych przez Artura Hajzera
additional: Rejestracja uczestników od godz. 20:00 do 21:50 w biurze zawodów przy bramie 4 Stadionu Śląskiego. Bieg odbywa się bez względu na warunki atmosferyczne. Uczestnicy muszą podpisać oświadczenie przed startem. Zalecane jest wyposażenie się w latarki czołowe ze względu na nocny charakter trasy. Część trasy jest słabo oświetlona, dlatego organizator rekomenduje zabranie latarki czołowej.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce - edycja nocna
description: Botaniczna Piątka to cykl biegów przełajowych organizowanych od 2014 roku, które łączą pasję do biegania z pięknem naturalnych i estetycznych lokalizacji. Wydarzenie promuje aktywność fizyczną na świeżym powietrzu, szczególnie w malowniczych ogrodach i terenach zielonych. Edycja nocna w Kielcach to wyjątkowa okazja do rywalizacji i wspólnego świętowania sportu w niecodziennych warunkach. Organizatorzy stawiają na przyjazną atmosferę i popularyzację biegania wśród różnych grup wiekowych i poziomów zaawansowania.
course_highlights: Trasa przełajowa w malowniczych terenach zielonych
Bieg w wyjątkowej, nocnej atmosferze
Estetyczne i przyjazne otoczenie sprzyjające rekreacji
additional: Organizatorem jest grupa pasjonatów biegania z doświadczeniem od 2014 roku, specjalizująca się w biegach przełajowych. Wydarzenia odbywają się w różnych lokalizacjach, często w ogrodach botanicznych i terenach zielonych. Latem 2026 obchodzono 10-lecie Botanicznej Piątki. Organizator zachęca do dołączenia do newslettera, aby być na bieżąco z informacjami o biegach.

name: MidSummerRun 2026
description: The MidSummerRun 2026 takes place on June 19 in Hamburg and is being organized for the fifth time by Lauftreff Alstertal e.V. This sustainable running event offers three races: a children’s run of approx. 970 meters, a 5 km run, and a 10 km run along the wild upper course of the Alster, one of Hamburg’s most beautiful running areas. The start and finish are on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, where a sustainability fair featuring sustainable partners and a food truck will also be available. The MidSummerRun stands for environmental protection and sustainability and was awarded second place in the Hanse Environmental Prize.
course_highlights: Route along the wild upper course of the Alster
Start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel
A sustainably organized race focused on environmental protection and the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals
additional: The entry fee includes free travel to and from the event on the HVV. The participant limit is 200 for the children’s run and 600 in total across all races. The event provides first aid in the finish area. Picnic blankets made from recycled advertising banners and a food truck will be available for a relaxed get-together after the race. Children’s run approx. 970 m, 5 km, 10 km, sustainable organization, start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, eco-friendly medals, sustainable refreshments

name: Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover
location: Vereinsheim des HRC Hannover, Weddigenufer 23, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Midsummer Night Run Hannover is an urban running event held on the longest day of the year along the idyllic Leine meadows in Hannover. Several distances are offered: a 7.7 km individual race, a 21.1 km individual race, and a 23.1 km relay with three participants. The event is part of the Hannover Region Running Pass and offers a special atmosphere, with the start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse. There are two aid stations along the course, and timing is provided using rental chips. Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 17:00.
course_highlights: Route along the idyllic Leine meadows in Hannover
Two aid stations with water, isotonic drinks, and energy gels
Start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse
additional: Timing is provided using rental chips, which are worn on the foot and returned at the finish. Showers and changing rooms are available in limited numbers at the neighboring Angaria clubhouse and at the University Sports Center (100 m walk). Bags can be left at the tent opposite the clubhouse before the start. Travel by light rail to Königsworther Platz, followed by a walk of approx. 500 m; parking is available at the University Sports Center. Distances: 7.7 km, 21.1 km, 23.1 km relay; start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse, Weddigenufer 23

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 5
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Over eight days, participants run, walk, or Nordic walk approximately 10 km per stage on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog, and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and encounters with nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out well in advance.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Langeoog (5. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. It takes place in 2026 from June 20 to 27 and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. Stage 5 takes runners to the car-free island of Langeoog, renowned for its 14 km-long sandy beach, dunes, tides and salt marshes in the Wadden Sea National Park. The start and finish are centrally located at the corner of Barkhausenstraße/Gartenstraße/Kurstraße, and the event offers a unique combination of athletic challenge and nature experience.

name: Osnabrücker Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The Charity Midsummer Night Run in Osnabrück-Sutthausen starts at 6:00 p.m. and offers a relaxed running event for all age groups in support of the nonprofit association Zusammen-Bewegen e.V. The route starts at the RW Sutthausen sports field and heads into the Hörner Bruch forest, where one lap is about 3 kilometers long. There are various distances, from 500 m for Bambinis to 10 km for adults, and no individual timing is provided. After the run, participants can wind down the evening over food and drinks.

name: Altstadtfestlauf in Lauf
description: The Altstadtfest Run in Lauf an der Pegnitz takes place every year on Friday evening, opening the Altstadtfest on the last weekend in June. It is considered the world’s largest class reunion and offers runners a special experience, with a setting found nowhere else, such as the runners’ pack on the Laufer Water Bridge. There is a 10 km main race with a turnaround point at Lebenshilfe in Schönberg, as well as a 5 km race, including Nordic walking, with a turnaround point on Ottensooser Straße. The event combines sporting competition with a social gathering and also supports social projects.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 3: Sommerlauf um den SchiederSee
description: The event offers two distances, 1 km and 8.3 km, and is suitable for runners of all ability levels. The scenic route goes around SchiederSee, with pleasant summer weather averaging 23°C and mostly sunny days. Results may be included in official athletics rankings.

name: Retzbachlauf Gaimersheim
description: The Retzbachlauf in Gaimersheim is a traditional race featuring a flat loop course that runs mostly on gravel paths. The event offers races for various age groups, from Bambini to the main race, and is part of the Sport IN Laufcup series. Due to high temperatures, start times are being moved later and course distances adjusted to ensure participants’ safety. The event places great importance on providing plenty of water along the course and creating a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat loop course, mostly on gravel paths
Start and finish at Retzbachpark Gaimersheim, near EDEKA
Part of the Sport IN Laufcup series
additional: The races have staggered starts from 18:10 to 20:00, with the main race starting at 20:00. Race packets can be collected from 17:00 at the start/finish area. The course has been adjusted due to the heat; the main race consists of 2 laps (6.4 km) instead of 3. Additional water stations are provided along the course. The event is easy to reach by bus and train. Parking is available, but not in the car park of the adjacent Edeka store.

name: Wiesengrundlauf
description: The Wiesengrundlauf in Haselbachtal is a regional running event held every year on the Friday evening after the summer solstice. The municipality of Haselbachtal invites runners of all ages to take part in distances ranging from 600 m to 11.6 km. The event is part of the Sachsen Energie Läufer-Cup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for overall and age-group winners. The start and finish are at the “Wiesengrund” sports field in Bischheim. The 2025 premiere was a great success, with numerous participants and a varied supporting programme.
