Malownicze tereny Chełma i okolic
Trudniejszy teren wymagający dobrej kondycji
additional: Dostępne plany treningowe od 8 do 20 tygodni, dostosowane do poziomu VDOT biegacza. Możliwość zarządzania wizytówką biegu i współpracy marketingowej dla organizatorów.

name: V Festiwal Biegowy pod Chełmcem Bieg Babinicza
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczawnie-Zdroju
description: IV Festiwal Biegowy pod Chełmcem Bieg Babinicza to wydarzenie biegowe odbywające się w malowniczym Szczawnie-Zdroju, u podnóża Góry Chełmiec. Uczestnicy mogą wybrać spośród wielu dystansów, od 1 km do pełnego maratonu, co czyni festiwal atrakcyjnym dla biegaczy o różnym stopniu zaawansowania. Trasa biegu prowadzi przez urokliwe tereny, oferując zarówno wyzwania, jak i piękne widoki. Impreza odbywa się w lipcu, kiedy panuje typowa letnia pogoda z temperaturą około 25°C i słonecznym niebem.

name: V Bursztynowy Półmaraton Jantar
location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Polska

name: Altmühl-Jura Halbmarathon
description: The Altmühl-Jura Half Marathon is a traditional race in the picturesque region around Greding. The course passes through the varied landscape of the Altmühl-Jura area, offering runners a challenging yet scenic experience. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and is organized by the City of Greding. The Greding Tourist Information Office is available as a contact point.
course_highlights: Altmühl-Jura landscape
Varied and scenic course
Traditional running event in Greding
additional: The contact point is the Greding Tourist Information Office, reachable at 08463 904-20. The event takes place in Greding. Further information and registration are available through the official websites. Terrain: roads and paved cycle paths; online registration; finishers receive a medal, certificates available online

name: Hausener Volks-Waldlauf (TGS-Hausen)
location: Sportplatz TGS Hausen, Obertshausen, Hesse, Germany
price_range: Nachmeldung 5 € für Erwachsene, online Anmeldung bis 25.07.2025, Kinder frei
description: The Hausener Volks-Waldlauf organized by TGS Hausen takes place and offers races over various distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and shorter schoolchildren’s and Bambini races. The start and finish are both at the TGS Hausen sports field in Obertshausen. The courses run mainly along well-marked, flat forest trails, with the half marathon run as two laps of the 10 km course. Timing is by transponder with gun-time results, and there is a 100 km team competition. The race is open to all age groups and offers a friendly, family atmosphere with good organization.
course_highlights: Well-marked, flat forest trails
Half marathon run as two laps of the 10 km course
Start and finish at the TGS Hausen sports field
additional: Late registration is possible on race day until 15 minutes before the start. The late-registration fee is 5 euros for adults and no fee for young people and Bambinis. Spikes are prohibited on the sports field. Timing is provided by R.S.T. Volkslauf GmbH. There is a 100 km team competition, with runners from the half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km races eligible to participate (maximum 20 participants per team). Courses on forest trails, gun and net timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, late registration possible until shortly before the start.

name: Wallenstein-Halbmarathon
location: Altdorf bei Nürnberg, Nürnberger Land, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Wallenstein Half Marathon is a long-standing fun run around Altdorf near Nuremberg. The half-marathon course runs through the picturesque Schwarzachtal valley, offering beautiful views, and includes roads, cycle paths, and forest trails. In addition to the half marathon, there is also a 12 km fun run and a family-friendly 5 km course for runners and walkers. The event offers well-organized facilities, including refreshment stations and an attractive start/finish area at the TV 1881 Altdorf sports park. The city championships for the half marathon and 12 km race are also held, with prizes presented by the mayor.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course through the Schwarzachtal valley with scenic viewpoints
Refreshment stations at km 7, 11, 15, 18, and at the finish
Route around Altdorf using roads, cycle paths, and forest trails
additional: Start and finish at the TV 1881 Altdorf sports park (Heumannstr. 5a). Isotonic drinks and water are available at several refreshment stations. Free admission to the outdoor swimming pool for all finishers, sponsored by Stadtwerke Altdorf. City championships and team competitions are held. Scenic route through the Schwarzachtal valley, team competitions, family-friendly 5 km course, and race-day facilities at the Altdorf sports park.

name: 38. Frankenwaldlauf
description: The 38th Frankenwaldlauf in Oßla offers races over 18.5 km and 9 km, as well as Nordic walking. There are also shorter distances for children and young people, including the Oßlaer Gimpel-Lauf. The course runs through the Thuringian Forest and features beautiful natural scenery. The event is part of regional running cups and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and an awards ceremony on site.

name: Blutenburglauf
description: The Blutenburglauf takes place in Munich-Untermenzing and offers attractive running routes along the Würm and around the historic Blutenburg. The event includes 5 km and 10 km distances, which take runners through scenic natural surroundings. Timing is electronic, using transponders in the race bibs, and refreshments are available along the course and at the finish. The event is organized by Rotary Club München-Blutenburg Gemeindienste e.V. and, alongside the sporting competition, offers an entertainment program in the start/finish area.

name: Langauer Inklusionslauf
description: The 3rd Langau Inclusion Run takes place in cooperation with Tri-Team Schongau as part of the 14th Schongau Triathlon. The run is open to everyone who would like to take part individually, in a paired run, or with assistance; participation in a wheelchair is also possible. The course is a flat out-and-back route, starting and finishing on Lechuferstraße by the ice rink. Participation is free of charge, and donations to support Langau are welcome. Every registered participant receives a running shirt and a finisher’s gift, and trophies are awarded to the top finishers in various categories.

name: Oscheffer TSG-Lauf
description: The 17th Oscheffer TSG Run takes place in Mainaschaff. The event offers various races for different age groups and ability levels, including a schoolchildren’s and youth race, the Sparkassen Run (5 km), the agilimo Run (10 km), a children’s race, and a relay race. The races are part of a long-standing sporting event organized by TSG Mainaschaff 1973 e.V., welcoming both recreational and competitive runners. Online registration is already open, and further information is available in the race information document.

name: Rainer Volkslauf
description: The Rainer Volkslauf takes place in Rain and offers runners of all ages a varied and motivating running experience. The 10 km main race starts at 9:30 a.m., followed by 5 km races and the shorter 1 km and 2 km Spatzenläufe. The focus is on enjoying exercise and promoting health, supported by enthusiastic spectators and a varied program of events as part of the SC Rain 1928 e. V. sports week. Registration includes a popular Volkslauf T-shirt in the race pack. In addition, one euro per participant is donated to the “Freunde durch Helfen” aid initiative.

name: Rückenwindlauf (Garching bei München)
description: The Rückenwindlauf in Garching near Munich is an established running event that has been held for more than 17 years and attracts around 900 participants each year. The course is officially measured and runs mostly along flat, paved paths around Lake Garching. In addition to the main 5 km and 10 km races, there is also a Bambini run for children. The event supports the Initiative krebskranke Kinder München e.V. and combines sporting ambition with social commitment.
course_highlights: Officially measured course with start and finish at the Business Campus Garching
Flat, mostly paved course, with a section on firm gravel paths around Lake Garching
10 km runners complete the 5 km loop twice
additional: Timing is provided by a transponder system. The event is limited to 1,000 participants. There are sufficient refreshment stations along the course and at the finish. Paramedics from Johanniter-Unfall-Hilfe will be on site. A colorful program for the Bambini runners includes face painting. Late registration is possible on race day until 09:00, subject to the availability of places. There is a team competition for clubs, companies, and running groups.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The Volkswandertag in Bollensen is an annual event held on the last Sunday in July, open to hikers of all ages. A range of family-friendly routes takes participants along forest trails through the beautiful Solling region. The marathon and half-marathon hikes are circular routes starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports hall. All routes are marked and have refreshment stations. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with food and drinks in the finish area and a strong sense of community.

name: Běh na Kozubovou
description: The Run to Kozubová is a traditional mountain race held in Dolní Lomná. It follows hiking trails over challenging elevation changes. The race starts by the bakery in Dolní Lomná and goes via Polana and the Pod Kykulou saddle to the tourist lodge on Kozubová. The course is approximately 5 km long, with around 500 metres of elevation gain, challenging runners with steep climbs and offering beautiful mountain views. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and generous prize raffle for participants.

name: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, mem. J. Morgoša
location: Turany okr. Martin, Turany okr. Martin, Turany - Šútovo – Zajacová
organizer: BS TATRAN Turany, LK NÁDEJ Turany
description: The Run to the Chata pod Chlebom, J. Morgoš Memorial, is a mountain running race held in the areas of Turany, Šútovo and Zajacová. The course is 3.1 km long, with an elevation gain of 680 metres, and follows mountain roads and trails. The race is part of the 2025 Turiec Running League and is open to various age categories for men and women. It is organised by BS TATRAN Turany, the town of Turany and LK NÁDEJ Turany. The race offers a challenge for runners who enjoy demanding mountain terrain.

name: XXXV-asis tradicinis estafetinis bėgimas „Medininkai - Vilnius“
description: The 35th traditional “Medininkai–Vilnius” relay race is Lithuania’s oldest traditional relay race. It commemorates those who were killed at the Medininkai border post. The event takes place in July, starting at the Medininkai Memorial. The relay consists of seven 5 km stages on paved roads, with participants running in teams. It is a special opportunity to take part in a meaningful historic sporting event that connects Medininkai and Vilnius.
course_highlights: 7 × 5 km relay on paved roads
Start at the Medininkai Memorial
The route commemorates those killed at the border post
additional: The event is organized by the Police Department under the Ministry of the Interior, the Customs Department, and LBMA. The results will be published on the organizers’ official website. The route is on paved roads, so suitable running shoes are recommended. The event commemorates the victims of Medininkai and was held in Vilnius. Officials participated. The route is 34 km long and consists of 7 stages. The relay baton contains symbolic soil. Medals and refreshments are provided at the finish.

name: Pajūrio basatlonas
description: Pajūrio Basatlonas is a unique barefoot run on the seaside sand, held in Smiltynė, Klaipėda. The event takes place during the Sea Festival and gives participants an unforgettable experience of running between the sea and the dunes. The race promotes running culture in Lithuania and encourages a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose from several distances and enjoy the beautiful coastal scenery and gentle breeze.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on seaside sand
Start on the beach by the southern pier, Kopgalis, Smiltynė
Distances of 500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, with a 2-hour time limit
additional: A 2-hour time limit applies to all distances. Participants must have an identity document, a race number attached, and an electronic timing chip attached to their shirt. Participants run voluntarily and assume all risks associated with taking part. Barefoot running on seaside sand, various distances (500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km), online registration, regulations and rules, awards and commemorative medals.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon is part of Zátopek’s Golden Week, a series of running races held in Plzeň in honour of Emil Zátopek’s Olympic victories. The main marathon takes place on 27 July and also offers accompanying races, including a half marathon, marathon and half-marathon relays, and a 10.5 km road race. The races start in the afternoon in Štruncovy sady and the surrounding area, with a varied programme and categories for men, women, and young people. The event is known for its tradition, high-quality organisation, and welcoming atmosphere for all runners.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červenec
description: Tempo Makers Osmička is a regular running race in Plzeň, held along the Úslava River. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and over and offers a friendly atmosphere for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The field is limited to 75 starters, making it an intimate and relaxed event. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking available nearby. After the race, the top finishers are announced and prizes are drawn in a raffle.

name: 4 PolandRockowy Bieg Policz się z cukrzy...
location: Broczyno, Czaplinek, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Polska

name: 43. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon run held under the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.10 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is marked with arrows or barrier tape depending on the weather. The event emphasizes self-sufficiency, as runners pass their cars after each loop. Marathon times are recorded with a handheld stopwatch, and a certificate is sent by email. Participants must be at least 18 years old. There is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of €5 is requested.

name: VI Bieg do Nocy Siedleczek
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Kostrzynie
description: VI Bieg do Nocy Siedleczek to wieczorny bieg na dystansie 5 km, który odbywa się w malowniczej okolicy Stawu w Siedleczku. Trasa prowadzi przez drogi leśne oraz utwardzone, a czas zawodników mierzony jest elektronicznie. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na pakiet startowy z numerem i chipem, wodę, posiłek regeneracyjny oraz medal za ukończenie biegu. Impreza jest częścią Grand Prix Biegów w Gminie Kostrzyn i przyciąga biegaczy z różnych kategorii, oferując nagrody dla najlepszych.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km przez drogi leśne i utwardzone
Elektroniczny pomiar czasu netto
Wieczorny start o godzinie 21:00
additional: Limit uczestników wynosi 200 osób. Biuro zawodów otwarte jest w dniu biegu od 19:30 do 20:30 w pobliżu linii startu/meta. Pakiet startowy można odebrać osobiście lub przez upoważnioną osobę. Maksymalny czas na ukończenie biegu to 60 minut. Nagrody w postaci pucharów i statuetek przyznawane są w kategorii OPEN oraz dla mieszkańców gminy Kostrzyn. Elektroniczny pomiar czasu netto; limit czasu na pokonanie trasy wynosi 60 minut. Uczestnicy otrzymują wodę, posiłek regeneracyjny i medal.

name: 07. Stadtholz Marathon
description: The Stadtholz Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a run at Heideteich, with a 6.14 km trail per lap. The event is not competition-focused, but is aimed at runners who enjoy running in nature. The marathon is being held to mark Evi Köppe-Neeb’s linen wedding anniversary and offers a special atmosphere at Heideteich. The course features natural trails and a peaceful setting.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: The Springe-Deister Summer Run features a measured 5 km loop at the foot of the Kleiner Deister. The course is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), so results can be included in rankings. Kilometer markers are clearly signposted, and the course is gently undulating, with an elevation difference of approximately 20 meters. The race starts at 5:45 p.m. at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe and is aimed at runners looking for an attractive, officially sanctioned running event in the region.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Polska
description: Botaniczna Piątka to cykl biegów przełajowych organizowanych od 2014 roku przez grupę pasjonatów biegania. Imprezy odbywają się na malowniczych trasach w Wielkopolsce i innych lokalizacjach, z naciskiem na walory estetyczne i przyrodnicze. Letnia edycja w Łodzi to wyjątkowa okazja do świętowania 10. urodzin tego wydarzenia, podczas której uczestnicy otrzymają specjalne medale z motywem liliowca. Bieg przyciąga zarówno amatorów, jak i bardziej doświadczonych biegaczy, oferując przyjazną atmosferę i piękne trasy.
course_highlights: Biegi przełajowe na malowniczych trasach
Walory estetyczne proponowanych lokalizacji
Specjalne urodzinowe medale z liliowcem
additional: Letnia edycja to świętowanie 10 urodzin Botanicznej Piątki z unikalnymi medalami. Organizatorzy kładą szczególny nacisk na biegi przełajowe i estetykę tras. Imprezy odbywają się w różnych lokalizacjach, w tym w Łodzi.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: Międzynarodowy Bieg św. Dominika to prestiżowa impreza biegowa odbywająca się corocznie od 1994 roku w Gdańsku, będąca integralną częścią Jarmarku św. Dominika. To sportowe wydarzenie lata na Wybrzeżu, które przyciąga ponad 1200 biegaczy i dziesiątki tysięcy kibiców, oferując wyjątkową atmosferę w zabytkowym centrum miasta. Trasa biegu to pętla o długości 1412 metrów prowadząca ulicami gdańskiej starówki, z metą i startem przy fontannie Neptuna. Impreza promuje zdrowy styl życia i integrację społeczną, a także oferuje bogaty program towarzyszący z koncertami i pokazami.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 1412 m w centrum Gdańska, start i meta przy fontannie Neptuna
Pętla prowadząca ulicami Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników, Podwale Przedmiejskie i innymi
Niesamowity doping ponad 25 000 widzów na trasie
additional: Impreza obejmuje cztery biegi pod wspólnym hasłem „Goń św. Dominika”, w tym Prolog dla wszystkich uczestników Jarmarku, Bieg Kobiet 5km Lotto Cup, Bieg Mężczyzn 5km Energa Cup oraz Bieg Elity Mężczyzn - Mistrzostwa Polski na 10 km. Wydarzenie odbywa się w ramach Festiwalu Biegowego z bogatym programem towarzyszącym, w tym stoiskami partnerów, prezentacjami i koncertami Jarmarku.

name: Arm Race Kamień
description: Arm Race Kamień to ekstremalny bieg z przeszkodami odbywający się w gminie Ceków-Kolonia. Trasa oferuje sportowe wyzwanie dla uczestników na różnych poziomach zaawansowania, łącząc rywalizację, technikę i satysfakcję z pokonywania przeszkód. Wydarzenie jest częścią serii biegów OCR, które przyciągają zarówno zawodników nastawionych na wynik, jak i osoby rozpoczynające przygodę z biegami przeszkodowymi oraz całe rodziny. To nie tylko bieg, ale także emocjonujące doświadczenie i okazja do aktywności na świeżym powietrzu.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km lub 10 km z około 25 lub 40 przeszkodami
Różnorodne formuły: PRO, OPEN, FUN oraz rodzinne i młodzieżowe
Ekstremalne przeszkody wymagające wytrzymałości, techniki i intensywności
additional: Możliwość wyboru formuły dostosowanej do poziomu zaawansowania, w tym wariant PRO dla walczących o wynik i OPEN dla osób szukających sportowego wyzwania. Dostępne są także formuły rodzinne i młodzieżowe. Karnet na sezon 2027 obejmuje 3 starty (5 km lub 10 km, także PRO/ELITE) za 699 zł, z techniczną czapką ARM RACE w prezencie.

name: Bieg o Wronkę Szlakiem Świętego Jakuba
location: Wronka, Giżycko County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Polska
description: Bieg o Wronkę Szlakiem Świętego Jakuba to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w malowniczej miejscowości Wronka koło Giżycka. Zawody oferują trasy na 5 km i 10 km po drogach szutrowych, a także biegi dla dzieci na krótszych dystansach. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalny pomiar czasu, pakiety startowe z medalami oraz posiłek regeneracyjny. Impreza organizowana jest przez Koło Gospodyń Wiejskich Wronka we współpracy z Gminą Giżycko, tworząc przyjazną atmosferę dla biegaczy w każdym wieku.
course_highlights: Trasa biegu na 5 km po drodze szutrowej
Trasa biegu na 10 km po drodze szutrowej
Biegi dzieci i młodzieży na dystansach 0,5 km
additional: Biuro zawodów czynne od 8:00 do 11:30 w dniu imprezy. Odbiór pakietów startowych oraz możliwość zapisów i płatności gotówką w dniu biegu w ramach limitu 200 uczestników. Medal na mecie oraz bon na posiłek regeneracyjny dla uczestników. Pomiar czasu realizowany za pomocą chipów zwracanych na mecie. Biegi dzieci i młodzieży bez pomiaru czasu i klasyfikacji.

name: IX Rudzki Półmaraton Industrialny
description: IX Rudzki Półmaraton Industrialny to wyjątkowe wydarzenie biegowe odbywające się w Rudzie Śląskiej, które łączy sport z industrialnym dziedzictwem regionu. Trasa o długości 10,5 km prowadzi przez centralną część miasta, mijając zabytki poprzemysłowe takie jak dworzec w Chebziu, Szyb Mikołaj, osiedle Kaufhaus oraz wielki piec Huty Pokój. Oprócz półmaratonu organizowany jest także bieg towarzyszący na dystansie około 10 km, umożliwiający udział osobom mniej doświadczonym. Start i meta znajdują się na stadionie lekkoatletycznym przy ul. Czarnoleśnej, gdzie mieści się również biuro zawodów i zaplecze organizacyjne.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 10,5 km na pętli w centralnej części miasta
Przebieg przez zabytki poprzemysłowe: dworzec w Chebziu, Szyb Mikołaj, osiedle Kaufhaus
Przejście obok jedynego na Śląsku wielkiego pieca Huty Pokój
additional: Start i meta na stadionie lekkoatletycznym przy ul. Czarnoleśnej, gdzie znajduje się także Biuro Zawodów i zaplecze. Bieg towarzyszący na dystansie około 10 km dla osób niegotowych na półmaraton. Zapisy odbywają się na platformie DO:ST:AR:TU.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: XI Czastarska Piątka to coroczny bieg uliczny organizowany w gminie Czastary, który przyciąga biegaczy z różnych miejsc. Impreza ma charakter sportowo-rekreacyjny i odbywa się na trasie o długości 5 kilometrów, prowadzącej przez malownicze tereny gminy. Bieg jest doskonałą okazją do aktywnego spędzenia czasu oraz integracji lokalnej społeczności i miłośników sportu.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 5 km
Bieg uliczny przez teren gminy Czastary
Malownicze krajobrazy i przyjazna atmosfera

name: Bieg z okazji 82. Rocznicy Wybuchu Powstania Warszawskiego
II Wielgomłyński Dycha
location: Wielgomłyny, Radomsko County, Łódź Voivodeship, Polska

name: Półmaraton Cross Laskowa
location: Laskowa, Limanowa County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Polska

name: Markttagelauf
description: The Markttage Run in Bredstedt is an international charity run, with entry fees donated to a good cause. There are different distances for children, beginners and experienced runners, taking them through Bredstedt town centre. The event fosters a sense of community and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups. Registration is online, and entry fees are moderate to make it possible for as many people as possible to take part.
course_highlights: Different routes for children, beginners and experienced runners
Run through Bredstedt town centre
International run for a good cause
additional: Registration online only until 30.07. at www.my.raceresult.com. Note: The event information PDF is currently not accessible.

name: 18. Ottonenlauf
description: The Ottonenlauf is a scenic race in the Harz that brings runners from three different villages to a shared finish in Quedlinburg, a UNESCO World Heritage city. The 21.1 km, 42.2 km, and 69 km routes start in Stiege, Alexisbad, and Meisdorf, respectively. The route runs mostly along forest and woodland trails through the Selke Valley, with shaded forests, rural sections, and moderate climbs that call for a good pace. Walking and Nordic walking options are also available, making the event open to a wide range of participants. Electronic timing and finisher medals round out the event.

name: 24. Hella Marathon Nacht
description: The hella marathon night rostock is an atmospheric sunset run set against the picturesque backdrop of the Haedgehalbinsel in Rostock’s city harbor. The event offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 km, and a children’s race. All start at dusk and finish in a brightly lit finish area. The route passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, and is kept traffic-free. The event combines a sporting challenge with Northern German hospitality and a holiday atmosphere.

name: 5. TCW Backyard Ultra
description: The TCW Backyard Ultra in Wölfersheim is a unique running event focused on camaraderie and endurance. A 6.706 km loop starts at the top of every hour and must be completed within that hour. The race continues until only one runner remains, who is declared the winner. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and motivating community, welcoming runners of all abilities.

name: adidas Runners City Night
description: The adidas Runners City Night in Berlin is a summer sports highlight that combines running and inline skating with a big party. The event offers 5 km and 10 km running routes, as well as a 10 km inline skating route through the lively City West and along Kurfürstendamm. Live bands, cheering zones, and enthusiastic spectators create a unique atmosphere, culminating at a glowing finish arch by the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church. Participants receive a glow-in-the-dark medal as a memento of this special event.
course_highlights: The route runs through the heart of City West and along Kurfürstendamm
Live bands and cheering points along the route, especially at Adenauerplatz
Start and finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder on the back of the race bib. The 5 km route has just one turnaround point and runs straight along Kurfürstendamm. The 10 km run has a time limit of 1:30 hours. The medal glows in the dark. Personalized medal engraving can be added during registration.

name: hella marathon nacht rostock
description: The hella marathon nacht rostock is an atmospheric sunset run along the Warnow, with a maritime flair and Hanseatic hospitality. The event takes place in August in Rostock and offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 and a students’ run. The start and finish are at Rostock’s city harbor, where runners set off at dusk and finish beneath bright lights. The course passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, making for a unique running experience.

name: Hemfurth-Edersee-Abendlauf
description: The Hemfurth-Edersee Evening Run is a traditional late-summer race that brings runners of all ages together in the beautiful surroundings of Edertal-Hemfurth. In pleasant temperatures and as the sun sets, the focus is on the joy of movement and a sense of community. At the finish, participants can enjoy refreshments, good music, and a sociable get-together in a relaxed atmosphere. The race is organized by volunteers from TSV 08 Hemfurth-Edersee e.V. and is a popular event for ambitious runners, recreational joggers, and families.

name: Pörndorfer Sommernachtslauf
description: The 15th Pörndorfer Summer Night Run in Aldersbach is a running event with a friendly, family atmosphere and a genuine competitive spirit. It offers suitable challenges for all age groups and ability levels, from the Bambini run through the children’s and youth races to the main race. Nordic walking is also part of the program. The event combines sporting ambition with a communal summer atmosphere and draws runners and spectators from the region.

name: Schwindegger Schlosslauf
description: The Schwindegg Castle Run is an annual sporting event in the idyllic community of Schwindegg. Participants run along picturesque paths and through forests, with views of Schwindegg Castle. There are various categories for all age groups, including children and teenagers. The event is also an opportunity to strengthen the community and support the sports club. Before and after the run, a summer festival with food, a drinks stand and a bar offers a cheerful atmosphere for celebrating and socializing.

name: Krkonošská 50
location: Areál Svatý Petr, Špindlerův Mlýn, Czech Republic
description: Krkonošská 50 is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque setting of the Krkonoše National Park, starting in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The field is limited to 300 starters, and the race is divided into several age categories for men and women. The organizers emphasize environmental responsibility and safety, including a requirement to carry a mobile phone and a ban on littering outside refreshment stations.

name: Běhej lesy Bílá
description: Běhej lesy Bílá is a mountain trail race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area. The race offers several routes, including a short and a long course; the long ČSOB 20 km route is included in the international UTMB Index. Runners can take the cable car to the summit and look forward to the special Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add extra competitive elements and rewards. The race is suitable for all mountain trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of the Beskydy Mountains and compete on well-marked routes.

name: Zlatá stezka
description: The Golden Trail is a historic international hiking route connecting Bohemia with the Danube region. It winds through the beautiful landscapes of Šumava and the Bavarian Forest. At 631 km long, it offers a unique experience, linking up with Germany’s Golden Trail and passing through several national parks and nature reserves. Hikers can explore historic towns, castles, observation towers, and cultural landmarks along the trail, which is equipped with information boards and rest areas. The Golden Trail is ideal for hiking and discovering the region’s natural and historical attractions in the South Bohemian and Plzeň regions.

name: Běh na Kamenný stůl
description: The Run to the Stone Table is a traditional running race held in Rataje nad Sázavou, celebrating its 10th anniversary this year. The race offers a challenging and beautiful route from the castle courtyard to the Stone Table landmark, with varied surfaces and hilly terrain. It is open to professional runners, amateurs, and families with children, with shorter routes available for the latter. The race is part of the Běhej zámky series, which brings together running races at attractive locations near castles.

name: Mšecká sedmička
organizer: Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec
description: Mšecká sedmička is a traditional running race held in Mšec in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 7 km long and follows forest and field paths, offering runners pleasant natural terrain. It starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field and is suitable for the general public. The event is organized by the Mšec Municipality and TJ Sokol Mšec, who ensure a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.

name: Libeř - Radlík
description: Libeř–Radlík is a 2.47 km uphill race with 170 m of elevation gain, part of the Runs in the Hills in Prague and Surrounding Areas series. The course is not entirely uphill: it includes several flat sections and one downhill, adding interest and variety to the race. The atmosphere is pleasant and the entry fee is symbolic, with generous prizes for the winners from Botanicus. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain near Prague.

name: Trail Running Cup - Krkonošská padesátka
location: Mšec, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Krkonoše Fifty is a traditional trail race held in the scenic surroundings of Špindlerův Mlýn in the Krkonoše Mountains. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The start is at the Svatý Petr resort, and participants can use the central car park in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race is limited to 300 starters. Overall winners are named for both men and women, along with winners in ten age categories for men and women.

name: Bear Foot Poľana
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 is a mountain race set in the wild and unique Poľana Mountains, the highest and best-preserved volcano in Central Europe. The race offers two main courses: 24 km with over 1,300 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and 10 km with over 600 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through popular hiking spots such as Bystrô Waterfall, the Kaľamárka Celtic hillfort, and the summit of Predná Poľana. Runners can enjoy the beauty of deep forests, mountain streams, and pastures. The race is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association league and is limited to 150 runners per course.

name: Porubska 11-ka
location: Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka
description: Porúbska 11-ka is a running race held in the village of Porúbka in Bardejov District. It features gently rolling, hilly to flat terrain at an elevation of 196 m. The course passes through the Carpathian region, which offers a combination of flat stretches and hills, ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable run in nature. The race is organized by the municipality of Porúbka and is part of local sporting activities with a tradition and community spirit. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
location: Lednické Rovne, Medné, Lednické Rovne, Medné, Medné
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia is an OCR race that will test your strength, endurance, and determination in Slovakia’s authentic natural surroundings. The course runs through meadows, forests, streams, and hills, with a variety of technical sections and obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing, and carrying loads. The race is open to men and women, from beginners to experienced athletes, with a time limit of 3 hours. Every participant receives an official T-shirt, a medal, a race pack, and electronic timing. Island Gladiator is not just a competition, but a challenge to overcome yourself and become a stronger gladiator.

name: „Biržų kilometrų“ bėgimas
description: The “Biržų kilometrai” run is a traditional event held during the Biržai City Festival. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively, meet like-minded people, and enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of the city. The event welcomes participants of all ages and promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit.
course_highlights: The run takes place in Biržai.
The event is held during the city festival.
The run is included in the Lithuanian Running Cup series.

name: XI Gorce Ultra-Trail
description: Gorce Ultra-Trail to wyjątkowy bieg górski odbywający się w malowniczej okolicy Ochotnicy Dolnej. Uczestnicy mają do wyboru pięć zróżnicowanych tras o długościach od 5 do 102 km, dostosowanych do różnych poziomów zaawansowania, od początkujących po doświadczonych ultramaratończyków. Trasy prowadzą przez piękne tereny Gorców, oferując wymagające podbiegi i spektakularne widoki. Limit czasu na najdłuższej trasie wynosi 20 godzin, co podkreśla wyzwanie i charakter imprezy.

name: Kresowe Trail #9
description: Kresowe Trail to kameralne biegi terenowe organizowane przez Fundację Maratony Kresowe, które promują zdrowy tryb życia i aktywność fizyczną w otoczeniu przyrody wschodniej Polski. Cykl składa się z jedenastu biegów odbywających się na dwóch dystansach: krótszym Szpurt (6-8 km) oraz dłuższym Wertep (17-21 km). Zawody odbywają się w malowniczych lokalizacjach, z poszanowaniem środowiska i lokalnych społeczności, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalną organizację, elektroniczny pomiar czasu oraz bogaty pakiet startowy. Kresowe Trail to także rywalizacja Nordic Walking oraz integracja biegaczy w duchu fair play i przyjaźni.
course_highlights: Trasy terenowe o długości około 6-8 km (Szpurt) i 17-21 km (Wertep)
Malownicze tereny Podlasia i Wileńszczyzny z oznakowaniem tras i bufetami
Limitowana liczba uczestników dla bezpieczeństwa i jakości organizacji
additional: Starty odbywają się w sektorach według wyników z poprzedniego sezonu. Pakiet startowy zawiera ciepły posiłek regeneracyjny, elektroniczny pomiar czasu, numer startowy z chipem ważny na cały sezon, zabezpieczenie medyczne, bufety na trasie i mecie, pamiątkowy medal (przy wcześniejszej rejestracji), serwis fotograficzny oraz nagrody dla najlepszych zawodników. Obowiązuje bezwzględny zakaz śmiecenia na trasie. Możliwość rejestracji internetowej do godziny 08:40 w dniu zawodów oraz rejestracja na miejscu od 8:00. W przypadku rejestracji późniejszej niż 10 dni przed zawodami pakiet startowy może być niepełny.

name: XI Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól
description: XI Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w malowniczej gminie Krasnopol. Trasa biegu ma około 10 km i prowadzi wyłącznie leśnymi drogami o nawierzchni szutrowej i trawiastej, co zapewnia kontakt z naturą i przyjemne warunki do biegania. Biuro zawodów mieści się w Gminnym Centrum Czytelnictwa i Kultury, a start biegu odbywa się w godzinach popołudniowych. Bieg jest otwarty dla różnych grup biegaczy, w tym Nordic Walking na dystansie 5 km. Organizatorzy dbają o komfort uczestników, zapewniając mapki i wskazówki dotyczące parkowania oraz punktów startowych.
course_highlights: Trasa około 10 km wyłącznie leśnymi drogami (szutrowe, trawiaste)
Start i meta w gminie Krasnopol
Malownicze tereny naturalne sprzyjające bieganiu
additional: Biuro zawodów czynne 13:00 - 15:00 w Gminnym Centrum Czytelnictwa i Kultury, ul. 1 Maja 1. Parkowanie dozwolone na terenie całej miejscowości z wyznaczonymi miejscami. Trasa biegu prowadzi po leśnych drogach szutrowych i trawiastych. Dostępne dystanse: bieg 10 km oraz Nordic Walking 5 km. Biegi są bezpłatne, ale wymagana jest odpowiedzialna rejestracja.

name: XXXIV Bieg Jezior
location: Stary Uścimów, Lubartów County, Lublin Voivodeship, Polska

name: virtueller St.-Anna-Jedermannslauf
description: The virtual St. Anna Fun Run in Amerdingen is a popular race held every July. Participants can run the original courses of 10 km, 5.8 km jogging, 5.8 km walking, or 3.5 km for young people. The route leads from St. Anna Chapel through the forest south of Amerdingen, past historic landmarks such as the Celtic rampart and the Three Stones, as well as a small lake. Times are recorded via an app and transferred immediately to a leaderboard, making the race especially modern and accessible. The event is attracting increasing numbers of participants and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups.
course_highlights: Start at St. Anna Chapel
Forest route south of Amerdingen with historic landmarks such as the Celtic rampart and the Three Stones
Route marked with directional arrows, with app-supported timekeeping
additional: The race is virtual and takes place in July, allowing participants to complete their runs at a time that suits them. Multiple entries and a second free attempt are possible. Different course distances are available for various age groups and ability levels. Virtual race, route toward the Celtic rampart, online registration, race period from 01.07. to 27.07.2025, start times between 06:00 and 20:00, participation from age 8, donations to preserve the chapel

name: Hirschbachschleiferl
organizer: Lauftreff Kirchdorf, Abteilung des Sport Club Kirchdorf
description: The Hirschbachschleiferl is a long-standing race in Kirchdorf im Ampertal that welcomes runners of all ability levels. The event takes place at Rathausplatz and combines a sporting challenge with a strong sense of community. In addition to the sporting aspect, the race supports social projects, such as Freising Cancer Support, through donations. Participation is at your own risk, and the organizers emphasize participants’ health and personal responsibility.
course_highlights: Main race over 9.7 km
Course includes sections on asphalt and through the forest
Additional race options over 3.9 km, as well as children’s races
additional: The race supports social organizations through donations from participants and local businesses. There is no information about different start times, tiered pricing, or special running gear. The finish is at Rathausplatz.

name: 10. Charity-Lauf Koldingen
description: The Koldingen Charity Run is part of the Sparkassen Laufpass of the Hanover Region, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. Runners can explore the Hanover Region on foot and collect stamps in their running pass each time they take part. The run offers a varied course in the beautiful surroundings of Pattensen and promotes recreational sport in the region. The event is open to everyone who wants to be active while doing good.

name: 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen
description: The 55th Volkslauf Rund um Wellen takes place in Beverstedt-Wellen and is one of Germany’s oldest marathons, with a friendly, family atmosphere. The event offers challenging courses over four distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km and 5 km. Some courses are certified by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The route passes through varied landscapes, with forest trails and a range of surfaces. The event is organized by TSV Wellen and relies on support from many volunteers from the village.

name: Hilpoltsteiner Burgfestlauf
description: The Hilpoltstein Castle Festival Run is a long-standing running event held as part of the Hilpoltstein Castle Festival. It takes place every year on the first Sunday in August. The event offers races for different age and ability groups, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s, fun and main races. A special highlight is the castle hill sprint in the main race, where the fastest runners can earn the title of Castle Hill King or Queen. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive course, with the start and finish on Marktstraße near the town hall.

name: Kapellenlauf Vorra
description: The Kapellenlauf Vorra is a traditional race held annually by DJK SC Vorra. It offers several distances, including a half marathon, a quarter marathon of 10.55 km, and a fun run and Nordic walking, newly added in 2025. The course passes through the rural surroundings of Abtsdorf and offers both competitive racing and a more leisurely running experience. The race also hosts the Upper Franconian Half Marathon Championships and attracts many participants from the region.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Moldava
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in different destinations, including Moldava, with routes for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers. Each race offers a main running race of 6 to 9 km, an adventure route of 20 to 30 km using a map, a 5 to 8 km walk with checkpoints to find, and children’s races from 200 to 1,600 metres. The series is suitable for a wide range of people who want to explore the beauty of the Ore Mountains in an active and sporting way.

name: Klokočovská päťka
location: Obecný úrad, Klokočov, Michalovce District, Slovakia
description: Klokočovská päťka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Klokočov in the Michalovce District. This sporting event offers runners the chance to enjoy a pleasant day outdoors while supporting the community. The course passes through the municipality’s picturesque surroundings and is suitable for the general public. The organizers welcome all runners interested in being active and enjoying a sporting experience.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque natural surroundings of Klokočov
The race is suitable for the general public and different age groups
The event promotes community spirit and sport in the region

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 8. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race covers 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The competition is part of a race series in which runners earn points toward a travelling cup based on their performances and participation in individual rounds.

name: Malý Kavečianský maratón
location: Kavečany - Košice, Kavečany - Košice, Futbalový štadión
organizer: TJ Mladosť Kavečany a MÚ MČ Košice - Kavečany
description: The Malý Kavečianský Marathon is a running event in Kavečany near Košice, offering 21 km and 7 km races as well as children’s runs. The race starts at the football stadium and is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans. It is organised by TJ Mladosť Kavečany together with the Košice-Kavečany Municipal District. The event is suitable for runners of various ages and ability levels, with affordable entry fees and online registration available.

name: 5-as pusės maratono bėgimas „Jonavos tiltai“ 2026
description: The 5th “Jonavos Bridges” Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Jonava, held on the city’s streets and bridges. Taking place in midsummer, the event brings running enthusiasts together to test their endurance and enjoy views of the city. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and get to know Jonava’s running community.
course_highlights: Run along the city’s streets and bridges
Scenic route across Jonava’s bridges
Summer event in Jonava

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Karlštejn
description: The Berounka Running Series in Karlštejn is a community trail race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Autokemp Karlštejn. The route crosses fields, meadows, and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry, continues along the red-marked St. James’s Way to Karlštejn Castle, and finishes with a downhill run to the finish line. The race offers a friendly atmosphere, a marked route, refreshments, and bag storage. Every participant receives a race number, and the top finishers in each category receive certificates and medals.

name: Berglauf zur Schuhbräualm
description: The 41st Berglauf zur Schuhbräualm is a challenging mountain run held in Raubling. The course covers 7.5 kilometers with an elevation gain of around 678 meters. The run starts at 19:00 and offers runners a challenging mountain route. The event is aimed at mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: 7.5 km course
678 meters of elevation gain
Very challenging mountainous profile
additional: Start and finish are provided for all competitions; exact location details require RUNME Premium. Accommodation is available near the start and finish. The run starts in Großholzhausen, with parking, changing facilities, and baggage transport. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a festive atmosphere with a raffle and commemorative gifts. Early registration is recommended.

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
description: The Rozdělov Quarter Marathon is a running race organized by Maratón klub Kladno and held in Kladno-Rozdělov. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing races in the region. The race offers runners of all levels an opportunity to test themselves over a quarter-marathon distance in the pleasant surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The event is part of the club’s running calendar and supports the running community around Kladno.

name: Krčský lomcovák
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Krčský Lomcovák is a traditional running race held in Krčský Forest in Prague 4. The race offers a 5 km course starting by the Velký altán, open to both men and women, with separate start times. The event is part of a fun sports afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and families with children can try various activities, such as slacklining, sack racing and disc golf. The race is organized by Krčák žije magazine, which covers activities and news from Krčský Forest and its surroundings.

name: X Memoriał Biegowy
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Lidzbarku Warmińskim
description: Jubileuszowy X Memoriał Biegowy im. Tadeusza Brzostka to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Lidzbarku Warmińskim. Zawody odbywają się na Stadionie Miejskim, oferując uczestnikom możliwość rywalizacji i aktywnego spędzenia czasu w sportowej atmosferze. Impreza ma charakter lokalny i jest okazją do promowania sportu oraz rekreacji wśród mieszkańców i gości.
course_highlights: Bieg główny na dystansie 5 km.
Biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży na dystansach od 200 m do 1 km.
Stadion Miejski jest miejscem startu i mety.
additional: Biegi dziecięce odbywają się na bieżni tartanowej.

name: Esenser Volksbanklauf - 31. Stadtlauf
description: The 31st Esens City Run, held as the 6th Esens Volksbank Run, takes place in Esens. The traditional “Around St. Magnus” race offers exciting competitions for runners of all ages in the town center. The event begins with a 670-meter Bambini run, followed by student races over 1,340 meters. Adults can compete over five and ten kilometers, with both races starting at the same time. The award ceremonies take place immediately after the races.
course_highlights: “Around St. Magnus” race in the town center of Esens
670-meter Bambini run
Adult races over 5 and 10 kilometers
additional: Start times: Bambini run at 18:10, student race at 18:30, and adult 5 km and 10 km races at 19:30. Online registration is available. Start and finish at Esens Market Square; online registration available; July weather: approx. 25°C, sunny.

name: Berglauf
description: TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. warmly invites you to the hill run in Höxter, which features a challenging course with varied terrain. The event includes a children’s hill run of approx. 1 km and a main race of approx. 3.2 km, with a steady climb and an elevation gain of about 170 meters. The course starts at the sports field and runs over grassy areas, asphalt paths, meadow trails, and narrow gravel and forest paths, finishing in the woods. This long-standing running event welcomes runners of all ages.

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
description: The Gifhorn Cemetery Run is a special event held at the St. Nicolai Protestant Lutheran Cemetery in Gifhorn. Runners can choose between 4- and 8-kilometer routes. After the run, participants gather for a relaxed barbecue and drinks under the apple trees. Traditionally held in the evening, the event combines sporting activity with a relaxed atmosphere in a historic setting.

name: Sparkassen-Festungslauf
description: The Sparkassen Fortress Run in Königstein is a summer-evening running adventure at one of Europe’s most architecturally and historically valuable hilltop fortresses. The challenging 9.4-kilometre main course climbs 470 metres, with the final kilometres running across the fortress plateau and offering magnificent views of Saxon Switzerland and the Elbe. Alongside the main race, there is a 7.7 km course, as well as a mini run and an inclusive run, each 1.2 km long, on the fortress plateau. The event has been established for over 20 years and offers a special atmosphere, with the awards ceremony held at sunset in the fortress market square.

name: Stauseelauf
description: The Stauseelauf Chemnitz is a running event organized by Leichtathletik-Club Erdgas Chemnitz e.V. The event is open to runners aged 14 and over who are in suitable training condition. The conditions of participation and organizational measures will be announced before the event. The event prioritizes safety and proper conduct, and the organizer reserves the right to disqualify participants for violations.

name: Benefičný beh pre Marcelku
description: The Run for Marcelka is a charity running event in Kluknava, offering courses for both children and adults. The main run is 5.5 km long, runs mostly on asphalt, and is suitable for the general public. The event also includes children’s races and Nordic walking, with refreshment stations along the course. The race takes place at the football field in Kluknava, where full facilities are available, including changing rooms, showers, and toilets.
course_highlights: The 5.5 km main run is 95% on asphalt
Refreshments along the course and at the finish (water, fruit, cakes)
Registration and start at the football field in Kluknava
additional: Registration and race-pack collection on race day from 14:30 to 16:30 at the football field. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and a bag drop are available in the start area. Parking is available by the church, manor house, and kindergarten in Kluknava.

name: niedamiRUN - Ultramaraton Sudecki
location: Niedamirów, Kamienna Góra County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Polska
description: NiedamiRUN to ultramaraton sudecki odbywający się w Niedamirowie, malowniczej wiosce położonej na granicy trzech kultur. Trasy biegu prowadzą przez Karkonosze, Bramę Lubawską oraz Dolinę Bobru, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe widoki i wymagające podejścia. Zawody obejmują cztery dystanse: 10 km, 20 km, 50 km oraz 100 km, z różnorodnym terenem od szutrów, łąk po regle i górskie szlaki. To doskonała okazja, by zmierzyć się z naturą i własnymi granicami w towarzystwie innych pasjonatów biegania.
course_highlights: Trasy przecinają Karkonosze, Bramę Lubawską i Dolinę Bobru
Wiodą granicznym Grzbietem Lasockim, okolicami Przełęczy Okraj i brzegami Zalewu Bukówka
Różnorodne podłoże: szutry, łąki, regle oraz solidne podejścia górskie
additional: Limit uczestników na każdy dystans wynosi 100 osób. Na życzenie wystawiane są faktury VAT. Start i meta znajdują się w Niedamirowie.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
location: Śliwice, Tuchola County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Polska

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: 12. eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny to wyjątkowy bieg godzinny odbywający się w Koszalinie na Górce Piaskowej. Uczestnicy rywalizują na wymagającej, około 1-kilometrowej pętli w trudnym, pagórkowatym terenie leśnym z fragmentami piaszczystymi. Bieg trwa dokładnie 1 godzinę, podczas której zawodnicy pokonują dowolną liczbę okrążeń, a zwycięzca to ten, kto przebiegnie ich najwięcej. Na mecie czekają unikalne, bardzo ciężkie medale oraz poczęstunek z grilla i ognisko, co tworzy przyjazną i integracyjną atmosferę.
course_highlights: Pętla o długości około 1 km w trudnym, pagórkowatym terenie leśnym
Zróżnicowane podłoże z fragmentami piaszczystymi
Wymagające podbiegi i liczne przewyższenia
additional: Start i meta na Górce Piaskowej w Koszalinie. Elektroniczny pomiar czasu z chipem. Uczestnicy otrzymują numer startowy z agrafkami. Na mecie napój i zabezpieczenie medyczne PCK Koszalin. Po biegu poczęstunek z kiełbasą z grilla, bułkami słodkimi oraz ognisko. Limit miejsc: 100 uczestników. Prawo startu od 18 lat z aktualnymi badaniami lekarskimi lub oświadczeniem.

name: Bieg Zbója
description: Bieg Zbója to górski bieg w Bielsku-Białej, który nawiązuje do legendy zbójnika Klimczoka. Trasa biegu prowadzi przez malownicze, ale wymagające górskie szlaki, w tym kultowe podejście pod kolejkę na Szyndzielnię oraz szczyt Klimczoka. Zawody oferują niezapomniane emocje i sprawdzą wytrzymałość każdego uczestnika, łącząc piękne widoki z wymagającym terenem.
course_highlights: Trasa górska z podejściem pod kolejkę na Szyndzielnię
Szczyt Klimczoka z legendarną historią zbójnika
Dziki i szybki zbieg wymagający dużej wytrzymałości
additional: Zimowy Bieg Zbója 2027 oferuje dwie trasy: Zbójnik 18 km z 996 m przewyższeń startujący o 09:00 oraz Piechur 13 km z 786 m przewyższeń startujący o 09:45. Trasy są wymagające, z zimową aurą i górskim charakterem. Zapisy odbywają się online z płatnościami przez PayU i PayPal.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań - edycja letnia to bieg przełajowy organizowany w malowniczym Ogrodzie Botanicznym UAM w Poznaniu. Impreza jest częścią cyklu biegów, które od 2014 roku promują bieganie i piękno naturalnych tras w Wielkopolsce. Bieg przyciąga pasjonatów biegania, którzy cenią sobie zarówno sportową rywalizację, jak i estetykę otoczenia. Lokalizacja zastępcza to Jezioro Rusałka, położone zaledwie 500 metrów od Ogrodu Botanicznego, co zapewnia dodatkowe walory krajobrazowe.
course_highlights: Trasa przełajowa w Ogrodzie Botanicznym UAM
Malownicze tereny zielone i naturalne otoczenie
Lokalizacja zastępcza nad Jeziorem Rusałka, 500 m od startu
additional: Pakiety startowe można odbierać z upoważnieniem. Organizatorzy szczególny nacisk kładą na walory estetyczne proponowanych lokalizacji biegów. Latem świętowana jest 10. rocznica Botanicznej Piątki.

name: I Jura Night Dog Run
location: Klucze, Olkusz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Polska
description: I Jura Night Dog Run to wyjątkowy bieg canicross, który odbywa się nocą w malowniczej okolicy Jury Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej. Zawodnicy mają do wyboru dystanse 10 km i półmaraton 21 km, a także możliwość startu wirtualnego na dowolnym dystansie. Impreza jest limitowana do 200 uczestników, co gwarantuje kameralną atmosferę i bezpieczeństwo. Start biegu zaplanowano na godzinę 20:00, co dodaje wyjątkowego charakteru rywalizacji z psem u boku.
course_highlights: Bieg nocny w malowniczej scenerii Jury Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej
Dostępne dystanse: 10 km i półmaraton 21 km
Możliwość startu wirtualnego na dowolnym dystansie
additional: Limit uczestników wynosi 200 osób. Dostępne są kategorie indywidualne oraz drużynowe (team), w których musi być co najmniej jedna kobieta lub mężczyzna. Pakiet startowy jest pełny i obowiązuje dla wszystkich dystansów. Dostępne są regulaminy w wersji standardowej i wirtualnej.

name: Złota Dycha
description: Złota Dycha to uliczny bieg organizowany w Złotoryi, odbywający się na dystansach 5 i 10 kilometrów. Trasa biegu składa się z pętli o długości 2,5 km, które uczestnicy pokonują odpowiednio dwukrotnie lub czterokrotnie. Bieg ma charakter wymagający, z lekko zmienionym profilem trasy, a na trasie znajdują się punkty z wodą, które pomagają w nawodnieniu podczas rywalizacji. Po zakończeniu zawodów odbywa się dekoracja najlepszych zawodników w różnych kategoriach. Impreza przyciąga biegaczy z całego regionu i jest organizowana z dbałością o komfort i bezpieczeństwo uczestników.
course_highlights: Trasa składa się z pętli o długości 2,5 km
Dwa dystanse: 5 km (2 pętle) i 10 km (4 pętle)
Na trasie rozmieszczone punkty z wodą - 4 na 5 km i 8 na 10 km
additional: Biuro Obsługi Zawodników czynne od 7:00 do 9:30 przy ul. Rynek przy fontannie Delfina. Limit uczestników: 100 miejsc na 5 km, 200 miejsc na 10 km, łącznie 300 osób. Każdy uczestnik otrzymuje numer startowy z chipem, mini pakiet startowy, pamiątkowy medal oraz posiłek regeneracyjny. Limit czasu: 60 minut na 5 km, 105 minut na 10 km. Po biegu dekoracja najlepszych zawodników po godzinie 12:00.

name: 16. Piesauer Glasmacherlauf
description: The 16th Piesau Glassmakers’ Run takes place in Piesau, Thuringia. The event offers 2 km races for children and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a 10 km Nordic walking competition on forest trails. It is part of the Sparkassen Cup and the TLV Running and Nordic Walking Cup, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with changing and shower facilities and refreshments on site. Trophies and awards are presented to the fastest runners and age-group winners.
course_highlights: 2 km children’s race
10 km main race entirely on forest trails
10 km Nordic walking with poles; running is prohibited
additional: Changing, washing and shower facilities are available. Food, drinks and cake are sold on site. Trophies are awarded to the fastest runners in each distance (places 1–3 for each gender), with awards for the top three in each age group. A team classification is held for the 10 km race, based on the two fastest women or three fastest men from a club.

name: Oettinger Stadtlauf
description: The Oettingen City Run takes place in Oettingen’s town centre as part of the “Summer in the City” festival. The event offers races for children, young people and adults, with timing for the main and youth races as well as the walking event. The routes pass through the historic town centre and offer a sporting challenge for all age groups. The event is organised by TSV Oettingen, Running Group, Triathlon and Athletics departments, and is a popular local race with a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the historic town centre of Oettingen
Children’s race, approx. 0.8 km, untimed
Main race and walking event, approx. 7 km, timed
additional: Children’s race is untimed; registration is available through the Oettingen holiday programme; late registration is possible on the day of the event for an additional fee; medals and drinks for the children’s and youth races; prizes for the first three boys and girls in the youth race; walking event and main race are timed; staggered start times from 16:00. The course is mostly flat, on asphalt and cobblestones. Start and finish at the Market Square. Open to all physically fit participants. Oettingen residents’ city championship.

name: CJ Schmidt Hafentagelauf
description: The CJ Schmidt Harbour Day Run takes place in Husum, a city on the North Sea in Schleswig-Holstein, as part of the Husum Harbour Days festival. The event offers flat road races over various distances, including children’s and youth races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. There is also the Husum Corporate Cup, in which company teams of four compete. The course runs through the city centre and along the harbour, combining urban streets with waterfront paths, accompanied by the fresh North Sea breeze.
course_highlights: Flat road races through Husum’s city centre and harbour
Course along the North Sea coast with a fresh sea breeze
A range of distances for children, young people and relay teams
additional: The organiser is Husumer Sportverein seit 1875 e.V. Timing is provided by Race Result, and registration is managed by LAV Husum. Typical August weather in Husum is around 25 °C, with mostly sunny days and average precipitation of 60 mm. The event also includes team and corporate races as well as family races, with a festive atmosphere in the harbour area. August weather is usually sunny, at around 25°C.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
description: The Volkslauf around the Center of Germany is a sporting event in Krebeck, suitable for young and old alike, as well as both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking routes with varied elevation profiles, some of which are challenging and follow paved or asphalt paths. The races start and finish at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there are age-group rankings and on-site medical support.

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The course follows paved and partly asphalted paths around Auesee and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional running series with a total of nine events. It is organized by ATSV Espelkamp, which ensures a well-organized event and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Měřínský kros
description: Měřín Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country race through the beautiful Vysočina countryside. It offers a 13 km main race over Dědkovská hora and a relaxed 8 km course suitable for recreational runners. Children aged 5 to 12 can take part in the Junior Cross obstacle race, which features a giant bouncy castle. The race is timed using chip timing, and after the run there is an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments. The start and finish are at the sports field behind the primary school in Měřín, where parking, a baggage drop, toilets, changing rooms and showers are available.

name: Mořice Run
location: Mořice, Prostějov District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Mořice Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque village of Mořice near Olomouc. The race is part of a series of running events focused on recreational and competitive running, which the club organizes in Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and endurance races, and Mořice Run offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a quality race atmosphere. The club also provides support and advice to runners who want to get started or improve their training.

name: Slatinická sedmička
description: Slatinice Seven is a 7 km charity run that follows mostly off-road routes around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc. The race is dedicated to the memory of Šárka Krčková and offers runners a pleasant route surrounded by nature. The event is suitable for all runners who want to combine sport with supporting a good cause.

name: Vnorovská desítka
description: Vnorovská Desítka is a popular 10 km race held every year in August in the village of Vnorovy. The race is part of the Moravian-Slovak Running Cup and attracts over 200 runners from various countries, including Czech elite athletes and African runners. The course follows a closed asphalt loop with minimal elevation gain, with the start and finish at the elementary school. The atmosphere is lively, thanks to the large crowd and high number of participants; nearly 700 runners take part across all categories.

name: Východniarska
location: Kluknava, parkovisko pred Kaštieľom hotela Biela dáma, čierny rytier – 8.8.2026 o 9:00
description: Východniarska is a mountain ultratrail and long-distance hike for individuals, building on the popular Východniarska stovka. The route runs through the eastern part of the Slovak Ore Mountains, mostly through the Volovské vrchy, and offers a challenging 85 km run with +4200 m of elevation gain. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak, with a time limit of 22 hours. The event is open to the public to participants aged 18 and over and requires proper registration and payment of the entry fee.

name: Hámorská dvadsiatka
location: Obecný úrad Remetské Hámre, Remetské Hámre, Slovakia
description: Hámorská dvadsiatka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre. Despite the cancellation of the last two editions due to the Covid-19 pandemic, the organizers are looking forward to bringing the event back and welcoming a large turnout of runners. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains, which offer attractive routes for sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains
Beautiful views and tourist attractions in the area
Organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre, with a long-standing tradition

name: Rajecký maratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held in the picturesque surroundings of Rajec and the surrounding area. Runners can expect a challenging course with elevation gain and beautiful natural scenery that will test their endurance and fitness. The event has a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere, reflected in its side events and the hospitality at the finish. In addition to the marathon, a half marathon, relay, cross duathlon, and the popular Rajec Borošovec are also held. The Borošovec is a cross-country classic with more than 200 meters of elevation gain.
course_highlights: A course with more than 200 meters of elevation gain
The Rajec Borošovec cross-country classic, 14.1 km long
Natural scenery in Rajec and the surrounding area
additional: The Rajec Borošovec is part of the events that kick off the running season in the Rajec Valley. After the races, participants are served goulash and homemade cakes. The Rajec Borošovec course is dry and fast, with possible obstacles such as fallen trees. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also attracts younger runners and juniors.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký In-line Half Marathon is a competitive inline skating race held in Rajec at SNP Square. The course runs from Rajec to the village of Čičmany and back, with the finish at the marathon turnaround point in Čičmany. Skaters must wear a helmet throughout the course and use the rented timing chips, which must be returned at the finish. The organizer provides refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as free transport back to Rajec for inline skaters. The final finishing straight is reserved for runners, so participants must follow the organizer’s rules.

name: Rajecká štafeta
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Relay is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is a relay race that is part of the Rajec Marathon and gives athletes the opportunity to compete in teams. The organizer provides race bibs, timekeeping, and full support for participants during the race. The event is suitable for runners of various levels and promotes community spirit and enthusiasm for sport in the region.

name: Rajecký detský beh
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký Children’s Run is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is aimed at children and underage runners, with an emphasis on safety and responsibility: a parent or legal guardian must sign for them to participate. The event is part of a wider running program in Rajec and gives young runners the opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a race in a pleasant urban setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at SNP Square in Rajec
For children and underage runners
Safety is supported by a parent or legal guardian’s signature
additional: Children and underage participants must bring a signed declaration from a parent or legal guardian. Participation will not be permitted without it.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Jurbarkas 2026“, skirtos Nemuno metams paminėti
description: In Jurbarkas, on Nemunas Street. Children, young people, and adults are all invited to take part. Three distances are offered: 400 m, 3 km, and 12 km. The event starts at 11:00. All participants who finish will receive commemorative gifts, and the top athletes will receive trophies. This is a great opportunity to celebrate Nemunas Year actively and run together in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Choose from three distances: 400 m, 3 km, and 12 km
The race takes place on Nemunas Street in Jurbarkas
The 12 km distance consists of 4 laps
additional: Race bibs will be distributed from 10:00. Age groups by distance: 400 m — B12/M12 (born in 2014 or later); 3 km — B14/M14, B18/M18 (older participants compete without classification); 12 km — men and women in separate age groups. All participants who finish will receive commemorative gifts, and the top athletes will receive trophies. Race distances: 400 m, 3 km, 12 km; age groups; advance registration; registration will not be available on the day of the event.

name: Šilutės naktinis bėgimas „ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026“
location: Šilutė, Šilutės rajonas, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
description: The Šilutė night run “ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026” is a night running event for everyone who enjoys an active lifestyle—from families and beginners to experienced runners. The event takes place in Šilutė, with an illuminated night course, music, a lively atmosphere, and a variety of activities. Participants can choose the 1 km family, children’s and pets’ run, or the 5 km and 10 km distances. Participants will receive finish medals, prizes will be awarded to the fastest runners, and delicious food will be available.
course_highlights: Illuminated night course
Location: Kiškio dauba, Šilutė
Distances: 1 km, 5 km and 10 km
additional: Event programme: 18:00 bib number collection, 19:30 official opening, 20:00 1 km family, children’s and pets’ run, 21:30 5 km and 10 km runs. Participants can enjoy music, prizes for the fastest runners, a variety of activities, and delicious food. The event programme includes various distances and activities, and participants receive medals and prizes.

name: Druskininkų naktinis bėgimas 2026
description: The Druskininkai Night Run is a unique summer night run in Druskininkai, inviting participants to experience the rhythm of running beneath the stars. The event features a vibrant atmosphere, music, light effects, and a scenic route around Lake Druskonis. Participants can choose from several events, including running, a relay, and roller skating, making it a great activity for families and friends. The run symbolizes friendship between Lithuania and Poland and is part of sports projects that promote cooperation between communities.
course_highlights: Scenic route around Lake Druskonis (1.2 km loop)
Night run with music, light and smoke effects
Option to participate in running and roller-skating events
additional: Race bibs and race packs are distributed at the event village from 20:00 to 21:40. Warm-up with a Zumba instructor. 21:25 – 1.2 km roller-skating event (untimed). 21:40 – 1,200 m run (untimed). 22:00 – 4 km and 12 km roller-skating events. 22:30 – starts for the 4 km, 8 km, and 16 km runs, and the 2×4 km relay. The event is part of the “Run Together with a Friend in Druskininkai” project, funded by the state budget. The event is funded by the Interreg Lithuania–Poland Programme. Participant bibs are issued on August 8; the start is in Druskininkai; several hundred participants are expected; this is an international project.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Polska
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce - edycja letnia to bieg przełajowy organizowany przez pasjonatów biegania od 2014 roku. Impreza odbywa się na malowniczych trasach, które podkreślają walory estetyczne proponowanych lokalizacji. Celem organizatorów jest popularyzacja biegania oraz zapewnienie uczestnikom wyjątkowych wrażeń sportowych i przyrodniczych. To doskonała okazja, by aktywnie spędzić czas w pięknym otoczeniu Kielc.
course_highlights: Bieg przełajowy na malowniczych trasach
Walory estetyczne proponowanych lokalizacji
Organizacja od 2014 roku z naciskiem na biegi terenowe
additional: Organizator podaje, że organizuje biegi od 2014 roku.

name: Chudy Wawrzyniec
description: Chudy Wawrzyniec to górski ultramaraton odbywający się w Beskidzie Żywieckim, z bazą w Rajczy i Ujsołach. Zawody oferują trzy dystanse ultra: 50 km, 80 km i 100 km, charakteryzujące się dużym przewyższeniem i wymagającą technicznie trasą. Dodatkowo organizowane są biegi towarzyszące, takie jak Parszywa Bendoszka, Mała Rycerzowa oraz Muńcuł Vertical, a także zawody dla dzieci i młodzieży pod nazwą Chudy Hulajnik. Impreza promuje aktywność fizyczną w otoczeniu przyrody i jest punktowana przez ITRA. Organizator zapewnia komunikację Chudy Bus oraz wskazówki parkingowe ze względu na ograniczoną liczbę miejsc parkingowych.
course_highlights: Trasy ultramaratonu o długościach 52 km, 82 km i 102 km z przewyższeniami odpowiednio 2500 m, 3800 m i ponad 5100 m
Trasa prowadzi przez Beskid Żywiecki, w tym przez szczyty takie jak Wielka Rycerzowa, Wielka Racza, Pilsko i Romanka
Na trasie 100 km trzy punkty odżywcze, na 80 km dwa, na 50 km jeden; brak jednorazowych kubków na punktach
additional: Start ultramaratonu o godz. 4:00 w Rajczy, godziny startów biegów towarzyszących i dziecięcych są podane szczegółowo. Limit czasu na ultramaratony to 16 godzin, na Parszywą Bendoszkę 13,5 godziny, na Małą Rycerzową 5 godzin. Trasy oznakowane taśmami, punkty odżywcze bez jednorazowych kubków. Organizowany jest Chudy Bus dla ułatwienia transportu ze względu na ograniczoną liczbę miejsc parkingowych. Biegi dzieci i młodzieży odbywają się na dystansach od 200 m do 2,5 km w okolicach amfiteatru w Ujsołach.

name: VII Charytatywny Bieg świętego Dominika
description: Międzynarodowy Bieg św. Dominika to prestiżowa impreza biegowa odbywająca się corocznie od 1994 roku w Gdańsku, będąca integralną częścią Jarmarku św. Dominika. To wyjątkowe wydarzenie sportowe przyciąga zarówno amatorów, jak i zawodowców, oferując biegi na różnych dystansach w malowniczej scenerii gdańskiej starówki. Trasa biegu prowadzi ulicami historycznego centrum miasta, a doping ponad 25 tysięcy kibiców tworzy niezapomnianą atmosferę. Impreza promuje zdrowy styl życia i integrację społeczną, a towarzyszą jej liczne wydarzenia kulturalne i sportowe.
course_highlights: Trasa w centrum Gdańska o długości 1412 m, prowadząca ulicami Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników i innymi
Start i meta przy fontannie Neptuna w zabytkowym centrum miasta
Doping ponad 25 000 widzów na trasie każdego biegu
additional: Impreza obejmuje cztery biegi pod wspólnym hasłem „Goń św. Dominika”, w tym Prolog dla wszystkich uczestników Jarmarku, wyścig osób niepełnosprawnych w ramach programu „Integracja przez Sport”, Bieg Kobiet 5km Lotto Cup oraz Bieg Mężczyzn 5km Energa Cup. Trasa jest pętlą zamkniętą, co umożliwia kibicom doskonałe śledzenie rywalizacji. Wydarzeniu towarzyszą liczne atrakcje, takie jak stoiska partnerów, prezentacje, pokazy i koncerty Jarmarku św. Dominika.

name: XI Bieg Lucka
description: XI Bieg Lucka to memoriałowy bieg upamiętniający Lucjana Chorążego, odbywający się w Skawinkach koło Lanckorony. Zawody oferują kilka dystansów: bieg główny na około 14 km, bieg rekreacyjny i marsz Nordic Walking na około 5,2 km oraz biegi dla dzieci na krótszych dystansach. Trasa biegu głównego prowadzi na górę Chełm, a po biegu uczestnicy mogą spotkać się przy poczęstunku. Impreza ma charakter rodzinny i przyjazny, zorganizowana przez Stowarzyszenie im. Lucjana Chorążego.
course_highlights: Trasa biegu głównego o długości około 14 km prowadzi na górę Chełm
Bieg rekreacyjny i Nordic Walking na dystansie około 5,2 km
Biegi dla dzieci na dystansach od 50 m do 1000 m na boisku i łąkach przy biurze zawodów
additional: Limit miejsc: 270 osób na Bieg Główny, Bieg Rekreacyjny i Nordic Walking; 80 miejsc online i 30 w dniu zawodów na biegi dzieci. Odbiór numerów startowych i dodatkowa rejestracja w dniu zawodów w godz. 9:00-11:00. Start biegów dla dzieci o 10:30, start biegów głównych i Nordic Walking o 12:00 w trzech grupach startowych.

name: Bieg na Wielką Sowę
location: Ludwikowice Kłodzkie, Gmina Nowa Ruda, Polska

name: Brunnenlauf
location: Iburg-Stadion, Bad Driburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bad Driburg Brunnenlauf is an annual running event organized by TV "Jahn" Bad Driburg e.V., welcoming runners of all ages.
