Measured course, start at Osttor Stadium, individual and relay races, online registration, start times at 9:00 and 9:05, course closes after 3 hours.

name: Rotherbaum 10K Hamburg - K Rotherbaum
description: The 10K Rotherbaum is an officially measured 10-kilometer race in Hamburg, held in accordance with international competition regulations. The course is a loop registered with the German Athletics Association and AIMS, making finish times eligible for rankings. The event is open to runners of all age groups and offers a cup competition across all 10K Hamburg races, with attractive prizes. Registration is online only, and participants are asked to travel by public transport.

name: Der Alstertallauf
description: The Alstertallauf is a family-friendly race along the upper Alster hiking trail, considered Hamburg’s most beautiful running route. It welcomes running enthusiasts of all ages and recreational athletes, and offers several distances. The event takes place near the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium in Hamburg and is known for its friendly atmosphere. In 2022, more than 200 runners took part, with distances ranging from 410 m to 10 km.

name: Gettorfer Staffelmarathon
description: The Gettorf Relay Marathon is a team marathon held at the Gettorf Sports Park. The course is an approximately 4.2 km loop, run ten times. Teams consist of 5 to 10 people, who pass the chipped relay baton in the exchange zone. Alternatively, two people can compete in the Duo Marathon, freely dividing the ten laps between them. Timing is electronic, using transponders and shoe chips, and split times are recorded for each runner.

name: Bielebohlauf
description: The Bielebohlauf Oppach is a running event in the Lusatian Highlands, offering a range of distances from 400 m to 20 km. The routes follow forest, meadow, and field paths as well as small roads around the Bieleboh. The longer distances are challenging and include steep climbs. Special Bambini and children’s races are available. Refreshments and entertainment are provided at Oppach Stadium, and finishers receive certificates and online clips.

name: 1. Laufchallenge Mellendorfer TV
description: The 2026 Sparkassen Running Pass for the Hanover Region features 43 running events, making it the largest series of its kind in Germany. Participants can collect stamps at various events across the Hanover Region and discover the region as they run. Each successful participation earns a stamp, and frequent runners can qualify for attractive gold, silver or bronze rewards. Participants register directly for the individual runs, which take place at many beautiful locations and offer a variety of activities. There is also a Running Pass app with an event calendar and digital running log.

name: Die Generalprobe
description: Die Generalprobe is an urban road race in Berlin that serves as the ultimate test for marathon training. Four weeks before the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON, runners can assess their fitness on a super-flat loop through the Berlin districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf and Zehlendorf. Distances offered are a quarter marathon (10.5 km) and a half marathon (21 km), both taking runners through typical Berlin neighbourhoods and offering a special city-running experience. Children can also take part in Bambini runs of 500 to 1,000 metres. All participants receive a lovely medal at the finish, optionally with a personalised engraving.
course_highlights: Super-flat loop through the Berlin districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf and Zehlendorf
The course passes through typical Berlin residential neighbourhoods with an urban feel
Two distances: quarter marathon (10.5 km) and half marathon (2 laps, 21 km)
additional: Timing is provided by a MIKA TAG disposable transponder on the back of the race bib; no return is required. The start and finish are on Schlossstraße in Berlin-Steglitz. Eligible participants must be born in 2011 or earlier (U18).

name: Slopenská desítka
description: Slopenská desítka is a traditional cross-country running race held in the picturesque village of Slopné near Luhačovice. The race offers a challenging course with varied terrain, including asphalt roads, steep climbs and descents through forest terrain. The start is located below the church and the finish is on the sports field, where a rousing crowd awaits the runners. The event is suitable for the general public, including junior categories and family relay teams. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series and the KRAKONOŠ Czech Mountain Running Cup.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Stříbrná
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in different locations, including Stříbrná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and the adventure route covers 20 to 30 km. In addition to the main races, there are children’s races and walking routes with map-based checkpoints. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a beautiful natural setting in the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh pro Střížák
description: Běh pro Střížák is a traditional race held on Střížovický vrch in Ústí nad Labem, now in its 16th year. The course is a loop run three times, with one significant climb and descent; otherwise, it is gently undulating. The event also includes shorter children’s and youth races, making it accessible to the wider public. The race has an interesting story: the course passes through an area that was once threatened by a planned development, which was cancelled thanks to local residents’ opposition.

name: Minimaratón
location: Banská Bystrica, Banská Bystrica, Atletický štadión na Štiavničkách
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT OZ, Minimaratón OZ
description: The Mini Marathon is a unique running event exclusively for families with children, held at the Štiavničky athletics stadium in Banská Bystrica. The event offers different age categories, from the youngest runners to older children, including mothers with strollers. The course is adapted to each age group, with 400 m and 200 m circuits. Alongside the sporting experience, there is an accompanying program with activities for children and meetups with athletes. Every participant receives a commemorative race bib, a medal, and refreshments after finishing.

name: Beh na boso Tatry
location: Veľká Lomnica, Veľká Lomnica, Golfový rezort Black Stork
description: Beh na boso Tatry is a running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Black Stork Golf Resort in Veľká Lomnica. Participants can choose between non-competitive runs for children and adults and a competitive 5 km run. The course runs across mown grass, paths and pebbles, giving it a cross-country character. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere in the nature of the Tatras. The organizer, OZ Beh na boso Tatry, ensures the event runs smoothly.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, czyli Aktywny Czerwonak Nocą to cykliczne, bezpłatne wydarzenie sportowe organizowane przez Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej w Czerwonaku. Impreza odbywa się wieczorem i łączy aktywność fizyczną z integracją lokalnej społeczności. To już wieloletnia tradycja, która przyciąga uczestników chcących spędzić czas na świeżym powietrzu, biegając lub maszerując w przyjaznej atmosferze.
course_highlights: Dystans 5 km potwierdzony dla edycji z 2026 roku
Wieczorna formuła wydarzenia w Bolechowie
Część cyklu Aktywny Czerwonak Nocą
additional: Wydarzenie jest bezpłatne i odbywa się w godzinach wieczornych, zwykle od 19:30 do 22:00. To spotkanie sportowe o charakterze rekreacyjnym, które jest częścią cyklu Grand Prix Czerwonaka. Brak informacji o limitach uczestników, opłatach czy wymaganym sprzęcie. Poprzednie edycje odbywały się wieczorem; w 2026 roku startowało 82 uczestników.

name: B2Run Hamburg
description: B2Run Hamburg is a company run of around 5.6 km, ending with a spectacular finish in the Volksparkstadion. The course is varied and largely flat, making it ideal for beginners, walkers and experienced runners. The event promotes team spirit, motivation and a sense of community, and is perfect for companies and individual participants from Hamburg and the surrounding area. In addition to the sporting experience, the run offers a professional supporting programme with commentary and music.

name: Běh Smetánkou
location: Smetánka Park, Prague 9, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh Smetánkou is a 3.5 km trail race held in Prague 9 and part of the SABZO series. The race gives runners the chance to enjoy a run in natural surroundings on varied terrain. It is suitable for anyone looking for a short but dynamic race in a pleasant atmosphere. The race is a longstanding part of Prague’s running season and attracts runners from the surrounding area.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (9) – srpnový
description: VAŠE LIGA’s 5 km and 10 km races are a regular running series in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The races are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to pros, and personal records are often set here. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant. The series is part of its 16th edition and rewards not only the top runners but also loyal participants.

name: Běh Modřanskou roklí - Memoriál Zdeňka Buriana
description: The Běh Modřanskou roklí – Zdeněk Burian Memorial is a 4 km race along a gently rolling course in the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series and features a staggered start, allowing the event to run smoothly. The course is suitable for runners who want to enjoy a run in nature with moderate elevation changes. It is ideal for anyone looking for a short but technically interesting race in beautiful surroundings.

name: Letni Ultra Świr
description: Letni Ultra Świr to wyjątkowy bieg ultra trwający 24 godziny, odbywający się na pętli o długości 15 km w okolicach Grybowa. To wyzwanie dla biegaczy, którzy chcą sprawdzić swoje granice wytrzymałości i cieszyć się atmosferą pełną potu, kurzu, zmęczenia, ale też śmiechu i szaleństwa. Impreza przyciąga miłośników długodystansowego biegania, oferując niepowtarzalne doświadczenie i moc emocji.

name: 7. Ahnepark-Lauf der Laufgemeinschaft Vellmar
description: The 7th Ahnepark Run, organized by Laufgemeinschaft Vellmar, is a late-summer running event in Vellmar. This club race offers two distances, 200 meters and 17.3 kilometers, and is designed primarily as a community run. Registration and results are managed through my.raceresult.com. The race is listed in the laufen.de running calendar and features officially measured courses that are relevant for rankings.
course_highlights: Two distances: 200 m and 17.3 km
Event in Ahnepark in Vellmar
Officially measured courses for rankings
additional: Registration and results are handled through my.raceresult.com. The race takes place in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny days. It is a local club race without major branding or destination elements. Distances: 200 m, 17.3 km; registration and results through my.raceresult.com; listed in the laufen.de running calendar

name: Lemgoer Hanselauf
description: The Lemgo Hanselauf is a traditional running event held annually on the last or second-to-last Friday in August in Lemgo. The event offers 3.3 km, 6.6 km and 10 km courses along the city’s ramparts. Children and Bambinis can also take part over shorter distances, making the Hanselauf a family-friendly event. With around 1,000 participants, the Hanselauf is a sporting highlight in the region that brings together fun and community.
course_highlights: Course along Lemgo’s historic ramparts
Distances of 3.3 km, 6.6 km and 10 km
Children’s and Bambini runs over 1.5 km and 400 m
additional: Bib collection and late registration on the event day from 4 p.m. in the right-hand school wing of Engelbert-Kämpfer-Gymnasium. No timing or placings for the children’s and Bambini runs. Assemble at the start from 4:55 p.m. Participation is free. Run along the ramparts, children’s and Bambini runs, registration at Engelbert-Kämpfer-Gymnasium, late registration available on the event day.

name: 26. Verdener Stadt-Lauf
description: The Verden City Run is a road race in Verden, starting and finishing at Lugenstein near the cathedral. The program includes short children’s and youth races, 5- and 10-kilometer races, and a mixed relay. Organized by LAV Verden, the event offers races for various age groups.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lugenstein near Verden Cathedral
Flat 5 km and 10 km road races
Mixed relay over 3 × 900 meters
additional: The 10 km course also counts as a district championship race for participants in the U16 age group and older.

name: Ibbenbürener Aaseelauf 2026
description: The Ibbenbüren Aasee Run is a long-standing running event taking place for the 41st time in 2026. The event offers races for children of kindergarten and primary-school age, as well as a 5 km fun run, a 5 km team run, and a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners. The course runs around Lake Aasee, with the start and finish at Stadion Ost in Ibbenbüren. The event is limited to 1,000 participants and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good on-course support.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadion Ost, Ibbenbüren
Loop course around Lake Aasee, with three laps in the 10 km main race
Drinks stations along the course and in the finish area
additional: Late registration is available on event day from 15:00 until 1 hour before the start of each race for a fee of €2.50. Changes to entries are also possible on event day for a fee. €1 per registration is donated to a charitable organization. Free parking is available at Stadion Ost. Race bibs can be collected on event day from 15:00. Timing is recorded using transponders on the back of the race bib. Registration is online only, with a limited number of places. Late registration costs €2.50; charitable projects can be supported.

name: Straßenlauf Rund um den Holtenauer Leuchtturm
5. LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Lauf
description: The 5th LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Lauf is an evening running event held at the Waldauer Wiesen sports ground in Kassel. The event offers various distances for all age groups, from a 500 m Bambini run to an 18 km run. The shorter children’s races start first, followed by the longer races in the early evening. The routes are well marked and include sections around Bugasee and Wahlebach, with refreshment stations and childcare available on site.

name: Sparkassen-Tauchscher-Stadtlauf
description: The Sparkassen Tauchscher City Run is a long-standing running event organized by Leichtathletik Club Taucha e. V. in the town of Taucha on the Parthe. The 21st edition of this city run also incorporates the state championship in the 10 km road race. The event offers runners of all ages an appealing opportunity to compete in a lively atmosphere. Registration opens in February.

name: Beskydská sedmička
description: IMOS Beskydská sedmička is an extreme mountain marathon across the entire Beskydy Mountains, running from Třinec to Frenštát pod Radhoštěm. This demanding race is approximately 101 km long with 5,500 m+ of elevation gain. It is the Czech Mountain Marathon Championship for individuals and is open to both solo runners and pairs. The race starts at night at 23:00 from the athletics stadium in Třinec, and the finish line closes after 28 hours on Sunday morning. The race offers a unique experience of the Beskydy mountain landscape and well-stocked aid stations along the course.

name: Alejemi v Kněžicích
location: Kulturní dům, Kněžice, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Alejemi v Kněžicích is a running race held around the cultural center in Kněžice, Vysočina. It offers a 9.8 km long course for men and a shorter 5.5 km course for women. The course follows paved and unpaved forest and field roads, is gently undulating, and is about 30% asphalt. The race is suitable for runners looking for a mix of paved and natural trails in the scenic Vysočina countryside. It is organized by Běžec Vysočiny z.s.
course_highlights: Long course along paved and unpaved forest and field roads
Gently undulating course with 30% asphalt surface
Scenic setting around Kněžice, Vysočina
additional: The first category starts at 17:30, and the main category starts at 18:00. The organizer is Běžec Vysočiny z.s.; the contact person is Bohumil Novák. The mixed-surface course is 9.8 km for men and 5.5 km for women. The start and race facilities are at the cultural center in Kněžice. Shorter races are also sometimes included in the program.

name: Naktinis bėgimas 2026
description: Night Run 2026 invites you to feel the rhythm of the night and immerse yourself in the late-summer buzz of Kaunas. It’s a unique opportunity to unwind from everyday life and end the summer with an energetic run featuring music, a sea of lights, and the company of enthusiastic runners. The event takes place in Town Hall Square and Santaka Park, offering spectacular views and an unforgettable nighttime adventure. Participants compete in the 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances, and the event is intended for both recreational and professional runners.
course_highlights: The course runs through Town Hall Square and Santaka Park
A night run with music and a sea of lights
Races over 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
additional: Participants must attach their bib with the timing chip to the front of their shirt. Participants’ times may not be recorded if they do not complete the course within the time limit. The use of vehicles on the course is strictly prohibited. The event will take place in Kaunas, with a course featuring a night run with lights, music, and a lively atmosphere. Registration and further information are available on the official website.

name: Półmaraton Roztoczański im. Czesławy Kwoki , Nielisz - Zamość
description: Półmaraton Roztoczański im. Czesławy Kwoki to bieg na dystansie półmaratonu, prowadzący z Nielisza do Zamościa. Jest ostatnim etapem Czteroetapowego Biegu Pokoju Pamięci Dzieci Zamojszczyzny. Zapraszamy do udziału w biegu łączącym sportową rywalizację z upamiętnieniem dzieci Zamojszczyzny.
course_highlights: Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi z Nielisza do Zamościa.
Bieg stanowi finałowy etap Czteroetapowego Biegu Pokoju Pamięci Dzieci Zamojszczyzny.

name: UKIEL Susnet Run Olsztyn
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: Uczestnicy mogą wybrać dystans 5 km lub 10 km, biegnąc przez centrum Olsztyna z malowniczymi widokami na Stare Miasto i plażę CRS Ukiel. Trasa jest atestowana przez PZLA, a meta zlokalizowana jest na plaży, gdzie czeka strefa finiszera z oprawą muzyczną i świetlną. To doskonała okazja, by połączyć sportową rywalizację z atmosferą miejskiego wydarzenia.

name: 11 Bieg Kurierów Sądeckich
description: Bieg Kurierów Sądeckich to historyczny bieg górski odbywający się w Beskidzie Sądeckim, na trasie z Rytra do schroniska PTTK na Przehybie. Trasa jest oznakowana i prowadzi przez różnorodne nawierzchnie: 15% asfaltu, 5% dróg szutrowych oraz 80% ścieżek leśnych, oferując uczestnikom kontakt z naturą i wymagający teren. Bieg upamiętnia kurierów z czasów II wojny światowej, a rekord trasy wynosi nieco poniżej godziny. Organizator zapewnia pomiar czasu, zabezpieczenie medyczne, pamiątkowy medal oraz ciepły posiłek po biegu.

name: 11 Łańcucka Piątka
description: Łańcucka Piątka to coroczny bieg na dystansie 5 km organizowany w Łańcucie, który łączy sportową rywalizację z ideą pomocy charytatywnej. Trasa biegu prowadzi przez malownicze tereny miasta, oferując uczestnikom atrakcyjne widoki i przyjazną atmosferę. Impreza przyciąga biegaczy w różnym wieku i o różnym poziomie zaawansowania, promując aktywność fizyczną i integrację lokalnej społeczności.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 5 km w centrum Łańcuta
Malownicze widoki i przyjazne miejskie otoczenie
Bieg organizowany w ramach Łańcuckiego Biegu Dobroci
additional: W ramach imprezy odbywa się także Mini Łańcucka Piątka dla dzieci. Organizatorzy zapewniają pakiety startowe oraz nagrody, a wydarzenie ma charakter charytatywny, wspierając lokalne inicjatywy dobroczynne.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa to cykl 12 zawodów biegowych i Nordic Walking organizowanych w Gliwicach w 2026 roku, odbywających się raz w miesiącu w soboty w Parku za stadionem Piasta. Trasa o długości 4219,5 metra prowadzi głównie po duktach leśnych, szutrowych oraz częściowo asfaltem, z punktem odświeżania na linii startu/mety. Impreza ma na celu popularyzację zdrowego i aktywnego spędzania czasu na świeżym powietrzu pod hasłem „Daj się sprowokować do walki z lenistwem!”.

name: Kunicki Bieg Reggae
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Kunicach
description: Kunicki Bieg Reggae to ogólnopolska impreza sportowa odbywająca się nad malowniczym Jeziorem Kunickim w Kunicach. Zawodnicy mają do wyboru trzy atestowane trasy biegowe: 5 km, 10 km oraz półmaraton. Start i meta znajdują się przed GOKiS w Kunicach przy ulicy Słonecznej 11. Impreza łączy sportową rywalizację z przyjazną atmosferą i muzyką reggae, przyciągając coraz większą liczbę uczestników z całej Polski.

name: Mały Wielki Bieg
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Pruszcz Gdański
description: Mały Wielki Bieg to największy bieg w gminie Pruszcz Gdański, który po rocznej przerwie powraca do Straszyna. Organizatorem jest Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Pruszcz Gdański, który promuje sport i rekreację wśród mieszkańców. Impreza odbywa się i stanowi ważne wydarzenie sportowe w regionie.

name: NorDan RUN
description: NorDan RUN to bieg odbywający się w malowniczym Wolsztynie, z trasami prowadzącymi ścieżkami parku miejskiego wzdłuż jeziora wolsztyńskiego. Uczestnicy mogą wybrać spośród kilku dystansów, od krótszych biegów dla dzieci po wymagające trasy 48 km z punktami kontrolno-odżywczymi. Start i meta zlokalizowane są przy obiekcie „Fala Park”, co zapewnia komfortową organizację i piękne widoki. Bieg jest doskonałą okazją do aktywnego spędzenia czasu na świeżym powietrzu w otoczeniu natury.

name: Tatraman
description: Tatraman to wymagające zawody triathlonowe na dystansie 1/2 Ironmana, rozgrywane w malowniczych terenach polskiego i słowackiego Spisza oraz Tatr. Trasa prowadzi od Niedzicy nad Jeziorem Czorsztyńskim, przez górzyste tereny, aż na szczyt Kasprowego Wierchu. Zawody są skierowane głównie do doświadczonych zawodników, ale także amatorzy mogą sprawdzić swoje umiejętności na tej ekstremalnej trasie. Tatraman to połączenie sportowej rywalizacji z pięknymi widokami i góralską gościnnością.

name: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą
description: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą to coroczny bieg uliczny odbywający się w Tczewie, będący częścią IX Biegowego Grand Prix Kociewia. Zawody przyciągają biegaczy z różnych regionów, oferując malowniczą trasę wzdłuż Wisły. Impreza ma charakter sportowo-rekreacyjny, promując aktywność fizyczną i integrację lokalnej społeczności.

name: X Jubileuszowy Charytatywny Cross
description: X Jubileuszowy Charytatywny Cross oraz Nordic Walking w Iwoniczu-Zdroju to coroczne wydarzenie sportowe odbywające się na Placu Dietla w Iwoniczu-Zdroju. Impreza łączy w sobie bieg przełajowy oraz marsz nordic walking, promując aktywność fizyczną i zdrowy styl życia w pięknym uzdrowiskowym mieście. To jubileuszowa edycja, która przyciąga uczestników z różnych grup wiekowych i poziomów zaawansowania. Organizatorzy zapraszają do udziału wszystkich chętnych, podkreślając charytatywny charakter wydarzenia.

name: XVI Bałtycki Maraton Brzegiem Morza
description: XVI Bałtycki Maraton Brzegiem Morza to coroczne wydarzenie biegowe odbywające się w malowniczych miejscowościach Jastarnia i Władysławowo. Zawodnicy mają do wyboru dystans maratonu oraz półmaratonu, które prowadzą wzdłuż brzegu morza, oferując wyjątkowe widoki i atmosferę. Impreza przyciąga biegaczy z różnych grup wiekowych, w tym kategorie wiekowe K60+ i M65+. Limit uczestników wynosi 250 osób, co zapewnia kameralną i przyjazną atmosferę.

name: XXIX Bieg Miodobrania Kurpiowskiego
location: Kurpiowska Kraina nad Zalewem Wykrot, Wykrot, Polska
description: XXIX Bieg Miodobrania Kurpiowskiego to coroczny bieg na dystansie 10 km z atestowaną trasą, prowadzący z Myszyńca do Kurpiowskiej Krainy nad Zalewem Wykrot. Impreza odbywa się i jest organizowana przez Miejski Klub Lekkoatletyczny w Myszyńcu. W programie znajdują się także biegi towarzyszące dla dzieci i młodzieży na krótszych dystansach. Start i meta zlokalizowane są w Kurpiowskiej Krainie, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalny pomiar czasu oraz uroczystą dekorację zwycięzców. Bieg ma charakter rodzinny i regionalny, promując aktywność fizyczną oraz lokalną kulturę Kurpiowską.
course_highlights: Trasa atestowana na dystansie 10 km
Start w Myszyńcu, meta w Kurpiowskiej Krainie nad Zalewem Wykrot
Biegi towarzyszące dla dzieci i młodzieży na dystansach od 200 do 1200 m
additional: Biuro zawodów i meta znajdują się pod adresem Kurpiowska Kraina w Wydmusach, ul. Miodobrania 1. Start odbywa się z Myszyńca, uczestnicy są dowożeni autokarami z parkingu obok Karczmy Kurpiowskiej. Chip do pomiaru czasu jest wydawany w biurze zawodów i należy go zwrócić po biegu. Biegi towarzyszące dla dzieci odbywają się na parkingu obok Karczmy Kurpiowskiej. Zawodnicy z Gminy Myszyniec oraz w kategoriach wiekowych 65-69, 70-74, 75+ mają 50% zniżki na opłatę startową przy płatności przelewem tradycyjnym. W programie są biegi dziecięce na dystansach 200, 400, 800 i 1200 m.

name: Piąteczka dla każdego
location: Nowy Dwór Mazowiecki, Masovian Voivodeship, Polska

name: XI Bieg Dożynkowy
location: Kobylarnia, Gmina Nowa Wieś Wielka, Polska

name: XVII Maraton Pieszo i Rowerem Dookoła Lubina
32. Zeitzer Stadtlauf
description: The Zeitz City Run takes place in Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz and is organized by SG Chemie Zeitz. The event begins at 9:15 a.m., with the main races starting at 10:00 a.m. The race office is located in front of the main stage in the city park, and changing and shower facilities are available at the Klinkerhallen on Albrechtstraße. The park entrance is via Stephanstraße. The run offers a great opportunity to be active and enjoy the atmosphere in the castle park.
course_highlights: Run through the historic Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz
Main races start at 10:00 a.m.
Changing and shower facilities at the nearby Klinkerhallen
additional: The run begins at 10:00 a.m., with changing and shower facilities at the Klinkerhallen. The park entrance is via Stephanstraße. August weather is usually sunny, ideal for an outdoor run.

name: 37. Heideblütenlauf
description: The 37th Heideblütenlauf takes place in Schneverdingen and is a traditional running event held as part of the Heideblütenfest. The event is organized by TV Jahn Schneverdingen and offers runners of all ages the opportunity to experience the beautiful heathland. The course runs through the picturesque surroundings and is supported by numerous volunteers and supporters who help ensure everything runs smoothly. Participants can look forward to a friendly, well-organized event.
course_highlights: Running routes through the heathland around Schneverdingen
Start in front of the town hall on Schulstraße
Event held as part of the Heideblütenfest
additional: The event is supported by numerous local partners and volunteers, including the City of Schneverdingen, the German Red Cross, Johanniter, the volunteer fire department, and the Heidekönigin. Certificates can be printed for all participants, including Bambini children. Registration is through TV Jahn Schneverdingen; further details are available on the website.

name: 39. Jever-Fun-Lauf
price_range: 4,00 € bis 36,00 € je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The 39th Jever-Fun-Lauf is a long-standing running event in Jever that brings together people of all ages and abilities. The course runs through the town centre, past well-known landmarks, with cheering spectators lining the route. The focus is on the joy of being active and a sense of community, rather than competition. There are various races for children, teenagers and adults, including walking, corporate and team categories, as well as a main race over 10 English miles.
course_highlights: A 2.864 km loop through Jever town centre
The route passes well-known landmarks
Cheering spectators line the course
additional: Merchandise such as sports socks, caps and multifunctional scarves is also available and can be collected in Jever on Wednesdays. Late entries are possible on the event day until one hour before the respective start. The time limit for the main race (10 English miles) is 150 minutes. Several race categories, registration deadlines, start times and further event details are available on the official website.

name: Edersee-Lauf
distance_verbose: 20 km, 10 km, 4.2 km, 2 km, 1.2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Edersee Run is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and takes place in Vöhl-Herzhausen on Lake Edersee. The run is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, a club that promotes sport and community for all age groups. The event is very popular and offers runners an appealing opportunity to get active and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Edersee. Pre-registration opens soon, and the club extends its heartfelt thanks to its supporters and sponsors.
course_highlights: A variety of race distances for all age groups
Flat, fast courses at Lake Edersee
Family and children's runs included
additional: The event is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, which also offers other sports activities and training groups. Sponsors support the race bibs. Pre-registration for 2026 opens soon. Various race distances, family-friendly, event held as part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup, start and finish at the Herzhausen Grill Hut.

name: Mindener Volkslauf
description: The Mindener Volkslauf is the largest running event organized by SV 1860 Minden, attracting more than 1,000 participants each year. Alongside the anniversary, the club is celebrating the 10th anniversary of the merged SV Minden with numerous activities. The event offers a great atmosphere and an after-run party following the company run, inviting everyone to join in the celebrations.
course_highlights: Course with new highlights and varied sections
Start and finish in the stadium with a special atmosphere
After-run party following the company run
additional: The 50th Mindener Volkslauf features an after-run party following the company run. In 2025, 1,467 participants crossed the finish line. The event also celebrates the 10th anniversary of the merged SV Minden, with many individual activities through the end of the year. It is the club’s largest event, with a special focus on community and anniversary celebrations.

name: 8. Stolberger Schloss-Lauf
description: The Stolberg Castle Run 2026 is a charity run in the southern Harz region, starting and finishing right at historic Stolberg Castle. The event offers a range of races for runners of all abilities, including a half marathon, relay, 10 km, 5 km, walking, and fun runs for all ages and children. The varied routes pass through the historic old town, along forest trails and over the heights of the southern Harz, combining a sporting challenge with scenic and cultural highlights. By taking part, every runner supports regional projects in and around Stolberg, giving the event a special charitable purpose.

name: SUNSET Wattenmeer
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is an extraordinary relay race covering approximately 250 kilometers, from Hamburg-St. Pauli to St. Peter-Ording. The route passes through the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea National Park and offers breathtaking natural scenery, idyllic towns, and marshland with a sea breeze. The event lasts more than 24 hours and challenges teams of 5 or 10 runners to complete it together. Start times are assigned based on the reported average pace, and digital map materials are provided before the race.

name: Birklauf
description: The Birklauf of MTV Gelting 08 is a long-running race event held from 3:45 p.m. at Birkhalle Gelting. The event celebrates sport, fun, and the great outdoors, and gives runners of various age groups the opportunity to compete. Times are recorded on all courses except the 750-meter Sprottenlauf, and all finishers receive a medal. Results are categorized by age group, with awards for the top three runners.

name: Elstertal-Lauf
description: The 1. SV Gera Elstertal Run is a traditional running event offering a variety of distances for runners of all ages. Individual races are held over 10 km and 15 km, along with relay races for companies and schoolchildren. There are also children’s races and a challenging stair run with around 1,300 steps. The event is part of the Thuringian and Gera running cup series and offers a varied course through the region.

name: Karlis Härtetest
description: Karlis Härtetest is a long-running race organized by Läuferteam Pretzsch. The race takes place every year in autumn near Leipzig and features a challenging cross-country course that tests runners of all ages. The club SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V. has a long history in running and promotes community and sporting ambition through this event. The race is known for its special atmosphere and the opportunity to prove yourself on a varied course.

name: Lauf rund um Tiefwarensee
description: The 20th Run around Lake Tiefwarensee in Waren (Müritz) is a traditional running event organized by Müritzer LSV. The course leads around the picturesque Lake Tiefwarensee and offers runners an attractive and varied setting. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar.

name: Salzbergener Raffinerielauf
description: The Salzbergen Refinery Run is a varied road race with events for all age groups, including a children’s race, a students’ mile, and 5 km and 10 km fun runs. The event takes place on 28 August 2027 in Salzbergen and offers an entertaining program for runners and spectators alongside exciting races. The races start at Oberschule Salzbergen and are open to individual runners and teams, with team rankings. The event is part of the EL-CUP and is known for its friendly, family atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Oberschule Salzbergen
Distances: 600 m children’s race, 1,700 m students’ mile, 5 km and 10 km fun runs
Team rankings in the main races
additional: Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before each race for a late-entry fee of €1.00. Race bibs and documents can be collected from approximately 1:15 p.m. at the race office. Walking/Nordic walking is untimed. Trophies are awarded to places 1–3.

name: Umpfertallauf
description: The 13th Umpfertal Run offers a range of race distances, including the 10 km main race, a 10 km relay, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and young children. The flat out-and-back course, with around 33 metres of elevation gain, is ideal for less experienced runners. The event starts early on Saturday evening, with the start and finish at the market square, and follows the cycle path to Schweigern. The awards ceremony takes place in the festival tent, rounding off the sporting event.

name: 4. S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz"
description: The 4th S-RUN Sparkassenlauf “Rund um das Dünkreuz” is a nature-focused community race in Eichsfeld, welcoming runners of all ages and fitness levels. The varied routes wind through breathtaking natural scenery around the Dünkreuz and offer exciting challenges for experienced runners and beginners alike. Alongside the competition, the event puts community spirit at the forefront, supported by an attractive program at the sports field. The race is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and is organized by SG Birkungen 07.

name: Kácovský běh
description: The Kácov Run is a traditional running race held on the last Saturday in August in the picturesque Posázaví region. It offers three main routes—the Nineteen, the Ten, and the Loop—with varied terrain and elevation that will challenge both experienced runners and beginners. The start and finish are in the center of Kácov, with aid stations on the longer courses. The race is timed using chip timing and accompanied by a varied program, including children’s races and a raffle.

name: Cross Parkmaraton
description: Cross Parkmaraton in Krásná Lípa is a traditional running race in the picturesque setting of Bohemian Switzerland National Park. It offers a range of events, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, Nordic walking, relays and canicross. The course crosses hilly terrain, mainly along forest paths, with beautiful views of the Lusatian Mountains. The race is suitable for the general public and welcomes runners of all ages, as well as families with children.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain, mainly along forest paths
Picturesque scenery in Bohemian Switzerland National Park
Views of the Lusatian Mountains
additional: The Canicross and 42 km Marathon start at 8:00; the other events (5 km, 10 km Nordic Walking, 10 km, 21 km and relays) start at 10:00. Relays are for teams of four, with each runner covering approximately 5 km on the half-marathon course. Categories are awarded by age and gender. Runners who do not meet the marathon cutoff may switch to the half marathon. Results are announced in stages from 10:05 to 14:00. The organizer provides changing rooms and showers. Canicross starts in C. Dittrich City Park; the other events start at Křinické Square. The official website also lists 10 km Nordic walking, relays, canicross and children's races.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.parkmaraton.cz/): 2027-08-28 — "Zveme Vás do Krásné Lípy ... na 18. ročník, 28. 8. 2027." (was estimated 2027-08-28)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Zveme Vás do Krásné Lípy ... na 18. ročník, 28. 8. 2027.

name: Chomutovský půlmaraton
description: The Chomutov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Chomutov in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a fast and scenic course through the town’s historic center, past the unique Kamencové Lake and beautiful natural areas such as Bezruč Valley. The event also includes children’s races and relay races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. Participants in the main race can look forward to refreshments along the course and at the finish, as well as a finisher’s medal.

name: Běhej lesy Jizerská
description: Běhej lesy Jizerská is a trail race held in the picturesque Jizera Mountains in Bedřichov. It offers a range of routes, including short and long distances and an ultramarathon, which pass through beautiful natural locations such as Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka, and Olivetská hora. The race is part of the Běhej lesy series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, providing international points. Runners can also take on the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add competitive elements and rewards.

name: Proběhni si Zoo Ústí nad Labem
description: Run through Ústí nad Labem Zoo is a running event held on the grounds of the zoological garden in Ústí nad Labem. The run offers a unique opportunity to combine sporting activity with a visit to the zoo and admire the animals in their natural surroundings. The event is suitable for all age groups and encourages active leisure time in nature. We look forward to your participation and sharing an experience in the beautiful setting of the zoo.

name: Prešov Half Marathon
description: The Prešov Half Marathon is a road running event in the centre of Prešov, with the start and event facilities on Hlavná Street. The half-marathon course runs through the city, and its certified loop gives runners the chance to discover the city in a sporting atmosphere. The event also typically includes shorter races and a children’s run.
course_highlights: Urban course in the historic centre of Prešov
Half-marathon distance of 21.1 km on a certified loop
Start and finish in the Hlavná Street area
additional: In previous editions, the programme also included a 10 km race, a shorter race and a children’s mini-marathon.

name: Beh vďaky Senica – Prietrž – pamätník SNP u Rehušov
location: Pamätník SNP u Rehušov, Prietrž, Senica District, Trnava Region, Slovakia

name: Šiaurės Lietuvos pusės maratono bėgimas – 2026
location: Pakruojo miesto parkas, Pakruojo rajonas, Lietuva
price_range: 0, nemokama; 2,5 km – 3-6 EUR; 5 km – 5-10 EUR; pusės maratono – 10-20 EUR
description: The Northern Lithuania Half Marathon 2026 will take place in Pakruojis District, in the northern part of Lithuania. The event aims to promote running culture and encourage residents to be active, offering scenic routes in popular tourist areas. The race will start and finish in Pakruojis City Park, where participants can enjoy not only the sport but also discover the nature and culture of northern Lithuania. The event brings together people of different ages and social groups to spend time actively and healthily.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in popular tourist areas
Start and finish in Pakruojis City Park
Discover northern Lithuania while running
additional: Bib collection is open from 8:00 to 10:00. The half marathon starts at 11:00, and the other distances start at 10:00. Registration will not be available on race day. Participants agree that photographs and video footage taken during the event may be used for marketing purposes. The event includes different distances and categories, and online registration is open until the end of August. The event date is September 4, 2027.

name: TEMPLE Kauno pusmaratonis `26
organizer: TK Temple Kauno pusmaratonis TS Temple social club
description: TEMPLE Kaunas Half Marathon '26 is the hottest summer running celebration in Kaunas, taking place on August 29. The event offers four distances: a half marathon (21.089 km), 10 km, 5 km, and a 400 m children's race. It is not just a competition, but a complete experience full of excitement, adrenaline, and community spirit, welcoming both those aiming for personal bests and those looking to enjoy the atmosphere of a running celebration. The event fills the city with participants' smiles and invites you to become part of its story.

name: 11 Bieg po Oddech

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Dla dzieci i młodzieży do lat 17 włącznie. Pakiet z koszulką

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Dla dzieci i młodzieży do lat 17 włącznie. Pakiet bez koszulki

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: Pakiet dla chorych na mukowiscydozę. Pakiet z koszulką

description: 11. Bieg po Oddech to charytatywny bieg na 5 km ulicami Zakopanego, organizowany na rzecz osób chorych na mukowiscydozę. Uczestnicy startują i kończą bieg w Parku Miejskim, a wydarzenie towarzyszy rodzinny piknik z zabawami i konkursami. Każdy uczestnik otrzymuje wyjątkową koszulkę i medal, a cały dochód wspiera rehabilitację i leczenie chorych. Bieg promuje aktywność fizyczną jako ważny element codziennej terapii oraz integrację społeczną.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km prowadzi malowniczymi ulicami Zakopanego
Start i meta w Parku Miejskim
Rodzinny piknik z zabawami i konkursami po biegu
additional: Elektroniczny pomiar czasu zapewnia firma S-Time. Po biegu poczęstunek dla uczestników. W miasteczku biegowym odbywa się charytatywny piknik rodzinny z zabawami i konkursami. Pakiety startowe zawierają koszulki i medale. Możliwość udziału w biegu wirtualnym.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU to ekstremalny zimowy półmaraton i ćwierćmaraton odbywający się w malowniczym terenie Jury Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej. Zimna Połówka to wymagający półmaraton z jurajskimi podbiegami i leśnymi ścieżkami, który stanowi prawdziwy test charakteru dla biegaczy. Chłodna Ćwiartka to krótszy dystans dla biegaczy i miłośników nordic walkingu, oferujący techniczną trasę i wyjątkową atmosferę zimowej przygody. Zawody odbywają się w grudniowej aurze, co dodatkowo podkreśla ich wyjątkowy charakter.
course_highlights: Jurajskie podbiegi i leśne ścieżki
Techniczna trasa z malowniczymi krajobrazami
Zimowa aura i wymagający teren
additional: Starty: Zimna Połówka (21 km) o 10:30, Chłodna Ćwiartka (11 km) o 10:40, Marsz Nordic Walking na dystansie 11 km o 10:45. Meta zamykana o 13:05, ogłoszenie wyników i rozdanie nagród o 13:10. Partnerzy i sponsorzy to m.in. Gmina Łazy, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Łazach, Under Armour, Decathlon. Dostępne pliki GPX tras. Biuro zawodów i kontakt telefoniczny pod numerem +48 664 715 931.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
location: Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II, Szczecin, Polska
description: 47. PKO Półmaraton Szczecin oraz bieg na 10 km to coroczne wydarzenie sportowe odbywające się w Szczecinie, które łączy rywalizację z możliwością poznania najpiękniejszych zakątków miasta. Trasa prowadzi przez centrum Szczecina, w tym przez Wały Chrobrego oraz aleję Wojska Polskiego, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe widoki i komfortowe warunki do biegu. Start i meta zlokalizowane są przy Placu Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II. Zawodnicy mogą wybrać dystans podczas biegu, decydując się na 10 km lub półmaraton na jednej pętli z atestem PZLA.
course_highlights: Trasa przebiega przez centrum Szczecina i Wały Chrobrego
Przebieg przez aleję Wojska Polskiego - najdłuższą ulicę Szczecina
Start i meta przy Placu Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II
additional: Możliwość wyboru dystansu (10 km lub półmaraton) podczas biegu na punkcie wyboru dystansu około 9,6 km. Trasa oznaczona co 1 km. Pomiar czasu elektroniczny za pomocą chipów w numerach startowych. Dostępne dwa pakiety startowe: podstawowy i rozszerzony z koszulką techniczną marki Ventus.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań to prestiżowy triathlon rozgrywany nad historycznym Jeziorem Kierskim, miejscu pierwszych zawodów triathlonowych w Polsce z 1984 roku. Zawodnicy mogą liczyć na spokojne i ciepłe wody do pływania oraz szybki, płaski odcinek rowerowy prowadzący przez malownicze wsie i zachodnią część Poznania. Bieg kończy się na stadionie Enea, gdzie panuje wyjątkowa atmosfera sportowa, a meta znajduje się na murawie stadionu Lecha Poznań. To wyjątkowe wydarzenie łączy sportową rywalizację z lokalną kulturą i nowoczesną infrastrukturą.
course_highlights: Pływanie w spokojnym i ciepłym Jeziorze Kierskim, miejscu pierwszego polskiego triathlonu
Płaska i szybka trasa rowerowa przez wsie i zachodnią część Poznania
Bieg kończący się na stadionie Enea z metą na murawie stadionu Lecha Poznań
additional: Start w formacie rolling start. Meta i wioska zawodów zlokalizowane na stadionie Enea oraz Międzynarodowych Targach Poznańskich. Zawody oferują kwalifikacje do IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. Uczestnicy muszą mieć ukończone 18 lat w dniu zawodów.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail to kameralny cykl biegów terenowych organizowany przez Fundację Maratony Kresowe, promujący zdrowy tryb życia i aktywność fizyczną w otoczeniu natury. Biegi odbywają się na malowniczych trasach wschodniej Polski, z poszanowaniem przyrody i lokalnych społeczności. Impreza jest otwarta dla biegaczy w każdym wieku, oferując różnorodne dystanse i formuły, a także integrując środowisko biegaczy poprzez ducha pasji, rywalizacji i przyjaźni. Organizatorzy dbają o bezpieczeństwo, wysoką jakość organizacji oraz ekologiczne podejście do wydarzenia.
course_highlights: Trasy terenowe w malowniczych rejonach Podlasia i Lubelszczyzny
Starannie oznakowane szlaki z bufetami na trasie dłuższych dystansów
Limit czasu około 2 godzin dla dystansów głównych, z elektronicznym pomiarem czasu
additional: Pakiet startowy zawiera ciepły posiłek regeneracyjny z opcją wegetariańską, elektroniczny pomiar czasu, bezpłatny numer startowy z chipem ważny na cały sezon, zabezpieczenie medyczne, bufety na trasie i mecie, pamiątkowy medal (przy wcześniejszej rejestracji), serwis fotograficzny oraz dekoracje w kategoriach wiekowych i open. Rejestracja możliwa jest także w dniu zawodów do godziny 08:40. Obowiązuje bezwzględny zakaz śmiecenia na trasie.

name: Półmaraton Buski
description: Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi przez reprezentatywne hotele i sanatoria, malowniczy Park Zdrojowy oraz urokliwe deptaki, co nadaje biegowi wyjątkowy klimat. Limit czasu na pokonanie dystansu 21,0975 km wynosi 3 godziny i 30 minut, co pozwala zarówno doświadczonym biegaczom, jak i amatorom spokojnie ukończyć bieg. To doskonała okazja, by sprawdzić swoje możliwości i dołączyć do sportowego święta w Busku-Zdroju.
course_highlights: Trasa przebiega obok reprezentatywnych buskich hoteli i sanatoriów
Bieg przez malowniczy Park Zdrojowy i urokliwe deptaki
Limit czasu 3 godziny i 30 minut na dystans 21,0975 km
additional: Start wspólny ze Stadionu Miejskiego. Trasa dostępna w formacie GPX do pobrania dla urządzeń Suunto i Garmin. Limit czasu 3 godziny i 30 minut liczony od startu do mety.

name: VII Maraton od Zmierzchu do Świtu
Burgwald Märchen Marathon
description: The Burgwald Märchen Marathon in Rauschenberg is a varied running event with distances for an ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, 3/4 marathon, fun runs and a costume run. The event offers a well-organized course with refreshments, timing and medals for all finishers. Race bibs can be collected the day before, and the races start from 8:00 a.m. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy the race in a fairytale setting.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 5 km to ultramarathon (52 km)
Start and finish close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg
Cutoff time for all races is 16:00
additional: A maximum of 1111 entries are available across all races. Late entries are possible on 29.08. from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 30.08. until one hour before the respective start, subject to late-entry fees (€3 for the ultra, marathon and half marathon; €2 for other races). All finishers who reach the finish by 16:00 receive a medal. Certificates can be printed online or collected in the finish area. The start and finish are close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg. The course runs mostly through the forest, partly on paved paths; refreshments are available every 5±2 km; dogs are allowed.

name: Mühlhäuser Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtverwaltung Mühlhausen, Kreissportbund Mühlhausen, SV 1899 Mühlhausen e. V.
description: The Mühlhausen Old Town Run is a traditional race through the historic old town of Mühlhausen, held annually since 1997. With three distances of 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km, it offers a sporting alternative to the Mühlhausen Kirmes and brings runners from the region together. The traditional start and finish are at Untermarkt in Mühlhausen. The event is organized in cooperation with the athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. and attracts around 800 to 1,100 participants each year.

name: 22. Eilenriederennen Hannover
description: The Eilenriederennen Hannover is an established summer running event through the green heart of Lower Saxony’s state capital. The public race offers three different distances: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course is officially measured, mostly paved and almost completely flat, making fast times possible. The event has a pleasant atmosphere, with a musical programme in the beer garden, and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass-Serie der Region Hannover.

name: 23. Windmühlenberglauf
description: The 23rd Windmühlenberglauf takes place in Fallersleben (Wolfsburg) at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg. The event is hosted by VfB Fallersleben and gives runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a traditional race. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Windmühlenberg and promises a varied running experience. Registration is open.

name: 30. Lauf um den Arendsee
description: The 30th Run around Lake Arendsee (LUDA) takes place at the Arendsee beach resort. This anniversary edition offers runners from the region and beyond a scenic natural setting for sport. There will also be a small party on the eve of the event to celebrate sport and community together. Organized by Kersten Friedrich Events, the event promises professional delivery with strong regional ties.

name: 45. Königseer Stadtwaldlauf
description: The Königsee City Forest Run is a traditional running event in Oberhain near Königsee, held annually. The event offers runners of various ability levels an attractive course through the city forest, with varied terrain. Its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings make the run a special experience for participants and spectators.

name: 6-Stunden-Sparkassenlauf
description: The 6-hour Sparkasse Run in Fleestedt takes place on a 1,200-meter loop at the Seevetal Sports Center. The course runs mainly on paved surfaces, with some sections on grass, and is easy to view from the start/finish area, keeping spectators on the edge of their seats. In addition to the individual race, there are team and relay competitions, with the marathon (42.2 km) receiving its own classification. The race is open to runners born in 2008 or earlier, and for the first time the relay is also open to young people born in 2014 or earlier. Younger participants can take part in a 5,000-meter run and have the opportunity to earn the DLV running badge.

name: Blankeneser Heldenlauf
location: Strandweg Ecke Mühlenberg, Blankenese, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Blankeneser Heldenlauf on August 29, 2027, offers five varied courses with different distances and profiles, taking runners through some of the most beautiful parts of Blankenese. The races start at Strandweg/corner of Mühlenberg and run along the Elbe, through the stair district and various parks. Whether you’re a beginner, a recreational runner or an experienced half-marathon runner, there’s a format for everyone. The event is known for its unique combination of maritime stretches and challenging climbs.
course_highlights: Courses run along the picturesque banks of the Elbe and through the famous Blankenese stair district
Half-marathon options with different levels of difficulty: moderate (“Sutsche”) and challenging (“Derbe”), with ramps and climbs
Finish at Blankenese weekly market square, with a finisher’s medal included
additional: The start is at Strandweg/corner of Mühlenberg, about a 15-minute walk from the event grounds. Award ceremonies will be held in stages from 10:00 a.m. on the stage at Blankenese weekly market. Bag drop-off is available at the event grounds from 8 a.m. Late registration is available online from August 19 to 25, 2027, at an increased entry fee. Finishers receive a medal included in the entry fee. Travel by public transport is recommended, as parking is limited.

name: Grafschaftslauf
description: The Grafschaft Run connects the historic towns of Rietberg, Verl and Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock, offering runners a varied route rich in history and atmosphere. The race starts at Gut Rietberg, passes historic buildings and runs through the town centre, then follows the Ems to the garden show grounds. The route continues through atmospheric locations, with several relay handover points, and finishes in the Holter Wald at Jagdschloss zur Holte, which provides an impressive backdrop for the finish. The race features varied rural paths, enthusiastic spectators and a special connection between sport and regional history.

name: Altra Sunset Wattenmeer
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is a unique team relay race. The route covers around 250 kilometres through the stunning natural landscape along the Elbe and the UNESCO World Heritage Site Wadden Sea National Park. The race starts on St. Pauli Hafenstraße in Hamburg and finishes in the Bad district of St. Peter-Ording. Teams consist of 5 or 10 runners, each taking on several sections of the route, making the race a special shared experience.

name: CrossFunRun
description: The CrossFunRun in Ahrensburg offers a variety of distances from 500 meters to 5 kilometers, suitable for all ages, from the youngest participants to adults. The races take place on varied terrain, with laps across meadows, through woods, and on trails, making the event especially exciting. The event is family-friendly and organized by the WEcycle e.V. club, which also provides good facilities, including changing rooms and toilets. Late registrations are possible on site, and all participants receive medals, certificates, and prizes.
course_highlights: Course surfaces: 10% asphalt, 80% meadow/woodland, and 10% trail
Start and finish at Heidkoppelhof in Ahrensburg
Loop courses of various distances from 500 m to 5 km
additional: Late registration is available on site from 10:00 a.m. for a fee of 5 euros. Relay options are available for teams of 3 or 4. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the start/finish. The course is well marked with arrows and flags.

name: Stundenlauf des TuS Fleestedt
description: The TuS Fleestedt 6h SPARKASSE Run is a traditional running event in Seevetal that welcomes runners of all ages. In addition to the 6-hour run, the event offers several other races for children and young people. The course circles the Seevetal Sports Centre and provides an attractive running environment with good accessibility. The event is open to everyone who wants to test their endurance and running performance.
course_highlights: Loop course around the Seevetal Sports Centre
Attractive running course with good public transport connections
Family-friendly events, including races for children and young people
additional: Late entries are possible at the venue on race day between 8:00 and 9:00. Race packs can be collected from 8:00 at the race office on the first floor of the sports hall. Participants who arrive by bicycle receive a voucher for cake. Medals can be ordered online until August 9.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The 40th Volkswandertag of TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. is a traditional hiking event held in Tiftlingerode. It is aimed at hiking enthusiasts and offers a lovely opportunity to enjoy nature and the surrounding area. This sociable sporting activity is suitable for all age groups. The event is organized by TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. and is part of the German Athletics Association’s competition calendar.

name: Öko-Run
description: The Öko-Run in Wächtersbach is part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge and takes place here. The route is fully paved and traffic-free, running alongside meadows and fields along the Kinzig. Races are offered over 5 km and 10 km, as well as a 1,000 m student race in various age groups. Every finisher receives a running shirt, and the event is part of a race series featuring scoring races and attractive non-cash prizes.

name: Běh teplickými skalami
description: The Run through the Teplice Rocks is a public trail race held every year on the last Sunday in August in Teplice nad Metují. The race dates back to 1994 and is part of the sports program of the International Mountaineering Film Festival. The 9 km course follows the Metuje River to the rock city, includes sandy sections and stairs, and returns along the same route. Since 2011, the event has also included a children’s race with age categories. The start and finish are at the TJ Slavoj football field.

name: Běh zámeckou zahradou
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The Run Through the Castle Garden is a traditional running race held in the castle park in Lysá nad Labem. This is its 62nd edition, open to a wide range of participants, from preschoolers to seniors. The race offers a pleasant setting in a historic park and promotes physical activity for all age groups. It is organized by T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem, which has long supported sport for everyone.

name: Běh Bezděkovem
description: Běh Bezděkovem is a traditional cross-country race covering approximately 9 km, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bezděkov pod Třemšínem. The course runs mainly along forest paths through hilly terrain with moderate elevation changes and includes a mix of paved and stony sections. The race starts at the hunting lodge and features a challenging climb with gradients of up to 7% that will test runners’ fitness. After this demanding section comes a final descent and a flat finish, giving runners a chance to show their speed. The event also includes children’s races, making it appealing to a wide audience.

name: Kolínská desítka
description: Kolínská desítka is a 10 km out-and-back race on paved roads and a well-maintained forest path around the Mirka Tučka sports stadium in Kolín. The race is part of the Kolín Grand Prix and offers runners a pleasant mix of paved surfaces and natural surroundings. It is suitable for all runners looking for a fast yet scenic run in nature. Come enjoy the race atmosphere and test yourself against other runners in the beautiful surroundings of Kolín.

name: Rakovnická 15
description: Rakovnická Patnáctka is a 15 km road race whose start alternates each year between the towns of Rakovník and Křivoklát. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and offers runners the chance to test themselves on an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for all runners looking for a quality road race with a tradition and the atmosphere of a regional running cup.

name: Sázava - Lázek
description: Sázava-Lázek is an uphill race covering 7.9 km with an elevation gain of 375 metres. The course starts on asphalt and continues along field and forest paths, with the steepest climb near the finish. This race offers challenging and varied terrain for runners seeking a challenge in the natural surroundings of the Pardubice Region.

name: Běh okolo Hříšné Milady
description: The Run Around Hříšná Milada is a cross-country race near Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region, offering two distances of 12 km and 6 km. The route runs mainly along forest roads and hiking trails that are open to regular traffic. The race is part of the District Running League and is suitable for trail running enthusiasts looking for natural terrain with technical challenges. The main category traditionally starts at 11:45, making it easy for a wide range of runners to take part.

name: Všenory - Jíloviště
description: Všenory - Jíloviště is a road race with a mass start, offering runners the challenge of a course with a considerable amount of elevation gain. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of the COOP store in Všenory and is part of the official Czech Running calendar. It is organized by the Czech Athletics Federation, which provides course certification and professional timing. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to become part of the running community.
course_highlights: Road course with a mass start
Considerable elevation gain
Picturesque surroundings of Všenory and Jíloviště
additional: The start is in front of the Coop store in Všenory, approximately 200 metres from Všenory railway stop.

name: Draždiak Run
location: Bratislava - Petržalka, Bratislava - Petržalka, Veľký Draždiak (Pláž pri bufete Barracuda).
description: Draždiak Run is a running event held in Bratislava, in the Veľký Draždiak area of Petržalka. Runners can expect courses along gravel and hiking trails, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The event includes children’s races, 5 km races for adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. It is organized by Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom
location: Snina, Snina, Rekreačná oblasť Sninske rybníky - OMW Snina
description: The Run beneath Sninský kameň is a running event in the Sninské rybníky recreational area in Snina, offering races for children and adults. The courses are on asphalt and dirt roads, while the children’s categories cover distances from 50 to 600 metres depending on age. The main category starts at 16:30 and is divided into men’s and women’s age groups. The event is organised by BehajmeSpolu o.z. in cooperation with the city of Snina. The entry fee is €15 for online registration and €20 on the day.

name: Alytaus Pusmaratonis – 2026
description: Alytus Half Marathon 2026 invites all running enthusiasts to a special summer finish in Alytus. The event starts and finishes in Alytus Town Hall Square, and the course passes through the city’s most beautiful spots—lush green parks, charming streets, and the banks of the Nemunas. Participants will experience a sense of community, movement, and excitement, with a festive atmosphere and support awaiting them at the finish. It’s a great opportunity to discover Alytus and take home unforgettable memories, whether you’re aiming for your best result or simply spending a meaningful day.
course_highlights: The course passes through lush green parks
Charming city streets
Inspiring banks of the Nemunas
additional: Various race distances, registration required, medals for all participants, awards for top finishers

name: Běh Anny-Marie
description: The Anna-Marie Run is a race held in Prague 4, offering a 6.6 km course across mixed terrain through Milíčovský Forest and over artificial hills. The event is organized by the SABZO Praha association and is part of its running series, attracting runners of all levels. The course includes both forest paths and paved sections, making the race appealing to different types of runners. The race takes place and offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere in Prague.

name: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie to bieg przełajowy organizowany w Koszalinie, będący finałem sezonu Leśnych Piątek. Trasa biegu jest poprowadzona w odmiennym niż zwykle kierunku, co pozwala uczestnikom poznać ją na nowo. Wydarzenie jest otwarte dla biegaczy, miłośników Nordic Walking oraz par mieszanych, a na mecie czekają medale dla wszystkich uczestników oraz trofea dla najlepszych w różnych kategoriach wiekowych i dyscyplinach. Bieg odbywa się na leśnej ścieżce edukacyjnej Nadleśnictwa Karnieszewice, co zapewnia malownicze i naturalne otoczenie.
course_highlights: Trasa biegu na leśnej ścieżce edukacyjnej Nadleśnictwa Karnieszewice
Start i meta na parkingu przy ul. Słupskiej w Koszalinie
Bieg w odmiennym kierunku niż zwykle, by poznać trasę na nowo
additional: Numery startowe z chipami do odbioru w biurze zawodów w dniu biegu. Możliwość rywalizacji w biegach i marszu Nordic Walking oraz w parach mieszanych. Bieg należy do Touru Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, gdzie można zbierać kilometry przez cały rok. Na mecie medale dla wszystkich uczestników oraz trofea dla najlepszych w klasyfikacjach głównych, osób maszerujących i par mieszanych.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Kėdainių miesto gimtadieniui, „NAKTINIAI KĖDAINIAI 654”
description: NAKTINIAI KĖDAINIAI 654 is a run celebrating the 654th anniversary of the city of Kėdainiai. The race takes place on city streets and is open to runners of all ages, from children to adults. The event promotes physical activity and community spirit, offering participants the chance to compete and determine the strongest runners. The start and finish are at Didžioji Rinkos Square. The event takes place in the evening, with awards presented after the races.
course_highlights: The route runs along city streets with asphalt and paving stones.
The course consists of laps: 4 laps of 1.6 km each (for the 6.4 km distance).
Children’s races cover shorter distances of 500 m and 1,000 m.
additional: Entry is free. Race numbers are distributed at the start venue from one hour to 15 minutes before the start. Online registration is open until September 2 at 23:59; additional registration is available at the start venue during the specified hours. The race program includes a symbolic children’s run, a children’s race, the main 6.4 km run, and awards. The city festival program schedules the children’s race for 20:00 and the night run for 21:00. Previous event programs included 500 m, 1,000 m, and 6.4 km distances; times are not recorded in the 500 m race.

name: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3
description: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3 to nocny bieg na dystansie 10 km, który odbędzie się w Jelcz-Laskowicach. To doskonała okazja, aby sprawdzić swoją formę na malowniczej trasie i przygotować się do jesiennych startów. Organizatorzy oferują plany treningowe dopasowane do różnych poziomów zaawansowania, aby każdy mógł optymalnie przygotować się do biegu. Wydarzenie jest skierowane do biegaczy ceniących sobie atmosferę nocnego biegania i sportową rywalizację.

name: 24. Duderstädter Sparkassenlauf
description: The 24th Duderstadt Sparkassenlauf takes place in Duderstadt’s historic pedestrian zone. The event starts at 16:00 with the opening ceremony in front of the town hall, which is also the finish point for all races. Distances range from a 600 m Bambini run and 1.25 km school races to 5 km and 10 km races. Children and young people receive finisher medals, participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive neckerchiefs, and winners are rewarded with cake. The event is supported by the City of Duderstadt, Sparkasse Duderstadt and other sponsors.
course_highlights: Races through Duderstadt’s historic old town and pedestrian zone
Finish in front of the beautiful town hall
A range of distances from 600 m to 10 km, including races for children and young people
additional: The event opens at 16:00 with a ceremony led by patron and Mayor Thorsten Feike and the board of Sparkasse Duderstadt. The Bambini runs have participant limits of 250, while the school races have limits of 300 to 400 participants. Neckerchiefs are given as finisher gifts for the 5 km and 10 km races. No on-site late registration is available. The awards ceremony begins at 18:00. Multiple race distances, registration via the website, medals for children, neckerchiefs for longer races, event in the historic city centre

name: Höinger Heidelauf
location: Ense-Höingen, Kreis Soest, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Höinger Heidelauf is a traditional running event held annually on the first Friday in September in Ense-Höingen. Known as the toughest 10 km race in the Soest district, the event offers distances for different types of runners, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course runs along mostly paved paths and gravel trails through the Sauerland hills and features challenging terrain. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event puts community and atmosphere at the forefront, making it a special experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Toughest 10 km race in the Soest district
Course along paved paths and gravel trails
Run through the hilly Sauerland landscape
additional: Children’s races start at 16:45, the 5 km and half marathon at 17:30, and the 10 km race at 18:30. The start and finish are at Karl-Kleine-Stadion. The event offers great refreshments and a strong sense of community. Temporary road closures and safety measures should be taken into account. In the past, the event has set participation records despite adverse weather conditions. Running event with children’s races and main races, a challenging course with elevation gain, and online registration available.

name: IHK-Ausbildungslauf move-on
location: Rostrup bei Oldenburg, Ammerland, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The training run “Move On!” is organized by the Oldenburg Chamber of Industry and Commerce (IHK) and takes place around the Zwischenahner Meer. The course is approximately 12 km long and runs from BBS Ammerland in Rostrup via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen, returning to Rostrup. It is aimed at trainers, apprentices, examiners, teachers and other people involved in vocational education and training in the Oldenburg region. In addition to the run, the event includes a program with race-number collection, team photos, a barbecue evening with music and an awards ceremony. The event takes place in all weather. Parking is available at BBS and at Bau-ABC Rostrup.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km circular route around the Zwischenahner Meer
Start and finish at BBS Ammerland in Rostrup
Route via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen
additional: Race numbers and T-shirts can be collected at BBS Rostrup on the day of the event from 14:00 to 15:30. There is a walking group starting at 15:00. The run starts in four groups from 16:00, at 4-minute intervals. After the run, a barbecue with a music act will take place from 18:00 at Bau-ABC near the finish. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 18:30. The IHK accepts no liability for accidents or theft. Valuables cannot be stored.

name: Sparkassen Pütt-Tage-Lauf 2026
organizer: Sparkasse Münsterland Ost, SG Rote Erde Beckum, Ski-Club Beckum, TV Beckum, Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen
price_range: online registration, exact fee not specified
description: The Sparkassen Pütt-Tage Run is a road-running event held on Fridays in downtown Beckum as part of the city’s Pütt-Tage festivities. The program includes short children’s races, a youth race, a charity run, and the 10 km main race, which also serves as the FLVW 10 km Road Running Championships. The course covers several laps through the streets around Hühlstraße, where the start and finish are also located. The event is organized by several local clubs and the Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen. Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib.
course_highlights: City streets around Hühlstraße in Beckum
10 km main race over several laps
Charity run of approximately 4.2 km over about five laps
additional: The program begins with a 400 m Bambini Run, followed by 1 km children’s races (ages 6–9), a 2 km youth race (ages 10–15), and the 10 km main race (ages 16 and up). Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib, and results are published online. Multiple race types, including children’s, youth, charity, and main races; held as part of the Pütt-Tage festivities; city-street race; timing with a RaceResult transponder.

name: 23. Lehrter CityLauf
description: The Lehrter City Run is a long-standing running event held annually in downtown Lehrte. The course includes 2 km, 4 km and 10 km races, as well as children’s and school races. A special highlight is the inclusion run, held as part of the 2 km race. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event offers a varied program of activities with musical accompaniment and team competitions for companies.
course_highlights: The course runs through downtown Lehrte
Races over 2 km, 4 km and 10 km
Inclusion run as part of the 2 km race
additional: There is a team competition for companies over 4 km and 10 km, with prizes awarded by KURTULUS GRUPPE. Walter Nebel provides musical accompaniment. Participants can take part in the supporting program with a stage performance. Volunteers are needed for organization and course support. Booth spaces are available for companies.

name: FLVW 10 km-Straßenlaufmeisterschaften
description: The FLVW 10 km Road Running Championships are a long-standing running event in Beckum that brings together runners from the region and beyond. The course follows a well-measured 10-kilometer road route that appeals to both competitive athletes and recreational runners. The event offers professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Well-measured 10 km road course
Scenic route through Beckum
Long-standing FLVW championship

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
location: Ľubotín, Ľubotín, Polyfunkčný dom Ľubotín (budova za obecným úradom)
description: The Run from Ľubotín to Plaveč Castle is a traditional race that starts in the village of Ľubotín, by the Multifunctional Building. The race offers categories for men, women, juniors, Nordic walking, and a 4 km hobby run. The main race starts at 17:30, and the children’s categories begin at 16:30. The organizers are the municipalities of Ľubotín and Plaveč, which welcome runners of all ages and abilities. The race is ideal for anyone looking to run in beautiful surroundings, with the finish at Plaveč Castle.

name: X Srebrna Dziesiątka
description: Srebrna Dziesiątka to coroczny bieg uliczny w Olkuszu, organizowany od 2016 roku ku pamięci wybitnego trenera Kazimierza Chechelskiego. Wydarzenie łączy sportową rywalizację z integracją lokalnej społeczności i promocją aktywnego stylu życia. Uczestnicy mogą wybierać spośród kilku dystansów dostosowanych do różnych poziomów zaawansowania, a trasa prowadzi ulicami miasta z startem i metą na stadionie. Bieg to także okazja do wspólnej zabawy i motywacji do ruchu dla biegaczy w każdym wieku i stopniu zaawansowania.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi ulicami Olkusza z startem i metą na stadionie
Dystanse: 10 km bieg główny, 5 km bieg towarzyszący, 5 km Nordic Walking
Trasa przebiega m.in. ulicami Parkową, Żuradzką, Mazaniec i Starowiejską
additional: W ramach biegu organizowany jest Memoriał Kazimierza Chechelskiego dla najmłodszych uczestników. Wydarzenie oferuje pamiątkowe medale oraz nagrody dla najlepszych zawodników. Trasa jest oznaczona, a biuro zawodów działa sprawnie. Bieg promuje zdrowy styl życia i integrację biegaczy z Olkusza i okolic. Informacje o poprzedniej edycji wskazują start i metę na stadionie przy ul. 29 Listopada 12c w Olkuszu oraz limit 90 minut na bieg główny. Szczegóły te mogą ulec zmianie w edycji 2027.

name: RAWki na Surowo
description: RAWki na Surowo to górski bieg trailowy odbywający się w magicznych Bieszczadach, prowadzący przez widokowe połoniny Małej i Wielkiej Rawki. Trasa o długości 29 km i przewyższeniu +1550 m przebiega przez tereny Bieszczadzkiego Parku Narodowego, co wymusza formułę biegu bez punktów odżywczych i znakowania trasy. Impreza jest certyfikowana przez ITRA i UTMB oraz stanowi część ligi MTrail Running Series. Start i meta znajdują się w Wetlinie, a bieg odbywa się w formule self-support, co podkreśla jego surowy charakter.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
description: Międzynarodowy Festiwal Chodu w Gdańsku to prestiżowe wydarzenie sportowe, które gromadzi zawodników w różnym wieku i na różnych poziomach zaawansowania. W ramach festiwalu odbywają się konkurencje chodu na dystansach 3 km, 5 km i 10 km, w tym Mistrzostwa Polski Masters oraz Mistrzostwa Polski U23. Impreza promuje także aktywność osób z niepełnosprawnościami, oferując wyścigi wózkarzy i zawody FrameRunning. Festiwal to także otwarty marsz „Chód z Listonoszem” oraz Bieg im. Obrońców Poczty Polskiej, tworząc sportową atmosferę dla wszystkich uczestników.
course_highlights: Konkurencje chodu na dystansach 3 km, 5 km i 10 km dla różnych kategorii wiekowych
Mistrzostwa Polski Masters i U23 w chodzie sportowym
Rywalizacja i aktywność dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: wyścigi wózkarzy i zawody FrameRunning
additional: Obrońców Poczty Polskiej Energa Cup. Impreza promuje aktywność fizyczną osób z niepełnosprawnościami, organizując równoległe konkurencje dostosowane do ich potrzeb.

name: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy
