description: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy to górskie zawody biegowe odbywające się w malowniczych Karkonoszach, w Sobieszowie. Festiwal oferuje różnorodne dystanse, od rodzinnego biegu edukacyjnego po wymagający ultramaraton na 102 km z ponad 5000 metrów przewyższenia. Trasy prowadzą przez kamieniste zbiegi, leśne ścieżki i szczyty górskie, zapewniając niezapomniane widoki i wyzwania dla biegaczy o różnym stopniu zaawansowania. Impreza ma charakter integracyjny i promuje bieganie jako sport drużynowy, a także edukację przyrodniczą w Karkonoskim Parku Narodowym.
course_highlights: Ultramaraton 102 km z ponad 5100 m przewyższenia
Malownicze trasy przez Karkonoski Park Narodowy z kamienistymi zbiegami i leśnymi ścieżkami
Różnorodne dystanse od 8 km biegu rodzinnego po 71 km i 42 km maraton
additional: Start i meta wszystkich biegów zlokalizowane są w okolicy Zamku Chojnik w Sobieszowie. Ultramaraton ma limit czasu 20 godzin, półmaraton 7 godzin. W trakcie festiwalu dostępna jest szeroka oferta gastronomiczna i strefa expo. Edukacyjny bieg rodzinny z przystankami edukacyjnymi i pytaniami sprawdzającymi wiedzę. Obowiązkowe wyposażenie dla ultra i półmaratonu obejmuje m.in. telefon z roamingiem, latarkę czołową, folię NRC i mapę trasy. Limit uczestników na poszczególne dystanse jest określony (np. 100 osób dla ultra, 375 dla półmaratonu).

name: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny
description: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny VII Srebrna Dziesiątka to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie Olkuszbiega, Urząd Miasta i Gminy Olkusz oraz Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olkuszu. Zawody odbywają się na trasach o długości 10 km (bieg główny), 5 km (bieg towarzyszący) oraz 5 km marszu nordic walking, z startem i metą na Rynku w Olkuszu. Trasa biegu prowadzi ulicami o nawierzchni asfaltowej i częściowo brukowej, jest oznakowana co 1 km i posiada pomiar międzyczasu na 5 km. Zawodnicy korzystają z pomiaru czasu systemem chipowym, a limit czasu na ukończenie biegu wynosi 90 minut. Impreza promuje aktywny tryb życia i bieganie jako formę rekreacji dla wszystkich grup wiekowych.
course_highlights: Trasa 10 km składa się z dwóch pętli po 5 km, asfaltowo-brukowa nawierzchnia
Oznakowanie trasy co 1 km oraz pomiar międzyczasu na 5 km
Punkt odżywczy na około 6 km biegu głównego
additional: Limit uczestników wynosi 300 osób. Weryfikacja i odbiór pakietów startowych odbywa się 6 i 7 września 2024. Pomiar czasu chipowy mocowany na obuwiu. Trasa częściowo zamknięta dla ruchu kołowego do godziny 16:30. Zawodnicy niepełnoletni muszą posiadać pisemną zgodę rodziców lub opiekunów. Depozyt dostępny w Biurze Zawodów.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: Półmaraton Praski to coroczny nocny półmaraton organizowany w Warszawie, który przyciąga biegaczy z całej Polski i zagranicy. Trasa biegu prowadzi przez malownicze dzielnice Pragi, oferując wyjątkową atmosferę nocnego biegu w sercu miasta. Impreza jest doskonale zorganizowana, z pomiarem czasu i bogatym zapleczem dla uczestników. W ramach wydarzenia odbywa się także Praska 5K Run, umożliwiając udział biegaczom o różnym poziomie zaawansowania.
course_highlights: Nocny bieg ulicami warszawskiej Pragi
Malownicze widoki na zabytkowe dzielnice
Profesjonalny pomiar czasu i strefy startowe
additional: Wydarzenie obejmuje także bieg na 5 km - Praska 5K Run. Obsługa klienta dostępna jest od poniedziałku do piątku w godzinach 9-18. Trasa i program imprezy na rok 2027 zostaną podane bliżej terminu wydarzenia.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: XLVI Usedom Marathon to wyjątkowy bieg łączący dwa kraje i oferujący niezapomniane chwile w otoczeniu natury. Trasa prowadzi od Świnoujścia wzdłuż najdłuższej promenady nadmorskiej w Europie, przez historyczne Kaiserbäder, lasy nadmorskie aż do Wolgast. Biegacze doświadczą różnorodności nawierzchni i krajobrazów, od asfaltu, przez bruk, po leśne ścieżki, z widokiem na Morze Bałtyckie i morską bryzę. Start o godzinie 9:00 w Świnoujściu, meta w Peene-Stadion w Wolgast, zapewniając wyjątkowe sportowe i morskie przeżycie na wyspie Uznam.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi wzdłuż najdłuższej promenady nadmorskiej w Europie
Różnorodne nawierzchnie: asfalt, bruk, leśne ścieżki
Przekraczanie granicy niemiecko-polskiej i widoki na Morze Bałtyckie
additional: Zapewniony jest transport bagażu do stadionu mety. Limit czasowy: zawodnicy muszą przejść punkt Kölpinsee (km 21,8) przed 2:30 h i Zinnowitz (km 30) przed 3:30 h, po przekroczeniu limitów zawodnik zostaje wycofany z trasy i przewieziony do mety. Po przekroczeniu limitów nie ma zabezpieczenia trasy ani punktów odżywczych.

name: I Mistrzostwa Śląska Osób z Niepełnosprawnościami
V Bieg Pamięci Ofiar Bombardowania Węzła Kolejowego
XIV Grand Prix Nordic Walking Nowa Wieś Lęborska
Felsburglauf
description: The Felsburglauf is a traditional running event held annually since 2013 on the last Sunday in August at the stadium below Felsburg in Felsberg. The event offers races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m and attracts runners of all ages from the region. Its family-friendly atmosphere and beautiful setting make it a popular event in the Schwalm-Eder district. As a licensed race in the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup, participants can also earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: Races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m
Start and finish at the stadium below historic Felsburg
Family-friendly atmosphere in beautiful surroundings
additional: The race is part of the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup. The youngest participants are often born in 2020 or later, and the oldest runner was born in 1937. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht 1863 Felsberg and partner TSV Jahn Gensungen. Distances: 400 m, 1 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: stadium and the area around Felsburg; registration not explicitly mentioned

name: Sparkassen-City-Lauf Meppen
organizer: TV Meppen 1912 e.V. und SV Union Meppen 1947 e.V.
description: The Sparkassen-City-Lauf Meppen is a long-established race jointly organized by the clubs TV Meppen 1912 e.V. and SV Union Meppen 1947 e.V. The event takes place in downtown Meppen and offers races for all age groups and distances. Runners can look forward to a varied course through the city, an enthusiastic atmosphere, and plenty of spectators. Race packets can be collected a few days before the race, and late registrations are still possible in person.
course_highlights: The course runs through downtown Meppen
A range of races for all age groups and distances
Jointly organized by TV Meppen and SV Union Meppen
additional: Late registration is possible in person at the club office or on-site on the day of the event. Race packets can be collected from September 1 during opening hours. On the day of the event, packets can be collected until approximately 45 minutes before the start. The 5 km and 10 km races are part of the Emsland running series (EL-Cup).

name: Volkslauf in St.Vit Laufen und Gutes tun
location: St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The charity run "Run and Do Good" takes place in St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The races follow flat circuits through the village of St. Vit, starting and finishing at the Küsterhaus. The event supports various social projects, including outpatient palliative care for children, the Malteser Herzenswunsch Krankenwagen, DKMS and families in need. In addition to the races, there will be an inline skating race for the first time, as well as a charity tattoo event that encourages participants’ social engagement.
course_highlights: Flat circuits through the village of St. Vit
Start and finish at the Küsterhaus
9.1 km inline skating race (5 laps), helmets required
additional: Timing is recorded using a disposable chip attached to the running shoe. Race bibs are available on the day of the event from 13:30 in the registration tent next to the Küsterhaus. Water is provided along the course, with tea and fruit in the finish area. Changing facilities are available at the local youth center. Helmets are required for the inline skating race. Charity tattoo event and DKMS registration on site. Participation is possible through membership; donations support children's hospices, DKMS and families in need. Races are offered over various distances, including a kids’ run and inline skating.

name: Warendorfer Emssee-Lauf
location: Warendorfer Freibad, Warendorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Warendorf Emssee Run is a long-established fun run with a special atmosphere in the Münsterland, welcoming runners of all abilities. The varied routes circle the Emssee and pass through the Münsterland parkland, with the start and finish at Warendorf outdoor swimming pool, creating a friendly, lively atmosphere. The event combines sporting ambition with community spirit and the joy of running, and is supported by numerous volunteers. Many health insurance providers subsidize participation through their bonus programs, supporting an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Varied route around the Emssee and through the Münsterland parkland
Start and finish at Warendorf outdoor swimming pool, with a friendly atmosphere
Routes include gravel paths, woodland trails, asphalt roads, and grassy areas
additional: Race packs can be collected at the outdoor swimming pool from 9:00 a.m. on event day. Race bibs with an integrated disposable chip are issued upon presentation of an identity card. Due to construction work, the courses are not officially measured and are therefore not eligible for best-list rankings. Parking is within walking distance at the “Zwischen den Emsbrücken,” “Lohwall,” and “Bootshaus” car parks.

name: Werler Kurpark Crosslauf - Hindernislauf für Groß und Klein
location: Werl Kurpark, Werl, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Werler Kurpark Crosslauf is an obstacle race for all ages, held in Werl’s picturesque Kurpark. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, from short courses for children to challenging 6.4 km races for endurance runners. New in 2026 is the relay cross-country race, which promotes team spirit and fun. The varied course includes numerous exciting obstacles, making the race a special experience.
course_highlights: A variety of obstacles, including Climb the Wall, Waterlagoon and Mountainclimber
Distances from 480 metres to 6.4 kilometres
New for 2026: Project S as an additional obstacle
additional: On-site late registration is possible until 60 minutes before the respective start (except for the relay). Race bibs with electronic timing via Racersult. Spikes, running barefoot and costumes are not permitted for safety reasons. Accompanying runners on the course are allowed only in the U6 Bambini race. Obstacles, courses for children and adults, family-friendly, team spirit, fun

name: Wildman Harz
description: WILDMAN Harz is a challenging trail-running event around the mountain town of Wildemann in the Harz Mountains. The course features tough climbs, technical downhills, spruce forests and alpine meadows, offering an authentic trail-running experience in the Upper Harz. With distances from 1.5 km to 55 km, there is a suitable challenge for every trail runner. The event also features a varied program, including a pasta party and a barbecue party, making the weekend a special experience.
course_highlights: Tough climbs and technical downhills
Spruce forests and alpine meadows
Singletrack trails over rugged terrain around Wildemann
additional: Late registration is possible online up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late-registration fee of EUR 10. Age limits are defined for each course. The program includes a pasta party on Friday and a barbecue party on Saturday. There are race categories, mandatory equipment and aid stations. Registration is through the partner myRacePartner.com. Courses have up to 2,100 metres of elevation gain. Aid stations, timing, environmental and fair-play rules, a program including pasta and barbecue parties, and registration are required.

name: Ederauenlauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 4.7 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.4 km
description: The Ederauenlauf in Bergheim is a popular running event offering a variety of distances suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels. The course runs through the scenic Ederauen and offers ideal conditions on a measured course eligible for record lists. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, numerous volunteers, and great spirit. Alongside the competition, the focus is also on sharing the experience and supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Measured course through the Ederauen, eligible for record lists
Distances from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km)
Start and finish at the central sports grounds of TV08 Bergheim
additional: The event offers various distances, from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km). The course is dry and sheltered from the wind, with ideal running weather. There is a family-friendly atmosphere, with many volunteers and spectators. The event supports social projects such as the Marburg Children's Cancer Aid. The central sports grounds of TV08 Bergheim serve as the start and finish venue. Courses are measured and well marked, including the Nordic walking route; donations for Children's Cancer Aid.

name: Fehmarn Marathon
description: The Fehmarn Marathon takes place annually on the island of Fehmarn and offers runners a varied route through the eastern part of the island. The main races follow roads, dike paths, and uneven country paths, providing a diverse running experience. The event starts at 9:30 a.m. at the sports ground at the Inselschule in Fehmarn. In addition to the marathon, there are other races with award ceremonies, and all participants receive an official marathon shirt. Timing is done using a foot chip attached to the running shoe, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Loops along roads, dike paths, and uneven country paths
Route through the eastern part of Fehmarn
Start and finish at the sports ground at the Inselschule
additional: Race number pickup is available the day before from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. and on the event day from 8:00 a.m. Award ceremonies take place after the races, staggered by race. Timing is done using a foot chip, which must be returned after the race; a fee of €15 is charged if it is lost. The event ends at approximately 3:15 p.m. with the arrival of the cyclist accompanying the final course sweep. Parking is recommended within walking distance of the start area. Late entries are possible until 30 minutes before the respective race. Shirts tend to run small, so larger sizes are recommended. The event takes place in all weather conditions; online registration is available, including running shirts and various categories.

name: 4. Backyard Ultra Munich
description: The Munich Backyard Ultra is a unique running event in Oberschleißheim near Munich, where runners complete a 6.7 km lap every hour. The distinctive feature is that the same course is run each time, and only one person emerges as the winner in the end. The event thrives on a strong community, with runners, volunteers, and spectators supporting one another and creating a special atmosphere together. Safety, refreshments, and comfort are taken care of, allowing participants to focus fully on their running experience.

name: Intern. Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run, organized by TSV Poggenhagen von 1946 e.V., is taking place. This traditional public race is scored in accordance with the German Athletics Regulations (DLO) and is recognized for all DLV public-race badges. Certificates are available for all placements for download online, and an awards ceremony will be held for the top three finishers in each category. A special prize will also be awarded to the largest registered group. Acceptance of the terms of participation and liability limitations is a prerequisite for taking part.

name: Volkslauf Eisbergen 2026
organizer: TuS Eisbergen TURN- UND SPIELVEREIN 1919 EISBERGEN e. V.
description: The Volkslauf Eisbergen is a long-standing running event in Porta Westfalica, offering various distances for children and adults. The course runs around the Eisbergen sports field and offers varied running options, with a 5.7 km Volkslauf and a 17.7 km long-distance race. Refreshments are also provided for participants, and the event is part of the Mühlenkreisserie. The course can also be viewed on Komoot, making it easy to prepare.

name: Volksbank Mitte Kurstadtlauf
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Kurstadtlauf in Heilbad Heiligenstadt is a longstanding race, taking place for the 27th time. The 19-kilometer route crosses the Dün and starts and finishes in the Vitalpark. A tree is planted for every participant to help reforest local woodlands, making the race particularly eco-friendly. The event offers a warm atmosphere and welcomes runners of all abilities.

name: 55. Brockenlauf
description: The Brockenlauf is Germany’s oldest mountain race and has been held annually in Ilsenburg in the Harz Mountains since 1927. The main 26.2 km course climbs 890 meters to the Brocken, the highest mountain in northern Germany, and offers a challenging experience with changeable high-mountain weather at the summit. The route passes through picturesque natural scenery and historic places, with impressive views. In addition to the main race, there are other shorter courses that also offer an experience in nature. The event is open to all runners, regardless of club membership.

name: Brokser Volkslauf
description: The Brokser Volkslauf takes place in Bruchhausen-Vilsen and offers running and walking events for all age groups. The event includes distances from 400 m to 20 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. Held in all weather, it offers participants a varied supporting program with a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The races start at the school and sports center, and children’s and youth races are rewarded with medals.

name: Gremsdorfer Kerwalauf 2026
description: The Gremsdorf Kerwalauf is a traditional running event in Gremsdorf, offering various distances for all age groups. The event includes races for toddlers, children, youth, recreational runners and the main race, as well as walking competitions. The routes pass through the scenic surroundings of Gremsdorf and offer a varied experience for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The race takes place annually as part of the Kerwa festival and is a popular event for the whole family.

name: 46. Internationaler Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run invites all running enthusiasts to Poggenhagen. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon races, all starting together. The scenic course runs around Poggenhagen, past the air base and as far as the bathing island in Steinhude. There are also 450 m and 850 m races for children. All races finish at the TSV Poggenhagen sports park.

name: SOKOLOVSKÁ 12/24 RUN
description: Sokolovská 12/24 RUN is an endurance running race lasting 6, 12 or 24 hours, for individuals, pairs and teams of four. The race takes place on an easy, gently undulating loop around the Michal Natural Swimming Pool in Sokolov. The start is at 11:15, and accommodation is available at a campsite with full facilities. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants and offers various age and team categories, with the option to change over in the relay zone by the refreshment stand.

name: Běh kolem Světa
description: Běh kolem Světa is a traditional running event held in Třeboň, following a route around the Svět pond. Since its launch in 2012, the race has gained a loyal following and offers an attractive 11.7 km course that follows the Svět Nature Trail. The event takes place every September and is popular for its natural scenery and varied terrain, including dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden footbridges, and sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for runners of all abilities, and entry can also be purchased as a Christmas voucher.

name: Mirovice - Běh do háje
description: Mirovice - Běh do háje is a running race held in the picturesque setting of the Mirovice sports field. The race features a challenging route with elevation gain that will test runners’ fitness and endurance. It is organized by the Czech Athletics Federation through its Český běh service, which supports running events throughout the Czech Republic. The race is suitable for all runners looking for a challenge on natural terrain and wanting to enjoy the atmosphere of a community sporting event.
course_highlights: Mass start at the Mirovice sports field
Challenging terrain with significant elevation gain
Natural forest and field paths around Mirovice

name: Podhostýnská 10
location: Zámecký park, Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Czech Republic
description: Podhostýnská 10ka is a running race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, offering 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races. The event takes place in the castle park and is part of the Běhy Zlín running series. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize tradition and high-quality race organization.

name: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků
description: The Plzeňská teplárenská Run around the Bolevec Ponds is a traditional running event organized by Pro Sport Activities, offering races for children and adults in the picturesque setting of the Bolevec Ponds in Plzeň. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including the youngest runners. Entry is free, and the first 300 people to register will receive a voucher for refreshments. In addition to the races, there is a program for children and an autograph session with athletes.

name: Birell Večerní Běh na 10 km Praha
description: The Birell Prague Evening 10 km Run is a traditional night race offering a unique atmosphere as Prague’s streets light up. The race starts at dusk, giving runners the chance to experience the city’s beauty in an unusual light. You can take part individually or as part of a team and enjoy the magical nighttime atmosphere beneath the stars. The race is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts thousands of runners every year.

name: adidas Běh pro ženy 5 km Praha
description: Come and run the adidas Women’s 5K in Prague, the largest race created specifically for women. The 5 km course is suitable even for runners with no prior training, with a 50-minute time limit. Enjoy the unique atmosphere and the support of thousands of women at an exclusive race with no men on the course. Sign up with your friends and share the joy of running and solidarity.

name: Barokomaraton
description: Barokomaraton is the 19th edition of a cross-country race held in the picturesque town of Plasy and the valley of the Střela River. The race is intended both for experienced runners and for those who run for pleasure and want to enjoy the beautiful autumn scenery. Runners can expect routes along forest and field paths, with regular refreshment stations. The organizers are also preparing a cultural program, entertainment for children, and refreshments, making Barokomaraton an enjoyable day of sport and relaxation for the whole family.

name: Strážný nahoru a dolů
description: Strážný Up and Down is part of the ISCAREX Cup, a traditional series of running races in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a challenging uphill and downhill run in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč. The organizers provide a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for all participants. The event is suitable for experienced runners and recreational athletes who want to try running on hilly terrain.

name: Lupenická dvanáctka
description: The Lupenice Twelve is a traditional running race in Lupenice, held for the 33rd year. The race offers a 12 km course with 98 metres of elevation gain, running entirely on asphalt and clearly marked. The start is at the Lupenice sports complex, and the race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix. All participants run at their own risk, and those under 18 must provide parental consent.

name: Jenštejnská pětka
description: The Jenštejn Five is an annual 5 km running race held in the village of Jenštejn since 2014. In addition to the main race, other running categories are also held, making the event accessible to a wide range of runners. It is a traditional sporting gathering in the Central Bohemian Region and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the picturesque setting of Jenštejn.

name: Zbraslavská Závist
description: Zbraslavská Závist is a trail uphill race that starts in Prague-Zbraslav near the former mini zoo and leads to the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist. The course is 3.5 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering a challenging and interesting running experience. The race is suitable for athletes ready for a fast start and a demanding climb. It is organised by KOPEC, z.s., under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation, and is part of Prague’s traditional running calendar.

name: Beh Novoveskou Hutou
location: Novoveská Huta, Spišská Nová Ves, Slovakia
organizer: Športový Klub ROHALS a Mesto Spišská Nová Ves

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: muži nad 60 a ženy nad 50 rokov - 3 €

price_tiers.distance: Dorast a beh pre zdravie 5 km

description: Sports Club Rohals warmly invites you to the 16th edition of the Run Through Novoveská Huta, taking place in Novoveská Huta. Adults can take on a new 12.2 km course to Vojtechova samota and back, the same for women and men. A 5 km course is also available for those who prefer a shorter distance. Children and young runners will compete on shorter courses through the streets of Huta, grouped by age category. After the race, participants can refuel with goulash; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: The new adult course goes to Vojtechova samota (Šadroň) and back
The adult course is 12.2 km and is the same for women and men
Short courses for children through the streets of Novoveská Huta, grouped by age category
additional: Registration for school-age participants is from 11:30 to 12:45, and for juniors and adults until 14:45. Participants may start in only one category. Goulash will be provided after the race; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest. Adult categories compete for points in the Spišská Nová Ves District Running League. 12.2 km and 5 km courses, categories for different age groups, registration on the day of the event, activities for children and adults.

name: Marathon Chopok
description: Marathon Chopok is a challenging mountain run in the beautiful surroundings of the Low Tatras, testing your abilities on a variety of surfaces and terrain. There are two main courses: the 43 km SkyMarathon Chopok, with 2,600 m of elevation gain, and the shorter 21 km Sky Race Jasná Trail, with 1,400 m of elevation gain. Relay entries are also available for the long course. The route runs along both the southern and northern sides of Chopok, including the main ridge, and offers beautiful views and varied terrain.

name: Kokava Trail
description: Kokava Trail is a certified trail race starting and finishing in Kokava nad Rimavicou, with routes through the Veporské vrchy and Stolické vrchy mountain ranges. There are two distances: the main course is 78 km with +3330 m of elevation gain and an 18-hour time limit; the shorter Pasiečky Trail is 23 km with +1200 m of elevation gain and a 7-hour time limit. The varied route consists of 45% meadow sections, 45% forest trails and 10% asphalt. It has no difficult technical sections, but includes several steeper descents and climbs. Runners can make use of six aid stations. Mandatory equipment includes a thermal blanket, headlamp, mobile phone with an active SIM card, GPS device, reflective vest and sufficient fluids. Winners in the Men, Women, Men 50+ and Women 50+ categories will receive medals and prizes during the awards ceremony at the cultural centre.

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series Round 3 is part of a series of running events held in Prešov throughout 2026. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, from beginners to professionals. The courses are designed to bring the community together, promote a healthy lifestyle, and make exercise enjoyable. The entry fee includes timing, a medal, refreshments, and an accompanying program. Children who are members of Prešov Running Team can run for free.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
location: Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Ul. Doliny
description: The 6-Hour Run Under Šariš Castle is an endurance running event held in Veľký Šariš, Prešov District. The race is open to individuals and relay teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The entry fee is the same for all runners, and the event offers the chance to test your endurance in a six-hour run in the beautiful surroundings below the castle. The organizers, Gejza Sabanoš and Ondrej Fedor, ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
location: Malé Ozorovce, Malé Ozorovce, Parkovisko pred KD
description: Ozorovská Twelve is a running race held in Malé Ozorovce, offering courses for both children and adults. The race is organized by OZ Zorovčan in cooperation with the municipality of Veľké Ozorovce. Participants can compete in the 6 km and 12 km races, with categories by age and gender. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 10:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere near the cultural center.

name: Horský kros Gerlach
location: Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov od pomníka ( Prezentácia: Obecný úrad Gerlachov )
description: Horský kros Gerlach is a traditional mountain uphill race that starts in the village of Gerlachov and runs through the Velická Valley to the Sliezsky dom mountain hotel. The course is 8,400 metres long with an elevation gain of 879 metres, and runners tackle a rocky trail and sections of asphalt road. The event is suited to runners who enjoy challenging mountain terrain and beautiful views of the High Tatras. The programme also includes children’s races, and runners can purchase an entry with original Horský kros Gerlach socks.

name: Beh za Tatry
location: Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, pod vyhliadkovou vežou Tatras Tower
organizer: Barbora a Slavomír Ogurčákovci v spolupráci s občianskym združením Žiť Tatry
description: Beh za Tatry is a running event held in the picturesque setting of Štrbské Pleso in the High Tatras, below the Tatras Tower observation tower. The races offer a start for children at 14:00 and for adults at 16:00, with the course running on natural surfaces along the lakeshore and cross-country ski trails. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of various age groups to take part. The organizers are Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčák, in cooperation with the Žiť Tatry civic association, who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Veľatský lesný beh
description: The Veľaty Forest Run is a traditional running event organized by the civic association OZ Stopa in the village of Veľaty. The race takes place at the FK Veľaty sports field and offers courses of various lengths for men and women aged 15 and over, while children’s races are held directly on the football pitch. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, voluntary donations in place of an entry fee, and refreshments. Volunteers support runners throughout the day, and times are recorded by timekeepers, followed by the announcement of the winners and the presentation of prizes.

name: Telekom Night run
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km

name: Bėgam už Kalvariją miesto gatvėmis XII
location: Centrinė aikštė, Laisvės g. 1A, Kalvarija, Lithuania
description: Bėgam už Kalvariją miesto gatvėmis XII is a traditional running event held on the streets of Kalvarija. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among city residents and running enthusiasts. Participants compete in a 2.5 km children's race and a 5 km race consisting of two laps. The start and finish are in the central city square. The event is open to everyone, and participants are awarded separately by gender.
course_highlights: 5 km course — 2 laps on city streets
2.5 km children's race — 1 lap
Start and finish in Kalvarija's central square
additional: Registration and race-number pickup take place on the day of the event from 10:00. The timekeeping system will be switched off at 13:00 on race day. Electronic chips are disposable and do not need to be returned. Participants are prohibited from using vehicles or personal escorts during the race. The start and finish are in the central square, Laisvės g. 1A. A water station is provided on the courses.

name: Labdaros bėgimas „Vaikai Vaikams“
organizer: Kauno sporto mokykla „Startas“ ir Rimanto Kaukėno paramos grupė
description: The “Children for Children” charity run is an annual event dedicated to helping children in need. Its mission is to support Nojus, who has cerebral palsy and needs laser therapy. The event welcomes everyone, from the youngest participants to adults, bringing physical activity together with meaningful support. Participants can choose from several distances, and all children taking part in the run receive a T-shirt.
course_highlights: The course runs through Kaunas Oak Park and the Valdas Adamkus Athletics Arena
Distances: 500 m, 1 km and 5 km
The event is held for charity, supporting children with special needs
additional: T-shirts and stickers are handed out to participants from 10:00 to 12:00. The event is organized by Kaunas Sports School “Startas” and the Rimantas Kaukėnas Support Group.

name: Rotary End Polio bėgimas
description: The “Rotary End Polio Run” is a charity 5 km run and walk, along with a 400 m children’s run, in the city of Palanga. It aims to help eradicate polio worldwide. The event takes place at Palanga Stadium and on city streets, including pedestrian and cycle paths and the Palanga Bridge. Participants can choose to run or walk, and the event encourages people with disabilities to take part in sport. All funds raised go to Rotary’s polio eradication program, while the organizers cover the event expenses themselves.
course_highlights: 5 km course surface: asphalt, city streets, pedestrian and cycle paths, park, Palanga Bridge
400 m children’s run
Start and finish at Palanga Stadium
additional: Age groups are based on year of birth, and overall winners are not eligible for age-group awards. The time limit for the 5 km run and walk is 100 minutes. The awards ceremony will take place at 12:00. The event also includes a 400 m children’s run.

name: 14 Tyski Półmaraton
description: 14 Tyski Półmaraton to bieg na dystansie półmaratonu (21,0975 km) z atestem PZLA, odbywający się ulicami miasta Tychy oraz wokół jeziora Paprocańskiego. Start, meta oraz miasteczko biegowe zlokalizowane są przy Stadionie Lekkoatletycznym w Tychach. Impreza promuje aktywny tryb życia i sportową atmosferę miasta, oferując także liczne atrakcje towarzyszące, takie jak biegi dla dzieci, masaże i pokazy sportowe. Trasa została zmodyfikowana w 2022 roku, aby zmniejszyć liczbę podbiegów, co czyni ją bardziej przyjazną dla uczestników. Bieg odbywa się pod honorowym patronatem Prezydenta Miasta Tychy i cieszy się rosnącą popularnością od 2012 roku.

name: Festiwal Sportowy im. Kazimierza Bubuli 2026
organizer: LKS Markam Wiśniowa – Osieczany, LKS Lubomir Wiśniowa oraz Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Wiśniowej
description: Festiwal Sportowy im. Kazimierza Bubuli w Wiśniowej to wyjątkowe wydarzenie sportowe i integracyjne, które odbędzie się 5 września 2027 roku. W programie znajdują się biegi na dwóch dystansach: Wiśniowa Run - 5 km oraz górski Bieg Trzech Wysp - 15 km, które prowadzą po drogach gminnych i szlakach turystycznych. Oprócz biegów organizowane są także turnieje sportowe, zawody na nartorolkach oraz atrakcje dla dzieci, co czyni festiwal wydarzeniem rodzinnym i pełnym sportowych emocji. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na atrakcyjne nagrody pieniężne i pamiątkowe medale.
course_highlights: Wiśniowa Run - szybka, wymagająca trasa 5 km po drogach gminnych częściowo wyłączonych z ruchu samochodowego
Bieg Trzech Wysp - górski bieg 15 km po drogach gminnych i szlakach turystycznych w masywie Grodziska/Księżej Góry/Ciecienia
Trasy odpowiednio oznakowane i zabezpieczone
additional: Wręczenie nagród o godz. 15:00, po czym odbędą się biegi przełajowe dla dzieci. W klasyfikacjach OPEN kobiet i mężczyzn przewidziano nagrody pieniężne: I miejsce - 700 zł, II miejsce - 400 zł, III miejsce - 300 zł. Dodatkowo nagrody dla najlepszych mieszkańców Gminy Wiśniowa w obu biegach - 200 zł. Każdy ukończony bieg w limicie czasu premiowany jest pamiątkowym medalem. Po zawodach losowanie nagród rzeczowych. Biuro zawodów mieści się w sali gimnastycznej Szkoły Podstawowej w Wiśniowej. Pakiet startowy obejmuje numer, medal, bon na posiłek i worek na depozyt.

name: Perly Malopolski Szczawnica Pieniny
description: Perły Małopolski Szczawnica to górskie zawody biegowe odbywające się w malowniczych Pieninach. Trasa prowadzi przez urozmaicone tereny, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe widoki i wymagające podbiegi. Impreza jest częścią cyklu Perły Małopolski, przyciągając biegaczy ceniących kontakt z naturą i sportową rywalizację. Szczawnica stanowi doskonałe miejsce startu i mety, zapewniając dobrą organizację i atmosferę.
course_highlights: Trasa górska w Pieninach z widokami na malownicze krajobrazy
Urozmaicone podbiegi i zbiegi na naturalnych ścieżkach
Start i meta w Szczawnicy, popularnym uzdrowisku

name: 26 Eco Półmaraton Wałbrzych
description: 26. edycja Toyota Eko Półmaraton Wałbrzych to jedno z najważniejszych wydarzeń biegowych w regionie i w kraju, które przyciąga biegaczy z całej Polski. Po zeszłorocznym sukcesie organizacyjnym i rekordowej frekwencji, impreza ponownie potwierdza swoją silną pozycję na sportowej mapie Polski. Trasa półmaratonu została bardzo dobrze oceniona przez uczestników, a wyjątkowa atmosfera tworzona przez wałbrzyskich kibiców dodaje wydarzeniu niepowtarzalnego charakteru. Zapraszamy serdecznie zarówno do udziału, jak i do kibicowania.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
location: Obliwice, Nowa Wieś Lęborska, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Polska
description: Zapraszamy na 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera, który odbędzie się w Obliwicach. Trasa biegu głównego ma długość 6,4 km i składa się z dwóch pętli po 3,2 km, start i meta znajdują się w tym samym miejscu. Impreza ma wyjątkową atmosferę sportową, łączącą rywalizację z rekreacją dla całych rodzin w otoczeniu przyrody. Bieg upamiętnia Tomasza Hopfera, legendę polskiego dziennikarstwa sportowego i lekkoatletę, a także promuje zdrowy styl życia i aktywność fizyczną w lokalnej społeczności.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: 64. Bieg Westerplatte to najstarszy w Polsce, nieprzerwanie organizowany bieg uliczny na dystansie 10 kilometrów, odbywający się w Gdańsku. Start biegu ma miejsce w historycznym miejscu, gdzie rozpoczęła się II Wojna Światowa, co nadaje imprezie wyjątkowy charakter i atmosferę refleksji nad poświęceniem i pokojem. Trasa biegu jest atestowana i oznaczona co kilometr, a finisz odbywa się na Polsat Plus Arenie Gdańsk, co stanowi dodatkową atrakcję dla uczestników. Wydarzenie przyciąga do 5 tysięcy biegaczy i jest zarówno sportowym wyzwaniem, jak i hołdem dla Obrońców Wybrzeża z 1939 roku.

name: Bieg KoBBiet
description: Bieg KoBBiet to coroczny bieg organizowany w Bielsku-Białej, który w 2026 roku odbędzie się 6 września na Stadionie Miejskim. Wydarzenie jest poświęcone pamięci Ewy Szymanek-Płaskiej, naczelniczki Wydziału Edukacji i Sportu w Urzędzie Miejskim w Bielsku-Białej. Tegoroczna edycja biegu wspiera dzieci w spektrum autyzmu, a zapisy rozpoczną się o godzinie 10:00. Honorowy patronat nad biegiem objął Prezydent Bielska-Białej, Jarosław Klimaszewski.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła to bieg na 5 km odbywający się w Bukownicy, Mazowieckie. To doskonała okazja dla biegaczy na różnych poziomach zaawansowania, aby sprawdzić swoją formę na łatwej, asfaltowej trasie. Organizatorzy zachęcają do przygotowania się z pomocą planów treningowych dopasowanych do indywidualnego poziomu, oferując wsparcie ekspertów. Wydarzenie ma charakter przyjazny i motywujący, idealny dla osób chcących poprawić kondycję i cieszyć się bieganiem.

name: Wiśniowa Run
organizer: LKS Markam Wiśniowa – Osieczany, LKS Lubomir Wiśniowa oraz Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Wiśniowej
description: Wiśniowa Run to bieg na dystansie 5 km odbywający się w ramach Festiwalu Sportowego im. Kazimierza Bubuli w Wiśniowej. Trasa jest szybka, lecz wymagająca, wytyczona po drogach gminnych częściowo wyłączonych z ruchu samochodowego. Wydarzenie łączy sportową rywalizację z integracją lokalnej społeczności i rodzinną atmosferą. Oprócz Wiśniowa Run organizowany jest także górski Bieg Trzech Wysp na 15 km, a po biegach głównych odbywają się biegi przełajowe dla dzieci. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na atrakcyjne nagrody, pamiątkowe medale oraz losowanie nagród rzeczowych.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km po drogach gminnych częściowo wyłączonych z ruchu samochodowego
Górski bieg 15 km po drogach gminnych i szlakach turystycznych masywu Grodziska/Księżej Góry/Ciecienia
Trasy odpowiednio oznakowane i zabezpieczone
additional: Nagrody pieniężne w klasyfikacji OPEN: I miejsce 700 zł, II miejsce 400 zł, III miejsce 300 zł. Dodatkowo pamiątkowe statuetki za miejsca I-III w kategoriach wiekowych. Dla mieszkańców Gminy Wiśniowa przewidziano dodatkową klasyfikację z nagrodą 200 zł dla najszybszej kobiety i mężczyzny na obu dystansach. Po zakończeniu zawodów losowanie nagród rzeczowych. Każdy ukończony bieg w limicie czasu premiowany jest pamiątkowym medalem.

name: XVIII Bieg Koguta
description: XVIII Bieg Koguta to bieg na dystansie 10 km organizowany w Oławie. Impreza jest organizowana przez Oławską Grupę Biegową we współpracy z lokalnymi instytucjami, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalny pomiar czasu. Biuro zawodów będzie czynne zarówno dzień przed biegiem, jak i w dniu startu, co ułatwi odbiór pakietów startowych. Bieg ma charakter otwarty i przyjazny dla biegaczy na różnym poziomie zaawansowania.

name: Bieg na Rowerze - Rower na Biegu
VII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Zblewo
location: Twardy Dół, Zblewo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Polska

name: X Bieg Neptuna
location: Trzebież, Police County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Polska

name: 16. Wardenburger Sommerlauf
description: The Wardenburg Summer Run is a long-standing race in Wardenburg that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 5 km to the 10-mile race; some start together and split at the Tillysee. The event focuses on fair, well-organized race management with chip timing and offers runners a varied route through the region. Children can take part in special untimed races, and Nordic walking is also on the program. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: The 10 km and 10-mile races start together and split at the Tillysee
Varied routes from 5 kilometers through the Wardenburg region
Timing with a chip integrated into the race bib
additional: No on-the-day entries are possible. Race bibs have an integrated chip; race bibs must be returned in the finish area. Running with dogs is not permitted. Baby joggers are allowed; participants with baby joggers should line up at the back. The Bambini run is without a race bib or timing. Toilets and changing rooms are available. Runners who exceed the 16:00 time limit will not be timed. Several distances; some races are not timed; participation is only permitted with a race bib; no on-the-day entries; organized via Laufmanager.

name: 31. Fulda-Marathon
description: The Fulda Marathon is a special running experience in the heart of Fulda, Hesse. The course passes the cathedral, winds through the Baroque Old Town and the Fulda meadows, and finishes in the stadium. The race is organised on a voluntary basis by Leichtathletik-Gemeinschaft Fulda e. V. and offers a well-designed course and professional organisation. In addition to the half marathon, there are other races, including 5 km and 11 km runs and a mini-marathon for different age groups.
course_highlights: The course passes the cathedral and runs through the Baroque Old Town
Run through the natural landscapes of the Fulda meadows
Finish in the stadium in the city of Fulda
additional: Start times for the other races: 10 km at approximately 09:40, 5 km at approximately 10:00, mini-marathon at 14:00 (primary school) and 15:00 (secondary level 1). Course maps for all races are clearly laid out and can be downloaded. The event is organised on a voluntary basis, with extensive support along the course, medical care and refreshments. Fulda Marathon T-shirts and a health check are available. Various races include the half marathon, 11 km, 5 km, team race and mini-marathon; please note the participation terms and cancellation fees. Numerous refreshment and support points, an accompanying programme and medical care.

name: 8. Flensburg liebt dich Marathon
description: The Flensburg liebt dich Marathon offers a varied running experience, with routes through Flensburg’s modern and historic city center, along the Sonwik marina and by the harbor. The marathon consists of four 10.55 km laps with a maritime atmosphere and finishes at Südermarkt. There is also a half marathon over two laps of the same route, as well as other races, including a marathon relay, 10 km and 5 km races. The event sends a positive message about community and quality of life in the region and warmly welcomes runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Four 10.55 km laps through the city center, Sonwik marina and harbor
Flat roads along the Förde with a maritime atmosphere
Finish at Südermarkt in Flensburg
additional: Race packets are issued upon presentation of the digital registration confirmation or an identity document. The participant limit is 1,000 runners for the marathon and 2,000 for the half marathon. The awards ceremony takes place at Flensburg Galerie. For safety reasons, participation with electronic audio devices, walking poles, jogging strollers, pushchairs and animals is not permitted. Online registration only; race packet collection at Flensburg Galerie; various race distances, including a marathon relay, children’s races and trial training sessions.

name: DresdenHALF
location: Dresden city center, Dresden, Saxony, Germany
description: The DresdenHALF is an exciting half marathon that, for the first time, runs through the heart of Dresden. The 21.1-kilometer course follows the Elbe and passes some of the city’s most beautiful sights, with each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s partner cities. The event offers runners a unique experience amid a historic setting and international atmosphere. In addition to the half marathon, there are other races for children and recreational runners, making the weekend a special running experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km through the heart of Dresden along the Elbe
Each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s 13 partner cities
Start at the World Trade Center Dresden, finish at the Saxon State Parliament
additional: The DresdenHALF starts at the World Trade Center Dresden and finishes at the Saxon State Parliament. The course is officially measured and eligible for rankings. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and the time limit is 3 hours. Every participant receives exclusive arm warmers and a finisher’s medal. The EWG Dresden5K includes an exclusive pom-pom beanie. Bib transfers are possible for a fee. All KidsRUN participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. Officially measured course, minimum age 16, 3-hour time limit, merchandise and bib transfers available, including children’s races and pre-race events on September 5.

name: Canyon Run Mühlheim
description: The Canyon Run in Mühlheim am Main is Hesse’s most beautiful forest run through the Mühlheim quarries. The event features flat, officially measured courses, attractive cash and non-cash prizes, and a unique atmosphere with live music in the finish area. Runners of all ages can choose from a range of distances, from the 400 m mini run to the half marathon, with excellent refreshments along the course. The run also supports social projects in the region, making the Canyon Run a special community experience.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured courses through the Mühlheim quarries and Mühlheim Forest
Half marathon with 80 metres of elevation gain, 10 km with 50 metres, 5 km with 20 metres
Start and finish at the Dietesheim sports grounds, with live music and excellent refreshments
additional: Net timing by transponder, provided by RST Volkslauf GmbH. Cash and non-cash prizes for the fastest runners. Team classifications for companies, clubs and schools. Professional photos in the finish area. Charity run with donations to local social organisations. Runs for families, kids and teams; includes refreshments, prizes, photos and community activities.

name: Kasseler Frauenlauf 2026
description: The Kassel Women’s Run is a charity event for women in Kassel-Wehlheiden, traditionally held on the first weekend of September at Buchenau-Kampfbahn. The event emphasizes exercise without performance pressure: there is no timing, no rankings, and no pressure to achieve personal bests. Participants can run, jog, walk or stroll, with short children’s races as well as 5 km and 10 km run-and-walk routes on flat courses. The day supports women in need and promotes a relaxed community atmosphere with a warm-up, music, food, a tombola, childcare, applause and participation certificates.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km and 10 km routes
Children’s races of 400 m and 800 m
Finish at Hessenkampfbahn on Auedamm
additional: There is no timing or ranking, and participants can run, jog, walk or stroll. The event takes place at Buchenau-Kampfbahn in Kassel-Wehlheiden and emphasizes relaxed, inclusive participation for women and children of all ages.

name: Schapener Volkslauf
description: The Schapen Volkslauf offers runners and walkers a choice of distances in a natural setting around the village of Schapen and the Riddagshausen ponds. The routes pass through idyllic woodland and pond landscapes, as well as historic places such as Schapen station. The 1.2 km route is especially family-friendly and is intended primarily for children and young people, accompanied by an adult. The event features a group warm-up, childcare and massages in exchange for a donation, and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km route goes around the Riddagshausen ponds and through Buchhorst
The 6.1 km route passes Schäfer’s Ruh and the historic Schapen station
The 1.2 km route is for children and young people and can be completed once or twice
additional: Start times vary by route, from 9:15 a.m. to 10:20 a.m. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 1921 Schapen e.V.

name: Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg
description: The Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg is a long-established running event held in Pinneberg. The event offers various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including a 1 km fun run for kindergarten children, a 2.5 km beginners’ and team run, and 5 km and 10 km courses for older participants. The races follow green loops through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark, with the start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark. The event is family-friendly, and spectators can watch and cheer on the children throughout the fun run.
course_highlights: Green loop through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark
Children’s fun run with 2 laps around Drosteipark
Start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark
additional: Late registration is available online until one hour before the start for a surcharge of €5.00. The team competition consists of 3 runners, whose individual times are added together; mixed teams are allowed. Online registration is available. Race bibs can be collected on September 4 and 5 at the VfL sports centre. Late registration is subject to a fee. The start and finish area is at Drosteiwiese.

name: Geithainer Herbstlauf
description: The Geithain Autumn Run is a family-friendly autumn race held at the Geithain Stadium in Geithain, Germany. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a 300 m Bambini Run, a 2.5 km Chestnut Run for children, a 7 km Fun Run, a 7 km walking route, and a 17 km scenic run for older participants and walkers. The start and finish are at the stadium, and the courses are GPS-measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. In addition to the races, there is a children’s programme, a bouncy castle, certificates, medals and small prizes. Every fifth finisher in races of 7 km or longer is rewarded with a bottle of sparkling wine.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Geithain Stadium
GPS-measured courses ranging from 0.3 km to 17 km
Family-friendly programme with children’s races and walking routes
additional: Every fifth finisher in the 7 km races or longer receives a bottle of sparkling wine. The event is organised by Impact Geithain e. V., with support from FSV Alemannia Geithain e. V. The children’s programme and bouncy castle are part of the event. The event includes children’s races, childcare, certificates, finisher medals, small prizes for children and a special bonus: every fifth finisher in the longer races receives a bottle of sparkling wine.

name: 10. Parchener Fiener-Cross
description: The Parchen Fiener Cross is a long-standing cross-country race in the Jerichower Land district, held in northern Saxony-Anhalt as part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP running series. The event attracts numerous runners of all ages each year and offers additional competitions, including the Heidel Team Cup and a family classification. The race takes place at the Klapperhalle on Parkstraße in Parchen and is known for its varied cross-country course. The event promotes running in the region and brings together sporting competition and a sense of community.

name: 15. Brunsberglauf
location: Holm-Seppensen, Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Brunsberglauf is a longstanding running event in Holm-Seppensen near Buchholz, held annually on the first Sunday in September. A range of distances is offered, from children’s races to a half marathon, on routes through the varied landscapes around the Brunsberg. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, professional organization by runners for runners, and attractive supporting program. Water stations are provided on the longer routes, with tea and sports drinks available at the finish.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the varied landscapes around the Brunsberg
Children’s races take place on the sports field
Water stations on the longer routes and refreshments at the finish
additional: The timing transponder is loaned free of charge and must be worn around the ankle. A fee of 40 EUR is charged if it is lost. There is a team competition on the 5 km and 11.7 km routes, with at least four runners per team. Late registration is only possible on the day of the event and costs an additional 3 EUR. Changing rooms, showers, and sports bag storage are available in the sports hall.

name: 23. Schoninger Volkslauf
location: SC Schoningen Turnhalle, Schoningen, Uslar, Lower Saxony, Germany
distance_verbose: 24.3 km, 17 km, 11 km, 10 km, 9 km, 6 km, 5 km, 2.3 km
description: The Schoninger Volkslauf is a long-running race event held annually in Schoningen. It invites running enthusiasts, hikers, families, and newcomers to sport to experience the beautiful countryside around Schoningen. The event is centered at the SC Schoningen gymnasium and starts in the morning. There are various courses for all age groups and ability levels, so everyone can take part.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful countryside around Schoningen
Routes for running, hiking, and walking
Family-friendly running event in the Solling
additional: There are options for running, hiking, and walking. The event is aimed at families, newcomers to sport, and experienced runners.

name: 37. CURREX Alsterlauf
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf is a traditional road race in Hamburg, held on a flat, traffic-free loop around the Inner and Outer Alster lakes. The event offers a unique start and finish atmosphere in Hamburg city center and is one of Europe’s largest 10-kilometer road races. In addition to the main 10 km race, there are also 5 km events, a schoolchildren’s race, and the R5K Tour for young runners. The courses are officially measured and ideal for fast times.

name: 38. Volkslauf des TSV Breuna
description: The 38th Breuna Malsburg Run is taking place. This traditional running event is held in the Breuna running and hiking park. The run offers an attractive route through the beautiful natural surroundings of Breuna and is open to runners of all ages. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and is part of the Nordhessencup. Registration is through the RaceResult platform.

name: 6. Tuchmacher Stadtlauf
description: The Tuchmacher City Run in Bramsche is a popular event with several race distances that attracts numerous participants each year. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and varied route through the city center. The 10 km main race is particularly popular with competitive athletes, while the schoolchildren’s race draws a large field and creates a lively atmosphere. The Bramscher Rumläufer organize the event with great dedication, supported by local schools and sponsors.

name: Breunaer Volkslauf mit 21,1km Malsburglauf
description: The 38th Breuna Malsburg Run is an established running event in Breuna. The route passes through Breuna’s running and hiking park and offers an attractive course for runners. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and welcomes runners of various ages and ability levels. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.

name: Gölitztallauf
description: The Gölitztallauf is an annual race in Marktgölitz, celebrating its 44th edition. The event offers four different distances, including a 1 km children’s race. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and awards in various age categories. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races to keep participants’ wait times to a minimum.

name: R5K - 5K Alsterlauf Hamburg 2026
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf Hamburg is a traditional running event featuring officially measured, flat, paved courses along the Outer Alster and on Ballindamm. The event offers various distances, including 10 km, 5 km and children’s races, and is open to runners of different age groups. The races are traffic-free and safely supervised by police and race marshals. The Hamburg 10 km Road Championships are also held as part of the Alsterlauf.

name: Stadtallendorfer Stadtlauf
description: The Stadtallendorf City Run takes place as part of the Heimat- und Soldatenfest in Stadtallendorf and is organized by TSV Stadtallendorf in cooperation with the German Armed Forces. The course is a loop through Heinz-Lang-Park and the adjacent stadium. Races are offered for various ability levels, including a 5-kilometer fun run and a 10-kilometer main race. These are followed by races for young people and children. The event attracts numerous athletes and offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, festive atmosphere.

name: Staffellauf der MBB-SG Augsburg
description: The 41st Augsburger Relay Race, organized by MBB SG Augsburg, takes place in the Siebentischwald forest in Augsburg. The event offers a relay marathon with three runners, each running a lap of 7,032.5 meters, as well as an individual half-marathon over 21.1 kilometers. The route is paved, flat, and fast, and runs mostly through the forest, creating ideal conditions for runners of all ability levels. There is also a recreational run of about 7 kilometers, particularly suitable for beginners. The course is well marked and designed as an out-and-back route.

name: Dörverden läuft 2026
description: The run in Dörverden is a versatile running event suitable for all ages and ability levels. The measured courses range from 1.8 km for walking and running to the 10 km main race, which consists of two 5 km laps. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes community sport in the Lower Saxony region. Races start in staggered intervals from 10:00 a.m., so every participant can find a suitable event.

name: Fränkische Schweiz-Marathon
description: The Fränkische Schweiz Marathon takes place in the picturesque landscape of Franconian Switzerland. The course runs from Neideck to Walberla, passing idyllic villages, castles, and rock formations. The car-free federal highway provides ideal running conditions. Tens of thousands of spectators and a varied supporting program give the event a festival atmosphere. The anniversary edition warmly invites runners of all ability levels to take part.

name: Glomb City Marathon Bremerhaven
description: The GLOMB City Marathon Bremerhaven is an annual marathon in Bremerhaven, held since 2005. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race. The course is a flat loop starting and finishing in front of the Bürgermeister-Smidt-Gedächtniskirche, and runs through the city center and Havenwelten. Runners enjoy an attractive route with many sights and a unique setting along the water and harbor facilities. The event is organized by the event agency Execute Sports Events, which ensures professional organization.

name: Vorkloster run (1. etapa)
description: Vorkloster Run is a stage race held in the picturesque foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands, amid the medieval atmosphere of Porta Coeli Monastery. The race features three stages of varying distances and profiles, from a fast, flat stage to more challenging hilly sections. It is organized by the experienced DálRunDál team in cooperation with the Porta Coeli Monastery Brewery, which adds to the authentic experience. The routes are carefully marked and run mostly away from traffic, offering beautiful views of the surrounding countryside and historic landmarks.

name: Ostrava City Marathon
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Moravská Ostrava, Ostrava, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ceny absolutního pořadí (ženy i muži) 1. 5.000,- Kč 2. 3.000,- Kč 3. 2.000,- Kč 4. 1.000,- Kč

tiers.description: Ceny absolutního pořadí (ženy i muži) 1. 4.000,- Kč 2. 3.000,- Kč 3. 2.000,- Kč 4. 1.000,- Kč

description: The Ostrava City Marathon is the oldest marathon in the Czech Republic. Every year, it brings a sporting atmosphere to the centre of Ostrava and connects the running world with the city’s industrial soul. It offers a wide range of race categories, from children’s races and relays to the classic marathon, making it suitable for competitive runners and recreational athletes alike. The running festival is open to everyone who wants to experience its unique atmosphere and support the charitable MiniMarathon. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, allowing runners and spectators to enjoy the centre of Ostrava in motion.
course_highlights: The marathon course runs through the historic centre of Ostrava
Refreshments along the course approximately every 5 km and at the finish
Accompanying programme and fitness activities with INDIVIDUAL FITNESS
additional: Race bibs are personalised according to the registered race distance. Electronic timekeeping is provided by non-refundable chips integrated into the race bib. Refreshments, toilets, showers, changing rooms and baggage storage are available for runners. Start times: marathon and half marathon at 09:00, relay at 09:20, children’s races from 09:45. The accompanying programme includes fitness activities with INDIVIDUAL FITNESS and a performance by Judo Club Baník Ostrava. The MiniMarathon has a charitable purpose. According to the organiser, the event takes place in all weather conditions and is accessible to people with disabilities.

name: Podčerchovský kros
description: The Podčerchovský Cross-Country Run is a challenging cross-country race held on Babí hora near Chodov. It follows forest paths with several tough climbs. The longest loop is 2.5 km and is also suitable for runners wearing spikes. The race is open to all age groups, with various distances ranging from children’s races to the men’s main event. Results are announced shortly after the race, and winners receive medals and prizes, with cash awards also offered in the main category.

name: Běh na Lahti
description: We invite you to the 47th edition of the traditional Běh na Lahti race, held in Děčín. The race offers two routes: the main route, nearly 10 km long with 230 meters of elevation gain, passing the Kvádrberk viewpoint and continuing above the village of Ludvíkovice, and a shortened route just under 5 km long with 130 meters of elevation gain. The route runs through the terrain of the Děčín forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River, offering beautiful views and a challenging run. Check-in and registration take place at the start site from 8:00 to 9:45. The race starts at 9:00.

name: Rychnov pomáhá během
description: Rychnov Helps Through Running is a charity race held in Rychnov nad Kněžnou, offering routes for children and adults in various age categories. The race takes place in early September and is known for its friendly atmosphere, accompanying program, and support for those in need. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, while the best runners in each category win valuable prizes. The event also includes an autograph session and a fun quiz with prizes, contributing to a family-friendly atmosphere and community spirit.

name: Běh mezi mosty
description: The Run Between the Bridges is a charity sporting event organized by the Athelas Home Hospice and the Friends of the Stone Bridge in Písek Association. Reviving the tradition of the original race, it is for everyone who wants to support seriously ill patients and their families. Participants can run, walk, or make a symbolic contribution. The entry fee is a donation that helps provide care at home for those who can no longer run. The event takes place in Písek and offers a variety of routes, including children’s runs and family walks.

name: Jihlavský půlmaraton
location: Sportovně relaxační centrum Český mlýn, Jihlava, Czech Republic
description: The Jihlava Half Marathon is a traditional 21.0975 km race run over two laps in the Český mlýn Sports and Recreation Centre in Jihlava. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of four, and the course is officially measured and marked every kilometre. In addition to the main race, the programme includes children’s races, a family run and a 10 km race. The event features a wide range of activities for the whole family and supports Nikča, who is facing serious health problems.
course_highlights: Officially measured 21.0975 km course over two laps (10.54 km each)
Refreshment stations approximately every 3 km with water and isotonic drinks
Start and finish at the Český mlýn Sports and Recreation Centre in Jihlava
additional: The race bib includes a timing chip that does not need to be returned. Relay teams receive a chip at registration and return it after the race. Registration and race bib collection take place at Decathlon Jihlava on the Friday before the race and at the start venue on race day. Refreshments are available on the course, with more at the finish, along with accompanying activities including sports and entertainment for children. Parking is recommended at the free car parks at Kaufland, OBI, Albert Hypermarket and Vodní ráj. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the venue. The 2027 edition takes place on 5 September, with the start scheduled for 11:00. The programme also includes the Decathlon 10 km race and a family run. The event facilities are at the Český mlýn complex.

name: Horský čtvrtmaraton Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch
description: The Jablonné nad Orlicí–Suchý vrch Mountain Quarter Marathon is a mountain race held in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The course runs through mountain terrain to Suchý vrch and is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Krkonoše Mountain Running Cup. The race covers approximately 10 km with around 580 metres of elevation gain. The course is demanding in terms of both endurance and running technique on mountain terrain. On-site registration is available, and the race is intended for runners looking for a challenge in nature.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 9. kolo
description: The Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. The race is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans, who are divided into categories. Registration takes place on-site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is part of a series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Cup based on their performance and age.

name: Dukelský beh mieru
location: Svidník, Svidník, Štart: Dukliansky priesmyk, Cieľ: pešia zóna Svidník
description: The Dukla Run for Peace is one of the oldest and most significant running events in Slovakia, held every year on the first Sunday in September. The route runs from Dukla to the centre of Svidník and is 19 kilometres long, descending from 479 m above sea level at the start to 244 m above sea level at the finish. Runners follow a historic route associated with the Carpathian-Dukla Operation, commemorating the victims and the struggle for peace in 1944–1945. The event has a rich history and strong emotional significance, bringing together competitive runners and amateurs.

name: VI Zarasų pusmaratonis
description: The VI Zarasai Half Marathon is a traditional running event held in Zarasai, at Sėlių Square. The event aims to promote running as a way to improve health and raise the profile of the Zarasai region. Participants can choose from several distances, including the half marathon, 10.5 km, 5 km, 1.2 km and 550 m runs, as well as relay races. The official start and finish are at Sėlių Square, and the routes run through the town, with refreshment stations along the way. The event is open to anyone who has checked their health and follows the rules.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course consists of 2 laps
Start and finish at Sėlių Square, in front of the municipal building
Course routes are publicly available at mappedometer.com
additional: Race bib distribution begins at 9:00 at Sėlių Square. The runners’ warm-up takes place at 11:00, followed by a welcome speech from the Mayor of Zarasai at 11:10. Time limits: half marathon — 3 hours; 10.5 km — 1 hour 30 minutes; 5 km — 60 minutes; 1.2 km — 15 minutes. The first 350 registered participants receive event T-shirts. There are several refreshment stations along the route with water and fruit. The regulations provide for water and fruit stations along the course. Nordic walking is also organized.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Srbsko
description: The Berounka Running Series in Srbsko is a community trail race run mostly along the Heart of the Bohemian Karst Nature Trail. The route starts at the railway station and passes over the Srbsko footbridge, by the Bubovice Waterfalls and through the Kačák Valley along the Berounka River to the finish. The race offers beautiful natural scenery, a friendly atmosphere, and on-site refreshments and storage for personal belongings. Each participant receives a race number, and the top three finishers in each category receive diplomas.

name: S kopečka do kopečka
description: The S kopečka do kopečka Run is a traditional endurance race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering runners the chance to test themselves on a challenging course in Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners series and is open to both recreational runners and competitive athletes. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for anyone looking to enjoy a run in beautiful surroundings and take on the challenge of hilly terrain.

name: Novostrašecký běh - Memoriál Vildy Šubrta
description: Novostrašecký běh – Vilda Šubrt Memorial is a traditional running race held in Nové Strašecí, featuring a 6 km course. The race takes place at the SK Nové Strašecí football stadium and in the surrounding area, on a mix of asphalt, field and forest paths. The main category is scheduled to start at 18:00. The race is suitable for the general public; adults pay an entry fee of 100 CZK, while children can take part for free. Online registration is available even on race day, making it easy to participate.

name: Geofyzikální běh
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Geophysical Run is a traditional running event organized by the Institute of Geophysics of the Czech Academy of Sciences. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4. The event has a long history dating back to 1985 and offers a sporting experience in nature with a scientific background. It is open to the general public and combines physical activity with the popularization of geophysics and the natural sciences.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 4 etapas
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event featuring cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling, and rogaining competitions. The event encourages active leisure in nature and promotes sport among participants of all ages. The competitions take place in Ukmergė, and the main organizer is the public institution Sportas miške. Participants compete by age group and event type, with a mass start for all groups. The time limit for the competitions is 120 minutes, except for Mini Rogaining.

name: 7. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Run for Health is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that everyone can complete at their own pace. Proceeds from entry fees go to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. The start is traditionally at 17:45 at Lodičky, with registration beginning at 17:00. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.

name: Witzenmann Opavská míle
description: The Witzenmann Opava Mile is a prestigious one-mile (1609 m) running race that continues the tradition of the Stanislav Mikeska Memorial. The race is open to a wide range of participants, including professionals, amateurs, children, families, corporate and school teams, people with disabilities, and wheelchair users. It takes place in Opava and is supported by its presenting partner, Witzenmann Opava. The course record is held by Filip Sasínek, with a time of 3:55 minutes set in 2023. The race is held regularly and is one of the most significant running events in the Czech Republic.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Liberec
description: The Night Run for Světluška in Liberec is a charity running event held at the Vesec sports complex. Participants can choose between a 3 km course (1 lap) and a 6 km course (2 laps), with the run starting at 20:00. The entry fee is CZK 500, half of which supports the Světluška project and half goes toward direct assistance for people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program, including a concert, and race packs with a headlamp or sports headband for those who register early.

name: Běh Akátkami
description: Běh Akátkami is a regular running race in Brno-Židenice, with courses for men, women, and children. Men run 5.2 km (3 laps), women 3.6 km (2 laps), and children of any age have their own 1.6 km lap. The race takes place in the evening, with registration from 17:15 and the main race starting at 18:00. Refreshments and baggage storage are available after the finish. Participants compete at their own risk and can use public transport and parking nearby.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026
distance_verbose: 159 km, 79 km, 56 km, Maraton, 24 km, Półmaraton, 10 km
description: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026 to górski bieg trailowy odbywający się w malowniczym otoczeniu Gór Stołowych, w okolicach Radkowskiego Jeziora. Trasy prowadzą przez skalne labirynty, techniczne szlaki i piękne formacje skalne, takie jak Szczeliniec Wielki i Błędne Skały. Impreza przyciąga zarówno początkujących, jak i doświadczonych ultramaratończyków, oferując różnorodne dystanse i wyjątkową atmosferę bliskości natury. Radków to idealne miejsce na sportową przygodę i regenerację wśród przyrody.

name: Ipsheimer Weinberglauf
location: Ipsheim, Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Ipsheim Vineyard Run is a traditional race held on the second Friday in September in the picturesque Ipsheim vineyards. It offers various events for schoolchildren and recreational runners, as well as the main race over a distance of approx. 5,800 m. The course is well marked and runs through the vineyards, offering a wonderful view of the Aisch Valley. After the race, participants can relax with refreshments and wine at the awards ceremony at the Weinberghaus. The race has become a sporting highlight, with almost 400 participants.
course_highlights: Race routes through the Ipsheim vineyards
Excellent views over the Aisch Valley in the finish area
Routes marked with colored arrows and distance markers
additional: Race number collection from 16:00 on race day in the start area below the Ipsheim vineyards. Race numbers must be worn on the front of the chest. All participants receive a high-quality technical T-shirt as a gift. Showers are available at the Ipsheim festival hall. Toilets are located in the start area and at the Weinberghaus. Free refreshments in the start area, during the main race, and at the finish. Clothing transport from the start to the finish for all races. Shuttle bus from the finish to the showers and the Weinberghaus, with shuttle service to the parking lot every half hour from 20:00. Parking at the start is available in a lit parking lot; parking in the vineyards is prohibited. Awards ceremony after the main race at the Weinberghaus, with wine and refreshments. Terrain in the vineyards, online registration, medals, T-shirts, refreshments, shuttle service, parking in Ipsheim

name: Emder Sparkassen Delftlauf
description: The Emder Sparkassen Delftlauf is a popular running event around the Emder Delft, held on a loop course approximately 2 kilometers long. Participants can choose between a 6-kilometer run or Nordic walking (3 laps), and a 10-kilometer run (5 laps).
