The event takes place in all weather and is open to everyone, including unaffiliated runners. Timing is recorded using a chip provided by the organizer. Certificates are awarded to the three fastest women and men, and are available online for all participants.
course_highlights: Loop course around the Emder Delft, approximately 2 kilometers long
6-kilometer run and Nordic walking over 3 laps
10-kilometer run over 5 laps
additional: Race materials can be collected from 16:00 on the event day at Restaurant Hafenhaus. Timing is recorded using a chip provided by the organizer, with results calculated by gun time. The event is sanctioned and held under the International Competition Rules (IWR). Certificates for all participants are available online.

name: Lauf der Bildung Aschersleben
description: The Lauf der Bildung in Aschersleben is a family-friendly city race on Friday evening, starting and finishing at Augustapromenade. The course passes through the historic city wall area and offers distances of 2.3 km, 4.6 km and 9.2 km for children, recreational runners and ambitious runners completing multiple laps. The event is part of the Solvay Cup and attracts both club runners and local families. The atmosphere is small and welcoming, and the event is well organised by the Kreisvolkshochschule Aschersleben.

name: Prajzské kilo
description: Prajzské kilo is an ultratrail race through the Hlučínsko region, recalling the historic borders and stories of a region divided in 1742. The race offers three distances—30, 50 and 100 km—with different time limits and elevation gains. You’ll run through a landscape of old roads, chapels and field tracks, bearing the traces of history and the identity of local residents. The race counts toward the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and also offers points for the UTMB Index and ITRA. Participants receive a unique medal and T-shirt, with refreshments along the course and at the finish. Childcare is available for the shorter distances.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny to ogólnopolska inicjatywa, która łączy sportowe emocje z realnym wsparciem ważnego celu społecznego - zdrowia psychicznego dzieci i młodzieży. Wydarzenie odbędzie się w całej Polsce, zachęcając uczestników do wspólnego biegu i działania na rzecz społeczności. Każde okrążenie, kilometr i minuta na trasie mają znaczenie, podkreślając ideę wspólnoty i pomocy. To jubileuszowa edycja, która zaprasza biegaczy do aktywnego udziału i wsparcia.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
description: Bieg 7 Dolin to górski ultramaraton na dystansie 100 km, odbywający się w malowniczym Beskidzie Sądeckim, ze startem i metą w Piwnicznej-Zdroju. Trasa prowadzi przez wymagające górskie szlaki z dużym przewyższeniem, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe widoki i kontakt z naturą. Zawody są częścią Festiwalu Biegów, który łączy sportową rywalizację z promocją regionu i aktywnym stylem życia. Limit czasu na pokonanie trasy wynosi 19 godzin, a na trasie znajdują się punkty żywieniowe i przepakowe. To wyzwanie dla doświadczonych biegaczy górskich, którzy chcą zmierzyć się z trudnym, ale pięknym terenem.

name: IX Bieg o Puchar Miasteczka Siewierz Jeziorna
description: IX Bieg o Puchar Miasteczka Siewierz Jeziorna to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w malowniczej miejscowości Siewierz. Zawody przyciągają biegaczy z różnych kategorii, oferując możliwość rywalizacji na trasach dostosowanych do różnych poziomów zaawansowania. To doskonała okazja do aktywnego spędzenia czasu na świeżym powietrzu i integracji z lokalną społecznością.

name: 5 Aktywna Piątka
location: Frydek, Gmina Miedźna, Silesian Voivodeship, Polska
description: Bieg Aktywna Piątka to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się we Frydku w Gminie Miedźna. Trasa o długości 5 km jest atestowana przez Polski Związek Lekkiej Atletyki, co gwarantuje jej dokładność i szybki charakter. W ramach biegu rozgrywane są Mistrzostwa Województwa Śląskiego w biegu ulicznym na 5 km. Wydarzeniu towarzyszy także Bieg Rodzinny skierowany do dzieci i młodzieży do lat 15, co czyni imprezę atrakcyjną dla całych rodzin.
course_highlights: Trasa asfaltowa o długości dokładnie 5 km z atestem PZLA
Trasa oznaczona co 1 km z punktem nawadniania i kurtynami wodnymi
Szybka i płaska trasa uliczna, start na ulicy Modowej 189C
additional: Limit uczestników biegu głównego wynosi 600 osób. W klasyfikacji OPEN nagradzanych jest 5 pierwszych miejsc kobiet i mężczyzn. Bieg rodzinny odbywa się na trzech dystansach dla dzieci i młodzieży do lat 15. Trasa biegu jest oznaczona co kilometr i wyposażona w punkty nawadniania oraz kurtyny wodne.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: Grand Prix Truchtacza w Mysłowicach to cykl biegów organizowanych przez Stowarzyszenie Truchtacz Mysłowice, promujący zdrowy i aktywny styl życia oraz integrację biegaczy na różnych poziomach zaawansowania. Imprezy odbywają się regularnie, tworząc społeczność wspierającą i inspirującą do ruchu. Zawody są otwarte dla wszystkich grup wiekowych i poziomów zaawansowania, a udział w Grand Prix jest bezpłatny. Organizatorzy kładą nacisk na radość z aktywności i wspólne motywowanie się do biegania.
course_highlights: Biegi przełajowe w Mysłowicach
Cykl składający się z kolejnych biegów i klasyfikacji
Lokalne zawody organizowane przez Truchtacz Mysłowice
additional: Zapisy do cyklu Grand Prix możliwe są wyłącznie w Biurze Zawodów w dniu biegu. Udział w zawodach z cyklu Grand Prix jest bezpłatny. Imprezy są otwarte dla każdego, niezależnie od poziomu zaawansowania i wieku.

name: Bieg przez Most – Białołęcka Triada Biegowa
II Ćwiartka Drzymały
location: Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Polska

name: Leszczyński Festiwal Sportu – Półmaraton Leszczyński C&C Partners
Orawski Półmaraton Rysim Tropem
location: Lipnica Wielka, Nowy Targ County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Polska

name: XIII Razem do Celu
location: Oleszka, Zdzieszowice Municipality, Opole Voivodeship, Polska

name: XVII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Sieroszewice
location: Sieroszewice, Sieroszewice Municipality, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Polska

name: XVIII Bieg Papieski
location: Służewo, Aleksandrów Kujawski County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Polska

name: Volvo Tierparklauf
description: The Volvo Tierparklauf takes place at Berlin Zoo and is especially family-friendly and suitable for beginner runners. The course runs through the zoo, past various animals such as monkeys and flamingos, and offers a unique atmosphere with free admission for participants and their companions. The event is part of the popular Berlin läuft! series and is known for its animal-themed atmosphere and comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: Course through Berlin Zoo with views of monkeys, flamingos and other animals
Free admission to the zoo for participants and their companions
Running festival for the whole family on the event grounds
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the shoe. Participants receive a comprehensive race pack, with refreshment points, toilets, an online certificate and free admission to the zoo. Groups of 15 or more receive a 10% discount and can collect their race packs together. Late entries are possible up to one hour before the start. Additional services such as event shirts, medal engraving and HD finish-line videos can be booked. Free admission, run through Berlin Zoo, family-friendly, course passes animals

name: Freiberger Herbstlauf
location: Platz der Einheit, Freiberg, Saxony, Germany
description: The Freiberger Autumn Run is a traditional race through Freiberg’s municipal forest, starting at 10:00 a.m. at Platz der Einheit. The varied program offers races for the whole family, including Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, distances from 2 km to the half marathon, a company relay, and the Einfach?Mensch!Lauf. The varied routes lead through the surrounding forests and include some climbs, making the race particularly appealing.
course_highlights: Route through Freiberg’s municipal forest
Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports venue
Varied routes with some climbs
additional: Activities for the whole family include Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, a company relay, and a one-wheel race. Distances range from 400 m to the half marathon. Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports venue. Multiple events include the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, children’s races, Nordic walking, a one-wheel race, and team competitions; the event takes place in the municipal forest and at Platz der Einheit.

name: Lauf in den Herbst
description: The Putzbrunn Autumn Run is a DLV-approved public race organized by the sports club’s gymnastics department. It offers running opportunities for all age groups and ability levels, with distances from 1.5 km to 10.7 km. A special feature is the inclusive nature of the race, which welcomes people with different abilities. Alongside sporting competition, the event emphasizes community and the fun of running.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, and 10.7 km
Inclusive race with participants from Lebenshilfe and Frame Runner
Age-group rankings and team rankings
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 12:00 at the Putzbrunn triple gymnasium. Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective race. Certificates will be handed out on site and made available as PDFs the following day. Special prizes are awarded to the fastest runners and the oldest participants. Refreshments and changing facilities are available on site. Courses are available for different age groups; registration by email; no advance registration required.

name: Schwarzenbacher Ausdauertag 2026
location: Sportzentrum Turnerheim, Schwarzenbach an der Saale, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Schwarzenbach Endurance Day offers a varied program of running and walking events for all age groups. From the Bambini Run and schoolchildren’s run to the Fun Run, 10 km run and half marathon, there is something for every ability level. The start and finish are at the Turnerheim Sports Center in Schwarzenbach an der Saale. Refreshment stations with water and bananas are available along the course and in the finish area. At the finish, participants can enjoy a buffet with fruit, water and cake. Timing is provided by a disposable chip in the race bib, except for the Fun Run and Bambini Run.
course_highlights: A variety of running and walking events for all age groups
Start and finish at the Turnerheim Sports Center
Refreshment stations with water and bananas along the course and at the finish
additional: The event takes place in the Upper Franconia region and offers a mix of running and walking courses as well as a family-friendly supporting program.

name: 10-Teiche-Marathon
description: The 10 Ponds Marathon in Hahnenklee is a scenic marathon held in September as part of the HarzerWanderWochen. The course takes runners through the Upper Harz, offering the chance to experience the region’s natural beauty and numerous ponds. The event is part of a ten-day hiking program featuring a variety of activities and live music. The marathon is a special challenge for runners who appreciate combining athletic achievement with enjoying nature.

name: 3. Wunstorfer Citylauf
description: The Wunstorf City Run is a running event in the city center of Wunstorf, organized by TuS Wunstorf. The race starts and finishes in front of the town church, which serves as the event hub. There are various distances, from a 400-meter Bambini run and several children’s and youth races to the 10-kilometer main race. The course is a 1,400-meter loop through the city center, run a different number of times or in a modified format depending on age group and distance. The City Run thus offers suitable races for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Fichtl-Fun-Run
description: The Fichtl-Fun-Run is an annual running event in Fichtenberg that is aimed particularly at children aged 6 to 11. Training for the run includes playful activities, running games, obstacle courses, and athletic exercises, held both outdoors and in the community hall. The event promotes community and enjoyment of sport in a family-friendly atmosphere. The run is organized by Sportkameradschaft Fichtenberg e.V., a long-established club with a wide range of sports.

name: Freisinger Volksfestlauf 2026
description: The Freising Volksfest Run takes place at the Volksfest grounds and in the adjacent Isar meadows, offering a varied course with a festival atmosphere. There are different distances for children and young people, as well as 5 km and 10 km main races. The races run mostly on gravel paths, with short sections of asphalt, and offer a special atmosphere as they pass right through the Volksfest. New glass trophies are awarded to every first-place finisher as a lovely tradition, and all participants receive attractive prizes and certificates.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Volksfest and the Isar meadows
Mostly gravel paths with short sections of asphalt
Loop course: 2 laps for 5 km and 4 laps for 10 km
additional: Payment is accepted exclusively by SEPA direct debit for online registration. There is a team competition, with 4 runners per team. Every adult receives a high-quality running cap; children receive a gingerbread-heart medal and a free water bottle. Every participant receives a voucher from sports freising for a water bottle, a towel or socks. The award ceremony takes place at around 17:00 in the beer tent, with awards presented by the mayor.

name: KlosterLauf Wiedenbrück
description: The KlosterLauf in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a special running event being held for the fourth time. The start and finish are at Wiedenbrück Monastery, and the races follow two scenic circular routes through the town. The event is for both ambitious runners and anyone who enjoys the camaraderie and fun of running. Community and the joy of running are at the heart of this sporting highlight.

name: Neubrandenburger Staffelmarathon (LC/NLC)
description: The Neubrandenburg Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay competition held in Neubrandenburg. The event is organized by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg e.V. and gives runners the opportunity to tackle the marathon distance together as teams. The start is at 9:30 a.m., and the event runs until around 2:30 p.m. The club’s running group organizes the event and looks forward to welcoming many participants.

name: Rudelsburglauf
description: The Rudelsburglauf is a long-standing running event along the Rudelsburg near Bad Kösen, organized by LG Rudelsburg 1995 Bad Kösen e.V. The race takes place annually and gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to experience the beautiful local region together. The event is a highlight in the club’s calendar and combines a sporting challenge with an experience of nature. Information about the race details and registration is published in good time before the event.

name: Run of Hope
description: The Run of Hope is an annual charity event in Kronach that brings together runners of all ages to fight cancer together. The event offers various distances, including Nordic walking and a fun run, and takes place on the LGS grounds in Kronach. Starting at 12:00, participants can enjoy a sporting yet supportive atmosphere made possible by generous sponsors and dedicated volunteers. The race combines athletic effort with social commitment and invites everyone to make a difference with every step.

name: Schledehausener Berglauf
description: The Schledehausener Berglauf is a 10-hour hill-running event in Schledehausen, part of Bissendorf, Germany. The race starts and finishes at the Schledehausen sports hall. The goal is to climb and descend a short hill as many times as possible, accumulating the most elevation gain within the time limit. The course is 700 metres long and has an elevation gain of 32 metres, with an average gradient of 10%. There are individual, relay and team categories. Omas on Tour organises the race as a charity event in support of HelpAge Deutschland e. V.

name: Spiegelsbergelauf
description: The Spiegelsbergelauf in Halberstadt offers varied running routes for all ability levels. The 14 km route passes over the Gläserner Mönch and, with its elevation gain and terrain, is a real challenge. The 8 km loop around the Jagdschlösschen combines speed and nature, while the 4 km route through the Spiegelsberge offers a relaxed introduction to racing. The youngest runners can take part in a 400 m fun run. The event is organized by SwimBikeRun Halberstadt e.V. and takes place at the Sportanlage Friedensstadion.

name: SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL
description: The SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL is a welcoming trail race in the beautiful surroundings of Suhl, celebrating its anniversary edition. The route follows some winding paths away from the main artery of the Thuringian Forest, past clear streams, dark valleys, and glistening ridgelines. The event offers an unforgettable experience in nature with spectacular views and is part of the SüHLER BÜCHSEN CUP. All finishers on the longer distances earn ITRA/UTMB® qualifying points.

name: ULTRAMARATHON DM im 100km-Straßenlauf
description: The 38th German 100 km Ultramarathon Championships will take place at Wartenberg Stadium in Berlin-Wartenberg. This road race is a demanding long-distance event that requires endurance and mental strength. The event is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and offers an official championship atmosphere under the auspices of the German Athletics Association. Participants can look forward to professional organization and an athletic challenge.

name: Unstrutlauf
description: The Unstrut Run is a versatile running event in Dingelstädt, offering suitable distances for all ability levels, from 2 km to the half marathon (21.1 km). The varied routes follow the Unstrut and feature scenic highlights, paved cycle paths and short climbs. Drinks, fruit and bratwurst are provided. All proceeds are donated to charitable projects in the region, giving the event a special social character.

name: Niedermeiserer Dorflauf
description: The Niedermeiser Village Run is a running event organized by TSV 1864 Niedermeiser e.V. and held in Liebenau/Niedermeiser. The races take place around Bodenberg, with distances ranging from 400 meters to 18.5 kilometers. Walking and Nordic walking events over various distances are also offered. The start and finish are at the sports ground in Niedermeiser, where race packets are also distributed. The event is approved by the Hessian Athletics Association and is conducted in accordance with the applicable regulations.

name: REHAmed Herkules-Berglauf
description: The REHAmed Herkules Mountain Run is a challenging mountain race through Wilhelmshöhe Mountain Park in Kassel, running almost entirely on paved natural trails. The course passes numerous landmarks, including Löwenburg and Steinhöfer Waterfall, and finishes at the Hercules Monument. The race is open to runners and walkers and offers both individual and three-person team relay categories, ideal for families, clubs and companies. Changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Reform School gym, and transport for clothing to the finish is arranged.

name: Okolo Kolovrat
description: The Run Around Kolovraty is a traditional race that takes you through the beautiful surroundings of Kolovraty, including the neighboring municipalities of Uhříněves and Lipany, as well as part of Říčany. It offers 11 km and 21 km routes, with the shorter distance also available as a two-person relay. The routes run mainly along tree-lined field, meadow, and forest paths, promising a wonderful running experience in nature. The race is suitable for all runners looking to improve their time or set a personal course record.

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
description: ČEZ RunTour Brno is a family-friendly running event held near the Brno Reservoir, offering courses for all ages, from children to experienced runners. Choose from distances of 500 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21.1 km). The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent facilities, and activities for the whole family. Every participant receives a race pack and contributes to charity. ČEZ RunTour is an ideal opportunity for recreational and elite runners alike to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of the Brno Reservoir.

name: Běh na Boží horu
description: The Run up Boží hora is a traditional race in Ivančice, challenging participants to climb 109 steps to Boží hora. Runners set off individually at one-minute intervals, ensuring a smooth race. The event is part of the wide range of activities organized by the Ivančice Leisure Centre, which has a long tradition and the support of the city. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a unique sporting experience in an attractive setting.

name: Běh Kovohutěmi
description: Běh Kovohutěmi is a traditional running race held in Lhota u Příbramě since 1967. The event features a 12 km main course as well as races for children and young people. It takes place at the TJ Kovohutě stadium and is popular with runners of all ages. Every year, it attracts many participants and is part of the Brdy Running Cup.

name: Strojařská desítka
location: Správa údržby silnic Zlínského kraje, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Strojařská desítka is a traditional road race in Zlín, now held for the 42nd year. The race offers 10 km and 5 km courses with 153 metres of elevation gain on a certified out-and-back route between Zlín’s Maják, the U Boudy crossroads, Salaš and back. The start is always at 10 a.m. by the headquarters of the Road Maintenance Administration on K Majáku Street. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all categories who want to compete in the beautiful surroundings of Zlín.

name: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Klenčí pod Čerchovem–Waldmünchen Friendship Run is part of the Běžec Chodska running series, which offers a diverse range of races in the Chodsko region. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem and attracts runners of all ages. The course is suitable for those who enjoy nature and trail running, while the race atmosphere encourages friendly gatherings among the running community. The Běžec Chodska series is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, ensuring an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Bezdězský půlmaraton
description: The Bezděz Half Marathon is a running race held in the picturesque Máchův kraj region around Bezděz Castle. It offers two routes of approximately 13.6 km and 21.2 km, with elevation gains of 200 to 300 metres, along forest roads, trails and short stretches of asphalt. The race is suitable for the general public and also includes children’s races. Refreshments, baggage storage, toilets, and an awards ceremony with a raffle are available at the venue. The field is limited to 500 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities.

name: 7 pohoří Krkonoše
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races offer technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. Whether you’re an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains will test your strength, willpower, and determination. Conquer all seven mountain ranges and become a trail-running legend.

name: Běh k Mohyle Hanče a Vrbaty
description: The Run to the Hanč and Vrbata Cairn is a traditional mountain race held in the Krkonoše Mountains. It starts at the White Bridge over the Elbe in Špindlerův Mlýn and finishes at the Hanč and Vrbata Cairn. The 9 km route, with 696 metres of elevation gain, runs mostly on asphalt and trails, offering beautiful views and unforgettable experiences. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners across different age categories. After the race, refreshments and a raffle are available, and public transport can be used to return from the finish.

name: ČEZ RunTour Ostrava
location: Dolní oblast Vítkovice, Ostrava, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: Dětské závody Lupilu 500 m a 1000 m

description: ČEZ RunTour Ostrava is part of a popular running series offering races for all ages and ability levels. Runners can choose from distances ranging from children’s races to 3, 5 and 10 km, as well as a half marathon. The event takes place in the unique setting of the Lower Vítkovice area and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a wide range of activities. Every participant receives a race pack and contributes to charity. ČEZ RunTour is ideal for recreational and elite runners alike who want to enjoy running and high-quality service.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km courses in the unique industrial setting of the Lower Vítkovice area
Children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres, with supervised childcare in the kids’ corner
Aid stations on the 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon courses; an official gymsack with gifts
additional: A medical team and pacers are available at the race to help runners achieve their target times. All races, including the children’s races, have refreshments at the finish. Children can enjoy a supervised kids’ corner and warm-up sessions. Running shoes can be borrowed at the event from a partner. The race pack contains gifts from partners, and children receive a special pack from Lidl. The programme also includes children’s races over 500 and 1,000 m.

name: Nočný beh mestom Lučenec
description: The Night Run Through Lučenec is a night race along the illuminated streets of Lučenec, covering a distance of 4.5 km. The event is open to the general public, including juniors and adults, with categories by age and gender. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad and takes place near the Synagogue, with electronic timing and chip technology. The start is scheduled for 19:30. Participants can expect a commemorative medal, a race number, refreshments, and an accompanying program.

name: Školáčik detský beh
description: Školáčik Children’s Run is a running event for children of various age groups, held in Lučenec near the synagogue. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad. The race is open to boys and girls aged 3 to 15 inclusive, including children with disabilities. The entry fee is symbolic and encourages children to take part in sports activities in the pleasant surroundings of the city.

name: Beh okolo Lysej
location: Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, pri kultúrnom dome
description: Beh okolo Lysej is a traditional running race in the village of Lysá pod Makytou, offering various categories for children, juniors, women, and men by age. The race takes place by the cultural centre and is organised by Bežecký klub Lysá pod Makytou. The children’s start is at 11:00, categories E, women, and juniors start at 12:30, and men start at 13:00. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky
description: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky is a night trail race in the beautiful wine-growing region of Topoľčianky. Runners will enjoy routes passing the Château Topoľčianky and Hrušov Castle, with forest paths and an atmosphere beneath the stars. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the international UTMB Index, adding to its prestige. There are two main distances: 11 km and 22 km. The course also features the Conti Speed Section, a timed segment with a valuable prize.

name: Marina Liptov RUN
location: Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Marina Liptov
organizer: Olympijský klub Liptova a rezort Marina Liptov
description: Marina Liptov RUN is a sports and leisure event set in the beautiful surroundings of the Marina Liptov resort near Liptovská Mara. This unique run combines nature with quality services in harmony with the four elements—fire, water, earth, and air. Runners can enjoy a peaceful and inspiring setting with views of the surrounding countryside and the chance to relax at the resort after the race. Marina Liptov is an ideal destination for athletes and families looking for an outdoor experience.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 3. Jesenné kolo
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany
description: The Lemešany Running League – 3rd Autumn Round is a running competition held in the village of Lemešany, in the beautiful surroundings of the Garden of Movement. The race is open to all age groups and ability levels, offering a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to enjoy sports outdoors. It is organised by the Garden of Movement, which provides quality facilities for sport and recreation.

name: Beh pre Labky jesenný špeciál
location: Košice, Košice, Košice - časť Kavečany, chata Hrešná
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: The Run for Paws Autumn Special is a running event in Kavečany, Košice, near Hrešná Cottage, organised by the Union for Mutual Assistance of People and Dogs (UVP). The race is open to various categories, including women, men, children, and runners with dogs, including shelter dogs. The 5 km course offers a pleasant autumn atmosphere surrounded by nature. Registration is available online at a discounted price and on site for a higher fee. The event supports dog adoption and brings runners and animals together in a friendly setting.

name: Night run Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, R M s.r.o.
description: Night Run Michalovce is a night running race held at Námestie osloboditeľov in Michalovce. The race offers three distances: 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km, suitable for different age groups and performance levels. The adult race starts at 19:00, and the children’s races begin at 17:00. The organizers are Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, and R M s.r.o. The race is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the city at night.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: II Złotowska Dziesiątka to uliczny bieg na dystansie 10 km, który odbywa się w Złotowie. Trasa składa się z dwóch pętli po 5 km każda, prowadząc przez malownicze ulice miasta. Impreza jest doskonałą okazją dla miłośników biegania do aktywnego spędzenia czasu i rywalizacji w przyjaznej atmosferze. Organizatorzy dbają o bezpieczeństwo uczestników oraz sprawną organizację wydarzenia.
course_highlights: Trasa składa się z dwóch pętli po 5 km każda
Bieg uliczny w centrum Złotowa
Malownicze widoki i bezpieczne warunki na trasie
additional: Bieg odbywa się na dwóch pętlach po 5 km. Organizator zapewnia współpracę ze służbami dla bezpieczeństwa biegaczy, pieszych i kierowców. Biuro ZCAS mieści się przy al. Mickiewicza 18 w Złotowie.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
description: Tor Poznań Track Day to cykl emocjonujących wydarzeń motoryzacyjnych odbywających się na torze wyścigowym w Poznaniu. Uczestnicy mają okazję do sportowej rywalizacji, treningów oraz eliminacji w różnych rundach rozgrywanych w sezonie 2026. Impreza jest skierowana do miłośników motoryzacji, oferując także możliwość wynajmu samochodów i indywidualnych szkoleń z instruktorami. To doskonała okazja, by poczuć sportowe emocje i doskonalić swoje umiejętności na profesjonalnym torze.
course_highlights: Tor wyścigowy w Poznaniu z profesjonalną infrastrukturą
Możliwość udziału w różnych rundach i eliminacjach sezonu 2026
Opcje treningów i indywidualnych szkoleń z instruktorami
additional: Możliwość wynajmu samochodu na tor dla siebie lub na prezent. Pakiet startowy zawiera udział członka zespołu, możliwość co-drive (wiek >17 lat), pełne wyżywienie, indywidualny pomiar czasu oraz opcje szkolenia z instruktorem. Wpłaty za uczestnictwo muszą zawierać odpowiednią formułę tytułu, aby potwierdzić udział.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
description: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w Środzie Wielkopolskiej. Wydarzenie łączy sportową rywalizację z integracją środowiska prawniczego regionu. Bieg przyciąga zarówno profesjonalistów, jak i amatorów, oferując wyjątkową atmosferę i możliwość aktywnego spędzenia czasu na świeżym powietrzu. Zapisy na bieg ruszają, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na dobrze zorganizowaną imprezę z wieloletnią tradycją.
course_highlights: Trasa przebiega przez malownicze tereny Środy Wielkopolskiej
Bieg łączy elementy rywalizacji i integracji środowiska prawniczego
Organizowany corocznie z wieloletnią tradycją

name: XRUN - Vistula Trail
description: Vistula Trail to górski bieg trailowy organizowany w Wiśle, oferujący różnorodne dystanse od krótkich tras dla początkujących po wymagające długie dystanse. Trasy prowadzą przez malownicze beskidzkie szlaki, z dużą ilością przewyższeń i pięknymi widokami. Zawody odbywają się w przyjaznej atmosferze, zachęcając zarówno doświadczonych biegaczy, jak i amatorów do aktywnego spędzenia czasu na świeżym powietrzu. Start i meta zlokalizowane są w centrum Wisły lub w Ustroniu, a limit czasowy pozwala na komfortową rywalizację.
course_highlights: Dystans 40 km z przewyższeniem 1800 m, start o 07:00 w Wiśle
Trasa 16 km z przewyższeniem 1000 m, start przy dolnej stacji Czantoria Rope Ski Resort
Krótsze dystanse 6 km i 4 km z wymagającymi podejściami i dynamicznymi zbiegami
additional: Limit czasowy na trasie 40 km to 9 godzin, na 26 km 7 godzin, na 16 km 4 godziny. Starty odbywają się w niedzielę 12.09.2027, z wyjątkiem dystansu 4 km, który startuje w sobotę o 13:00. Trasy prowadzą przez rezerwat Czantoria i okolice góry Bukowa. Kategorie wiekowe dla dzieci obejmują dystanse od 150 do 1000 m. Biuro zawodów znajduje się w Wiśle.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: 16. Bieg Częstochowski to uliczna impreza biegowa, która odbędzie się w centrum Częstochowy. Trasa o długości 10 km prowadzi przez reprezentacyjne arterie miasta, w tym okolice Jasnej Góry, co nadaje biegowi wyjątkowego prestiżu. Bieg posiada oficjalną atestację, przyciągając zawodników nastawionych na szybkie tempo i poprawianie rekordów życiowych. To doskonała okazja do sportowej rywalizacji w malowniczym miejskim otoczeniu.
course_highlights: Trasa 10 km przez centrum Częstochowy
Przebieg w okolicach Jasnej Góry
Oficjalna atestacja trasy
additional: Dostępny jest strukturalny plan treningowy dostosowany do dystansu 10 km.

name: Bieg na Skałę
description: Bieg na Skałę to wyjątkowe wydarzenie sportowe łączące aktywność fizyczną z pięknem przyrody malowniczego regionu. Trasa biegu prowadzi przez urokliwe ścieżki i pagórki Ojcowskiego Parku Narodowego, oferując uczestnikom niesamowite widoki i zróżnicowany teren, w tym leśne ścieżki, kamieniste odcinki oraz strome podbiegi. Bieg jest wyzwaniem zarówno dla doświadczonych biegaczy, jak i okazją dla początkujących, by poczuć ducha przygody i cieszyć się świeżym powietrzem. Po biegu uczestników czekają pamiątkowe medale, nagrody oraz liczne atrakcje, w tym zabawy i konkursy dla dzieci.
course_highlights: Trasa przez Ojcowski Park Narodowy z pięknymi widokami
Zróżnicowany teren: leśne ścieżki, kamieniste odcinki, strome podbiegi
Atrakcje dla dzieci: dmuchane zamki, animatorzy, konkursy z nagrodami
additional: Dostępne są trzy dystanse biegowe: Bieg po Pstrąga Ojcowskiego (8 km) z klasyfikacją drużynową i nagrodą dla najlepszego mieszkańca gminy Skała, Bieg Szlakiem Skał i Dolin (15 km) również z klasyfikacją drużynową i nagrodą dla najlepszego mieszkańca gminy, oraz biegi dziecięce na dystansach 100 m (2-5 lat, bez klasyfikacji), 800 m (10-11 lat) i 1300 m (12-15 lat). Cała impreza odbywa się w przyjaznej, sportowej atmosferze.

name: Chyża 10
description: XII Chyża Dziesiątka to popularny bieg na 10 km organizowany przez Nowotomyski Klub Biegacza Chyży w Nowym Tomyślu. Trasa jest szybka i lubiana przez uczestników, a bieg odbywa się w przyjaznej atmosferze, zaliczany jest także do Grand Prix Powiatu Nowotomyskiego. Start biegu zaplanowano na godzinę 9:00, co sprzyja komfortowym warunkom do rywalizacji. Organizatorzy serdecznie zapraszają biegaczy na to wydarzenie, które łączy sportową pasję z lokalną społecznością.
course_highlights: Trasa szybka i lubiana przez biegaczy
Bieg na dystansie 10 km w Nowym Tomyślu
Zaliczany do Grand Prix Powiatu Nowotomyskiego
additional: Biuro zawodów otwarte od 07:00 do 08:30 w dniu biegu. Dekoracje zwycięzców o godzinie 10:45. Bieg współfinansowany przez Gminę Nowy Tomyśl i Powiat Nowotomyski.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Północy XI Maraton Bieg Czterech Latarni
location: Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Polska
description: Festiwal Biegowy Północy to wyjątkowa impreza biegowa odbywająca się na Półwyspie Helskim, łącząca tradycję z nową energią. Zawody obejmują maraton, półmaraton, biegi na 10 km i 5 km oraz bieg dla dzieci i młodzieży - Bieg Małego Latarnika. Trasa biegu prowadzi przez malownicze miejsca Helu, Jastarni i Rozewia, a uczestnicy mają okazję biec w otoczeniu czterech latarni morskich, co czyni ten bieg unikalnym w Polsce. To doskonała propozycja dla biegaczy na każdym poziomie zaawansowania, którzy chcą połączyć sport z pięknem nadmorskiej przyrody.
course_highlights: Trasa biegnie wzdłuż Zatoki Puckiej z widokiem na morze
Przebiega przez cztery latarnie morskie: Hel, Jastarnia, dwie w Rozewiu
Malownicze krajobrazy Półwyspu Helskiego i wybrzeża
additional: Sztafety maratońskie zostały odwołane z powodu zbyt małej liczby zgłoszeń. Trasa maratonu dostępna jest w formatach GPX, KML i TCX do pobrania. Możliwość korzystania z Karty Mieszkańca Gminy Władysławowo na zniżki startowe. Bieg Małego Latarnika przeznaczony dla dzieci i młodzieży do 14 lat.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: XV DAMAK Tarczyn Półmaraton to rodzinne święto biegania, które odbywa się w Tarczynie. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na atestowaną trasę o długości półmaratonu, doskonałą atmosferę oraz sportowe emocje w przyjaznym, rodzinnym klimacie. To wydarzenie przyciąga biegaczy z różnych środowisk, oferując niezapomniane wrażenia i wspólnotę pasjonatów biegania.
course_highlights: Atestowana trasa półmaratonu o długości 21,097 km
Rodzinny klimat i doskonała atmosfera biegu
Sportowe emocje i integracja biegaczy
additional: Biuro zawodów mieści się przy ul. Szarych Szeregów 8 w Tarczynie. Wydarzenie odbywa się corocznie we wrześniu, start o godzinie 10:00. W ramach imprezy organizowany jest także Bieg Tarczyński na 5 km oraz biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
description: Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie "Biegiem Radom!". Bieg odbywa się na malowniczych trasach Puszczy Kozienickiej w okolicach Jedlni-Letnisko, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe doświadczenie w otoczeniu natury. Impreza ma charakter integracyjny i promuje zdrowy styl życia oraz aktywność fizyczną w duchu trzeźwości. Tradycja maratonu sięga wielu lat, a organizatorzy dbają o przyjazną atmosferę i profesjonalną organizację.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi przez Puszczę Kozienicką
Malownicze leśne ścieżki i naturalne otoczenie
Bieg odbywa się w okolicach Jedlni-Letnisko
additional: Możliwość personalizacji medali za symboliczną opłatą 10 zł podczas imprezy. Organizator to Stowarzyszenie "Biegiem Radom!", które promuje bieganie i aktywność fizyczną w regionie. Impreza ma charakter leśnego crossu i odbywa się tradycyjnie we wrześniu.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów w Biegu to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Żyrardowskie Towarzystwo Cyklistów, która odbędzie się 12 września 2027 roku. Zawody obejmują dwa dystanse: bieg główny na 10 km oraz bieg towarzyszący na 5 km, które prowadzą wokół Zalewu Żyrardowskiego. Trasa jest płaska i składa się z okrążeń wokół zalewu, co zapewnia malownicze widoki i sprzyja szybkim czasom. Uczestnicy otrzymują numery startowe z chipami, a w biegu na 10 km mogą startować także zawodnicy na aktywnych wózkach inwalidzkich. Impreza promuje aktywność fizyczną oraz przyjazną atmosferę sportową w mieście Żyrardów.
course_highlights: Trasa wokół Zalewu Żyrardowskiego
4 okrążenia na dystansie 10 km, 2 okrążenia na dystansie 5 km
Płaska i malownicza trasa sprzyjająca szybkim wynikom
additional: Numery startowe z chipem odbierane są w biurze zawodów w dniu startu. Baza imprezy (start, meta, parking) znajduje się przy Zalewie Żyrardowskim, ul. Ziołowa 17.

name: 32. Międzynarodowy Bieg Uliczny o Puchar Przewodniczącego Rady Miejskiej
Biegaj razem z nami
location: Zebrzydowice, Cieszyn County, Silesian Voivodeship, Polska

name: II Bieg Tropem Wilka
location: Korpele, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Polska

name: III Palmirski Bieg Pamięci Janusza Kusocińskiego
XII Bieg Marchewkowy
location: Zielonki, Kraków County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Polska

name: XVIII Bieg o Puchar Burmistrza Miasta i Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie
location: Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Polska

name: XX EKO Bieg po Dolinie Będkowskiej
Internationaler Altenaulauf
description: The International Altenaulauf in Borchen is a long-standing race organized by SC Borchen 1926/32, Athletics Department. Held annually, the race is part of the Hochstift-Cup. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also supports a social cause: coffee and cake are offered free of charge, and donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels an appealing opportunity to take part.
course_highlights: Part of the Hochstift-Cup
A variety of distances for different age groups
A traditional race with a social commitment
additional: Coffee and cake are offered free of charge at the cake counter. Runners can register for distances online; the event also includes social activities such as coffee and cake, as well as donations for “Aktion Lichtblicke e.V.”

name: 6. DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused extreme experience in the wooded Deister hills near Springe. The event offers running and walking routes of 10 km, 21.1 km (half marathon) and 42.2 km (marathon), with challenging climbs, including the Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with aid stations, places to sit and filled rolls for walkers. The event is all about consideration for others and enjoying nature, with awards for the fastest runners and a finisher’s gift as a souvenir.
course_highlights: Deisterhölle with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch
Marathon walk with an additional climb to Bielstein and the Deister ridge
Aid stations with places to sit and filled rolls
additional: Race bib collection from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. Chip timing with a rental chip; return the chip to receive a wheat beer glass as a finisher’s gift. Showers and changing rooms in the IGS Springe sports hall. Parking at IGS, netto and BZE. Travel by S5 to Springe station, then a 10-minute walk to the Nord school centre. Awards ceremonies: 10 km and half marathon at 12:00, marathon at 14:30. Sew-on patches for walkers. Trail event with challenging terrain, refreshments at aid stations, and options for runners and walkers.

name: Braker hkk Lauf
description: The 19th Braker hkk Run takes place in Brake (Unterweser). It is a short running event with distances of 850 meters and 10 kilometers. The race offers an enjoyable running opportunity in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. Please check the exact event details directly with the organizer.
course_highlights: Distances: 850 m and 10 km
Typical September weather with approximately 19°C and 45 mm of precipitation
Start location in Brake (Unterweser)
additional: The race includes two distances: 850 meters and 10 kilometers. September weather is typically mild and cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event usually takes place in comfortable temperatures of around 19°C. Participants should check the latest details with the organizer before registering.

name: Kiel Lauf
description: The Kiel.Lauf is a long-established running event in Kiel, with various competitions for all age groups. The main event is the half marathon, covering 21.1 kilometers through western Kiel and attracting both recreational runners and elite athletes. The 10.2-kilometer fun run is the event’s largest race by participation and offers a lap through Kiel city center with a great atmosphere. There are also shorter races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: The half marathon runs across western Kiel
The fun run goes through Kiel city center
A range of distances from approx. 0.7 km to 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon starts at 10:50 a.m. and the fun run at 09:45 a.m. Due to construction work, short-notice course changes may occur and will be announced in good time. The event is very popular, with more than 10,000 runners. There are various races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly. The event includes street closures and participant information, and offers technical running shirts for most categories.

name: Meißner Berglauf mit Hess. Meisterschaft
description: The Meißner Mountain Run with the Hessian Championships is a traditional mountain race in the Werra-Meißner district, organized by Ski-Club Meißner. The course runs through the scenic countryside around Meißner-Abterode and offers runners a challenging route with varied terrain. The event attracts both competitive athletes and running enthusiasts from the region and is part of the North Hesse Running Cup standings.
course_highlights: A challenging mountain-running course in the Werra-Meißner district
Varied terrain with scenic sections
Part of the North Hesse Running Cup standings
additional: The Meißner Mountain Run is part of the Nordhessencup, a series of races held in North Hesse. The event is organized by Ski-Club Meißner, which also offers other sports activities, including athletics, a running group, and skiing.

name: Othaler Gutshof Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Othaler Gutshoflauf is a young but popular running event starting and finishing at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal. The event offers distances ranging from 0.5 km to the 21.1 km half marathon, which is known as the Intersport Liebig Half Marathon and passes through several villages. The race gives participants the chance to explore the eastern foothills of the Harz on varied routes. Around 350 runners take part each year, highlighting the event’s growing popularity.
course_highlights: Half marathon route through Sotterhausen, Holdenstedt, Klosterrode and Beyernaumburg
Start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal
Distances ranging from 0.5 km to 21.1 km
additional: Start times: 09:00 half marathon, 09:45 10 km run/walk, 10:00 5 km run/walk, 10:05 0.5 km run, 10:15 1 km run, 10:30 2 km children’s race. Routes for children, recreational runners and competitive runners; start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm in Othal; supported by sponsors such as Intersport Liebig and Autohaus Liebe.

name: Rathaus Center Dessauer CityRUN
description: The 26th Dessauer Rathaus-Center CityRUN is a long-standing race in downtown Dessau that has attracted runners from the region and beyond for many years. The route follows a circuit through the city’s central streets, with the start and finish on Zerbster Straße near the Rathaus-Center. The race offers a sporting challenge in an urban setting and is part of a varied sports programme organised by Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising major sporting events in the region for decades.
course_highlights: Circuit through downtown Dessau
Start and finish on Zerbster Straße at the Rathaus-Center
Route along Steinstraße, Askanische Straße and Kavalierstraße
additional: Volksbank children’s race for children up to 9 years old over 1,000 metres, free for all children and schoolchildren from Dessau. The organiser is Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising numerous major sporting events in the region for over 20 years. Various distances, including children’s races; company race; on-site registration available; finisher medals

name: Sindiso-Spendenlauf
location: Hof von Walter Jahn, Zeitlarn, Bavaria, Germany
price_range: 20 Euro für Laufshirt, Spenden ab 20 Euro für Teilnahme
description: The Sindiso Charity Run in Zeitlarn is a community event that brings together running, celebration, and fundraising. The event takes place at Walter Jahn’s farm and offers races for all ages, as well as a colorful festival with lots of attractions for children. Alongside the sporting experience, supporting the education project in Rabuor, Kenya, is a key focus. Food and drinks are available, and there is a variety of entertainment, including a children’s train, face painting, and vehicle displays.
course_highlights: 10 km run consisting of 2 laps of 5 km each
Attractions for children, including a children’s train and face painting
Vehicle display by Wasserwacht Neutraubling, Freiwillige Feuerwehr Laub, and BRK Barbing/Neutraubling
additional: The Sindiso running shirt can be purchased for €20 on race day after ordering through the online registration. There are races for different age groups and disciplines, including a 400 m farm run for toddlers, a 1.5 km children’s race, a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and 5 km Nordic walking. The event kicks off with a big party from 11:00 and offers a variety of food and refreshments, as well as a colorful program of activities. 10 km run (2 x 5 km), family activities, children’s program, vehicle display, donations for an education project in Kenya

name: Volksbank-Münster-Marathon
description: The Volksbank-Münster-Marathon is a major running event organized by runners for runners, largely by volunteers and with great dedication. With around 12,000 participants, more than 300 artists and bands, and over 100,000 spectators along the course, this autumn marathon offers a unique atmosphere. The course is almost entirely flat and runs through the running- and cycling-friendly city of Münster. A red carpet is rolled out in the finish area on Prinzipalmarkt, making the finish a special experience.
course_highlights: Almost entirely flat course
More than 300 artists and bands along the course
Finish on a red carpet at Prinzipalmarkt
additional: The marathon is part of a major event featuring several races, including the Atruvia Staffelmarathon, Wecker-28 (28 km), Stadtwerke-Kids Marathon, Westfalen AG Charity-Lauf (10 km), and H+B technics-Gesundheitslauf (6 km). There is a combined ranking with the Enschede Marathon. The marathon office is open on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9:00 to 15:00. A marathon guide with general information and FAQs is available. The marathon attracts around 12,000 runners, offers qualification opportunities for other races, and is supported by numerous sponsors. There are also accompanying events such as talks and health seminars.

name: Waldlauf des TuS Calle-Wallen - Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup
description: The 46th TuS Calle-Wallen Forest Run is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Running Cup and takes place in Meschede. The event offers 1 km and 10 km races and is open to runners of all ages. The race route passes through the wooded areas around Meschede and promises a varied course in a natural setting. Typical September weather is mild and mostly cloudy, ideal for running events.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded areas around Meschede
Distances of 1 km and 10 km
Natural and varied running course
additional: Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with lows of about 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are mostly cloudy. The event takes place in Meschede, with typical temperatures around 19 °C and cloudy skies. It is a great opportunity for the whole family to take part in a traditional race.

name: Wemdinger Stadtlauf
description: The Wemding City Run invites runners of all ages to explore Wemding’s historic old town and the scenic countryside on the edge of the Ries. A special highlight is the panoramic run to the Maria Brünnlein pilgrimage church, combining sporting challenges with impressive views. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and welcomes both experienced runners and beginners. Timing is handled electronically using transponders in the race bibs, and an awards ceremony takes place on the stage at the market square.
course_highlights: Run through Wemding’s historic old town
Panoramic run to the Maria Brünnlein pilgrimage church, with views across the Ries
Start and finish at the market square in the town centre
additional: Race-pack collection and late entries are available on the event day until 30 minutes before each start at the race office in the Geopark Information Centre at the market square. The children’s run has no timing or results list; all children’s and school races receive medals. Timing for the other races is handled using transponders in the race bibs. Parking is available at Johannisweiher, with access via Wolferstädter Straße. Various race distances, medals, non-cash prizes, group prizes, children’s and school races, group training before the event.

name: 17. Parklauf Tangerhütte
description: The 17th Park Run Tangerhütte takes place in the idyllic Tangerhütte City Park and is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP race series in the north of Saxony-Anhalt. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 1.1 km for young runners, 2.9 km for youth, and 5.4 km and 10.3 km for adults. The routes pass around Spiegelsee and by sights such as the New Palace and the Mausoleum. In the finish area, SV Germania Tangerhütte provides refreshments for participants, including grilled food, drinks, fruit, coffee, and cake.

name: 21. swb-Marathon Bremen
description: The 21st swb-Marathon Bremen is taking place, offering runners a varied running experience through Bremen. The start and finish are at Bremen’s Market Square. The course passes well-known sights including Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron-Park, the University, Bürgerpark, Überseestadt and Schlachte, and ends with a run through the Weserstadion. In addition to the marathon, there is also an AOK half marathon, a HIRSCH 10K race and an AOK children’s race. The event is aimed at both beginners and experienced runners and promises an unforgettable day of sport, with a great atmosphere and support from spectators.

name: 43. Internationalen Airport Race
description: The 43rd International Airport Race in Hamburg is taking place, offering a varied running experience around Hamburg Airport. The 10-mile race traditionally starts at 11:00 a.m. at the LSV sports grounds on Borsteler Chaussee. In addition to the main 10-mile race, there are also 5 km events and the Mini Airport Race. The unique airport setting offers ever-changing views and a special atmosphere.

name: DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused endurance event that combines running and walking in the outstanding natural surroundings of the forested Deister mountain range. The event offers 10 km, 21.1 km, and 42.2 km courses for runners and walkers. The challenging routes pass through the Deisterhölle, including a continuous 200-meter elevation gain, and offer a unique nature and mountain experience near Hanover. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with participants looking out for one another, and offers aid stations, finisher gifts, and an awards ceremony in addition to the sporting challenge.

name: Dübener Heidelauf
description: The Dübener Heide Run is a traditional forest race held at the scenic Obermühle in Bad Düben, a spa town in northern Saxony. The event is organized by SV Bad Düben and offers courses for children, teenagers, and adults. With distances ranging from 500 m to the half marathon (21.1 km), the race appeals to both young runners and experienced long-distance athletes. It is part of the regional athletics structure for northern Saxony and Leipzig and is known for its family-friendly, club-oriented character.

name: ebm-papst Marathon
description: The ebm-papst Marathon in Niedernhall is a long-standing running event taking place for the 29th time. The event offers various disciplines, including the marathon, half marathon, duo marathon, relay marathon, 10 km run, handbike and inline skating races, as well as children’s races and Nordic walking. The course runs through the region’s scenic countryside and offers a varied experience for runners of all abilities. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied program of events featuring a show, childcare and a pasta party. Every finisher receives a medal and can download a free finish-line photo.

name: Eicklinger Volks- und Familielauf
description: The 1st Eicklingen Community and Family Run is aimed at active families who want to spend an enjoyable day running together. The focus is on fun and the joy of running, without the pressure of competition. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for all age groups and encourages people to get active together.

name: Garbenteicher Volkslauf
description: The Garbenteich Volkslauf, organized by Sportverein 1928 Garbenteich e.V., is a traditional race in Pohlheim, known as a good training run for the Frankfurt Marathon. The course has been optimized for safety, so it no longer crosses any federal highways or railway lines. There are seven refreshment stations offering water, cola and tea, and excellent refreshments await participants after the race. Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 08:00 or the day before at the Sport- und Kulturhalle Garbenteich.

name: Holzlandlauf
description: The Holzlandlauf is a traditional race in the Holzland region near Hermsdorf, held every year on the second Saturday in September. Starting in 2026, the race will be part of the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), giving the courses international recognition and making runners’ performances visible worldwide. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 11 km and a half marathon, through the beautiful natural landscape of the Holzland. The race welcomes both ambitious trail runners and recreational runners and offers a special atmosphere in the region.

name: Kristall Lauf Weißwasser
description: The Kristall-Lauf Weißwasser is a versatile popular race that welcomes runners and walkers of all ages. The course crosses mixed terrain, including asphalt, concrete, sand paths and forest trails with roots. The race is part of several regional competitions, including the Bezirksrangliste Dresden, the Sachsenenergie Läufer-Cup and the Niederlausitz-Cup. It also offers an official walking competition recognized by the German Athletics Association. A special feature is the traditional team race, which encourages community and team spirit.

name: Miltenberger Landkreis Lauftag
description: The Miltenberg District Running Day offers a variety of races for different age and ability groups. The routes pass through the Elsenfeld State Forest and along the former Spessart steam railway line, with scenic, mostly flat sections. All participants receive T-shirts, and the top runners are awarded prizes in kind. The event is ideal for runners looking for a well-organized race in a natural setting.

name: Run for life
description: The race starts at 2:00 p.m. in the forecourt of the Bavarian National Museum in Munich and follows a well-known route through the English Garden. The event is under the patronage of Munich’s Lord Mayor, Dominik Krause, and combines sporting commitment with social engagement.

name: runroll City
description: The runroll City event takes place in Bielefeld and offers a fast-paced sporting experience on a flat, 7.2-kilometer course through the heart of the city. The course is ideal for fast times and is suited to both intensive running training and a quick race. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban setting and become part of a dynamic event.

name: Zeuthener Jedermannslauf
description: The Zeuthen Jedermannslauf is a popular community run held every September in Zeuthen. It offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from 400 m to 10 km. The event is family-friendly and promotes recreational sport in the region. The races start at Zeuthen S-Bahn station and follow a varied route along the forest promenade.

name: HochRhön-BergTrail
description: The HochRhön Mountain Trail is a challenging trail-running event in the picturesque uplands of the Hochrhön around Hilders. The event offers four trail distances from 7 km to 42 km, with varied routes through forests, along singletrack trails and forest roads, and across meadows. The races feature some steep climbs and wonderful views, particularly from Auerbergsee and Buchschirm. The event also supports a good cause, with part of the entry fees donated to the Malteser Children’s Hospice and Family Support Service in Fulda. The event is part of the regional Trailrunning Cup Rhön and also offers children’s races.

name: Okolo Muňáku
location: Munice u Hluboké nad Vltavou, Jihočeský
description: Okolo Muňáku is a family running race in Munice near Hluboká nad Vltavou, offering a relaxed atmosphere and a fast course around Munický Pond. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is open to all age groups, including children’s races. Each edition supports the charity Centrum Bazalka, which receives part of the entry fees. After the race, there is a varied program, including a raffle and prizes for the fastest runners.

name: Vrchlabský 1/2 Maraton
description: The Vrchlabí City Half Marathon is the inaugural edition of the half marathon, held in the heart of the Krkonoše Mountains at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí. During the race, participants can enjoy a sporting challenge on asphalt roads, field paths and forest trails, as well as a cultural programme and a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main half marathon, shorter 2 km and 9 km routes are available for children, juniors and families with children, taking them through the town and its side streets. The event brings together running, experiences and community, and is co-funded by the State Environmental Fund of the Czech Republic.

name: Forestova čtrnáctka
description: Forestova čtrnáctka is a 14 km running race around Záluží near Plzeň, featuring a mix of field, forest, and gravel roads with light trail terrain. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children and young people, who can enter for free. Runners can look forward to plenty of refreshments, a participant medal, and race photos. Registration opens at 9:00, and the start is scheduled by 9:45. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The organizer emphasizes participant safety and fitness to compete; runners take part at their own risk.

name: Králický Lískovec
description: Králický Lískovec is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Lískovec hill and its vicinity in Králíky, Pardubice Region. The race offers various distances, from short children’s categories to the 8 km main race, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The main race starts at 11:30, while the children’s categories start from 10:30. The race is suitable for the general public and prizes are awarded to winners in each category. Registration is available on-site on race day from 8:00 to 9:45.

name: Kokořínský kros
description: Kokořín Cross is a trail race held amid the picturesque scenery of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, not far from Prague. The race offers three main routes of 15 km, 10 km and 5 km, which pass through romantic ravines and by unique sandstone towers. The start and finish are located in the municipal spa complex in Mšeno, which provides facilities including refreshments and a children’s corner. The race is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offers a wide range of categories, with the option to change route distance even on race day.

name: Hostivařská 15°
description: Hostivařská 15 is a family-friendly trail race in the natural surroundings of Prague’s Hostivař district, offering more than just a test of performance. The race takes place around the reservoir, golf course and meanders of the Botič River, with mostly forest trails and very little asphalt. There is no timing equipment at the start; the winner is the runner who estimates their time most accurately. The atmosphere is outdoorsy and brewery-themed, and the event is suitable for all ages, including children.

name: 4Drun
description: 4Drun is a traditional running race organized by Sportovní klub DDsport, z.s., held in the picturesque surroundings of Dubany near Prostějov. The race offers a 10.2 km course through the area around Dubany, neighboring villages, and nearby cycle paths, combining asphalt and cross-country sections. The program also includes a 2 × 5 km relay, a 4 km family run, and children’s races, making the event suitable for all age groups. A varied program of accompanying activities is planned for race day, and every participant receives a commemorative medal.

name: Beh Ždaňou
location: Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Obecný úrad
description: Beh Ždaňou is a running event in the village of Ždaňa in the Košice-okolie District, offering courses for various age groups and ability levels. The races cover 2.5 km and 5 km, with categories divided by age and gender. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, adults, and seniors. The organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sporting day in the pleasant surroundings of the village.

name: Beh okolo Spišského hradu
location: Spišské Podhradie, Spišské Podhradie, Pred MsÚ
description: The Run Around Spiš Castle is a traditional running race in Spišské Podhradie, featuring a mix of asphalt and compacted dirt roads with grassy sections. The course passes around the historic Spiš Castle and is suitable for various age groups, including children and adults. The event is organized by the Town of Spišské Podhradie, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. Registration is available online or on site, and residents of Spišské Podhradie can enter for free.

name: RUN & RAVE Palanga
description: RUN & RAVE Palanga is a new community initiative for people who love movement, music, and good energy. The event takes place in Palanga and includes mobility training, a 5 km social run with DJ music, an ice bath ritual, and coffee breaks. It’s a great opportunity to meet new people, make connections, and experience summer energy at a single morning event. Registration is required, and participants are invited to bring running shoes, swim shorts, and a towel.

name: Crow Mountain Survival
description: The Crow Mountain Survival obstacle race in Bremen is an exciting adventure entering its ninth edition. Distances range from 1.2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, with challenging obstacles and spectacular water sections, including a swim across Lake Werdersee. The event offers challenges for beginners and experienced OCR veterans, as well as inclusive races for people with disabilities. The varied course runs through forests, meadows and different types of terrain, testing endurance, strength and agility. Children and newcomers can take part in special untimed races that make it easier to get started.
course_highlights: Spectacular swim across Lake Werdersee
Varied course through forests, meadows and different types of terrain
Challenging obstacles involving climbing, balancing, crawling and traversing
additional: Wave starts of 10 participants every 60 seconds for the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km races; participants are grouped by pace at registration; untimed junior and inclusive races; medals and certificates for all participants; start times vary by distance, e.g. junior race at 09:30 and taster race at 12:00; children under 12 require prior approval to participate on certain courses. Distances from 5 km to 15 km, including water sections, natural trails through forests and meadows, challenging obstacles, and junior, taster and inclusive races.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - září
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a regular 8 km running race held in the pleasant surroundings of Plzeň. The race is for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking available for participants. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and is suitable for various age groups.

name: Malý Pieninský maratón – mem. Bohuša Ježíka
location: Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Kúpele Smerdžonka
organizer: Malý pieninský maratón – memoriál Bohuša Ježíka
description: The Malý Pieninský Marathon – Bohuš Ježík Memorial is a running event in Červený Kláštor, offering an 18 km course with 163 metres of elevation gain. The route runs through the Dunajec River Gorge, with half the surface paved and half forest trail. The start is scheduled for 10:00. The entry fee includes a medal, a gift, a race number, refreshments along the course and at the finish, lunch, and a raffle. In addition to the main race, a non-competitive 9+9 km relay is also available.

name: B2Run Berlin
description: B2Run Berlin is a corporate run with a route of around 5.7 km around Berlin’s Olympic Stadium. The run ends with an emotional finish in the historic Olympic Stadium and offers a unique team event for companies and individual entrants from Berlin and the surrounding area. The focus is on team spirit, motivation and fun rather than personal bests, making it ideal for beginners, walkers and experienced runners. The event combines physical activity with workplace health promotion and a professional supporting program featuring an emcee and music.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (10) – zářijový
description: The 5 km and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running series in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava where personal bests are often set. The races are part of the 16th edition and are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to pros. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the chance to meet the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant, adding to the relaxed running atmosphere.

name: Podzimní běh okolo Europlantu
description: The Autumn Run around Europlant is a traditional running race held in Prague’s Horní Počernice district. The race is 7.5 km long and combines paved and off-road sections. It starts in the early evening, with slower runners setting off earlier. The event is open to all runners and is supported by Prague 20. After the race, participants are rewarded with potatoes provided by the sponsor, Europlant.

name: Běh proti násilí
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
organizer: Asociace pro práci s lidmi, kteří se dopouštějí násilí z.s.
description: Run Against Violence is a traditional charity run held in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6. It supports the Stop Violence program and clients taking part in long-term therapies focused on managing anger and aggression. The run brings together participants of all ages who want to show their support and offer hope to those trying to change their behavior. The 5 km course is suitable for anyone who wants to support a good cause while enjoying exercise in nature. The event is organized by Diakonie ČCE, a major provider of social services in the Czech Republic.

name: Maraton 3 Jezior / Three Lakes Marathon
description: Maraton 3 Jezior to górski festiwal biegowy odbywający się w malowniczym regionie Beskidów Małych, w dolinie rzeki Soły. Głównym dystansem jest ultramaraton o długości około 43 km z przewyższeniem około 2485 m, prowadzący przez najwyższe partie Beskidów Małych, z pięknymi widokami na trzy jeziora i okoliczne góry. Trasa łączy wymagające podbiegi i techniczne zbiegi, a uczestnicy mają okazję poznać zarówno dziką przyrodę, jak i historyczne miejsca regionu. Impreza odbywa się w pięknym okresie przejścia lata w jesień, co dodatkowo podkreśla urok trasy i okolicy.

name: 23 Przejście Dookoła Kotliny Jeleniogórs...
description: Przejście Dookoła Kotliny Jeleniogórskiej to jedna z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych pieszych imprez długodystansowych w Polsce, organizowana od 2004 roku. Uczestnicy pokonują około 140 km trasę wokół Kotliny Jeleniogórskiej, przemierzając pasma Karkonoszy, Rudaw Janowickich, Gór Kaczawskich i Gór Izerskich. Wydarzenie upamiętnia ratowników GOPR, a w ramach opłaty startowej uczestnicy otrzymują materiały startowe, gadżet, ciepły posiłek oraz certyfikat. Trasa jest wymagająca, z sumą przewyższeń około 5500 m, a limit czasu na pokonanie trasy wynosi 48 godzin.

name: 3 Backyard Ultra Zagłębie
description: Backyard Ultra Zagłębie to wyjątkowy ultramaraton rozgrywany na pętli o długości 6,706 km wokół Jeziora Pogoria 3 w Dąbrowie Górniczej. Zawodnicy startują co godzinę, a ostatni na mecie w każdej rundzie kontynuuje bieg, aż pozostanie tylko jeden zwycięzca. Trasa łączy różnorodne nawierzchnie - asfalt, ścieżki gruntowe i leśne oraz odcinek plażowy, co wymaga od uczestników zarówno wytrzymałości, jak i technicznej precyzji. Impreza jest finałem Polish Backyard Ultra League i przyciąga miłośników ekstremalnych wyzwań z całej Polski.

name: Ogólnopolskie Mistrzostwa Policji
location: Łazy, Zawiercie County, Silesian Voivodeship, Polska

name: Stadtlauf Hanau - Stärke zeigen - gemeinsam gegen Gewalt an Frauen
description: The Hanau City Run takes place under the motto “Show Strength – Together Against Violence Against Women.” Around 3,500 people take part each year to take a stand against violence against women. The run combines sporting commitment with an important social cause and provides a platform for solidarity and awareness. The event is well organized, with race bib collection and the race office at Hanau City Hall.
course_highlights: Route through Hanau city center
Start and finish at Hanau Market Square
An urban city run with good infrastructure
additional: The race office opens at 14:00 on race day at City Hall. Race bib collection begins at 14:00. Baggage storage is available at City Hall from 15:30. Changing facilities are limited. There are no showers. Paid parking is available in nearby parking garages. Mobile structures on Market Square are permitted only for the organizers. The run is an annual event that collects donations for women’s shelters. More than 3,500 participants are expected.

name: SportScheck RUN Hannover
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The SportScheck Run Hannover is an evening night run that transforms Hanover’s city centre into a spectacular display of lights. Runners can choose between a 1 km children’s race and 5 km and 10 km courses, which pass through the illuminated city centre and landmarks such as Opernplatz, the Lower Saxony State Parliament, Kröpcke and the New Town Hall. The nighttime atmosphere makes the run a particularly memorable experience. The fastest runners can take part in a 10 km SpeedRUN, with a target time of under 50 minutes. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and also offers training plans to help them prepare.

name: ONW-Lauf Dannenberg 2025
description: There are three race distances of 2.1 km, 4.2 km and 10.5 km, starting at the Market Square. The event welcomes participants of all ages and supports a good cause while fostering a strong sense of community. The entry fee for female students is covered; adults pay 6 euros. Groups of four or more can enter the team competition and win trophies.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
location: Ochotnicza Straż Pożarna w Janiszewicach, Janiszewice, gmina Zduńska Wola, Polska
description: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Ochotniczą Straż Pożarną w Janiszewicach. Bieg skierowany jest do miłośników szybkich, płaskich tras asfaltowych, które od 2021 roku mają atestowaną długość 10 km. Wydarzenie ma charakter sportowy i integracyjny, a także obejmuje biegi dla dzieci, które promują aktywność fizyczną wśród najmłodszych. Strona zawiera relacje, zdjęcia oraz wyniki z poprzednich edycji, podkreślając rosnącą popularność i rekordową frekwencję.
course_highlights: Płaska i szybka trasa asfaltowa
Atestowana trasa o długości 10 km od 2021 roku
Organizacja biegów dla dzieci na krótszych dystansach
additional: Biegi dla dzieci w wieku 4-15 lat na dystansach około 300 metrów, organizowane bez presji i rywalizacji, promujące pasję do ruchu. Biegi dziecięce są przeznaczone dla uczestników w wieku 4 - 15 lat.

name: 17. PKO Bytomski Półmaraton
description: 17. PKO Bytomski Półmaraton to prestiżowy bieg półmaratoński odbywający się w Bytomiu, który w 2026 roku uzyskał rangę Otwartych Mistrzostw Śląska w Półmaratonie. Trasa biegu to jedna pętla o długości 21,097 km, w całości asfaltowa i atestowana przez PZLA, z oznaczeniem co kilometr oraz punktami odżywiania i kontroli. Zawodnicy mają do pokonania limit czasowy 3 godzin, a po biegu mogą spersonalizować swój medal dzięki grawerowaniu. Wydarzenie jest doskonałą okazją do promocji zdrowego stylu życia oraz integracji lokalnej społeczności.
course_highlights: Trasa 21,097 km - jedna pętla, asfaltowa, atest PZLA
Oznaczenie trasy co 1 km oraz punkty odżywiania i odświeżania
Limit czasowy 3 godziny, z kontrolą i transportem dla zawodników kończących po czasie
additional: Wspólna rozgrzewka zaplanowana na godz. 9:45. Po biegu możliwość grawerowania wyników na medalach dzięki partnerowi Wikoss Sport (dwa stanowiska). Na starcie obecni pacemakerzy z czasami 1:45, 2:00, 2:15. Limit uczestników 18+ lat. Start i meta na parkingu Centrum Handlowego G City Plejada, Bytom, al. Jana Nowaka Jeziorańskiego 25.

name: 30 Międzynarodowy Bieg Uliczny Bieg Rekreacyjny 10 km
description: 30. Międzynarodowy Bieg Uliczny w Jaworznie to coroczna impreza biegowa, która przyciąga zarówno zawodowców, jak i amatorów. Wydarzenie obejmuje bieg rekreacyjny na dystansie 10 km, odbywający się na ulicach miasta. Trasa jest atrakcyjna dla biegaczy ceniących sobie miejskie biegi z dobrą organizacją i atmosferą. To doskonała okazja do sportowej rywalizacji i aktywnego spędzenia czasu wśród biegowej społeczności.
course_highlights: Bieg uliczny na dystansie 10 km
Trasa przebiega przez ulice Jaworzna
Impreza o międzynarodowym charakterze

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail to unikalny bieg o formule odwróconej, trwający 6 lub 12 godzin na pętlach około 10 km w malowniczym masywie Gontyńca. Zawodnicy pokonują jak najdłuższy dystans, korzystając z doskonale wyposażonych bufetów po każdej pętli. Trasa oferuje zmieniające się krajobrazy o różnych porach dnia, z pięknymi widokami na dolinę Noteci oraz unikalnymi atrakcjami przyrodniczymi i kulturowymi, takimi jak ule figuralne w postaci pradawnych bogów. To wyjątkowe doświadczenie dla biegaczy szukających wyzwań i niezapomnianych wrażeń.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
location: Parking przy Operze Leśnej, Sopot, Polska
