The race is known for its fast, flat course and attracts runners from across the region. Registration is available on the official website, and the event is a popular opportunity for recreational and competitive runners to improve their personal bests.

name: Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte
description: The 19th Volksbank City Run Telgte is taking place and offers runners of all ages a varied programme. The routes pass through the historic old town, along the Ems and through the surrounding countryside, vividly reflecting the motto “Town, Country and River.” In addition to the main 10,000-metre race, other events include a 5,000-metre race, walking, student and Bambini races, and an untimed Fun Run. The event is suitable for competitive runners, recreational runners and families, and is organised by TV Friesen Telgte e.V.
course_highlights: 10,000-metre main race through the old town, the Ems floodplains and the countryside
5,000-metre race with a drink station halfway along the route
Varied surfaces, including asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €2 late-entry fee (for the Bambini race, this fee is charged once per family or group). Changing facilities are available in the old double gym at the school centre, close to the start and finish. Medals, trophies and certificates are awarded in various events and age groups. The varied route includes asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails. Photos and video footage will be taken and published. The start and finish are at the school centre sports field. Registration is online. Changing facilities are in the Old Double Gym. Children’s races are not timed.

name: Herbstcross des SSV-MG-Ahlsdorf / 2. Peter Zinke Gedenklauf
MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl is a challenging trail-running event in the Chiemgau Alps, with five different distances ranging from 11 to 73 kilometers. The routes pass through impressive mountain scenery, with highlights including ski jumps, the idyllic Klausenbach Gorge, alpine pastures, and Dürrnbachhorn, with breathtaking views all the way to the Wilder Kaiser. The event welcomes trail runners from beginners to professionals, although the longer distances are suitable only for experienced runners. Special routes are available for hikers, and dogs are also welcome on the shorter routes. The event offers a friendly, family atmosphere, with an expo, Kids’ Trail, Community Trail, and a pasta party on the evening before the race.

name: Kreuzhorst Ultra
description: The Kreuzhorst Ultra (KRHU) is a friendly backyard ultra in Magdeburg-Kreuzhorst, taking place for the third time. The 6.7 km course starts again at the top of every hour, and participants run as many laps as they can or wish to. The race is a private invitation-only event focused on community, passion, and the joy of running. The course runs mainly along forest and farm tracks with no significant climbs, and there are classifications for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km.

name: Bausch+Ströbel Stadtlauf Ilshofen
description: The Bausch+Ströbel Ilshofen City Run is a long-standing running event held annually in Ilshofen. It offers runners of various ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete on a varied route through the city. The course is well marked and passes through attractive parts of the city, making the race appealing to both participants and spectators. The city run is a popular event on the regional running calendar and is organized by TSV Ilshofen.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Ötigheim Autumn Run is a traditional running event held annually by Turngemeinde Germania Ötigheim 1907 e.V. The race offers a friendly atmosphere for running enthusiasts of all ages and ability levels. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and the opportunity to experience the club community. Numerous photos and reports from previous races are available on the website to give an impression of the event.

name: 1. Basche-Cross
description: The Basche-Cross is a traditional cross-country race in Barsinghausen, welcoming runners of all ability levels. The course passes through varied terrain and offers a demanding challenge away from paved paths. The event is known for its natural atmosphere and the chance to experience cross-country running in a scenic setting. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.
course_highlights: Natural cross-country course through varied terrain
Demanding sections away from paved paths
Scenic surroundings in Barsinghausen

name: 10. Göttinger Lichterlauf
description: The Göttingen Charity Lights Run is an atmospheric running event around Kiessee lake in Göttingen, bringing people together to do good. The event features special lighting, a varied music program, and the strong commitment of participants and volunteers. The run supports Elternhaus Göttingen, which provides families with seriously ill children a home away from home during a difficult time. The Charity Lights Run is an evening of community, music, and lights that delights many people every year.
course_highlights: Atmospheric lighting around Kiessee lake
Varied music program during the event
A community running and walking evening in support of Elternhaus Göttingen
additional: The event is a charity run in support of Elternhaus Göttingen, which helps families with seriously ill children. It is an evening run featuring music and lights, and walkers are welcome too. The event is supported by many volunteers, musicians, and supporters.

name: Bergzeitlauf Brockenheroes 2026
description: The BROCKENHEROES mountain time trial and uphill race is a challenging individual time trial in the Harz, held in Schierke. Participants compete on various routes of up to 24 km and with up to 900 metres of elevation gain, including road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing and Nordic walking. The event offers a unique challenge against the clock, the mountain and oneself, starting on Brockenstraße and finishing on the Brocken plateau. The atmosphere combines sporting ambition with the impressive natural scenery of the Harz.

name: Böckstiegellauf
description: The Böckstiegellauf is a scenic race through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills, running from Peter auf’m Berge in Bielefeld to the center of Werther. Distances include 18 km and 10 km, as well as a 2.5 km schoolchildren’s race. The course partly follows the Hermannslauf and passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum. The event is very well organized, with a shuttle bus from the finish to the start and an awards ceremony in the center of Werther.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event held as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend in September. The main race starts at the Red School on the market square and runs along Eschstraße to Rathausplatz. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition in which teams of four each complete a course of approximately 1,000 metres four times. The event is organised by the running group of SV Bethen e. V. and overseen by the NLV district of Cloppenburg.

name: Crosslauf Winhöring
description: The cross-country race in Winhöring offers a varied event for different age groups and ability levels. It includes a 7.5 km main race and a 700 m children’s race. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Winhöring and offers runners of all ages an athletic challenge.

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
description: The 3-Täler-Lauf, organised by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V., takes participants along varied routes through the three valleys of Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The 14.1 km main race features challenging, hilly terrain and impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg. There is also an 8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes alike. Children are welcome to take part in an 800 m schoolchildren’s race and a 400 m Bambini race, where fun is the main focus. The family-friendly event offers timing with a disposable chip, as well as showers and changing rooms at Ludgeri School.

name: Emmertinger Herbstfestlauf
description: The Emmerting Herbstfest Run takes place at the sports field in Emmerting and is part of the local autumn festival. The event is aimed at children, adults, club runners, recreational runners, and walkers. There are various distances, including Bambini runs, children’s races, 5- and 10-kilometer runs, and Nordic walking routes. Its family-friendly, festive atmosphere makes the run a popular meeting place for the local running community.

name: Herbstfestlauf
description: The 30th Niederstetten Autumn Festival Run takes place around the town hall in Niederstetten and offers varied routes for all age groups. The shorter races run through the town center, while the main race follows the scenic Vorbach Valley. Participants can look forward to beautiful views of the vineyards and Weikersheim Castle. A range of race categories, from the mini run to the relay, means there is something for everyone.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf is a long-standing running event that has been held annually on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds since 2002. With distances of 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is especially family-friendly, with special Bambini runs for children and a varied program featuring games, a food mile and entertainment. It promotes a sense of community and the joy of being active, and welcomes individuals, school classes, teams and companies.

name: Hotfoot Run Warstein
description: The Hotfoot Run Warstein is a spectacular obstacle race, with distances ranging from 5 km (Family Edition) to 20 km, making it suitable for all fitness levels and age groups. The course crosses the Montgolfiadengelände, the ski slope and the quarry, with plenty of muddy obstacles, water slides and foam. Since 2007, the event has offered an electrifying start show, a unique atmosphere, and a focus on team spirit and fun. Whether you’re a fitness fanatic, a fun-loving group or a family, everyone can enjoy an unforgettable adventure here in NRW.

name: Höhlerfestlauf
description: The 11th Höhlerfest Run in Gera offers a varied running event with courses for all ages and ability levels. New this year is the 22 km cross-country run with obstacles and 420 m of elevation gain, which leads through the city forest and Hofwiesenpark. In addition to classic distances from 0.8 km to 12 km, there are walking and handicap courses, as well as the popular parent-child run for preschoolers. The event stands out for its special atmosphere, with live music and a family-friendly feel, and is supported by the City of Gera.

name: König Ludwig Lauf - Sommeredition
description: The König Ludwig Lauf - Summer Edition is Bavaria’s most scenic panoramic run in the Ammergau Alps. The event offers varied courses from 6 km to 21 km through the picturesque landscape of the Ammergau Alps Nature Park. A free shuttle bus takes participants to the start in Ettal, and the event is ideal for trail and landscape running enthusiasts. Its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized arrangements make the run a special experience.

name: Oldersumer Appel-Loop
description: The Oldersum Appel-Loop is a popular race that passes through Oldersum’s picturesque parks, along the Rorichumer Tief canal, and through the “alte Seilerei” museum. The course finishes in the apple park, where the Oldersum Apple Market is also taking place and refreshments are available. In addition to the main 5 km and 10 km races, there is a 5 km walking route and 800 m children’s races for various age groups. The race is part of the Ostfriesische 7 running series and offers a lovely atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: R5K Berlin
description: The R5K Tour Finale is an exciting 5-kilometer run for children and young people as part of the GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON. The race takes place on September 25, 2027, between Potsdamer Platz and the finish line at the Brandenburg Gate. It gives young runners the opportunity to take part on an attractive course in central Berlin and be part of a major running event. The event promotes exercise and community under the motto of getting the next generation moving.
course_highlights: Course between Potsdamer Platz and the Brandenburg Gate
Attractive location in central Berlin
Part of the major GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON event
additional: The R5K Tour Finale takes place on Saturday, September 25, 2027. The exact start time is not specified. The event is part of the GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON Kids & Youth offerings and is supported by sponsors such as Generali and adidas.

name: Wald-und Hügellauf
description: The forest and hill run in Groß-Umstadt is a long-standing event that starts and finishes at Ludwig-Wedel-Stadium. Participants can choose between two distances: the classic 13.2 km course and the half-marathon distance of 21.1 km. The run is part of the Langlauf Cup Jugenheim and is sanctioned by the DLV. The course winds through forests and hills, where runners can expect witches in the woods and the “Mountain of Truth.” Refreshments are provided along the way, and after the run there is an awards ceremony, with showers and changing rooms available on site.

name: Mělnický vinařský běh
description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering 10 km and 21 km courses. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, and the route passes historic and natural attractions in the surrounding area. After the finish, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a large prize draw. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own free races. The event is organized by the Run the World association, which promotes running as a friendly community activity.

name: Grymovská pětka
description: Grymov Five is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering athletes the chance to test their abilities in the pleasant surroundings of the town of Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc is a club specializing in recreational and competitive running that organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of its running calendar and attracts runners of various ages and ability levels. The club also supports runners with training and race preparation, ensuring a high-quality sporting experience.

name: Běh Bohutínem
description: Běh Bohutínem is a traditional running race organized by SK Sporting Bohutín and held at the Litavan football pitch. The race offers an 8 km course for men and a 4 km course for women, with a surface combining asphalt and forest trails. The event also includes children’s races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The main race starts at 13:00, and the atmosphere is friendly and sporty.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
description: The Zlín Region Run is part of the Zlín Region Day celebrations, held in Zlín. The event offers not only a sporting experience with a 6 km run, but also a cultural program, regional cuisine, and family activities. The run is open to the general public and is part of a full day of entertainment, crafts, and regional products. It is organized by the Zlín Region, which supports sport and local traditions through the event.

name: Běh Velké skály
description: Běh Velké skály is a traditional running race held in Děčín, offering 11 km and 6.5 km courses through forest and urban terrain. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom special races are held. The race starts at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium, and its atmosphere is enhanced by the beautiful surrounding countryside and rock formations. The race is now in its 56th edition and is known for its exceptional atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
description: The Plzeň Cardio Run is Plzeň’s largest cross-country race, with 5.8 km and 10 km courses. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and also serves as the Czech Republic Cross-Country Championship for healthcare professionals. It is organized by Pro Sport Activities, an agency with a long-standing tradition of organizing sporting events in Plzeň and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a quality sporting experience in the natural surroundings of Plzeň-Roudná.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountain Ranges is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The Beskydy race takes place at the Horečky amphitheatre in Trojanovice and offers technical trails, epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. The routes follow forest roads and paths, with climbs up interesting hills and long descents. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can look forward to refreshments and professional facilities.

name: ŠumpeRUN
location: Historical Centre of Šumperk, Šumperk, Czech Republic
description: ŠumpeRUN is a popular city race through the historic center of Šumperk. The eighth edition offers races for the general public, including the main 10 km race, a 3.33 km race, three-person relay teams, and children’s races of various lengths. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit while celebrating the city’s cultural heritage. For 2026, a varied program of activities is planned, including group warm-ups and music along the course.

name: K3-run
description: K3 – the Krčmaň Run over Three Peaks is an 11.3 km race with approximately 350 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through beautiful countryside over three peaks, mainly on paved paths and partly on grass, with predominantly firm surfaces. This run offers athletes an enjoyable experience in nature and a challenge in the form of climbs and trail running.

name: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom
location: Pača, okr. Rožňava, Pača, okr. Rožňava, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Pačanský Chotár Mountain Run is a running event in the village of Pača, offering two main courses: a more challenging 13.5 km main race with 492 m of elevation gain and a shorter 6.3 km hobby run with 203 m of elevation gain. The routes combine paved and forest roads, with beautiful views and refreshment stations along the way. Runners start and finish in front of the cultural centre in Pača, and the organizers provide route navigation and marking. The event is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners and offers a sporting atmosphere with refreshments and a raffle.

name: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka
location: Rybník, okr. Levice, Rybník, okr. Levice, futbalový štadión
organizer: Obec Rybník, ZŠ s MŠ Rybník
description: Rybník 10K and 5K is a running event held at the football stadium in the village of Rybník, Levice District. Races are held over two distances—5 km and 10 km—with various age categories for men and women. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including secondary school students and seniors, who receive discounted entry fees. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and quality facilities for runners.

name: Behaj lesmi Devín
description: Behaj lesmi Devín is a unique trail race near Bratislava, offering a route with views of the confluence of the Danube and Morava rivers and Devínska Kobyla. The trails follow the historic Amber Road and pass through blooming wild garlic avenues, making the run an unforgettable experience. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is listed as a UTMB Index Race, providing an international points ranking. You can compete on the short 12 km route or the 22 km half marathon. Both routes feature a marked Conti Speed Section, with a valuable prize up for grabs.

name: S Ankou za život
description: The Run with Anka for Life is a charity event held in Košice near St. Elisabeth Cathedral. The entry fee is a voluntary contribution, and all proceeds from entry fees go to the Oáza - Hope for a New Life facility. The event is organized by the Anka Kolesárová Pastoral Centre in Vysoká nad Uhom. Runners can combine a sporting challenge with supporting a good cause.

name: Hutčanská 5 s vierou – beh srdcom i telom
description: The Run with Heart and Soul in Nižná Hutka is an annual running event offering a 5 km course for experienced runners and a fun 500 m route for the youngest participants. Alongside the sporting experience, the program includes a spiritual reflection, refreshments, a panel discussion, and music. The event creates a welcoming community atmosphere and encourages both competition and the joy of running.

name: XXVI Nidos pusės maratono bėgimas. Lietuvos pusės maratono bėgimo čempionatas.
description: The International Nida Half Marathon is a traditional annual event held in Nida, on the Curonian Spit. The event includes a half-marathon distance, the 5 km YIT Run, and shorter distances for children and young people. It is a great opportunity for both professional and recreational runners to enjoy running in a unique natural setting and take part in the Lithuanian Half Marathon Championships. The event encourages physical activity and promotes sport in Lithuania, while participants can look forward to professionally prepared courses and a friendly atmosphere.

name: VERTICAL VILNIUS 2026
organizer: TA Trail Akademija VŽ Vaidas Žlabys
description: Vertical Vilnius is Lithuania’s most vertical off-road running race, held in Vilnius. Participants tackle the slopes of Liepkalnis, and the race offers an opportunity to earn ITRA ranking points. An eco-friendly “Trash Vertical” challenge is also organized to encourage participants to care for the environment. Registration for the event is free, so everyone is invited to take part and test their strength on this unique course.

name: 26-as Tarptautinis Nidos Pusės Maratono Bėgimas
description: The 26th International Nida Half Marathon will take place in Nida. The event offers various distances: a half marathon, a 5 km YIT run, a 2 km youth run, and short children’s runs (500 m and 210 m). The race courses are certified according to World Athletics and AIMS requirements, with starts at different locations in Nida. This traditional event encourages people to take part in sport and promotes running and athletics in Lithuania.

name: Vertical Vilnius
description: Vertical Vilnius is Lithuania’s most vertical off-road running race, held on the slopes of Liepkalnis in Vilnius. Participants tackle steep mountain slopes, aiming to earn ITRA rating points and take part in the eco-friendly “Trash Vertical” challenge. The race promotes physical activity and environmental care, inviting runners to test their strength on a unique course.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Polska
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w Gdańsku, której trasa liczy 21,0975 km. Start i meta zlokalizowane są przy Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. Bieg ma charakter masowy, z podziałem na strefy startowe według deklarowanego wyniku, a także możliwość startu w sztafetach 4-osobowych. Organizatorzy zapewniają profesjonalny pomiar czasu, zabezpieczenie medyczne oraz bufet i wodę na trasie. Impreza promuje aktywność fizyczną i zdrowy styl życia, a także popularyzuje Gdańsk w kraju i za granicą.
course_highlights: Trasa półmaratonu o długości 21,0975 km w Gdańsku
Start i meta przy Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Podział na strefy startowe według deklarowanego wyniku
additional: Start podzielony jest na strefy czasowe według deklarowanego wyniku (czerwona, niebieska, zielona, żółta). Sztafety startują ze strefy niebieskiej. Pakiet startowy zawiera wodoodporny numer startowy z chipem, pomiar czasu, zabezpieczenie medyczne, wodę na punktach odświeżania, bufet za metą oraz medal. Numer startowy musi być przymocowany poziomo na przodzie koszulki. Zabronione jest przekazywanie numeru startowego innej osobie bez zgody organizatora. Wydarzenie obejmuje różne dystanse, w tym półmaraton i 5 km, z limitem uczestników do 10 tysięcy. Rejestracja odbywa się online, a opłaty można uiścić przez Przelewy24 lub tradycyjny przelew. Dla młodszych uczestników dostępne są biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży.

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: 48. Maraton Warszawski to wyjątkowe wydarzenie biegowe odbywające się w sercu Warszawy, które przyciąga tysiące biegaczy. Trasa prowadzi przez najpiękniejsze i historyczne miejsca stolicy, oferując niepowtarzalne widoki i atmosferę. Każdy uczestnik otrzymuje pamiątkowy medal i koszulkę, a kibice mogą korzystać z licznych atrakcji i stref kibicowania. To święto biegania, które łączy sport, kulturę i wspólnotę.
course_highlights: Start spod Pałacu Kultury i Nauki w centrum Warszawy
Trasa przebiega przez Krakowskie Przedmieście, Nowy Świat, Most Poniatowskiego z panoramą Wisły oraz PGE Narodowy
Wyłączony ruch samochodowy zapewnia bezpieczne i komfortowe warunki biegu
additional: Numer startowy należy umieścić z przodu stroju i nie może być zasłonięty ani modyfikowany. Start i meta znajdują się w centrum miasta, w pobliżu stacji metra. W dniu biegu dostępne są depozyty, przebieralnie i toalety. Wydarzenie towarzyszą liczne atrakcje, strefy kibicowania oraz program w Marathon Fan Zone i EXPO Sport&Fitness. Możliwość udziału w ścieżce charytatywnej #BiegamDobrze z bezpłatnym numerem startowym. W tym samym weekendzie odbywają się także biegi na 10 km (Warszawska Dycha) oraz Mini Maraton dla dzieci i młodzieży. Zapisów można dokonywać poprzez oficjalną stronę, a wydarzenie obejmuje również półmaraton i bieg na 5 km. Organizacja zapewnia atrakcje i wsparcie dla uczestników.

name: 21. Kamień Extreme - Rybnik
description: 21. Kamień Extreme to wymagający bieg górski organizowany w Rybniku, który przyciąga miłośników ekstremalnych wyzwań biegowych. Zawody oferują profesjonalny pomiar czasu z wykorzystaniem technologii RFID. Impreza jest organizowana przez MOSiR Rybnik, zapewniając uczestnikom sprawną organizację i sportową atmosferę. Start biegu zaplanowano na godzinę 12:00, a zapisy kończą się o godzinie 23:59.

name: 1 Półmaraton Ostrzeszowski
description: Półmaraton Koroną Wzgórz Wielkopolski to wyjątkowy bieg odbywający się w malowniczym Ostrzeszowie. Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi przez dwa wzgórza i dwa źródła, oferując uczestnikom niepowtarzalne widoki i wyzwania terenowe. To doskonała okazja, aby zmierzyć się z wymagającą trasą i przeżyć sportową przygodę w sercu Wielkopolski. Zapraszamy biegaczy do udziału i wspólnego świętowania sportu i natury.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi przez dwa wzgórza
Przebiega obok dwóch źródeł
Malownicze krajobrazy Wielkopolski

name: 16 Bieg im. Pawła Lorensa
description: 16 Bieg im. Pawła Lorensa to coroczny bieg na 10 km organizowany w Tychach, upamiętniający zasługi wybitnego biegacza Pawła Lorensa dla rozwoju lekkiej atletyki w regionie. Trasa biegu prowadzi malowniczymi ścieżkami wokół jeziora Paprocańskiego, jest płaska i szybka, co sprzyja osiąganiu dobrych wyników. W dniu zawodów odbywają się także bezpłatne biegi dla dzieci, które można zapisać się w dniu imprezy. Organizatorem jest grupa Przyjaciele Tyskiego Sportu we współpracy z MOSiR Tychy i innymi lokalnymi partnerami.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 10 km wokół jeziora Paprocańskiego
Płaska i szybka trasa po ubitych ścieżkach i chodniku z kostki brukowej
Malownicza sceneria jeziora i terenów rekreacyjnych Paprocan
additional: W dniu zawodów organizowane są bezpłatne biegi dziecięce z zapisami w dniu imprezy.

name: Kresowe Trail #11
description: Kresowe Trail to kameralne biegi terenowe organizowane przez Fundację Maratony Kresowe, które promują zdrowy tryb życia i aktywność fizyczną w otoczeniu przyrody wschodniej Polski. Cykl składa się z jedenastu etapów, odbywających się głównie na Podlasiu, z trasami o różnym stopniu trudności, dostosowanymi zarówno dla początkujących, jak i doświadczonych biegaczy. Biegi mają charakter niekomercyjny, z ograniczoną liczbą uczestników, co zapewnia bezpieczeństwo i poszanowanie lokalnych społeczności oraz środowiska. W ramach cyklu odbywają się dwa dystanse: krótszy Szpurt (ok. 6-8 km) oraz dłuższy Wertep (ok. 17-21 km), a także rywalizacja Nordic Walking. Finał sezonu 2027 odbędzie się 26 września w Michałowie.
course_highlights: Trasy terenowe o długości około 6-8 km (Szpurt) i 17-21 km (Wertep)
Trasy oznaczone kolorowymi strzałkami (zielone na żółtym tle dla Szpurt, czerwone dla Wertep)
Biegi odbywają się w malowniczych rejonach Podlasia i Wileńszczyzny, z poszanowaniem przyrody i lokalnych społeczności
additional: Starty odbywają się w sektorach według wyników z poprzedniego sezonu. Limit czasu na trasach to około 2 godziny dla krótszego dystansu i 2:15 dla dłuższego. W pakiecie startowym znajduje się numer startowy z chipem, ciepły posiłek regeneracyjny (również wegetariański), bufety na trasie i mecie, zabezpieczenie medyczne, pamiątkowy medal (przy wcześniejszej rejestracji), a także serwis fotograficzny. Możliwość rejestracji w dniu zawodów do godziny 08:40, jednak z ryzykiem niepełnego pakietu startowego. Organizator umożliwia przeniesienie opłaty startowej na inny termin bez dodatkowych kosztów przed zakończeniem rejestracji internetowej.

name: X Półmaraton Crossowy
description: X Półmaraton Crossowy to bieg terenowy odbywający się w malowniczej okolicy Jelcza-Laskowic. Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi przez zróżnicowany teren, oferując uczestnikom wyzwanie i satysfakcję z pokonania naturalnych przeszkód. Impreza przyciąga biegaczy ceniących sobie kontakt z naturą i sportową rywalizację w kameralnej atmosferze.
course_highlights: Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi przez teren crossowy z naturalnymi przeszkodami
Malownicze krajobrazy okolic Jelcza-Laskowic
Zróżnicowany teren leśny i polny

name: XXVIII Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie
description: XXVIII Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w Małkini Górnej, która przyciąga miłośników biegania i nordic walking z całego regionu. Trasa prowadzi malowniczymi, leśnymi ścieżkami w okolicy Gminnego Ośrodka Kultury i Sportu, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe sportowe emocje i kontakt z naturą. Wydarzenie ma charakter integracyjny i promuje aktywny tryb życia wśród różnych grup wiekowych. Organizatorzy zapewniają przyjazną atmosferę i profesjonalną organizację.
course_highlights: Malownicze leśne ścieżki wokół Gminnego Ośrodka Kultury i Sportu
Trasa dostosowana do biegaczy i uczestników nordic walking
Impreza o charakterze regionalnym z wieloletnią tradycją
additional: Impreza odbywa się w okolicy Gminnego Ośrodka Kultury i Sportu w Małkini Górnej. Wydarzenie łączy biegaczy i uczestników marszu nordic walking. Organizator to Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Małkini Górnej.

name: Festiwal Biegowy i Nordic Walking
location: Olszewo-Borki, Ostrołęka County, Masovian Voivodeship, Polska

name: Nice To Fit You Warszawska Dycha
Nowotarski Półmaraton
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Polska

name: XII Zielona Wierzchosławicka Dycha
location: Wierzchosławice, Tarnów County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Polska

name: 14. Bahrs-Kartoffellauf
description: The 14th Bahrs-Kartoffel-Lauf 2026 in Jembke offers runners a varied program with three distances: the 10 km Bahrs-Lauf, the 5 km Kartoffellauf, and an 800 m children’s run. The event takes place in a family-friendly atmosphere, with culinary delights and a varied program featuring performances by the Jembke cheerleaders. Race bibs must be returned after the run, and late registration is not available. The event is part of the running cup and offers not only sporting competition but also a chance to socialize over a generous cake buffet and hearty food.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Komoot
5 km course on Komoot
800 m children’s run
additional: Start times: 10 km Bahrs-Lauf at 10:30, 5 km Kartoffellauf at 12:00, and 800 m children’s run at 13:15. Late registration is not available; registration is in advance only. Race bibs must be returned after the run. Food options include potato soup, veggie bowls, potato pancakes with apple sauce, burgers, bratwurst, shashlik, and rosemary potatoes. The Jembke cheerleaders perform at approximately 11:45 and 13:00. Award ceremonies take place after each race. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, a variety of running options for all age groups, and the opportunity to combine the run with socializing.

name: Asse-Volkslauf und Nordic Walking
description: The Asse Fun Run and Nordic Walking event organized by TSV "Vater Jahn" Wittmar is held annually and will take place for the 34th time. The event is very popular, with record participation last year. It offers a range of running and walking routes in the beautiful surroundings of Wittmar and welcomes athletes of all ages. Registration is available from the end of June. Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run.
course_highlights: Distances of 0.3 km and 10.6 km
Nordic Walking included
Location: Wittmar, Germany
additional: Registration opens at the end of June; detailed information is available in the official announcement; the event includes running and Nordic Walking disciplines

name: Schusterlauf
description: The Schusterlauf Preetz is a traditional running event with various distances, held in Preetz. The challenging 16 km course runs through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker, and requires good to very good fitness. In addition to the main race, there are shorter distances, including the Bambini Run for children and the Kirchsee and Wehrberg runs. The event is part of the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, where participants can earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: 16 km course through forests, meadows and along Lake Lanker
Good, firm-footed trails in the Wehrberg and along the shore of Kirchsee
Challenging course with a checkpoint at Gut Wahlstorf
additional: Bib pickup is available the day before the event (19:00–20:00) and on event day from 08:00 at the Alte Wilhelminenhalle, Schulstraße 2, 24211 Preetz. Automatic participation in the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup with points scoring. Bib transfers are not possible. New service: Bags can be dropped off in a truck at the Market Square, near the finish. GPX files for the 5 km and 16 km courses are available to download. Courses are available as GPX files; online registration; start and finish in Preetz; includes a bag-drop service and results downloads.

name: Bergkloster-Lauf
description: The Bergklosterlauf, organized by TuS Velmede-Bestwig in cooperation with Bergkloster Bestwig, takes place in the Sauerland. The 6, 10 and 21 km races follow idyllic streams, cross ridges with magnificent viewpoints and pass through small settlements before finishing at Bergkloster Bestwig. Alongside the races, there are children’s and youth races and a supporting program featuring live music, childcare, free massages and extensive catering. The event is also part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup organized by LAC Veltins Hochsauerland. The start and finish are easy to reach and offer ample parking as well as affordable overnight accommodation at the monastery.
course_highlights: Routes pass idyllic streams
Ridges with magnificent viewpoints
Finish at Bergkloster Bestwig
additional: Free massages are available after the finish. Childcare is provided for “running parents.” The start and finish are only 600 meters apart and are easy to reach by bus, train or car. There are 500 parking spaces nearby, including spaces for motorhomes. Affordable overnight accommodation is available at Bergkloster. The 10 km race is also open to walkers. The children’s and youth races start at 12 noon. The 10 km race and the children’s and youth races count toward the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup. Routes of 6, 10 and 21 km; children’s and youth races; registration via Race Result; parking and accommodation at Bergkloster; route maps on Outdooractive

name: Internationaler Hochfelln-Berglauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Nenngeld 40.- € inklusive Nudelparty, Talfahrt mit der Hochfellnseilbahn, Parkplatz, Verpflegungsbuffet, Duschen, Gepäcktransport

description: The International Hochfelln Mountain Run is a traditional mountain race in Bergen, Germany, held annually. The course starts in the valley at the Hochfelln cable car station at an altitude of 600 metres and finishes at the summit of the Hochfelln at 1,671 metres. It is 7.8 km long, with 1,071 metres of elevation gain. The race is part of the Mountain Running Grand Prix and offers runners a challenging, scenic mountain-running experience. In addition to the race, the event includes a pasta party and a wide range of refreshments for participants.
course_highlights: 7.8 km course with 1,071 m of elevation gain
Start at the valley station of the Hochfelln cable car (600 m), finish at the Hochfelln summit (1,671 m)
Part of the Mountain Running Grand Prix, with challenging mountain terrain
additional: The €40 entry fee includes Saturday's pasta party, the downhill ride on the Hochfelln cable car, parking, a generous refreshment buffet, showers and luggage transport. Race bibs can be collected on the evening before the race and on race day. Welcome party with pasta dinner on Saturday evening. Mountain trail terrain, registration required, historic race with multiple editions.

name: Volkslauf durch das schöne Alstertal
description: The Volkslauf through the beautiful Alstertal takes place in Hamburg and offers runners an attractive natural course along the walking trails in the upper reaches of the Alster. The event includes various distances, from a half marathon to 10 km and 4 km, as well as introductory runs for children. The course stands out for its natural setting in the heart of Hamburg, with a few small climbs and stairs. The event is part of the 27th Hamburger Laufcup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical support.

name: 52. BMW Berlin-Marathon
description: The GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the world’s most renowned marathon events and part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors. On September 26, 2027, runners from around the world will gather to run through the streets of Berlin, cheered on by millions of enthusiastic spectators. The race is known for its unique energy, diversity, and the opportunity to achieve personal bests on a fast, flat course. In addition to the marathon, there are also exciting events for children and young people that promote running.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through central Berlin
Support from millions of spectators along the route
Part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors, with international prestige
additional: Children and young people can take part in special races such as the mini-MARATHON, Bambini-Lauf, and R5K Tour Finale, which take place on September 25, 2027. The event is supported by strong partners such as Generali and adidas.

name: Northeimer Stadtlauf
description: The Northeim City Run is a long-standing running event held in the city of Northeim. The races start and finish at Münsterplatz, a central location in the city. The run is organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V. and offers a sporting event for runners of all ages. The event takes place and includes various running routes through the city.

name: Aindlinger Kleeblattmarsch
description: The Aindling Cloverleaf March is a unique 24-hour march in which participants can cover up to 100 kilometers over four 25-kilometer loops. The route is not marked and there are no road closures, requiring considerable determination and a good sense of direction. The route passes through varied, hilly landscapes around Aindling, including woodland and open countryside as well as picturesque villages. The march supports social projects, combining athletic effort with a good cause.

name: Auricher Spendenlauf
description: The Aurich Charity Run is a charitable running event benefiting various organizations, including Leukin e.V. and the Sandhorst Volunteer Fire Department. The races take place around the Energy Experience Center in Aurich and offer competitions for all age groups, from a children’s race to main races over 5 and 10 kilometers. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of numerous volunteers and sponsors. Award ceremonies take place soon after the races, and certificates are available online.

name: Kienberglauf
description: The Kienberglauf is a traditional running event organized by SV 08 Oehrenstock e.V. and held annually on the last Sunday in September. The event offers various competitions for different age groups and ability levels, including Nordic walking, children’s races, and distances from 2 to 16 kilometers. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Oehrenstock near Ilmenau and is a highlight of club life. The fastest runners receive trophies, and all participants receive a certificate.

name: Kleeblattultra (100-Meilen-Lauf)
description: The Kleeblattultra is a challenging 100-mile ultramarathon in Schwarme, Lower Saxony, passing through three districts. The event was conceived with the idea of establishing the first 100-mile race in northern Germany. Organized by TSV Schwarme and a dedicated planning team, the race offers experienced ultrarunners a unique opportunity to complete the full distance. The event prioritizes comprehensive support, including timing, live tracking, and course refreshments.
course_highlights: 100 miles through three districts
Four individual course sections of 25 miles each
Start and finish area in Schwarme, with the sports hall serving as the event center
additional: Check-in on 24.09.2027 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 25.09.2027 from 07:00 to 08:30; briefing on 25.09.2027 at 08:30; finish cutoff on 26.09.2027 at 12:00; the race cutoff time is 27 hours; participant limit of 50 individual starters; open to participants aged 18 and over; free showers are available in the start and finish area; the entry fee includes timing, live tracking, a pasta party, a substantial breakfast, extensive race refreshments, certificate printing, and a high-quality finisher shirt.

name: Marner Kohltagelauf
description: The Marner Kohltagelauf is a traditional race in Marne and an official part of the Dithmarschen Cup and the Dithmarscher Firmencup. The event offers various distances, from 400 meters for children to 10 kilometers for adults. The courses are closed to traffic, clearly marked, and every kilometer is marked. Timing is handled professionally using a chip attached to the race bib, and the event takes place in almost any weather.
course_highlights: Courses are closed to traffic and clearly marked
Every kilometer is marked
Water stations every 5 km and refreshments at the finish (mineral water, isotonic drinks, fruit)
additional: Late registration is possible online until 30 minutes before the start, with a €5 late registration fee. Timing uses a chip attached to the race bib, with no rental fee. Changing rooms are available, and showers can be used after the event at the Marne swimming pool.

name: Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf
description: The 10th Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf is a traditional scenic race for running and Nordic walking enthusiasts, held in the picturesque surroundings of Möhrendorf. The course follows forest, meadow, and field paths, passing numerous carp ponds, and includes around 150 metres of elevation gain over 21.1 km. In addition to the half marathon, there are Nordic walking events and various youth and children’s races. The event offers a varied, nature-rich setting for runners of all ages.

name: Nordahl Grieg Gedenklauf
organizer: Förderverein der Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule mit gymnasialer Oberstufe Kleinmachnow
description: The Nordahl Grieg Memorial Run is a traditional running event in Kleinmachnow, held at Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule. The event offers various races for Bambini, schoolchildren, young people, and adults on circuits around the school and Lake Kleinmachnow. All participants receive drinks and refreshments in the finish area, as well as medals after crossing the finish line. The event is organized by the Friends Association of Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule and is held under the patronage of the Norwegian Ambassador and the Mayor of Kleinmachnow.

name: Ruhstorfer Geländelauf
description: The Ruhstorf Cross-Country Run is an approximately 7.5-kilometer trail run around Ruhstorf an der Rott, taking in beautiful scenery and several climbs. The route is roughly half asphalt and half farm and meadow paths. Its attractive natural setting makes the run suitable for both ambitious runners and beginners. It takes place annually and is part of the 2024 Grenzland Running Cup. The event is organized by SVG Ruhstorf e.V. and offers a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: SPORT IN Reisberglauf
description: The 29th SPORT IN Reisberglauf takes place in Lippertshofen. The race is recognized by the German Athletics Association (DLV), which means performances can be officially included in athletics rankings. Two distances are offered: a short 400-meter race and a longer 13.8-kilometer race. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete in an official, recognized event.

name: Bleckeder Storchenlauf
description: The 1st Bleckede Stork Run is taking place, offering runners and walkers a choice of distances in the natural surroundings of the sports field in Bleckede. The routes pass through wooded areas and open spaces with small to moderate hills, providing varied running conditions. Bib numbers and chips must be collected 30 minutes before the respective start. The event is organized by VfL Bleckede von 1862 e. V. and is open to participants of all ages, including a Bambini run for the youngest children.

name: City-Lauf Lübeck
description: The City Run Lübeck is a long-established running event offering different distances for various age groups and interests. The event includes a Bambini run, a students’ run, unicycling, a 5 km run and walking, as well as a 10 km main race. The routes lead through Lübeck city centre and feature varied courses that are adapted each year to current conditions. The event is open to all runners, including those who are not members of a club, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with team competitions and a supporting programme.
course_highlights: Route through Lübeck’s historic city centre
Circuit for unicyclists, who are required to wear protective gear
Varied routes for Bambinis, students, and the 5 km and 10 km races
additional: Late registrations are possible up to the day of the event; on the day itself, late registration is available only for the 10 km race. T-shirts for late registrants are available only while stocks last. Unicyclists must wear protective gear, and team competitions are held for students and the 5 km race. The race bibs must not be altered in shape or size.

name: Crosslauf Friedrichsruh mit Kreismeisterschaft
description: The Friedrichsruh Cross-Country Run with District Championships is a cross-country event in Geestland, Germany, held at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg. The event is organized by TV Langen von 1908 e.V. and offers various distances, from 0.5 km for the youngest participants up to 25 km. In addition to the district championship races for children, young people, and adults, there are also open supporting races over distances from 2.5 km to 10 km. The event is characterized by a friendly club atmosphere and a focused local running event.

name: Crosslauf und Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder
description: The Cross-Country Run & Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder takes place and is organized by SV Grün-Weiß Birkenwerder e.V. Several race distances from 400 m to 8.6 km are offered, as well as a Nordic walking event in which proper pole technique is mandatory. The event is open to various age groups, from Bambini to seniors, and all participants receive a printable certificate, with medals awarded to places 1 to 3. Registration is online and limited to 500 starting places; late registration is possible up to the day of the event.

name: Einstein-Marathon
description: The Ulm Einstein Marathon is one of the largest running events in southern Germany and attracts over 15,000 runners each year. The event offers various disciplines, including the marathon, half marathon, relays and Nordic walking. The course runs through the city of Ulm and offers a varied running experience with an urban atmosphere. The event is known for its professional organisation and the option to transfer or change entries flexibly.
course_highlights: Course through the historic city of Ulm, with views of Ulm Minster
A range of disciplines: marathon, half marathon, relay, Nordic walking
Professional organisation, with race bib collection available on several days
additional: A late registration fee of €5 applies. Entries can be transferred digitally until the registration deadline, and only in person after that. Changes to another discipline can be made online until the registration deadline, and only in person after that, for a fee of €5. Race packs can be collected over two days at different locations. Running with strollers, bicycles or dogs is not permitted.

name: Elmshorner Stadtlauf
description: The Elmshorn City Run is a traditional running event for the whole family, appealing to young and old alike. The main course follows an officially measured 5-kilometre loop through Elmshorn’s largely paved city centre. Shorter distances of 600 metres and 1.5 kilometres are offered for children, making the city run a varied sporting event for all age groups. The event is known for its great atmosphere and for incorporating state championships over 5 and 10 kilometres.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km loop through Elmshorn city centre
Largely paved course
Children’s distances of 600 m and 1.5 km
additional: In addition to the main races, the city run includes SHLV state championships over 5 and 10 km. Children receive medals. The event offers entertainment for the little ones and a lively atmosphere with musical accompaniment. The course is inspected annually to ensure safety.

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
description: Běchovice–Prague is a legendary 10 km road race with the longest unbroken tradition in Europe, now being held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech Republic Road Running Championships and features a challenging 10,031-metre course that will test every runner. The exceptional atmosphere is complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying programme and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and also offers a relay race.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and a sense of belonging among residents of their district. The race is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, as well as people with disabilities, who represent their district. Every start earns points in the competition to determine Prague’s most sporting district. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with original medals and gifts for participants.

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: Mariatálsky štvanec is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Little Carpathians, offering a range of events for recreational and competitive runners. The event takes place in the village of Marianka, with a family-friendly atmosphere, and culminates in a beautiful sunset. You can compete in the 6 km, 10 km, and 15 km categories, in three-person teams over 3×6 km, or in the children’s Beh Záhoráčik races. The start and finish are at the football pitch, and the race is governed by the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation.

name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
location: Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, OÚ Ľubietová
description: MTHIKER Kylof Ľubietová is a running race that combines history, nature and a great atmosphere in the picturesque heart of Slovakia. There are three race distances: a 4.3 km hobby run for beginners and young runners aged 13 and over, a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners, and an 850 m children’s race for children aged 6 to 12. The course features climbs and beautiful views of the Low Tatras. Runners can compete for cash prizes and valuable awards. After the finish, participants can enjoy traditional granadír and an original medal that is part of the Marathon Tour.

name: Gréta Run
location: Liptovská .Sielnica okres L. Mikuláš, Liptovská .Sielnica okres L. Mikuláš, 8,7 km štart z Kvačianskej doliny (ústie) , 15 km štart z Koliby Gréta
description: Gréta Run is a traditional running race set in the scenic surroundings of Kvačianska Valley and Liptovská Sielnica, offering routes of various lengths for children and adults. The race follows the yellow hiking trail and the embankment, finishing at Koliba Gréta, where refreshments and a cultural programme await participants. The event also includes a rich programme of activities for families and children. The organizer, the Liptov Olympic Club, provides high-quality technical and medical services.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 5. kolo
description: Šamorín Running League 2026 – Round 5 is a running event organized by 3klub Šamorín in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. The races take place in the pleasant surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park in Šamorín and are open to various age groups, from preschool children to adults. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race begins at 10:30. The event offers participants the opportunity to take part in the league and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a community setting.

name: Svatováclavský běh Blažovicemi
organizer: Spolek přátel Svatováclavského běhu - sdružení Vévoda
description: The St. Wenceslas Run through Blažovice is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Blažovice in the South Moravian Region. It offers two main routes of 10 km and 5 km, running mostly along natural paths and forest trails. The event also includes community runs and children’s races ranging from 50 to 1,100 metres, making it appealing to a wide audience and families with children. It is organised by the Friends of the St. Wenceslas Run Association, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.

name: Běh Neumannovou stezkou
description: The Neumann Trail Run is a traditional running race organized by the T. J. Sokol Unhošť running club in the picturesque, wooded surroundings of Unhošť. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in nature and is complemented by children’s races. Runners who register in advance receive a lower entry fee. The event has a long history and is held regularly in autumn.

name: MilešovKa(p)
description: MilešovKa(p) is a traditional 17.5 km running race from Teplice to Milešovka, with 846 m of elevation gain. The course follows asphalt roads, hiking trails, and dirt and forest paths, and is marked with the Czech Tourist Club’s red and blue trail markings. The race is open to the general public and offers awards for the top finishers in each category, hill climbers, and age-record holders. It is organized by SPONA Teplice, an association that supports amateur sport in the region. The results are announced alongside other running events in November.

name: Běh kolem Panské skály
description: The Run Around Panská skála is a popular trail race held in Kamenický Šenov-Prácheň in the Liberec Region. The race offers 3 km and 6 km routes through the hilly terrain around Panská skála and is part of the Českolipsko District Running League. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced competitors, offering a unique running experience in nature with beautiful views.

name: Kauno rajono bėgimas 2026
location: Aikštė prie Senosios Zapyškio Šv. Jono Krikštytojo bažnyčios, Zapyškis, Kaunas District Municipality, Lithuania
description: The traditional Kaunas District Run invites running enthusiasts to Pakaunė. This year, it will take place in Zapyškis, by the Old St. John the Baptist Church of Zapyškis. The event is for participants of all ages who want to spend time actively and test their abilities in beautiful natural surroundings. It is a great opportunity to meet like-minded people and enjoy a sporting celebration in Kaunas District. The event is professionally organized, ensuring participants’ safety and a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the square at the Old St. John the Baptist Church of Zapyškis
The route passes through the beautiful nature and rural areas of Pakaunė
A traditional event with a friendly atmosphere and races for different age groups
