name: ACE BATTLE RUN:  ACE BATTLE Mile indywidualni zawody rankingowe na dystan...
description: ACE BATTLE RUN to nowatorski format taktycznego biegu drużynowego odbywający się na dystansie jednej mili (1609 m) na Stadionie Podskarbińska w Warszawie. Zawody łączą indywidualne kwalifikacje z rywalizacją drużynową, gdzie wynik indywidualny i drużynowy wpływa na oficjalny ranking biegaczy. Sezon 2027 to emocjonujące pojedynki i rywalizacja o miejsce w ACE BATTLE Mile City League Warsaw. Biegacze mogą startować solo lub w drużynach, zdobywając poziomy i ratingi w systemie ACE BATTLE RUN.
course_highlights: Dystans jednej mili (1609 m) na stadionie
Rywalizacja indywidualna i drużynowa z oficjalnym rankingiem
Emocjonujące mecze drużynowe w formacie taktycznym
additional: Zawody składają się z trzech etapów: kwalifikacji indywidualnej, biegu drużynowego o poziom ABR oraz ratingu drużynowego ACE BATTLE Mile. Drużyny zdobywają oficjalny rating, a każdy uczestnik zostaje zawodnikiem ABM. Po sezonie drużyny z ratingiem rozgrywają mecze bezpośrednie w ACE BATTLE Mile City League Warsaw. Wyniki i galerie zdjęć z minionych wydarzeń są dostępne online. Oficjalna strona wskazuje Stadion Podskarbińska jako lokalizację formatu ACE BATTLE RUN. W programie systemu są także briefing, role drużynowe i nagrody.

name: OTF presented by DYNAFIT
description: The OTF presented by DYNAFIT is a trail running festival in Oberaudorf, Bavaria. It offers five distances from 12 km to 100 km, including the new OTF 100 XXL Ultra, with 104 km and 5,900 meters of elevation gain. The event is part of the ITRA National League and offers ITRA points for the various distances. The afterparty adds to the lively atmosphere, bringing runners and spectators together to celebrate.

name: Podzimní běh projektantů "Od hospody k hospodě"
description: The Designers’ Autumn Run “From Pub to Pub” is a traditional running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4-Krč. The race is popular with runners and has been held for many years, welcoming all running enthusiasts and nature lovers. Organizers Pepa Krejčí and Honza Vočko warmly invite you to take part in this popular race, which offers an enjoyable experience in nature. Registration is available on race day, approximately one hour before the start.

name: Baran Trail Race
description: Baran Trail Race to cykliczne zawody biegowe odbywające się w malowniczej Węgierskiej Górce. Zawody oferują różnorodne dystanse od 10 km do 100 km, prowadzące przez wymagające, górskie trasy z pięknymi widokami i naturalnym terenem. Impreza przyciąga zarówno amatorów, jak i doświadczonych biegaczy, oferując wyjątkowe wyzwania i atmosferę. Organizatorzy dbają o profesjonalny przebieg zawodów oraz bezpieczeństwo uczestników.

name: Běh Karla Havlíčka Borovského
location: Park Budoucnost, Havlíčkův Brod, Czech Republic
description: The Karel Havlíček Borovský Run is a traditional circuit race in Havlíčkův Brod, offering distances for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The route runs through Budoucnost Park and passes notable landmarks, including the memorial to the victims of the world wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský. The race is suitable for all age groups and features a mix of paved and unpaved paths with gentle elevation changes. The start and finish are at the elementary school at V Sadech 560, where showers and toilets are also available.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Biegnij Warszawo to jedno z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych wydarzeń biegowych w Polsce, które co roku gromadzi tysiące uczestników w sercu stolicy. Bieg odbywa się w pierwszą sobotę października i oferuje trasę o długości 10 km prowadzącą przez najbardziej charakterystyczne miejsca Warszawy. Formuła FUNRUN zachęca do udziału wszystkich, niezależnie od wieku i doświadczenia, stawiając na radość z ruchu i dobrą zabawę bez presji rywalizacji. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na muzyczne strefy, doping kibiców oraz kompleksowe zabezpieczenie medyczne na trasie.
course_highlights: Trasa 10 km przez najbardziej klimatyczne i charakterystyczne miejsca Warszawy
Muzyczne strefy i doping kibiców na całej długości trasy
Trasa posiada atest PZLA i jest przyjazna dla początkujących biegaczy
additional: Pakiet startowy zawiera koszulkę Nike Dri-FIT z okolicznościowym nadrukiem, numer startowy z chipem do pomiaru czasu, upominki od partnerów oraz medal okolicznościowy. Na trasie znajduje się strefa nawadniania w połowie dystansu, a organizator zapewnia kompleksowe zabezpieczenie medyczne. Limit uczestników wynosi 10 000 osób.

name: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazow...
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Czerwonce Włościańskiej, Czerwonka Włościańska, Polska
description: Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazowieckiej to bieg na dystansie 5 km, który odbywa się w malowniczej miejscowości Czerwonka Włościańska. Start i meta zlokalizowane są przy Szkole Podstawowej w Czerwonce, a trasa przebiega wzdłuż drogi krajowej nr 60 między Makowem Mazowieckim a Różanem. Impreza organizowana jest przez lokalne kluby sportowe i instytucje, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalną organizację oraz dekorację zwycięzców. Bieg jest otwarty dla osób powyżej 18 lat oraz młodszych za zgodą opiekuna prawnego.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 5 km wzdłuż drogi krajowej nr 60
Start i meta przy Szkole Podstawowej w Czerwonce Włościańskiej
Malownicza okolica Niziny Mazowieckiej
additional: Limit uczestników wynosi 200 pakietów startowych. Rejestracja i odbiór pakietów odbywa się w biurze zawodów na boisku szkolnym w Czerwonce od 08:30 do 10:00. Po biegu przewidziana jest dekoracja zwycięzców oraz podsumowanie imprezy.

name: XIII Podbieg na Makowicę
description: XIII Podbieg na Makowicę to bieg górski na dystansie 10 km, odbywający się w malowniczej miejscowości Rytro w województwie małopolskim. Zawody są doskonałą okazją do sprawdzenia swojej kondycji na wymagającej trasie z podbiegami. Organizatorzy oferują plany treningowe dostosowane do różnych poziomów zaawansowania, aby pomóc uczestnikom w optymalnym przygotowaniu do startu. Impreza ma charakter kameralny i przyjazny dla biegaczy, którzy cenią sobie kontakt z naturą i sportową rywalizację.
course_highlights: Trasa górska o długości 10 km
Malownicze widoki w okolicach Rytro
Wyzwanie w postaci podbiegów na Makowicę
additional: Organizatorzy oferują plany treningowe od 8 do 20 tygodni, dostosowane do poziomu VDOT biegacza, z instrukcjami i wsparciem ekspertów. Możliwość zarządzania wizytówką biegu i współpracy marketingowej na platformie TreningBiegacza.pl.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
Saerbecker Kirmeslauf
price_range: Bambinilauf € 1,00; Schülerläufe 1,2 km und 2 km € 3,00; 5 km Jedermannlauf € 8,00; 10 km Hauptlauf € 10,00
description: The Saerbecker Kirmeslauf takes place at the Sparkassen-Stadion Saerbeck. The course is entirely paved and flat, and runs along well-maintained side roads, making fast times possible. The event offers races for different age groups, with chip timing and results determined by finish order. Children receive medals, and awards are presented for the overall and age-group rankings. Participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Well-maintained, entirely paved course
Flat side roads for fast times
Start and finish at the Sparkassen-Stadion Saerbeck
additional: Timing is provided by a chip attached to the back of the race bib. Finish order determines the results. Certificates are available online for all participants. The course is monitored by volunteers, but traffic rules must still be followed. Every child receives a medal in the children's races. Liability for theft is excluded. Participants must confirm that they are in a healthy state of training. Online registration is available; late entries are accepted on the event day for a fee; the event is held under official supervision in accordance with DLV/IWR rules.

name: 16. Köhlbrandbrückenlauf
description: The Köhlbrandbrückenlauf is Germany’s largest bridge run and crosses the landmark in the Port of Hamburg. The course offers runners a unique experience with impressive views of the port and the Köhlbrand Bridge. The event attracts numerous participants every year and is known for its special atmosphere and sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Run across the famous Köhlbrand Bridge in the Port of Hamburg
Impressive panoramic views of the port during the run
Course through the South/West Terminal grounds with an urban port atmosphere
additional: Registration opens on December 3, 2026, and experience suggests it fills up quickly. Bag storage is available on event day, and every finisher receives a medal. Travel by public transport or bicycle is recommended, as parking is very limited.

name: 26. Bismarck-Gedenklauf
description: The Bismarck Memorial Run is an annual road and forest race in Schönhausen (Elbe), Saxony-Anhalt, held on German Unity Day. Organized by SV Preussen 27 Schönhausen, it is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP and offers 6.5 km and 13 km distances, as well as shorter races for children and young people. The course starts at the club’s sports center and follows paved roads into the forest, past Kollerberg. The longer distance is run twice. The event honors Otto von Bismarck, Schönhausen’s most famous son, and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments at the sports center.

name: 28. Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The 28th Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf takes place in Alfeld, Lower Saxony. Various distances are offered for adults, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, all finishing in Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, signposted courses are ideal for running at a steady pace. There are also races for children and teenagers, making for a varied program.

name: 49. Warburger Oktoberwochen Volkslauf
description: The Warburg Oktoberwochen Run is a long-standing running event in Warburg, held annually in October. The event offers various distances, including a 5 km company competition, and is open to young people, school students, and adult runners. It takes place at the Diemelaue Sports Center and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and involvement of the local sporting community. Warburger SV organizes the run and promotes grassroots sport in the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Diemelaue Sports Center
5 km course with a company competition
Family-friendly running event with youth and school student categories
additional: The entry fee is collected by SEPA direct debit via RaceResult.

name: 10km Lauf Neuhütten
description: The Neuhütten 10 km run is a popular race starting and finishing at Burgfriedenhalle in Wüstenrot-Neuhütten. The course is a gently rolling but fast loop, suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers age-group rankings up to M/W 80 and a finisher’s medal for young participants. After the race, there is an awards ceremony with prizes and certificates. The race is also part of the Laufcup Schwäbisch Fränkischer Wald.

name: Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The Alfelder Leinetal Run takes place in Alfeld, Germany. Races are offered over 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, all finishing at Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, marked courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and young people, making for a varied program.

name: Burgentrail Unterfränkische Traillaufmeisterschaften
description: The Burgentrail in Ostheim is a challenging trail-running event that hosts the Lower Franconian Trail Running Championships. The course follows varied forest and meadow paths, passing historic castle ruins such as Lichtenburg and Königsburg, and features technically demanding trails with roots and steep descents. The scenic backdrop, with views across the Grabfeld, makes the race a special experience for trail-running enthusiasts of all ability levels. SC Ostheim/Rhön warmly invites all running enthusiasts to take part in this sporting highlight.

name: Crailsheimer Sparkassenlauf (4. Lauf des 4-Jahreszeiten Laufcup 2026)
description: The Crailsheim Sparkassenlauf is a family-friendly sporting event held in the city center of Crailsheim. The event offers a variety of race distances for all ages and fitness levels, including Bambini, student and main races, as well as walking and relay races. The races follow varied circuits through the heart of the city, with enthusiastic spectators and a lively atmosphere. Sustainability and community are a focus, so participants can take part in a sporting event that is also environmentally conscious with a clear conscience.

name: Cross der deutschen Einheit
description: The Cross der Deutschen Einheit in Weißensee is a traditional cross-country race organized by the sports club Blau-Weiß 1921 Weißensee e.V. This race is being held for the 35th time and offers various competitions for all age groups, including Bambini races, youth races, a 3.5 km race, a 10.5 km race, a half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking. The course runs around the Gondelteich, with varied sections including climbs and stairs, and offers a sporting challenge for runners of all ability levels. A jubilee relay race rounds off the program and requires no registration or entry fee.

name: Duvenstedter Dorflauf
description: The Duvenstedter Dorflauf is a traditional race in and around Alt Duvenstedt, held annually on German Unity Day. With over 350 participants, the event offers various distances for children, young people, and adults. The course is well marked and includes a 10.6 km main race, as well as a 5.5 km fun run and Nordic walking event. The event is supported by the village community and the volunteer fire brigade, who help ensure everything runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Main race splits at approximately 6.5 km
Start and finish at Alt Duvenstedt Primary School
The course is marked with signs matching the bib colors
additional: Timing is done using transponders that are loaned free of charge; a fee of 40 euros applies if they are not returned. Changing and shower facilities are available in the sports hall, but there are no lockers. After the race, each participant can receive a free drink, cake, or sausage by handing in their voucher.

name: Herbstlauf TuS Ofen
location: Ofen, Bad Zwischenahn, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The TuS Ofen Autumn Run is a family-friendly event taking place for the 35th time. It offers distances for all age and ability groups, from 800 m for the youngest participants and a 3 km schoolchildren’s run to a 5 km walking event and fun run, and the 10 km EDEKA-Böse Run for ambitious runners. The start and finish are at the TuS Ofen sports field. A large cake buffet in the sports hall will provide refreshments, and all participants will receive a gingerbread heart at the finish as a special treat.

name: Krautsander Insellauf
description: The Krautsand Island Run is a long-standing running event on the Elbe island of Krautsand near Drochtersen. Organized by SV Dornbusch and TV Wischhafen, the race offers an attractive route in a natural setting. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and takes place annually on October 3. It is organized by the Kehdingen Athletics Association, which ensures everything runs smoothly.

name: Langeooger Sanddornlauf 2026
description: The Langeoog Sea Buckthorn Run takes place on the island of Langeoog and offers races for different age groups. The main races cover 5 km and 10 km on paved paths and roads, ideal for island residents and visitors. There are also dedicated races for young runners: 400 m (Bambini) and 1,000 m (youth). The event marks the end of the island running series and is supported by the island school. The awards ceremony takes place in front of the Haus der Insel, where runners gather after crossing the finish line.

name: Neudorfer Fichtelberglauf mit LM Berglauf
description: The Neudorf Fichtelberg Run is a challenging mountain race covering 9.4 kilometers with 550 meters of elevation gain. It has been held annually in Sehmatal in the Ore Mountains since 1987. Considered the toughest mountain race in Saxony, it attracts both professional and amateur runners. The race starts at the Neudorf Spinning Mill and finishes on the Fichtelberg summit plateau. The event includes an open state mountain running championship and offers a free shuttle service for the return journey.

name: Oberbayerische Straßenlaufmeisterschaften 10 km
description: The Schweiger Forest Run is a long-standing running event organized by LG Sempt in Anzing, held annually on October 3 since 1983. The 44th edition in 2026 offers fast courses and a family-friendly atmosphere in the heart of the Anzing Forest. The Upper Bavarian 10 km Road Running Championships are held as part of the Forest Run. The event is open to runners of all age groups and is known for its excellent organization and large running community.

name: Ochsenweiherlauf Emskirchen
description: The Ochsenweiherlauf in Emskirchen is a long-standing running event organized by TSV Emskirchen and held annually on October 3. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a youth/schoolchildren’s run, a fun run, walking, and the 10 km main race. The course follows paved forest paths around the Ochsenweiher and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. Refreshments are provided, and times can be used for the German Sports Badge.

name: Rodenbacher Lauftag
description: The Rodenbacher Lauftag is a long-standing race for peace and democracy in Europe, taking place for the seventh time. The event offers four competitions for the whole family on a flat, paved, IAAF-measured high-speed course through the oxygen-rich Rodenbach Forest. A special highlight is the stadium finish at the end of the 5 km circuit, offering exciting views for spectators and runners. The youngest participants can enjoy an entertaining stadium cross-country race with obstacles, commentated by an experienced team of announcers. The race is ideal preparation for an autumn marathon and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization.

name: Stauch Cup
description: The Stauch Cup, also known as the Kupferzeller Kärwelauf, is a long-standing running event in Kupferzell. It offers a variety of distances for all age groups, including a toddlers’ race, children’s and youth races, a health run, Nordic walking, and a main race. The event takes place around the Carl-Julius-Weber-Halle, which also serves as the start and finish area and provides changing rooms and showers. The award ceremonies are held in the hall, where refreshments are available, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Strausseelauf
description: The Straussee Run in Strausberg is a traditional annual running event. It gives runners of different ability levels the opportunity to compete and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Straussee. The event is organized by Kultur- und Sportclub Strausberg e.V. and takes place at Theodor Fontane Gymnasium in Strausberg. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: Taubertal 100
location: Rothenburg ob der Tauber, Bavaria, Germany
description: Taubertal 100 is a scenic ultramarathon offering distances of 50 km, 70 km, 100 km, and 100 miles. The point-to-point course runs from Rothenburg ob der Tauber through the Tauber Valley to Bad Mergentheim, Tauberbischofsheim, Wertheim, or Gemünden. The race is IAU Bronze certified and offers a measured course eligible for official rankings, particularly the 100-mile distance. The event takes place annually on the first Saturday in October, combining an athletic challenge with an attractive holiday region. Mandatory equipment is required for the 100-mile distance, and extensive refreshment and return-transport options are provided.
course_highlights: Point-to-point course on a paved cycle path through the Tauber Valley
Elevation profiles with moderate climbs and varied sections, for example between km 85 and 95
Officially measured course and IAU Bronze certification for all distances; the 100-mile distance is eligible for rankings
additional: Mandatory equipment applies only to 100-mile runners from km 100, with a drop bag. Bus transport is available from various finish locations back to Rothenburg. Shower facilities are available at all finish locations. Runner dinner with a talk on Friday evening at Hotel Rappen. Online race briefing via Teams on the Monday before the race, in German and English. Every kilometer is marked; turns are marked three times, with reflective bands at night.

name: 4 Moore Ultratrail-Marathon
description: The 4 Moore Ultratrail Marathon is a non-commercial 53-kilometer ultratrail run through the countryside around Langenhagen. The route passes through a variety of moorland and heathland areas, including Kananoher Forst, Schwarzes Moor, Otternhagener Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Große Heide and Bissendorfer Moor. The course is unmarked and navigated by GPS; the final GPS track and a briefing are sent by email in advance. Three aid stations provide drinks and snacks. Participants must bring their own hydration containers and cups. Entry is limited to 50 runners, and the time limit is 9 hours.

name: PUMA Třeboňský půl/maraton 10 a 5 km
description: The Puma Třeboň Marathon, Half Marathon, 10 km and 5 km races run through the unique natural landscape of the Třeboňsko Protected Landscape Area. The courses are flat with minimal elevation gain, mostly following paved cycling paths and forest trails, allowing runners to achieve personal bests in beautiful, peaceful surroundings. The race starts in Třeboň’s Renaissance square and passes through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO listing. The ideal October date offers pleasant running weather and a motivating atmosphere, with professional pacers on the course.

name: Run Berounka Run
description: Run Berounka Run is a relay race for teams and individuals, following the Berounka River from Újezd u Svatého Kříže to Prague-Radotín. The 130 km route is divided into 6 sections, with over 3,100 metres of elevation gain, mostly on forest and dirt roads. The race starts from 5:00 a.m. in several waves, while the Ultra category starts in the evening. The race is open to teams of 2 to 6 runners and individuals in the Ultra category. Winners are announced in several categories, and refreshments are provided at the finish.

name: 24DS (24 Dlouhé Stráně)
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: 24DS is a 24-hour endurance challenge in the unique setting of the Hrubý Jeseník mountains, running from Kouty nad Desnou to the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage hydroelectric power station. The race offers stunning views of the Jeseníky Mountains and combines day and night running with sunrise and sunset. The demanding route has 820 metres of elevation gain and is 90% trail, making it suitable for individuals and pairs. The Kouty nad Desnou resort offers comfortable facilities, including restaurants, accommodation and parking.

name: Běh kolem Hejtmanu
description: The Run Around Hejtman is a traditional sporting event held in Chlum u Třeboně in the Třeboň region on the second Saturday in October. The main event is a 10 km run with a time limit of 1 hour and 20 minutes, following local roads and fishpond dams through picturesque surroundings. The race is open to the public and takes place amid regular road traffic, with an emphasis on safety and compliance with the rules. Shorter races are organized for children and young people up to 15 years old, with on-site registration on race day. The organizer is TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně, z.s.

name: ČEZ RunTour Praha
location: Praha, Park Ladronka (u televizní věže), Praha
description: ČEZ RunTour Prague is a family-friendly running event offering distances of 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km for recreational runners and elite athletes, as well as children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ladronka Park and is part of a nationwide series held at eight unique locations. The organisers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, including an accompanying programme and a charitable element. Every participant receives a race pack and can support charity by taking part.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - říjen
location: Příluky, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 2 Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of fewer than two laps on a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant can look forward to a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish as a reward for their effort.

name: Běh na Čerťák
description: Běh na Čerťák is a traditional race organized by AK Běžci z Rýmařova, held at the Flemmich Garden complex in Rýmařov. The race offers courses for various age categories, from preschoolers to seniors, with the main route running along forest roads and over the summit of Kamenná hora. The start is at the SKI Flemmich Garden complex, and the course includes field roads, meadows, and forest trails with beautiful views. Refreshments and the results ceremony are provided after the race at the SKI complex. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region, and category winners receive prizes.

name: Benešovská osmička
description: Benešovská osmička is a traditional cross-country race in Benešov near Semily, held for more than half a century. The race offers courses for the whole family, from preschool children to veterans, with the main 8,000-metre race winding through the picturesque countryside around the village and along the slopes of Benešov Hill. The start and race facilities are at the sports complex in Horní Benešov. Prizes are provided for competitors, and light refreshments are available for all participants and spectators.

name: Běh města Příbrami
description: The Příbram City Run is a traditional running event held for the 32nd year in the picturesque setting of Nový rybník in Příbram. The event offers various categories, including the 10 km main race, relays, and children’s runs, welcoming a wide range of runners. It is suitable for families, students, and individuals looking to enjoy a sporting day in a friendly atmosphere. Start times and registration are tailored to each category to ensure everything runs smoothly and is well organized.

name: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run
location: Liberec, Náměstí Dr. E. Beneše před libereckou radnicí, Liberecký
description: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run is a race in nature that gives runners the chance to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy running along forest trails in the Jizera Mountains. It is the final race of the season and runs through the forest, around a reservoir, across a granite quarry, and back. Runners can choose between a shorter 12 km route and a longer 22 km route, allowing them to test their strength amid beautiful natural scenery.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - říjen
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open race for runners of all ages and abilities who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. The course follows Stromovka’s paved paths. Adults run two laps (3.2 km), while children aged 12 and under run one lap (1.6 km). After the race, everyone is rewarded with a warm cinnamon pancake. The race is part of the year-round Lívancový pohár, which encourages regular participation and reflection on performance.

name: SILESIA kros 1/2marathon ZRUŠENO
description: SILESIA Cross 1/2 Marathon is a traditional cross-country running race held in Opava-Kylešovice, with its event hub at the U Chovatelů grounds. The race offers 21 km and 13 km courses that pass through scenic locations including Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka and Opava. The course is challenging and partly uses roads open to traffic. Participants must follow fair-play rules and respect nature. Times are recorded electronically without chips, and the awards ceremony takes place at the finish venue. The 2026 race has been cancelled, but information about previous editions and courses is available.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
description: The Run Through the Chateau Park is a race set in the picturesque surroundings of Vlašim Chateau Park. The 8.4 km course combines off-road and paved sections, offering runners a varied experience. The race is organized by Atletika Vlašim, z.s., and is part of the official Czech Running calendar. The event is ideal for runners looking to enjoy a run in a beautiful park with a historic atmosphere.

name: Z(a)tracené vrchy
description: Z(a)tracené vrchy is an adrenaline-fueled team orienteering-and-beer race that combines running, walking, and crawling, held in the scenic terrain of Bordovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. Participants must complete the course carrying a 10-liter keg of beer on their backs, take part in mini-games at checkpoints, and drink the beer at the checkpoints. The race combines a physical challenge with teamwork and fun, and the course winds through rugged terrain with climbs and descents. The winning team receives a perpetual trophy and gift packages. The event is for adults over 18 and emphasizes participant safety and responsibility.

name: Běh Pístovickou riviérou
description: The Pístovice Riviera Run is a traditional cross-country race along forest paths above the Pístovice Riviera recreation area in Pístovice near Vyškov. The race is open to everyone who enjoys healthy exercise, from children to adults, and takes place in all weather. The course is uneven, with possible puddles and mud, and includes uphill and downhill running and walking. The organizers, Lyžařský klub Vyškov, warmly invite runners and spectators to take part and support sport in the region.

name: Cibulka - Košířský okruh
description: Cibulka - Košířský Circuit is a popular running race held in Prague’s Košíře district, featuring a course approximately 4.5 km long. The race is part of a series of local running events and is intended for recreational runners as well as those looking to improve their performance in a natural setting. The route follows forest roads and trails around the Cibulka lookout tower, providing a pleasant and varied environment for running. The event is suitable for all ages and running levels, with an emphasis on enjoying exercise outdoors.

name: Běh za bořetickým burčákem
description: The Run for Bořetice Burčák is a traditional sporting event held in the picturesque wine-growing village of Bořetice, in the heart of the Blue Mountains. The run gives participants the chance to experience the beautiful landscape of vineyards and wine cellars characteristic of this area of South Moravia. The event is organized by the Bořetice Municipal Cultural Commission, SDH Bořetice and the Republic of Kraví hora, and is part of the village’s rich cultural calendar. The run is scheduled to start in the afternoon at Sólo, by the cultural center.

name: Jarabský polmaratón
location: Jarabá, Brezno District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia
description: The Jarabá Half Marathon is a unique mountain trail race in the Low Tatras, covering 22.1 km. It features a demanding course with climbs, descents, and technical terrain. The race is designed for trail-running and active-outdoor enthusiasts, who can enjoy beautiful views and the atmosphere of a running community ranging from professionals to recreational athletes. The event has been held since 2015 and embodies the spirit of a friendly running get-together: “Go as you can around Jarabá.” In 2025, it is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League, underscoring its quality and challenge.

name: U.S.Steel Family Run – Minimaratón
description: The U. S. Steel Family Run - Mini-Marathon is a running event in Košice and part of the traditional International Peace Marathon. Runners of all ages are welcome, with no age restrictions. The event follows the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletic Federation, and the organizers ensure thorough preparation and organization. The start and finish are on Hlavná Street in Košice, making for an appealing city run.

name: Matúškovský beh
organizer: Občianske združenie DAM Šport Matúškovo a obec Matúškovo

price_tiers.distance: Hlavný beh, Hobby beh, Nordic walking

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: obyvateľ Matúškova, žiak MŠ Matúškovo zadarmo

description: The Matúškovo Run is a running event in the village of Matúškovo, featuring a 12 km main race, a 4 km hobby run and 4 km Nordic walking. The course runs on paved and asphalt roads through the village, consists of 4 km loops and is marked with traffic signs. The event also includes children’s categories with distances varying by age. Participants receive finisher medals, while winners receive cups and certificates. The event takes place in all weather and is limited to 300 runners, excluding children.
course_highlights: The course runs on paved and asphalt roads through the village and is marked with traffic signs
The main race consists of three 4 km loops
Children’s categories offer distances that vary by age
additional: Race-day registration is from 8:00 at the Cultural Centre in Matúškovo. Parking is available around the Cultural Centre. The maximum number of starters is 300 runners, excluding children. All runners who finish receive participant medals. The race takes place in all weather. The route runs on paved and asphalt roads through the village, alongside traffic in one lane separated by traffic signs; it is not certified. Registration and parking are at the Cultural Centre in Matúškovo. The capacity is 300 starters, excluding children.

name: Karpaty Run – Bratislava Trail Run
location: Malokarpatské Námestie 1, Bratislava - Lamač, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Karpaty Run - Bratislava Trail Run is the largest trail running festival in the Little Carpathians, offering routes of varying lengths and difficulty for runners and hikers. The race takes place in a pleasant natural setting, with an emphasis on protecting nature and promoting a healthy lifestyle. The routes run mainly along forest roads and trails, with minimal asphalt, and are suitable for intermediate to advanced runners. The organizer is the Hojta civic association, which supports sports and ecological values.
course_highlights: Routes are 65% forest road and 33–35% forest trail
Elevation gain ranges from 80 m to 876 m, depending on the route length
Refreshments are available at several points along the route, depending on its length
additional: The start is 700 m from Malokarptské Square in Lamač, with a transfer 20 minutes before the start. There is no time limit for most routes, except for the longest ones, which have a limit of 5 or 7 hours. Refreshment stations are available along the route depending on its length. Refreshments can be purchased at Biely Kríž.

name: Bėgimas skirtas Sporto ir kūno kultūros dienai paminėti
description: The Lithuanian Sports Day Run in Alytus is a mass running event aimed at promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The event is part of the National Physical Activity Programme and takes place in October. Participants can choose from three distances designed for different age groups. All finishers receive commemorative souvenirs, and the top performers are awarded medals.
course_highlights: Course within the city of Alytus
Different distances for different age groups: 1.5 km, 3 km and 6 km
Start and finish near the Alytus Sports Centre
additional: Registration is available both online in advance and on the event day from 10:00 to 11:15. Race bibs must be worn on the front of the shirt. Participants take part voluntarily and assume all risks associated with running.

name: Festiwal Biegowy JuraRun 2026
distance_verbose: 104 km, 81 km, Maraton, 23 km, Półmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 9 km, 5 km
description: Festiwal Biegowy JuraRun 2026 to wyjątkowe wydarzenie trailowe odbywające się w sercu Jury Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej, w Podlesicach. Zawodnicy mają do wyboru wiele dystansów, od krótkich biegów dziecięcych po wymagające ultramaratony, które prowadzą przez malownicze leśne ścieżki, wapienne ostańce i jurajskie wzniesienia. To impreza dla miłośników sportu i natury, łącząca pasję do biegania z możliwością odkrywania piękna regionu. JuraRun to także spotkanie z ludźmi o podobnych zainteresowaniach i okazja do przeżycia niezapomnianej przygody biegowej.
course_highlights: Trasy prowadzą przez malownicze krajobrazy Jury Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej
Wapienne ostańce i leśne ścieżki o różnym stopniu trudności
Dystanse od 100 metrów dla dzieci do ponad 100 km ultramaratonu
additional: Starty odbywają się falami, m.in. nocny bieg JuraRun Night 10+ o 21:00, ultramaratony JuraRun ULTRA 100+ i ULTRA 80+ o 23:00. Biuro zawodów otwarte jest od piątku 17:00 do soboty 13:30 z różnymi godzinami zamknięcia rejestracji dla poszczególnych dystansów. Wydarzenie obejmuje także marsz Nordic Walking na 12 km oraz biegi dziecięce od 100 metrów. Limit miejsc na dystanse jest ograniczony, a pakiety startowe dostępne w różnych terminach.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Silesia Marathon 2026
description: Silesia Marathon to największe wydarzenie biegowe na Śląsku, które w 2026 roku odbędzie się jako trzydniowy festiwal biegowy. Uczestnicy mogą wybierać spośród różnych dystansów, w tym maratonu, półmaratonu, ultramaratonu oraz biegów na 10 km i 5 km. Meta znajduje się na ikonicznym Stadionie Śląskim, co dodaje wyjątkowego charakteru imprezie. To nie tylko rywalizacja, ale także niezapomniane emocje i atmosfera wspólnoty biegaczy.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: Poznań Maraton to jubileuszowa, 25. edycja królewskiego maratonu na dystansie 42,195 km, odbywająca się w sercu Poznania. Trasa biegu prowadzi przez najważniejsze ulice miasta, w tym powrót na Stary Rynek po 18 latach, a także przez malownicze miejsca takie jak Park Sołacki, Malta i Enea Stadion. Impreza przyciąga zarówno doświadczonych biegaczy, jak i amatorów, oferując wyjątkową atmosferę i doping kibiców. Organizatorzy przygotowali nową, atrakcyjną trasę oraz bogaty program towarzyszący, w tym biegi dla dzieci i krótsze dystanse.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi przez Stary Rynek, Plac Ratajskiego i Plac Wolności
Przebieg przez malownicze tereny nad Maltą i Park Sołacki
Meta na Placu Marka przy Międzynarodowych Targach Poznańskich
additional: Start dla zawodników na wózkach o 8:55, dla biegaczy o 9:00. Strefy startowe przypisane według deklarowanego czasu ukończenia maratonu, oznaczone kolorowymi paskami na numerach startowych. Limit uczestników wynosi 8000 osób. Biuro zawodów czynne 2-3 października na terenie Międzynarodowych Targów Poznańskich.

name: II Radomski Bieg Onkologiczny
description: II Radomski Bieg Onkologiczny to wydarzenie sportowe organizowane przez Stowarzyszenie "Biegiem Radom!" w Radomiu, które promuje aktywność fizyczną i zdrowy styl życia. Bieg ma charakter charytatywny i integracyjny, skierowany do osób w różnym wieku i o różnym stopniu zaawansowania biegowego. Organizatorzy stawiają na wspólnotę i wsparcie osób dotkniętych chorobami onkologicznymi, łącząc sport z ważną misją społeczną. Impreza odbywa się w malowniczych okolicach Radomia, zachęcając do udziału zarówno biegaczy, jak i sympatyków ruchu.

name: Olsztyn Półmaraton
description: Olsztyn Półmaraton to coroczny bieg na dystansie półmaratonu (21,1 km) odbywający się wokół malowniczego jeziora Ukiel w Olsztynie. Trasa biegu jest mieszana, obejmuje utwardzone nawierzchnie szutrowe, ścieżki leśne, asfalt oraz polbruk, a zawodnicy mają do dyspozycji co kilometr oznakowanie oraz minimum dwie strefy bufetowe. Wydarzenie towarzyszą biegi na 5 km oraz biegi dla dzieci, tworząc sportową atmosferę dla całych rodzin. Organizatorzy zapewniają profesjonalną obsługę i atrakcyjny harmonogram, zachęcając do udziału zarówno amatorów, jak i doświadczonych biegaczy.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 21,1 km wokół jeziora Ukiel
Mieszana nawierzchnia: szuter, ścieżki leśne, asfalt, polbruk
Minimum 2 strefy bufetowe na trasie
additional: Limit czasu na ukończenie półmaratonu to 3 godziny, a na bieg 5 km to 45 minut. Biuro zawodów czynne jest w dniu poprzedzającym i w dniu biegu. W dniu startu nie ma możliwości zapisów. Trasa nie posiada atestu PZLA.

name: Wild Run
description: Wild Run to charytatywny bieg organizowany we Wrocławiu, który odbywa się na terenie wrocławskiego zoo. Uczestnicy mogą biec na dystansie 10 km, a także wziąć udział w biegu wirtualnym na dowolnej trasie. Bieg ma na celu wsparcie ochrony zagrożonych gatunków zwierząt oraz promocję aktywności fizycznej i rodzinnego stylu życia. Wydarzenie jest organizowane z myślą o miłośnikach przyrody i biegaczy w każdym wieku, oferując także biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży.
course_highlights: Trasa główna to pętla około 5 km na terenie wrocławskiego zoo, którą pokonuje się dwukrotnie
Możliwość udziału w biegu wirtualnym na dowolnej trasie
Biegi towarzyszące dla dzieci i młodzieży na dystansach około 1 km i 100 m
additional: Pakiety startowe wydawane są w dniu biegu od godziny 12:00 do 15:00 przy kasach zoo oraz w sobotę w Decathlon Magnolia od 15:00 do 20:00. Wejście do zoo odbywa się na podstawie biletu jednorazowego, który uczestnik otrzymuje przy odbiorze pakietu startowego. Pierwszych 1000 uczestników biegu stacjonarnego otrzyma wyjątkową płócienną torbę. W ramach pakietu rozszerzonego można dokupić koszulki techniczne, ręcznik szybkoschnący oraz wesprzeć fundację Zoo Wrocław - DODO.

name: Botaniczna Piątka - edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczna Piątka, Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Polska

name: Bieg o Puchar Wójta Mikołajki Pomorskie
25. Benther-Berg-Lauf
location: VSV Benthe Sportplatz, Am Hammfeld, Ronnenberg-Benthe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Benther-Berg-Lauf takes place in Ronnenberg-Benthe and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover. The event offers a variety of race distances for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to a half marathon covering 21.8 km. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of the Benther Berg and offers a varied running experience for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. Race number and transponder pickup starts at 8:30 a.m. in the gymnasium of VSV Benthe. Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before each start.
course_highlights: 21.8 km long-distance race (half marathon) through the Benther Berg
A range of distances from the 550 m Bambini race to the 21.8 km long-distance race
Part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event up to 45 minutes before each start, with an additional late-entry fee of €5 (€2 for the Bambini and children’s races). Parking is available in a designated lot behind the sports facility; on the day of the event, access is only possible as far as the dead end. Groups of 5 or more can request a discount by email.

name: 31. Geiseltalseelauf
description: The Geiseltalsee Run is a long-standing running event in Braunsbedra that welcomes runners of all ability levels. The route passes through the scenic surroundings of Lake Geiseltal and offers a sporting challenge across varied terrain. The event is very popular and attracts numerous participants every year. Alongside the competition, the sense of community is also a central part of the event.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Geiseltal
Varied terrain with scenic views
Half marathon with a course record set the previous year
additional: Late entries are possible on race day up to 1 hour before the start. The event also includes children’s and youth races as well as walking events. It takes place in Braunsbedra at Lake Geiseltal and is part of the Landescup. The exact start and finish locations can be found on the official website.

name: Buchdorfer Jedermannslauf
price_range: 8 Euro für Erwachsene, 4 Euro für Schüler/Jugendliche
description: The 33rd Buchdorf Fun Run takes place and offers runners a challenging course through a romantic woodland. There are two distances: 10 km for adults and 3.3 km for young runners. The event is ideal as a personal fitness test and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. The entry fee is moderate, and the winners receive nutritious prizes, with a special prize for the team with the most participants.
course_highlights: 10 km and 3.3 km courses on well-maintained forest roads
A challenging woodland section with a romantic atmosphere
Start area in the nearby woodland, next to the football pitch in the direction of Daiting
additional: Registration is possible until approximately 25 minutes before the start at the Eisstockschützenheim next to the football pitch. Nordic walkers may use the course without registering, but will not be timed or ranked. Participation is at your own responsibility and risk. Distances: 10 km and 3.3 km; registration until approximately 25 minutes before the start; no club membership required; participation at your own responsibility.

name: Kranlauf
description: The Kranlauf Offenbach takes place every year on German Unity Day at the blue harbor crane, and all proceeds support Aidshilfe Offenbach. The event offers three timed race options suitable for both individual participants and groups. The route goes around the harbor and offers a unique atmosphere in Offenbach. Race bibs are equipped with a timing chip, and a €5 deposit is charged, which can be refunded or donated.
course_highlights: Run by the blue harbor crane in Offenbach
Distances: approx. 1.3 km, 2.6 km, and 5 miles
Timing chip in the race bib
additional: Race bibs with an integrated timing chip for the 5-mile race. A €5 deposit is charged for the bib; it can be returned or donated. Online registration is open until 30 minutes before each race start; on-site registration is also possible until 30 minutes before the start. Event runs from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. at Offenbach Harbor. Parking is available in the Hafenzentrum underground garage and near the Mainparkplatz. Travel by bicycle, on foot, or by public transport is recommended. Races over 1.3 km, 2.6 km, and approx. 8 km; online registration until 30 min. before the start; harbor festival with music and food and drink.

name: Labertal-Lauf
description: The Labertal Run is a traditional running event in Geiselhöring, taking place for the 16th time. The route is considered one of the most scenic in the region, away from town centers and busy roads, and partly alongside the Kleine Laber. The Lower Bavarian 10 km Road Running Championships are also held as part of the Labertal Run. The event attracts runners from the region and beyond, and offers ideal conditions for fast times in autumn running weather.
course_highlights: Scenic route away from town centers
Partly right alongside the Kleine Laber
The Lower Bavarian 10 km Road Running Championships are held as part of the event
additional: The race traditionally starts in the morning, most recently at 09:40. The route is well established and offers ideal running conditions. The event is part of the Lower Bavarian Championships and attracts the region’s top runners. Registration is possible until race day; club membership is not required. Flat courses for all ability levels.

name: Odenwälder Herbstlauf
description: The Odenwälder Herbstlauf is a traditional running event held in Mudau. The event offers five different routes through the beautiful Mudauer Odenwald, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, Nordic walking and a Bambini run. The routes run mostly on paved, flat forest paths and asphalt, with no significant climbs, making them challenging yet scenic. Prizes are awarded for course records on the half-marathon and 10 km routes, and each registration supports a charitable cause. The start and finish areas are at the Odenwaldstadion in Mudau, where race bibs are also distributed and awards ceremonies take place.
course_highlights: Routes through the Mudauer Odenwald on asphalt and paved forest paths
Flat terrain with no significant climbs
Officially measured routes: half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km, 5 km, Nordic walking (10 km) and Bambini run (600 m)
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 7:30 a.m. at the Odenwaldstadion. Timing is recorded using gun time, with a disposable transponder integrated into the race bib. There are up to 5 aid stations along the route, offering bananas, sports drinks and water. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the TSV clubhouse. Valuables can be stored there securely. Awards ceremonies take place at the stadium as soon as possible after the races. Age-group rankings and team competitions are available for the 5 km and 10 km races. Late registration is possible on race day until 8:45 a.m., by email or in person, for an additional fee of 4 EUR. The race is known for its rolling courses and friendly, family atmosphere. There are also special competitions for children and young people.

name: Ortsstraßenlauf
description: The TV Marienhagen village road race has been held annually on German Unity Day since 1990 and is the club’s largest sporting event. The courses run along roads within and outside the village, as well as paved forest and field paths. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup and offers categories for Bambini, students, youths, and seniors. Everyone is welcome to participate; club membership is not required. Advance registration is no longer available—registration is exclusively on site. Refreshments are provided during and after the event, and every participant receives a certificate.
course_highlights: Courses along roads and paved forest and field paths
10 km run and 7.5 km Nordic walking on out-and-back courses
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup
additional: Registration is available only on site, no later than 45 minutes before the start. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Children and youths may not enter more than one race. Refreshments are provided during and after the race at the village community centre by the sports ground. The course runs through the village. No advance registration is available. Refreshments are available on site, and all participants receive certificates.

name: Treiser Volkslauf
description: The Treis Volkslauf is being held for the 34th time in Staufenberg-Treis. The event is for runners, walkers, and hikers of all ability levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a large cake buffet and delicious pea soup. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a popular running series in Hesse and the surrounding area. Registration is available via Race Result from [date not specified].
course_highlights: Part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a regional running series
A variety of routes for running, walking, and hiking
Large cake buffet and pea soup
additional: A large cake buffet and pea soup are available for participants. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup running series, which includes several events in the region. The club also offers regular running and walking groups, as well as beginner courses. Running, walking, and hiking event; community activities; refreshments including a cake buffet and pea soup.

name: Bismarckturmlauf
location: Neustadt an der Orla, Thuringia, Germany
description: The Bismarck Tower Run in Neustadt an der Orla is a long-established running event, taking place for the 33rd time on October 3, 2027. The run is open to recreational athletes of all ages and offers a range of distances through varied landscapes. Organized by Freizeitsportverein 1978 e.V. Neustadt an der Orla, the event celebrates exercise, fitness, and community. It is supported by numerous sponsors, club members, and volunteers, and offers a sporting challenge in a convivial atmosphere.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 0.7 km to 21.1 km
Run through the scenic surroundings of Neustadt an der Orla
A traditional event with a family-friendly atmosphere and a broad participant base
additional: Registration for the Bismarck Tower Run opens in April 2027 through the registration portal on the website. There is a 0.7 km children's loop as well as other distances, with GPX files available to download. The event is organized by Freizeitsportverein 1978 e.V. Neustadt an der Orla and supported by local sponsors. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website.

name: Soester Stadtlauf
price_range: abhängig von der Distanz (Infos im Anmeldeportal)
description: Experience the traditional Soest City Run, a sporting highlight for young and old in the historic city centre of Soest. Whether you’re a recreational runner, a competitive athlete or running with your family, together you’ll make the day an unforgettable experience, with a unique atmosphere along the course. The event offers various race distances, an appealing supporting programme, and refreshments for all participants and guests.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the heart of the historic old town
Atmospheric run through Soest city centre
Commentary, music and refreshments along the course
additional: Race distances: children’s races 475m (start 12:00), school races 950m (born 2016–2018, start 12:45) and 1450m (born 2006–2015, start 14:15), main races 4km (start 15:00) and 10km (start 15:45). Parking available on the outskirts of town, with a shuttle service. Drinks and snack stands for participants and guests. An appealing family programme and on-site commentary. Various race distances, start and finish in the heart of the old town, refreshments, shuttle service, awards ceremony immediately after the races.

name: 14. Burgdorfer Spargel-Lauf
description: The Burgdorf Asparagus Run is an annual running event held as part of the Oktobermarkt town festival in Burgdorf. The routes run along the Aue and through the city center, with the start and finish at the Auebrücke Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße. The event offers 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km races, as well as Nordic walking and a children’s race.

name: 23. Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The Central German Marathon connects the Central German metropolitan region with a unique route from Leipzig to Halle (Saale). The marathon starts at the Sportforum in Leipzig and passes through two federal states and two cities before finishing in the historic center of Halle. Other events include the Händel Run Half Marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km run, 10 km walking, Salzwirker Run and AOK Tryout Run. The event offers runners of all abilities a varied and culturally interesting running experience.
course_highlights: Marathon start at the Sportforum in Leipzig
Finish in Halle (Saale), which is over 1,200 years old
Run through one of Germany’s greenest cities in the Händel Run Half Marathon
additional: The marathon, half-marathon, 10 km, Salzwirker Run and Tryout Run routes are loops starting and finishing at the Marktplatz in Halle (Saale), except for the marathon, which runs from Leipzig to Halle. All routes are subject to official approval. Various events and relays are offered, including the Central German University Championships. Race packets can be collected, and late registrations and transfers are possible.

name: Bayerische Halbmarathon-Meisterschaften
description: The Bavarian Half Marathon Championships take place in Aschaffenburg on Westring, near the Linde MH Arena. The event is hosted by TV Haibach and is open to active athletes and masters from Lower Franconia, Bavarian Lower Main, Northern Bavaria and across Bavaria. The championships give runners the opportunity to compete on an official half-marathon course and vie for Bavarian championship titles. Online registration is available.

name: Boitzer Herbstlauf
description: The Boitzer Autumn Run is a local autumn race with walking in Walsrode, Lower Saxony, organized by the SV Kirchboitzen sports club. In 2026, the event will be held in person for the 19th time and is open to runners and walkers of all ages. Participants can get the key information directly from the organizing team on site. Further practical details are provided by SV Kirchboitzen.

name: Cottbuser Oktoberlauf
description: The Cottbus October Run is a traditional running event held at the Cottbus Sports Center, in the athletics stadium and mainly in the adjacent woodland, on paved paths and cycle paths. The event offers various distances from 400 meters to the half marathon (21.1 km), as well as walking and cross-country runs for different age groups. The races are part of the Sparkasse Running and Walking Cup and feature varied courses with both paved and unpaved paths. All participants receive a commemorative medal and can print a certificate online; trophies and prizes are also awarded to the top runners.
course_highlights: Routes pass through woodland on paved paths and cycle paths
Refreshment points at the Spree Bridge
Varied routes with both paved and unpaved paths, including obstacles in the Kids Run
additional: Timing is recorded using an ankle transponder, which must be returned after finishing. A fee of 20 EUR applies if it is lost or damaged. The race number must be worn visibly on the chest. Late registration is available online from 29.09. to 02.10.2027 and on the event day until one hour before the start. Age-group award ceremonies are held, with certificates and trophies. The event is part of the Sparkasse Running and Walking Cup.

name: Gaudilauf 14
organizer: Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Gaudilauf is a traditional race held in Bad Liebenwerda. The route runs from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda back to Munich and offers a scenic course along the Elster. The event is characterized by a friendly atmosphere, with the competitive aspect taking a back seat. Refreshments are provided every 5 kilometers, and participants can look forward to a relaxed celebration at the finish with drinks and grilled food. A bus transfer from the finish back to the start is available on request.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Ovenhausen Autumn Run is a traditional race held annually on the first Sunday in October and organized by TuS Ovenhausen. The event offers various distances for different age and performance groups, including a challenging 20.8 km tour through forests and hills, as well as shorter races for young athletes. The course is varied, with sections on cycle paths, in the Grubestadion, and through the forest. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes, and usually takes place in pleasant autumn weather.

name: Kalbsvilla Run
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Kalbsvilla Run takes place in Ortenberg, Hesse, with the historic Kalbsvilla on Am Mühltor serving as the start and finish area. Various distances are offered, including a 5 km run, a 10 km run, a half marathon, and 5 km Nordic walking. There are also races for toddlers, children, and teenagers, making the event family-friendly. Timing is electronic via a Race Result transponder, and the event supports a good cause as a charity run.

name: Oktoberlauf Embsen
description: The Oktoberlauf Embsen is expected to take place on Sunday, October 3, 2027, in 21409 Embsen. Running events over 5 km and 11 km are offered, as well as events for children and young people. All events share the same finish location. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a sporting challenge amid Embsen’s autumn scenery.
course_highlights: 5 km and 11 km running courses
A shared finish location for all events
Events for children and young people
additional: The exact finish locations are shown only with RUNME Premium. The website does not provide detailed information about start waves, participant limits, or late entries.

name: OLFINCAR HRADECKÝ PŮL/MARATON
description: OLFINCAR Hradec Králové Half Marathon is the largest sporting event in Eastern Bohemia and has been held since 2013. The race offers certified courses, including a marathon, half marathon, relay, 10 km race, and children’s races. The course is one of the fastest in the Czech Republic and is considered one of the most scenic urban courses. In 2026, the event will also host the Czech Masters Half Marathon Championships and the Czech Championships for emergency and security services in the half marathon. The facilities at the new football arena in the city center provide runners with comfortable services.

name: Horský běh Alfrédka - Memoriál Miroslava Čermáka
description: The Alfrédka Mountain Run – Miroslav Čermák Memorial is a race run mainly along forest roads, covering 13.6 km with 430 m of elevation gain. It is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix and the Czech Mountain Running Cup. The challenging route through the beautiful countryside of the Moravian-Silesian Region is ideal for fans of mountain running and endurance events. The race takes place in Stará Ves near Rýmařov and is suitable for experienced runners looking for a trail challenge.

name: Běh okolo Panoramy
description: The Run Around Panorama is a traditional cross-country race through challenging mountain terrain around Jáchymov’s football stadium. The race is open to all age groups and is being held for the 33rd year. The event is organised by Tělovýchovná jednota Jáchymov and offers a sporting experience in the beautiful surroundings of the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh údolím Orlice
organizer: Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Klášterec nad Orlicí
description: The Orlice Valley Run is a traditional cross-country race held in Klášterec nad Orlicí, offering routes through meadows and along local roads over hilly terrain. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. Winners receive medals, prizes and cash awards. The start and finish are at the football pitch by the school, and the main race begins in the morning.

name: Slatinský kros
description: Slatinský Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country running race held in Brno-Slatina, now in its 19th year. The race takes place in Terénky Park on Dědická Street and features a grassy course with rolling terrain, putting runners to the test in a pleasant natural setting. The event is held under the auspices of the Brno-Slatina Municipal District and is suitable for the general public. Participants can look forward to trophies, medals, and valuable prizes.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - říjen
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race focuses on the joy of running and competing primarily against yourself. It takes place in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc by the fountain, except for some June and August races, which are held by the river. The run is part of a cup competition, where results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.

name: Roštejnské stráně
description: Roštejnské stráně is a traditional cross-country race organized by Orel Telč and part of the Orel Running League. This 14th edition takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ranč u Lipek in Telč and offers various categories, including family relays and a fun run for beginners. The race is open to all age groups and emphasizes fair play and sportsmanship. Winners will receive medals, certificates, and prizes, with special awards also presented to the youngest and oldest runners.

name: Běh kolem Lužnice
description: The Run Around the Lužnice is a traditional running race organized by the Atletika Veselí athletics club in Veselí nad Lužnicí. The race offers runners of all ages a unique opportunity to enjoy the beautiful countryside and sporting atmosphere at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium. The club has a long-standing commitment to athletics and running races, with an emphasis on high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and children alike.

name: Huť - Bratříkov - Huť
location: Huť u Jablonce nad Nisou, Liberecký
description: Huť-Bratříkov-Huť is a traditional cross-country race held every year on the first Sunday in October in Huť near Jablonec nad Nisou. Established in 1972, the event offers a 10 km main race and shorter distances for different age groups. The route passes through scenic countryside, with a grassy sports field serving as the start and finish area. The race welcomes runners of all ages, from children to adults, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Medzinárodný maratón mieru
description: The International Peace Marathon in Košice is a traditional running festival held on Hlavná Street. Organized by the Košice Marathon Club, it offers a marathon, half marathon, and other disciplines, with the start and finish located in the city center. The event is known for its long history and high-quality organization, including the Slovak Half Marathon Championships. Runners can expect professional timing and a rich program of accompanying events.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v polmaratóne mužov a žien - MMM 2026
description: The Slovak Republic Championships in the Men’s and Women’s Half Marathon are part of the Košice Peace Marathon, held in Košice. The half-marathon course is fast, with few sharp turns and a favourable elevation profile, allowing runners to achieve excellent times. The start and finish are on Hlavná Street in the city centre, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The event is organised with an emphasis on professional preparation and support for the running community.
course_highlights: A fast course with few sharp turns
A favourable elevation profile suited to fast times
Start and finish on Hlavná Street in Košice
additional: The start of all events is on Hlavná Street, between the DoubleTree by Hilton hotel and the Dargov department store. The MMM relays consist of four runners, with legs of 12 km, 9 km and 12 km. The organiser awards age categories for the marathon and half marathon. Registration is available online only through the official website.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Tetín
description: The Berounka - Tetín running series is a community trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Tetín. The course crosses hills and offers beautiful views of the Bohemian Karst and the surrounding landscape, including a climb to a viewpoint overlooking Beroun. The race is part of a series of 12 runs that encourage runners of all levels to get active outdoors in a friendly atmosphere, with support from local pubs. Refreshments, bag storage, and prizes for the top finishers in each category are available on site.

name: Mrdická mašina
description: Mrdická mašina is a fast 2.0 km run across the meadows of Mrdice in Heřmanův Městec. The race is part of the Heřmanův Městec Sports League, which includes ten athletics and cycling events around the Mrdice fortress site. The race is open to the general public and offers a fun sporting challenge for all runners. It is organized by the Běžecký klub Heřmanův Městec, which supports running and sporting activities in the region.

name: Warburger Stundenlauf 2026
description: The 34th Warburg Hour Run takes place in Warburg. The competition is aimed at adults and offers both individual and team categories. The course is flat and the event lasts one hour. There are also competitions for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official announcement.
course_highlights: Flat course
Duration: 1 hour
Individual and team categories available
additional: A competition for children and young people is offered. The start and finish are at Hüffertsportplatz; precise location details require RUNME Premium. The event is part of the RUNME race calendar. Participants receive certificates and trophies; registration is online; the event takes place in October in good weather.

name: Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried
description: The Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried is a short autumn cross-country race held on the grounds of the Bergfried in Saalfeld, Germany. Distances range from 800 m to 4.8 km and are designed for fast off-road running rather than long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a hill race and a cross-country race. The Saalfelder Leichtathletikverein has organized the event for many years, with separate races for children and adults and various age groups.

name: Herbstcross des Saalfelder LV
distance_verbose: 13.5 km, 10 km, 9.9 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: Běh pro Světlušku s knihovnou
location: Masaryk Public Library, Dolní náměstí, Vsetín, Czech Republic
description: The Run for Světluška with the Library is a traditional sporting event organized by the Masaryk Public Library in Vsetín. The run combines physical activity with supporting a good cause and attracts a wide range of participants, including families and running enthusiasts. The event takes place in the pleasant setting of Dolní Square and offers an opportunity for active recreation and socializing.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Dolní Square in Vsetín
Pleasant urban setting, with the whole family welcome to take part
An event connected with the library and cultural activities
additional: Proceeds go to Světluška, a project of the Czech Radio Endowment Fund. No registration is required; participants run or walk at their own risk.

name: Roštejnskou oborou
description: Běh Roštejnskou oborou is a friendly race for the general public, held amid the picturesque forests near Růžená in the Vysočina Region. The course follows forest trails and is suitable for all ages from 4 years upwards, with distances ranging from 300 metres to 8,900 metres. The event is part of the Běžec Vysočiny cup and offers a unique experience of running in nature, with the chance to observe local wildlife. It is organized by TJ Růžená, z.s., and is ideal for families and sports enthusiasts looking to combine sport with nature.

name: Pražský Kelt
description: Pražský Kelt is a unique 100 km ultra trail in the heart of Prague, offering runners the chance to discover beautiful natural scenery and Celtic hillforts, with a total elevation gain of 2,500 metres. The route winds through Prague’s forested, hilly landscape and passes historic sites such as the Šance, Butovice, Závist and Vyšehrad hillforts, as well as others. It also offers stunning views of the city and the surrounding countryside. The race starts and finishes at the grounds of Kunratice Elementary School and is intended for runners looking to experience the atmosphere of an ultramarathon in an unconventional urban setting. The race is limited to 120 participants, creating an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 5 etapas
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event aimed at promoting running, cycling and orienteering in nature. The competitions take place in Ukmergė, with participants competing in cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling and rogaining events. The event encourages active leisure for people of all ages and fosters young people’s interest in sport. The races start at the stadium of Šilas Basic School, and the time limit is 120 minutes (except for Mini Rogaining).

name: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event featuring cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling, and rogaining competitions. The event takes place in Kopūstėliai Forest in Ukmergė and aims to encourage active recreation in nature and promote sport among participants of all ages. The start is shared by all groups and takes place in the evening; participants compete in age groups and event categories. The main organiser is VšĮ Sportas miške, and the event is supported by several Ukmergė companies.

name: II Korczyński Półmaraton Górski XI Korczyński Bieg i Nordic Walking "Do Prządek"
description: II Korczyński Półmaraton Górski oraz XI Korczyński Bieg i Nordic Walking „Do Prządek” to wydarzenie sportowe odbywające się w malowniczych terenach Czarnorzecko-Strzyżowskiego Parku Krajobrazowego. Uczestnicy mają do wyboru trasy biegowe na dystansach 21 km i 6 km oraz marsz Nordic Walking, co pozwala sprawdzić kondycję i wytrzymałość w pięknej scenerii. Impreza promuje aktywny styl życia oraz walory przyrodnicze regionu, integrując lokalną społeczność i miłośników sportu. Organizowana jest przez Gminny Ośrodek Kultury w Korczynie z udziałem licznych partnerów i sponsorów.
course_highlights: Trasy przebiegają przez Czarnorzecko-Strzyżowski Park Krajobrazowy
Dostępne dystanse: półmaraton górski (21 km) oraz bieg na 6 km
Malownicze krajobrazy i naturalne walory przyrodnicze regionu
additional: Wydarzenie organizowane jest przez Gminny Ośrodek Kultury w Korczynie. W imprezie uczestniczy około 120 osób. Medale i nagrody wręczają przedstawiciele samorządu i partnerów. Współpraca z jednostkami OSP oraz wolontariuszami wspiera organizację. Partnerami są m.in. Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Krośnie, Nadleśnictwo Kołaczyce i lokalne szkoły.

name: 30 Bieg Przełajowy o Nóż Komandosa
location: Stadion Miejski w Lublińcu, Lubliniec, Polska
description: Bieg Przełajowy "O Nóż Komandosa" to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana w Lublińcu, która przyciąga liczne reprezentacje wojskowe, policyjne i sportowe. Zawody mają charakter przełajowy, odbywają się na wymagającej trasie, a ich tradycja sięga wielu lat, co potwierdza wysoka frekwencja i zaangażowanie uczestników. Bieg jest objęty patronatem honorowym Biskupa Polowego Wiesława Lechowicza, co podkreśla jego rangę i znaczenie. Wydarzenie ma także wymiar charytatywny i integracyjny, a relacje i zdjęcia z poprzednich edycji dostępne są online.
course_highlights: Trasa przełajowa o zróżnicowanym terenie
Wysoka frekwencja i udział reprezentacji wojskowych i policyjnych
Patronat honorowy Biskupa Polowego Wiesława Lechowicza
additional: Wyniki i relacje z poprzednich edycji dostępne online. W biegu uczestniczą liczne drużyny wojskowe i policyjne. Wydarzenie ma charakter charytatywny i integracyjny.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: Grand Prix Truchtacza w Mysłowicach to cykl biegów przełajowych, które łączą pasję do biegania z aktywnym stylem życia. Impreza promuje zdrowie, integrację oraz radość z aktywności fizycznej, tworząc społeczność wspierającą się nawzajem. Zawody są otwarte dla wszystkich grup wiekowych i poziomów zaawansowania, a udział w Grand Prix jest bezpłatny. Organizatorzy dbają o przyjazną atmosferę i motywują do regularnego ruchu.
course_highlights: Cykl obejmuje sześć biegów przełajowych.
Trasa prowadzi w terenie na terenie Mysłowic.
Wydarzenie jest częścią Grand Prix organizowanego przez lokalne stowarzyszenie biegowe.
additional: Zapisy do cyklu Grand Prix możliwe są wyłącznie w Biurze Zawodów w dniu biegu. Udział w zawodach jest bezpłatny. Impreza jest otwarta dla wszystkich, niezależnie od poziomu zaawansowania i wieku.

name: 2 Maraton od Źródeł do Ujścia Grabiszynki
Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet na cały cykl w jednym mieście (4 imprezy) można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL z Fundacją Lotto to ogólnopolski cykl biegów przełajowych na dystansie 5 km, odbywający się w siedmiu lokalizacjach, w tym w Warszawie w Parku Młocińskim. Zawody mają charakter rekreacyjno-sportowy, promują aktywność fizyczną na łonie natury oraz zdrowy tryb życia. Cykl obejmuje cztery biegi w każdej lokalizacji, a uczestnicy mogą rywalizować w klasyfikacji lokalnej i łącznej. Biegi odbywają się w sezonie od października do kwietnia, a start głównego biegu jest o godzinie 11:00.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km po lasach lub parkach miejskich
Bieg w naturalnym otoczeniu Parku Młocińskiego w Warszawie
Cykl czterech biegów w sezonie w każdej lokalizacji
additional: Biuro zawodów otwierane jest o 8:30, a odbiór numerów startowych i chipów odbywa się w dniu biegu. W dniu biegu opłata startowa wynosi 60 zł. Karnet na cały cykl umożliwia także jeden bezpłatny start w innym mieście niż główna lokalizacja po wcześniejszym zgłoszeniu mailowym. W biegu mogą uczestniczyć osoby od 16 lat wzwyż, a młodsi (2008-2010) za zgodą rodziców. Harmonogram biegów jest stały i obejmuje także biegi CITY TRAIL Junior dla dzieci. Warszawskie biegi sezonu 2026/2027 zaplanowano na 10 października, 21 listopada, 16 stycznia i 20 marca; start o 11:00.

name: IX ARYZTA Półmaraton Strzegom – Bieg Piekarza
LIII Maraton Pieszy w Puszczy Kampinoskiej
VIII Półmaraton Lasy nad Utratą
location: Michałowice, Michałowice Municipality, Masovian Voivodeship, Polska

XIV Cross Centaura
location: Biały Bór, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Polska

location: Zębowice, Opole County, Opole Voivodeship, Polska

XIV ultraMaraton Bieszczadzki
location: Cisna, Lesko County, Subcarpathian Voivodeship, Polska

name: Muswiesenlauf
description: The Muswiesenlauf is a traditional fun run in Hohenlohe, celebrating its 41st edition. It is the oldest fun run in the region and offers various distances for children, young people and adults. The courses are officially measured and follow varied routes along paved agricultural roads and gravel forest paths. Every participant receives a certificate, and children also receive bumper-car tokens. The event is part of the historic Muswiese festival, which has been held annually since 1434.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses of 500 m, 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Varied routes on paved roads and gravel forest paths
The race is part of the traditional Muswiesenfest in Hohenlohe
additional: Late entries are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Changing rooms and showers are available at the multi-purpose hall "Forum", 2 km away; basic changing facilities without showers are available in the start area. The awards ceremony takes place in the Muswiesenhalle on the festival grounds. Parking is available around the festival grounds and the start/finish area; heavy traffic may cause congestion. Races over 500 m, 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m; online registration until one day before the race; late entries possible on race day; race-number distribution at Stadel Hofburk.

name: Wadersloher Volkslauf
description: The Wadersloh Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Wadersloh, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses are available and are eligible for rankings until 2029. There are also shorter races for children and walking routes. The event takes place at the Sportpark on Winkelstraße and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a start-number deposit and timekeeping.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured and eligible for rankings until 31.12.2029
