It offers a 10.9 km course for men and a 4.5 km course for women, on asphalt and surrounding paths. The event is listed among runs for health, hobby runs, and children’s races, making it suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages. It is organized by AC Moravský Krumlov, led by Mgr. Zuzana Marková. Registration is available on a separate page, and the race is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s services for runners.
course_highlights: Courses run on asphalt and surrounding paths
Course distances: 10.9 km (men) and 4.5 km (women)
The event includes a hobby run and children’s races
additional: The race is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletics Federation. It is organized by AC Moravský Krumlov; the contact person is Mgr. Zuzana Marková. The event is open to the general public, including hobby runners and children. The program also includes children’s races, a hobby run, and a run for health. The information provided concerns the 2026 edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Podvihorlatský kros
location: Poruba pod Vihorlatom, Poruba pod Vihorlatom, futbalové ihrisko (amfiteáter)
description: The Podvihorlatský Cross is a running event held at the football field (amphitheatre) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom. The races include starts for children’s categories and the main category. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads, with 30% asphalt surface. The event is organised by Mgr. Ján Podstavský with the support of the Municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom. It is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025 and offers categories for various age groups and Nordic walking.

name: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica
location: Oščadnica, Oščadnica, Račatak na Námestí M. Bernáta pri fontáne
organizer: Obec Oščadnica, Klub turistov Oščadnica, extremmaraton.sk
description: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica is a mountain marathon through the picturesque Kysuce countryside, mainly along mountain ridges with beautiful views of Veľká Rača. The 42-kilometre course, with nearly 1,700 metres of elevation gain, will test your endurance, strength and love of the mountains. This is not a race but a recreational running experience that celebrates the joy of movement, friendship and determination. The organisers provide full services, including refreshments, a T-shirt and a post-run get-together.

name: Rozhanovská dvanástka
organizer: Obec Rozhanovce, Občianske združenie KŠK Rozhanovce
description: Rozhanovce Twelve is a running race held at the amphitheatre grounds in Rozhanovce. It offers two main categories—a short 6 km course and a long 12 km course—for both men and women. The race is organised by the Municipality of Rozhanovce and the KŠK Rozhanovce civic association, and is suitable for runners of varying abilities. The children’s races are scheduled to start at 10:45 and the main courses at 11:00.

name: Šurianska desiatka
description: Šurianska desiatka is a running event held in the town of Šurany, with the start and finish in front of the Municipal Office. The course runs along the town’s streets and through part of Nitriansky Hrádok on asphalt roads. The event is open to the general public, including pupils, juniors, recreational runners, and Nordic Walking participants. It is organized by Gymnázium Bernolákova 37, Šurany, and the number of participants is limited in categories A to J. Refreshments and drinks are provided for competitors. Winners receive diplomas, prizes, and cash rewards.

name: Memoriál Ondreja Holca v cezpoľnom behu Poniky
location: Futbalové ihrisko ŠK OPL Poniky, Poniky, Slovakia
description: The Ondrej Holec Memorial in Poniky is a cross-country race starting and based at the ŠK OPL Poniky football field. The event includes a 10-kilometre main race, a shorter hobby race and children’s races. The courses run through the surrounding area and offer runners of different age categories a chance to take part.
course_highlights: The main course is 10 km long with approximately 290 m of elevation gain.
The main course follows village roads, forest and field paths, and logging roads.
The hobby course is 3.7 km long with approximately 60 m of elevation gain.
additional: The programme also typically includes children’s races, with courses for schoolchildren, preschoolers and the youngest children.

name: STOP.SHOP. Liptovský Mikuláš polmaratón
location: STOP.SHOP Liptovský Mikuláš, Liptovský Mikuláš, Slovakia
organizer: STOP.SHOP. Slovakia s.r.o.; Olympijský klub Liptova
description: The STOP SHOP Liptovský Mikuláš Half Marathon is a 21.1 km road race on an asphalt loop with 114 metres of elevation gain. The course is certified by a commissioner of the Slovak Athletics Association, and after the turnaround runners return along the same route. Refreshment stations are available at 5, 10 and 15.5 km, with water at the 5 km station. The event is part of the Liptov Running League and is organised by STOP.SHOP Slovakia s.r.o. together with the Liptov Olympic Club.
course_highlights: Asphalt road loop with 114 m of elevation gain
Refreshment stations at 5, 10 and 15.5 km; water at 5 km
Course certified by a Slovak Athletics Association commissioner
additional: Race-day registration and bib collection take place from 8:00 to 9:30 on the first floor of the STOP SHOP shopping centre. The first 200 registered participants receive a race pack including a goulash voucher and other gifts. Participants receive a finisher’s medal at the finish. Changing rooms and toilets are available in the shopping centre. More than 380 outdoor and underground parking spaces are available at the shopping centre. The start and finish are beside the STOP SHOP shopping centre.

name: Večerný beh Moldavou
location: Športový areál Pod Kopcom, Moldava nad Bodvou, Slovakia
organizer: Athletic Legion Club – Moldava nad Bodvou
description: The Moldava Evening Run is a traditional running race in Moldava nad Bodvou, offering 5 km and 10 km routes on asphalt and forest terrain. The event is open to a broad age range, from 13 years old, and runners can compete in various men’s and women’s age categories. Running headlamps and reflective elements are mandatory, emphasizing the event’s evening character. Category winners receive cash prizes, and all participants receive a finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: 10 km route (2 laps) and 5 km route (1 lap)
Surface: 80% asphalt, 20% forest
Start and finish at the Športový Areál Pod Kopcom
additional: The time limit is 2 hours (18:00–20:00). Winners in the M17 and Ž17 categories receive non-cash prizes; other category winners receive cash prizes. Every participant who finishes receives a participation medal. A running headlamp and reflective elements are mandatory on the course.

name: onsemi Jesenný beh okolo Sĺňavy
location: Bufet Dino, Sĺňava Reservoir dam embankment, Piešťany, Slovakia
organizer: OZ Sĺňava Piešťany a Atletický oddiel TJ Družba Piešťany
description: The onsemi Autumn Run Around Sĺňava is a running event in Piešťany offering a 12 km asphalt loop around the Sĺňava Reservoir. The event also includes two-person relay races on the same course and free children’s races for various age groups. Runner registration takes place on race day at the start line. The event is organised by OZ Sĺňava Piešťany and the TJ Družba Piešťany Athletics Club, and is suitable for the general public across a range of ability levels.
course_highlights: 12 km asphalt loop around the Sĺňava Reservoir
Two-person relay on the same course
Children’s races for various age groups
additional: Registration and race-number pickup take place on race day from 9:30 to 10:45 at the start venue; relay registration closes at 10:30. Men’s age categories are divided by age, while women compete without age divisions. The children’s races start after the main category has set off. Free children’s races are also on the programme.

name: Trnava Run
location: Atletický areál Slávia Trnava, Trnava, Slovakia

name: Vajnorský minimaratón
description: The Vajnory Mini-Marathon is a traditional autumn road race in Bratislava-Vajnory, which includes the Slovak Championships in the 5 km road race for men and women. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 10 km races or children’s races for the youngest participants. The event takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Park pod lipami, where a lively sporting atmosphere filled with music and excitement awaits. Every participant receives an original medal and has a chance to win prizes in a raffle.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km on paved roads in Park pod lipami
Course certified by the Slovak Athletics Federation
Slovak 5 km Road Championships
additional: Race bibs are distributed on race day from 10:30 to 13:45, and for the 10 km race until 14:45. Changing rooms, a bag storage area, toilets and refreshments are available on site. Wearing headphones during the race is prohibited for safety reasons. Children can register online or on site until 12:00; participation in the children’s races is free. The course has a time limit of 2 hours and is certified. The children’s races are free. Park pod lipami is accessible on foot, by public transport and by car; parking is available in the surrounding area.

name: Psotkov memorial
description: The Psotkov Memorial is a traditional mountain running race in the heart of the High Tatras, held near Štrbské Pleso. Runners can choose between two challenging courses: BASIC, 25.3 km long with 1,540 m of elevation gain, and EXTREME, 37.9 km long with 2,490 m of elevation gain. The route passes through picturesque mountain scenery, including a climb below the summit of Kriváň, a descent to Tri studničky, a stretch past Jamské pleso and through the Furkotská Valley, and a finish at Chata pod Soliskom. The race is part of the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia and offers a unique experience of running in challenging mountain terrain.

name: Tajovský beh
location: Tajov, Okres Banská Bystrica, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia

name: BIOBEH Vinohradmi Veľký Krtíš
location: Veľký Krtíš, Okres Veľký Krtíš, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia

name: Beh na Muránsky hrad
location: Muráň, Revúca District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia

name: Štefánik urban trail
location: Devín, Bratislava IV, Bratislava Region, Slovakia

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Gajary
location: Gajary, Malacky District, Bratislava Region, Slovakia

name: Beh od hradu k hradu
location: Soblahov, Trenčín District, Trenčín Region, Slovakia

name: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas
description: The Backyard Ultra World Championship is a unique off-road running event in which runners must complete a 6.7 km loop every hour until only one runner remains standing. The race takes place on hilly, off-road courses that demand endurance and determination. It challenges both physical and mental endurance, and there is always only one winner. Trailo Kalvė organizes the event with special attention to course quality and participant experience, inviting runners to test themselves and push beyond their limits.

name: XII Pagarbos/Paramos bėgimas „IN MEMORIAM“, skirtas šiais metais mirusiems kariams atminti
organizer: Lietuvos didžiosios kunigaikštienės Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų organizacija
description: The “In Memoriam” Run of Respect and Support in Vilnius is a prominent event held to honor Lithuanian Armed Forces personnel who died this year and support their families. The event takes place in Vingis Park and includes non-competitive 1 km and 4 km distances, as well as an open 10 km Lithuanian Armed Forces Running Championship. The run began as a heartfelt initiative to remember a young officer and has become an important annual civic and patriotic tradition. It is organized by the LDK Birutė Association of Women in Officers’ Families together with the Ministry of National Defence and the Lithuanian Armed Forces.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė
description: The Graužikai–Kelmė Run is a traditional race in Kelmė District held in memory of Vaidotas Rimkus. The event takes place in October and aims to promote running and athletics in Lithuania, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and increase physical activity among local residents. It attracts runners of all ages, who can choose from several distances, including the 8 km main race. Participants are awarded cups, medals, and commemorative prizes.

name: Atviros Vilniaus rajono kroso pirmenybės
location: Miško slidinėjimo trasos prie biatlono šaudyklos, Nemenčinė, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The Open Vilnius District Cross-Country Championships take place on the forest ski trails near the biathlon shooting range in Nemenčinė. These traditional races bring together participants competing in various age groups and distances, striving for their best results on the cross-country courses. The event draws running enthusiasts from Vilnius District and nearby areas, encouraging an active lifestyle and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: The races take place on forest ski trails
The trails are near the biathlon shooting range in Nemenčinė
Cross-country courses of varying difficulty and length
additional: Separate men's and women's categories are planned for the competition.

name: 52.Maraton Dębno 2026
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dębnie
description: 52. Maraton Dębno to najstarszy i jeden z najszybszych maratonów w Polsce. Trasa o długości 42,195 km, atestowana przez PZLA, prowadzi ulicami Dębna i okolic, sprzyjając uzyskiwaniu życiówek. Impreza ma bogatą tradycję sięgającą 1966 roku i przyciąga zarówno amatorów, jak i profesjonalnych biegaczy z kraju i zagranicy. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalną organizację, liczne punkty odżywcze oraz gorący doping kibiców. Maraton jest także okazją do integracji środowiska biegowego i świętem sportu dla całych rodzin.

name: 12. PKO Półmaraton Gliwicki
description: PKO Półmaraton Gliwicki to coroczne wydarzenie biegowe organizowane od 2014 roku w Gliwicach, które zyskało popularność jako lokalna inicjatywa promująca aktywność fizyczną i zdrowy styl życia. Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi przez malownicze ulice miasta, a start i meta znajdują się w Hali Widowiskowo-Sportowej PreZero Arena Gliwice. Limit czasu na pokonanie dystansu wynosi 3 godziny, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalną organizację i wsparcie na trasie. Impreza jest częścią większego festiwalu zdrowia i sportu, który przyciąga biegaczy w różnym wieku i o różnym poziomie zaawansowania.
course_highlights: Start i meta w Hali Widowiskowo-Sportowej PreZero Arena Gliwice
Trasa prowadzi przez ulice miasta Gliwice
Limit czasu na pokonanie półmaratonu to 3 godziny
additional: Biuro zawodów mieści się w Hali Widowiskowo-Sportowej PreZero Arena Gliwice. Odbiór pakietów startowych odbywa się w sobotę i niedzielę przed biegiem. Na trasie dostępne są punkty z wodą i muzyką. Organizowany jest także Festiwal Zdrowia i zawody biegowe Poho50 dla różnych grup wiekowych. Limit czasu na pokonanie dystansu półmaratonu wynosi 3 godziny od startu.

name: 10 Półmaraton Lubelski
description: 10 Półmaraton Lubelski to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w Lublinie, która przyciąga biegaczy z całego regionu. Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi ulicami miasta, oferując uczestnikom dynamiczne i szybkie odcinki. Wydarzenie jest częścią kalendarza biegów Lublina na sezon 2026 i stanowi doskonałą okazję do sportowej rywalizacji oraz integracji biegowej społeczności.
course_highlights: Trasa prowadzi ulicami Lublina
Dynamiczne i szybkie odcinki
Malownicze miejskie krajobrazy
additional: Wydarzenie jest częścią Grand Prix Lublina 2026. W kalendarzu biegów Lublina znajduje się wiele imprez, a półmaraton jest jednym z ważniejszych biegów sezonu.

name: Wartko!... bez Gaszowice
description: WARTKO!... bez Gaszowice to coroczny bieg na dystansie 10 km organizowany przez Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Gaszowicach. Impreza przyciąga miłośników aktywnego spędzania czasu i promuje sportową rywalizację w malowniczej okolicy. Bieg odbywa się w październiku i cieszy się rosnącą popularnością, oferując uczestnikom profesjonalną organizację oraz przyjazną atmosferę.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 10 km
Malownicze tereny Gaszowic
Profesjonalny pomiar czasu
additional: Odbiór pakietów startowych odbywa się w biurze zawodów w Ośrodku Kultury i Sportu. Organizowane są także otwarte treningi biegowe i Nordic Walking na trasie WARTKO! W dniu biegu mogą wystąpić utrudnienia w ruchu drogowym.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (10)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w wysokości 20 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: pozostałe osoby – w wysokości 45 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_5
tiers.description: małżeństwa – w wysokości 80 zł przelewem na konto

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika to rekreacyjna impreza biegowa i Nordic Walking odbywająca się w malowniczych lasach panewnickich w Katowicach. Zawody mają charakter otwarty, promują aktywny styl życia oraz edukują na temat prawidłowych zachowań w terenach leśnych. Trasa to pętla o długości około 4882 metrów, oznaczona co kilometr, którą można pokonać do czterech razy w limicie 3 godzin. Wydarzenie organizowane jest przez Akademię Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki oraz Państwową Straż Pożarną Katowice.
course_highlights: Trasa w lesie panewnickim o długości około 4882 m
Oznaczenie trasy co 1 km
Możliwość pokonania pętli do 4 razy, limit czasu 3 godziny
additional: Limit uczestników wynosi 700 osób. Zawodnicy powyżej 18 roku życia muszą podpisać oświadczenie o udziale na własną odpowiedzialność lub przedstawić zaświadczenie lekarskie. Osoby urodzone w roku 1950 i wcześniej są zwolnione z opłaty startowej. Można wykupić pakiet startów na cały rok 2026. Opłaty nie podlegają zwrotowi, ale mogą być przeksięgowane na kolejny start pod warunkiem zgłoszenia do czwartku poprzedzającego start do godz. 15:00.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
description: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej to znana pomorska impreza biegowa, która powraca w nowej odsłonie pod banderą STONE TRI & RUN. Zawody odbywają się jesienią, oferując odświeżoną trasę i wyjątkowy klimat, będąc finałowym wydarzeniem Puckiej Triady Biegowej. To idealna okazja, by zakończyć sezon biegowy w mocnym stylu, rywalizując na dystansie półmaratonu oraz krótszych biegach i marszach nordic walking. Organizatorzy zapewniają kompleksowe informacje i wsparcie dla uczestników, w tym program imprezy, mapy tras oraz strefy depozytowe.
course_highlights: Odświeżona trasa półmaratonu o długości 21,097 km
Jesienny klimat i finałowe miejsce w Puckiej Triadzie Biegowej
Dodatkowe biegi na 5 km oraz marsz nordic walking na 5 km
additional: Biuro zawodów czynne 15:00-20:00 i 7:00-9:00 w dniu startu w MOKSiR Puck. Depozyt dostępny 8:00-13:00. Starty: półmaraton 10:00, bieg 5 km 10:05, nordic walking 5 km 10:07. Dla dzieci Mini Kids Run (ok. 400 m) i Mega Kids Run (ok. 800 m) po zakończeniu półmaratonu. Dekoracja zwycięzców o 13:00.

name: 40. Bieg Barbórkowy o Lampkę Górniczą – Sztafeta Międzyzakładowa
XII Otwarty Bieg Uliczny i Marsz Nordic Walking
Laubacher Ramsberglauf
price_range: bis 20. September vergünstigtes Startgeld, danach zzgl. Nachmeldegebühr
description: The Laubach Ramsberg Run is a traditional running event that starts and finishes in the picturesque castle park in Laubach. The event offers various distances for different age and ability groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and Bambini. The races feature a varied course through the beautiful countryside around Laubach. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere, with refreshments, changing facilities, and an awards ceremony right in the castle park.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Laubach Castle Park
A varied course through the countryside around Laubach
Refreshments and changing facilities at the Sports and Cultural Hall
additional: Registration is via RACERESULT, with a reduced entry fee available until 20 September; a late registration fee applies thereafter. Changing and shower facilities are available at the Sports and Cultural Hall. The awards ceremony takes place right in the castle park. Distances: 10 km main race, 5 km fun run, children’s races over 1500 m and 300 m; registration via Raceresult; start and finish in the castle park; refreshments, changing and shower facilities on site; October weather: approx. 14°C, cloudy

name: Offenbacher Mainuferlauf
description: The Offenbach Main Riverside Run is an open running event held annually along the Main River in Offenbach. Races are offered over 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 2 km schoolchildren’s run. The course follows the Main and offers an attractive riverside setting. In 2025, short-notice course changes were made due to construction work. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required. It has a family-friendly atmosphere and a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: Run along the Main with attractive riverside scenery
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon
Separate 2 km schoolchildren’s run
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Mathildenschule Offenbach, Arthur-Zitscher-Str. Parking is recommended at the Innenstadt car park on Berliner Straße (about 750 m away; fee of approximately €1 per hour). Due to construction work, Mainstraße is closed, resulting in short-notice course changes. This year’s course is not eligible for record purposes because official measurement was not possible. The half-marathon starts about 350 m from the previous start location. The 5 km and 10 km races start by the Main at the finish arch. The 2 km schoolchildren’s run starts by the Main as usual. Event photos are provided by Team Ingo Kutsche. Course changes due to construction work; course not eligible for record purposes; registration opens on 1.8.2025; weather-dependent conditions; various race distances

name: Salacher Löwenlauf
description: The Salacher Löwenlauf is a running and Nordic walking event in Salach, Germany. The courses cover 500 meters for children, 2 kilometers for teenagers, 6 kilometers for fitness runners and Nordic walkers, and 10 kilometers for experienced runners. The course is hilly but well suited to beginners, and all races finish on Baumgartenstraße near the Stauferlandhalle. The event is organized by TSG Salach, which also highlights the connection to the Stauferland region in the Nordic walking race.
course_highlights: Hilly course profile, not a flat sprint
Finish on Baumgartenstraße near the Stauferlandhalle
A range of distances for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: Start times are planned around midday. There are special races for children (500 m Bambini Löwenlauf) and teenagers (2 km Jugend-Löwenlauf). The event also includes a 6 km Nordic walking race. October weather is typically around 14 °C, with occasional rain and mostly cloudy skies. The event also includes Nordic walking and is aimed at all age groups. It is recommended that participants check the details with the organizer before registering.

name: Traditioneller Sparkassen-Herbstwaldlauf
location: Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum, Beckum, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Traditional Sparkasse Autumn Forest Run in Beckum is a popular running event held at the Harberstadion sports center in Neubeckum. The event offers various races for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a student race, a 5 km fun run, 5 km walking, and the 10 km main race. Participants receive medals, certificates, and trophies, making the event a motivating experience for recreational and competitive runners. Late entries are possible until about 30 minutes before the start, offering flexibility for last-minute entrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Harberstadion sports center in Neubeckum
Races for all age groups, from Bambini to the main race
Trophies for the fastest runners and certificates for all participants
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until approximately 30 minutes before the start, for a late-entry fee of €2. All participants in the Bambini and student races receive medals; participants in the 5 km fun run and 5 km walking receive certificates; and the top three runners in the 10 km main race receive trophies, while all participants receive certificates. Forest running event; registration and results on the website.

name: Weißenhorner Altstadtlauf
description: The Weißenhorn Old Town Run is a traditional race held every year in October in the historic old town of Weißenhorn. The event is organized by TSV Weißenhorn and gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The race is known for its varied course through the picturesque old town and is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. Enjoyment of running and community are at the heart of the event.
course_highlights: Course through the historic old town of Weißenhorn
Varied terrain with views of the town
Traditional event in October
additional: The race is organized by TSV Weißenhorn, which also offers other athletics training groups and events. The athletics department meets regularly for training, and the Old Town Run is an annual highlight in October. The event takes place at the TSV hall and in the old town. It is held every year, with various races for all age groups. Registration is usually through Race Result, and the results are publicly available. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and support from the local community.

name: Oldenburg Marathon
price_range: 35 Euro für Sportshirt (genaue Startgebühr nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon offers runners a varied programme featuring a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km city run, 5 km run and children’s mile run. The course passes through Oldenburg and Wardenburg and is known for its excellent refreshments and friendly atmosphere. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and also offers a public race series with additional events throughout the year. Participants receive high-quality long-sleeved shirts, and extensive services are available on site.
course_highlights: Refreshment stations every 5 km on courses of 10 km or longer, offering water, sports drinks and fruit
Showers at the sports hall of Graf Anton Günther School, approximately 300 m from the start/finish area
Changing facilities and baggage drop-off on Parking Deck 1 at Schlosshöfe
additional: Race packs will be available at Schlosshöfe from 11 a.m. on 11 October. On race day, collection opens at 7 a.m. for marathon runners and at 8 a.m. for everyone else. Group registration is available. After the race, extensive refreshments will be provided, including drinks, fruit, coffee, tea, pastries and non-alcoholic wheat beer. Physiotherapy students will offer free massages. Portable toilets and changing facilities are available. Several race distances; start in Wardenburg; road closures in the city centre; medals for finishers; online registration available.

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
description: The Müggelsee Half Marathon is a scenic race in southeast Berlin that runs entirely around the Großer Müggelsee. The event offers three distances: a half marathon, 10 kilometers, and 5 kilometers, each set up as either an out-and-back course or a loop. The route passes through the historic Spree Tunnel and offers idyllic views of Berlin’s largest lake and the surrounding Müggelberge. The race is suitable for all runners, whether they are aiming for personal bests or simply want to enjoy the community and nature. The start and finish are at Müggelseeperle, and the race takes place.

name: Almetal-Marathon
description: The Almetal Marathon 2026 takes place on October 18 and offers runners a scenic route from Büren-Ringelstein to Ahorn-Sportpark in Paderborn. Alongside the classic marathon distance, there are two half-marathon options and a relay race covering four stages. The event is shaped by the volunteer commitment of numerous sports clubs and offers a family-friendly atmosphere and an impressive experience of nature in the Alme Valley.

name: Döbraberg Dr. Heinz Laubmann Gedächtnis Lauf
description: The Döbraberg Dr. Heinz Laubmann Memorial Run is a traditional group run that starts in Hof and takes participants along the Webersteig to the Döbraberg, the highest point in the Frankenwald. The event takes place in October and offers distances of 8.5 km, 14.5 km and 23 km, as well as 8.5 km walking and Nordic walking routes. The shorter adult runs are untimed, with the focus on reaching the summit together. The route is hilly and challenging, with a structured format in which pacemakers set the pace and overtaking is not permitted. The run was established in 1968 in honour of Dr. Heinz Laubmann, founder of the IfL clubs.

name: Hubertuslauf
description: The Hubertuslauf in Neuruppin is a traditional running event organized by the Ostprignitz-Ruppin District Sports Association. It offers 8 km and 15 km races, a 3 km company run, and an 8 km walking event. The event is open to athletes of all ability levels and takes place annually. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Neuruppin, offering runners and walkers an enjoyable and varied experience.
course_highlights: 8 km and 15 km races
3 km company run
8 km walking event

name: Kauferinger Stauseelauf
description: The Kaufering Reservoir Run is a running event in Kaufering offering several distances, including a half marathon and shorter routes of 0.4 km, 0.8 km and 8.2 km. The event attracts runners from the region and features a varied course around the reservoir. The atmosphere is family-friendly, making it suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website, highlighting the race’s tradition and popularity.

name: Spannrit Volks- und Straßenlauf TSG Kleinostheim
description: The Spannrit Volks- und Straßenlauf TSG Kleinostheim is a local road-running event in Kleinostheim, Germany, held at the Maingauhalle on Ludwigstraße. The event is organized by TSG Kleinostheim and offers children’s and youth races as well as 5 km and 10 km races for adults. The adult course is flat and follows an out-and-back route, with all races finishing at the Maingauhalle. The event is being held for the 15th time and is listed in the German athletics calendar, underscoring its significance in organized club running.

name: Kros Českým rájem
description: Kros Českým rájem is a trail race in a picturesque, little-known corner of Český ráj, featuring a varied and undulating course that winds among sandstone rocks, forest paths, and white-sand trails. The race is 100% trail and is suitable for nature lovers and technical runners. The start and finish are in the village of Skokovy, which is less than an hour from Prague. Race day also includes children’s races and an accompanying programme, including a children’s area.

name: Podzimní Kiosk
description: Podzimní Kiosk is a cross-country race held in Tyršovy sady in Šternberk, featuring a 7 km course for men and a 3.5 km course for women. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners and gives runners the chance to test themselves in pleasant autumn surroundings. The course runs over mixed terrain, making for an engaging and dynamic race for all participants.

name: Běh Zlínem "Přes valašské kotáry"
description: The “Across the Wallachian Hills” race in Zlín is a traditional running event that gives runners the chance to experience the beauty of the Wallachian countryside and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at the Mládeže Stadium, and the route takes runners through picturesque hills and natural scenery. The organizers emphasize quality organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series, which includes various running events in the region.

name: PREFA Brněnská 25
organizer: BehejBrno.com, MARATON BRNO z.s., Aleš Čtvrtníček
description: PREFA Brněnská 25 is a traditional road race held in Brno and the surrounding area, running continuously since 1967. It offers several distances—25 km, 16 km, 8 km, and relays—and is open to a wide range of participants, from competitive runners to beginners. The race takes place at the Olympia Park complex near the rope course in Modřice and is part of the Czech Running Club. The first category starts at 11:00, making it convenient for families and recreational runners to take part.

name: Horokros
description: Horokros is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which offers a challenging cross-country race in the picturesque Jeseníky Mountains near Šumperk. The race is intended for runners looking for a trail challenge with varied terrain and natural obstacles. The course is known for its difficulty and beautiful views, attracting both experienced competitors and mountain-running enthusiasts. The Chlapácký běh series rewards regular participants who complete at least six races in a season. Come enjoy the sporting atmosphere and push your limits in the unique setting of the Jeseníky Mountains.

name: Běh na Žaltman
description: The Běh na Žaltman is an open hill race with a mass start, part of the Krakonoš Czech Hill Running Cup and the East Bohemia Grand Prix series. The race takes place in Malé Svatoňovice in the Hradec Králové Region and offers a sporting challenge amid beautiful natural surroundings. The route follows demanding terrain with significant elevation gain, attracting runners of all abilities. The event is a traditional part of the running season and welcomes athletes and fans of hill running alike.

name: Běh okolo Rané
description: The Run Around Raná is a race held in the surroundings of Raná near Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. It offers an 8.5 km course for men and a 4.25 km course for women. The race is part of the Louny Running Cup and gives runners the opportunity to enjoy running in natural surroundings with picturesque views. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners looking for a quality race with a regional tradition.

name: Běh pro republiku
location: Památník Vojna, Lešetice, Milín, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro republiku is an annual running event held around the Vojna Memorial near Příbram. It commemorates the founding of the Czechoslovak Republic and the fate of political prisoners. The route follows forest and field paths with asphalt and stony surfaces, and participants remember prominent figures in the struggle for freedom and democracy. The event is held under the patronage of President Petr Pavel and offers races for adults and children, as well as walks and Nordic walking. The programme also includes tours of the Vojna Memorial and other accompanying activities.
course_highlights: The 5 km route starts at the Vojna Memorial, goes through Žežice and Lešetice, and returns to the Vojna Memorial
The route includes asphalt, stony dirt, forest paths and field paths
The run takes place alongside regular vehicle traffic; the route is marked with ribbon and spray paint
additional: Registration is available online for the 5 km race, the 200 m children’s run, the Nordic walking outing and the 5 km dog walk. Parking is available in front of the Vojna Memorial or along the roads; arriving by bicycle is recommended. Refreshments and water are available at the finish. A volunteer with a first-aid kit is present in the start and finish area. Tours of the Vojna Memorial and the accompanying programme take place every hour on the hour until 16:00. The Vojna Memorial is located in Lešetice near Milín.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 10. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running competition over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. The race takes place at Kuchajda in Bratislava and is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. The start is traditionally at 10:00, and the event also includes children’s races of approximately 200 meters. The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is part of a series of races held throughout the year, offering runners of various age groups and ability levels an opportunity to compete.

name: Challenge Airport Run
location: Prešov, Prešov, vojenská letecká základna v Prešove
organizer: Prešov Running, v spolupráci s Vojenskou leteckou základňou v Prešove
description: Challenge Airport Run is a unique running experience at the Military Air Base in Prešov, combining sport with the atmosphere of military training. Runners can choose between a 5 km and a 10 km course, with each participant carrying a symbolic weighted backpack, highlighting courage and endurance. The event offers an unforgettable atmosphere among helicopters and military equipment, which is rarely accessible to the public. In addition to the athletic challenge, it is also a tribute to discipline and strength, with a rich accompanying programme and original race packs.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 6. kolo
organizer: 3klub Šamorín o.z. v spolupráci s mestom Šamorín
description: The Šamorín Running League is a traditional running competition organized by 3klub Šamorín, held in the pleasant surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park in Šamorín. The league offers several rounds with different distances, suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts. Participants can expect high-quality organization and a pleasant atmosphere in and around the amphitheater. The league is part of the region’s active sporting life and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: Slaňaki CUP – Beh do vrchu Dubník
location: Zámutov okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Zámutov okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom
organizer: Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov, Penzión Kondor Zámutov
description: Slaňaki CUP - Dubník Uphill Race is a traditional uphill race held in Zámutov, Vranov nad Topľou District. The course is 11.2 km long with 600 metres of elevation gain, and the finish is at Slovakia’s highest structure, the Dubník transmitter, at an altitude of 318 metres. The race is part of the Slovak Uphill Running Cup and is open to a broad range of male and female runners of various ages. It is organized by the Vranovské Vydry Winter Swimming Club, Zámutov Municipal Office, and Penzión Kondor Zámutov. The race challenges runners to test their endurance and strength on demanding mountain terrain.

name: Žipovská desiatka
description: The Žipovská desiatka is a traditional running race held in the village of Nižný Žipov, offering runners the chance to test themselves on a 10-kilometre course. The race is organised by the Municipality of Nižný Žipov and is part of the village’s sporting life. The course runs along local roads and streets, allowing runners to experience the atmosphere of the village and its surroundings. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The route runs along Hlavná Street in Nižný Žipov
A 10 km race with an inline option
The atmosphere of a traditional village sporting event
additional: The event also includes an inline race on the same course. Race results are published on the municipality’s official website. The organiser is the Municipality of Nižný Žipov, which also provides other services and information for participants. In the previous edition, changing rooms were available in the cultural centre.

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 8. kolo
location: Námestie T. G. Masaryka, Trenčianske Teplice, Slovakia

name: Bež, kto môžeš
description: Bež, kto môžeš is a charity run organized by Oáza Bernátovce, supporting people in extreme hardship and those experiencing homelessness. This running event has attracted many kind-hearted people and has a strong social focus, bringing sport together with support for disadvantaged groups. The run takes place in Košice - Barca and is part of a long-term project supporting socially excluded people. The organizers give the community an opportunity to get involved in helping others through sport and solidarity.
additional: The run is part of the DOMA SI ?! II. project, running from 08/2024 to 06/2027, which helps people facing long-term disadvantage and at risk of poverty and social exclusion.

name: Botanic Five Kaunas
location: Vytautas Magnus University Botanical Garden, Kaunas, Lithuania
description: Botanic Five Kaunas is a unique 5 km run held at the Botanical Garden of Vytautas Magnus University in Kaunas. The event offers the chance to run in beautiful natural surroundings and enjoy the diversity and scents of the garden’s plants. Children’s races are also organized, making the event suitable for the whole family. The Botanical Garden offers a sense of peace and connection with nature, making running here a special experience for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: 5 km route through the VMU Botanical Garden
Run surrounded by nature, with a variety of plants and scents
Children’s races for families
additional: The event takes place at the VMU Botanical Garden, which is open from 09:00 to 19:00 outside the season. The garden has a greenhouse and a tropical butterfly exhibition, which visitors can visit during the event. Visitors can purchase admission tickets, and after 17:00, entry to the park is permitted only with an electronic ticket or season pass.

name: Bėgimas Botanic five
location: Vytautas Magnus University Botanical Garden, Kaunas, Lithuania
description: The Botanic Five run will take place at the Botanical Garden of Vytautas Magnus University in Kaunas, inviting participants to discover the garden while running. It is a unique opportunity to experience the beauty of nature and get to know the garden in a different way by taking part in an international initiative. The event is intended both for active runners and nature lovers who want to spend time surrounded by nature.
course_highlights: The run takes place within the Botanical Garden grounds
A unique opportunity to discover the garden while running
The event takes place surrounded by nature in Kaunas
additional: During the event, visitors can enjoy the Botanical Garden’s educational activities and exhibitions. Named benches adorn the garden, and visitors can contribute to their purchase. The Botanical Garden offers a variety of educational programmes and events for all age groups.

name: Klánovický 1/2maraton
description: The Klánovice Half Marathon is a trail half marathon through the beautiful surroundings of Klánovice Forest in Prague. The race offers a certified 21.0975 km course along forest paths, a nature trail, and tracks with minimal asphalt and no significant climbs. The event also includes 10 km races, a relay, and children’s races, all with convenient facilities and refreshments along the course. It is ideal for nature lovers and trail runners who want to discover the forest’s beautiful spots and enjoy a friendly atmosphere with an accompanying program.

name: Dvojmíľový beh 30. ročník, Memoriál Gabriela Zelenaya 5. ročník - preteky mládeže
Loučení s oválem
description: Farewell to the Track is a traditional race organized by the Slezan Frýdek-Místek Sports Club. It has been held annually since 2000 as the final track race of the season. Originally intended only for young athletes, it added adult categories in 2014, with distances of 1500 m for men and 800 m for women. After a break from 2017 to 2019, the race returned in 2020 with 800 m events for young athletes and 3000 m for adults. The race takes place at Na Příkopě 1159 in Frýdek-Místek and is a popular event among the region’s athletics community.

name: Beh k srdcu SNP
location: Atletický štadión pri Strednej odbornej škole polytechnickej, Ul. Čs. armády 24, Martin, Slovakia

name: Medziklubové preteky Jesenný kros ŠK Juventa Žilina
Mizuno Neon Run Olomouc
description: Mizuno Neon Run in Olomouc is a nighttime running event full of color, lights, and fun. It’s not a race, but an experience for all participants. This neon run offers a wild and crazy glowing experience that celebrates the joy of movement and having fun together. Get ready to shine and enjoy an unforgettable atmosphere at the Výstaviště Flora grounds in Olomouc.

name: Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Polska
distance_verbose: 149 km, 102 km, 69 km, 46 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: Łemkowyna Trail to górski bieg po trasie wyznaczonej Głównym Szlakiem Beskidzkim w Beskidzie Niskim. Zawody odbywają się w okolicach Krynica-Zdrój i Komańcza, oferując różnorodne dystanse od 10 km do ultramaratonu 150 km. Trasa charakteryzuje się znacznym przewyższeniem i naturalnym, wymagającym terenem, co czyni bieg wyzwaniem dla miłośników trailu i górskich przygód. Impreza ma silną tradycję i przyciąga biegaczy z całej Polski i zagranicy.
course_highlights: Trasa wyznaczona Głównym Szlakiem Beskidzkim
Znaczne przewyższenia do +5860 m i -5970 m na najdłuższym dystansie
Różnorodne dystanse od 10 km do 150 km, z limitami czasowymi
additional: Limit uczestników na poszczególnych dystansach od 300 do 550 osób. Limit czasowy na każdy dystans. Zawody odbywają się na naturalnych, górskich szlakach z dużym przewyższeniem. Zawody obejmują trasy z przewyższeniem sięgającym nawet 740 m dla 30 km i 150 km ultramaratonu, z limitami czasowymi do 35 godzin. Rejestracja dostępna online, z możliwością zwrotu wpisowego i transferu pakietów startowych.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet na cały cykl w jednym mieście (4 imprezy)

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL z Fundacją Lotto to ogólnopolski cykl biegów przełajowych na dystansie 5 km, odbywający się w siedmiu lokalizacjach, w tym we Wrocławiu w Lesie Osobowickim. Zawody mają charakter rekreacyjno-sportowy, promują aktywność fizyczną na łonie natury oraz zdrowy tryb życia. Cykl obejmuje cztery biegi w każdej lokalizacji, a uczestnicy mogą rywalizować w klasyfikacji lokalnej i łącznej. Bieg główny startuje o godzinie 11:00, a impreza jest otwarta dla osób od 16 roku życia wzwyż, z możliwością udziału młodszych pod opieką rodziców.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km prowadzi po lesie miejskim - Las Osobowicki we Wrocławiu
Bieg przełajowy w naturalnym otoczeniu, po terenach leśnych i parkowych
Cykl czterech biegów w sezonie w każdej lokalizacji
additional: Biuro zawodów otwierane jest o 8:30, a odbiór numerów startowych i chipów odbywa się w dniu biegu. Możliwość wykupienia pakietu charytatywnego wspierającego Fundację Siepomaga. Karnet na cały cykl pozwala na start w 4 biegach w danym mieście, a uczestnicy z karnetem mogą skorzystać z jednego bezpłatnego startu w innym mieście po wcześniejszym zgłoszeniu mailowym. Brak limitu uczestników. Start biegu głównego o 11:00, a zakończenie imprezy około 12:15. Do startu i biura zawodów nie można dojechać samochodem; parkowanie jest możliwe wzdłuż ul. Osobowickiej.

name: XXIII Bieg śladami ks. Józefa Londzina
Nordwalder Laufspektakel
description: The Nordwalde Running Spectacle is a popular running event with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as children’s races. It takes place annually in Nordwalde and attracts numerous runners looking forward to a sporting challenge. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organisation. It offers suitable running options for competitive runners, families and children alike.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon
Children’s races over 1 km and 2 km
Participant and course records for the 5 km and half marathon
additional: The event takes place annually and offers children’s races alongside the main distances. It combines a sporting challenge with a family-friendly atmosphere. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. The event takes place in Nordwalde, with more than 800 participants at the last edition, including record-breaking times and food and drink.

name: Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd
location: Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd, Schwäbisch Gmünd, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd is a traditional ultramarathon that has been held annually since 1991 during golden October. The 50-kilometer course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain crosses the Three Imperial Mountains—Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen—through breathtaking scenery. In addition to the main race, other events include the Alb Ultra at approx. 60 km, the 37 km Alb-Trail, a 25 km race, a 10 km run and walk, and a children’s race. The event offers a sporting spectacle for the whole family and a varied program including a talk, briefing and pasta party.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain across the Three Imperial Mountains: Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen
Breathtaking natural scenery and landscapes
A range of distances, from the children’s race to the 60 km Alb Ultra
additional: Start for all races (except the Alb-Trail) is on Schwerzerallee, level with the Großsporthalle. Event center at the Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd. Electronic timing using a transponder in the race number (no ChampionChip). A medal is included for races over 25 km; medals for other races can be ordered online for €5. Return transport by local and special buses is available to participants with a race number. Friday evening program includes a talk, briefing and pasta party (€7 contribution toward the meal). Loop course across the Imperial Mountains, aid stations, relay and team competitions, award ceremonies, race number with RFID transponder

name: Burgkirchner Raiffeisen-Crosslauf
location: Freizeitzentrum Halsbachgraben, Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Burgkirchner Raiffeisen Cross-Country Run is a hilly cross-country race in Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria. The start and finish are at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Centre. The event is part of the Raiffeisen Cross-Country Series and offers various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including short courses from 0.65 km to 1.3 km and longer races of 4.5 km and 6.6 km. The course is challenging and hilly rather than flat, making even the short distances strenuous. Separate races for children and teenagers, as well as a special 6.6 km race for men, round out the programme.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country course, not a flat road
Start and finish at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Centre
Various distances for children, teenagers and adults
additional: Results, photos and further details are available at laufpix.de. Official information is also linked via crosslauf-is.de. Typical October weather: around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Multiple course distances, separate categories for children and teenagers, not a flat road race, and a sporting challenge due to the hilly terrain

name: Gelenauer Erzgebirgscross
description: The Gelenau Erzgebirge Cross is a long-standing running event in the Ore Mountains, organized by LV 90 Erzgebirge. The competition takes place in Gelenau and gives runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on a challenging course. The event is known for its scenic and varied cross-country course through the Ore Mountains. It is open to children, youth, active runners, and masters, and is a fixture on the regional athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Scenic cross-country course in the Ore Mountains
A variety of courses for children, youth, active runners, and masters
Organized by the experienced LV 90 Erzgebirge
additional: Entries should be sent to Sophia Teicher, Kemtauer Straße 27, 09423 Gelenau/Erzgebirge. The contact email is given as meldung "ät" lv90.de. The event includes various categories and age groups, with possible official results for rankings. October weather is typically cool, with temperatures around 14°C; rain is possible.

name: Lusatian Race Walking
description: The Lusatian Race Walking is an international race walking meeting held annually in Zittau. The event offers half-marathon and marathon races on a 1-kilometer circuit. It attracts top athletes from various countries and is part of the World Race Walking Tour at Silver level. The course is flat and offers good visibility, ensuring exciting races for spectators.
course_highlights: 1-kilometer circuit
Flat course, ideal for fast times
International top athletes and meeting records
additional: The race is part of the World Race Walking Tour at Silver level. The venue is Zittau, Germany. The organizers are AC Rumburk, z.s. and O-SEE Sports e.V.

name: Alb Marathon
description: The Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd is a traditional ultramarathon that has been held every year since 1991 during golden October. The main course covers 50 kilometers with 1,100 meters of elevation gain, crossing the three Imperial Mountains—Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen—through impressive scenery and unique natural surroundings. In addition to the 50 km race, other events include a 25 km race, the 37 km Alb Trail, the 60 km Alb Ultra and relay races. The event offers a sporting spectacle for the whole family and welcomes both competitive runners and those who run for enjoyment.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain over the Imperial Mountains of Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen
Breathtaking scenery and unique natural surroundings in the Swabian Alb
Various distances and relay races for different ability levels
additional: The start and finish area is at the Großsporthalle, Katharinenstraße 33 in Schwäbisch Gmünd. The 50 km race uses electronic timing via a transponder attached to the race number. There are five aid stations along the course, offering water, tea, soft drinks, salted pretzels and bananas. Special buses run from the event center to the starts in Essingen and Lautern for the Alb Ultra and Alb Trail. A medal is included for individual entrants in the 60 km, 50 km, 37 km and 25 km races, and can also be ordered online for €6.

name: B.U.T.XxX - BURGBERNHEIM ULTRA TRAIL
description: The B.U.T.XxX - Burgbernheim Ultra Trail is a challenging ultratrail run held in the picturesque surroundings of Burgbernheim. The event gives runners the opportunity to experience nature and varied landscapes on demanding courses. The run is part of TSV Burgbernheim’s activities and combines sporting ambition with community and tradition.
course_highlights: Challenging ultratrail course in the surroundings of Burgbernheim
Varied terrain with natural landscapes
Part of TSV Burgbernheim’s club activities

name: Lauf der Crossserie des BLV-Kreises Ansbach
Tálínská desítka
location: Náves před obecním úřadem, Tálín, Czech Republic
organizer: Obec Tálín a Progres TT Tálín
description: Tálínská desítka is a traditional running race held in the village of Tálín, bringing together athletes of all ages in the village’s picturesque setting. The race is part of the village’s sports calendar and supports community life and sporting activities for local residents and visitors. The event is organized in cooperation with local sports clubs, including Triatlon Team Tálín, and offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. The start and finish are on the village square in front of the municipal office, creating a friendly atmosphere and making the event easily accessible to participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the village square in front of the municipal office in Tálín
Picturesque village setting suitable for running
Event suitable for all age groups, including people with physical disabilities
additional: The race is part of Tálín’s sporting events, which support community life and are open to the general public, including children, seniors, and people with physical disabilities. It is organized by local sports clubs Triatlon Team Tálín and Galaxy Cyklošvec Písek. The village also has the V OBRAZE mobile app for following the latest information.

name: Třebíčský maraton
description: The Třebíč Marathon invites you to run through the picturesque streets of Třebíč’s historic centre, where you can admire the atmosphere of its UNESCO landmarks, including the iconic Basilica of St. Procopius. In addition to the marathon, you can choose the half-marathon or the shorter 10K, both of which also pass through the city’s historic and natural beauty. Refreshment stations await you along the course and at the finish, followed by a relaxing AfterRun party—the perfect way to round off a day of sport. Families can also enjoy children’s races right in the city centre, with an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: Picturesque streets in Třebíč’s historic centre
The atmosphere of UNESCO landmarks, including the Basilica of St. Procopius
Refreshment stations along the course and a welcoming atmosphere
additional: The registration fee must be paid within 14 days of registration; otherwise, the registration will be cancelled. After completing online registration, you can also register on site, but the number of race packs is limited. An AfterRun party will round off the day after the race. Children’s races take place right in the city centre, with a lively atmosphere. The event offers a marathon, half-marathon, 10K race and children’s races. Prices published for the 2026 edition may not apply to 2027.

name: Slapy Trail Maniacs
description: Slapy Trail Maniacs is a marked trail race around the Slapy Reservoir, offering three challenging routes of 61 km, 47 km, and 33 km. The main course, with 2,300 metres of elevation gain, follows roads, paths, stream crossings, rocky outcrops, and steep slopes, making for a varied and technically interesting run. There are two special competitions on the course—a hill-climb and a speed prize—and the race is also suitable for earning ITRA points. Medals, diplomas, prizes in kind, and prize money are awarded to the top runners. The event is organised by Š&P Outdoor z.s., which provides high-quality organisation and support for runners.
course_highlights: 61 km main course with 2,300 m of elevation gain
Routes follow roads, paths, stream crossings, rocky outcrops, and steep slopes
The course features hill-climb and speed prizes
additional: ITRA points can be earned by completing the 61 km or 47 km course. The fastest runners can win medals, diplomas, prizes in kind, and prize money. The organiser is Š&P Outdoor z.s.; the contact person is Ondřej Kutiš. The marked race features technically challenging terrain around the Slapy Reservoir. Race facilities are listed at Hořovická chata in Borotice.

name: Olomoucký kros
location: Přírodní koupaliště Poděbrady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Olomouc Cross is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the natural surroundings of the Poděbrady swimming pool in Olomouc. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region and gives athletes the opportunity to test their fitness and performance in a beautiful natural setting. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners who want to test themselves in a cross-country race.
course_highlights: Run in the natural surroundings of the Poděbrady swimming pool
Part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Cross-country race with natural obstacles
additional: Available information about previous editions relates to races for children and young people; the program for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed.

name: Skalička run
location: Obecní hřiště, Skalička, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Skalička Run is the fifth edition of a successful off-road running event, held mainly in the valley of the Lubě stream in the South Moravian Region. The race offers three distances: 22 km, 13 km and 7 km, all featuring cross-country and trail terrain. It starts at the municipal sports field in Skalička and is suitable for nature-running enthusiasts looking for varying levels of difficulty. The event is organised by DálRunDál z.s., led by Pavel Matoušek.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly through the valley of the Lubě stream
Cross-country and trail terrain
Distances of 22 km, 13 km and 7 km
additional: The race is organised by DálRunDál z.s.; the contact person is Pavel Matoušek. Race type: cross-country/trail. The first category starts at 11:15. The start venue is the municipal sports field.

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Kemp Stříbrný rybník, Malšova Lhota, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Hradečák is part of Leskros, the largest Czech running and canicross series, offering an authentic trail-running experience. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Stříbrný rybník campsite in Malšova Lhota near Hradec Králové, and includes various running and canicross categories as well as the unique Leskrosí jednadváca race. Individuals and whole families can take part, with children’s races and a charity walk also on offer. The series emphasizes fairness, transparency, and support for nonprofit organizations through entry fees and donations.
course_highlights: Authentic trail running in interesting locations across the Czech Republic
Canicross on the main route, approximately 4 km, with OPEN and ELITE categories
The unique Leskrosí jednadváca: 19–22 km along an unmarked route through beautiful places in the surrounding area
additional: The race offers running, canicross, and Leskrosí jednadváca categories. The Rozběháček children’s running program is free. A 4 km charity walk is also part of the event. Results for individual races and the whole series are announced. Registration and entries are managed through the Rozběháme Česko app. The organizer is the nonprofit organization Rozběháme Česko z.ú., which supports charitable projects. For the 2026 edition, the first category was scheduled to start at 8:00; this time may not apply to the 2027 edition.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
location: Prokopské údolí, Praha 5, Prague, Czech Republic
description: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí is a traditional autumn running race set amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Prokopské and Dalejské valleys in Prague. It offers two main routes of approximately 8.7 and 14.3 km, running along paved and unpaved paths, meadows and trails, with limited traffic on the asphalt roads. The race is suitable for the general public and has a relaxed atmosphere, with refreshments and accompanying children’s races. The capacity is limited to 500 starters, ensuring a comfortable event. The organizers emphasize clear route marking and runner safety.
course_highlights: The routes wind through the beautiful, wild scenery of Prokopské and Dalejské valleys
Two routes of approximately 8.7 km and 14.3 km, with every kilometre marked
The routes combine paved and unpaved paths, meadows, trails and asphalt roads with limited traffic
additional: Race-day check-in and registration take place from 9:00 to 10:45. The children’s races start from 10:00; the main races start at 10:45 (8 km) and 11:00 (14 km). The race is limited to 500 starters. On-site registration is available for an additional fee of 600 Kč, if capacity has not been reached. There is one refreshment station on the course. The timing chip is attached to the race number and does not need to be returned after finishing. Trail shoes with a more aggressive tread are recommended. The event site has toilets, baggage storage, changing tents, a results ceremony and a raffle. Course, price and start-time information is from the 2026 edition.

name: Běhej Valachy
location: Hotel Galik, Velké Karlovice, Czech Republic
description: Běhej Valachy is a trail-running race across the rugged hills of the picturesque Velké Karlovice valley. The course follows the Hanzlůvka valley and passes the Za Miloňovou bell tower before climbing to the ridge of the Vsetín Beskids, below Vysoká and up to Člověčí. From there, it descends along a steep ridge with beautiful views of the Beskids and Javorníky. The race offers unique views, challenging climbs, and a memorable experience of movement and nature. It also includes children’s races for various age groups and a family race.
course_highlights: The course follows the Hanzlůvka valley and passes the Za Miloňovou bell tower on its way to the ridge of the Vsetín Beskids.
Beautiful views of the Beskids and Javorníky from a steep ridge.
A challenging climb past the U Křenků cottage and a mountain sprint at an elevation of 938 m above sea level.
additional: There are mass starts for adults running 12.5 km and 6.5 km, as well as a 3.2 km family race. Children’s races are divided into age categories from 4 to 15 years. The start area opens at 11:45; check-in and registration for children take place from 8:00 to 9:15, and adult check-in runs from 9:30 to 11:30. The finish straight is attractive and offers plenty of room for a final sprint. The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule on race day. According to information available for the 2026 edition, the races on offer are 12.5 km, 6.5 km, and a 3.2 km family run, alongside the children’s races. Facilities include registration, a changing room, showers, and refreshments; prices for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
location: Městský stadion Ostrava-Vítkovice, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: The Golden Emil Zátopek Marathon Ostrava is a prestigious running event offering a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, and mixed team race on a fast, certified course in Ostrava-Vítkovice. The event takes place at the Ostrava-Vítkovice Municipal Stadium, with the start and finish on the stadium track. Runners can follow in the footsteps of the legendary Emil Zátopek and experience the atmosphere of a professionally organized race with an accompanying program. The race pack includes an original performance shirt, a medal, and refreshments during and after the race. The event is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes.
course_highlights: Fast, certified course in Ostrava-Vítkovice
Start and finish on the track at the Municipal Stadium
8 refreshment stations on the marathon course offering water, fruit, and energy supplements
additional: The bib with timing chip must be worn on the chest for accurate timekeeping. After the start, marathon runners complete one lap of the stadium track before heading out onto the course. Lead and sweeper vehicles and cyclists accompany the first and last runners. Changing rooms, toilets, and baggage storage are available at the stadium. Parking is available at Ostravar Arena for a fee, or free of charge in limited spaces on nearby streets. After the race, a wide range of refreshments, an expo, and free physiotherapy are available. The date October 23, 2027, has not been confirmed on the official website.

name: Moravská Sázava
location: Horský Resort Buková Hora, Červená Voda, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné ULTRA 50 je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné DVOJIC je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč / člen dvojice

description: Moravská Sázava Ultra 50 is a 50 km ultrarunning race that follows the valleys of the Moravská Sázava River from Zábřeh to the summit of Buková hora. The course offers a varied mix of forest roads, natural trails and paved sections, with a total elevation gain of 1,369 metres. The race is suitable for experienced ultrarunners as well as runners looking for a new challenge, and finishes at the summit of Buková hora, from where participants can comfortably ride the cable car down. After the race, camping is available in the finish area, with showers and breakfast on Sunday morning.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,369 m of elevation gain
A mix of forest roads, natural trails and paved sections
Finish at the summit of Buková hora, with the option to ride down by cable car
additional: Participants receive an ID wristband, race bib and GPS tracker. Aid stations along the course provide water, sports drinks, Coca-Cola and fruit. After the race, camping is available at the finish, with access to showers. The finish area is at the cable car’s upper station, and participants can comfortably ride down by cable car. Results are timed electronically and manually. GPS trackers are mandatory and are used to track participants online. The race is included in the UTMB Index 50K and ITRA 50K - 2. The race base is at Horský Resort Buková Hora.

name: NN Night Run Olomouc
description: NN Night Run Olomouc is the largest running event in Olomouc, held at the Flora Exhibition Centre. The event offers a 10 km night run, a 2 × 5 km relay, a 5 km charity run, and a 3 km family run, including children’s races. It brings an unforgettable atmosphere, a varied programme of activities, and support for charitable projects. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can enjoy running through the city at night by the light of headlamps.
course_highlights: Night run through Olomouc, with an atmosphere illuminated by headlamps
Distances ranging from 300 m for children to a 10 km night run
Bellis Run charity race supporting the fight against breast cancer
additional: Registration and race-pack collection take place from 13:00 to 17:30, depending on the race. A baggage drop and changing rooms are available. After the race, participants can enjoy activities including a photo booth, face painting, a bouncy castle, and testing and sales of running equipment and nutritional supplements. Entry can be transferred to another participant online or on site for a fee. All participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish. The race facilities are at the Flora Exhibition Centre. Online registration closes on 19 October 2026 at 18:00; on-site registration is subject to available capacity. The time limit for the main race is 90 minutes.

name: Běh kolem Asuánu
location: Jižní konec retenční nádrže Asuán, Jinonice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Aswan is a traditional cross-country race held on the embankment of the Aswan retention reservoir in Prague’s Jinonice district. It offers courses of various lengths for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, on gently undulating terrain with a natural surface and an asphalt finish straight. The race is accessible only on foot from several nearby bus stops and is organized by Atletika Stodůlky z.s. The entry fee is voluntary, making the race accessible to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: A gently undulating course with a natural surface
An asphalt finish straight
The start and race office are on the embankment of the Aswan retention reservoir and are accessible on foot
additional: Race categories are divided by age, with course distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 3600 m for men. The start and race office are located at the southern end of the Aswan retention reservoir. Access is on foot only from the Ovčí hájek and Galerie Butovice bus stops and the Volcano complex. The start and race office are at the southern end of the reservoir; access is on foot only.

name: Běh do vrchu na Pastýřskou stěnu
location: Pastýřská stěna, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Pastýřská stěna uphill race is the oldest uphill race in the Czech Republic, with an elevation gain of 110 metres. The race features an extremely steep climb in the second part of the course, which runs over stairs, paving and forest trails. It takes place in Děčín and is suitable for runners looking for a challenging, technical uphill race. It is organised by AK Loko Děčín under the leadership of Zdeněk Hrnčíř.
course_highlights: The oldest uphill race in the Czech Republic, with an elevation gain of 110 m
An extremely steep climb in the second part of the course
The course surface includes stairs, paving and forest trails
additional: The first category starts at 10:30, and the main category starts at 11:00. The organiser is AK Loko Děčín; the contact person is Zdeněk Hrnčíř. The course is short, at 0.83 km, with a significant elevation gain and technical terrain.

name: Beh hrebeňom Čergova
location: Kamenica, Sabinov District, Prešov Region, Slovakia
description: The Run Along the Čergov Ridge is the longest mountain race in the Čergov Mountains, intended for nature-running enthusiasts and trained runners. The route starts in the village of Kamenica and passes over the range’s highest peaks, including Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá and Sedlo Besná, offering magnificent panoramic views. The course is 32 km long with 1,413 metres of elevation gain, making it a challenging and appealing race for mountain runners. The race starts at Farma Kamenica and finishes at Sedlo Besná, by Hotel Šport Lysá. The organizer provides transport for runners from Drienica to the start and takes their personal belongings to the finish.
course_highlights: The route passes over the highest peaks of the Čergov Mountains, all above 1,000 m
Magnificent panoramic views throughout the race
Forest hiking trails marked in blue and green
additional: A large bus will take runners from the village of Drienica to the village of Kamenica at 7:15 a.m. on race morning. Race-day registration is from 7:00 to 8:30 a.m. at Farma Kamenica. The results ceremony and lunch will be held at Hotel Šport Lysá.

name: Rajecká 12-minútovka
location: School sports field on Lipová Street, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecká 12-Minute Run is a running competition organized by the Rajec Marathon Club. It takes place on the sports field beside the elementary school on Lipová Street in Rajec. This dynamic timed run challenges participants to cover the greatest possible distance in 12 minutes. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant surroundings of Rajec.
course_highlights: A 12-minute timed run
Start and finish on the sports field beside the elementary school on Lipová Street
Pleasant urban surroundings in Rajec

name: Beh vinicami Bojničiek a Hlohovca
location: Kultúrny dom, Bojničky, Hlohovec District, Trnava Region, Slovakia
description: The Run through the Vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec is a running race organized by Atletický klub Bojničky and the Municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place amid the scenic vineyards around Bojničky and Hlohovec, with categories for men, women, and Nordic walking. The start and finish are by the cultural center in Bojničky, creating a welcoming community atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public, including students and running enthusiasts of various ages.
course_highlights: The route runs through the vineyards around Bojničky and Hlohovec
Start and finish by the cultural center in Bojničky, near the church
Categories for men, women, and Nordic walking over 6 km
additional: The entry fee can be paid online or on site on race day. The organizers are Atletický klub Bojničky, the Municipality of Bojničky, Ing. Ivan Pavelka, and Ján Šiška. The organizer can also be contacted by phone at 0905 236 204.

name: Ružínska desiatka
location: Jaklovce, Gelnica District, Košice Region, Slovakia
description: Ružínska desiatka is a running race in the village of Jaklovce, offering 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races. The course is mostly asphalt with a small gravel section, making for a fast and enjoyable run. The race is organized by Športový klub Jaklovce in cooperation with the municipality of Jaklovce and is suitable for the general public, including various age groups. The main race starts at 11:00, and the children’s races start at 10:00.
course_highlights: The course is 90% asphalt and 10% gravel (macadam)
The race takes place in the village of Jaklovce, Gelnica District
Categories include 10 km, 5 km, and children’s races
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00. The organizers are Športový klub Jaklovce o.z. and the municipality of Jaklovce. Contacts: Peter Budinský (0905 527 234), Peter Mitrík (0905 377 836).

name: Beh Rematskou dolinou
location: Handlová, Prievidza District, Trenčín Region, Slovakia

location: Brezová pod Bradlom, Myjava District, Trenčín Region, Slovakia

name: Sparťanský Areál Challenge 3
location: Bratislava, Bratislava District, Bratislava Region, Slovakia
