location: Atletický štadión v Martine, Martin, Slovakia

name: Sporto šventė Juodšilių ruduo
description: The “Juodšilių ruduo” sports festival is a sports event in the Vilnius District held in Juodšiliai. The event encourages community members to take part in sports and promotes athletics and running. Athletes of all ages can participate, and the event is open to everyone. Participants compete in the 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km distances, in a friendly and safe environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Juodšiliai area in the Vilnius District
Races are held over 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km distances
Participants must follow the course and the rules; walking animals on the course is prohibited
additional: Bib distribution and registration take place from 10:00 to 11:30. Participants must wear their bib on the front of their shirt. Transferring a bib to another participant, receiving personal assistance, and walking animals on the course are prohibited. Guardians or coaches are responsible for underage participants. Participants agree that video footage recorded during the event may be used for marketing purposes.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: PKO Sopot Półmaraton to coroczne wydarzenie biegowe odbywające się w nadmorskim Sopocie, które przyciąga biegaczy z całej Polski i zagranicy. Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi przez malownicze ulice miasta, oferując wyjątkowe widoki i atmosferę biegu w rytmie miasta. Meta znajduje się w ERGO Arenie, co dodaje imprezie wyjątkowego charakteru i sportowego ducha. Wydarzenie to jest również okazją do rodzinnego świętowania sportu, z licznymi biegami towarzyszącymi dla różnych grup wiekowych i poziomów zaawansowania.
course_highlights: Nadmorska trasa prowadząca przez ulice Sopotu
Meta w ERGO Arenie - wyjątkowe miejsce finiszu
Atmosfera biegu w rytmie miasta, przyciągająca biegaczy i kibiców
additional: Wydarzenie obejmuje również biegi towarzyszące, takie jak Sztafeta Półmaratońska, Bieg na 5 km oraz biegi dla dzieci i juniorów. Pakiet startowy zawiera medal oraz inne gadżety. Meta w ERGO Arenie zapewnia wyjątkową atmosferę i komfort dla uczestników. Organizator oferuje także plan treningowy "Run, Be Ready" dla przygotowujących się do biegu.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja jesienna 2026
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Polska

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema to wyjątkowy nocny bieg uliczny w Koszalinie, który oferuje trzy dystanse: 7 km, półmaraton oraz maraton. Trasa biegu prowadzi ulicami miasta, start i meta znajdują się na stadionie ZOS "Bałtyk". Bieg charakteryzuje się oficjalnym atestem PZLA, co gwarantuje dokładność pomiaru trasy i możliwość ustanawiania rekordów. Atmosfera wydarzenia jest niepowtarzalna, z laserowym startem o godzinie 2:00 w nocy, co podkreśla jego unikalny, nocny charakter. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na doskonałą organizację, atrakcyjne nagrody oraz pamiątki.
course_highlights: Trasa z atestem PZLA, potwierdzająca dokładność pomiaru
Pętla o długości około 7 km pokonywana wielokrotnie w zależności od dystansu
Start i meta na stadionie ZOS "Bałtyk" w Koszalinie
additional: Start biegu o 2:00 w nocy z laserowym startem. Biuro zawodów dla dzieci i młodzieży znajduje się w Hali Sportowej Politechniki Koszalińskiej. Trasa biegu prowadzi ulicami Koszalina z widokiem na eksponaty muzeum lotnictwa. Po każdym dystansie dzieci wręczane są upominki i nagrody bezpośrednio na stadionie. Trasa biegu jest pofałdowana, a odpoczynek następuje na stadionie, przez który prowadzi pętla.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic
description: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński to kameralna impreza biegowa organizowana w malowniczej wsi Chwałowice, położonej wśród lasów i pól. Trasa maratonu prowadzi przez leśne i wiejskie tereny, oferując biegaczom ciszę i kontakt z naturą, z charakterystycznym punktem na pętli przy Kamieniu Napoleońskim. Bieg ma koleżeński charakter, bez presji rywalizacji i tłumów, co sprzyja przyjaznej atmosferze i wspólnemu kręceniu kilometrów. Organizatorzy, w tym lokalny biegacz Arek Tołłoczko, dbają o oznakowanie trasy i komfort uczestników. W 2024 roku planowany jest cykl czterech maratonów na tej trasie, odbywających się w różnych porach roku.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 42,195 km prowadząca przez lasy i malownicze pola
Pętla z charakterystycznym Kamieniem Napoleońskim jako punktem orientacyjnym
Oznakowanie każdego kilometra i start/meta na ulicy Polnej
additional: Trasa biegowa o długości 7 km wytyczona i oznakowana przez Klub Biegacza ''Harcownik'' z Jelcza-Laskowic, dogodne miejsca do parkowania, brak tłumów i luźna atmosfera bez presji rywalizacji, planowany cykl 4 maratonów w roku 2024 odbywających się zimą, wiosną, latem i jesienią. Wcześniejsze edycje obejmowały cykl czterech maratonów odpowiadających porom roku.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
description: Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Dolnej Doliny Wisły to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się na terenie Powiatu Tczewskiego. W ramach wydarzenia organizowane są dwa biegi: maraton z atestem PZLA o długości 42,195 km oraz półmaraton o długości 21,097 km. Trasy prowadzą przez malownicze tereny Doliny Wisły, zróżnicowane pod względem nawierzchni - asfaltowej i szutrowej, a bieg odbywa się przy ograniczonym ruchu kołowym. Start i meta zlokalizowane są w Tczewie, a wydarzenie przyciąga biegaczy z różnych regionów, oferując profesjonalną organizację i oznakowanie tras.
course_highlights: Maraton z atestem PZLA o długości 42,195 km przez Tczew i okoliczne miejscowości
Półmaraton o długości 21,097 km z trasą asfaltowo-szutrową
Trasa oznaczona znakami poziomymi i tablicami co 1 km, bieg przy ograniczonym ruchu kołowym
additional: Limit uczestników wynosi 400 opłaconych zawodników. Start maratonu o 09:00 w Zespole Szkół Budowlanych i Odzieżowych w Tczewie, start półmaratonu o 11:00 w Szkole Podstawowej w Małych Walichnowach. Linia startu zamykana jest po 15 minutach od startu. Trasa maratonu posiada atest PZLA, półmaraton nie posiada atestu. Trasa oznaczona jest znakami poziomymi i tablicami co 1 km.

name: XLIV Perła Paprocan
description: Perła Paprocan to bieg maratoński odbywający się wokół Jeziora Paprocany w Tychach na pętli o długości 7 km. Zawodnicy mogą wybrać dowolny dystans, przebiegając wielokrotności tej pętli aż do pełnego maratonu. Bieg ma charakter treningowy i rekreacyjny, bez konieczności wcześniejszej deklaracji dystansu, a na mecie każdy uczestnik otrzymuje medal pamiątkowy. Organizatorzy podkreślają, że ważniejsza od rywalizacji jest atmosfera i wspólnota biegaczy. Tychy są jedynym miastem w Polsce, gdzie maraton odbywa się dwa razy w roku, a Perła Paprocan jest jedną z tych edycji.
course_highlights: Pętla o długości 7 km wokół Jeziora Paprocany
Nawierzchnia z kostki brukowej (ponad 50%) oraz utwardzone dróżki i ścieżki leśne
Punkt z napojami, owocami i słodyczami po każdej pętli
additional: Możliwy odbiór numeru przez osobę trzecią na podstawie upoważnienia. Zawodnicy niepełnoletni muszą mieć zgodę rodziców/opiekunów. Rzeczy wartościowe można zostawić w depozycie oznakowanym numerem startowym.

name: 63 Bieg Republiki Ostrowskiej
location: Ostrów Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Polska

name: Botaniczna Piątka – edycja jesienna, Stradomia Dolna
location: Stradomia Dolna, Syców Municipality, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Polska

name: II Jesienny Bieg Charytatywny Artbud Group – Biegniemy dla Rodzin Zastępczych
XIV Pętla Krosowa Grodziskiego Klubu Biegacza
XV Grand Prix Krakowa w biegach górskich – Wielkie Otwarcie
Glauchauer Herbstlauf
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinschaft Glauchau e.V. und Kreissportbund Zwickau
description: The Glauchau Autumn Run is a long-standing running event in Glauchau, held annually in autumn since 1986. The event offers courses for runners of all ages and ability levels, including a half marathon, 10 km, 3.2 km and 1.1 km races, as well as walking and Nordic walking. The routes pass through the scenic surrounding area on asphalt and paved paths, including by the reservoir and castle pond. The event is a sporting highlight for the region and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running to experience autumn actively.
course_highlights: 21.1 km flat scenic run with 75% asphalt and 25% paved paths
10 km route with 25% asphalt and 75% paved paths around the reservoir and castle pond
3.2 km and 1.1 km loops around the grounds of the Sachsenlandhalle Glauchau
additional: Half-marathon time limit: 2:45 h. Checkpoint at km 14.3 (reservoir pavilion) must be passed by 12 noon; otherwise, disqualification with a shortened finish route. Race bib includes a baggage tag and raffle ticket. Recommended parking: Kaufland, Grenayer Straße.

name: Olympiaberg-Cross München mit Deutschem Cross Cup
organizer: Förderverein Leichtathletik & Events München e. V.
price_range: Männer/Frauen 18 Euro, Jugend 8 Euro, Kinder 8 Euro, Barfußlauf 8 Euro
description: The Olympiaberg Cross Munich is a challenging cross-country race in Munich’s historic Olympic Park. The course follows a loop of approximately 1,100 metres, with several notable climbs and obstacles such as straw-bale sections. The race is part of the German Cross Cup and offers age-group and team classifications. Elite runners can win cash prizes, and all participants receive a certificate through an online service.
course_highlights: A loop course of approximately 1,100 metres with several marked uphill sections
Four numbered straw-bale sections as technical obstacles
Start and finish in the central area of Olympiaberg in Munich’s Olympic Park
additional: Online registration is possible until 60 minutes before the respective start. Participants may compete only if they provide their DLV start-pass number and DLV regional association. All participants can use an online service to print their certificates. Separate age-group and team classifications are available (U12 to U18). Barefoot runners receive a special gift. The course features climbs and obstacles (straw bales) and is a challenging, hilly route. Online registration. Start and finish in Munich’s Olympic Park.

name: Volkswaldlauf des MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt
description: The Volkswaldlauf of MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt takes place in Winsen-Borstel. The event offers distances ranging from short children’s races to a challenging 20.3 km course, making it ideal for families as well as runners looking for a longer distance. The start and finish are at the Am Habichtshorst sports facility on Heidlandsweg, which serves as the central meeting point. The race is part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup and promises a varied route through natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.5 km to 20.3 km
Start and finish at the Am Habichtshorst sports facility
Event held as part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup
additional: The event is aimed at families and runners of all ages. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The Am Habichtshorst sports facility is the central meeting point for runners. Distances: 0.5 km to 20.3 km, including children’s races; central meeting point at the Am Habichtshorst sports facility; October weather: approx. 14 °C, 6 °C low, 40 mm precipitation, cloudy.

name: Mönchsdegginger Lauf zum Plossen - 1. Lauf Jedermannlaufserie
Winterlauf-/Wanderserie TuS Jaderberg 1.Teil
description: The TuS Jaderberg winter running and walking series is a longstanding event held in the Jaderberg region. It gives runners and walkers the opportunity to stay active and exercise together during the colder months. The series comprises several events suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. The event is firmly rooted in the work of TuS Jaderberg and promotes community and grassroots sport.
course_highlights: Running and walking routes in the natural surroundings of Jaderberg
Suitable for all ages and ability levels
Part of a multi-event winter running series
additional: The winter running series is currently looking for successors to take over its organisation. The available pages provide no explicit information about start times, prices or registration options.

name: 35. Ricklinger Volkslauf / Ricklinger Volkslauf
location: Meisenwinkel 9, Hannover-Ricklingen, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Ricklingen Volkslauf is a local race day in Hannover-Ricklingen, organized by TuS Ricklingen. It offers flat runs for adults over approximately 5.5 to 5.7 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking over the same distance. The main event is the 10 km Lothar-Mayer-Lauf. There is also a 400 m Bambini run for the youngest participants and a 1 km schoolchildren’s run, allowing families and club runners to take part together while being grouped by age category.
course_highlights: Flat courses in Hannover-Ricklingen
Runs for adults and children, plus walking and Nordic walking
Finish at Meisenwinkel 9 in Hannover-Ricklingen
additional: Running and walking events are organized by distance and age category. All events finish at the same location. The event takes place in Hannover-Ricklingen, with the start and finish at Meisenwinkel 9. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various running options, including walking and children’s races.

name: 44. Zerbster Rolandlauf
description: The 44th Zerbster Roland Run is a traditional fun run in Zerbst, Saxony-Anhalt, with the start and finish at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium. The event takes place on a Sunday in October and is organized by the athletics department of TSV Rot-Weiß Zerbst. Various distances are offered for all age groups, from short children’s races to 10 kilometers for adults. The course consists of a flat 5-kilometer loop on roads and mixed terrain, which also passes through the stadium. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop on roads and mixed terrain
The course passes through the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Separate categories for children, youth, adults, and seniors. Typical October weather: around 14 °C, mostly cloudy, with about 40 mm of precipitation. The race also supports Anhalt Hospice Zerbst and is organized as a community fun run, with medals and certificates.

name: Gütersloher DJK Halbmarathon
description: The Gütersloh DJK Half Marathon is an established running event in Gütersloh, offering 5 km and 10 km road races in addition to the half marathon. The courses are officially measured according to IAAF/AIMS standards and are therefore eligible for rankings. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for the fastest participants in various age groups. The awards ceremony takes place shortly after the races in the tent, and certificates can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: Officially measured half-marathon course according to IAAF/AIMS standards
5 km and 10 km road races as additional events
A notably family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for the fastest runners
additional: Parking is available at Hauptschule Nord, Ahornallee. The awards ceremonies take place as soon as possible after the races in the tent. Certificates can be downloaded from the timekeeper’s website, www.timeteam-jung.de. The organizer accepts no liability for accidents, theft, or other damage.

name: FSV-Lauf
description: The FSV Run takes place in the Brucker Lache in Erlangen and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. The course is a relatively flat 5 km loop, which is completed twice for the 10 km race. In addition to the main races, there are free children’s and schoolchildren’s races, as well as a relay. The event promotes local sports and supports the Erlangen Food Bank’s support association with every entry fee.
course_highlights: Relatively flat 5 km loop in the Brucker Lache
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
Start and finish near the Brucker Lache elementary school
additional: Race number pickup and the race office open from 9 a.m. at the Brucker Lache elementary school. Personalized certificates can be printed, and children receive a finisher’s medal. Free fruit, tea, and non-alcoholic wheat beer are available in the finish area. Face painting and activities for children are offered on site. Environmental protection is promoted through bottle labeling and by not providing cups. Arriving by bicycle or public transport is recommended.

name: Lauf um den Eisbrunn - 1. Lauf der Jedermannserie
location: Sportgelände des SV Mauren, Harburg, Donau-Ries, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Lauf um den Eisbrunn kicks off the LG Donau-Ries everyone’s running series in late autumn. The road race takes place in Harburg, with the start and finish at the SV Mauren sports grounds. Events include a main race of approximately 10 km, a 3 km short race, and a 7 km walking route. The event welcomes all running enthusiasts, from children to club runners, and offers a friendly atmosphere for individual entrants and series runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the SV Mauren sports grounds in Harburg
Main race of approx. 10 km, plus a 3 km short race and a 7 km walking route
Local late-autumn road race with typical October weather around 14 °C
additional: Race numbers with transponders are distributed on site before the start. The main race starts in the morning, followed by the shorter events. The series concludes with a final in Nördlingen on the third Sunday of Advent. A local race for all age groups, including children, teenagers, adults, and walkers. The series finale in Nördlingen offers community runners a good opportunity to prepare for winter.

name: Porzellinerlauf
location: Sportplatz Am Dohlenstein, Kahla, Thüringen, Germany
description: The Porzellinerlauf Kahla is a traditional autumn road race starting and finishing at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground in Kahla, Thuringia. The 13 km race is the main event, alongside shorter children’s and youth races, making the day appealing to both families and regular runners. Organised by SV 1910 Kahla e.V. since 1971, the race combines a sporting challenge with the local porcelain tradition. Regional timekeepers oversee the course, which receives particularly positive feedback for its route.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground
13 km main race, with shorter children’s and youth races
Route through Kahla with a connection to its porcelain tradition
additional: The field is modest, with around 101 to 300 runners and more than one hundred finishers in recent editions. Typical November weather in Kahla is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. Timing is provided by regional timekeepers. The race has been established since 1971 and regularly attracts between 101 and 300 participants. The course is known for its good condition and attractive surroundings. The event also includes refreshments, showers and an awards ceremony.

name: VR Bank Westküsten Herbstlauf Schafstedt
description: The VR Bank Westküsten Autumn Run Schafstedt is an autumn running event in Schafstedt, Schleswig-Holstein, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. Distances include 3 km, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event welcomes adults and younger participants and fosters a family-friendly atmosphere with children’s and youth races. The routes pass through the autumn landscape in the fresh air and offer an alternative to city runs.
course_highlights: The 3 km route is flat
The 5 km run and 5 km walk include some hills
All races finish at the same finish line
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Typical October weather in Schafstedt is around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event also includes walking options and is aimed at families and young people. October weather is generally mild, with temperatures around 6–14 °C, creating ideal conditions for an autumn run.

name: Thüngersheimer Bocksbeutellauf 2026
description: The Thüngersheimer Bocksbeutellauf is a traditional race held annually in Thüngersheim. The event offers runners of all ages a friendly and welcoming atmosphere, with a generous runners’ buffet, a large cake and coffee bar, and a medal and bottle of wine for every finisher. Children receive a small gift. The race is a celebration of the local running community, combining sporting ambition with socializing.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque wine region around Thüngersheim
Generous runners’ buffet and large cake and coffee bar
A bottle of wine for every finisher, or a gift for children
additional: Every finisher receives a medal and a bottle of wine; children receive a small gift. There is a generous runners’ buffet and a large cake and coffee bar. Distances: 600 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km; local race, family- and club-friendly

name: Freisinger Strassenlauf pwd. by Munich Airport
Kobeřický půlmaraton
location: TJ Sokol Kobeřice, Kobeřice, Czech Republic
description: The Kobeřice Half Marathon is a road race organized by TJ Sokol Kobeřice, offering runners the chance to test themselves over the half-marathon distance. The race is part of the official Český běh calendar, which provides comprehensive services for runners and organizers in the Czech Republic. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers quality facilities and a certified course. The start time and further details will be confirmed closer to the race date.
course_highlights: Certified road course
Organized by TJ Sokol Kobeřice
Half marathon with quality facilities
additional: In 2024, the first category was scheduled to start at 9:00 by the TJ Sokol sports field; the time and location for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Park Ladronka, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh metropole is a series of public running races held in various Prague districts, with the aim of promoting a healthy lifestyle and residents’ sense of belonging to their district. The race in Prague 6 takes place in Ladronka Park and offers a chance to test your strength in a friendly atmosphere. Each participant represents their district and contributes to the competition for Prague’s most athletic district. Original medals are prepared for participants as keepsakes from each edition.
course_highlights: Race in Ladronka Park in Prague 6
A series of races across Prague’s districts
Promoting a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
additional: Each participant represents their district based on their permanent residence and contributes to the districts’ score. Special medals are prepared for individual categories as unique keepsakes from the race. The official website lists the previous edition in Ladronka Park.

name: Račiansky kros – jeseň
location: Knižková dolina Amphitheater, Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros – autumn is a traditional running race held in Bratislava, in the Knižková dolina area of Bratislava-Rača. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the autumn atmosphere in the pleasant surroundings of the amphitheatre and nearby area. The organisers, OZ PERUN, ensure thorough preparation and refreshments for participants. The event is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages.
course_highlights: Race in the natural surroundings of Knižková dolina
Start and finish at the Bratislava-Rača amphitheatre
Autumn atmosphere and quality refreshments
additional: The registration form and consent of the data subject are available on the website. The organiser is OZ PERUN. IBAN for payments: SK09 8330 0000 0025 0082 7935. The course is 80% forest paths and 20% asphalt. The races are open to men, women and children. Registration is available online and on-site, with a limited number of starting places. The event also includes children’s races and post-race refreshments.

name: T1 Ring kros
location: T1 Ring, Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou District, Slovakia
description: T1 Ring Cross is a running race held at the T1 Ring venue in Vechec, offering 9 km and 4 km courses. The race is divided into age and gender categories and also includes a non-competitive 4 km Nordic Walking event. The children’s start is at 11:00 and the main category starts at 13:00. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025 and offers an enjoyable challenge, with approximately 210 metres of elevation gain on the main course.
course_highlights: 9 km course with approximately 210 m of elevation gain
4 km course for recreational runners and Nordic Walking
Race at the T1 Ring venue in Vechec
additional: Children’s start at 11:00; main category at 13:00. Competitive categories by age and gender. Part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025.

name: Košickopolianska desiatka
description: The Košickopolianska Ten is a running race organized in the municipality of Košická Polianka, offering categories for men, women, and children in different age groups. The start is in front of the cultural centre, and the main race begins at 13:00. The event is suitable for the general public and supports community sports in the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish in front of the cultural centre in Košická Polianka
Categories for all age groups, from children to seniors
The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Košická Polianka
additional: The children’s races start at 11:00. The organizer is the Municipality of Košická Polianka. Categories are divided by age and gender, including categories for the youngest children from age 0.

name: Atenčan
location: Kozárovce Reservoir, Kozárovce, Levice District, Slovakia

name: Cezpoľný beh na Brezine - Preteky jednotlivcov
Kojša RUN – lesný beh „Bežkovanie bez lyží“
location: Areál bežeckého lyžovania LK Metropol, Kojšovská hoľa, Slovakia

name: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“
description: The “Around Lithuania” run is a traditional running event held in Rumšiškės, near the Lithuanian Open-Air Museum. The event offers various distances, from a children’s run to a half marathon, in which participants run several laps according to set rules. The race takes place in October, and participants are awarded in age groups and in the overall standings. It is a great opportunity for runners of all ages to spend time actively and test their abilities.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 300 m children’s run to a 21.098 km half marathon
The half-marathon distance is run over 4 laps around the Lithuanian Open-Air Museum
The race takes place in Rumšiškės, Kaišiadorys District, with the start and finish on the museum grounds
additional: The race-day programme begins with registration from 09:00, and starts for the different distances take place from 11:00 to 13:00. The half-marathon starts according to handicap rules, which are announced at the event venue and on the website. The awards ceremony takes place from 14:00, including the Lithuanian Running Cup age-group awards.

name: Smaltovaný bažant
description: The Enamelled Pheasant is the final race in the Ruler of Mrdice series, held in the picturesque pheasantry in Heřmanův Městec. This traditional 1,500-metre race offers an opportunity to test your strength in a friendly atmosphere. The Heřmanův Městec Running Club organizes a range of sporting activities and group training sessions throughout the year, complementing the racing season. The Enamelled Pheasant is an ideal event for runners who want to end the season with joy and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A 1,500-metre race in the pheasantry
Part of the Ruler of Mrdice series
A traditional race in Heřmanův Městec
additional: The race is part of the Ruler of Mrdice series, which includes classic races as well as open, timed group training sessions. The running club holds regular group runs every Tuesday in a friendly atmosphere. A course map and results from previous editions are available. The race is the final round of the Mrdice League. In 2026, the first category was scheduled to start at 18:00; the 2027 race date had not been confirmed in the available materials.

name: Podzimní půlmaraton VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Cycling path near Kempinku, Braník, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The VAŠÍ LIGY Autumn Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1 km road race held in Prague 4-Braník on the cycle path by Kempink. The route follows a beautiful, flat and fast path along the Vltava from Braník to Vrané and back, often enabling runners to achieve personal bests. The race offers a relaxed running atmosphere and is suitable for anyone looking to experience a high-quality half marathon in pleasant surroundings. The first category starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A beautiful route along the Vltava on a cycle path
A flat and fast course
Route from Braník to Vrané and back
additional: The race takes place on a flat cycle path that is suitable for fast times and personal bests. It is organized by VAŠE LIGA; Petra Lundák can be contacted. A relaxed atmosphere is guaranteed.

name: Náměšťský tvarůžek
location: Náměšť na Hané, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Náměšťský tvarůžek is a four-year running race in Náměšť na Hané, which is part of the Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. The main race is 9.22 km long and consists of three 2.9 km loops, plus an approach and a run-out. The course runs on asphalt and farm tracks, offering a combination of firm surfaces and natural surroundings. The race is open to different age categories, as well as a recreational run with no age limit, with an emphasis on fair play and participant safety.
course_highlights: Main race: 9.22 km, consisting of three 2.9 km loops
Surface: asphalt and farm tracks
Approach and run-out outside the loop: 518 m in total
additional: Race-day check-in takes place at the venue. Runners must have a chip card with a balance of at least CZK 150, which will be deducted at check-in. The results ceremony will take place at the KVS grounds; results will be published on hanackybeh.cz and liga100.cz. Categories are divided by age and gender, including a recreational run with no age limit. The race offers cash prizes for the top runners, registration is available with a chip card, and the course passes through the scenic surroundings of Náměšť na Hané.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nepomuk
location: Sokolovna Nepomuk, Nepomuk, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nepomuk is a fun run with no competition, held on October 28. Routes are available for adults and children and run mainly along paved paths and roads through the town of Nepomuk. The event base is at the local Sokol sports grounds, where participants can collect their race packs and receive a beautiful medal in the shape of the country after finishing. Sports activity stations are set up for children, and refreshments are available at the finish. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the sokol hall car park.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along paved paths and roads through the town of Nepomuk
The route passes the Church of St. John of Nepomuk and crosses the Mihovka stream
The finish is at the sokol hall, after a gentle uphill section
additional: Finish times are not measured, and no results list with rankings is produced. The race pack contains a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Sports activity stations for children are set up at the venue. The event base has facilities for leaving belongings and getting refreshments.

name: Provodovský běh
location: Provodov, Zlín District, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Provodov Run is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Provodov near Zlín. It offers three distances of 5, 11 and 21 kilometres, running mainly along field and forest paths. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in shorter age-based races free of charge. It is organised by UnArt Provodov, p.s., and takes place regardless of the weather, with an emphasis on safety and fair play. The start and registration are at Areál mládí and the FC Rak Provodov football pitch.
course_highlights: Trail race mainly along field and forest paths
Three distances: 5 km, 11 km and 21 km, with varying levels of difficulty
Free children’s races, with distances from 30 to 750 metres depending on age
additional: Race registration opens at 9:00 at Areál mládí. The race number must be clearly displayed on the chest. First aid is provided by members of the Czech Red Cross (ČČK). The race takes place regardless of the weather; only extreme conditions may cause it to be postponed or cancelled. The organiser reserves the right to change the programme and rules without prior notice.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Březník
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Březník is a fun, non-competitive run held on October 28. The routes follow the Oslava and Chvojnice valleys, mostly along paved and forest roads with gentle descents and climbs. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children, so early online registration is required. A beautiful medal in the shape of the republic and a gift-filled race pack await everyone at the finish. The run takes place on the border of the Divoká Oslava National Nature Reserve, in a private venue with open restrooms.
course_highlights: The route follows the Oslava and Chvojnice valleys along paved and forest roads
A challenging course with difficult terrain and a steep descent on the 6.2 km route
The run takes place on the border of the Divoká Oslava National Nature Reserve
additional: Finish times are not recorded, and no results list or rankings are produced. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children. The race pack contains a race bib and gifts. Open restrooms are available. The route includes paved and unpaved forest roads, including a challenging section with a steep descent on the 6.2 km route.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Děčín
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Děčín is a traditional race held on 28 October to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The main race route is 5 km long and winds through the picturesque town, past the castle gardens and Mariánská louka, across the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and along the flat Elbe embankment, finishing by crossing Tyršův Bridge back to Smetanovo nábřeží. Children can choose between two distances: 5 km for older children and 1 km for the youngest, both following a similar route to the adults’ race. The event offers professional timing, a race pack, and a medal shaped like the country for all participants.
course_highlights: 5 km loop through the castle gardens and Mariánská louka
Cross the new bridge with views of the Elbe
Flat stretch along the Elbe embankment and crossing Tyršův Bridge
additional: The race is professionally timed. Every participant receives a medal shaped like the country at the finish. The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Online registration closed on 25 October.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Dolní Újezd
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Dolní Újezd is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race offers a main 8.9 km route through the countryside with gentle elevation changes, combining paved roads and compacted dirt tracks. Children can choose flat 1.4 km routes according to their age category. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Refreshments, changing rooms and parking are available for runners’ comfort.
course_highlights: Main race route: 8.9 km with 112 m of elevation gain
A combination of paved roads and compacted dirt tracks
Children’s 1.4 km routes on a flat paved road
additional: Start and finish at the Sokol Hall in Dolní Újezd. Race packs and medals for registered participants. Times are not recorded by a timing system, but results and a winners’ award ceremony are provided. On-site registration beyond the race capacity does not guarantee a medal or race pack.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Kutná Hora
location: Oleška, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, organized on October 28 by the Czech Sokol Association. In Kutná Hora, the run will take place for the first time, offering a sporting atmosphere and a chance to meet people with a connection to Sokol. The main race route is just under six kilometers long, with the start and finish at the Sokol gym, which provides facilities including changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments. The event is suitable for families and individuals, with an emphasis on safety and professional organization.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Sokol gym, with full facilities
Main race of just under 6 km in the beautiful surroundings of Kutná Hora
Children’s courses are safely routed within the grounds, with no need to cross roads
additional: The race capacity is set at approximately 155 runners to ensure quality organization and timekeeping. A team of volunteers is ready to help with course navigation and event organization. Facilities at the Sokol gym include changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments. The children’s courses are safely routed within the grounds so children do not have to cross roads.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Louňovice pod Blaníkem
location: Louňovice pod Blaníkem, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Louňovice pod Blaníkem is a traditional race held in honor of the founding of Czechoslovakia and takes place on October 28. The 5.6 km main race starts from the town square and passes through the natural and historical beauty of Malý Blaník, including its highest point, where the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene stands. The course combines paved sections with field and forest paths. At the finish, participants receive a beautiful medal in the shape of the republic, and main-race entrants can take part in a raffle. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series and is professionally timed.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural and historical beauty of Malý Blaník
Run past the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene at the highest point of Malý Blaník
A mix of paved, field, and forest paths
additional: The start and finish are on the town square in Louňovice pod Blaníkem, in front of the castle. A raffle for main-race participants takes place after the winners’ awards ceremony. Every participant receives a medal in the shape of the republic at the finish. All races are professionally timed.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Lužice
location: Lužice, Hodonín District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Lužice is a traditional race celebrating the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 27 October 2027. Runners follow paved paths and roads through a beautiful new park created after a tornado, past orchards and vineyards. Shorter routes for children are set up in the Sokol Hall grounds, which also provide changing rooms, showers and refreshments. At the finish, everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the country and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: The route passes through a new park created after a tornado
The route goes past orchards and vineyards around Strání
Paved paths and roads in Lužice
additional: The race is held without chip timing, but finish times are recorded and winners are announced. Changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments are available in the Sokol Hall grounds. Sports equipment and games are provided for children. Parking is available by the Sokol Hall and the Sports Hall.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Mníšek pod Brdy
location: Státní zámek Mníšek pod Brdy, Mníšek pod Brdy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Mníšek pod Brdy is a traditional race held in honor of the founding of Czechoslovakia. It takes place on October 28. The race starts by the state chateau and runs through the picturesque surroundings, including Sokol Hall on Vrška, ponds, and the U Káji Maříka Inn. There are various race distances for adults and children, with predominantly asphalt surfaces and easy courses. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful medal in the shape of the republic, and a race pack with a race number and gifts is provided. The start area has tents for registration and changing, toilets, refreshments, and benches.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the state chateau in Mníšek pod Brdy
The route passes Sokol Hall on Vrška and ponds
The course is asphalt; children's loops are on a grassy area
additional: The event is held in RACE format without timing, but finish times are recorded and winners are announced. Parking, a bag drop, and a rest area are available at the start.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nový Bydžov
location: Nový Bydžov, Hradec Králové District, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nový Bydžov is a traditional race held on October 28 in honour of the founding of Czechoslovakia. The event offers routes for adults and children. The main adult race is 4.8 km long and runs partly through the town and partly along dirt roads, crossing two bridges over the Cidlina River. Shorter children’s races take place on the athletics track at the Sportring complex. At the finish, all participants receive a commemorative medal in the shape of the republic and a goody bag. The race takes place in live traffic, with organisers and volunteers stationed at intersections, and is suitable for runners of all categories.
course_highlights: 4.8 km route with 30% asphalt and 70% dirt roads
Cross the Cidlina River via two different bridges
The most challenging section is the uphill climb in the village of Humburky
additional: The race takes place in live traffic, with organisers at intersections and volunteers along the route. The lead runner is guided by a cyclist. Children’s races take place on the athletics track; times are not recorded, and placings are indicative. A goody bag and medal are included in the race. In bad weather, goody bags are handed out in the lobby of the Sokol hall; otherwise, distribution takes place outdoors by the clay court.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Uherský Brod
location: Uherský Brod, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Uherský Brod is a traditional race held in honour of the founding of Czechoslovakia, taking place on 28 October. The race offers several routes for different age categories, including 5 km and 8 km races for adults and shorter distances for children. The routes pass through the town centre, residential areas, around a pond and past allotment gardens, with professional timekeeping and prizes for the fastest runners. Every participant receives a race pack and an original medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Participants under 18 may register only with the consent of a legal guardian. On-site registration is also available.
course_highlights: The 5 km route passes through the town centre and residential areas, and around a pond
The 8 km route continues further into the countryside, past a spring and the observatory
Start and finish at the Sokol stadium, with professional timekeeping
additional: Race times are measured using professional timing equipment. At the event facilities, every participant can collect a race pack containing a race number and gifts. A beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits everyone at the finish.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28 by the Czech Sokol Association. It draws inspiration from the historic 1919 relay race, “Rozestavný běh,” and has become a modern tradition that grows every year, connecting dozens of locations in Czechia and abroad. The race offers runners of all ages, including children, an opportunity to celebrate the founding of the republic through movement. The routes vary and often pass through both urban and natural areas, allowing participants to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of each location.
course_highlights: The route in Děčín passes through the castle gardens, Mariánská louka, the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and the flat Elbe riverbank
Children’s races have shorter routes, some of which follow the same route as the adult race
The routes are mostly flat, with varied sections and iconic landmarks in each city
additional: Registration is available online only and is valid once the entry fee has been paid. Children aged 15 to 18 may take part only in the main race. A race T-shirt can be purchased during registration and must be ordered by October 15. On-site registration is available only while capacity remains and does not include a race pack or a medal for late entrants. Races are divided into the BĚH, ZÁVOD, and VELKÝ ZÁVOD levels, each with different rules. In Děčín, times are recorded using professional timing, and participants receive a republic-shaped medal at the finish.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Milovice
location: Milovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Milovice is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28. The race offers an easy 5.8 km trail suitable for beginner and experienced runners, with a partly paved and road surface. Children can enjoy simple oval courses around Haken Stadium, with distances varying by age. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful medal shaped like the republic and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: An easy 5.8 km trail with a partly paved and road surface
Children’s courses around Haken Stadium with an oval gravel surface
A course suitable for beginner and experienced runners; trail shoes are recommended
additional: The race pack includes a custom-designed bag featuring #SBR graphics, Halls Ice Team & Cola (adults only), and an original medal at the finish. On-site registration takes place at Haken Stadium, which also has changing facilities and restrooms. Parking is available near the stadium. For refreshments, you can visit the RKDM restaurant and Clock Cafe next to the stadium.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Písek
location: Palackého sady, Písek, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Písek is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 28 October. The race offers several routes for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults, and is part of the broader tradition of runs organised by the Czech Sokol Community. The route passes through the picturesque Palacký Gardens, across the Stone Bridge and along the river, with professional timing and awards for the fastest runners. Every participant receives a race pack and an original republic-shaped medal at the finish.
course_highlights: Start in Palacký Gardens by the music pavilion
Across the Stone Bridge and along the Otava River
The route crosses the footbridge to the right bank and returns to the Ševčík Pavilion
additional: The race pack includes a custom-designed bag featuring SBR graphics, a medal at the finish, and the option to order an official Alpine Pro T-shirt for an additional fee. The main race is limited to 180 runners. Registration and race-pack collection close at 11:45 for the children's routes and at 13:30 for the main race. If capacity is not reached, on-site registration is available.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Prostějov
location: Náměstí T. G. Masaryka, Prostějov, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Prostějov is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28. The race offers various distances for adults and children, all running through the city center on paved roads, on a 2.5 km loop. The start and finish are at T.G.M. Square, where participants can expect professional timing and a race pack, followed by a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. The atmosphere is enhanced by music, sports demonstrations, and refreshments for runners and spectators. The route is flat, wide enough, and safe, with no parked cars, making for a comfortable run through the historic center of Prostějov.
course_highlights: The route runs through the city center on paved roads
A 2.5 km loop, run 1, 2, or 4 times depending on the race distance
A flat, sufficiently wide course with no parked cars
additional: Start and finish at T.G.M. Square. At 14:00, the clock on the town hall building starts. Facilities include changing rooms for women and men, and storage for valuables and backpacks. Payment by Apple Pay or Google Wallet is available. A memorial ceremony is held at the statue of T. G. Masaryk, followed by the awards ceremony. Traffic is diverted from the route, and municipal police manage parking in the city center.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
location: Municipal Forest behind Piast Stadium, Gliwice, Polska
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa to cykl 12 zawodów biegowych i Nordic Walking odbywających się w Gliwicach, w lesie komunalnym za stadionem Piasta. Trasa o długości około 4,2 km prowadzi po duktach leśnych, szutrowych i częściowo asfaltowych, a zawody mają na celu popularyzację zdrowego i aktywnego spędzania czasu na świeżym powietrzu. Uczestnicy mogą wybrać od 1 do 5 okrążeń, co odpowiada dystansom od około 4,2 km do połowy maratonu. Impreza ma charakter amatorski i przyjazny, z klasyfikacją drużynową i indywidualną oraz możliwością udziału w e-Prowokacji online.
course_highlights: Trasa o długości 4219,5 m po duktach leśnych, szutrowych i asfalcie
Start i meta na polanie koło stadionu Piasta w Gliwicach
Możliwość wyboru od 1 do 5 okrążeń (od 4,2 km do połowy maratonu)
additional: Zawody odbywają się raz w miesiącu w soboty, limit czasowy na bieg i Nordic Walking to 3 godziny, e-Prowokacja bez limitu. Można startować w biegu lub Nordic Walking, zmiana konkurencji wymaga nowej rejestracji i numeru startowego. Po każdym okrążeniu dostępny jest punkt odświeżania z napojami. Po zawodach uczestnicy otrzymują napój i przekąskę (kiełbasa lub banan) oraz batonik w losowaniu nagród, jeśli pozwalają przepisy sanitarne. Numery startowe są ważne na cały rok i należy je oddać po zawodach. Organizatorzy prowadzą klasyfikację wytrwałych i drużynową. W edycji opisanej przez MZUK biuro zawodów działało od 9:00, a start zaplanowano na 10:00. Do udziału w klasyfikacji wymagane były wcześniejszy zapis i opłata startowa.

name: Botaniczna Piątka – Bydgoszcz, edycja jesienna
location: Botanical Garden of the Kazimierz Wielki University, Bydgoszcz, Polska

name: MnO Jaszczur – Bludny Balvan
location: Trzebina, Opole County, Opole Voivodeship, Polska
description: MnO Jaszczur - Bludny Balvan to bieg na dystansie 10 km odbywający się w Opolu. Zawody są doskonałą okazją do sprawdzenia swojej formy na asfaltowej trasie o średnim stopniu trudności. Organizatorzy oferują plany treningowe dopasowane do różnych poziomów zaawansowania, które pomagają optymalnie przygotować się do startu. Wydarzenie jest częścią kalendarza biegowego TreningBiegacza.pl, który promuje biegi uliczne i wspiera biegaczy w rozwoju.
course_highlights: Trasa asfaltowa o średnim stopniu trudności
Dystans 10 km w Opolu
Możliwość przygotowania się dzięki dedykowanym planom treningowym
additional: Organizatorzy oferują wsparcie ekspertów oraz szczegółowe instrukcje treningowe. Możliwość korzystania z platformy do zarządzania wizytówką biegu i współpracy marketingowej. Dostępne plany treningowe od 8 do 20 tygodni, dostosowane do poziomu VDOT biegacza.

name: Towarzyski Maraton Wokół Polski w Oleśni...
26. Dresden-Marathon / DRESDEN-MARATHON
description: The DRESDEN-MARATHON has been held regularly at the end of October since 1999 and offers a flat, fast course through the Saxon state capital, passing its famous sights. The route takes runners through the historic old town, including Brühl's Terrace, the Semper Opera House and other Baroque buildings, as well as the lively Neustadt district. More than 300 musicians and numerous bands create a special atmosphere along the course. The second half of the marathon runs through the Blasewitz district, with views of the castles on the Loschwitz Elbe slopes and the villas along Goetheallee, before heading back to the old town along the Elbe.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Dresden's historic old town and Neustadt district
Illuminated Waldschlösschen Tunnel and bridge, and the Großer Garten
Atmosphere created by more than 300 musicians and bands along the course
additional: There is a marathon expo, race packet pickup and a SPARKASSEN pacemaker service. After the race, medal engraving, a photo service, showers, changing rooms and toilets, as well as award ceremonies, are available. The evening before the race, an anniversary party will be held in the marquee behind Heinz-Steyer-Stadion (€25 admission; limited capacity).

name: Frankenwaldlauf um den Preis der Kulmbacher Brauerei
description: The Frankenwald Run for the Kulmbacher Brewery Prize is a relaxed running event in the beautiful Franconian Forest village of Ludwigschorgast, organised by runners for runners. Featuring a 1.5-kilometre singletrack trail as an exciting alternative to the paved section, the event welcomes both ambitious runners and recreational athletes, with a fun run and Nordic walking. Alongside sporting ambition, the focus is on having fun amid the Franconian Forest’s romantically rugged natural scenery. The overall male and female winners of the main race receive prize money, and the club with the most participants receives a financial award.
course_highlights: A 1.5 km singletrack trail replaces the paved section from Wirsberg to the Goldener Adler Hut
Run through the Franconian Forest’s romantically rugged natural scenery
A variety of events: main race, fun run (5 km) and Nordic walking (8.4 km)
additional: Late registration is available on the event day at the FC Ludwigschorgast sports hall from 12:30 to 13:30, for an additional fee of 5 euros. All participants receive a small gift from Kulmbacher when they hand in their race number at the finish. Tea, non-alcoholic drinks, biscuits, pretzel sticks and gummy bears are available at the finish. The race number must be worn clearly visible on the front of the body; otherwise, participants will be disqualified. There is a team competition in the main race, with non-cash prizes and a challenge trophy for the fastest men’s team. Courses in the Franconian Forest region; registration opens on 18 September; late registration at the start for a fee; refreshments at the finish; start at 9:00; awards ceremony at 11:30.

name: Halloween-Run-Rotenburg
location: Flugplatz Rotenburg (Wümme), Rotenburg (Wümme), Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Halloween Run Rotenburg takes place on October 30, 2027, at Rotenburg (Wümme) Airfield and offers a unique running experience in a spooky Halloween atmosphere of darkness, lights, and fog. The course is divided into 2.5 km laps and has been adapted for 2027 to make it easier to run in challenging light conditions. There are various events for all age groups, from the Kids Run to the 15 km Evilthon. After the run, a spectacular fireworks display will bring the evening to a fitting close.
course_highlights: Lapped course at Rotenburg Airfield, with 2.5 km per lap
Spooky Halloween decorations with lights and fog
Revised course for better running conditions in the dark
additional: The start and finish area is at Rotenburg Wümme Airfield, between the THW and the tower. Race-pack collection is available on event day from 15:00 in the Transall training room (behind Restaurant HeyLü). Participants can register for the costume contest; photos for voting will be taken at the start area from 17:00. A spectacular fireworks display is scheduled for 20:15 after the run. Participants are asked to bring headlamps or running lights because of the darkness and fog. Race packs can be mailed for a fee of €7.50; register for mailing by October 3, 2027. Planned events are a 1,000 m Kids Run and 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km races. The 5 km and 10 km events can also be walked. A costume contest and fireworks to close the evening are planned.

name: 34. Mündener Altstadtlauf
description: The 34th Münden Old Town Run takes place on October 31, 2027, and offers runners of all ages attractive courses through the historic old town of Hann. Münden. The event includes a 500 m Bambini race, a 1,000 m schoolchildren’s race, and 5 km and 10 km races for recreational and competitive runners. The 5 km race includes a group category, while the 10 km race has a team category requiring at least one woman per team. The course is measured by the Lower Saxony Athletics Association and is therefore eligible for record times. The organizing team places great emphasis on professional event management and runner safety.
course_highlights: The historic old town of Hann. Münden provides the setting for the race
Course eligible for record times, measured by the athletics association
A range of distances from 500 m to 10 km, with individual, group, and team categories
additional: The event is organized by a dedicated team with support from the fire department, police, city administration, and local businesses. There is a Bambini race for the youngest participants, as well as group and team categories. Around 40 volunteers secure the course and help ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: 6. Halloween Run
description: The Halloween Run Bremen 2027 takes place on October 31 and offers runners a spooky costumed running experience around Werdersee. With five different distances, from 1 km to the marathon, there is something for every ability level. The courses are measured according to German Athletics Federation rules and are eligible for record lists, underlining the competitive nature of the event. Alongside the race, there is a costume contest and an awards ceremony, followed by a spectacular fireworks display as the event’s highlight.
course_highlights: 8.333 km loop around Werdersee, measured by the German Athletics Federation and eligible for record lists
Distances from 1 km to the marathon (42.195 km), with spooky extras
Start and finish area between the Finnbahn and the barbecue lawn, near the DLRG lifeguard station
additional: Race packet pickup on October 31 from 11:00 to 14:30 at the sports hall at LidiceHaus. Costume contest with photo voting before the start, from 12:45. Relay races are possible; the race bib with RFID chip serves as the relay baton. Runners must bring their own race-bib belt. A spectacular fireworks display follows the race, starting at 18:00. Registration is open until October 31, 2027, at 12:30 or until the participant limit is reached.

name: Bredstedt-Cross

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgelder liegen je nach Kategorie zwischen 2,50 Euro und 3,50 Euro

description: The Bredstedt Cross is a traditional cross-country race taking place on October 30, 2027, in Bredstedt. Organized by Bredstedter TSV, the event offers competitions for numerous age groups, from children to seniors. The races take place on the grounds of Gemeinschaftsschule Bredstedt, in Harald-Nommensen-Halle, and in the outdoor area, and are part of the KLVNF Cross Cup. The courses consist of short and long loops, with a minimum distance of 5 km. All participants receive certificates, and an awards ceremony is held outdoors.
course_highlights: Competitions on the grounds of Gemeinschaftsschule Bredstedt and in the outdoor area
Part of the KLVNF Cross Cup, with short and long cross-country races
Courses are at least 5 km long and consist of short and long loops
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available in Harald-Nommensen-Halle. Ample parking is available in front of the hall. Results and personal data are collected and published. An outdoor awards ceremony is held with social distancing.

name: Kreismeisterschaft und 3. Halloween-Crosslauf im Örtzetal zu Munster
location: Sportpark Osterberg, Munster, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The County Cross-Country Championships and 3rd Örtzetal Halloween Cross-Country Run in Munster is a cross-country event held at Sportpark Osterberg in Munster. The event combines the county cross-country championships with the third Halloween cross-country run and is open to children, youth, open classes and masters. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, creating a local, club-focused atmosphere rather than the feel of a large city race. The race takes place in the autumnal Örtzetal region and is a popular seasonal event organised by Eintracht Munster.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in the Örtzetal on varied terrain
Distances from 500 m to 10 km for different age and ability groups
Event at Sportpark Osterberg, Munster
additional: The event was postponed due to bad weather and incorporates the county championships into the Halloween cross-country run. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event is held in a cross-country format, has a local character, and is open to children, youth, adults and masters. It takes place on Halloween, with weather-dependent adjustments.

name: Köstritzer Parklauf
location: Köstritzer Park, Bad Köstritz, Thuringia, Germany
description: The Köstritzer Parklauf is a cross-country race held in late October in Bad Köstritz, Germany. The course runs through and around Köstritzer Park, away from the usual running tracks. The event offers short races for children and young people, as well as longer distances for adults and masters, from 500 m to the 12 km main race. It attracts numerous local and regional clubs, mainly from Thuringia, but also from Saxony and Bavaria. The 27th edition of the race is known for its strong regional turnout.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through and around Köstritzer Park
Start in the park with views of dahlias in bloom in autumn
A range of distances from 500 m to 12 km
additional: Typical October weather: around 14 °C maximum and 6 °C minimum, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event includes races for children and young people, as well as main races for adults and masters. It takes place in late October, with various race distances and categories for children, young people, active runners, and masters. Registration is possible until shortly before the event.

name: Nordhessische Crosslaufmeisterschaften
description: The North Hesse Cross-Country Championships are a regional club and regional cross-country championship held in various locations across North Hesse. The event is aimed primarily at club runners from the region competing for regional and district titles. Course distances range from short youth races of 1.2 km to longer senior races of 8 km. The races take place on cross-country terrain, not on closed roads, and are organized by various athletics districts and clubs.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain rather than a road race
Distances from 1.2 km to 8 km
Held at sports facilities in various locations across North Hesse
additional: The event is geared strongly toward club runners. Depending on the course, runners are advised to choose suitable shoes carefully, such as spikes. Results are published as web and PDF listings. Typical October weather is cool and mostly cloudy, with a daytime high of about 14°C and a low of 6°C. October weather: about 14°C, low of 6°C, 40 mm of precipitation, cloudy; races take place at sports facilities in the region, online registration is possible, and results are published as web and PDF listings.

description: The TEAG - LEGEND OF CROSS in Mühlberg is Thuringia’s toughest cross-country race series, offering a challenging obstacle-race weekend with mud, steep climbs, and more than 30 natural and artificial obstacles. The event takes place over two days and takes participants past three castles. Distances ranging from 1 km to 30 km offer a suitable challenge for every ability level, for both individuals and teams. The races are known for their varied trails and the unique atmosphere of the historic Drei Gleichen setting.
course_highlights: Three castles as prominent points along the course
Up to 950 metres of elevation gain on the longest distance
More than 30 natural and artificial obstacles
additional: Races start in waves, with the elite running in the first start wave. There are individual and team competitions (CLAN OF CROSS for 5 or more people). The start and finish are at the Mühlberg sports field, with ample parking. Race packets can be collected on-site on several days beforehand. Children need parental consent. Late registration is available on race weekend; a fee of 5 euros applies for changes after October 30.

name: Podzimní běh Dražovkou
location: Vodojem, Hořovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Autumn Run through Dražovka is a traditional race held in Hořovice in a picturesque woodland setting. The main course is approximately 7.2 km long and runs mainly along forest paths over varied terrain. The race also offers a shorter 3.6 km course for women and children’s races. The start and registration are by the water tower at Dražovka, offering convenient access and a setting in nature. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including junior and veteran runners.
course_highlights: Mainly forest paths over varied terrain
Main course: 7.2 km; women’s course: 3.6 km
Start and registration by the water tower at Dražovka in the forest
additional: Junior men, women, and veterans over 70 run one lap; everyone else runs two laps. Children’s races are also part of the program. The start and registration are in the same place, in the forest by the water tower at Dražovka (Podlužská Street).

name: Vinařský maraton
location: Velké Bílovice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Wine Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Báječné ženy v běhu association in Velké Bílovice. The race offers a marathon course with categories for men and women, as well as special categories for visually impaired runners. The event also includes the charitable Vinařská míle run, which supports children with disabilities. Race facilities are located at the local elementary school, where refreshments and a bag drop are available. The race is limited to 800 participants, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Marathon course in the wine-growing region of Velké Bílovice
Charitable Vinařská míle run for children and families
Facilities and refreshments at the elementary school
additional: The race is limited to 800 participants. A bag drop is available in a tent at the multifunctional sports ground. Participants can enter as relay teams; all team members must be registered under the same team name. Wooden medals are awarded at the finish, and small prizes are prepared for children taking part in the charitable Vinařská míle run.

name: Lhotecká Kaštanka
location: Restaurace U Splavu, Lhota, Kladno District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Lhotecká Kaštanka is a 15 km race on asphalt and firm forest paths around Lhota in the Kladno District. This run is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Running Cup and offers runners a pleasant route combining asphalt and forest surfaces. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting on quality surfaces. The start and finish are at the U splavu restaurant in the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: 15 km route
Asphalt and firm forest paths
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Running Cup

name: Krospůlmaraton
location: Sosnová u České Lípy, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Krosp half marathon in Sosnová near Česká Lípa is a traditional running race held as part of the Česká Lípa District Running League. The race takes place and offers runners the chance to test their strength in the pleasant autumn setting of the Liberec Region. The event is part of a series of regional races that encourage sporting activity and community gatherings for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Natural terrain suitable for cross-country
Part of a regional running league
Held in the picturesque surroundings of Sosnová near Česká Lípa
additional: The race is part of a regional running series. The exact course profile is not provided, but the terrain is expected to be suitable for running in nature.

name: Lesní kros mezi přeštickými prasaty
location: Střelnice, Přeštice, Plzeň Region, Czech Republic
description: Lesní kros mezi přeštickými prasaty is a traditional 8-kilometre race in Přeštice. Runners follow forest paths, running over dirt, leaves and roots, with the possibility of mud. The start and finish are at Střelnice in Přeštice, which offers convenient facilities, including changing rooms, refreshments and home cooking. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and is open to runners over the age of 15. Registration opens at 9:00 and the race starts at 10:30. The results are announced after the last runner finishes, usually around noon.
course_highlights: Eight kilometres of forest paths with natural obstacles such as roots and leaves
Start and finish at the traditional venue, Střelnice in Přeštice
The race takes place in all weather conditions
additional: On-site registration opens at 9:00. By registering, runners consent to the processing of their personal data for the purposes of organising and promoting the race. The organiser provides changing rooms, refreshments and home cooking at the Střelnice venue. The race is open to runners over the age of 15; minors must have the consent of their legal guardians.
