description: Sninský Cross is a traditional running race in Snina, offering a competition in pleasant surroundings with quality organization. Competitors are provided with race numbers, a changing tent, toilets, and a bag storage facility. The race is held according to the rules of the Slovak Athletics Federation, and category winners receive medals and in-kind prizes. The event has a friendly atmosphere and supports charitable causes.
course_highlights: The route follows a circuit through the town of Snina
Asphalt surface with distance markers every 5 km
A detailed map, elevation profile, and GPX file are available
additional: A changing tent is provided, toilets are available at Hotel Kamei, and bag storage is located by registration. Every participant receives a medal, and refreshments are provided. The winners are announced immediately after all runners have finished, at the venue.

name: Majcichovský maratón
location: Základná škola Jána Palárika, Majcichov, Slovakia

name: Oeventroper Volks- und Straßenlauf
location: Sportplatz 'In den Oeren', Arnsberg-Oeventrop, Arnsberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Oeventrop Volks- und Straßenlauf is a local road race in Arnsberg-Oeventrop, held at the “In den Oeren” sports ground. The main event is a flat 10 km race for adults, which starts in the morning. There is also a 5 km youth race and several 1.1 km children’s races, divided by age and gender. The start and finish are centrally located at the sports ground, making the event family-friendly and easy to navigate. The event is hosted by TuS 1896 Oeventrop e.V. and is part of the Lauf Cup standings.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km circuit
5 km youth race on a flat loop
1.1 km children’s races divided by age and gender
additional: The start and finish are at the “In den Oeren” sports ground, bringing everything together in one place for runners and families. There is a three-person team classification for the 5 km race. The children’s races have separate starts for different age and gender groups. Race in Arnsberg-Oeventrop, Lauf Cup standings, parking at REWE and ALDI Widayweg

name: Birkhahnlauf
location: Schneeren, Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Birkhahnlauf in Schneeren is a traditional race that has been held annually on the last Sunday in October for over 50 years. The event offers distances for all age groups, from short children’s races starting at 500 meters to challenging 5 km and 10 km races for adults. The courses run through the pine forest on paved forest paths with a slightly sandy surface and no significant elevation profile, making the race a special experience amid nature. New this year is a 2.3 km course for the U12 age group and up. The friendly atmosphere and prompt award ceremonies with certificates and medals round off the event.
course_highlights: Courses through the pine forest on paved forest paths
Distances from 500 m to 10.2 km for all age groups
Kilometer markers on the 5.1 km and 10.2 km courses, which have no significant elevation profile
additional: Start times: children’s 500 m race at 10:30, 1,000 m at 10:45, 2.3 km at 11:10, and 5.1 km and 10.2 km at 11:40. Award ceremonies take place promptly after the respective races. Parking is available nearby and is signposted.

name: Halloween-Run-Bremen
description: The Halloween Run Bremen 2026 takes place on October 31 and offers runners a spooky race experience around Werdersee. With five different distances, from 1 km to the 42.195 km marathon, there is something for every ability level. The courses are measured in accordance with German Athletics Association rules and are eligible for record lists, underscoring the competitive nature of the event. Alongside the sporting event, participants can look forward to a spooky atmosphere with costumes, lights and fog, as well as an awards ceremony and a closing fireworks display.
course_highlights: 8.333 km loop course, measured by the German Athletics Association and eligible for record lists
Distances from 1 km (Spuklauf) to the marathon (Splatterthon), with a spooky atmosphere
Start and finish area at Werdersee, between the Finnbahn and the barbecue area
additional: The awards ceremony for the Spuklauf takes place immediately after the finish; awards for the other distances are presented later. A spectacular fireworks display at 18:00 rounds off the event. There are also relay competitions for the marathon (5-person relay). The race bib with RFID chip serves as the relay baton and must be brought by the team. Costumes are expressly encouraged but are not compulsory. Participants can register online. There are various distances and relay options; the event takes place at night and offers a spooky atmosphere.

name: 19. Bothfelder Waldlauf
description: The Bothfelder Waldlauf is a popular race approved by the German Athletics Association and organized by TuS Bothfeld 04 in Hanover. The races start and finish at the Bothfeld district sports ground and follow a circular route through the beautiful Bothfeld Forest, along woodland paths and well-maintained forest roads. The race is part of the Hanover Region running pass and changing and shower facilities are available at the finish. Affordable food and drinks, as well as free hot tea for all participants, are provided.
course_highlights: Circular route through the Bothfeld Forest
Race along woodland paths and well-maintained forest roads
Start and finish at the Bothfeld district sports ground
additional: Late entries can be made online up to 60 minutes before the respective race starts, subject to availability, for an additional fee of 2 euros on top of the entry fee. The children’s race awards ceremonies take place in the finish area about 60 minutes after the races; awards for the longer distances are presented immediately after the finish. All runners can print their certificates on site. The 5 km walk starts at the same time as the 10 km main race. The venue is easily accessible by Stadtbahn line 13, and parking is available nearby.

name: 28. Tangerpokallauf
description: The 28th Tanger Cup Run in Demker is the oldest running event organized by SC Demker '95 and marks the end of the Elbe-Ohre Cup season. The course runs through the autumnal Tangerniederung between Demker and Weißewarte, past Deutsches Eck, under the Stendal–Magdeburg railway line, and through the Süpplings woodland. Distances offered are 1.2 km for children and young people, and 5.4 km and 12.0 km for older young people and adults. The terrain is entirely flat, with the dikes as the only rises; they have protected Demker since the 2013 flood.
course_highlights: Flat course through the autumnal Tangerniederung
Along the Tanger and past Deutsches Eck
Through the Süpplings woodland
additional: The course is entirely flat, with the dikes as its only rises. There are three distances: 1.2 km for children and young people, and 5.4 km and 12.0 km for older young people and adults. The course passes under the Stendal–Magdeburg railway line.

name: LG Alsternord Herbstwaldlauf 2026
description: The LG Alsternord Autumn Forest Run is a local autumn race through the forest in Norderstedt, north of Hamburg. Organized by LG Alsternord Hamburg e.V., the race starts at 11:00 a.m. at the Rantzauer Forst-Thingplatz. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes, including a cross-country option. The race takes place away from city streets in the Rantzauer Forst area and also offers walking and hiking events. With a modest field of usually 101 to 300 runners, the event has more of a club-run feel than that of a major race.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Rantzauer Forst, away from city streets
5 km, 10 km and cross-country options
Modest field with a club-run atmosphere
additional: Results are published via race result; public start lists, photos, reports and historical rankings are available. In addition to the races, there are walking and hiking events, including a 5 km walk. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with rainy days. The event takes place in typical November weather, around 7°C and with rainy conditions. It is open to runners and walkers of all ages, with a modest participant count of between 101 and 300.

name: Neustädter Sparkassen Nachtlauf
location: Neustadt an der Aisch, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Night Run in Neustadt an der Aisch is a long-standing running event that welcomes runners of all ages. In addition to the children’s race, there are walking, fun and main races, all held in the evening and offering a special atmosphere. The course has been optimized to take participants’ wishes into account and offers a varied route through the town. Participants can collect their race numbers at the town hall and receive a small thank-you bag at the finish. Award ceremonies take place in front of the Sparkasse and at the town hall.
course_highlights: Varied route through Neustadt an der Aisch
Race-number collection at the town hall on the market square
Award ceremonies in front of the Sparkasse and at the town hall
additional: Late entries are possible at the town hall up to 30 minutes before each start, for a late-entry fee of €2. Showers and changing facilities are available at the TSV sports ground from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m. Jackets may be left at the town hall or in the Stadtwerke tent during the race, at the owner’s risk. For safety reasons, boys start 3 minutes before girls in the children’s race. Race numbers must be handed in at the finish; in return, each runner receives a small thank-you bag. Prize money is awarded to the top three finishers in the main race.

name: Tiergarten-Cross
description: The Tiergarten Cross in Schleswig is a local cross-country race. The event offers two main distances, 4.4 km and 8.8 km, which start one after the other so the fields are separated. The course is undulating and challenging, with constant changes of rhythm that make the race varied. Alongside the main races, there are also children’s and youth races, making the event family-friendly and varied.
course_highlights: Finishes in Tiergarten Schleswig, the course’s most distinctive point
Undulating course with constant small changes of rhythm
Separate start times for the 4.4 km and 8.8 km distances
additional: Typical November weather in Schleswig is cool, with daytime highs of around 7 °C, and rainy on most days. The event takes place in Tiergarten Schleswig, is weather-dependent (November is usually rainy), and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various race categories.

name: Winterlaufserie 2026/2027, 1. Wertungslauf
description: The Winter Run Series in Hamm is a long-standing winter road-running series, now taking place for the 51st time. The first scoring race covers a distance of 15 km on roads outside the stadium. The event attracts many club runners from Westphalia and beyond, including teams from Dortmund, Münster and Bielefeld. The race offers a challenging course in the cool November weather and is a popular start to the winter season for runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: 15 km road race outside the stadium
A field with a strong club-running presence from Westphalia and the surrounding area
Typically cool and rainy November weather
additional: The starting location is Ahnatal. The average November temperature is around 7°C, with frequent rain (approximately 45 mm of precipitation). The event is part of the Winter Run Series, which may take place in typical weather of around 7°C with rain. It is the series’ first scoring race and appeals to runners from various regions.

name: Motolské jamky
location: Golf Club Praha, Motol, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Motolské jamky is a traditional metropolitan trail run held on the course of the oldest golf club in the Czech Republic, which is celebrating its centenary. The race features a challenging hilly profile and runs over soft green fairways and forest paths, making it an enjoyable experience for runners of all abilities. The event is part of the Trail Running Cup and is known for its atmosphere, quality services and the opportunity to enjoy a family outing in Prague. The start and finish are at a familiar spot below the central putting green. The course consists of four or two laps, with a total elevation gain of 184 or 92 metres, respectively.
course_highlights: A challenging course with three hills and one steeper climb before the finish
Predominantly soft surfaces, running over green fairways and forest paths
The course passes the golf course’s holes, with views of Prague
additional: The race is part of the Trail Running Cup and offers 28 categories, from the youngest participants to seniors. The course was slightly modified four years ago, with one steeper hill removed. The event has been held without interruption for 22 years and is known for its high-quality race services. After the finish, refreshments are available in the clubhouse restaurant.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - listopad
description: The 2 Mile Run Olomouc is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The event focuses on the joy of running and competing primarily against yourself. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, by the fountain. It also includes a cup competition with a points system based on age coefficients, encouraging participation throughout the year.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
Suitable for all ages and running abilities
Scenic park setting by the fountain
additional: Registration takes place on site from 9:30 to 10:00. The top three finishers are announced in each category. The race is part of a year-round cup competition with a points system, counting each runner’s best results from a maximum of 9 races during the year.

name: HRUŠTICE 10 km - Memoriál Zdeňka Drobníka
location: Metelkovy sady, Turnov, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 200 Kè - přihláška předem - kategorie Z, Z35, Z45, M39, V40, V50, V60

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startovné 150 Kè - přihláška předem - kategorie V70, Z55

description: The HRUŠTICE Road Race – Zdeněk Drobník Memorial is a traditional race dating back to 1974. Since 2024, it has been run on a new 10 km course through the Jizera River valley in Turnov. The start and finish are in Metelkovy Gardens, an urban park, and the course runs mostly on paved roads and cycle paths, with gentle elevation changes and one steeper hill. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants and offers a pleasant atmosphere in beautiful natural surroundings. It is organized by the AC Turnov athletics club, which provides full race services, including chip timing.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Jizera River valley, mostly on paved roads and cycle paths
Start and finish in Metelkovy Gardens, an urban park in Turnov
One steeper hill, about 200 m long, at around the 3.5 km mark
additional: All categories start together. Registration and race number pickup take place from 08:45 to 10:00 at the AC Turnov clubhouse at Ludvík Daněk Stadium. The start and finish are in Metelkovy Gardens, about 600 m from the stadium, where you can leave your car. Parking at the start and finish is not provided. After the race, race numbers are entered into a draw for prizes.

name: Betelný Bergl – Virtuální běžecká série závodů – Brněnsko
location: Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

name: Běh na Babí lom
location: Babí lom, Kuřim, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Beroun
location: Hospoda na Černém vršku, Prague, Czech Republic

description: The Berounka Running Series in Beroun is a night stage through the beautiful Křivoklát forests. The route is marked with yellow reflective signs and red arrows on the ground, and passes over the summit of Děd, with views of Beroun and the surrounding area. The race features a challenging climb to the lookout tower, followed by a descent to the finish. Each participant receives a race number and a headlamp. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site.
course_highlights: Night stage with a headlamp
The route passes the Děd lookout tower, with views of Beroun
Marked with yellow reflective signs and red arrows
additional: The latest start time is 17:45. The top three finishers in each category receive a diploma. Participants are provided with a headlamp.

name: Benešovská dušičková soutěska
location: Občerstvení Pod Lesem, Benešov nad Ploučnicí, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic

name: Flutlicht-Crosslauf und OWL Crossmeisterschaften
location: Crosspark am Sportplatz Lüchtringen, Lüchtringen, Höxter, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The floodlit cross-country run in Lüchtringen is a long-standing event held alongside the OWL Cross-Country Championships. The race takes place in the Crosspark at the Lüchtringen sports field and offers runners a challenging cross-country course under floodlights. The event is open to athletes of all ages and ability levels and is a highlight of the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Crosspark at the Lüchtringen sports field
Race under floodlights
Host venue for the OWL Cross-Country Championships
additional: Registration is by email using a self-created Excel spreadsheet based on the template, sent to meldung@lf-luechtringen.de. There is no editable Excel file available to download. The event is organised by the Leichtathletikfreunde Lüchtringen 1983 e.V. club. The event also includes the OWL Cross Championships.

name: BEH 17. NOVEMBRA
location: Žilina, Okres Žilina, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia

description: Gorlicki Bieg Górski to dwudniowa impreza biegowa odbywająca się w malowniczym Beskidzie Niskim, w okolicach Radocyny i Sękowej. Zawody obejmują trzy dystanse: 7 km, 24 km oraz bieg typu Vertical na Magurę Małastowską. Trasy charakteryzują się znacznym przewyższeniem i pięknymi widokami, a limit uczestników jest ściśle kontrolowany, co zapewnia kameralną atmosferę. Organizatorzy zapewniają profesjonalną obsługę, dekoracje oraz nagrody finansowe dla najlepszych zawodników.
course_highlights: Trasa 24 km z przewyższeniem 610 m
Trasa 8 km z przewyższeniem 160 m
Vertical o długości 2,3 km i przewyższeniu 340 m na Magurę Małastowską
additional: Limit uczestników: 24 km - 250 osób, 8 km - 150 osób, Vertical - 150 osób. Start i meta dla 7 km i 24 km w OSW Lasów Państwowych Radocyna, start Vertical w Magura Ski Park / Małastów. Limit czasowy: 5 godzin dla 24 km, 1 godzina dla Vertical. Możliwość zwrotu wpisowego do 31.10.2027 oraz przepisanie pakietu startowego na inną osobę do tego samego terminu.

name: Heiner-Mayr-Staffelberglauf
description: The Heiner-Mayr-Staffelberglauf is a challenging mountain relay race held in Bad Staffelstein. Organized by TSV 1860 Staffelstein e.V. with support from Sparkasse Coburg-Lichtenfels, the course covers 3,960 meters and 260 meters of elevation gain, climbing from the start at Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße to the Staffelberg plateau by the Adelgundis Chapel. Runners can expect a challenging race with impressive views across the Franconian countryside. The race pays tribute to decades of dedication to running in the region.
course_highlights: 3,960-meter course with 260 meters of elevation gain
Start at Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße in Bad Staffelstein
Finish on the Staffelberg plateau by the Adelgundis Chapel, with panoramic views

name: Internationaler Fackellauf
description: The 45th International Torch Run in Rodenbach is taking place and offers a challenging 7 km course for adults. The course is a hilly loop with a total of 92 meters of elevation gain and loss, appealing to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers alike. There are also competitions for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official announcement. The start is at 18:00, and the finish is the same for all competitions.
course_highlights: 7 km hilly loop
92 meters of elevation gain and loss
Very challenging, mountainous course
additional: Competitions for children and young people are offered; see the organizer’s official announcement for details. The finish is the same for all competitions. The exact finish location is available with RUNME Premium. The event is part of the Red Cross’s international humanitarian work, conveying a message of hope and peace.

name: Limes- Winterlaufserie - 1. Lauf über 10 km
description: The Limes Winter Running Series is a three-part winter running series in Pohlheim. The first race, a 10 km run, forms the basis for the overall standings. The series attracts runners from the region, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district, and has a long tradition, with its 49th edition taking place in 2026. The race offers a great opportunity to compete with other runners during the colder months and kick off the winter running series.
course_highlights: 10 km run through Pohlheim, Watzenborn-Steinberg
Part of a three-race winter running series
Popular race with regional participation, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, usually rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Please check the details with the organizer before registering. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in a wintry atmosphere. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and also provides results and participant lists.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event held in Rodgau since 1980, attracting recreational runners and elite athletes from Germany and abroad. The series comprises four dates, each featuring 5 km and 10 km routes through the Jügesheim Forest, described as fast and flat. The event takes place at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion in Rodgau-Jügesheim and offers team rankings for men’s, women’s and mixed teams. The organization is highly praised, and a COVID-safe outdoor changing area is available. Timing is provided by a chip attached to the race bib.
course_highlights: Flat, fast route through the Jügesheim Forest
Event at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion in Rodgau-Jügesheim
Team rankings for men’s, women’s and mixed teams
additional: Start times: 5 km at 14:00, 10 km at 15:00. Chip timing using a chip attached to the race bib (gross-time recording). The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Club members receive a 50% discount on the entry fee when registering by email. Payment is made in cash on site. A COVID-safe outdoor changing area with a roof is available. The route is very popular for setting personal bests. The series comprises several races, with chip timing and refreshments at the stadium. Teams of three are permitted. The event is also geared toward winter training, with training plans provided.

name: 14. Sollingquerung

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Preis von 45€ inklusive Duschen, Toiletten, Getränke und warme Mahlzeiten im Ziel

description: The Solling Crossing is a challenging GPS-guided race from Bad Karlshafen to Dassel, taking place on November 6, 2027. The course is not marked, so GPS navigation is required. The field is limited to 100 participants, and the start is at 9:00 after a group bus transfer from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen. The entry fee includes hot showers, toilets, drinks, and hot meals at the finish.
course_highlights: Course from Bad Karlshafen to Dassel
No course markings; GPS navigation only
Aid stations along the course
additional: Bib pickup on November 6 from 17:00 to 17:30 and on November 7 from 6:30 to 7:30. The bus departs at 7:45 from the stadium at Lehmbreite in Dassel (for navigation: Lessingstraße).

name: 6. Weserbergland Backyard Ultra
description: The Weserbergland Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarunning event in Höxter, North Rhine-Westphalia, held in the Backyard format. Participants run a 6.706-kilometer loop every hour until only one runner remains. The race is marked by exciting head-to-head contests, personal challenges, and a strong sense of community. The event attracts numerous ultrarunners each year, ready to take on the challenge of completing the same loop again and again.
course_highlights: Hourly loops of 6.706 kilometers
Run through the Weserbergland with challenging sections, such as at Heiligenberg
A prolonged test of limits with changing light and weather conditions
additional: A 24/7 live camera in the start/finish area shows starts and finishes without commentary. Special running shirts are available for the event. The event takes place in November, with dusk from 17:00 and darkness from 18:00, presenting particular challenges for runners.

name: Heseper Martinslauf
description: The Hesepe Martinslauf is a popular athletics competition in Groß-Hesepe, held annually in November. Organized by SV Groß Hesepe, it offers various categories for children, young people, adults and masters. The event includes races of approximately 8,870 m and 3,000 m, as well as competitions for children and young people, offering both an athletic challenge and a community experience. After the race, participants can look forward to a sociable atmosphere with refreshments and special activities.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in the natural surroundings of Groß-Hesepe
Routes of approximately 8,870 m and 3,000 m
A variety of categories for all age groups
additional: The event takes place in November, with registration by email and various competition classes for children, young people, adults and masters. After the race, there is often a sociable gathering with refreshments.

name: Pokallauf
description: The "Rund um Marienberg" Cup Race is a traditional running competition held in the Marienberg region. The event offers various distances, including 5 km and 10 km, each run on a 2.5 km loop. Technique varies by age group, with classical technique for the youngest participants and freestyle technique from age group U10 onward. The event is organized by ATSV Gebirge/Gelobtland e.V., a multisport club for all generations.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances on a 2.5 km loop
Classical technique for U6–9 with mass start
Freestyle technique from U10 onward with mass start
additional: The event announcement is not updated. Changes to technique and distance are possible depending on current snow conditions.

name: SCC Cross Country
description: The SCC Cross Country is a forest race in Berlin at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage in Westend. Two clearly defined cross-country routes are offered: 4 km for U16 through adults and 9 km for U18 through adults; both races start in the morning. The event is deliberately straightforward and is aimed at club runners, young athletes and adults who want to run short off-road loops, setting it apart from the city’s major road races. The course follows paved and unpaved forest paths, where rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish matter more than scenic views. Awards go to the top three in each age and gender category, and there is a prize for the fastest final lap for men and women.
course_highlights: Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths
Two routes: 4 km for U16 through adults, 9 km for U18 through adults
Focus on rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish
additional: Entry is free for SCC members. Late registration is available shortly before the start for an additional fee. An archive of results is available to document the race. The event takes place at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage on Harbigstraße in Westend, Berlin-Charlottenburg. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with rainy days. Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths, entry fee for non-members, late registration for an additional fee, November weather around 7 °C, rainy.

name: Schkölener Stadtparklauf
description: The Schkölen City Park Run is a long-standing running event organized by TSV 1885 Schkölen and SSV Friedrich-Schiller-Gymnasium Eisenberg. The race takes place at the Schkölen sports ground and offers various distances for children, teenagers, and adults. The event emphasizes clear age-group divisions and is open to runners of all ages. The race starts in the morning, and the routes pass through the city park with different lap lengths.
course_highlights: Routes through Schkölen City Park featuring short, medium, and long laps
Age-appropriate distances from 0.6 km to 5 km
A combination of short and long laps for longer distances
additional: Age groups are determined by calendar year; for example, a 6-year-old runner (born in 2020) belongs to age group 6. The event takes place annually and is part of the regional athletics competition schedule.

name: Sparkassen-LüneCross
description: The Sparkassen-LüneCross is an exciting and challenging cross-country running event set amid the natural surroundings of Lüneburg, welcoming runners of all ability levels. The varied course takes runners over sandy, root-covered trails, meadows, forest paths and gravel tracks, testing endurance, strength and running technique. In addition to the main 4 km and 8 km races, there are shorter distances for children and teenagers, as well as relay races that offer a shared team experience. Food and drinks are provided, and after the races there is an awards ceremony and a chance to socialise. The joy of running and a sense of community are at the heart of this special event.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with sandy, root-covered trails
Course runs through meadows, forest paths and gravel tracks
Relay races with 3 to 6 runners as a team event
additional: There is a school competition, with prizes for schools with the highest participation rate. After the races, there is an awards ceremony and a chance to socialise.

name: Offene Kreismeisterschaft im Crosslauf des NLV Kreis Göttingen
Běh Labským údolím
location: Dolní Žleb, Děčín, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through the Elbe Valley is a traditional autumn running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Žleb near Děčín. The race offers courses of 4, 8, and 16 kilometres, running through varied terrain, mostly on forest roads and trails. It is organised by the LABÁCI group, which continues the long-standing tradition of local organisers. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for the general public who want to enjoy the beauty of the Elbe Valley in autumn.
course_highlights: Varied terrain, mostly on forest roads and trails
Picturesque Elbe Valley in autumn
Courses of 4, 8, and 16 km, suitable for different age and ability groups
additional: Race registration takes place from 10:45 at the gathering point in Dolní Žleb, in front of the “U KOSTI” pub. The organiser does not provide changing rooms, but luggage storage is available. The recommended way to get to the race is by train, departing from Děčín main railway station at 10:41. After the race, runners can enjoy tea and a friendly atmosphere.

name: TRAIL LÁZNĚ VELICHOVKY
location: Lázně Velichovky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Lázně Velichovky is an autumn trail race held at the historic Velichovky spa, offering varied and beautiful running terrain. The start and finish are located on the spa colonnade, with covered facilities, changing rooms and a restaurant, including a spa café. The race is known for its atmosphere and quality services for runners, including refreshments, medical services and an accompanying programme. Participants receive an original medal, a race pack and electronic chip timing. The race is suitable for anyone who wants to experience the beauty of autumn nature and the spa setting.
course_highlights: The most colourful autumn running terrain
Start and finish on the spa colonnade
Covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant
additional: Runners have access to changing rooms, luggage storage, toilets, catering and parking. The entry fee includes an electronic timing chip, refreshments during the race and at the finish, photos and a downloadable certificate (photos are not guaranteed for everyone). Gladiator Race clothing is available for purchase on site.

name: Jizerun
location: Stadion Čelákovice, Čelákovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

description: Jizerun is a relay running race that takes teams of 4–5 runners from Prague to the Jizera Mountains. The total route is approximately 165 km, which competitors complete in one day. The course follows cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains, offering a team experience full of sporting challenges and camaraderie. The race is open to men’s, women’s, mixed, and corporate relay teams. The start and finish are at the stadium in Čelákovice, and a finisher party with live music awaits at the finish.
course_highlights: A 165 km relay run from Prague to the Jizera Mountains
The route follows cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains
Stages of varying difficulty, from 1 to 8 on a scale of 10
additional: The race package includes, among other things, portable toilets, facilities at the finish including showers, a host and sound system, medical services throughout the race, gifts from partners, photos and video, full staffing, and all necessary permits. Check-in is mandatory; the presence of one team member or their representative is sufficient.

name: Běh kolem Práchně
description: Běh kolem Práchně is a road race around Horažďovice in the Plzeň Region, offering runners the challenge of a course with elevation gain. The race is part of the official Czech Running calendar, managed by the Czech Athletics Federation. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers quality facilities and organization. Exact details about the course distance and start time will be published closer to race day.
course_highlights: A road race with elevation gain around Horažďovice
Scenic surroundings in the Plzeň Region
Part of the official Czech Running calendar

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - listopad
location: Příluky, Zlín, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit, just under 2 laps long (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to 12 years old. Every runner is timed, and the first three finishers in both the adult and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop).

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
location: Otrokovice, Zlín District, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Otrokovice Running Festival 2026 offers a wide range of races, including a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10K and youth races. The MUDr. Josef Podmolík Memorial is the festival’s premier half-marathon event. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Otrokovice, with the start and finish between the Lanáček rope centre and the Municipal Sports Hall. The festival is a traditional gathering for runners of all ages and abilities, with electronic timing and a varied accompanying programme. Participants can enjoy a high-quality asphalt course and convenient facilities, including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: Start and finish between the Lanáček rope centre and the Municipal Sports Hall
The course is 100% asphalt
Course suitable for all ages, including youth
additional: Race registration takes place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall. Changing rooms and showers are available in the hall. Refreshments can be purchased at the Lanáček rope centre near the start and finish. Parking is available by the main building of the New Stadium and on nearby streets. The start and finish area is accessible only on foot.

name: Svatojánská 20
location: Atletický stadion TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 is a traditional endurance running race organized by the athletics and triathlon club TJ Lokomotiva Beroun since 1985. The race offers two routes: 11 km for women and men over 70, and 18 km for men under 70. They run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and Loděnický Stream. The start and finish are at the athletics stadium in Beroun, with turnarounds in the settlement of V Kozle and in Svatý Jan pod Skalou. The race takes place in normal road traffic; participants must obey traffic regulations and take part at their own risk.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and Loděnický Stream
Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium
Two turnarounds: the 11 km route turns in the settlement of V Kozle; the 18 km route turns in Svatý Jan pod Skalou
additional: On-site check-in and registration are available on race day from 11:00 to 12:40. Runners who register in advance and pay by November 4 will receive a race number bearing their name. Finish-line refreshments include tea and biscuits. Parking is available in nearby car parks outside the blue zones around the stadium.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Kovárna VIVA, former Svit/Baťa industrial complex, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Kovářská pětka is a 5-kilometre urban road race held in Zlín in the former Baťa industrial complex. The race is for both adults and children and is organised by Kovárna VIVA in cooperation with the Běhy Zlín association. The event has a long tradition and attracts strong competition, including international runners. It offers a pleasant atmosphere in the centre of the regional capital and is suitable for the general public.
course_highlights: A 5 km road course in the former Baťa industrial complex
The centre of Zlín, with its historic industrial complex
Events for adults and children
additional: The race has children’s categories and is part of the Běhy Zlín running series. It is organised by the Běhy Zlín association and Kovárna VIVA. Results and photos from previous editions are regularly published on the website.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
location: Královská obora Stromovka, Praha 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Prague is an open race for the public, held in the beautiful surroundings of Královská obora - Stromovka Park. The course follows the park’s paved paths. Adults run two laps (2 miles, i.e. 3.2 km), while children up to 12 years old run one lap (1 mile + 70 m). The race is part of the year-round Lívancový pohár, which recognizes performances adjusted using an age coefficient. The start is usually at 9:07 a.m. on the first Saturday of each month, and registration is available both on site and online.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km + 70 m)
Královská obora - Stromovka offers beautiful surroundings that are almost always dry
additional: Registration takes place in the area by the Brussels Gate, beneath the Marold Panorama building, from 8:15 to 8:45 a.m. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings, along with a mobile valuables storage facility and toilet cabins. Arriving by bike, on foot, on rollerblades, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský ostrov, on Za elektrárnou Street.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Dostihové závodiště Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: The Labský Half Marathon is a running race held at the racecourse in Lysá nad Labem. It offers two routes of approximately 13 km and 21 km, running through the flat Elbe lowland forest on a combination of paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short asphalt sections. The start and finish are in the racecourse grounds, where refreshments, baggage storage, and other facilities are available. The race is suitable for the general public and also includes children’s races. Capacity is limited to 730 participants, ensuring a comfortable event.
course_highlights: The routes are flat and run through the beautiful Elbe lowland forest
The start follows approximately 1 km on the racecourse track
The route surface consists of paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short asphalt/concrete sections
additional: Race capacity is limited to 730 participants. Parking is available in the racecourse grounds for a fee of 50 Kč. Tents for changing, baggage storage, toilets, and refreshments are provided at the start and finish. The 21 km route has two aid stations (at km 8 and 17), while the 13 km route has one aid station (at km 8). The route is marked with flags, signs, and flour arrows, and each kilometre is marked for guidance.

name: Závod dvojic
location: Kladno, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hostivař Doubles is a relay running race for pairs, offering a unique team-running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Hostivař. The race is for pairs who want to tackle the course together and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Relay race for pairs
Scenic surroundings of Hostivař
Friendly, sporting atmosphere

name: Hornická desítka
description: Hornická desítka is a traditional running race in the Moravian-Silesian Region, held in and around Frýdek-Místek. The race has a long history dating back to 1980 and gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on a 10 km course. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and broad participation by runners of all ages, including youth races and a run for health. Hornická desítka is a celebration of exercise and sporting spirit in the region.
course_highlights: The course runs between the former Paskov and Staříč mines
The race is 10 km long
The route is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners
additional: The race is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s. and is part of a wider sports event featuring runs for children, youth and adults. In the past, more than 2,000 runners have taken part, including recreational parent-and-child runs.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Pardubice, Pardubice District, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Malá Pardubická - cross country is a traditional cross-country race organized by the AC Pardubice athletics club. The race takes place in Pardubice and is open to all runners and running enthusiasts. The organizers look forward to welcoming participants and spectators, and publish the race information and results on their website. The race has a long tradition and is part of AC Pardubice's regular events.

description: The Run Against Addiction is a running race in Plzeň, offering courses from 300 metres to 6 kilometres along the paved paths of Homolka Forest Park. The race is open to various age categories and includes a relay for teams of three, with each runner completing one lap of approximately 2,000 metres. The 6 km course is varied and consists of three laps, while the children’s courses are flat. The organisers provide medals and prizes for the top three finishers in each category, and the race takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: The course follows the paved paths of Homolka Forest Park
The 6 km course has varied terrain and consists of three laps
The children’s courses are flat and suitable for younger runners
additional: Race bibs are distributed at the event venue from 9:00 to 10:20. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The organiser reserves the right to change the categories and times depending on how the race progresses. The relay team has three members, each running one lap of approximately 2,000 m, with a clearly marked handover zone.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - září
location: Madal Bal, U Tescomy 244, Zlín-Příluky, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and covers just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. There is also an 800-meter children’s course. Every participant can enjoy a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish. The race is held regularly on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to 12 years old. Each runner’s time is recorded, and the top three finishers in the men’s, women’s, and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The men’s course record is 9:31.8. The start and registration are in front of the Madal Bal company building at U Tescomy 244 in Zlín-Příluky.

location: Bruselská brána, Královská obora Stromovka, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 2 Miles Run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for the general public. The course follows paved paths through the Royal Game Preserve Stromovka, where adults run two laps and children up to 12 years old run one. The race usually takes place on the first Saturday of each month, starting at 9:07, and offers a pleasant park setting with changing facilities and toilets. Each participant’s time is recorded, and results count toward the year-long Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through the Royal Game Preserve Stromovka
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles); children up to 12 run 1 lap (1 mile + 70 m)
Start and registration by the Brussels Gate, below the Marold Panorama
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate from 8:15 to 8:45. You can also register online in advance for a faster check-in. We recommend arriving by bike, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Parking is recommended by the bridge to Císařský Island, on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing, along with a mobile valuables storage facility. Results are published online, and times are adjusted using an age coefficient for the Lívancový Cup. Runners are welcomed at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake. Tents for changing and leaving belongings, as well as toilets, are available on site.

Běh o koláč panny z Dívčích Hradů
description: The Běh o koláč panny z Dívčích Hradů is a traditional running race organized by SK Zlíchov Praha, held on the first Saturday in November. The race attracts a wide range of runners, including young aspiring athletes and veterans, and offers a pleasant atmosphere with friendly competition. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and sunny weather, which also prevailed at the most recent edition. After the race, participants can meet and socialize at the club premises.
course_highlights: A traditional race held on the first Saturday in November in Prague’s Zlíchov district
A wide range of participants, from schoolchildren to veterans
A friendly atmosphere and pleasant weather
additional: The race is part of the activities of SK Zlíchov Praha, which also organizes other social and sporting events. The boathouse is accessible only to members with keys or by arrangement with the committee. After the race, it is possible to attend social evenings and other club activities.

300 m children’s run
The event takes place in Jonava

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL z Fundacją Lotto to ogólnopolski cykl biegów przełajowych na dystansie 5 km, odbywający się w siedmiu lokalizacjach, w tym w Trójmieście (Gdańsk i Gdynia). Biegi prowadzone są po lasach i parkach miejskich, oferując uczestnikom możliwość rywalizacji na świeżym powietrzu w naturalnym otoczeniu. Cykl składa się z czterech biegów w każdej lokalizacji, a wyniki sumują się do klasyfikacji końcowej. Zawody są otwarte dla osób od 16 roku życia, a także dla młodszych uczestników z odpowiednim pozwoleniem. Start biegu głównego odbywa się o godzinie 11:00.
course_highlights: Trasa 5 km po lasach i parkach miejskich
Lokalizacja Trójmiasto: Nadleśnictwo Gdańsk, Trójmiejski Park Krajobrazowy w okolicy AWFiS Gdańsk
Cykliczność i stałość harmonogramu oraz lokalizacji biura zawodów
additional: Możliwość wykupienia pakietu charytatywnego wspierającego Fundację Siepomaga. Biuro zawodów otwarte od 8:30, odbiór numerów startowych i chipów w dniu biegu. Uczestnicy z karnetem mogą skorzystać z jednego bezpłatnego startu w innym mieście po wcześniejszym zgłoszeniu mailowym. Brak limitu uczestników. Wspólna rozgrzewka z Ambasadorkami CITY TRAIL przed startem. W sezonie 2026/2027 biegi CITY TRAIL w Trójmieście odbywają się w Gdańsku i Gdyni.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa to coroczna, bezpłatna liga biegowa i nordic walking, która odbywa się na malowniczych trasach Gminy Międzyzdroje. W sezonie 2026/2027 zawodnicy rywalizują na dystansach około 5 i 10 km w biegu oraz 5 i 7 km w nordic walking. Liga słynie z przyjaznej, rodzinnej atmosfery i zdrowej rywalizacji, zapraszając zarówno stałych uczestników, jak i nowych miłośników aktywnego wypoczynku. Aby znaleźć się w klasyfikacji generalnej, należy ukończyć co najmniej cztery zawody z wymaganymi dystansami. Zawody są otwarte dla osób powyżej 14 roku życia, a udział jest bezpłatny.
course_highlights: Trasy o długości około 5 i 10 km dla biegaczy
Trasy o długości około 5 i 7 km dla uczestników nordic walking
Malownicze trasy Gminy Międzyzdroje
additional: Udział w zawodach jest bezpłatny. Wymagany wiek uczestników to minimum 14 lat, osoby niepełnoletnie mogą startować za pisemną zgodą rodziców lub opiekunów i pod ich opieką. Aby być klasyfikowanym w lidze, należy wystartować i ukończyć co najmniej cztery zawody z wymaganymi dystansami (dwukrotnie 5 km i dwukrotnie 10 km w biegu lub dwukrotnie 5 km i dwukrotnie 7 km w nordic walking). Cykl obejmuje kilka zawodów w sezonie; do klasyfikacji generalnej wymagany jest udział w co najmniej czterech. Zapisy prowadzone są przez ProTiming24. Wiek uczestników: od 14 lat; osoby niepełnoletnie potrzebują pisemnej zgody opiekuna.
